name: titlematchScore
desc: Titlematch score of the site, a signal that tells how well titles are matching user queries.
meaning: How well the site's page titles match the queries users type.

name: site2vecEmbeddingEncoded
desc: Encoded site2vec embedding (to be used in superroot) since the full embeddings take too much space.
meaning: A compressed vector representation of the site for use in serving.

name: smallPersonalSite
desc: Score of small personal site promotion go/promoting-personal-blogs-v1
meaning: A promotion score for small personal sites and blogs.

name: pnavClicks
desc: denominator for the pnav computation
meaning: The click count used as the denominator of the pnav fraction.

name: siteChunkSource
desc: These are only annotated in the Goldmine NSR annotator.
meaning: Which annotator produced the site grouping key.

name: siteAutopilotScore
desc: Aggregated value of url autopilot scores for this sitechunk.
meaning: The site-wide aggregate of per-page autopilot scores.

name: isVideoFocusedSite
desc: Bit to determine whether the site has mostly video content, but is not hosted on any known video-hosting domains. Site is considered to be video-focused, if it has > 50% of the URLs with watch pages (with smoothing prior). ariane/4045246
meaning: Whether most of the site's pages are video watch pages.

name: chromeInTotal
desc: Site-level Chrome views.
meaning: How much Chrome viewing traffic the site gets overall.

name: chardScoreVariance
desc: Site-level Chard Variance for all pages of a site.
meaning: How much predicted content quality varies across the site's pages.

name: chardScoreEncoded
desc: Site-level Chard (encoded as an int).
meaning: Versioned site-wide predicted content quality scores.

name: nsrdataFromFallbackPatternKey
desc: If true indicates that we do not have NSR data computed for the chunk, and instead the data is coming from an average of other host chunks.
meaning: A flag saying the site data was borrowed from an average of other hosts.

name: clusterId
desc: An id for defining clusters of sites. Used in ecosystem experiments (project Tundra).
meaning: An id grouping sites into clusters for ecosystem experiments.

name: localityScore
desc: Locality score of the site, i.e. the locality component of the LocalAuthority signal (see go/pq-localauthority).
meaning: How local the site is, as the locality part of a local authority signal.

name: siteChunk
desc: Primary NSR sitechunk. In most of the cases it's same as HOST_LEVEL_V3 sitechunked canonical url of the document. In rare, but important cases it's based on page markup (see quality/nsr/util/sitechunker.h for details).
meaning: The main site grouping key for this record.

name: i18nBucket
desc: Currently corresponds to i18n_g42_bucket.
meaning: An internationalization bucket id assigned to the site.

name: chardEncoded
desc: Site-level chard score: site quality predictor based on content.
meaning: A site-wide predicted content quality score, stored as an integer.

name: nsrEpoch
desc: The epoch from which this NSR value is coming from.
meaning: Which data epoch this site quality value came from.

name: tofu
desc: Site-level tofu score: site quality predictor based on content.
meaning: A site-wide content-based quality prediction.

name: siteLinkOut
desc: Aggregated value of url link out scores for this sitechunk.
meaning: The aggregated outgoing link score of the site's pages.

name: nsrOverrideBid
desc: This signal is used to unconditionally override NSR as a bid in Q*. Should only be used in case of emergency (see go/nsr-override-bid). To have any effect, the value should be present and greater than 0.001.
meaning: A manual value that replaces the site quality score in ranking when set.

name: isCovidLocalAuthority
desc: Bit to determine whether the site has the local authority covid signal, as computed by go/covid-local-authority
meaning: Whether the site counts as a local authority for COVID information.

name: pnav
desc: Fractional signals.
meaning: A site-level fraction describing navigational click behavior.

name: siteQualityStddev
desc: Estimate of site's PQ rating stddev--spread of the page-level PQ ratings of a site. Note this is different from nsr_variance which predicts error of NSR itself from the aggregated site-level rating.
meaning: How widely page quality ratings vary across the site.

name: impressions
desc: Site-level impressions.
meaning: How often the site's pages were shown in results.

name: vlq
desc: Score of the Video LQ model.
meaning: A score from a model that spots low-quality video sites.

name: racterScores
desc: Site-level AGC classification score (see also go/project-racter-overview).
meaning: Site-level scores from a classifier for auto-generated content.

name: spambrainLavcScore
desc: The SpamBrain LAVC score, as of July 2022. See more information at go/cloverfield-lavc-deck.
meaning: A site-level spam score produced by the SpamBrain system.

name: secondarySiteChunk
desc: Secondary NSR sitechunk. When present, it provides more granular chunking than primary sitechunks (see quality/nsr/util/sitechunker.h for details).
meaning: A finer-grained site grouping key for this record.

name: articleScore
desc: Score from article classification of the site.
meaning: How article-like the site's content is, per a classifier.

name: site2vecEmbedding
desc: Site2vec embeddings.
meaning: A vector representation of the site.

name: versionedData
desc: Versioned map of NSR values for experimenting with the next release.
meaning: Site quality values kept per version for testing new releases.

name: siteLinkIn
desc: Average value of the site_link_in for pages in the sitechunk.
meaning: The average incoming link score of the site's pages.

name: ketoVersionedData
desc: Keto data.
meaning: The site's keto quality scores across versions.

name: isElectionAuthority
desc: Bit to determine whether the site has the election authority signal, as computed by go/election-authority
meaning: Whether the site counts as an authority on elections.

name: priorAdjustedNsr
desc: NSR - prior. Estimate of whether the site is above/below average NSR in its slice.
meaning: How far the site's quality sits above or below average for its group.

name: healthScore
desc: Categorical signals.
meaning: A site-level score within the categorical health grouping.

name: clutterScore
desc: Delta site-level signal in Q* penalizing sites with a large number of distracting/annoying resources loaded by the site (see go/clutter-v0).
meaning: A site-level penalty for loading many distracting or annoying extra resources.

name: vlqNsr
desc: NSR from a headroom model targeting low-quality video sites.
meaning: A site quality value from a model aimed at low-quality video sites.

name: scienceDoctype
desc: Scholar/Science Document type: <0 == not a Science Document -- default 0 == Science doc fully visible >0 == Science doc but limited visibility, the number is the visible terms
meaning: A code marking the document as a Scholar science document and how much of it is visible.

name: ScaledExptIndyRank2
desc: experimental
meaning: A second experimental independence-rank value.

name: videoLanguage
desc: Audio-based language classified by Automatic Language Identification (only for watch pages).
meaning: The spoken language of a watch page's video, detected from the audio.

name: uacSpamScore
desc: The uac spam score is represented in 7 bits, going from 0 to 127. Threshold is 64. Score >= 64 is considered as uac spam.
meaning: A 0-127 spam score where 64 or more marks the page as UAC spam.

name: DEPRECATEDAuthorObfuscatedGaia
desc: The obfuscated google profile gaia id(s) of the author(s) of the document. This field is deprecated, use the string version.
meaning: Old obfuscated Google profile IDs for the page's authors; replaced by a string version.

name: spamtokensContentScore
desc: For SpamTokens content scores. Used in SiteBoostTwiddler to determine whether a page is UGC Spam. See go/spamtokens-dd for details.
meaning: A content score used to decide whether a page is user-generated-content spam.

name: webrefEntities
desc: WebRef entities associated to the document. See go/webref for details.
meaning: The WebRef entities that the document is about.

name: PremiumData
desc: Additional metadata for Premium document in the Google index.
meaning: Extra index metadata kept for premium documents.

name: spamMuppetSignals
desc: Contains hacked site signals which will be used in query time joins. As of Oct'19, the field is stored in a separate corpus. It'll only be populated for in-flight requests between retrieve and full-score in perdocdata. So no extra storage is needed on muppet side.
meaning: Signals about the site being hacked, joined in at query time.

name: knexAnnotation
desc: For indexing k'nex annotations for FreshDocs.
meaning: Stored k'nex annotations attached to fresh documents.

name: smartphoneData
desc: Additional metadata for smartphone documents in the Google index.
meaning: Extra index metadata kept for smartphone versions of documents.

name: semanticDateConfidence
desc: DEPRECATED: semantic_date_confidence replaced by semantic_date_info.
meaning: A deprecated confidence value for the semantic date, replaced by the newer info field.

name: trendspamScore
desc: For now, the count of matching trendspam queries.
meaning: How many trending-spam queries the document matches.

name: ScaledSpamScoreYoram
desc: Spamscores are represented as a 7-bit integer, going from 0 to 127.
meaning: A 0-127 spam score for the document under the Yoram scheme.

name: numUrls
desc: Total number of urls encoded in the url section = # of alternate urls + 1
meaning: A count of how many URLs are packed into the document's URL section.

name: datesInfo
desc: Stores dates-related info (e.g. page is old based on its date annotations). Used in FreshnessTwiddler. Use encode/decode functions from quality/timebased/utils/dates-info-helper-inl.h
meaning: Encoded information about the page's dates, such as whether its dates look old.

name: nsrDataProto
desc: Stripped site-level signals, not present in the explicit nsr_* fields, nor compressed_quality_signals.
meaning: A container of site-level quality signals not stored in the separate NSR fields.

name: fringeQueryPrior
desc: Contains encoded FringeQueryPrior information. Unlikely to be meaningful for anyone other than fringe-ranking team. Contact fringe-ranking team if any questions, but do NOT use directly without consulting them.
meaning: Encoded prior about fringe queries for this document, owned by the fringe ranking team.

name: ymylHealthScore
desc: Stores scores of ymyl health classifier as defined at go/ymyl-classifier-dd. To use this field, you MUST join g/pq-classifiers-announce and add your use case at
meaning: A classifier score for how much the page is health content in a sensitive area.

name: lastSignificantUpdate
desc: Last significant update of the document. This is sourced from the quality_timebased.LastSignificantUpdate proto as computed by the LSUSelector from various signals. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds.
meaning: The timestamp of the last meaningful change to the document.

name: spambrainData
desc: Host-v1 sitechunk level scores coming from spambrain.
meaning: SpamBrain scores computed at the host level for this site.

name: tundraClusterId
desc: This field is propagated to shards. Stores clustering information on a site level for the Tundra project. This field is deprecated - used the equivalent field inside nsr_data_proto instead.
meaning: A deprecated site-level cluster identifier from the Tundra project.

name: homepagePagerankNs
desc: The page-rank of the homepage of the site. Copied from the cdoc.doc().pagerank_ns() of the homepage.
meaning: The pagerank of the site's homepage, copied onto this document.

name: topPetacatTaxId
desc: Top petacat of the site. Used in SiteboostTwiddler to determine result/query matching.
meaning: The site's main topic category, used to check how well a result matches a query.

name: OriginalContentScore
desc: The original content score is represented as a 7-bits, going from 0 to 127. Only pages with little content have this field. The actual original content score ranges from 0 to 512. It is encoded with quality_q2::OriginalContentUtil::EncodeOriginalContentScore(). To decode the value, use quality_q2::OriginalContentUtil::DecodeOriginalContentScore().
meaning: A score for how original the page's content is, stored for pages with little content.

name: DocLevelSpamScore
desc: The document spam score is represented as a 7-bits, going from 0 to 127.
meaning: A 0-127 spam score for the individual document.

name: urlPoisoningData
desc: Contains url poisoning data for suppressing spam documents.
meaning: Data about URL poisoning used to hold back spam documents.

name: Event
desc: Free form debug info. NB2: consider carefully what to save here. It's easy to eat lots of gfs space with debug info that nobody needs...
meaning: Free-form debug notes attached to a document.

name: mediaOrPeopleEntities
desc: Contains the mids of the 5 most topical entities annotated with selected KG collections. This information is currently used on Image Search to detect cases where results converged to mostly a single person or media entity. More details: go/result-set-convergence.
meaning: The five most topical person or media entities on the page, used by Image Search.

name: scaledSelectionTierRank
desc: Selection tier rank is a language normalized score ranging from 0-32767 over the serving tier (Base, Zeppelins, Landfills) for this document. This is converted back to fractional position within the index tier by scaled_selection_tier_rank/32767.
meaning: A 0-32767 value giving the document's position within its index serving tier.

name: pagerank
desc: Experimental pageranks (DEPRECATED; only pagerank in MustangBasicInfo is used).
meaning: Deprecated experimental pagerank values; only the pagerank in basic info is used.

name: QuarantineInfo
desc: bitmask of QuarantineBits (or'd together) used to store quarantine related information. For example: QUARANTINE_WHITELIST | QUARANTINE_URLINURL.
meaning: A bitmask of quarantine flags recorded for the document, such as whitelisted or url-in-url.

name: rosettaLanguages
desc: Top two document language BCP-47 codes as generated by the RosettaLanguageAnnotator in the decreasing order of probability.
meaning: The page's top two language codes from the Rosetta language annotator.

name: freshnessEncodedSignals
desc: Stores freshness and aging related data, such as time-related quality metrics predicted from url-pattern level signals. Use the encoding decoding API in quality/freshness/docclassifier/aging/encoded-pattern-signals.h This field is deprecated.
meaning: Deprecated packed freshness and aging data derived from URL-pattern signals.

name: queriesForWhichOfficial
desc: The set of (query, country, language) triples for which this document is considered to be the official page. For example, www.britneyspears.com would be official for ("britney spears", "us", 0) and others (0 is English).
meaning: The query, country and language combinations for which this page counts as the official page.

name: nsrIsCovidLocalAuthority
desc: This field is propagated to shards. In addition, it is populated at serving time by go/web-signal-joins. This field is deprecated - used the equivalent field inside nsr_data_proto instead.
meaning: Deprecated flag marking the site as a local COVID authority.

name: crawlerIdProto
desc: For crawler-ID variations, the crawling context applied to the document. See go/url, and the description in google3/indexing/crawler_id
meaning: The crawling context that was used when fetching this document.

name: v2KnexAnnotation
desc: For indexing v2 k'nex, see/go/knex-v2-doc-annotation for details.
meaning: Stored second-generation k'nex annotations for the document.

name: MobileData
desc: Additional metadata for lowend mobile documents in the Google index.
meaning: Extra index metadata kept for low-end mobile versions of documents.

name: BookCitationData
desc: the book citation data for each web page, the average size is about 10 bytes
meaning: Book citation information attached to a web page, about ten bytes per page.

name: semanticDate
desc: SemanticDate, estimated date of the content of a document based on the contents of the document (via parsing), anchors and related documents. Date is encoded as a 32-bits UNIX date (1970 Jan 1 epoch). Confidence is encoded using a SemanticDate specific format. For details of encoding, please refer to quality/freshness/docclassifier/semanticdate/public/semantic_date.proto
meaning: An estimated date for the page's content, derived from the page, its anchors and related pages.

name: biasingdata2
desc: A replacement for BiasingPerDocData that is more space efficient. Once this is live everywhere, biasingdata will be deprecated.
meaning: A more space-efficient container of per-document biasing data.

name: ymylNewsScore
desc: Stores scores of ymyl news classifier as defined at go/ymyl-classifier-dd. To use this field, you MUST join g/pq-classifiers-announce and add your use case at
meaning: A classifier score for how much the page is news content in a sensitive area.

name: saftLanguageInt
desc: Top document language as generated by SAFT LangID. For now we store bare minimum: just the top 1 language value, converted to the language enum, and only when different from the first value in 'languages'.
meaning: The page's top language from a second language identifier, stored when it differs.

name: rsApplication
desc: Application information associated to the document.
meaning: Rich snippet application information found on the page.

name: domainAge
desc: 16-bit
meaning: The age of the domain, stored as a 16-bit value.

name: lastSignificantUpdateInfo
desc: Metadata about last significant update. Currently this only encodes the quality_timebased.LastSignificantUpdate.source field which contains the info on the source of the signal. NOTE: Please do not read the value directly. Use helpers from quality/timebased/lastsignificantupdate/lsu-helper.h instead.
meaning: Extra detail recording where the last-significant-update timestamp came from.

name: spamCookbookAction
desc: Actions based on Cookbook recipes that match the page.
meaning: Actions triggered when the page matches a spam Cookbook recipe.

name: compressedUrl
desc: Compressed URL string used for SETI.
meaning: A compressed copy of the page URL used by an internal system.

name: extraData
desc: This field is available only in the docjoins: it is cleared before building per-doc data in both Mustang and Teragoogle. (MessageSet is inefficient in space for serving data) Use this for all new fields that aren't needed during serving. Currently this field contains:
meaning: A grab bag of extra fields kept only in docjoins and cleared before serving.

name: socialgraphNodeNameFp
desc: For Social Search we store the fingerprint of the SG node name. This is used in one of the superroot's PRE_DOC twiddlers as a lookup key for the full Social Search data. PRE_DOC = twiddlers firing before the DocInfo request is sent to the mustang backend.
meaning: A fingerprint used as a lookup key for social search data.

name: urlAfterRedirectsFp
desc: These two fingerprints are used for de-duping results in a twiddler. They should only be populated by freshdocs, and will only be present for documents that are chosen to be canonicals in a cluster whose previous canonical is also in the index. Additionally, url_after_redirects_fp is only present if it is different from a fingerprint of the URL.
meaning: A fingerprint of the URL after redirects, used to remove duplicate results.

name: localizedCluster
desc: Information on localized clusters, which is the relationship of translated and/or localized pages.
meaning: Grouping information linking translated or localized versions of a page.

name: pageregions
desc: String that encodes the position ranges for different regions of the document. See "indexer/pageregion.h" for an explanation, and how to decode the string
meaning: An encoded map of where the different regions of the page start and end.

name: KeywordStuffingScore
desc: The keyword stuffing score is represented in 7 bits, going from 0 to 127.
meaning: A 0-127 score for how much the page repeats keywords unnaturally.

name: spambrainTotalDocSpamScore
desc: The document total spam score identified by spambrain, going from 0 to 1.
meaning: SpamBrain's overall spam score for the document, from 0 to 1.

name: noimageframeoverlayreason
desc: If not 0, we should not show the image in overlay mode in image snippets
meaning: A reason code saying the image should not be shown in overlay mode in image snippets.

name: scienceHoldingsIds
desc: Deprecated 2016/01/14.
meaning: Scholar holdings identifiers, deprecated since 2016.

name: crawlPagerank
desc: This field is used internally by the docjoiner to forward the crawl pageranks from original canonicals to canonicals we actually chose; outside sources should not set it, and it should not be present in actual docjoins or the index.
meaning: An internal pass-through of crawl pagerank that should never appear in the index.

name: nsrIsVideoFocusedSite
desc: This field is propagated to shards. It will also be populated at serving time by go/web-signal-joins (see b/170607253). Bit indicating whether this site is video-focused, but not hosted on any major known video hosting domains. This field is deprecated - used the equivalent field inside nsr_data_proto instead.
meaning: Deprecated flag marking the site as video-focused but not a major video host.

name: spamrank
desc: The spamrank measures the likelihood that this document links to known spammers. Its value is between 0 and 65535.
meaning: A 0-65535 measure of how likely the page is to link to known spammers.

name: s3AudioLanguage
desc: Primary video's audio language classified by S3 based Automatic Language Identification (only for watch pages).
meaning: The spoken language of a watch page's main video, detected from the audio.

name: watchpageLanguageResult
desc: Language classified by the WatchPageLanguage Model (go/watchpage-language). Only present for watch pages.
meaning: The language of a watch page as judged by a dedicated model.

name: appsLink
desc: AppsLink contains Android application IDs in outlinks. It is used to improve results ranking within applications universal. See
meaning: Android app IDs found in the page's outgoing links, used for app results.

name: desktopInterstitials
desc: Contains desktop interstitials signal for VOLT ranking change.
meaning: A signal about interstitials shown on desktop, used by the VOLT ranking change.

name: nsrSitechunk
desc: SiteChunk computed for nsr. It some cases it can use more information than just url (e.g. youtube channels). See NsrAnnotator for details. If sitechunk is longer than --populate_nsr_sitechunk_max_length (default=100), it will not get populated. This field might be compressed and needs to be decoded with quality_nsr::util::DecodeNsrSitechunk. See go/nsr-chunks for more details. This field contains only nontrivial primary chunks.
meaning: An encoded identifier for the chunk of a site that site signals are grouped under.

name: originalTitleHardTokenCount
desc: The number of hard tokens in the title.
meaning: How many hard tokens the original title contained.

name: hostAge
desc: The earliest firstseen date of all pages in this host/domain. These data are used in twiddler to sandbox fresh spam in serving time. It is 16 bit and the time is day number after 2005-12-31, and all the previous time are set to 0. If this url's host_age == domain_age, then omit domain_age Please use //spam/content/siteage-util.h to convert the day between epoch second. Regarding usage of Sentinel values: We would like to check if a value exists in scoring bundle while using in Ranklab AST. For t
meaning: The earliest date any page on this host was first seen, used to sandbox fresh spam.

name: inNewsstand
desc: This field indicates whether the document is in the newsstand corpus.
meaning: Flag saying the document belongs to the newsstand collection.

name: launchAppInfo
desc: Info on how to launch a mobile app to consume this document's content, if applicable (see go/calypso).
meaning: Instructions for opening a mobile app to view this document's content.

name: eventsDate
desc: Date for Events. A web page might list multiple events with different dates. We only take one date (start date) per event.
meaning: The start dates of events listed on the page, one date per event.

name: GibberishScore
desc: The gibberish score is represented in 7 bits, going from 0 to 127.
meaning: A 0-127 score for how much of the page reads as nonsense text.

name: toolbarPagerank
desc: A copy of the value stored in /namespace/indexing/wwwglobal//fakepr/* for this document. A value of quality_bakery::FakeprUtils::kUnknownToolbarPagerank indicates that we don't have toolbar pagerank for this document. A value between 0 and 10 (inclusive) means that this is the toolbar pagerank of the page. Finally, if this value is not set it means that the toolbar pagerank is equivalent to: quality_bakery::FakeprUtils::EstimatePreDemotionFromPagerankNearestSeeds( basic_info.pagerank_ns()) calle
meaning: A stored copy of the page's 0-10 toolbar pagerank value.

name: freshboxArticleScores
desc: Stores scores of freshness-related classifiers: freshbox article score, live blog score and host-level article score. The encoding/decoding API is in quality/freshness/freshbox/goldmine/freshbox_annotation_encoder.h. To use this field, you MUST join g/pq-classifiers-announce and add your use case at
meaning: Packed scores from freshness classifiers, including news article and live blog scores.

name: ScaledExptIndyRank3
desc: experimental
meaning: A third experimental independence-rank value.

name: nsrIsElectionAuthority
desc: This field is propagated to shards. It will also be populated at serving time by go/web-signal-joins (see b/168114815). This field is deprecated - used the equivalent field inside nsr_data_proto instead.
meaning: Deprecated flag marking the site as an election authority.

name: onsiteProminence
desc: Onsite prominence measures the importance of the document within its site. It is computed by propagating simulated traffic from the homepage and high craps click pages. It is a 13-bit int.
meaning: A measure of how important the page is within its own site, from simulated traffic.

name: travelGoodSitesInfo
desc: This field stores information about good travel sites.
meaning: Stored information about travel sites judged good.

name: IsAnchorBayesSpam
desc: Is this document considered spam by the anchor bayes classifier?
meaning: Flag saying the anchor-text Bayes classifier judged this document spam.

name: isHotdoc
desc: Set by the FreshDocs instant doc joiner. See //indexing/instant/hotdocs/README and
meaning: Flag set by the fresh-document pipeline marking this as a currently hot document.

name: commercialScore
desc: A measure of commerciality of the document Score > 0 indicates document is commercial (i.e. sells something) Computed by repository/pageclassifiers/parsehandler-commercial.cc
meaning: A score for how commercial the page is; above zero means it sells something.

name: asteroidBeltIntents
desc: For indexing Asteroid Belt intent scores. See go/asteroid-belt for details.
meaning: Stored intent scores for the document from the Asteroid Belt project.

name: TagPageScore
desc: Tag-site-ness of a page, repesented in 7-bits range from 0 to 100. Smaller value means worse tag page.
meaning: A 0-100 score for how much the page looks like a thin tag listing page.

name: geodata
desc: geo data; approx 24 bytes for 23M U.S. pages
meaning: A compact blob of geographic data about the page.

name: oceandata
desc: 28 bytes per page, only in the Ocean index
meaning: A small data block used only by the Ocean index.

name: SpamWordScore
desc: The spamword score is represented in 7-bits, going from 0 to 127.
meaning: A 0-127 score for how many spammy words appear on the page.

name: ScaledIndyRank
desc: The independence rank is represented as a 16-bit integer, which is multiplied by (max_indy_rank / 65536) to produce actual independence rank values. max_indy_rank is typically 0.84.
meaning: An independence rank stored as a 16-bit number that is scaled back to its real value.

name: bodyWordsToTokensRatioBegin
desc: The body words over tokens ratios for the beginning part and whole doc. NB: To save space, field body_words_to_tokens_ratio_total is not set if it has the same value as body_words_to_tokens_ratio_begin (e.g., short docs).
meaning: The ratio of real words to tokens in the opening part of the page body.

name: fireflySiteSignal
desc: Contains Site signal information for Firefly ranking change. See
meaning: Site-level signal data used by the Firefly ranking change.

name: titleHardTokenCountWithoutStopwords
desc: Number of hard tokens originally in title without counting the stopwords.
meaning: How many hard tokens the title has once stopwords are excluded.

name: hostNsr
desc: Site rank computed for host-level sitechunks. This value encodes nsr, site_pr and new_nsr. See quality_nsr::util::ConvertNsrDataToHostNsr and go/nsr. This field is deprecated - used the equivalent field inside nsr_data_proto instead.
meaning: A deprecated packed site rank value; the same data now lives in the NSR data proto.

name: semanticDateInfo
desc: Info is encoded using a SemanticDate specific format. Contains confidence scores for day/month/year components as well as various meta data required by the freshness twiddlers.
meaning: Packed confidence and metadata about the page's estimated date, used by freshness reranking.

name: languages
desc: Plausible languages in order of decreasing plausibility. Language values are small, IE < 127 so this should compress to one byte each.
meaning: The likely languages of the page, listed most likely first.

name: GroupsData
desc: 16 bytes of groups2 data: used only in groups2 index
meaning: A small block of data used only by the Groups index.

name: countryInfo
desc: This field stores the country information for the document in the form of CountryAttachment.
meaning: The country information recorded for the document.

name: brainloc
desc: Brainloc contains location information for the document. See ariane/273189 for details.
meaning: Location information attached to the document.

name: ScaledLinkAgeSpamScore
desc: End DEPRECATED ------------------------------------------------------------ Link age score is represented as a 7-bit integer, going from 0 to 127.
meaning: A 0-127 score based on the age of links pointing at the page.

name: ScaledExptIndyRank
desc: DEPRECATED ---------------------------------------------------------------- Please do not use these fields in any new code. experimental
meaning: An old experimental independence-rank value marked deprecated and not for new code.

name: productSitesInfo
desc: This field stores information about product sites.
meaning: Stored information about product sites.

name: spambrainDomainSitechunkData
desc: Domain sitechunk level scores coming from spambrain.
meaning: SpamBrain scores computed at the domain level for this site.

name: voltData
desc: Contains page UX signals for VOLT ranking change. See
meaning: Page experience signals used by the VOLT ranking change.

name: timeSensitivity
desc: Encoded Document Time Sensitivity signal.
meaning: An encoded measure of how time-sensitive the document is.

name: servingTimeClusterIds
desc: A set of cluster ids which are generated in Alexandria and used to de-dup results at serving time.
meaning: Cluster identifiers used to remove near-duplicate results when serving.

name: ugcDiscussionEffortScore
desc: UGC page quality signals. (Times 1000 and floored)
meaning: A score for the effort behind user-generated discussion content on the page.

name: experimentalQstarDeltaSignal
desc: This field is
meaning: An experimental value measuring a change in a Q* scoring signal.

name: productReviewPDemoteSite
desc: Product review demotion/promotion confidences. (Times 1000 and floored)
meaning: A confidence value used to demote or promote a site for product reviews.

name: experimentalQstarSiteSignal
desc: This field is
meaning: An experimental site-level value tested in Q* scoring.

name: exactMatchDomainDemotion
desc: Page quality signals converted from fields in proto QualityBoost in quality/q2/proto/quality-boost.proto. To save indexing space, we convert the float values in [0, 1] to integers in range [0, 1023] (use 10 bits). exact_match_domain_demotion: converted from QualityBoost.emd.boost.
meaning: A stored demotion for domains that exactly match the query words.

name: nsrVersionedData
desc: Versioned NSR score to be used in continuous evaluation of the upcoming NSR version and assess quality impact on various slices. This field is deprecated - used the equivalent field inside nsr_data_proto instead.
meaning: Deprecated copies of the site quality score kept per version for evaluation.

name: nsrConfidence
desc: NSR confidence score: converted from quality_nsr.NsrData. This field is deprecated - use nsr_variance inside nsr_data_proto instead.
meaning: A deprecated confidence number for the site quality score.

name: lowQuality
desc: S2V low quality score: converted from quality_nsr.NsrData, applied in Qstar. See quality_nsr::util::ConvertNsrDataToLowQuality.
meaning: A low quality score for the site, applied during Q* scoring.

name: navDemotion
desc: nav_demotion: converted from QualityBoost.nav_demoted.boost.
meaning: A stored demotion for pages flagged by the navigational demotion system.

name: pqData
desc: Encoded page-level PQ signals.
meaning: Encoded page-level page quality signals.

name: siteAuthority
desc: site_authority: converted from quality_nsr.SiteAuthority, applied in Qstar.
meaning: A site-level authority score applied during Q* scoring.

name: crapsNewUrlSignals
desc: For craps
meaning: URL-level click and impression data for the Craps system.

name: babyPandaV2Demotion
desc: New BabyPanda demotion, applied on top of Panda. This is meant to replace |baby_panda_demotion|.
meaning: A newer quality demotion applied on top of the Panda demotion.

name: authorityPromotion
desc: authority promotion: converted from QualityBoost.authority.boost
meaning: A stored promotion value that raises pages judged authoritative.

name: productReviewPUhqPage
desc: The possibility of a page being a high quality review page.
meaning: The estimated chance that the page is a high quality review page.

name: crapsAbsoluteHostSignals
desc: Impressions, unsquashed, host level, not to be used with compressed ratios. Not to be used in Pattern Data.
meaning: Raw host-level impression counts used by the Craps click and impression system.

name: nsrOverrideBid
desc: NSR override bid, used in Q* for emergency overrides. This field is deprecated - used the equivalent field inside nsr_data_proto instead.
meaning: A deprecated manual override value for the site quality score.

name: babyPandaDemotion
desc: baby_panda_demotion: converted from QualityBoost.rendered.boost.
meaning: A stored quality demotion value in the Panda family.

name: serpDemotion
desc: serp demotion: applied in Qstar.
meaning: A demotion value applied to the page during Q* scoring.

name: anchorMismatchDemotion
desc: anchor_mismatch_demotion: converted from QualityBoost.mismatched.boost.
meaning: A stored demotion value for pages whose anchor text does not match the page.

name: experimentalQstarSignal
desc: This field is
meaning: An experimental page-level value tested in Q* scoring.

name: pairwiseqScoringData
desc: Deprecated and unused field.
meaning: A deprecated and unused scoring data holder.

name: topicEmbeddingsVersionedData
desc: Versioned TopicEmbeddings data to be populated later into superroot / used directly in scorers.
meaning: Versioned topic embedding data for the page that scorers can read directly.

name: scamness
desc: Scam model score. Used as one of the web page quality qstar signals. Value range from 0 to 1023.
meaning: A model score for how scam-like the page looks, used in quality scoring.

name: pandaDemotion
desc: This is the encoding of Panda fields in the proto SiteQualityFeatures in quality/q2/proto/site_quality_features.proto. The encoding/decoding is performed using functions from quality_coati::coati_util.
meaning: The encoded Panda site quality demotion for the page.

name: unauthoritativeScore
desc: Unauthoritative score. Used as one of the web page quality qstar signals.
meaning: A score for how unauthoritative the page looks, used in quality scoring.

name: experimentalNsrTeamWsjData
desc: This field is
meaning: A second experimental site quality data set kept by the site quality team.

name: experimentalNsrTeamData
desc: This field is
meaning: Experimental site quality data kept by the site quality team.

name: productReviewPReviewPage
desc: Fields product_review_p_review_page and product_review_p_uhq_page are for promoting/demoting HQ/LQ review pages in NGS. See go/pr-boosts for details. The possibility of a page being a review page.
meaning: The estimated chance that the page is a product review page.

name: pqDataProto
desc: Stripped page-level signals, not present in the encoded field 'pq_data'.
meaning: Page-level quality signals kept outside the encoded page quality field.

name: pairwiseqVersionedData
desc: Versioned PairwiseQ score to be used in continuous evaluation of the upcoming PairwiseQ versions and assess quality impact on various slices.
meaning: Copies of the PairwiseQ score kept per version to evaluate upcoming releases.

name: vlqNsr
desc: NSR for low-quality videos, converted from quality_nsr.NsrData.vlq_nsr. This field is deprecated - used the equivalent field inside nsr_data_proto instead.
meaning: A deprecated site quality score for low quality video pages.

name: absoluteImpressions
desc: Thus far this field is only used for host level unsquashed impressions. When compressed (e.g., in perdocdata.proto, CompressedQualitySignals), this value is represented individually and thus is generally incompatible with the other values which are compressed as click-ratios.
meaning: How many times results from this host were shown, as a raw count.

name: unicornClicks
desc: The subset of clicks that are associated with an event from a Unicorn user.
meaning: The share of clicks tied to a particular internal class of user sessions.

name: unsquashedClicks
desc: This is not being populated for the current format - instead two instances of CrapsClickSignals (squashed/unsquashed) are used. We are migrating to the new format where this field will be populated.
meaning: A raw click count field that is not filled in under the current format.

name: unsquashedImpressions
desc: This is not being populated for the current format - instead two instances of CrapsClickSignals (squashed/unsquashed) are used. We are migrating to the new format where this field will be populated.
meaning: A raw impression count field that is not filled in under the current format.

name: chard
desc: URL-level chard prediction (encoded as an int).
meaning: A page-level predicted content quality score.

name: chardScoreEncoded
desc: URL-level Chard (encoded as an int).
meaning: Versioned page-level predicted content quality scores.

name: contentEffort
desc: LLM-based effort estimation for article pages (see landspeeder/4311817).
meaning: A model's estimate of how much effort went into creating the page's content.

name: deltaSubchunkAdjustment
desc: Total deltaNSR adjustment based on subchunks. This is a page-level adjustment (subchunks are retrieved based on the page classification).
meaning: A page-level adjustment to site quality based on the page's topic group.

name: keto
desc: Keto score.
meaning: The page's keto quality score.

name: numOffdomainAnchors
desc: The total number of offdomain anchors seen by the NSR pipeline for this page.
meaning: How many links to this page come from other domains.

name: predictedDefaultNsr
desc: Predicted default NSR score computed in Goldmine via the NSR default predictor (go/default-nsr-predictor).
meaning: A predicted default site quality score computed for the page.

name: rhubarb
desc: Site-URL delta signals based quality score computed in Goldmine via the Rhubarb model (go/rhubarb-dd).
meaning: A page quality score based on how the page differs from its site.

name: tofu
desc: URL-level tofu prediction.
meaning: A page-level content-based quality prediction.

name: unversionedRhubarb
desc: The delta score of the URL-level quality predictor.
meaning: The page-level quality predictor's difference score.

name: vlq
desc: URL-level score of the VLQ model.
meaning: The page's score from the low-quality video model.

name: bylineDate
desc: The following field is set only when the byline date is different from the "date" field above. Currently this happens when the byline date is within the 24 hours of the crawl time, or close but not exactly the same as blog post date due to time zone. The syntactic date is never later than the crawl time. NOTE: If this field is set, use_as_byline_date will be meaningless, and better to be cleared.
meaning: The byline date, stored when it differs from the page's main date.

name: date
desc: The number of seconds since epoch (Jan 1, 1970). This can be negative to indicate a publication date that is before 1970. For example, the ones from NY Times archive: "
meaning: The page's publication date as seconds since 1970.

name: fromExplicitTimeZone
desc: If set to true, the source of the date has explicit time zone specification. Note: This is only used internally and should not be populated in docjoins.
meaning: Whether the date on the page stated its time zone; internal use only.

name: info
desc: Used to store extra information about the syntactic date. For now only two bits are set. Please refer to the encoding/decoding functions provided in: quality/timebased/syntacticdate/util.h Bit 1 = High confidence byline. This bit is set if the syntactic date has a byline date and this date is considered to be high confidence. Bit 2 = High confidence byline without content age. This bit is set if the syntactic date has a byline date and this date is considered to be high confidence without suppor
meaning: Flag bits saying whether the byline date is considered high confidence.

name: precisionMark
desc: The precision mark should be of type PRECISION_MARK.
meaning: How precise the extracted date is, for example day, month or year.

name: syntacticDateNotForRestrict
desc: If this is true, do not use syntactic date in date restricts.
meaning: Whether this date may be used when a searcher filters by date.

name: timeZoneOffsetSeconds
desc: Indicates the time zone offset in seconds applied to derive
meaning: The time-zone shift in seconds applied when working out the date.

name: adjustmentInfo
desc: This is stored only for debugging purposes. Please consult dates@ team before making a dependency on this field.
meaning: Details about date adjustments, stored only for debugging.

name: date
desc: LastSignificantUpdate as UNIX timestamp in seconds. This is the new signal (go/lsu-dd) from LSU Selector V2 (once that is enabled, see b/171879888 for status), falling back to the legacy V1 signal if the HIGH_PRECISION signal does not exist. Please use the 'source' field to determine where the value comes from.
meaning: The time the page was judged to have last meaningfully changed.

name: source
desc: The source the signal comes from.
meaning: Which component produced the last-significant-update time.

name: penguinLastUpdate
desc: BEGIN: Penguin related fields. Timestamp when penguin scores were last updated. Measured in days since Jan. 1st 1995.
meaning: When the page's Penguin scores were last refreshed.

name: badbacklinksPenalized
desc: Whether this doc is penalized by BadBackLinks, in which case we should not use improvanchor score in mustang ascorer.
meaning: Whether the page was penalized for bad backlinks, which suppresses its anchor score.

name: penguinPenalty
desc: Page-level penguin penalty (0 = good, 1 = bad).
meaning: The page-level Penguin link spam penalty, 0 good to 1 bad.

name: minHostHomePageLocalOutdegree
desc: Minimum local outdegree of all anchor sources that are host home pages as well as on the same host as the current target URL.
meaning: Smallest outbound link count among same-host home pages linking here.

name: droppedRedundantAnchorCount
desc: Sum of anchors_dropped in the repeated group RedundantAnchorInfo, but can go higher if the latter reaches the cap of kMaxRecordsToKeep. (indexing/docjoiner/anchors/anchor-loader.cc), currently 10,000
meaning: How many anchors were dropped as redundant.

name: penguinEarlyAnchorProtected
desc: Doc is protected by goodness of early anchors.
meaning: Whether early good anchors shield the page from a link penalty.

name: penguinTooManySources
desc: Doc not scored because it has too many anchor sources. END: Penguin related fields.
meaning: Whether the page was left unscored because it had too many linking sources.

name: anchorSpamInfo
desc: This structure contains signals and penalties of AnchorSpamPenalizer. It replaces phrase_anchor_spam_info above, that is deprecated.
meaning: Bundle of anchor spam signals and penalties for the page.

name: minDomainHomePageLocalOutdegree
desc: Minimum local outdegree of all anchor sources that are domain home pages as well as on the same domain as the current target URL.
meaning: Smallest outbound link count among same-domain home pages linking here.

name: skippedAccumulate
desc: A count of the number of times anchor accumulation has been skipped for this document. Note: Only used when canonical.
meaning: How many times anchor collection was skipped for this page.

name: topPrOnsiteAnchorCount
desc: According to anchor quality bucket, anchor with pagrank > 51000 is the best anchor. anchors with pagerank < 47000 are all same.
meaning: How many high-PageRank same-site anchors point at the page.

name: spamLog10Odds
desc: The log base 10 odds that this set of anchors exhibits spammy behavior. Computed in the AnchorLocalizer.
meaning: Log-odds score that the page's anchor set looks spammy.

name: pageFromExpiredTaggedAnchors
desc: Set in SignalPenalizer::FillInAnchorStatistics.
meaning: Count of anchors coming from pages tagged as expired.

name: phraseAnchorSpamInfo
desc: Following signals identify spike of spammy anchor phrases. Anchors created during the spike are tagged with LINK_SPAM_PHRASE_SPIKE.
meaning: Bundle of signals about a spike in spammy anchor phrases.

name: anchorPhraseCount
desc: The number of unique anchor phrases. Capped by the constant kMaxAnchorPhraseCountInStats (=5000) defined in indexing/docjoiner/anchors/anchor-manager.cc.
meaning: How many distinct anchor phrases point at the page, capped at 5000.

name: totalDomainsAbovePhraseCap
desc: Number of domains above per domain phrase cap. We see too many phrases in the domains.
meaning: How many domains exceeded the per-domain phrase cap.

name: totalDomainsSeen
desc: Number of domains seen in total.
meaning: How many distinct domains link to the page.

name: scannedAnchorCount
desc: The total number of anchors being scanned from storage.
meaning: How many anchors were read out of storage.

name: globalAnchorDelta
desc: Metric of number of changed global anchors computed as, size(union(previous, new) - intersection(previous, new)).
meaning: How much the set of links pointing at the page changed.

name: totalDomainPhrasePairsSeenApprox
desc: Number of domain/phrase pairs in total -- i.e. how many anchors we would have if the domain/phrase cutoff was set to 1 instead of 200. This is "approx" for large anchor clusters because there can be double counting when the LRU cache forgets about rare domain/phrase pairs.
meaning: Roughly how many domain and phrase pairs were seen before capping.

name: skippedOrReusedReason
desc: Reason to skip accumulate, when skipped, or Reason for reprocessing when not skipped.
meaning: Reason anchor collection was skipped or redone.

name: anchorsWithDedupedImprovanchors
desc: The number of anchors for which some ImprovAnchors phrases have been removed due to duplication within source org.
meaning: How many anchors had duplicate phrases removed within the linking organization.

name: redundantAnchorForPhraseCapCount
desc: Total anchor dropped due to exceed per domain phrase cap. Equals to sum of anchors_dropped in the repeated group RedundantAnchorInfoForPhraseCap, but can go higher if the latter reaches the cap of kMaxDomainsToKeepForPhraseCap (indexing/docjoiner/anchors/anchor-loader.h), currently 1000.
meaning: How many anchors were dropped for exceeding the per-domain phrase cap.

name: totalDomainPhrasePairsAboveLimit
desc: The following should be equal to the size of the following repeated group, except that it can go higher than 10,000.
meaning: How many domain and phrase pairs exceeded the cap.

name: timestamp
desc: Walltime of when anchors were accumulated last.
meaning: When anchors were last gathered.

name: creationDate
desc: used for history - the first and last time we have seen this anchor. creation_date also used for Freshdocs Twitter indexing, a retweet is an anchor of the original tweet. This field records the time when a retweet is created.
meaning: When the link was first seen, also used as retweet time in fresh indexing.

name: origText
desc: Original text, including capitalization and punctuation. Runs of whitespace are collapsed into a single space.
meaning: The link text exactly as written, keeping capitalization and punctuation.

name: context2
desc: This is a hash of terms near the anchor. (This is a second-generation hash replacing the value stored in the 'context' field.)
meaning: A hash of the words surrounding the link on the page.

name: experimental
desc: If true, the anchor is for experimental purposes and should not be used in serving.
meaning: Marks a link as test-only and not to be used in serving.

name: fragment
desc: The URL fragment for this anchor (the foo in
meaning: The fragment part of the link's target URL.

name: sourceType
desc: is to record the quality of the anchor's source page and is correlated with but not identical to the index tier of the source page. In the docjoins built by the indexing pipeline (Alexandria), - Anchors marked TYPE_HIGH_QUALITY are from base documents. - Anchors marked TYPE_MEDIUM_QUALITY are from documents of medium quality (roughly but not exactly supplemental tier documents). - Anchors marked TYPE_LOW_QUALITY are from documents of low quality (roughly but not exactly blackhole documents). Not
meaning: Quality band of the page the link came from: high, medium or low.

name: pagerankWeight
desc: Weight to be stored in linkmaps for pageranker
meaning: Weight given to this link when PageRank is computed.

name: isLocal
desc: The bit ~roughly~ indicates whether an anchor's source and target pages are on the same domain. Note: this plays no role in determining whether an anchor is onsite, ondomain, or offdomain in mustang (i.e., the bit above).
meaning: Roughly whether the linking page and the target page share a domain.

name: originalTargetDocid
desc: The docid of the anchor's original target. This field is available if and only if the anchor is forwarded.
meaning: Document id of the link's target before forwarding.

name: fullLeftContext
desc: The full context. These are not written out in the linklogs.
meaning: The full text appearing before the link on the page.

name: expired
desc: true iff exp domain
meaning: Flags that the linking domain is an expired one.

name: catfishTags
desc: CATfish tags attached to a link. These are similar to link tags, except the values are created on the fly within Cookbook. See:
meaning: Tags attached to a link that are generated on the fly rather than stored.

name: linkTags
desc: Contains info on link type, source page, etc.
meaning: Tags describing the link type and the page it came from.

name: forwardingTypes
desc: How the anchor is forwarded to the canonical, available only for forwarded anchors (i.e., the field is set). The forwarding types are defined in URLForwardingUtil (segindexer/segment-indexer-util.h). Always use URLForwardingUtil to access this field and use URLForwardingUtil::GetAnchorForwardingReason to get the explanation how the anchor is forwarded to the canonical. NOTE: Use with caution as it is only set for docjoins generated using the urlmap from repository/updater.
meaning: How the link was redirected onto the canonical URL.

name: possiblyOldFirstseenDate
desc: DEPRECATED. It used to be set if firstseen_date is not set. It's to indicate that the anchor is possibly old, but we don't have enough information to tell until the linkage map is updated. TODO(hxu) rename it to possibly_old_firstseen_date_DEPRECATED after clean up other dependencies.
meaning: Old flag meaning the link may be older than recorded; deprecated.

name: locality
desc: For ranking purposes, the quality of an anchor is measured by its "locality" and "bucket". See quality/anchors/definitions.h for more information.
meaning: A measure of how local a link is, used in judging link quality.

name: demotionreason
desc: DEPRECATED
meaning: Old field for why a link was demoted; deprecated.

name: parallelLinks
desc: The number of additional links from the same source page to the same target domain. Not populated if is_local is true.
meaning: How many other links on the same page point to the same target domain.

name: text
desc: Space-delimited anchor words. Text that needs segmentation (like CJK or Thai) is unsegmented, since we set FLAGS_segment_during_lexing to false in mr-linkextractor.cc .
meaning: The words that make up the link text.

name: targetUrlEncoding
desc: A given target URL may be found in different encodings in different documents. We store the URL encoding with each source anchor so that we can count them later to find the encoding most likely to be expected by the Web site. Around 0.7% of target URLs are expected to require a non-default value here. The default value 0 is referenced in C++ as webutil::kDefaultUrlEncoding. See also webutil/urlencoding.
meaning: Which character encoding the target URL was written in.

name: compressedOriginalTargetUrl
desc: The anchor's original target url, compressed. Available only in Alexandria docjoins when the anchor is forwarded.
meaning: Compressed form of the URL the link originally pointed to.

name: firstseenDate
desc: # days past Dec 31, 1994, 23:00:00 UTC (Unix time @788914800) that this link was first seen. Should never occupy more than 15 bits. NOTE: this is NOT the same as creation_date; firstseen_date is filled during link extraction
meaning: Day the link was first seen, counted from a fixed 1994 date.

name: setiPagerankWeight
desc: TEMPORARY
meaning: A second, temporary link weight for a PageRank variant.

name: linkAdditionalInfo
desc: Additional information related to the anchor, such as additional anchor text or scores.
meaning: Extra data about the link, such as further anchor text or scores.

name: type
desc: DEPRECATED: Now in link_tags
meaning: Old link type field, replaced by link tags.

name: firstseenNearCreation
desc: true if we think 'firstseen_date' is an accurate estimate of when the link was actually added to the source page. false if it may have existed for some time before we saw it.
meaning: Whether the first-seen date is close to when the link was actually added.

name: lastUpdateTimestamp
desc: Used for history and freshness tracking - the timestamp this anchor is updated in indexing.
meaning: When this link record was last refreshed during indexing.

name: offset
desc: This is the offset for the first term in the anchor - it can be used as a unique ID for the anchor within the document and compared against all per-tag data. This is measured in bytes from the start of the document. We write this out to the linklogs to recover the original order of links after source/target forwarding. This is necessary for computing the global related data.
meaning: Byte position of the link in the source page, used as its id there.

name: weight
desc: weights are 0-127
meaning: The link's weight on a scale of 0 to 127.

name: encodedNewsAnchorData
desc: Encoded data containing information about newsiness of anchor. Populated only if anchor is classified as coming from a newsy, high quality site. Encoded data for anchor sources are being stored in googledata/quality/freshness/news_anchors/encoded_news_anchors_data.txt Scores are being computed with quality/freshness/news_anchors/ routines.
meaning: Packed data marking links that come from newsy, high quality sites.

name: compressedImageUrls
desc: If the anchor contained images, these image urls are stored here in compressed form.
meaning: Compressed list of image URLs that appeared inside the link.

name: timestamp
desc: This field is DEPRECATED and no longer filled. For source page crawl timestamp, use Source.crawl_timestamp. Next tag id should be 62.
meaning: Old crawl time field for the link, no longer filled.

name: additionalInfo
desc: Additional information related to the source, such as news hub info.
meaning: Extra attached data about the linking page, such as news hub details.

name: cluster
desc: anchor++ cluster id
meaning: Internal cluster id for the linking page.

name: compressedUrl
desc: compressed source url
meaning: The linking page's URL in compressed form.

name: crawlTimestamp
desc: Source page crawl timestamp.
meaning: When the linking page was crawled.

name: docid
desc: The docid field used to be "required", but it is now "optional" because it is not present when anchors are stored in webtable. When anchors are stored as part of docjoin files in the segment indexer, however, docid should be considered required.
meaning: Internal document id of the linking page.

name: doclength
desc: necessary for anything?
meaning: Length of the linking page, with its usefulness questioned in the note.

name: homePageInfo
desc: Information about if the source page is a home page. It can be one of the enum values defined in PerDocData::HomePageInfo (NOT_HOMEPAGE, NOT_TRUSTED, PARTIALLY_TRUSTED, and FULLY_TRUSTED).
meaning: Whether the linking page is a homepage and how trusted that homepage is.

name: indyrank
desc: uint16 scale
meaning: A stored rank value for the linking page.

name: ipaddr
desc: DEPRECATED, use packed_ipaddress
meaning: Old IP address field for the linking page; deprecated.

name: language
desc: default -> English
meaning: Language of the linking page.

name: linkhash
desc: 0 -> no hash
meaning: Hash identifying the link, zero when there is none.

name: localCountryCodes
desc: Countries to which the source page is local/most relevant; stored as III identifiers for country/region codes (see
meaning: Countries the linking page is considered most relevant to.

name: nsr
desc: This NSR value has range [0,1000] and is the original value [0.0,1.0] multiplied by 1000 rounded to an integer.
meaning: Site quality score of the linking page, scaled to a 0 to 1000 range.

name: outsites
desc: approx num of pointed-to sites
meaning: Roughly how many different sites the linking page points out to.

name: packedIpaddress
desc: string in IPAddress::ToPackedString() format.
meaning: The linking page's IP address in packed string form.

name: pageTags
desc: Page tags are described by enum PageTag in PerDocData. Page tags are used in anchors to identify properties of the linking page. These are DEPRECATED: in the future, use link_tags instead. DEPRECATED
meaning: Old property tags for the linking page; deprecated in favour of link tags.

name: pagerank
desc: uint16 scale
meaning: PageRank of the linking page, stored on a 16-bit scale.

name: pagerankNs
desc: unit16 scale
meaning: A variant PageRank value for the linking page.

name: seglanguage
desc: DEPRECATED
meaning: Old segmentation language field; deprecated.

name: spamrank
desc: uint16 scale
meaning: Spam rank of the linking page on a 16-bit scale.

name: spamscore1
desc: deprecated, to be removed after October 20. 0-127 scale
meaning: Old spam score for the linking page; deprecated.

name: spamscore2
desc: 0-127 scale
meaning: A spam score for the linking page on a 0 to 127 scale.

name: webtableKey
desc: Webtable key of source
meaning: Storage table key for the linking page.

name: homepageAnchorsDropped
desc: The total # of local homepage anchors dropped in AnchorAccumulator.
meaning: How many links from other homepages on the same site were discarded during anchor processing.

name: indexTier
desc: The index tier from which the anchors were extracted. Note that this is only valid in the anchor record written by linkextractor. The value can be one of the enum values defined in segindexer/types.h.
meaning: Which index tier the anchors were pulled from.

name: localAnchorsDropped
desc: The total # of local non-homepage anchors dropped in AnchorAccumulator.
meaning: How many same-site non-homepage links were discarded during anchor processing.

name: nonlocalAnchorsDropped
desc: The total # of non-local anchors dropped in AnchorAccumulator.
meaning: How many links from other sites were discarded during anchor processing.

name: redundantAnchorsDropped
desc: The *_anchors_dropped fields below are not populated by Alexandria, which uses cdoc.anchor_stats instead. The total # of redundant anchors dropped in linkextractor.
meaning: Count of duplicate links thrown out in link extraction; not filled by the current pipeline.

name: supplementalAnchorsDropped
desc: The total # of supplemental anchors dropped in AnchorAccumulator. ## DEPRECATED.
meaning: Count of discarded supplemental-tier links; marked deprecated.

name: targetDocid
desc: may be implicit
meaning: Internal document id of the page the links point to.

name: targetSite
desc: HOST_LEVEL site chunking.
meaning: The host the links point to, used for grouping link data.

name: targetUrl
desc: This is produced during link extraction but not written out in the linklogs in order to save space.
meaning: The URL the links point to, kept only during link extraction.

name: annotatedEntityId
desc: The id of this entity, prefer accessing through webref-entities-util.h functions.
meaning: The identifier of the entity this record is about.

name: cdoc
desc: This field contains reference pages for this entity. A reference page is a page that is highly topical for this entity, which can be used to mine additional information about this entity. Example reference pages for Apple Inc. would be the composite docs for "
meaning: Stored copies of pages that are strongly about the entity.

name: contextNameInfo
desc: The context names (with scores) of this entity. The difference to regular names (aka name_info) is that context names are not used for finding mentions in a document as they consist of names somehow related to the entity (e.g. name "fisherman s wharf" for the entity "Gary Danko"). Used for reconciling freebase and oyster.
meaning: Scored names related to the entity that are not used to find mentions.

name: debugInfo
desc: Debug information about the entity.
meaning: Debugging notes about the entity.

name: enricherAnnotatorProfile
desc: Optional profiling data from the enricher that enriched this entity (and produced this EntityJoin as debug output).
meaning: Timing data from the step that enriched this entity.

name: enricherDebugData
desc: Contains debug data produced by enricher and only used for debug purpose (e.g. demo).
meaning: Data kept only for debugging and demos.

name: extraData
desc: Additional metadata about the entity, that can be derived from the "raw data" (composite doc, domain specific data...), or come from other sources. Despite its name, this field often contains quite important information.
meaning: Extra metadata about the entity gathered from its sources.

name: humanRatings
desc: Human ratings (e.g. ratings from EWOK). This is typically only populated in the evaluation pipelines (e.g. P@5).
meaning: Human rater judgments, filled in only for evaluation runs.

name: linkInfo
desc: Contains all links (with scores) that Webref knows for this entity. Links are relationships between entities. The data in this field is very important for the quality of the model.
meaning: All scored relationships this entity has to other entities.

name: nameInfo
desc: Contains all names (with scores) that Webref knows for this entity. The data in this field is very important for the quality of the model.
meaning: All scored names known for this entity.

name: refconNameInfo
desc: Contains names and names metadata used by Refcon.
meaning: Names and name details used by the entity reconciliation system.

name: representation
desc: An entity can have metadata from various data sources. Generally speaking all sources will be / should be reconciled into a single KG Topic entry. However, in some cases we pull in additional chunks of metadata from these sources; these are stored in this field. For example a local business could have a KG entry (topic proto), wikipedia entry (WikiJoin) and a MapFacts entry (Feature proto).
meaning: Extra chunks of entity data pulled from other source systems.

name: crawlTime
desc: The timestamp of when the document was crawled (if known). Copied from CompositeDoc.Content.CrawlTime.
meaning: When the page was crawled.

name: docFp
desc: Fingerprint of the document. We compute and set this fingerprint when creating the pagesets that we use for evals. Otherwise, this field is not normally set. We use the field to make sure that the human ratings that we have are generated for the same version of the document, otherwise they might be invalid. We do not compute the fingerprint on the fly (e.g. as a fingerprint of the proto buffer serialization of the cdoc) because protocol buffer serialization is not stable.
meaning: A hash of the document version, used to check that human ratings match.

name: docId
desc: DocId of the annotated document as read from cdoc.doc().docid().
meaning: The internal document identifier.

name: forwardingUrls
desc: Urls that forward to this url. Needed for url -> topical entity entries.
meaning: Other addresses that redirect to this page.

name: isDisambiguationPage
desc: Set to true if the document is a known disambiguation page, e.g.
meaning: Whether the page is a known disambiguation page.

name: language
desc: The document language, as read from doc().content().language(). This is go/language-enum value.
meaning: The language the page is written in.

name: numIncomingAnchors
desc: The (weighted) number of incoming anchors (links from other documents).
meaning: The weighted count of links pointing at this page from other pages.

name: salientTerms
desc: The salient terms for this document. Only set if --webref_doc_metadata_copy_salient_terms is true. Same motivation as the title field above.
meaning: The important terms of the page, copied in when a flag is on.

name: title
desc: The title of the document. Only set if --webref_doc_metadata_set_title is true. The idea is that we can use this to more easily learn things like: title contains "restaurants" -> more likely to be a list page.
meaning: The page title, copied in when a flag is on.

name: totalClicks
desc: The total clicks on this document, taken from navboost data.
meaning: The total number of clicks on this page taken from navboost data.

name: url
desc: The url of the document.
meaning: The address of the page.

name: normalizedName
desc: The normalized name.
meaning: The cleaned up standard form of a name.

name: variantInfo
desc: All the variants of this name together with associated information such as score, sources, etc.
meaning: All spelling variants of a name together with their scores and sources.

name: debugTitle
desc: A short human-readable name/title of the entity, similar to what is displayed at the top of a Hume page. Do not use for any production purpose as it does not provide guarantees for stability or policy checks (access requirements).
meaning: A readable entity title kept only for debugging, explicitly not for production use.

name: isBoostedPrimaryWeightLink
desc: Whether this is a BoostedPrimaryWeight link. For these links in some cases a higher weight is used for primary scoring.
meaning: Flags an entity link that in some cases gets extra weight in primary scoring.

name: targetMid
desc: The mid of the linked entity.
meaning: The knowledge graph id of the entity at the other end of the link.

name: variantInfo
desc: The information about this link for each locale.
meaning: Per language and region details for this entity link.

name: annotationStats
desc: Detailed annotation statistics that can, e.g., be used to tune the WebRef scoring logic based on existing (Model-0) annotations.
meaning: Bundle of annotation statistics used for tuning the annotator.

name: annotatorCheckpointFingerprints
desc: Fingerprints checkpointing annotator stages, can be used to track the source of diffs.
meaning: Fingerprints recorded at annotator stages to trace differences.

name: category
desc: Categories of the document or query. This replaces the category_score found under EntityAnnotations.
meaning: Topic categories assigned to the page or query.

name: dateRange
desc: Dates ranges that are most relevant to the document. E.g. on a document about Dune the 2021 movie, this might hold the release date of that movie.
meaning: Date ranges judged most relevant to the page, such as a film's release date.

name: documentInfo
desc: Information that applies globally to the document. The exclude_field option is for Goldmine AnnotationsFinder to exclude document_info from retrieving annotation entities
meaning: Container for information that applies to the whole document.

name: entity
desc: The annotated entities, with associated confidence scores and metadata. This is the primary output of WebRef/QRef. In case of Webref output, entities are sorted by decreasing topicality score.
meaning: The entities found on the page with their confidence and topicality scores.

name: rangeAnnotations
desc: These messages contain non-entity annotations of ranges in the document. This might be used to hold part-of-speech annotations, stopword annotations, and other range based information. The exclude_field option is for Goldmine AnnotationsFinder to exclude ranged_annotations from retrieving annotation entities
meaning: Non-entity markings of text ranges such as parts of speech or stopwords.

name: status
desc: The status message returned by the annotator. Might not be populated on success.
meaning: Status message returned by the annotator.

name: stuff
desc: A generic container to hold extra result data.
meaning: Generic container for extra result data.

name: tripleAnnotations
desc: Triples inferred from the document When the annotator recognizes phrases, lists or tables associated with a property or relationship for an entity it generates triples that encode that information. This generated data is only substantiated by the document vs KG data which has been verified from multiple sources and/or human curators.
meaning: Facts the system inferred from the page's own text, tables and lists.

name: answerScore
desc: Answer score of the passage for this
meaning: How well a passage answers the query, used when picking a snippet.

name: navboostQuery
desc: Navboost query for this radish signal.
meaning: The query string associated with this snippet passage signal.

name: passageCoverage
desc: The ratio of overlapping tokens between the radish passage and snippet candidate.
meaning: Share of words shared between the source passage and the candidate snippet.

name: passageType
desc: Integer value of indexing::annotations::wa_passages::Passage::Type.
meaning: A numeric code for which kind of passage this is.

name: queryPassageIdx
desc: The index of this passage under
meaning: The position number of this passage in a list.

name: similarityMethod
desc: How the similarity score is computed. Integer value of mustang_repos_www_snippets::RadishSignalScoringInfo::SimilarityMethod.
meaning: A code for which method was used to compute the similarity score.

name: similarityScore
desc: Similarity score between this
meaning: How similar this passage is to the snippet candidate.

name: candidateInfo
desc: Candidates are ordered by their id.
meaning: The list of possible snippets considered for a result, ordered by their id.

name: containUserQuotes
desc: Indicates that the snippet candidates all contain uesr quotes.
meaning: Notes that every candidate snippet contains text the user quoted in the query.

name: containVulgarCandidates
desc: Indicates if there are any vulgar snippet candidates.
meaning: Notes that some of the candidate snippets contain vulgar wording.

name: disableNg3Scoring
desc: Indicates that SR side should disable the ng3 scoring and soly rely on the SnippetBrain scoring for selecting the final candidate. E.g. this can happen when the offline snippet generation routine is triggered.
meaning: A switch telling the system to pick the snippet using only the SnippetBrain model.

name: disableQueryFeatures
desc: Indicates whether the query relevance features is disabled or not in Muppet scoring.
meaning: A switch turning off query-relevance features when scoring snippets.

name: forceLeadingTextOrMeta
desc: Indicates to not add any new candidates in SnippetFlow.
meaning: A switch preventing new snippet candidates from being added later in the flow.

name: snippetBrainSelectedCandidateIndex
desc: Snippet candidate index selected by snippet brain model. This field will get populated in SnippetFlow in superroot. go/snippets-brain
meaning: Which candidate snippet the SnippetBrain model picked.

name: snippetsbrainModelInfo
desc: SnippetsBrain model information for snippets popup debug.
meaning: Model details about the snippet picker, kept for a debugging popup.

name: boldedRanges
desc: Bolded ranges in the printed snippet lines.
meaning: Which parts of the snippet text get shown in bold.

name: id
desc: Candidate identifier number, unique among all snippet candidates under each document in each request. What does this number mean: - Muppet candidates: This equals to the candidate's rank by Muppet snippets scorer. - Superroot candidates: No specific meaning, this number should be larger than that of Muppet candidates. This field is used to: - Verify whether snippet brain chooses a different snippet from Muppet (the one chosen by Muppet is always in id 0). - Print debugging information and sort c
meaning: A number identifying each candidate snippet for a document within one request.

name: isMuppetSelectedSnippet
desc: If this snippet is chosen by Muppet.
meaning: Marks whether this candidate is the one the earlier snippet picker chose.

name: isSnippetBrainBoldingTriggered
desc: If SnippetsBrain bolding model triggered and a bolding span is generated.
meaning: Marks whether the model generated a bolding span for this snippet.

name: listInfo
desc: List information for this candidate, only populated for RADISH_LIST snippets.
meaning: Extra list layout details, filled in only for snippets shown as lists.

name: sentenceStarts
desc: Sentence starting positions in the printed snippet lines.
meaning: Where each sentence begins inside the snippet text.

name: snippet
desc: Muppet fills snippet lines in
meaning: The actual lines of snippet text for this candidate.

name: sbScore
desc: The value corresponding to this version.
meaning: SpamBrain's spam score for this document under a given model version.

name: versionId
desc: The version id (derived from the epoch - larger number means newer score)
meaning: Version number of the SpamBrain score, where a larger number is newer.

name: site
desc: Sitechunker site granularity for this result
meaning: The site grouping that a spam classifier result applies to.

name: versionedData
desc: Versioned scores of SB classifiers
meaning: The spam classifier scores for a result, one per model version.

name: languages
desc: The languages of the document, taken from its cdoc.properties().languages()
meaning: The languages of the page a sitelink points to.

name: salientImage
desc: The image data will be copied from the DocInfo response, and will be retrieved online, so this field should not be populated during indexing. This is a temporary field for experimentation.
meaning: An image for the sitelink target, fetched live and used for experiments.

name: sectionTexts
desc: Section texts used for Page Anchors Preview (go/page-anchor-preview-dd).
meaning: Text of page sections used to preview page anchors.

name: snippetResponse
desc: The snippet response for the target document for an empty query.
meaning: The snippet generated for the sitelink target page.

name: sporcSignals
desc: FIELD SHOULD ONLY BE POPULATED DURING ONLINE/SERVING TIME. Thus it should have no impact on cdoc/mdu.
meaning: Sitelink scores filled in only at serving time, never stored in the index.

name: geotopicality
desc: Information about geo locations, rather than individual businesses.
meaning: Annotations about the geographic places a page is about, not specific businesses.

name: isLargeChain
desc: Does this LocalWWWInfo represent a widely-distributed chain?
meaning: Whether the local business tied to this page is a widely spread chain.

name: siteSiblings
desc: These are per-document signals independent of any particular address.
meaning: Per document counts of sibling pages on the same site, independent of any address.

name: url
desc: These are for convenience during intermediate data processing, and should be cleared before the data gets into doc-joins.
meaning: A temporary copy of the page URL that is cleared before the data is stored.

name: annotationConfidence
desc: Confidence score for business mention annotations which is copied from LocalEntityAnnotations::location_confidence.
meaning: Confidence that a business mention found on the page is really that business.

name: confidence
desc: Probability that this is the authority page of the business. Same as LocalListing.authority_page_probability, only set for pages with page_type_flags & AUTHORITY.
meaning: Probability that this page is the business's own main page.

name: featureType
desc: Feature type for this listing, from LocalListing::info::related_feature. A geostore::FeatureProto::TypeCategory. Intended primarily to indicate POI-ness (i.e., TYPE_ESTABLISHMENT_POI).
meaning: The category of place this listing is, mainly whether it is a point of interest.

name: hours
desc: Opening hours for the business, from Local attributes and/or extracted annotations.
meaning: The business's opening hours as known from local data or the page.

name: isPlusbox
desc: TODO(local-universal) Consider deleting is_plusbox once the new scheme that uses make_plusbox_visible rolled out.
meaning: An old flag for showing an expandable local result box.

name: level
desc: DEPRECATED / NO LONGER WRITTEN. URL path level from actual references to this webpage.
meaning: A retired count of the URL path depth of references to this page.

name: makePlusboxVisible
desc: A hint for frontend to decide whether this plusbox should be visible or not.
meaning: A hint telling the front end whether to show the expandable local box.

name: menuUrl
desc: Menu link for the business. Currently only comes from Local attributes.
meaning: Links to the business's menu.

name: pageTypeFlags
desc: Type of the web reference.
