meaning: Flags describing what kind of web reference this page is for the business.

name: relevance
desc: DEPRECATED / NO LONGER WRITTEN. How relevant the webpage is to the business (clustering distance). Same as LocalListing::Reference.relevance. Typically only set for pages with (page_type_flags & WEB_EXTRACTION && !AUTHORITY).
meaning: A retired score for how closely a page matched a business.

name: KaltixRank
desc: approx. 2 bytes for top 1B
meaning: A per-document rank value stored in compact form for the top billion documents.

name: LocalKaltixRank
desc: empty for now
meaning: A local variant of the per-document rank value, currently left empty.

name: SiteKaltixRank
desc: empty for now
meaning: A site-level variant of the per-document rank value, currently left empty.

name: PhilString
desc: phil data , approx 70 bytes for top 500M
meaning: An opaque per-document data blob of about 70 bytes for top pages.

name: DEPRECATEDDesktopCanonicalDocid
desc: If set, this page is a smartphone dup, a page serving equivalent contents as another URL (desktop canonical), but in smartphone-optimized style. This field holds the docid of the desktop canonical.
meaning: A retired pointer to the desktop page that this mobile page duplicates.

name: DEPRECATEDMobileHomepageDocid
desc: Mobile URL for homepages, predicted by the URL rewrite rules. See go/mobile-homepage-prediction.
meaning: A retired pointer to the predicted mobile version of a homepage.

name: adsDensityInterstitialViolationStrength
desc: Indicates if the page is violating mobile ads density interstitial policy and the violation strength. See go/interstitials-for-ads and
meaning: How badly the page breaks the rules on ad-heavy mobile interstitials.

name: isErrorPage
desc: Indicates if the page serves error to smartphone crawler. go/ramsey-sp404demotion
meaning: Whether the page returns an error to the smartphone crawler.

name: isN1Redirect
desc: Indicates if the page has mobile N-1 redirection. go/ramsey-n1demotion
meaning: Whether the mobile page redirects visitors away from the matching content.

name: isSmartphoneOptimized
desc: Indicates if the page is rendered in a friendly manner on smartphones. We use this field as tri-state: "unset" means the rendering result classification is not available, and "set as false" means that the page is rendered in unfriendly manner on smartphones. See also go/modena-ranking.
meaning: Whether the page displays properly on smartphones.

name: isWebErrorMobileContent
desc: Indicates if the current URL serves error page to desktop crawler and non error page to smartphone crawler.
meaning: Whether the URL errors for the desktop crawler but works for the smartphone crawler.

name: maximumFlashRatio
desc: The ratio of the area of the largest Flash to the render area.
meaning: How much of the rendered area the largest Flash object takes up.

name: violatesMobileInterstitialPolicy
desc: Indicates if the page is violating mobile interstitial policy and should be demoted. See go/interstitials-ranking-dd for details.
meaning: Whether the page breaks the mobile interstitial rules and should be demoted.

name: DEPRECATEDEntropyColor
desc: entropy and color values for thumbnail (4 bytes consisting of R, G, B and entropy values)
meaning: An old packed color and detail summary of the thumbnail, no longer used.

name: filename
desc: about 10 bytes
meaning: The file name of the image stored with the page record.

name: flags
desc: image_perdoc.h
meaning: A packed set of internal bits about the image, readable only with helper code.

name: blogurlFp
desc: used for blogurl crowding.
meaning: A fingerprint of the blog address used to limit how many results one blog gets.

name: clientSpamminess
desc: This score captures how spammy the client is that the micropost was created with. The higher the score the worse.
meaning: How spammy the posting tool used to create a short post looks.

name: convTree
desc: For the threaded conversation view. Only populated in docs with provider type SYNTHETIC_CONVERSATION_DOC.
meaning: The reply structure used to show a conversation view of posts.

name: isSyntacticReshare
desc: A syntactic reshare is a document that is
meaning: Marks a post that simply reshares another post.

name: microblogQualityExptData
desc: Experimental data for quality experiments. This will NOT be populated in prod, but we will use this for experiments.
meaning: Experimental blog quality data that is never filled in for live traffic.

name: numMentions
desc: For replies/reshares. num_mentions = number of times the pattern @foo appears in the document.
meaning: How many at-mentions of other users appear in the post.

name: postContentFingerprint
desc: The fingerprint for the body text of the microblog post. It is copied from MicroBlogPost.post_content_fingerprint.
meaning: A fingerprint of the post's body text.

name: spamScore
desc: Blog scoring signals.
meaning: A spam score for the blog post.

name: userQualityScore
desc: User and doc quality scores for updates (aka microposts).
meaning: Quality scores for the author and for the short post itself.

name: GroupId
desc: Legacy group mysql id.
meaning: Old internal database identifier for a Google Groups group.

name: numShingles
desc: Total number of shingles in the document.
meaning: How many text fingerprints the document contains.

name: source
desc: A list of all sources.
meaning: The list of other sources the document's text fingerprints came from.

name: VisitorsPastDay
desc: Indicates how many distinct toolbar visitors this page had in the past day. Will only be present if the number is reasonably large.
meaning: Count of distinct Google Toolbar visitors this page had in the past day.

name: encodedLookupInformation
desc: Encoded lookup information. The fields set above are expensive to store. Storing them in docjoins is fine, but we cannot store them in MDU shards. In order for the MDU shards to display field provenance information, we store them as a bitfield. For details about the encoding and decoding scheme, see quality_nsr::util::EncodeMetadataLookupInformation. We expect this to occupy 8 bytes as long as there are less than 64 fields in NsrData proto, 12 bytes between 64 and 92 fields, etc.
meaning: A packed record of where each field's data was looked up from.

name: goldmineLookupKeyPerField
desc: Same as raffia_lookup_key_per_field. Note that the goldmine_lookups have priority; if a field appears in both goldmine and raffia entries, it means it was taken from goldmine. If it's missing here but present in raffia_lookup_key_per_field, it was taken from raffia.
meaning: Which goldmine key supplied each field of the site data.

name: goldmineLookupKeys
desc: The lookup keys attempted by goldmine. Note that goldmine only runs for urls which can be chunked differently than raffia; in those cases, goldmine related fields are empty.
meaning: The keys goldmine tried when looking up site data.

name: lastTimeProcessedMduInSeconds
desc: This field is populated only during MDU population, so it's
meaning: When this record was last processed by the MDU pipeline.

name: lastTimeProcessedRaffiaInSeconds
desc: Records the last time each system has processed the proto. These are recorded as seconds from the unix epoch. Ideally these fields would be google.protobuf.Timestamp, but the scoring bundle (which depends on this proto) does not understand proto3 syntax. See cl/500942047 for details.
meaning: When this record was last processed by the Raffia pipeline.

name: nsrChunksWithSourceInfo
desc: Stores the NSRChunks (computed by goldmine) which were used to populate the data.
meaning: The site grouping keys that were used to fill in this record.

name: raffiaLookupKeyPerField
desc: Returns the raffia lookup key per each field in the NsrData proto (with exclusion of the Metadata sub-message (i.e. this)). It contains information like 3 : 1, meaning that the field inside NsrData with id '3' (in this case 'host') has been taken by raffia from the raffia lookup key at index 1.
meaning: Which Raffia key supplied each field of the site data.

name: raffiaLookupKeys
desc: This is an internal field set by Raffia, to indicate which lookup keys have been attempted to populate the NsrData for this document. This will allow us to determine which key has been used to populate each field in the proto. The keys are ordered by lookup priority; raffia will give priority to earlier keys, and only take fields from later keys if they are missing.
meaning: The ordered keys Raffia tried when filling in the site data.

name: raffiaSignalMergerUrl
desc: The url used by NsrSignalMerger (
meaning: The URL the signal merger used for this record.

name: local
desc: Score for the local sites arm.
meaning: An uplift score for the local-sites arm of a site experiment.

name: small
desc: Score for the small sites arm.
meaning: An uplift score for the small-sites arm of a site experiment.

name: country
desc: The two-letter uppercase country slice of the CrapsData. Examples: "US", "FR", "BR"
meaning: Which country's slice of click data this record covers.

name: device
desc: The device interface and os slice of the CrapsData.
meaning: Which device and operating system slice of click data this record covers.

name: features
desc: Contains CrapsClickSignals for specific features. (i.e. for mobile, US, metro id - 123")
meaning: Click statistics broken out for particular slices such as mobile users in one city.

name: impressions
desc: These fields may become legacy fields; we may retire them and use the squashed field (below) instead, to allow for some nesting.
meaning: How many times the result was shown to users.

name: language
desc: The language slice of the CrapsData. Examples: "en", "fr", "pt-BR",
meaning: Which language slice of click data this record covers.

name: lastLongestClicks
desc: The number of clicks that were last and longest in related user queries.
meaning: How many clicks were the final and longest click in a related search session.

name: mobileData
desc: DO NOT USE: Use the above mobile_signals fields instead. DO NOT REMOVE: Field is present in legacy protos in golden tests.
meaning: An old mobile click field kept only for legacy compatibility.

name: mobileSignals
desc: The portion of this CrapsData aggregated on data from tier 1/2 mobile interfaces in QSessions.
meaning: Click statistics gathered only from mobile searches.

name: packedIpAddress
desc: Contains a packed string in network byte order, as expected by CrapsIpPrior. Only populated if we looked up the ip_prior_bad_fraction at retrieval time.
meaning: The packed IP address used to look up a click-trust prior.

name: patternLevel
desc: Level of pattern. More general patterns get higher values. For URL patterns this field = 0. For example, if we have "
meaning: How general the URL pattern is that this click record covers.

name: patternSccStats
desc: For pattern data, this will contain stats of the SCC's of the individual urls contributing to the pattern.
meaning: Statistics about the individual URLs that contributed to a pattern's click data.

name: sliceTag
desc: This field can be used by the craps pipeline to slice up signals by various attributes such as device type, country, locale etc. The slice_tag can be an arbitrary string, and the CrapsData values for each slice_tag are aggregated separately, together with the default empty slice_tag.
meaning: A free-form tag naming how this click data was sliced.

name: squashed
desc: Not used yet - we will probably move the impressions / clicks / good_clicks bad clicks / last longest clicks into here from top level, and rename those fields to legacy.
meaning: A placeholder for compressed click counts that is not used yet.

name: unscaledIpPriorBadFraction
desc: Used to assign a prior based on IP address. See quality/navboost/craps/craps-ip-prior.h. This value is prior to the linear transformation (scaling / offset / min / max) that's applied in craps-penalty.cc.
meaning: The raw share of bad activity expected from this IP address, before scaling.

name: unsquashed
desc: We will start using this one for the retuning rollout.
meaning: Uncompressed click statistics for this record.

name: voterTokenCount
desc: The number of distinct voter tokens (a lower bound on the number of distinct users that contributed to the entry, used for privacy-related filtering).
meaning: How many distinct user tokens contributed to this click record.

name: country
desc: Country, like "us". If not present, it's an aggregation for all countries. This is the same format as one used in Glue.
meaning: Which country this click aggregation covers, if any.

name: device
desc: Device, like "m". If not present, it's an aggregation for all devices. "m" - mobile devices. "d" - destop devices.
meaning: Which device type this click aggregation covers, if any.

name: language
desc: Language, like "en". If not present, it's an aggregation for all languages. This is the same format as one used in Glue.
meaning: Which language this click aggregation covers, if any.

name: locationId
desc: Location id for metro and city. If not present, it's an aggregation for all locations within current country.
meaning: Which metro area or city this click aggregation covers.

name: signals
desc: CRAPS Signals for the locale.
meaning: The click statistics for this particular locale slice.

name: voterTokenBitmap
desc: The set of voter tokens of the sessions that contributed to this feature's stats. Voter tokens are not unique per user, so it is a lower bound on the number of distinct users. Used for privacy-related filtering.
meaning: A compact set of user tokens behind these stats, used for privacy filtering.

name: isForumPage
desc: Set to true if this page is classified as a forum page.
meaning: Whether the page was classified as a forum page.

name: isPageWithFreshRepeatedDates
desc: Set to true if this page has a fresh repeated date sequence.
meaning: Whether the page shows a run of recent repeated dates.

name: isQnaPage
desc: Set to true if this page is classified as a question answers page.
meaning: Whether the page was classified as a question-and-answer page.

name: unreliableDatesScore
desc: If scores are missing, the date is reliable by default. max(petacat.unreliable_dates_score)
meaning: A score for how untrustworthy the dates on this page look.

name: unreliableDatesScoreExposureAdjusted
desc: max(petacat.unreliable_dates_score * petacat.date_exposure_score)
meaning: The date-unreliability score adjusted by how prominent dates are on the page.

name: boostSourceBlocker
desc: Defined as a source-blocker, a result which can be a boost target but should itself not be boosted (e.g. roboted documents). For more details on source and target blocking, please read through the code for quality/twiddler/impls/PROTECTED/local_result_twiddler_v2.cc
meaning: Whether the page may be a boost target but must never be boosted itself.

name: deprecatedHreflangInfo
desc: Since July 2014 those two fiels are no longer populated, the data is stored in the TargetLinkSets instead. The deprecated fields contain values only for docs which have not been processed since July 2014.
meaning: Old hreflang data no longer filled in since 2014.

name: documentLanguage
desc: The language of this document (as detected by on-page language detection, not influenced by external anchor signals or other indirect conclusions).
meaning: The language detected from the page's own text.

name: sitedupRuleId
desc: The list of Sitedup rule IDs for this specific URL. The value is only populated if the URL has at least one localized cluster fulfilling the following conditions: - spans more than one host - does not have filtering enabled due to other input (e.g. due to being a hreflang cluster).
meaning: Identifiers of the site-duplication rules that matched this URL.

name: warningMessage
desc: A warning indicator that a problem has occurred, e.g. cross-domain links being filtered early. The warning is just presented for debugging purposes.
meaning: Debug warning text about problems found while building the cluster.

name: lastSignificantUpdate
desc: Contains a date used for the "Date Last Modified" toolbelt restrict mode. Note: this date is a combined date and is different from the pure shingle-based signal stored in contentage.last_significant_update field.
meaning: A combined date of the page's last meaningful change, used for the last-modified search filter.

name: cdocBuildInfo
desc: To hold extra info for building a final cdoc from raw cdoc and goldmine annotations.
meaning: Extra bookkeeping used when assembling the final document record.

name: contentProtected
desc: Whether current page is under content protection, i.e. a page has been crawled as an error page, but we preserve its last known good content and keep its crawl_status as converter.CrawlStatus::CONTENT.
meaning: Whether the page's last good content is kept even though crawling hit an error.

name: convertToRobotedReason
desc: If set, indicates that the crawl status was converted to ROBOTED for the reason specified by the enum value in converter.RobotedReasons.ConvertToRobotedReasons. See indexing/converter/proto/converter.proto for details. If unset, then the document was not converted to roboted, and if the document crawl status is ROBOTED, then the document is disallowed (at least to Google) in robots.txt.
meaning: Why the page was treated as blocked by robots rules.

name: crawlStatus
desc: One of the enum values in converter.CrawlStatus.State (see indexing/converter/proto/converter.proto for details). Default is converter.CrawlStatus::CONTENT. The document is roboted if the value is converter.CrawlStatus::ROBOTED.
meaning: The crawl state of the page, such as having content or being blocked.

name: errorType
desc: One of the enum values in converter.ErrorPageType (see indexing/converter/proto/error-page-detector-enum.proto for detail). Default is converter::ERROR_PAGE_NONE.
meaning: Which kind of error page this document was detected as, if any.

name: hostid
desc: The host id of the document. Used chiefly to determine whether the document is part of a parked domain.
meaning: The page's host id, used mainly to tell whether it sits on a parked domain.

name: ieIdentifier
desc: A short descriptive string to help identify the IE application or setup where this CDoc is generated. For example: websearch_m3 This field is for debuggability purposes.
meaning: A short label naming the pipeline that produced this record, for debugging.

name: imageIndexingInfo
desc: Indexing info about images (i.e. image links missing image data, etc).
meaning: Notes on how the page's images were indexed, such as missing image data.

name: indexingTs
desc: The timestamp (the time since the Epoch, in microseconds) when the docjoin is exported from indexing. The main purpose of this field is to identify different versions of the same document.
meaning: When the document left indexing, used to tell versions of it apart.

name: noLongerCanonicalTimestamp
desc: If set, the timestamp in microseconds when the URL stopped being canonical. This should never be set for exported canonical documents. This field is used by dups during canonical flip, and by webmain when doc selection switched between desktop and mobile. Union respects this timestamp to prevent old doc being deleted until the new doc is picked up
meaning: When the address stopped being the chosen one, used to order updates.

name: normalizedClickScore
desc: This score is calculated by re-mapping the back onto the partition's score distribution, such that the score represents the score of the equivalently ranked organically-selected document.
meaning: A click score rescaled to match the score of a similarly ranked normal page.

name: primaryVertical
desc: Vertical membership of the document. -
meaning: Which search vertical the document belongs to.

name: rawNavboost
desc: The raw navboost count for the canonical url without aggregating the navboost from dup urls. This field is used when building forwarding map.
meaning: The page's own click boost count before duplicates are merged in.

name: rowTimestamp
desc: The timestamp (the time since the Epoch, in microseconds) to represent doc version, which is used in the downstream processing after Raffia. If it's not set, indexing_ts will be used as row_timestamp. The timestamp is generally set by reprocessing to set slightly newer indexing_ts such that the system can respect the reprocessed version to overwrite old data in storage.
meaning: The storage timestamp marking this version of the document.

name: selectionTierRank
desc: Selection tier rank is a language normalized score ranging from 0-1 over the serving tier (Base, Zeppelins, Landfills) for this document.
meaning: A zero to one score placing the document within its serving index tier.

name: tracingId
desc: The tracing ids is to label the version of url for url status tracking. This repeated field will carry at most 10 tracing id. See more details in go/rich-tracing-design There will be less than 2% base+uz cdocs carrying this field. The major sources of tracing ids include:
meaning: Labels used to trace a version of the address through the pipeline.

name: urlChangerate
desc: Changerate information for this doc (see crawler/changerate/changerate.proto for details).
meaning: How often the page's content changes.

name: urlHistory
desc: Url change history for this doc (see crawler/changerate/changerate.proto for details). Note if a doc has more than 20 changes, we only keep the last 20 changes here to avoid adding to much data in its docjoin.
meaning: A record of the page's recent content changes.

name: urlPatternSignals
desc: UrlPatternSignals for this doc, used to compute document score in LTG (see indexing/signal_aggregator/proto/signal-aggregator.proto for details).
meaning: Signals drawn from the address pattern that feed the document's score.

name: videoIndexingInfo
desc: Indexing info about videos.
meaning: Notes on how the page's videos were indexed.

name: embedding
desc: Needed for relevance scoring.
meaning: A vector representation of a page section used when picking jump links.

name: geometryScore
desc: aggregate score from Section Geometry.
meaning: A combined score describing the shape and layout of the page section.

name: headingAbbrvScore
desc: Heading Abbreviation score.
meaning: A score for how well the heading works as a shortened label.

name: hpScore
desc: Needed for heading/passage filtering.
meaning: A score used to filter which headings and passages qualify as jump links.

name: sectionHeight
desc: Needed for Geometry Scoring and backoffs. from Section Geometry.
meaning: How tall the page section is.

name: text
desc: Heading/Reformulated text is needed to display.
meaning: The heading or reworded text shown for the jump link.

name: locale
desc: Data for each locale.
meaning: A container holding one set of product-site data per locale.

name: normalizationFactor
desc: Factor that determines how local anchor credit is scaled before being added to global anchors.
meaning: How much credit from local links is scaled before being added to global links.

name: totalScore
desc: Site quality score, which determines the site type.
meaning: A quality score for the site that decides which site type it is.

name: docData
desc: doc_data contain additional salient-term-set-level data.
meaning: Document-level details attached to the set of important terms.

name: salientTerm
desc: salient_term is the list of terms that are good descriptors, sorted in decreasing order of weight.
meaning: The list of terms that best describe the document, most important first.

name: version
desc: version is the Salient Terms version used to create the SalientTermSet. This is specific to web documents salient terms.
meaning: Which version of the important-terms pipeline produced this data.

name: bias
desc: A fixed bias for this signal, the higher the stronger. This can be used to balance the weight of signals independently of the confidence we give it. This field is only available in debug mode.
meaning: A fixed weighting nudge for a term source, stored only in debug output.

name: confidence
desc: The measurement of how much we trust this signal. Range: [0.0, 1.0] This field is available is both debug and non-debug mode.
meaning: How much this source of term data is trusted, from zero to one.

name: halfSalience
desc: Raw saliences equal to half_salience will be equal to 0.5 normalized. Range: [0, volume]. This field is only available in debug mode.
meaning: The raw salience level treated as the halfway point, debug output only.

name: noiseCorrection
desc: The minimum TF for a term not to be considered noise. While the possible range of values for this field is [0, observed_volume], it is expected to be a somewhat small percentage of observed_volume (e.g. 5%). This field is only available in debug mode.
meaning: The minimum term count needed to not count as noise, debug output only.

name: observedConfidence
desc: The measurement of how much we trust this signal, calculated using the observed volume. Range: [0.0, 1.0] This field is only available in debug mode.
meaning: Trust in a source based on observed volume, stored only in debug output.

name: observedVolume
desc: The amount of signal we observed for a document. Range: [0.0, +infinity) This field is only available in debug mode.
meaning: How much data this source gave for the document, debug output only.

name: rawVolume
desc: The amount of raw signal we observed for a document. Range: [0.0, +infinity) This field is only available in debug mode.
meaning: The unadjusted amount of data from this source, debug output only.

name: source
desc: source is the type of the signal of this SignalData.
meaning: Which source the term data came from, such as body text, anchors or clicks.

name: volume
desc: The amount of signal left after applying all corrections. Range: [0.0, +infinity) This field is only available in debug mode.
meaning: The amount of source data left after corrections, debug output only.

name: confidence
desc: confidence is a measurement of how much data we had to compute the SalientTermSet. Range: [0.0, 1.0]
meaning: How much data was available when the document's important terms were computed.

name: headVolumeRatio
desc: head_volume_ratio is the ratio of the sum of term frequency of the top K terms over the volume of all terms. Range: [0.0, 1.0]. K is defined by Accumulator2Params::head_size.
meaning: The share of all term occurrences taken by the document's top terms.

name: language
desc: language is the main language of this SalientTermSet.
meaning: The main language of the document's important-terms set.

name: signalData
desc: signal_data contains signal-specific (e.g., body, anchors, clicks) data for this SalientTermSet.
meaning: Per-source details, such as body text, anchors and clicks, behind the term set.

name: virtualVolume
desc: virtual_volume is a measurement of how much data we had to compute the SalientTermSet. Range: [0.0, +infinity)].
meaning: A measure of how much term data was available for the document.

name: siteEmbedding
desc: Compressed site/page embeddings.
meaning: A compact numeric summary of what a whole site or page is about.

name: siteFocusScore
desc: Number denoting how much a site is focused on one topic.
meaning: A number for how tightly a site sticks to a single topic.

name: siteRadius
desc: The measure of how far page_embeddings deviate from the site_embedding.
meaning: How far a site's individual pages stray from the site's main topic.

name: boostLevel
desc: Identifies the degree to which the existence of this LiveResult should boost a query's score (when the query is performed within the hot_times range). This field is always in the range [0,1]. A missing field, a value of 0, or a value outside the legal range indicates that no boosting is performed. A value of 1 indicates that the maximum level of boosting will be applied. This field will be updated from time to time based on CTR and other signals.
meaning: How much a page's score is boosted while its live result is timely, from zero to one.

name: hotTimes
desc: Specifies the time range within which this LiveResult is relevant. Used for deciding whether the rank of the corresponding page should be boosted. For example, this range can be set to encompass a few days before and after a sports game to which the page refers. If this field is missing, no boosting is performed. Specifying that a page should always be boosted is not recommended, but can be accomplished by setting hot_times.start_unix_time=0 and hot_time.end_unix_time=0x7fffffff. Note that multi
meaning: The time window during which the live result counts as timely.

name: geotopics
desc: The geotopics are ordered by normalized_score in descending order.
meaning: The list of places the page is about, strongest first.

name: crumb
desc: Each crumb represents one link of the breadcrumb chain.
meaning: The list of links making up a page's breadcrumb trail.

name: url
desc: The URL of the document from which this breadcrumb trail was extracted.
meaning: The address of the page the breadcrumb trail was taken from.

name: approximatedPosterior
desc: The approximated posterior distribution.
meaning: The fitted statistical distribution used in change-rate estimates.

name: averageChangeSignificance
desc: The "significance" of the average change we saw of this document (from 0 to 1). Influenced by content changes. This can be used for prioritizing the crawl (higher significance first).
meaning: How big the page's typical change is, used to order crawling.

name: changeperiod
desc: //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// The classic changerate estimation. //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// The classic estimate of change period (in seconds). It is computed by inserted a "fake" change and no-change interval as a prior distribution. This field is generally not used and should NOT be accessed directly. See above for correct method for determining the change period estimate.
meaning: An old estimate of seconds between page changes that is generally not used.

name: confidence
desc: The confidence (between 0 and 1) in the changeperiod guess.
meaning: How sure the system is about the estimated time between changes.

name: globalBasedChangePeriod
desc: //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// The changerate estimation based on the global prior. //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// The global-based changeperiod. This is our estimate (in seconds) for the average time between changes. It is computed using the new prior method based on global_based_prior_period and the global_based_prior_strength specified below. This is used for computing pattern priors. Use pattern_based
meaning: Estimated seconds between page changes, using a global starting assumption.

name: globalBasedChangePeriodConfidence
desc: The 'confidence' of the global-based changeperiod. This is the n-th root of the posterior evaluated at MAP point, where n is the number of history intervals. For now, it is hard to interpret the meaning of the absolute values of 'average' posterior cross different sets of data.
meaning: How sure the system is about the global-prior change estimate.

name: globalBasedPriorPeriod
desc: The 2 parameters below specify the prior employed in calculating the global_based_change_period. These values are precomputed through an offline analysis and specified via flags.
meaning: A precomputed constant fed into the global change-rate estimate.

name: lastChangeSignificance
desc: The "significance" of the last change we saw of this document (from 0 to 1). Influenced by content changes, etc. This can be used for prioritizing the crawl (higher significance first).
meaning: How big the page's most recent change was, used to order crawling.

name: lastChanged
desc: The last time (unix timestamp) we saw a changed copy of the document. Provided iff we have seen the page change.
meaning: The last time the crawler saw the page's content differ.

name: lastFetched
desc: The last time (unix timestamp) we saw a fetched copy of the document.
meaning: The last time the crawler fetched the page.

name: numIntervals
desc: The number of intervals we've seen for this document (where an interval is two different versions).
meaning: How many pairs of page versions have been observed.

name: patternBasedChangePeriod
desc: //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// The changerate estimation based on the pattern prior. //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// The pattern-based changeperiod. This is our estimate (in seconds) for the average time between changes. It is calculated based on the pattern_based_prior_period and pattern_based_prior_strength below. This quantity will eventually replace the old changeperiod calculation.
meaning: Estimated seconds between page changes, using a URL-pattern assumption.

name: patternBasedChangePeriodConfidence
desc: The same as global_based_change_period_confidence, except it is computed using pattern based priors.
meaning: How sure the system is about the pattern-based change estimate.

name: patternBasedLowerChangePeriod
desc: The lower edge of a confidence interval for the pattern-based change period.
meaning: The low end of the range for the pattern-based change estimate.

name: patternBasedPriorPeriod
desc: The 2 parameters below specify the prior employed in calculating the pattern_based_change_period. These values are calculated in a separate process and looked up based on the URL pattern.
meaning: A precomputed constant looked up by URL pattern for change estimates.

name: patternChangePeriodVersion
desc: The version number of the algorithm, refer to ChangePeriodVersion for more information.
meaning: Which version of the change-period algorithm produced the value.

name: type
meaning: What kind of document the crawl history suggests this is.

name: ugcChangePeriod
meaning: Estimated time between changes worked out from user-generated content.

name: change
desc: All the changes we've seen for this URL.
meaning: The full list of changes seen for this URL.

name: latestVersion
desc: The latest version we've seen.
meaning: The most recent recorded version of the URL.

name: url
desc: This field in only set in 'url_history' column of Union repository to avoid having to read CompositeDocs.
meaning: The URL, stored in one column only to avoid extra lookups.

name: Reason
desc: The Reason field gives further clarifying details about why or how the fetch had the given outcome. For instance, if State is URL_ERROR - was it a 404/NotFound or a DNS error? The Reason field is present iff State != URL_CRAWLED. For a given crawl status of URL_FOO, the Reason value will be one of the various FetchFooReason enum values from crawler/trawler/trawler_enums.proto
meaning: The detailed reason behind a fetch outcome, such as a 404 or a DNS failure.

name: State
desc: The State field describes the basic outcome of a fetch (URL_CRAWLED, URL_ROBOTED, URL_ERROR, etc). The value is one of the UrlStatusType enum values from crawler/trawler/trawler_enums.proto Note, there are several combinations of this Status/Reason tuple that could mean that your content is crawled or can be bucketed in a particular type of error. So instead of comparing the enumeration values manually, we suggest to use the predicate functions such as IsContentCrawled() provided in crawler/traw
meaning: The basic outcome of a fetch, such as crawled, blocked by robots, or error.

name: MaxAllowedRate
desc: Max doc_requestor urls/second allowed from this client to this fetcher.
meaning: The most URLs per second this client may request from the fetcher.

name: belowThresholdIntents
desc: Same as above, but for intents below triggering threshold. It can be assumed that any intent in this list has trigger=false. Most intents do not have below-threshold annotations.
meaning: Topic intents found on the page that scored below the triggering threshold.

name: imageIntentScores
desc: Map of imageid key to ImageIntentScores, for images on cdoc.doc_images
meaning: Intent scores for each image on the page, keyed by image id.

name: intents
desc: The 'intents' and 'scores' fields are stored as parallel lists for compactness. The 'scores' field should not be accessed directly, but instead through the functions in document_intent_scores_utils.
meaning: The list of intents the document was classified into.

name: scores
desc: The intent scores, scaled to integers between 0 and 100 for compactness.
meaning: The strength of each detected document intent, on a 0 to 100 scale.

name: version
desc: DEPRECATED. DO NOT USE IT FOR ANY REASON! contact orbit@ if necessary.
meaning: A deprecated version marker that should not be used.

name: encodedChardXlqHoaxPrediction
desc: An encoding of the Chard XLQ-hoax prediction in [0,1].
meaning: A packed model estimate that the page is a hoax.

name: encodedChardXlqTranslatedPrediction
desc: An encoding of the Chard XLQ prediction on translated content in [0,1].
meaning: A packed low-quality estimate for translated content on the page.

name: encodedChardXlqYmylPrediction
desc: An encoding of the Chard XLQ-YMYL prediction in [0,1].
meaning: A packed low-quality estimate for pages about money or health topics.

name: encodedDaftScore
desc: An encoding of the Document About Fringe Topic (daft) score in [0, 1].
meaning: A packed score for how much the document is about a fringe topic.

name: encodedDocumentFringeVulnerability
desc: An estimate of the vulnerability of this doc to show fringe content, based on the context around the document. Can be interpreted as a 'safe' QScore threshold to use (see go/doc-fringe-vulnerability for more info). Encoded for compactness and to restrict visibility. Please contact fringe-ranking@ to get access to quality_fringe::DocumentFringeVulnerabilityEncoding to decode this field.
meaning: A packed estimate of how likely this page is to surface fringe content.

name: encodedEntityPriorScore
desc: Highest entity prior seen for document's Headline and SingleTopic entities (see go/topicality-score for definitions of entity topicalities). Represents probability that a query is fringe, given that the entity is in the result set with topicality >= Headline. Scores scaled to integers between 0 and 1000 for compactness. Scores must be interpreted through FringeQueryPriorEncoding::Decode API.
meaning: The highest chance a query is fringe based on the main entities on the page.

name: encodedFringePriorScore
desc: Probability that a query is fringe, given this document is in the result set. Scores scaled to integers between 0 and 1000 for compactness. Scores must be interpreted through FringeQueryPriorEncoding::Decode API.
meaning: The chance that a query is fringe when this page appears in results.

name: encodedFringeSitePriorScore
desc: Probability that a query is fringe, given this document's site is in the result set. Scores scaled to integers between 0 and 1000 for compactness. Scores must be interpreted through FringeQueryPriorEncoding::Decode API.
meaning: The chance a query is fringe when this page's site appears in results.

name: encodedFringeSitePriorScoreForQfsTraining
desc: Probability that a query is fringe, given this document's site is in the result set. Does not use signals with a dependency on the QueryFringeScore of a document. Scores scaled to integers between 0 and 1000 for compactness. Scores must be interpreted through FringeQueryPriorEncoding::Decode API. Will NOT be present if the fringe_site_prior_score_for_qfs_training is not significantly different from the site_prior_score.
meaning: A training-only version of the site fringe prior that leaves out some inputs.

name: encodedPredictedXlqScoreAndConfidence
desc: A combined encoding of the pXLQ score in [0,1] and the confidence with which that score should be interpreted in [0,1].
meaning: A packed predicted lowest-quality rating for the page plus its confidence.

name: encodedProximityScore
desc: A score in [0, 1] representing the similarity of this doc to known fringe-vulnerable 'seeds'. See go/fringe-proximity for more information. Encoded for compactness and to restrict visibility.
meaning: How similar the page is to known fringe-prone example pages.

name: encodedPseudoraterPxlqScore
desc: An encoding of the XLQ pseudorater severity score translated into pXLQ score space in [0,1]. The encoding includes the pseudorater version and confidence.
meaning: An automated rater's low-quality severity score for the page.

name: sensitiveEntitiesIndices
desc: Indices on the repository_webref::WebrefEntities::entity field of entities that represent a person or a group of people (aka sensitive entities). Will be deprecated once sensitive_entities_mids is fully launched (see b/290268614).
meaning: Positions of entities on the page that refer to people or groups; being replaced.

name: sensitiveEntitiesMids
desc: MIDs of entities that represent a person or a group of people (aka sensitive entities). See b/290268614 for reference why this is needed in replacement to sensitive_entities_indices.
meaning: Identifiers of entities on the page that refer to people or groups of people.

name: desnippetedCountryCode
desc: List of countries that desnippet the publisher. ISO 3166-1-alpha-2 country code (such as FR). See go/iiuse#region-identifiers. Used in V1.
meaning: Countries where this publisher's snippets are withheld.

name: policyCriteriaBase64
desc: Search Console Signals that modifies how policy are calculated. Didn't add
meaning: Encoded Search Console settings that change how preview policy is computed.

name: status
desc: ENP status.
meaning: Whether the publisher is approved or rejected for extended news previews.

name: version
desc: The default version is V0 (for backward compatibility).
meaning: Which version of the extended news preview data this is.

name: numImages
desc: Images are also resources. num_images <= num_resources.
meaning: How many images the page loads.

name: numImagesWithContent
desc: Number of images whose crawl status is CONTENT.
meaning: How many of the page's images were fetched successfully.

name: numResources
desc: Numbers below don't include embedder.
meaning: How many external resources the page loads.

name: numResourcesWithContent
desc: Number of resources whose crawl status is CONTENT.
meaning: How many of those resources were fetched successfully.

name: sumHttpResponseLength
desc: Sum of embedder and all referenced resources.
meaning: Combined byte size of the page and its resources.

name: doubleIndexingExperimentId
desc: Only for double indexing experiments. This field is set for duplicated documents so that docjoin users will not see duplicated docs.
meaning: Marker tagging duplicate documents made for a double indexing experiment.

name: dupExperimentId
desc: Only for Experimental clusters, not relevant for production serving data: Index-Dups can run experiments in Quality Clusters where different versions of the same document (e.g. with different signals) are serving in parallel. They are uniquely identified by the dup-experiment-IDs. This is for experimental clusters only. In prod-versions the member will not be set.
meaning: Identifier used only in experimental clusters, not in production.

name: key
desc: The primary identifier of a production document is the document key, which is the same as the row-key in Alexandria, and represents a URL and its crawling context. The document key is the unique identifier for each document, but multiple document keys can cover the same URL (e.g. crawled with different device types). In your production code, please always assume that the document key is the only way to uniquely identify a document. Link for more background information:
meaning: The unique key identifying a crawled document.

name: cseId
desc: There were defined back in 2007, but were never used. optional string label = 2; optional uint64 user = 3; optional float score = 4;
meaning: An old custom-search identifier that was defined in 2007 and never used.

name: anchorEnd
desc: End date of the last anchor of the document.
meaning: Date of the most recent anchor pointing at the page.

name: anchorFraq
desc: Ratio of spam demoted period to all anchor period.
meaning: Share of the anchor history that falls in the demoted period.

name: anchorStart
desc: Start date of the first anchor of the document.
meaning: Date of the earliest anchor pointing at the page.

name: demoted
desc: Following field record details of anchor demotion in action. How many anchors were demoted.
meaning: How many anchors were demoted.

name: demotedAll
desc: Demoted all anchors in the period or only anchors classified as spam.
meaning: Whether every anchor in the period was demoted or only the spammy ones.

name: demotedEnd
desc: End date of the demotion period.
meaning: When the anchor demotion period ends.

name: demotedStart
desc: Start date of the demotion period.
meaning: When the anchor demotion period starts.

name: phraseCount
desc: Following fields record signals used in anchor spam classification. How many spam phrases found in the anchors among unique domains.
meaning: How many spam phrases appeared in anchors across unique domains.

name: phraseDays
desc: Over how many days 80% of these phrases were discovered.
meaning: The number of days over which most of those phrases appeared.

name: phraseFraq
desc: Spam phrases fraction of all anchors of the document.
meaning: Share of the page's anchors that were spam phrases.

name: phraseRate
desc: Average daily rate of spam anchor discovery.
meaning: Average number of spam anchors found per day.

name: processed
desc: Total number of processed anchors.
meaning: Total number of anchors processed for this page.

name: sampled
desc: True if anchors were sampled during observation phrase.
meaning: Whether only a sample of anchors was examined.

name: sources
desc: Detailed information about trusted sources and match computation. Populated only when --anchorspam_penalizer_debug=true.
meaning: Debug-only details about trusted anchor sources.

name: spamDebugInfo
desc: Additional debug information about computation of spam probability.
meaning: Free-text debug notes about how the spam probability was computed.

name: spamPenalty
desc: Combined penalty for anchor demotion.
meaning: The overall penalty applied for anchor spam.

name: spamProbability
desc: Predicted probability of spam.
meaning: The model's estimated chance that the page's anchors are spam.

name: trustedDemoted
desc: Number of trusted anchors used in computation of spam probability.
meaning: How many trusted anchors went into the spam probability.

name: trustedExamples
desc: Examples of trusted sources.
meaning: Sample names of trusted sources linking to the page.

name: trustedMatching
desc: Number of trusted anchors with anchor text matching spam terms.
meaning: How many trusted anchors used text matching the spam terms.

name: trustedTarget
desc: Following fields record details about trusted anchors True if is this URL is on trusted source.
meaning: Whether this URL sits on a trusted source.

name: trustedTotal
desc: Total number of trusted sources for this URL.
meaning: How many trusted sources link to this URL.

name: phraseAnchorSpamCount
desc: How many spam phrases found in the anchors among unique domains.
meaning: How many spam phrases appeared in anchors across unique domains.

name: phraseAnchorSpamDays
desc: Over how many days 80% of these phrases were discovered.
meaning: The number of days over which most of those spam phrases appeared.

name: phraseAnchorSpamDemoted
desc: Total number of demoted anchors.
meaning: How many anchors were demoted.

name: phraseAnchorSpamEnd
desc: Time when anchor spam spike ended with padding.
meaning: When the burst of spammy anchor text ended.

name: phraseAnchorSpamFraq
desc: Spam phrases fraction of all anchors of the document.
meaning: Share of the page's anchors that were spam phrases.

name: phraseAnchorSpamPenalty
desc: Combined penalty for anchor demotion.
meaning: The overall penalty applied for anchor spam.

name: phraseAnchorSpamProcessed
desc: Total number of observed anchors.
meaning: How many anchors were looked at in total.

name: phraseAnchorSpamRate
desc: Average daily rate of spam anchor discovery.
meaning: Average number of spam anchors found per day.

name: phraseAnchorSpamStart
desc: Time when anchor spam spike started with padding.
meaning: When the burst of spammy anchor text started.

name: localizedAlternateName
desc: Localized alternate names are similar to alternate names, except that it is associated with a language different from its canonical. This is the subset of webmaster-provided localized alternate names being in the dup cluster of this document. Used during serving for swapping in the URL based on regional and language preferences of the user.
meaning: Other language versions of the address, swapped in to match the user's locale.

name: accessRequirements
desc: Contains necessary information to enforce row level Docjoin access control.
meaning: Access control information for reading this document record.

name: badSslCertificate
desc: This field is present iff the page has a bad SSL certificate itself or in its redirect chain.
meaning: Present when the page or its redirects have a bad security certificate.

name: ptoken
desc: Contains information necessary to perform policy decision on the usage of the data assosiated with this cdoc.
meaning: Policy information governing how this document's data may be used.

name: richcontentData
desc: If present, indicates that some content was inserted, deleted, or replaced in the document's content (in CompositeDoc::doc::Content::Representation), and stores information about what was inserted, deleted, or replaced.
meaning: A record that parts of the page's content were inserted, removed, or replaced.

name: scaledIndyRank
desc: to copy to per-doc
meaning: A scaled independence rank value copied into the per document data.

name: indexingIntermediate
desc: Serialized indexing intermediate data.
meaning: Packed intermediate data from the indexing pipeline.

name: docVideos
desc: Info about videos embedded in the document.
meaning: Data about videos embedded in the page.

name: storageRowTimestampMicros
desc: Row timestamp in CDoc storage.
meaning: The storage row timestamp for this document record.

name: partialUpdateInfo
desc: Only present in partial cdocs.
meaning: Present only when this document record is a partial update.

name: anchors
desc: Mark as non-personal since no personal fields will be populated in
meaning: The incoming links and their anchor text for this page.

name: registrationinfo
desc: Information about the most recent creation and expiration of this domain. It's extracted from domainedge signal.
meaning: When this domain was most recently registered and when it expires.

name: docAttachments
desc: A generic container to hold document annotations and signals. For a full list of extensions live today, see go/wde.
meaning: A general container that holds the document's annotations and signals.

name: docinfoPassthroughAttachments
desc: This message set is used for data pushed into the index using the signals framework that is never to be used in Mustang or TG Continuum scoring/snippeting code. Any protocol buffer stored in this message set is automatically returned in a docinfo response - it ends up in the "info" message set in the WWWSnippetResponse, so it can be used in post-doc twiddlers and for display in GWS with no code changes in Mustang or Teragoogle.
meaning: Extra data passed through for display only, deliberately kept out of scoring.

name: docImages
desc: Info about "selected" images associated with the document for which we (already) have ImageData. For each image URL, some fixed number of documents are selected as web referrers for the image URL, and within those selected documents, we say the image is "selected". Within the remaining documents, we say the image is "rejected". Note that this distinction is slightly different from selected for indexing. Only images within doc_images where is_indexed_by_imagesearch i
meaning: Data about the images chosen to represent this page.

name: porninfo
desc: Porn related data used for image and web search porn classification as well as for diagnostics purposes.
meaning: Adult content data about the page used for safe search classification.

name: urldate
desc: Date in the url extracted by quality/snippets/urldate/date-in-url.cc This is given as midnight GMT on the date in question.
meaning: A date parsed out of the page's web address.

name: embeddedContentInfo
desc: Data produced by the embedded-content system. This is a thin message, containing only embedded_links_info data for the embedder and JavaScript/CSS embedded links (the embedded-content bigtable also contains snapshots, compressed document trees and all embedded link types). Provided using the index signal API.
meaning: Information about content and links pulled in from embedded resources.

name: richsnippet
desc: rich snippet extracted from the content of a document.
meaning: Structured rich snippet data pulled out of the page's content.

name: anchorStats
desc: Mark as non-personal since it's an aggregation of anchors. For more details of Search personal data, see go/dma52-search-cdoc-fields.
meaning: Aggregated statistics about the links pointing at this page.

name: dataVersion
desc: Contains the tracking version of various data fields in CompositeDoc.
meaning: Version tracking for the various data fields in the document record.

name: url
desc: WARNING!!! "url" field in CompositeDoc is optional, and is usually missing: e.g., Docjoin CompositeDoc's don't have CompositeDoc::url. has_url() checking is often useful. So don't rely on CompositeDoc::url unless you're sure otherwise. Usually you want to use CompositeDoc::doc::url instead.
meaning: An optional address field that is usually empty and should not be relied on.

name: docjoinsOnSpannerCommitTimestampMicros
desc: The commit timestamp of a CDoc update to Docjoins on Spanner.
meaning: When the document record was committed to storage.

name: ContentChecksum96
desc: Visible content checksum as computed by repository::parsehandler::checksum::Checksum96bitsParseHandler. The value is a Fprint96 in "key format" (i.e., by Fprint96::AsKey()).
meaning: A checksum of the page's visible content.

name: labelData
desc: This field associates a document to particular labels and assigns confidence values to them.
meaning: Labels attached to the document, each with a confidence value.

name: sitemap
desc: Sitelinks: a collection of interesting links a user might be interested in, given they are interested in this document. WARNING: this is different from the crawler Sitemaps (see SitemapsSignals in the attachments).
meaning: The set of related links that may be shown alongside this page.

name: csePagerankCutoff
desc: URL should only be selected for CSE Index if it's pagerank is higher than cse_pagerank_cutoff.
meaning: The pagerank a page must beat to be picked up for the custom search index.

name: SourceTypeBitfield
desc: Indicate how this content came to be included. Legal values are constructed by bitwise-OR-ing values from the included_content::SourceType enum. Default SourceTypeBitfield = included_content::INCLUDED_FRAME
meaning: Flags describing how a piece of included content, such as a frame, got pulled in.

name: dupsComputedAlternateNames
desc: A subset of computed variations, only the members which are dups to the main url. Used during serving for swapping in the URL based on regional and language preferences of the user.
meaning: Duplicate addresses in other languages that can be swapped in for the user.

name: webmasterAlternateNames
desc: All localized alternate names provided by the webmaster (canonical and dups, indexed and not-indexed). Used on the ranking side for swapping out results based on the webmaster preference.
meaning: The webmaster-declared alternate language or region versions of a page, used to swap in the right variant.

name: corpus
desc: The corpus of last full updates.
meaning: Which corpus the last full document update came from.

name: lastFullIndexingTsMicros
desc: Last full update indexing timestamp in microseconds.
meaning: Timestamp of the last full indexing pass for this document.

name: aggregationFp
desc: Representative id for an equivalence class of URLs. E.g.
meaning: An identifier standing for a group of addresses treated as the same.

name: bookId
desc: the book id for the main citation
meaning: The identifier of the book this page mainly cites.

name: discretizedCitationScore
desc: the discretized citation score for the main book. we map the raw score 1.0-20.0 to 0 - 127
meaning: A bucketed score for how strongly the page cites its main book.

name: previewable
desc: Is there a preview or excerpt of the book on this document?
meaning: Whether the page shows a preview or excerpt of the book.

name: secondBookId
desc: book id for the second citation if we can't separate the two top citations (they are too close).
meaning: The identifier of a second book cited about as strongly as the first.

name: secondDiscretizedCitationScore
desc: the discretized score for the second citation
meaning: A bucketed score for the page's second book citation.

name: brainFeatures
desc: Features from SnippetFlow in Superroot.
meaning: Model features used when choosing which snippet to show.

name: experimentalFeatures
desc: For experimental usage, not populated yet.
meaning: A placeholder for experimental snippet features that is not filled in.

name: finalScore
desc: The final score of this candidate.
meaning: The final score of this snippet candidate.

name: isMuppetSelectedSnippet
desc: Is this the candidate chosen by Muppet scorer.
meaning: Whether this candidate was the snippet a particular scorer picked.

name: originalQueryTermCoverageFeatures
desc: Query term (original terms only) coverage features.
meaning: How much of the raw query wording the snippet covers.

name: queryFeatures
desc: Core set of snippet features.
meaning: The main query-related features of the snippet candidate.

name: queryTermCoverageFeatures
desc: Query term (including synonyms) coverage features.
meaning: How much of the query, including synonyms, the snippet covers.

name: radishFeatures
desc: Radish related information.
meaning: Features from the Radish system about this snippet.

name: snippetInfo
desc: Information to identify current chosen snippet.
meaning: Details identifying the snippet that was chosen.

name: perTypeRank
desc: Rank of this title among titles of the same
meaning: Where the title ranks among candidates of the same type.

name: queryMatch
desc: The number of (different) terms with a query match. It may include the match with any SQuery node (e.g., synonyms).
meaning: How many query terms, including synonyms, the title matches.

name: percentBodyTitleTokensCovered
desc: Numbers of body title tokens covered by this title, in range of [0, 1]. Not set if body title is considered "bad".
meaning: What share of the on-page heading's words this title covers.

name: goldmineOtherBoostFeatureCount
desc: The number of BoostFeatures present in AlternativeTitlesGeneator but not populated above.
meaning: How many other title boost features were present but not listed separately.

name: percentTokensCoveredByBodyTitle
desc: Numbers of tokens covered by body title, in range of [0, 1]. Not set if body title is considered "bad".
meaning: What share of this title's words also appear in the on-page heading.

name: hasSiteInfo
desc: Whether a title contains site information.
meaning: Whether the title includes the site's name.

name: goldmineFinalScore
desc: Deprecated: use
meaning: A deprecated final score for the title candidate.

name: testRank
desc: The ranking index of this candidate (starting from 0) in test.
meaning: Where this title candidate ranked in the experiment run.

name: isValid
desc: Whether a title is valid (i.e., not empty).
meaning: Whether the title candidate is non-empty and usable.

name: dupTokens
desc: Numbers of duplicated tokens. For example, duplicated tokens for a title "dog cat cat cat" is 2 (for 2 extra "cat").
meaning: How many repeated words the title contains.

name: text
desc: Title text to display. Populated for debugging purpose only, and won't be used for model inferences. This represetns the exact display text in SERP, with modifications like truncations or site-title appending involved.
meaning: The title's display text, stored only for debugging.

name: forcedExperimentScore
desc: A score assigned for candidates forced by experiments.
meaning: A score given to title candidates forced in by an experiment.

name: baseRank
desc: The ranking index of this candidate (starting from 0) in base.
meaning: Where this title candidate ranked in the baseline run.

name: isTruncated
desc: Whether this title candidate is truncated or not.
meaning: Whether the title candidate was cut short.

name: docLang
desc: Document language for this title. It is used for model inference and hence flattened into RanklabTitle instead of RanklabDoc.
meaning: The page language used when scoring this title candidate.

name: queryRelevance
desc: Deprecated experimental features.
meaning: A deprecated experimental relevance value for the title.

name: sourceTitleTag
desc: =============================================================== Title candidate's original source information. They are populated only for non-production environment for debugging purposes.
meaning: A debug-only flag saying the title came from the page's title tag.

name: queryMatchFraction
desc: A number of matched query terms divided by the number of all terms in query. Synonyms or other terms that appear in squery but not in the raw query are excluded. Takes values in [0, 1].
meaning: The share of the user's query words matched by the title.

name: perTypeQuality
desc: How good or bad this title is as a
meaning: How good the title is judged to be for its type.

name: goldmineAnchorFactor
meaning: How much anchor text contributed to the title candidate's boost score.

name: widthFraction
desc: A rendered width of this title divided by the max allowed width for title. Takes values in [0, 1].
meaning: How wide the rendered title is compared to the maximum width allowed for a title.

name: dataSourceType
desc: Title source type.
meaning: Where the title candidate came from.

name: goldminePageScore
desc: The score for the
meaning: A page-based score for the title candidate.

name: goldmineAdjustedScore
desc: The score for
meaning: An adjusted score for the title candidate.

name: isSnippetBrainBoldingTriggered
desc: Is the bolding triggered.
meaning: Whether bolding was applied inside the generated snippet.

name: modelScore
desc: The score by SnippetBrain model.
meaning: The score a snippet-generation model gave to a candidate snippet.

name: datasetModelArticleScore
desc: Score from the blockbert article classifier model. go/article-understanding-project
meaning: A classifier score for how much the page looks like an article.

name: datasetModelForumListScore
desc: From forum and qna confidence score * 100,
meaning: A classifier score for how much the page looks like a forum or Q and A page.

name: datasetModelMultiProductScore
desc: From indexing.ml.PageType.confidence * 100 (DatasetModelAnnotation in cdoc) go/sdu-shopping-page-intro
meaning: A classifier score for how much the page looks like a multi-product page.

name: expiredShoppingPageScore
desc: From indexing.badpages.CollapserInfo.expired_shopping_page_score * 100
meaning: A score for how likely the shopping page is out of date or expired.

name: multiProductScore
desc: From MagicPageTypeAnnotation.multiplicity.confidence_score * 100 Deprecated as of July 2020 when dataset_model_multi_product_score and dataset_model_single_product_score were added.
meaning: An older multi-product page score, replaced by newer model scores.

name: shoppingSiteScore
desc: From ShoppingSiteClassifier.score * 100
meaning: A classifier score for how much the site looks like a shopping site.

name: shoppingSiteScoreShopfab
desc: From ShoppingSiteClassifierShopfab.score * 100
meaning: A second shopping-site classifier score for the site.

name: outlinkDomainRelationship
desc: Whether an outlink points to the same domain or off-domain. Only added if the relationship is known, and the Offer has ref_type of OUTLINK.
meaning: Whether an offer link points to the same domain or off to another one.

name: pblock
desc: Client needs to make decision on which field to use when both non_displayable_title and pblock.final_title are present.
meaning: The product block data attached to a product.

name: productBrowseonomyIds
desc: Product level Browseonomy ids from shopping_annotation.product.browseonomy.
meaning: Numeric shopping category identifiers for the product.

name: relevanceEmbedding
desc: Relevance embedding from ShoppingAnnotation.Product
meaning: A relevance embedding carried over from the product annotation.

name: weakGlobalProductClusterId
desc: Matched/Inferred weak product identity - set only if the global_product_cluster_id is missing
meaning: A weaker product grouping identifier used when the main one is missing.

name: fingerprintOfOfferUrls
desc: fingerprint of original offer item_urland mobile_offer_url (if present) to be able to understand if offer data came from different url.
meaning: Hashes of the offer's web addresses, used to tell sources apart.

name: gtinValue
desc: Global trade item number (GTIN).
meaning: The global trade item number of a product offer.

name: imageId
desc: image_id is sorted and distinct for efficient search during serving.
meaning: Sorted identifiers of the images attached to an offer.

name: inferredImages
desc: inferred_images are sorted by inferred_image_id for efficient search during serving.
meaning: Images guessed to belong to an offer, sorted for fast lookup at serving.

name: isLensBuildable
desc: Is the offer Lens buildable. The corresponding field in Shopping Annotation is SurfaceSelection.
meaning: Whether the offer can be used by the visual search product.

name: matchingType
desc: information about methods used to match offer with indexed url. See shopping_annotation.proto
meaning: Which method matched a merchant offer to an indexed page.

name: merchantAccountId
desc: account_id of the merchant in shopping systems.
meaning: The merchant's account identifier in shopping systems.

name: merchantItemId
desc: merchant_item_id is meaningless without the merchant_account_id.
meaning: The merchant's own identifier for the item.

name: nonDisplayableBrandMerchantRelationship
desc: direct to consumer brand merchant relationship
meaning: Whether the merchant is the brand selling direct to consumers.

name: nonDisplayableOrganicScoreMillis
desc: Normalized riskiness score for Organic destinations. It's in range [1,1000] with 1 being the worst score and 1000 being the best.
meaning: A one-to-1000 riskiness rating for a merchant destination in organic results.

name: nonDisplayableStaleAvailability
desc: This is experimental, not filled in yet and not intended to be used. Please contact buyable-corpus@ before considering using this field.
meaning: An experimental, unfilled field for stale product availability.

name: allTargetsNamedAnchors
desc: If all the targets in this group are named anchors on the source page.
meaning: Whether every link in this group points to a named anchor on the source page.

name: allTargetsNamedTopictagsScrollto
desc: If all the targets in this group are named topictags_scrollto on the source page.
meaning: Whether every link in this group points to a named scroll-to tag.

name: topUrl
desc: A list of top urls with highest two_level_score, i.e., chrome_trans_clicks.
meaning: The links with the most browser transition clicks in this group.

name: begin
desc: Bolded range [begin, end)
meaning: Where the bolded stretch of snippet text starts.

name: text
desc: Only populated for debugging.
meaning: The bolded snippet text, filled in only for debugging.

name: adjustmentSource
desc: If the selected LSU has been adjusted, i.e. the maximum passage timestamp, firstseen or contentage were assigned to LSU, the adjustment source is stored here.
meaning: Which component supplied an adjustment to the last-update time.

name: isUpperboundTimestampPrecise
desc: The timestamp is precise when it's derived from existing (>March 2022) passage timestamp.
meaning: Whether the upper-bound timestamp came from a precise passage date.

name: unboundedTimestampInSeconds
desc: The timestamp that was picked up by the component indicated in the LastSignificantUpdateSource but was dropped due to exceeding the upper bound. Set only if it is not equal to final LSU.
meaning: A candidate update time that was thrown out for being too late.

name: unboundedTimestampSource
desc: The source that produced the unbounded timestamp.
meaning: Which component produced the discarded candidate update time.

name: upperboundTimestampInSeconds
desc: The upperbound value derived from passage timestamps. If present, the LSU date should never exceed this value. Design doc: go/lsu-max-passage-timestamp
meaning: The latest time the page's last-update date is allowed to be.

name: boostFactor
desc: Site boosting multiplier.
meaning: A multiplier used to boost a shopping site.

name: gobiSite
desc: Whether this is a gobi site, ie, a site from a gobi domain that should be boosted for a category query with this gobi domain. For example, amazon.com is a gobi store domain for category query [hdtv] but some sites (like askville.amazon.com) from amazon.com should not be boosted.
meaning: Marks a site as one from a shopping domain eligible for boosting on category queries.

name: locale
desc: Locale for this data.
meaning: Which country and language this block of data applies to.

name: idf
desc: idf of the original_term. Used by Accumulator2. This field is only available in debug mode.
meaning: How rare a term is across the corpus, stored only in debug output.

name: label
desc: label can be two things depending on where this message is. When right under a SalientTermSet, it is the normalized term returned by quality_salient_terms::utils::NormalizeTerm() from salient_terms_utils.h. When under another SalientTerm message, it is the original term as found in a signal (see original_term field).
meaning: The term itself, either normalized or as originally written.

name: originalTerm
desc: original_term are the different ways we found this normalized term in the signals. They are in increasing idf order (the most common version first). An empty string means that this original term is the same as the label field in the parent SalientTerm message. NOTE: Please do not access this field directly. Use quality_salient_terms::utils::OriginalTermsIterator from salient_terms_utils.h instead.
meaning: The different spellings under which this term was found on the page.

name: salience
desc: salience is the importance of the term as a descriptor in [0, 1] (the higher the more important). This field takes precedence over weight field below. NOTE: Please do not access this field directly. Use quality_salient_terms::utils::GetSalience() from salient_terms_utils.h instead.
meaning: How important a term is as a descriptor of the document, from zero to one.

name: signalTerm
desc: signal_term contains extra signal-specific (e.g., body, anchors, clicks) data for this term.
meaning: Per-source detail for this term, such as body text, anchors or clicks.

name: virtualTf
desc: virtual_tf is the accumulated corrected term frequency from all the signals. This field is only available in debug mode.
meaning: An adjusted count of a term across sources, stored only in debug output.

name: weight
desc: weight is the importance of the term as a descriptor in [0, 100] (the higher the more important). NOTE: Please do not access this field directly. Use quality_salient_terms::utils::GetSalience() from salient_terms_utils.h instead. DEPRECATED: prefer salience field above.
meaning: An older zero-to-100 importance value for a term, replaced by salience.

name: numOfArticlesByPeriods
desc: number of articles (lattice article score is 0.8 or more) sliced by 30 days (num_of_articles_by_periods[0] is the newest).
meaning: How many news-quality articles a site published in each of the last 30-day windows.

name: numOfUrlsByPeriods
desc: number of urls sliced by 30 days (num_of_urls_by_periods[0] is the newest).
meaning: How many pages a site published in each of the last 30-day windows.

name: siteFp
desc: Hash value of the site. This will be used by our experiment and analysis.
meaning: A hash of the site name used for internal experiments and analysis.

name: additionalFixedPointEncodings
desc: Each of the repeated elements in this field has the same scheme as 'fixed_point_encoding'; See go/rankembed-astro-rule-set-dd
meaning: Extra encoded copies of the document's ranking embedding.

name: compressedDocumentEmbedding
desc: Each uint64 encodes 8 8-bit values for the quantized document embedding
meaning: The document's ranking embedding stored in compressed form.

name: fixedPointEncoding
desc: This field replaces the above 3 "per-encoding-type-fields", where the encoding type (and the embedding type) are part of the encoding, and is stored in the first byte. The remaining bytes are the same as the previous 3 fields, but shifted by 1 byte. - byte[0]: encoding type & embedding type - byte[1....]: similar to the above depending on the encoding type.
meaning: The document's ranking embedding packed into one encoded string.

name: scaledFixedPoint4Encoding
desc: byte[0]: version - bytes[1...4]: scalar - bytes[5,...]: the values, one byte per 2 values
meaning: A four-bit-per-value encoded copy of the document's ranking embedding.

name: scaledFixedPoint8Encoding
desc: byte[0]: version - bytes[1...4]: scalar - bytes[5,...]: the values, one byte per value
meaning: An eight-bit-per-value encoded copy of the document's ranking embedding.

name: scaledShiftedFixedPoint4Encoding
desc: byte[0]: version - bytes[1...4]: scalar - bytes[5...8]: shift - bytes[9,...]: the values, one byte per 2 values
meaning: A shifted and scaled compact encoding of the document's ranking embedding.

name: versionAndImprovInfo
desc: First 7 bits encode the version, then each chunk of 5 bits encode the index of a potential improv query (lsb to msb) -------|-----|-----|-----|-----|----- version| id1 | id2 | id3 | id4 | id5 where id1 is the index of the first improv query in the improv debug table. As of cl/270008220, this field only contains the version info. For backward compatibility, version still only uses the first 7 bits, and is still prepended by 5 1 bits.
meaning: Version bits for the embedding format.

name: bootstrappingPreviousIteration
desc: If the EntityNameScore is part of a bootstrapped model, then this field contains the score_ratio from the previous model ("Model 0"). If Model 0 does not have a corresponding entry, because it did not know about this name for this entity, then bootstrapping_previous_iteration is left empty.
meaning: The score this name had in the previous model version during bootstrapping.

name: confidence
desc: Confidence that this name is a trusted name of the entity. A reasonable threshold for name trust is 0.6. A name can be trusted and still have very low score_ratio, esp. if it is ambiguous (e.g. 'mercury') and/or not the dominant interpretation (e.g. "siberian husky" -> /m/06krnsr (a book)).
meaning: How sure the system is that this name really refers to the entity.

name: debugInfo
desc: Debug information about the entity.
meaning: Debugging notes about the entity behind a name score.

name: debugVariantSignals
desc: Source and score data, this is internal to refx (e.g. for demo/debug).
meaning: Internal source and score details for name variants, used for demos and debugging.

name: extendedScoreRatio
desc: Stores region specific score ratios for the entity when it is significantly different from the language version above.
meaning: Name scores for particular regions where they differ from the language-wide score.

name: includeInModel
desc: Include this name in the name lookup table.
meaning: Whether this name is put into the name lookup table.

name: internalBootstrapIsOpenWorld
desc: Transient field, only used in bootstrap pipeline.
meaning: A temporary flag used only while building the model.

name: isClusterGlobal
desc: Set to true iff the concept is cluster parent and the name can be a name for any child of the cluster. (e.g. 'starbucks' is cluster_global for the [Starbucks] chain cluster).
meaning: Whether a name can apply to any member of a group, such as a chain of stores.

name: isDropped
desc: Documented at: google3/repository/webref/enricher/core/data/scored_entity_name.h
meaning: A flag whose meaning is only documented in internal source code.

name: isMatchlessResultContext
desc: Only for context names: Whether this EntityNameScore represents an entity that was dominant in the search results but was not annotated by QRef during learning. Matchless result contexts are useful for bootstrapping, where different model iterations may have different names and thus context scores from Model 0 that are inconsistent with the names from Model 1.
meaning: Marks a name that search results favored but the annotator missed during training.

name: isPruned
desc: Documented at: google3/repository/webref/enricher/core/data/scored_entity_name.h
meaning: A flag whose meaning is only documented in internal source code.

name: mid
desc: The id of the entity.
meaning: The identifier of the entity.

name: nameMetadata
desc: Metadata about this name aggregated from name signals.
meaning: Combined details about a name gathered from the various name sources.

name: rangeMetadata
desc: Metadata of segment range, which is annotated by this entity.
meaning: Details about the stretch of text that this entity was matched to.

name: score
desc: The absolute score of that entity. score = artificial_score + volume_based_score
meaning: The overall score for this entity as a meaning of the name.

name: scoreRatio
desc: Ratio between this entity score and the total score over all entities. This is including the "open world" information if it was estimated.
meaning: This entity's share of the total score across all entities sharing the name.

name: useAsNameCandidate
desc: When this field is true, we consider this context name as candidate in Enricher's names pipeline.
meaning: Whether a context name may be considered as a name candidate later on.

name: volumeBasedScore
desc: Absolute score that comes from quantitative sources such as navboost clicks, anchors, etc. artificial_score = score - volume_based_score
meaning: The part of a name score that comes from counted sources such as clicks and anchors.

name: alphaEntityIdf
desc: This field is only for debugging and link weight experiments. It stores the entity's idf from the alpha model. Alpha idfs are used for link weight computations and available during model omega building via enricher_current_entity_idf_for_link_direction.
meaning: An older rarity score for an entity kept for debugging and link weight tests.

name: commonNgramProb
