desc: Probability that the entity is a common ngram (e.g. from dictionary).
meaning: How likely the entity's name is just a common word or phrase.

name: entityIdf
desc: The final (model omega) idf of an entity. Equals log2(1 / probability of the entity to appear in a document). This probability is currently estimated from its names (i.e. it is a sum of the name frequency weighted by P(entity | name)).
meaning: How rare an entity is across documents.

name: nameCapitalizationProb
desc: The following field is deprecated and should eventually be removed. It uses data and rules that have not been refreshed for ~10y and KG has changed a lot in the meantime.
meaning: An outdated estimate of how often a name is capitalized.

name: canonicalName
desc: An encylopedia style topic name (e.g. "Dog", not "Dogs"). Corresponds to Freebase /type/object/name and similar sources.
meaning: The encyclopedia-style name of a topic.

name: language
desc: The language of this name. See
meaning: Which language a display name is written in.

name: subjectName
desc: A name as it would be used for a news topic, an interest, the subject of a story. E.g. in list of things ("Related topics: Smartphones, computers, accidents". "Interests: Dogs").
meaning: The name used when the entity appears as a topic or interest in a list.

name: aggregatedScores
desc: The score aggregated from all sources.
meaning: The combined score for a name across all its sources.

name: annotatedCategory
desc: Information on categories annotated on the range.
meaning: Categories that were annotated on the text range.

name: debugDetails
desc: DEBUG ONLY: stores a list of queries with per-candidate scores about signals used for prior learning.
meaning: Debug only list of queries with per candidate scoring details.

name: includeInModel
desc: Field which decides if this NameInfo should be included in model creation.
meaning: Whether this name record is used when building the model.

name: name
desc: The specific name to which this information applies.
meaning: The specific name this record describes.

name: ngramData
desc: N-gram data (e.g. n-gram IDF).
meaning: Word frequency data for the name, such as how rare it is.

name: perNameLightweightToken
desc: Lightweight token semantic metadata for inflected name.
meaning: Small token grammar data for an inflected form of the name.

name: scores
desc: The name-specific scores. These scores only depend on the name and are independent of the entity.
meaning: Scores that depend on the name alone, independent of any entity.

name: source
desc: The per-source scores.
meaning: The name's score broken down by each source.

name: completeWorldVolume
desc: Approximates volume of this name including entities we don't have in our set. This is useful to estimate the size of the "open world". For example, this field can be equal to the total number of clicks for the query. Note that for now, we ignore the number of clicks but just use the idf if available.
meaning: An estimate of how much total usage a name has, including unknown entities.

name: contextFringeScore
desc: The fringe score in [0, 1] for this context name. This is only populated for full-query context names.
meaning: How obscure a full query context name is, on a zero to one scale.

name: contextWeight
desc: The amount of evidence available for this context name.
meaning: How much evidence exists for this context name.

name: idfScore
desc: The idf of this name.
meaning: How rare this name is across the corpus.

name: openWorldVolumeModifier
desc: 'Raw' open world is computed based on ngram count data. For some names however, we modify the open world based on entities associated with them. This field contains the additive open world modifier. open_world_volume = raw open world + open_world_volume_modifier
meaning: An adjustment added to the estimated open world usage of a name.

name: totalScore
desc: The total score of that name/source. It describes how much data we have for that name/source. It can for example be the sum of all the entity scores for this name.
meaning: The overall amount of data backing this name from a source.

name: begin
desc: Byte offsets of the mention.
meaning: The byte position where a rated mention starts.

name: anchorIndices
desc: The set of (equivalent from WebRef point of view) anchors used to produce this segment.
meaning: Pointer to the group of anchors this segment came from.

name: anchorText
desc: The anchor text. Note that the normalized text is not populated.
meaning: The visible text of a link pointing at the page.

name: count
desc: The number of times we see this anchor text.
meaning: How many times this exact anchor text was seen.

name: countFromOffdomain
desc: Count, score, normalized score, and volume of offdomain anchors.
meaning: Count of these anchors coming from other domains.

name: countFromOnsite
desc: Count, score, normalized score, and volume of onsite anchors.
meaning: Count of these anchors coming from the same site.

name: normalizedScore
desc: The normalized score, which is computed from the score and the total_volume.
meaning: The anchor score after being scaled against total anchor volume.

name: score
desc: The sum/aggregate of the anchor scores that have the same text.
meaning: Combined score of all anchors sharing this text.

name: scoreFromFragment
desc: The sum/aggregate of the anchor scores that direct to a fragment and have the same text.
meaning: Combined score of anchors with this text that point to a page fragment.

name: scoreFromRedirect
desc: The sum/aggregate of the anchor scores that direct to a different wiki title and have the same text. NOTE: url direct to a fragment score is not included in this value.
meaning: Combined score of anchors with this text that arrive via a redirect.

name: totalVolume
desc: The total score volume used for normalization.
meaning: Total anchor score volume used as the denominator when normalizing.

name: anchors
desc: The composite doc anchors trimmed and transformed in a smaller data structure and aggregated (if they have the exact same text).
meaning: The page's anchors, trimmed down and grouped by identical text.

name: cdocContainer
desc: IMPORTANT: do not access this field directly, use the simplified-cdoc-access library functions to get the composite doc out of this proto.
meaning: Internal wrapper holding the document record; not meant to be read directly.

name: documentMentionSpans
desc: The composite doc spans which were annotated with entities by Webref.
meaning: The spans of document text that were tagged with entities.

name: forwardingDups
desc: Forwarding dups generated by merging existing forwarding dups within cdoc_container and URLs from ReferencePageCandidateList. Populated only before writing to online CDocs Spanner table and used for keeping an index on non canonical URLs in table. [!] Do not use unless fetching CDocs from Enricher's online Spanner CDocs database knowledge-enricher-cdocs-spanner.
meaning: Bookkeeping list of duplicate URLs used only by an internal storage table.

name: matchingMetadata
desc: Metadata related to why this doc was matched to its owning entity.
meaning: Notes on why this document was matched to the entity it belongs to.

name: refconDocumentMetadata
desc: Additional document metadata needed by Refcon.
meaning: Extra document metadata needed by an internal system.

name: url
desc: The URL, populated independently of whether we have a CompositeDoc proto. If the cdoc exists, the url is the same as CompositeDoc.doc.url.
meaning: The document's URL.

name: annotatedRelationship
desc: Information about links (e.g. implications) between the annotated entities.
meaning: Links recorded between entities annotated on the same page.

name: annotations
desc: All annotations of this entity on the given document.
meaning: All the markings of this entity found on the page.

name: collections
desc: Information about the collections of this entity.
meaning: The knowledge graph type groups this entity belongs to.

name: entityJoin
desc: Metadata and raw signals used by the annotator. Intended for internal use. Steer clear of adding new dependencies on fields in this proto, especially external dependencies. If you are a Refx client and would like to consume entity metadata, consider querying TopicServer instead.
meaning: Internal bundle of annotator metadata and raw inputs for an entity.

name: id
desc: An identifier (usually a MID) for the entity. Consider using GetWebrefEntityMid() in the adjacent webref-entities-util.h to read this.
meaning: The entity's identifier.

name: mrf
desc: MRF equivalent representations of this entity as a compound, one for each unique MRF representation. Populated for compounds. Each MRF expression contains a minimum FunctionCall structure wrapped in a nameless Argument without signals and range data. This is not meant to be directly usable as MRF, use QueryJoinToMeaningStructConverter to expand it into a usable form. References to entities are made as component_reference ArgumentValue. Each compound Mention of this entity (not all of its mention
meaning: Alternative structured representations of a compound entity.

name: conceptId
desc: The MID in integer format. Nowadays, this field contains the equivalent representation of
meaning: The entity ID stored as a number.

name: freebaseMid
desc: The MID in the same format that is returned by metaweb::MidToString(), e.g. "/m/02mjmr" or "/g/11b6vyscgb" or "/t/24bjj59_jbj9f".
meaning: The entity ID in its usual string form.

name: byteLength
desc: The length in bytes of such a link (including internal spaces); e.g. if the link text is "click here" then the length is 10.
meaning: Length in bytes of the link text for an outgoing link.

name: byteOffset
desc: The byte offset of the start of a link with this target URL, in the content of the annotated document.
meaning: Byte position where an outgoing link starts in the page content.

name: isNofollow
desc: Whether this is a nofollow link (
meaning: Whether an outgoing link is marked nofollow.

name: topicalityWeight
desc: The topicality_weight for each link with this target URL.
meaning: How much topical weight each outgoing link to this address carries.

name: url
desc: The target URL of the link.
meaning: The address an outgoing link points to.

name: outlinkInfo
desc: Information about each target URL referred to in the document's outlinks. If a given URL has multiple links, they are grouped in a single WebrefLinkInfo.
meaning: Details about every address the page links out to.

name: broaderImportance
desc: The relatedness score of the two entities corresponding to each source above.
meaning: How strongly a broader entity relates to this one, one score per source.

name: mid
desc: The mid of the latent entity.
meaning: The knowledge graph id of the broader related entity.

name: sources
desc: The sources this generalization relationship is coming from.
meaning: Where the broader entity relationship came from.

name: latentEntity
desc: Latent entities with associated metadata including source of the relationship. This is pruned ("compacted") from the concept table and will never reach the annotator.
meaning: A pruned list of broader related entities that never reaches the annotator.

name: aggregatedScore
desc: The score aggregated from all sources.
meaning: The combined score for an entity to entity link across all its sources.

name: isPreferredDirection
desc: The EntityJoin keeps bi-directional links, but for some applications we only need them in one direction. This value indicates whether this is the preferred direction to keep. (We usually prefer keeping the link from the less common to the more common entity for performance reasons). For categorical links the preferred direction is from child to parent.
meaning: Marks which of the two directions of a bidirectional entity link to keep.

name: metadata
desc: The metadata associated with the link.
meaning: Extra descriptive data attached to an entity link.

name: source
desc: The per-source scores.
meaning: The link's score broken down by each source that supplied it.

name: flags
desc: The flags associated with the link kind.
meaning: Boolean settings describing the kind of entity link.

name: topicPropertyName
desc: If the link was extracted from a property, the name of the property. Can start with an exclamation mark "!" to indicate that the inverse relationship is specified. (e.g. "!/tv/tv_series_episode/series" is the inverse of "tv/tv_program/episodes").
meaning: The knowledge graph property name the link was extracted from.

name: allTypes
desc: Contains all types relevant for this entity, along with their provenances and confidences. This field basically replicates information above in a unified way, so that Refcon scroing can make better use of it. If present, Refcon scoring will use all_types, and ignore other fields like freebase_type. Note: there is some basic conflict resolution applied when all_types are computed (implemented in type-extractor.cc, IsLikelyConflictingFreebase).
meaning: All entity types with their sources and confidences, used by entity scoring.

name: salientCategory
desc: verticals4 categories that cooccur with this entity, aggregated over D2E. See where we read from CompactDocClassification in
meaning: Topic categories that often appear together with this entity across documents.

name: wpCategory
desc: WPCat CategotyResult classification.
meaning: Category classification taken from Wikipedia categories.

name: browsyTopic
desc: Experimental scores to be used by Discover.
meaning: Experimental topic scores meant for Discover.

name: debugString
desc: Title of the category. Eg "Politics", "Technology".
meaning: A human-readable category name kept for debugging.

name: hitcat
desc: Sources asserting the category. In the future we may have one calibrated confidence score.
meaning: The sources that claim this page belongs to a category.

name: mid
desc: Mid representation of the category. Eg "/m/05qt0". WARNING: In UDR this field is not populated, use document_entity.entity.mid instead of document_entity.category.mid.
meaning: The category's knowledge graph id, which is not filled in for some outputs.

name: shopping
desc: Qprime asserting this category.
meaning: Shopping system assertion that this category applies.

name: mid
desc: Mid of the topic; only filled in if no values.
meaning: The identifier of a knowledge graph topic.

name: boolValue
desc: Present when value is bool.
meaning: Holds the value when it is a true or false flag.

name: compoundValue
desc: Compound values are those that contain either a number of simple valued facets (such as a latitude/longitude pair), or "mediator" topics representing multi-dimensional relationships between topics. See metaweb/data/topictable/topic.proto for more details.
meaning: Holds a value made of several parts, such as a latitude and longitude pair.

name: datetimeValue
desc: Present when value is datetime.
meaning: Holds the value when it is a date and time.

name: enumValue
desc: Present when value is enum.
meaning: Holds the value when it is one of a fixed list of options.

name: floatValue
desc: Present when value is float.
meaning: Holds the value when it is a decimal number.

name: idValue
desc: Present when value is an id.
meaning: Holds the value when it is an identifier.

name: intValue
desc: Present when value is int.
meaning: Holds the value when it is a whole number.

name: serializedProtoValue
desc: Present when value is a serialized protocol buffer.
meaning: Holds the value when it is a packed binary message.

name: textValue
desc: Present when value is text.
meaning: Holds the value when it is plain text.

name: uriValue
desc: Present when value is URI.
meaning: Holds the value when it is a web address.

name: uriValueFprint32
desc: 32-bit fprint of uri. Can be used instead of
meaning: A short hash of the stored web address.

name: provenance
desc: Optional - for inferred types the principal source of information.
meaning: Where an inferred entity type came from.

name: score
desc: Optional score. Not present in KG directly but e.g. in WPCat.
meaning: An optional score for how well a type fits the entity.

name: typeFprint
desc: Fingerprint of type hrid
meaning: A hash of the type name.

name: typeName
desc: e.g.: "/business/industry", "/book/book_subject", "/people/person"... HRID of the type. May be missing for optimisation reasons in Refcon, but is present for Qref/Webref. At least one of type_name or type_fprint will be present at all times
meaning: The readable name of an entity type, such as a person or a business industry.

name: displayString
desc: How this rating is displayed in the evals, pre-computed from the other fields.
meaning: The pre-built display text for a rating shown in evaluation tools.

name: furballUrl
desc: The url of the ewok task that resulted in this rating. Example:
meaning: The link to the human rating task that produced this rating.

name: pageIsAboutChain
desc: If the topic is about a business chain, whether the
meaning: A rater's judgment about whether the page is about a business chain.

name: projectId
desc: Metadata for task-level ratings. Not filled for aggregated doc-level ratings.
meaning: The rating project identifier, filled only for task level ratings.

name: raterCanUnderstandTopic
desc: Whether rater can understand the topic.
meaning: Whether the human rater said they understood the topic.

name: topicIsChain
desc: Whether the topic is about a business chain.
meaning: Whether the rated topic is a business chain.

name: bookScore
desc: Stores score for later offline voting to choose reference pages. If zero, it's not a good book reference page.
meaning: A score for whether the page is a good book reference page.

name: referencePageScore
desc: Reference page score used to select the reference page owner.
meaning: A score used to pick which page is the reference page for an entity.

name: selected
desc: True if the entity is selected as the reference page owner.
meaning: Whether this entity was chosen as the owner of the reference page.

name: singleTopicness
desc: A score in [0, 1] which indicates the single topicness of the entity.
meaning: Score from 0 to 1 saying how much the page is about just this one entity.

name: singleTopicnessV2
desc: This should have the same semantic as single_topicness, and should replace it in the long term.
meaning: Newer version of the single-topicness score meant to replace the old one.

name: address
desc: Stores parent/container information containing city, province & country.
meaning: The city, region and country containing the place the page is about.

name: componentScores
desc: The raw scores used to calculate the normalized_score. Note that not all these scores may be exposed to the users.
meaning: The raw scores that were combined into the final place score.

name: confidence
desc: A score [0, 1] indicating the confidence.
meaning: How confident the system is that the page is about this place.

name: denseCity
desc: Is this a dense city (e.g., population > 100k)?
meaning: Whether the place is a densely populated city.

name: establishmentType
desc: Sub type for POI types like ESTABLISHMENT_POI, ESTABLISHMENT_GROUNDS & ESTABLISHMENT_BUILDING
meaning: A code for the kind of establishment the place is.

name: latE7
desc: Latitude and Longitude of the location.
meaning: The latitude and longitude of the place.

name: locationName
desc: Name of the Geographic location. This is the normalized name.
meaning: The standardized name of the place.

name: normalizedScore
desc: A score [0, 1] indicating the likelihood of the location being the GeoTopicality.
meaning: How likely it is that the page is about this place, from zero to one.

name: oysterId
desc: Oyster Feature ID of the location.
meaning: The internal map-database identifier for the place.

name: oysterType
desc: Oyster Feature Type
meaning: The internal map-database type code for the place.

name: sumContainedPoiNormalizedScores
desc: The sum of the normalized scores of POIs contained within a particular locality.
meaning: The added-up scores of points of interest inside this area.

name: rating
desc: Ratings and reviews Either for this version only or for all versions to be displayed.
meaning: The app's star rating to display.

name: operatingSystems
desc: See google3/quality/richsnippets/schema/data/operating_systems_rules.txt for possible values.
meaning: The operating systems an app runs on.

name: inAppPurchase
desc: Whether the app offers in-app purchase.
meaning: Whether the app sells things inside the app.

name: iconUrlHref
desc: Icon and Screenshots
meaning: The address of the app's icon image.

name: trustedGenomeData
desc: Trusted Genome data with categorical app information key: locale (e.g. en, en_US)
meaning: Play store category tags for an app, stored per language.

name: liveOpDetails
desc: Unified proto for android LiveOps and iOS LiveEvents.
meaning: Details of limited-time in-app events for Android and iOS apps.

name: applicationUrl
desc: Fields for internal use
meaning: An app link kept for internal use only.

name: langLocale
desc: locale for the localized data, such as name, description and screenshots
meaning: The language and country of the app's translated text.

name: extractedIconColors
desc: Top 10 of extracted icon colors. r = (rgb >> 16) & 0xff; g = (rgb >> 8) & 0xff; b = rgb & 0xff;
meaning: The ten most common colors pulled from an app icon.

name: isDefaultLangLocale
desc: Indicates if the localized data comes from default locale. This is needed because the default localized data does not specify its locale. If this is true, lang_locale may not be the correct locale and should be ignored.
meaning: Flag saying the app text came from the default locale, so the locale label may be wrong.

name: extractedIconColor
desc: Top 1 of extracted icon colors. We keep this field for backward compatibility.
meaning: The single main color pulled from an app icon, kept for older code.

name: supportsChromecast
desc: Whether this App supports Google Cast.
meaning: Whether the app works with Google Cast.

name: screenUrlHref
desc: TODO(b/260128276) deprecate this field in favor of image_data.
meaning: Screenshot links for an app, being replaced by a newer image field.

name: size
desc: bytes or numeric with MB or GB
meaning: How much space the app takes up.

name: price
desc: Price
meaning: The app's price as shown.

name: supportsAndroidTv
desc: Whether this App supports Android TV. Note that some App supports more than one platforms. So we would use boolean for a platform.
meaning: Whether the app works on Android TV.

name: hasEditorsChoiceBadge
desc: Whether the app has editors choice tag
meaning: Whether the app carries an editors choice badge.

name: countriesSupported
desc: These are currently used only for Google Play.
meaning: The countries an app is available in, used only for Google Play.

name: imageData
desc: Copied from google3/contentads/shared/boulder/mobile-app-data-image-data.proto.
meaning: Image data for a mobile app listing.

name: vendor
desc: Vendor
meaning: The company or person that makes the app.

name: optionalResult
desc: Whether this App is optional result for Grid UI.
meaning: Whether this app is an optional extra result in a grid layout.

name: marketplace
desc: Market Android or itunes
meaning: Which app store the listing came from.

name: devConsoleId
desc: Developer console ID of the app if it exists. The ID is available for an app registered to Google Developers Console, not Play Developer Console.
meaning: The developer console identifier of an app.

name: category
desc: Application information.
meaning: The category labels listed for a mobile app.

name: totalRatingCount
desc: Rating_count including all versions of this application.
meaning: How many ratings the app has across all versions.

name: filteringTag
desc: Tags to be indexed for filtering, e.g. "ft_popular_score_gt_1m".
meaning: Tags stored so app results can be filtered, such as a popularity threshold tag.

name: ignoreDataObject
desc: If ignore_data_object is set to true, pagemap attachment is processed regardless of whether data object is present or not.
meaning: Processing flag to handle a pagemap even when no data object is present.

name: type
desc: The object type.
meaning: The type of a structured-data object found on the page.

name: starburstPornScore
desc: Additional SafeSearch signals that are used to compute final scores.
meaning: An image adult-content score that feeds the final SafeSearch scores.

name: count
desc: Number of ratings/reviews aggregated to create this product rating. If there are no ratings yet, this field will be explicitly set to zero, so whether this field is set should be checked using has_count.
meaning: How many ratings or reviews were combined into this product rating.

name: minValueMillis
desc: The lower and upper bounds of the rating values that could be submitted for the product. (Note that it is not the min/max ratings submitted for the product, it is the min/max that can hypothetically be submitted.)
meaning: The lowest and highest rating values that could possibly be given for a product.

name: value
desc: The value of this rating normalized between 0 and 5. This will not be set if count is set to 0.
meaning: The product's average rating rescaled onto a zero to five scale.

name: valueMillis
desc: The non-normalized aggregated value of the ratings for this product.
meaning: The product's combined rating value before it is rescaled.

name: type
desc: Type of this leading text. Should be an enum of LeadingTextInfo.LeadingTextType
meaning: Which kind of leading text this annotation marks.

name: beginPos
desc: Leading text start position, byte offset of page content. The offset is got in ParseMaster. So it is the offset after the content is converted to UTF8.
meaning: The byte position in the page where the leading text starts.

name: leadingtext
desc: Note: You can also use it to save multiple leading text candidates.
meaning: One or more candidate stretches of opening text taken from the page.

name: text
desc: UTF8 text, for alignment when using reusableinfo. The text is not available in docjoins.
meaning: A copy of the leading text itself, used to line positions back up.

name: type
desc: Type of leading text which is optimized for this type of document.
meaning: Which style of leading text was chosen for this kind of document.

name: ThrottleClient
desc: If present, Client API will enforce the contained constraints
meaning: Rate limit constraints the crawl client must obey.

name: DNSHost
desc: Sometimes the hostid and destination IP in the FetchReplyData are not for the hostname in the url. If that's the case DNSHost will be the host that we have used when resolving hostid and DNS. Right now there are two cases: (1) malware team provides a proxy IP:Port to us, so DNSHost will be the proxy IP; and (2) PSS team provides a reference DNS host; so DNSHost will be the reference DNS host.
meaning: Hostname used for DNS lookup when it differs from the URL's host.

name: HostBucketData
desc: Data about the host bucket this request is in (if desired) Please talk with Trawler team before considering using this, since what we fill in here is subject to change.
meaning: Information about the host load bucket this request fell into.

name: DownloadTime
desc: The download time for this fetch (ms). This is the RTT time between fetcher and HOPE, note it does not include time from redirects, just initial hop. If you want the sum of the DownloadTime values for all fetches in the redirect chain, then use the DownLoadTime value in the FetchStats.
meaning: Milliseconds this fetch took to download.

name: ID
desc: Same as the ID of the matching request (used for matching internal fetchclient data in request/reply)
meaning: An identifier that matches this crawl reply back to the request that asked for it.

name: originalProtocolUrl
desc: If the input url in FetchRequest is Amazon S3 protocol or Apple Itunes protocol, we will translate it into https url and log it as https url. In the meantime we will store the original s3/itunes url in this field. Before sending back to client, the Url will be translated back to s3 and this field will be cleard.
meaning: The original S3 or iTunes URL before it was translated to an https address.

name: FlooEgressRegion
desc: If present, fetch was conducted using floonet and this is the location of floonet egress point we used.
meaning: Floonet egress location used for this fetch.

name: UseHtmlCompressDictionary
desc: Use the special compression dictionary for uncompressing this. (trawler::kHtmlCompressionDict. Use trawler::FetchReplyUncompressor to uncompress; crawler/trawler/public/fetchreply-util.h)
meaning: Flag saying a special compression dictionary is needed to unpack the stored body.

name: HTTPTrailers
desc: The received HTTP trailers if available.
meaning: HTTP trailers received with the response.

name: Endpoints
desc: ------- If fetched, the IP from which we fetched, as well as source IP and ports. It is recommended to use trawler::DestinationIP()/HasDestinationIP() accessors, which return a proper IPAddress.
meaning: Source and destination IP addresses and ports used for the fetch.

name: GeoCrawlEgressRegion
desc: If present, the last hop of the fetch was conducted using floonet and this is the location of floonet egress point. It is different from EgressRegion and FlooEgressREgion because it is a Trawler transparent routing configured in the geo crawl rules(go/da-geo-crawl).
meaning: Floonet egress location used for the last hop of a geo crawl.

name: HSTSInfo
desc: Set to: o HSTS_STATUS_NONE if there was no HSTS policy match for the URL's host. o HSTS_STATUS_AVAILABLE if there was an HSTS policy, but the URL was not rewritten from HTTP to HTTPS because enable_hsts was not set in client capability config. o HSTS_STATUS_REWRITTEN if the HSTS policy was followed and url was rewritten from HTTP to HTTPS. This field only pertains to the current URL fetch and does not explain a redirect's HSTS status. However, FetchReplyData.Redirects have their own HSTSInfo.
meaning: Whether an HSTS policy applied and if the URL was rewritten to HTTPS.

name: FetchPatternFp
desc: With the introduction of fetch pattern based hostload exceptions, one hostid may have multiple hostload buckets, each with its own hostload. In this case, FetchPatternFp will be set to identify the hostload bucket within the hostid. Note this field is only meaningful for the HostBucketData which is recorded only when the client requests to have as part of reply. However, this field is useful for certain stats gathering, so we choose to always record it if its value is available during the fetch.
meaning: Fingerprint identifying which host load bucket this fetch used.

name: UrlEncoding
desc: Encoding info for the original url itself. Bitfield encoding; see UrlEncoding::{Set,Get}Value in webutil/urlencoding.
meaning: Character encoding information about the URL string itself.

name: PostData
desc: If the fetch uses HTTP POST, PUT, or PATCH protocol, and WantPostData is true, the POST data will be copied here. This is only for initial hop. If there are redirects, HTTP POST will be changed to GET on subsequent hops, and the PostData will be cleared. There is only one exception, if the HTTP response code to the POST request is 307 (a new code introduced in RFC7321, sec. 6.4.7), we will preserve the request method and the PostData for the next hop.
meaning: A copy of the POST body sent with the crawl request, when one was used.

name: TransparentRewrites
desc: If the url got rewriten by transparent rewrites, here it is the series of rewrites it got through. The fetched one is the last
meaning: The chain of automatic URL rewrites applied before the page was fetched.

name: GeoCrawlFallback
desc: Whether we fallback from geo crawl to local crawl during fetch. The fallback could happen in any hops and there can be at most one fallback because once fallback happens, we will not try geo-crawl anymore.
meaning: Whether the crawler fell back from geo crawl to local crawl.

name: ReuseInfo
desc: -------- Returns trawler::ReuseInfo with status of IMS/IMF/cache query. Consider using HopReuseInfo instead, which has per-redirect hop detail. If there's URL redirection, this field stores the reuse info of the last hop. For example, if the and URL redirect chain is [URL A] --> [URL B] --> [URL C], this field stores the reuse info of [URL C].
meaning: Whether the crawler reused cached content instead of downloading the page again.

name: TimestampInMS
desc: When this reply came back from fetcher NOTE: TimestampInMS is used for internal debugging. To see when a document was crawled, check CrawlDates.
meaning: When the crawl reply came back, used for internal debugging only.

name: CompressedBody
desc: Is the associated body compressed ?
meaning: Whether the fetched body is stored compressed.

name: HttpResponseHeaders
desc: HTTP headers from the response (initial hop). Trawler does not fill this in; this is intended as a placeholder for crawls like webmirror that fill in and want to track this across redirect hops.
meaning: Placeholder for response HTTP headers, not filled in by the crawler.

name: RedirectSourceFetchId
desc: If this fetch was a result of a redirect, we populate the parent ID here.
meaning: The id of the parent fetch when this fetch came from following a redirect.

name: RobotsStatus
desc: Status of the robots.txt fetch. Currently, this is present if: - Certain robots error cases, such as URL_TIMEOUT-TIMEOUT_ROBOTS or URL_UNREACHABLE-UNREACHABLE_ROBOTS_ERROR. - If WantRobotsBody is set in the FetchParams.
meaning: The outcome of fetching the site's robots.txt file.

name: trafficType
desc: Traffic type of this fetch.
meaning: The category of crawl traffic this fetch belongs to.

name: HostId
desc: If known, the trawler::HostId that identifies the host (initial hop).
meaning: Internal host identifier for the host that was fetched.

name: HopRobotsInfo
desc: Extra information in robots.txt for this page (integer: or'ed together of type trawler::RobotsInfo) on a per-hop basis (initial hop)
meaning: Extra robots.txt flags that applied to this fetch.

name: TotalFetchedSize
desc: How many raw bytes we read from the connection to the server when we fetched the page. Includes everything: HTTP headers, overhead for HTTP chunked encoding, whatever compressed/uncompressed form (i.e. gzip/deflate accept-encoding) the content was sent in, etc. This is NOT the same as the size of the uncompressed FetchReply::Body - if the webserver used gzip encoding, this value might be much smaller, since it only counts the compressed wire size. To illustrate, think of 3 sizes: 1) TotalFetched
meaning: Raw number of bytes read off the wire for this fetch, headers included.

name: GeoCrawlLocationAttempted
desc: Set only when GeoCrawlFallback is true. Logs the geo crawl location we attempted but failed for this request.
meaning: The geo crawl location that was tried and failed.

name: HttpVersion
desc: Stores the HTTP version we used in the final hop.
meaning: HTTP version used on the final hop of the fetch.

name: HopCacheKeyForLookup
desc: Returns the cache key used when doing cache lookup/update, on a per-hop basis (initial hop) Note this field will not be set if cache lookup/update is disabled/skipped.
meaning: Cache key used for the crawl cache lookup on this hop.

name: EgressRegion
desc: If present, the edge region that we have used.
meaning: Edge region the crawl request went out from.

name: RobotsInfo
desc: Extra information in robots.txt for this page (ORed together bits from trawler::RobotsInfo). e.g. nosnippet vs. noarchive vs nofollow vs noindex vs disallow Consider using HopRobotsInfo instead, which has per-redirect hop detail.
meaning: Robots directives found for the page, such as noindex, nofollow, nosnippet or noarchive.

name: HopReuseInfo
desc: Returns trawler::ReuseInfo with status of IMS/IMF/cache query, on a per-hop basis (initial hop) For example, if the URL redirect chain is [URL A] --> [URL B] --> [URL C], this field stores the reuse info of [URL A].
meaning: Status of the cache or if-modified-since check for this hop.

name: RequestorIPAddressPacked
desc: Machine that sent Trawler this request, for logging. An IPAddress object, packed as a string.
meaning: The IP address of the machine that sent the crawl request, stored for logging.

name: ProtocolVersionFallback
desc: Whether we fallback from HTTP/2 to HTTP/1.1 during fetch. The fallback could happen in any hops and there can be at most one fallback because once fallback happens, we will not try HTTP/2 anymore.
meaning: Whether the crawler dropped from HTTP/2 to HTTP/1.1 during the fetch.

name: BadSSLCertificate
desc: This field, if non-empty, contains the SSL certificate chain from the server. The filed should be serialized SSLCertificateInfo protobuf, although it used to be text format. Hence, one should ideally use trawler::CertificateUtil to check this field and understand in more detail. This field is populated in two cases: (1) something is wrong with the server certificate and we cannot verify the server's identity. In this case the URL most likely won't display in a browser; (2) if you turned on WantS
meaning: The server's SSL certificate chain when it could not be verified.

name: ClientServiceInfo
desc: Some client specific data that's set by client in the FetchRequest, and we just copy it here verbatim. This is similar to ClientInfo that we copy from FetchRequest to FetchReply, but this is copied to FetchReplyData, thus stored in trawler logs so can be useful for debugging cases.
meaning: Client supplied data copied into the fetch reply for debugging.

name: deliveryReport
desc: Transfer operation detailed report.
meaning: Details about the file transfer operation for this fetch.

name: Url
desc: The original url in the request we are answering. Even though "optional," url must be filled in on all well-formed replies. Trawler guarantees that it is filled in, and basically every client expects it (CHECKs in some cases). -> Not filling this field in is a bug, if you share this data with other crawls/pipelines. You should expect everybody else to require a url.
meaning: The original URL that this crawl reply answers.

name: ThrownAwayBytes
desc: Sometimes we throw away content because we cannot store it in the internal buffers. These is how many bytes we have thrown away for this factor.
meaning: How many bytes of content were discarded because internal buffers were full.

name: HttpRequestHeaders
desc: The HTTP headers we sent to fetch this URL (initial hop). Not normally filled in, unless FetchParams.WantSentHeaders is set.
meaning: The HTTP request headers sent, only when the client asks for them.

name: LastUrlStatus
desc: Crawl status of the last url on chain
meaning: The crawl outcome for the final URL in a redirect chain.

name: EligibleGeoCrawlEgressRegion
desc: If present, it means this host might be eligible for geo crawl. However, this does not mean we enable geo-crawl for this request. Check "GeoCrawlEgressRegion" instead to see if this fetch is conducted via geo crawl.
meaning: Edge region this host might be eligible to be crawled from.

name: Status
desc: Status of the fetch - refers to the final status at the end of the redirect chain.
meaning: The final crawl outcome for this URL after any redirects were followed.

name: RequestorID
desc: RequestorId is the same on as in the request that triggers this reply -- mainly for diagnostics purpose
meaning: The id of the client that asked for this crawl, kept for diagnostics.

name: TrawlerPrivate
desc: For logging only; not present in the actual fetcher response
meaning: Internal crawler logging data that is never returned to clients.

name: PolicyData
desc: Trawler can optionally add a policy label to a FetchReply. Some uses: - "spam" label via trawler_site_info - "roboted:googlebot" label as a signal to crawls supporting multiple useragents that it's not safe to share the fetch replies with googlebot crawls.
meaning: Optional labels the crawler attaches to a fetch, such as spam or roboted markers.

name: HttpProtocol
desc: The http protocol we send to fetch this URL. This will only be set if the request is using http
meaning: The HTTP protocol used to send this fetch request.

name: PredictedDownloadTimeMs
desc: This is available only if a fetch results in TIMEOUT_WEB, and we were able to predict, based on content length and bandwidth we were using, how much time (in ms) would be needed to download the entire content.
meaning: Estimated time it would have taken to finish downloading a page that timed out.

name: RobotsTxt
desc: The robots.txt we used for this URL (initial hop). Not normally filled in unless WantRobotsBody is set. This is mostly for debugging purposes and should not be used for large volumes of traffic.
meaning: A copy of the robots.txt used for this URL, filled in only for debugging.

name: BotOverheadMS
desc: Overhead spent RPCing with the Bot/proxy.
meaning: Time spent communicating with the crawl bot or proxy.

name: ConnectTimeMs
desc: Report only with first request on connection, so that we keep track of the connect time with a host. Sometimes a connection is initiated by a prior request that times out before the connection is established. Another request can get scheduled on a connection that is already in the process of being established but has no request scheduled onto it. We want to keep track of the entire connect time even if a request didn't need to wait for the entire connection establishment time. Sometimes a connec
meaning: How long it took to open the connection to the host.

name: DownLoadTime
desc: DownLoadTime = Share of connect time + ServerResponseTimeMs + TransferTimeMs (see below) in ms
meaning: Total time in milliseconds to download the page.

name: EdgeEgressOverheadMs
desc: Overhead spent routing the request from HOPE to edge egress nodes, which open connection to webservers. This is only set for edge fetches (e.g., through Floonet egress nodes).
meaning: Routing overhead when the fetch went out through edge egress nodes.

name: SSLConnectTimeMs
desc: ConnectTimeMs includes TCP connect time + SSL time, whereas SSLConnectTimeMs includes only the latter.
meaning: The part of connection time spent on the SSL handshake.

name: ServerResponseTimeMs
desc: Time between the request send and the receipt of the first fragment of the response. For HTTP responses the first fragment is the first fragment of the response payload (the headers are ignored).
meaning: Time between sending the request and receiving the first piece of the response.

name: TransferTimeMs
desc: Time to receive the entire response payload starting the clock on receiving the first fragment.
meaning: Time taken to receive the whole response body.

name: BadSSLCertificate
desc: The server SSL certificate chain in SSLCertificateInfo protobuf format. See this field in FetchReplyData (i.e., the initial hop) for more description on when it will be populated.
meaning: The server's SSL certificate chain recorded for this redirect hop.

name: CrawlTimes
desc: Per redirect hop timestamps. This
meaning: Timestamps recorded for each individual redirect hop.

name: DownloadTime
desc: Download time of this fetch (ms)
meaning: How long this hop took to download, in milliseconds.

name: Endpoints
desc: ## stats If fetched, ip info.
meaning: The IP address details for the connection used on this hop.

name: HSTSInfo
desc: This specifies if the url in a redirect was rewritten to HTTPS because of an HSTS policy for the domain. See comments on FetchReplyData.HSTSInfo for how this field's values. A redirect that was rewritten with HSTS will have HSTS_STATUS_REWRITTEN ## here.
meaning: Whether the redirect URL was rewritten to HTTPS because of an HSTS policy.

name: HTTPResponseCode
desc: The HTTP response code for this hop. We need this since multiple response codes may have the same redirect type (e.g., 302 and 307 are both REDIRECT_TEMPORARILY), but clients may want to know which one was received. Note this is set only for the hops that are followed (i.e., TargetUrl is present). If the last redirect hop was not followed the fetch status will be URL_NOT_FOLLOWED, and the response code will be in the top level ProtocolResponse field.
meaning: The HTTP response code returned for this redirect hop.

name: HopPageNoIndexInfo
desc: Extra trawler::PageNoIndexInfo for this hop. Integer: ORed together bits from trawler::PageNoIndexInfo. The information specified by this field comes from the http header or content of the source url, not the "TargetUrl" in this Redirects group.
meaning: Noindex instructions found in the headers or content of this hop's source URL.

name: HopReuseInfo
desc: trawler::ReuseInfo with status of IMS/IMF/cache query, for this hop.
meaning: Whether cached content was reused for this particular hop.

name: HopRobotsInfo
desc: Extra trawler::RobotsInfo for this hop. Integer: ORed together bits from trawler::RobotsInfo
meaning: Robots directives that applied to this redirect hop.

name: HostId
desc: If known, the hostid for this hop
meaning: The internal host identifier for this hop, when known.

name: HttpRequestHeaders
desc: The http headers we sent for fetching this redirect hop. Not normally filled in, unless FetchParams.WantSentHeaders is set.
meaning: The request headers sent for this hop, stored only when specifically asked for.

name: HttpResponseHeaders
desc: The http headers we received from this redirect hop. Trawler does not fill this in; this is intended as a placeholder for crawls like webmirror that fill in and want to track this across redirect hops.
meaning: A placeholder for this hop's response headers that the crawler does not fill in.

name: RawTargetUrl
desc: bytes: can contain bad encoding.
meaning: The raw, possibly badly encoded redirect target address.

name: RefreshTime
desc: Refresh time in meta redirect tag
meaning: The delay value given in a meta refresh redirect tag.

name: RobotsTxt
desc: The robots.txt we used for this fetch. Not normally filled in unless WantRobotsBody is set.
meaning: A copy of the robots.txt used for this hop, stored only on request.

name: SourceBody
desc: For meta-redirects, this field may contain the body of the source document. Currently only filled client side and not implemented (yet) for server-side redirects.
meaning: The body of the source page for a meta redirect, rarely populated.

name: TargetUrl
desc: Difference between the following two fields: TargetUrl is set when we have followed the redirect target, and the url is canonicalized. RawTargetUrl is set in either of the following two cases: (1) The url has not be been followed. For example, the redirect is intended to be handled by the client. In the fetch reply response, you will see the url's status as URL_NOT_FOLLOWED-NOT_FOLLOWED
meaning: The cleaned up URL the redirect pointed to and that the crawler followed.

name: Type
desc: URL and redirect type
meaning: The kind of redirect that was seen on this hop.

name: ClientTrafficFraction
desc: How much existing traffic
meaning: Share of the existing crawl traffic that belongs to this client.

name: ClientWeightFraction
desc: belong to the client How much weight the client
meaning: Share of crawl weight assigned to this client.

name: CurrentActiveConnections
desc: How many connections are actively used for downloading ?
meaning: How many connections are actively downloading from this host right now.

name: IsFull
desc: Is this bucket currently full ?
meaning: Whether this crawl queue bucket is currently full.

name: LastScheduleIntervalMs
desc: How many ms ago we last scheduled a url
meaning: How long ago the crawler last scheduled a URL for this host.

name: MaxActiveConnections
desc: The current hostload value (# of connections) - if negative does not apply
meaning: The current host load limit expressed as a number of connections.

name: MediumTermLoad
desc: The load the recent times (the actual hostload that we apply is MaxActiveConnections / MediumTermLoad) - a hostload of 1.00 is normal, while over 1.0 is higher than normal load
meaning: Recent load level for the host, where 1.0 counts as normal.

name: MinInterRequestSecs
desc: The min delay between requests (in secs) - if negative does not apply
meaning: Minimum delay in seconds the crawler keeps between requests to this host.

name: NonFullIntervalMs
desc: If is full, when is becoming non-full (in ms)
meaning: How long until a full crawl bucket has room again.

name: TotalCapacityQps
desc: The following four fields attempt to make things simpler for clients to estimate available capacity. They are not populated yet as of 2013/08/21. Even after they are populated, they may change. So talk to trawler-dev@ before you use the fields. Total qps for this hostid
meaning: Total crawl requests per second available for this host.

name: TotalUsedQps
desc: Currently used qps
meaning: How much of the host's crawl capacity is currently being used.

name: ExtraData
desc: in roboted case, the RobotsInfo
meaning: Extra detail attached to a policy label, such as robots information.

name: Label
desc: "spam" or "roboted:googlebot"
meaning: A policy tag on a fetch, for example spam or blocked for a specific crawler.

name: ALPNNegotiatedProtocol
desc: ALPN negotiated protocol, see
meaning: The protocol agreed on during the TLS handshake.

name: CertificateChain
desc: If present, this consists of the remote webserver's X.509 certificate chain in DER format. The chain stored here is the
meaning: The web server's certificate chain captured during the fetch.

name: ErrorMessages
desc: ErrorMessages contains errors from HTTPS validation. Examples of such errors include invalid certificates, failure to build a certificate chain, certificates that do not match the expected hostname, and internal errors. If ErrorMessages is empty, HTTPS validation succeeded. Otherwise, it failed. This is the only guarantee about the contents of this field, though legacy code exists that embeds invalid assumptions, b/70904498. New code should not do anything with this field other than test whether
meaning: Errors from HTTPS certificate validation; empty means validation passed.

name: IsTruncated
desc: This SSLCertificateInfo had its fields truncated because it was too large. It is no longer set (cl/205356251) but may be true in old records.
meaning: An old flag saying certificate data was cut short; it is no longer set.

name: OCSPResponse
desc: Stapled OCSP response obtained during the TLS handshake, if any. An OCSP (Online Certificate Status Protocol) response is an indication, signed by the issuing CA, that the certificate has not been revoked. A TLS handshake extension allows servers to "staple" a response to the certificate served in the handshake, saving the need for the client to fetch it itself from the CA. This field contain the stapled OCSP response if the server served one. See RFC6066, Section 8 for the data format
meaning: The stapled certificate revocation response served during the TLS handshake.

name: SCTList
desc: SCTList obtained during the TLS handshake, if any. See RFC6962, Section 3.3 for the data format:
meaning: Certificate transparency records seen during the TLS handshake.

name: SSLProtocolVersion
desc: Details about the SSL/TLS protocol and cipher. See RFC5246 and google3/crawler/trawler/hope/proto/ssl.proto for more details.
meaning: The TLS protocol version and cipher used, as a numeric code.

name: SSLProtocolVersionName
desc: The names of the SSL protocol version and cipher suite. These strings are implementation defined and may be subject to change.
meaning: Readable names of the TLS version and cipher suite used.

name: DestinationIPAddressPacked
desc: Address of the destination host. Extract with trawler::DestinationIP() or decode with PackedStringToIPAddress().
meaning: The IP address of the server that was fetched.

name: SourceIPAddressPacked
desc: Source address of the crawl machine we originated the fetch from. Extract with trawler::SourceIP() or decode with PackedStringToIPAddress().
meaning: The IP address of the crawl machine the fetch came from.

name: docBoost
desc: Information about potential rank boosting for the document by virtue of its Live Result feed.
meaning: The bundle of live-result boost information attached to a document.

name: providerAttachment
desc: Identifies a Live Result which is to be attached to the document.
meaning: The live result content attached to the document.

name: additionalChangesMerged
desc: Duplicate UrlChanges crawled within a specified time range will be merged together. UrlChanges are considered duplicates if the simhash, simhash_is_trusted, simhash_v2, simhash_v2_is_trusted, and shingle_simhash are the same. additional_changes_merged indiciates the number of duplicate UrlChanges merged into this UrlChange.
meaning: How many identical change records were folded into this one.

name: fractionalTileChange
desc: Deprecated fields. The fraction of tiles (0 to 1) that changed.
meaning: A deprecated measure of what share of the page's tiles changed.

name: interval
desc: The length in seconds of the change.
meaning: How many seconds the observed change spanned.

name: offDomainLinksChange
desc: Whether the content of the off-domain links changed.
meaning: Whether the page's links to other domains changed.

name: offDomainLinksCount
desc: The new count of off-domain links, if they changed.
meaning: The new number of links pointing off the page's own domain.

name: onDomainLinksCount
desc: The new count of on-domain links, if the count changed.
meaning: The new number of links pointing within the page's own domain.

name: onDomainLinksCountChange
desc: Whether the number of on-domain links changed.
meaning: Whether the number of same-domain links changed.

name: shingleSimhash
desc: The old simhash value obtained from shingles.
meaning: A content fingerprint of the older version of the page.

name: simhash
desc: The simhash-v1 value. Use of simhash-v1 is deprecated, and newer UrlChange should only contain simhash-v2. During this transition period, UrlChange can contain either simhash or simhash_v2. It is possible that previous UrlChange only contain simhash-v1 and the next UrlChange only contain simhash-v2. In this case, we skip that interval in our changerate computation. [go/changerate-simhash-v2-migration]
meaning: A deprecated first-version content fingerprint of the page.

name: simhashIsTrusted
desc: Whether the simhash-v1 should be trusted.
meaning: Whether the older content fingerprint can be relied on.

name: simhashV2
desc: The simhash-v2 value.
meaning: The second-version content fingerprint of the page.

name: simhashV2IsTrusted
desc: Whether the simhash-v2 value should be trusted.
meaning: Whether the second-version content fingerprint can be relied on.

name: additionalChangesMerged
desc: Same as the field in UrlChange. This allows us to merge identical UrlVersions into a single UrlVersion.
meaning: How many identical version records were folded into this one.

name: contentType
desc: The content type of the page.
meaning: The content type of the fetched page.

name: isImsNotModified
desc: Whether this is an IMS response (a 304, not modified).
meaning: Whether the fetch came back as a not-modified response.

name: lastModified
desc: The date from the LastModified header, if present.
meaning: The date the server reported in the page's last-modified header.

name: shingleSimhash
desc: The simhash value obtained from shingles.
meaning: A content fingerprint of this version of the page.

name: simhash
desc: The simhash-v1 value. The simhash-v1 is now deprecated and new UrlVersions should only populate simhash-v2. During migration phase from using simhash-v1 to simhash-v2, it is possible that previous UrlChange only contain simhash-v1 and the next UrlChange / UrlVersion could only contain simhash-v2. In this case, we skip that interval in our changerate computation. [go/changerate-simhash-v2-migration]
meaning: A deprecated first-version content fingerprint of this page version.

name: simhashIsTrusted
desc: Whether the simhash-v1 should be trusted.
meaning: Whether the older content fingerprint can be relied on.

name: simhashV2
desc: The simhash-v2 value.
meaning: The second-version content fingerprint of this page version.

name: simhashV2IsTrusted
desc: Whether the simhash-v2 value should be trusted.
meaning: Whether the second-version content fingerprint can be relied on.

name: timestamp
desc: The timestamp we crawled the page.
meaning: When the crawler fetched this version of the page.

name: logScaling
desc: Scaling factor to ensure the approximated posterior to have the same scale as the product of prior and likelihood. This value is used to compute posterior weights. Uses log scale to provide a wider range. This field is for internal use only.
meaning: An internal scaling factor used in the change-rate maths.

name: type
desc: The type indicates the type of the distribution.
meaning: Which kind of statistical distribution this is.

name: weight
desc: The weight is only used in multiple component scenarios.
meaning: The weight of one part of a multi-part distribution.

name: debugInfo
desc: For debugging purpose only.
meaning: Free-text notes kept only for debugging.

name: numImageUrls
desc: This represents the number of urls with image clicks. A url can have both image and non-image clicks, in which case we set num_image_urls to be the ratio of image_clicks vs total clicks. For example, if a url has 10 total clicks and 7 image clicks, num_image_urls will be set to 0.7.
meaning: How many of the URL's clicks were image clicks, as a count or a ratio.

name: pattern
desc: For debugging purpose only.
meaning: The pattern string, kept only for debugging.

name: fpOutlinks
desc: A fingerprint of all outlink-URLs of this document that have been used as algorithmic input.
meaning: A fingerprint summarizing the page's outbound links.

name: lastModifiedInputTimestampMs
desc: The last time the set of outgoing links of this document was modified. This is the input for our calculation.
meaning: When the page's set of outbound links last changed.

name: lastProcessedOutputTimestampMs
desc: The last time the cross-validation of the links was done. Between that last timestamp and now, only cached results have been used.
meaning: When the link cross-check was last run.

name: linkMember
desc: All verified members of the cluster (including recursive inclusions).
meaning: The verified member pages of the cluster.

name: crawlTimestamp
desc: If set, represents the crawl timestamp. If not set, there is no known crawl timestamp for that url.
meaning: When the linked page was last crawled.

name: pathFromRoot
desc: The path from root to current node. This is only used for debugging.
meaning: The route from the root to this node, kept only for debugging.

name: patternId
desc: This is only used in leaf nodes which represents a url pattern. It is the fingerprint of the splitting url features from root to the leaf.
meaning: A fingerprint identifying the URL pattern at a leaf node.

name: splittingFeatureScore
desc: The information gain of content features when selecting this splitting feature to split the node.
meaning: How much splitting on this feature improved the tree, as an information-gain number.

name: fingerprintWithGroupInType
desc: If consider position when calculating fingerprint of url feature.
meaning: Whether feature position is included when the URL feature fingerprint is computed.

name: groupInType
desc: Used together w/ type field to group features, for finding features with too many possible values.
meaning: A grouping label used with the feature type to bucket URL features.

name: id
desc: Unique ID.
meaning: The vertical's numeric identifier.

name: name
desc: The description name.
meaning: The name of the predicted vertical.

name: petacatId
desc: The corresponding Petacat ID.
meaning: The matching category ID in another taxonomy.

name: probability
desc: The probability of the vertical, whose value is in [0.0, 1.0].
meaning: How confident the model is that the page belongs to this vertical.

name: deviceMatchInfo
desc: Device match info calculated only by URL pattern.
meaning: Guess at which device an alternate URL targets, based on the URL pattern.

name: ecnFp
desc: Fp96 of webmirror ECN as of the last time the canonical was processed.
meaning: A fingerprint recorded when the canonical URL was last processed.

name: feedUrl
desc: Populated if annotation_source is SITEMAP.
meaning: The sitemap address that supplied this alternate URL, when applicable.

name: parsedLanguage
desc: Parsed language and region code from language field.
meaning: Language and region code parsed out of an alternate URL's language field.

name: urlEncoding
desc: see webutil/urlencoding
meaning: Numeric code for how the URL is encoded.

name: expirationTimestamp
desc: The thumbnail is guaranteed to be kept in the serving system until the expiration timestamp has passed, in microseconds.
meaning: How long the thumbnail is guaranteed to stay available for serving.

name: corpusSelectionInfo
desc: Corpus scoring info for images indexed through Amarna.
meaning: Scoring information about which image collections this image was selected into.

name: isUnwantedContent
desc: Field to indicate the image is unwanted for search index. The data is propagated from amarna to alexandria to be annotated in the cdoc. Refer to image/repository/proto/unwanted_content.proto for more info.
meaning: A flag marking the image as unwanted for the search index.

name: colorScore
desc: Colorness scores for the image. Each score represents the amount of a particular color in the image. At the current time, there are 12 colors, so there should always be 0 or 12 values in this array. The 12 colors are black, blue, brown, gray, green, orange, pink, purple, red, teal, white, yellow. The convention is that the scores are stored in alphabetical order, so the first score is black, and the last score is yellow.
meaning: How much of each of twelve basic colors appears in the image.

name: isIndexedByImagesearch
desc: If this image was not selected for indexing by imagesearch, these fields say so and explain why.
meaning: Whether image search chose to index this image, and why not if it did not.

name: lastCrawlTime
desc: Most recent timestamp in seconds when this URL was crawled.
meaning: The most recent time this image address was fetched.

name: nearDupFeaturesVersion
desc: Image content derived data used for finding image near dups. NOTE: This hash is generated by V1 hash computation.
meaning: Which generation of the duplicate-detection hash was used.

name: clipartDetectorScore
desc: Image content based classifier scores.
meaning: A classifier score for whether the picture looks like clipart.

name: contentFirstCrawlTime
desc: Earliest known crawl time among all neardups of this image (go/imagecontentage).
meaning: The earliest crawl time seen for any near duplicate of this image.

name: embeddedMetadata
desc: the EXIF/IPTC metadata
meaning: The camera and authoring metadata embedded in the image file.

name: imageContentQueryBoost
desc: Image Content Scored per query boosts. Currently this is filled by the pamir algorithm and populates the pamir_section.
meaning: Per-query score boosts for the image produced by an image content model.

name: shoppingProductInformation
desc: The Shoppable Images product information to be annotated in the Cdoc. All fields will be populated except the product location bounding box.
meaning: Product details attached to shoppable images.

name: height
desc: Height
meaning: The height of the image in pixels.

name: imageLicenseInfo
desc: Indicates license info of this image, which will tell image search users how to use this image legally.
meaning: Licensing details telling users how they may legally reuse the image.

name: extendedExif
desc: The EXIF generated by photos backend team's (more specifically FIFE's) thumbnailer library. This exif model is more comprehensive since a dedicated team is constantly improving it and adding new fields over time. This is currently populated by moonshine for selected corpora.
meaning: A richer set of embedded image metadata produced by the photos backend.

name: nimaVq
desc: Productionized Nima VQ score.
meaning: A model score for the technical visual quality of the picture.

name: imageQualityClickSignals
desc: Click signals for measuring image quality (e.g., usefulness, presentation, appealingness, and engagingness). Click signals are considered Search CPS Personal Data.
meaning: Click behavior used to judge how useful and appealing an image is.

name: finalPornScore
desc: A [0..1] porn score based on some image-level features (like content score, referrer statistics, navboost queries, etc.). See class RiflePornScorer for more details.
meaning: A combined adult-content score built from image features, referrers and query clicks.

name: coloredPixelsFrac
desc: Fraction of the image that contains pixels over a certain saturation threshold: can be used to determine if the image is grayscale or not.
meaning: The share of pixels with real color, used to tell color from grayscale.

name: whiteBackgroundScoreVersion
desc: Image is likely an object on a white background (value on [0,1]).
meaning: How likely the picture is a single object shot on a white background.

name: clusterId
desc: Superlabels generated cluster id. This field is going to be deprecated, please use
meaning: An internal cluster identifier for the image that is being phased out.

name: restrictStrings
desc: A string representation of all the restricts associated with this image.
meaning: A written-out list of all the filters attached to this image.

name: hateLogoDetection
desc: Hate logo detections from the VSS logo_recognition module.
meaning: Detections of hate-related logos found in the picture.

name: clickMagnetScore
desc: A score in (0, 1] to indicate how likely this image is considered as a click magnet based on clicks received from bad queries.
meaning: How likely the image is to attract clicks from unrelated or bad queries.

name: nearDupFeaturesSmallVersion
desc: The following fields contain information about a smaller and less powerful version of the hash, needed for neardup retrieval. A compressed and an encoded version of the small hash are stored below. The smaller hash may have a few variants to increase recall. NOTE: This hash is generated by V2 hash computation. A compressed version of the small hash. Currently, a 4-byte fingerprint.
meaning: Which generation of the small duplicate-detection hash was used.

name: styleAestheticsScore
desc: Aesthetics score of a style image.
meaning: How attractive a fashion-style image is judged to be.

name: smearedTopWebLandingPageDocids
desc: Web docids that correspond to high ranked smeared landing pages for this image. Used for conditional retrieval of actionable landing pages for image search.
meaning: Identifiers of top-ranked web pages that this image leads to.

name: robotedAgents
desc: CSV list of user agents for which this image should be considered roboted. Note: All images are crawled using googlebot-images, this exists for clients that require additional restrictions beyond googlebot-images such as news.
meaning: Which crawler user agents are blocked from this image by robots rules.

name: size
desc: Size in bytes of original (non-thumbnail)
meaning: The byte size of the original full-size image file.

name: canonicalDocid
desc: This is the image docid used in image search. For ImageData protos coming from Alexandria/Freshdocs, this is a 'required' field that MUST be populated.
meaning: The internal identifier used for this image in image search.

name: pornFlagData
desc: Used by the segindexer for combined www+image indices.
meaning: Adult-content flags used when web and image indexes are combined.

name: personAttributes
desc: Contains person attributes from the LookNet-Person model and the Style AI Iconic Person Scorer for the most iconic person in a style image.
meaning: Attributes of the most prominent person in a fashion-style image.

name: generatedImageLikelihoodSignal
desc: The signal about the likelihood of whether the image is generated by Google.
meaning: How likely it is that the picture was made by Google's image generation.

name: testingScore
desc: This field is for testing purposes, more information in go/media-dirt-2022.
meaning: A field kept purely for testing purposes.

name: ocrGoodoc
desc: Pruned OCR Goodoc see vss_aksara_ocr_util.h for the fields copied.
meaning: A trimmed record of text read out of the image by character recognition.

name: docid
desc: fingerprint(non-canonicalized absolute image url) This is
meaning: An identifier built from the image's web address.

name: orbitIntents
desc: Orbit intents. More details on go/orbit-in-image-indexing.
meaning: Predicted user intents associated with the image.

name: flags
desc: Use image_perdoc.h to read/write 'flags'.
meaning: A packed set of internal bits about the image, readable only with helper code.

name: thumbWidth
desc: Thumbnail width.
meaning: The width of the thumbnail shown for this image.

name: packedFullFaceInfo
desc: Encodes face number and largest face frac into a small package for storage in mustang. This is calculated directly from FaceDetectionResult.
meaning: Face count and largest-face size squeezed into a compact index value.

name: crops
desc: The content-aware cropping information.
meaning: Suggested crop areas so the image can be shown well at small sizes.

name: ocrTextboxes
desc: Text lines detected by OCR engine.
meaning: The individual lines of text found inside the image.

name: h2i
desc: 'Hovers to Impressions' and 'Hovers to Clicks' ratios for an image. These are considered Search CPS Personal Data due to concerns that they may be used to reidentify or confirm the presence of specific singleton (unique) queries.
meaning: How often people hover over this image compared with seeing or clicking it.

name: isMultiframe
desc: True if the original image contains multiple frames (e.g., for animated or stereoscopic images).
meaning: Whether the original file contains more than one frame.

name: ocrTaser
desc: Ocr detected by ocr_taser module.
meaning: Text read out of the image by a second character recognition system.

name: featuredImageProp
desc: Properties used in featured imagesearch project. inspiration_score indicates how well an image is related to products, or how inspirational it is.
meaning: Properties for the featured image money-making project, such as inspiration score.

name: unavailableAfterSecs
desc: Time in seconds since epoch after which this image should be considered unavailable.
meaning: The time after which this image should be treated as no longer available.

name: imageRegions
desc: Regions detected within the image (go/images-region-search-edd). Regions contain bounding boxes circumscribing objects of interest in the image, along with object labels. Regions may overlap.
meaning: Boxes around objects found inside the picture, each with a label.

name: fileFormat
desc: True file format (not extension).
meaning: The image's actual file format, regardless of its file extension.

name: deepTags
desc: VSS generated deep tags for shopping images.
meaning: Shopping-oriented visual tags attached to product images.

name: personDetectionSignals
desc: Contains person detection result.
meaning: The result of looking for people in a fashion-style image.

name: flowOutput
desc: The output of various features generated by the Flow framework, most importantly data from Starburst (go/starburst). Do NOT interact with the internals of this proto since they may change over time. Instead, use the existing interfaces that consume FlowProtoProd's directly, e.g., image/mustang/content/image_content_distance.h For more info, please contact image-content-core@.
meaning: Bundled image-content features used to compare how similar pictures are.

name: numberFaces
desc: Number of faces detected in the image
meaning: How many faces were found in the picture.

name: deepImageEngagingness
desc: Productionized Deep Image Engagingness score.
meaning: A model score for how engaging the picture is likely to be.

name: isVisible
desc: True if the image is inlined on the page (typicially via ) or false if the image is linked to (via an href).
meaning: Whether the image is shown on the page or only linked from it.

name: url
desc: Canonicalized absolute image url.
meaning: The cleaned-up full web address of the image.

name: licensedWebImagesOptInState
desc: Indicates the web-master opt-in state of this image, and will be used for Google products to decide usage rights like showing large previews.
meaning: Whether the site owner opted this image into uses such as large previews.

name: rankInNeardupCluster
desc: Rank in near-dup cluster (go/image-rank-in-neardup-cluster). The rank is 1-indexed: rank 1 is the best.
meaning: Where this image places among its near duplicates, with one being best.

name: codomainStrength
desc: Like is_visible, this is a property of the (web-doc, img_url) pair not just the image. A high codomain_strength indicates high confidence based on collected stats that the image is hosted on a companion domain. If not enough stats are available for codomain strength, this field may be absent in ImageData, and hence the CompositeDoc. Do not place negative values here. Permitted values range between 0 and image_quality_codomain::kMaxCodomainStrength defined in //image/quality/codomain/codomain-sta
meaning: Confidence that the image is hosted on a domain related to the page showing it.

name: deepCrop
desc: DeepCrop based cropping information. See go/creatism/deepcrop for details.
meaning: Model-based suggested crop areas for showing the image.

name: firstCrawlTime
desc: Earliest known timestamp about this image. Today, this is the timestamp when the content key was generated for this image. The time is in seconds.
meaning: The earliest time this image is known to have existed.

name: adaboostImageFeaturePorn
desc: Warning: adaboost_image_feature_porn* and imageFeaturePorn fields are DEPRECATED in favor of brain_porn_scores. Please do not use them. Contact safesearch@ for transition advice.
meaning: An old adult-content classifier score, replaced by newer safe search scores.

name: brainPornScores
desc: A [0..1] SafeSearch scores based on image pixels, using Google Brain: porn, csai, violence, medical, and spoof. For porn only, if available prefer final_porn_score as it should be more precise than brain_porn_scores.porn_score.
meaning: Scores from image pixels for adult, violent, medical and spoof content.

name: styleImageType
desc: Prediction of a style image type: Stage, Stock, Street or Outfits.
meaning: A guess at which kind of fashion image this is, such as stock or street.

name: animatedImageData
desc: Present for animated images only: additional animatated image perdoc data.
meaning: A pointer to extra stored data that only animated images have.

name: onPageAlternateUrl
desc: For an image not explicitly visible on this page, the following url is the one which most closely matches it.
meaning: The page address that best matches an image not directly shown on this page.

name: largestFaceFrac
desc: Fraction of image covered by the largest face (should match largestFaceFraction, but without scaling). In perdocs, is set only if numberFaces > 0.
meaning: How much of the picture is taken up by the biggest face in it.

name: imageExactBoost
desc: A set of query fingerprints and confidence scores. There queries are supposed to be relevant to the image with high confidence.
meaning: Queries the image is believed to match, with a confidence score for each.

name: brainPornScoresVersion
desc: A string that indicates the version of SafeSearch classifier used to compute brain_porn_scores.
meaning: Which version of the safe search classifier produced the pixel scores.

name: largestFaceFraction
desc: Fraction of image covered by the largest face, scaled by 1000. Warning: Is DEPRECATED in favor of largest_face_frac. Do not use.
meaning: An older scaled version of the largest-face fraction that should not be used.

name: finalPornScoreVersion
desc: A string that indicates the version of SafeSearch classifier used to compute final_porn_score.
meaning: Which version of the classifier produced the final adult-content score.

name: superlabelsV2ClusterId
desc: Superlabels V2 generated cluster id.
meaning: A newer internal grouping identifier for the image.

name: isIipInScope
desc: IIP in scope signal (go/iip). Set to true if the image is annotated with any iip_in_scope entities (go/iukp-trust-v2).
meaning: A flag marking the image as covered by a particular trust program's entities.

name: firstTimeSeenOnDocSec
desc: The first time this image URL was seen on the containing web page. Only set during web indexing.
meaning: The first time this image address was seen on the page that shows it.

name: nimaAva
desc: Productionized Nima AVA score. Both this field and nima_vq were added on the top of nima_ava_score and nima_vq_score because the signals are already integrated with Batch Amarna in image/repository/schema/global_output_tags.h using NimaOutput.
meaning: A model score for the aesthetic appeal of the picture.

name: precomputedRestricts
desc: Restricts computed before building a Mustang index.
meaning: Filters worked out ahead of time and stored with the index entry.

name: linkinfoType
desc: Bitmask of LinkInfo enum in google3/indexing/converter/outlinks/linkinfo.h.
meaning: A packed set of bits describing the link type, with no further detail given.

name: indexedVerticals
desc: Vertical indexing information for the document and associated image outlinks.
meaning: Which specialized indexes this image and its links were placed into.

name: expirationTimestampMicros
desc: The thumbnail is guaranteed to be kept in the serving system until the expiration timestamp has passed, in microseconds.
meaning: How long the thumbnail is guaranteed to stay available for serving.

name: score
desc: NIMA score.
meaning: A model score rating the quality of the image.

name: fingerprintNearestNeighborDecision
desc: Decision according to the given fingerprint nearest neighbor score.
meaning: Verdict on whether an image is machine generated based on fingerprint matching.

name: provenanceClassifierDecision
desc: OVERALL DECISION Decision according to the given watermark logits and fingerprint nearest neighbor score.
meaning: Overall verdict on whether an image was machine generated.

name: watermarkDecision
desc: INDIVIDUAL DECISION Decision according to the given watermark logits.
meaning: Verdict on whether an image is machine generated based on watermark detection.

name: durationValue
desc: seconds
meaning: A duration value, in seconds, stored on a knowledge graph fact.

name: idValue
desc: An id representing an entity (mid or hrid)
meaning: An internal identifier pointing at a knowledge graph entity.

name: locale
desc: The language code for the object value. It must be a BCP 47-compliant language tag (b/10005172). See also go/kg-data-l10n.
meaning: The language tag of the stored value.

name: stringValue
desc: A UTF-8 string value to be used for the following expected schema types: - /type/rawstring - /type/text - /type/key
meaning: A plain text value stored on a knowledge graph fact.

name: uriValue
