desc: A UTF-8 string value to be used for expected type /type/uri - b/68760994.
meaning: A URL value stored on a knowledge graph fact.

name: imagesearchDocid
desc: Source imagesearch docid
meaning: An internal document ID pointing at the image search record this entry came from.

name: webDocid
desc: Docid of web landing page
meaning: An internal document ID for the web page an image links out to.

name: freshdocsOutgoing
desc: Selected outgoing attributions extracted on FreshDocs.
meaning: Content the page credits to other sources, found on the fresh document path.

name: offlineOutgoing
desc: Selected outgoing attributions extracted via offline MR jobs.
meaning: Content the page credits to other sources, found by offline batch jobs.

name: onlineOutgoing
desc: Selected outgoing attributions extracted online on Alexandria.
meaning: Content the page credits to other sources, found during online indexing.

name: customPropertyFilter
desc: This filter specifies a structured syntax to match against the [PropertyDefinition].is_filterable marked as
meaning: A filter expression matching custom document properties.

name: customWeightsMetadata
desc: To support the custom weighting across document schemas, customers need to provide the properties to be used to boost the ranking in the search request. For a search query with CustomWeightsMetadata specified, only the RetrievalImportance for the properties in the CustomWeightsMetadata will be honored.
meaning: Customer-supplied property weights used to boost enterprise document search results.

name: documentCreatorFilter
desc: The exact creator(s) of the documents to search against. If a value isn't specified, documents within the search results are associated with any creator. If multiple values are specified, documents within the search results may be associated with any of the specified creators.
meaning: Restricts results to documents made by named creators.

name: documentNameFilter
desc: Search the documents in the list. Format: projects/{project_number}/locations/{location}/documents/{document_id}.
meaning: Restricts the search to a listed set of documents.

name: documentSchemaNames
desc: This filter specifies the exact document schema Document.document_schema_name of the documents to search against. If a value isn't specified, documents within the search results are associated with any schema. If multiple values are specified, documents within the search results may be associated with any of the specified schemas. At most 20 document schema names are allowed.
meaning: Restricts results to documents using the named schemas.

name: fileTypeFilter
desc: This filter specifies the types of files to return: ALL, FOLDER, or FILE. If FOLDER or FILE is specified, then only either folders or files will be returned, respectively. If ALL is specified, both folders and files will be returned. If no value is specified, ALL files will be returned.
meaning: Whether to return folders, files, or both.

name: folderNameFilter
desc: Search all the documents under this specified folder. Format: projects/{project_number}/locations/{location}/documents/{document_id}.
meaning: Restricts the search to documents inside one folder.

name: isNlQuery
desc: Experimental, do not use. If the query is a natural language question. False by default. If true, then the question-answering feature will be used instead of search, and
meaning: Whether the query should be treated as a natural-language question.

name: propertyFilter
desc: This filter specifies a structured syntax to match against the PropertyDefinition.is_filterable marked as
meaning: Filters matching structured document property values.

name: query
desc: The query string that matches against the full text of the document and the searchable properties. The query partially supports
meaning: The text being searched for in the stored documents.

name: queryContext
desc: For custom synonyms. Customers provide the synonyms based on context. One customer can provide multiple set of synonyms based on different context. The search query will be expanded based on the custom synonyms of the query context set. By default, no custom synonyms wll be applied if no query context is provided. It is not supported for CMEK compliant deployment.
meaning: Which customer-defined synonym set to expand the query with.

name: timeFilters
desc: Documents created/updated within a range specified by this filter are searched against.
meaning: Restricts results to documents created or changed in a time range.

name: GarbageDetectorChangeList
desc: If the garbage text detector was run, the changelist that the binary was sync'ed to (or -1 if unknown), and whether the settings had their production values (or false if unknown).
meaning: The build version of the garbage text detector that ran on this page.

name: Height
desc: Height in pixels
meaning: The page height in pixels.

name: HorizontalDpi
desc: Horizontal resolution in DPI.
meaning: The horizontal scan resolution of the page in dots per inch.

name: PornScore
desc: Score of porn classifier from analyzing images on page. Note: This should be named porn_score, but we use PornScore as the name in order to be consistent with the rest of this proto.
meaning: A classifier score for how adult the pictures on a scanned page look.

name: TextConfidence
desc: Page text recognition confidence. Range depends on the algorithm but should be consistent in a given volume. 0 is bad, 100 is good.
meaning: How sure the system is that the page's text was read correctly.

name: VerticalDpi
desc: Vertical resolution in DPI.
meaning: The vertical scan resolution of the page in dots per inch.

name: Width
desc: Width in pixels
meaning: The page width in pixels.

name: postOcrConfidence
desc: Whether page-level text confidences and other summary data were computed by PostOcrUtils instead of the now-obsolete GarbageTextDetector
meaning: Whether page confidence numbers came from the newer tool, not the old one.

name: stats
desc: Page level stats (font size, line spacing, etc.)
meaning: Summary layout statistics for the page, like font size and line spacing.

name: subtype
desc: Optional client specific subtype of abuse that is too specific to belong in the above enumeration. For example, some client may want to differentiate nudity from graphic sex, but both are PORNOGRAPHY.
meaning: A client-specific label for a narrower kind of abuse than the standard categories.

name: ageYears
desc: This restriction applies if the user is between [min_age_years, age_years) years old.
meaning: Upper age bound for an age-based restriction on content.

name: child
desc: This restriction applies if all of the children apply.
meaning: Sub-restrictions that must all apply for the parent restriction to apply.

name: subservice
desc: The name of the subservice within a client. This subservice can be used to affect the flow of decision script, or selection of backend classifiers. For example, StreetView may want to specify a panel is insufficiently blurred (maybe there is a lisense plate or public sex, etc), which requires manual review then the subservice might be "blurring".
meaning: Name of the sub-part of a client product that requested the abuse review.

name: type
desc: A constant of type TRUE always applies, and of type FALSE never applies.
meaning: A restriction that is either always true or always false.

name: adminVerdict
desc: Takedowns specified by admins via AbuseIAm
meaning: Content takedowns entered by administrators.

name: userVerdict
desc: User-specified takedowns
meaning: Content takedowns requested by users.

name: backend
desc: Who creates this Evaluation. This field is required.
meaning: Which system produced this abuse evaluation.

name: comment
desc: Backends can choose to put some debug info in addition to abuse_type, score, and status.
meaning: Free-text debug notes attached to an abuse evaluation.

name: miscData
desc: This field is used to store miscellaneous information that Backend might provide. If you find youself here considering to use this field, please prefer using the repeated feature field below instead. It supports a richer structure for passing complex data back from the backend.
meaning: Assorted extra name and value data returned by an abuse backend.

name: processedMicros
desc: When the evaluation was processed by the decision script.
meaning: Time the abuse evaluation was handled by the decision script.

name: region
desc: The list of regions where the evaluation applies.
meaning: Regions where this abuse evaluation applies.

name: timestampMicros
desc: When the Evaluation was generated.
meaning: Time the abuse evaluation was created.

name: userRestriction
desc: A boolean expression tree used to define the restrictions where the verdict applies. Please use java/com/google/ccc/abuse/abuseiam/client/TakedownManager.java to evaluate this proto.
meaning: Boolean rule tree describing which users an abuse verdict applies to.

name: version
desc: Version of Backend. For rules, this string is the only way to differentiate between them.
meaning: Version string of the abuse backend or rule that ran.

name: location
desc: The location where the restriction applies. Defaults to the "The world". See go/iii.
meaning: The place where a content restriction applies.

name: restriction
desc: The UserRestriction that applies to this location. If not specified evaluates to true.
meaning: The user restriction tied to a given location.

name: hash
desc: 64 bit hash in the hex form.
meaning: A 64-bit hash value written in hexadecimal.

name: child
desc: This restriction applies if the child does not apply. Only one is allowed. "repeated" is used to avoid breaking Sawzall (See b/6758277).
meaning: The restriction that must not apply for this rule to hold.

name: child
desc: This restriction applies if any of the children apply.
meaning: Sub-restrictions where any one applying is enough.

name: region
desc: This is a CLDR Region Code:
meaning: A country or region code.

name: andRestriction
desc: Operators
meaning: Holds an AND combination of restrictions.

name: constantRestriction
desc: Constant
meaning: Holds a constant always-or-never restriction.

name: geoRestriction
desc: Leaf Nodes
meaning: Holds a location-based restriction.

name: client
desc: Target client of the verdict. It can be used to differentiate verdicts from multiple clients when such verdicts are processed in one common place.
meaning: Which product this abuse verdict is meant for.

name: comment
desc: Additional info regarding the verdict.
meaning: Extra notes about the abuse verdict.

name: durationMins
desc: Time duration (in minutes) of the verdict.
meaning: How many minutes the abuse verdict lasts.

name: evaluation
desc: Evaluations relevant to this verdict. Every Verdict should contain at least one Evaluation.
meaning: The evaluations that led to this abuse verdict.

name: hashes
desc: Details of all the hashes that can be computed on a message, such as simhash and attachment hash
meaning: Hashes computed over the reviewed message or its attachments.

name: isLegalIssued
desc: Is this verdict issued by legal?
meaning: Whether the takedown was issued by the legal team.

name: miscScores
desc: This field is used to pass relevant / necessary scores to our clients. For eg: ASBE propagates these scores to moonshine.
meaning: Extra abuse scores passed along to client systems.

name: reasonCode
desc: A short description of the reason why the verdict decision is made.
meaning: Short reason given for the abuse decision.

name: region
desc: The regions in which this verdict should be enforced. Absence of this field indicates that the verdict is applicable everywhere.
meaning: Regions where the abuse verdict is enforced.

name: restriction
desc: Restrictions on where this verdict applies. If any restriction is met, the verdict is applied there. If no restrictions are present, the verdict is considered global.
meaning: Conditions limiting where the abuse verdict applies.

name: strikeCategory
desc: Category of the strike if this is a strike verdict.
meaning: Category of the strike issued against an account.

name: targetTimestampMicros
desc: The timestamp of the target. E.g., the time when the target was updated.
meaning: Timestamp of the item the verdict was made about.

name: timestampMicros
desc: When the verdict is generated
meaning: Time the abuse verdict was created.

name: userNotification
desc: Extra notification(s) to be delivered to target user or message owner about the verdict.
meaning: Messages to be delivered to the user about the verdict.

name: version
desc: version of decision script
meaning: Version of the abuse decision script.

name: context
desc: For a restriction to apply, all contexts must be satisfied. For example, if context[0] is COUNTRY/'GERMANY' and context[1] is DESTINATION_STREAM/'gplus:SQUARE:knitting_discussion', then the verdict applies only when the 'knitting discussion' square is viewed from inside Germany. Please note that this is present for legacy reasons and users of this field would be migrated to use the user_restriction field defined below.
meaning: Legacy conditions such as country and stream that scope a verdict.

name: userRestriction
desc: A boolean expression tree used to define the restrictions where the verdict applies. Please use java/com/google/ccc/abuse/abuseiam/client/TakedownManager.java to evaluate this proto.
meaning: Boolean rule tree scoping where a verdict applies.

name: id
desc: String identifying the context.
meaning: String identifying a restriction context.

name: membershipCount
desc: count of members with given type and state
meaning: How many chat space members have a given type and state.

name: id
desc: The hierarchy of IDs. Each individual ID is "flat" and the repeated list defines the hierarchy. Namespaces define the "validity" of this hierachy (depth, naming convention, etc) and the server will reject invalid IDs.
meaning: Nested ids identifying where a social activity is delivered.

name: reportCompromised
desc: Corresponds on "This account might be compromised or hacked" reporting action.
meaning: Count of reports that a social post came from a compromised account.

name: reportHarassment
desc: Corresponds on "Harassment or bullying" reporting action.
meaning: Count of harassment reports on a social post.

name: reportHate
desc: Corresponds on "Hate speach or graphic violence" reporting action.
meaning: Count of hate speech or graphic violence reports on a social post.

name: reportPorn
desc: Corresponds on "Pornography or sexually explicit material" reporting action.
meaning: Count of pornography reports on a social post.

name: reportSpam
desc: Corresponds on "Unwanted commercial content or spam" reporting action.
meaning: Count of spam reports on a social post.

name: serveCount
desc: Number of times this activity was served out of asbe/stanza.
meaning: How many times a social activity was served.

name: timeSec
desc: Timestamp in seconds for which time this record is valid.
meaning: Timestamp for which this engagement record is valid.

name: ytThumbsDown
desc: Corresponds on Distiller comment thumbs down action.
meaning: Count of thumbs-down actions on a comment.

name: safeHtmlValue
desc: Sanitized HTML value that is only populated when the SANITIZE_ABOUT_HTML extension is requested.
meaning: Cleaned HTML version of a profile's About text.

name: inconsistentPhoto
desc: True if photo diff is greater than 0.01 on any color band, or if the user has a low res photo but no high res photo. This field is primarily for use in About Me and for other uses it's recommended to use the DiffData values directly instead. The cutoff is based on a heuristic determined in go/comparing-profile-photos
meaning: Whether a user's two stored profile photos differ noticeably.

name: lowResData
desc: Only present if the photo diff is greater than 0.01 on any color band.
meaning: Low resolution profile photo data, kept only when the photos differ.

name: privateLowResAcl
desc: True if the low-res photo has a private ACL set.
meaning: Whether the low resolution profile photo has a private access setting.

name: lockedField
desc: Read-only set of zero or more field paths that are locked for update on this person, such as "person.name", "person.email", etc. The set of fields is only populated for the requester's profile. Fields in the set cannot be edited, added, or deleted from the profile. Attempting to update any of these fields will result in an exception.
meaning: Profile fields the user is not allowed to change.

name: computedNameChangesRemaining
desc: The number of name changes remaining at RPC request time. This can be more than name_changes_remaining, if user hasn't changed name for some time and accrued quota since last change.
meaning: How many profile name changes the user has left right now.

name: computedNicknameChangesRemaining

meaning: Link to an emoji image used as a person's avatar.

name: glyph
desc: Unicode emoji representation of the chat room emoji avatar. This can be used by clients that use go/emoji-rendering directly so that they can present this with the same version/style as the rest of their application. This value may also be useful to clients as alt-text for the image. This field will only be populated if all of: - The PersonFieldMetadata
meaning: The emoji character used as a chat room avatar.

name: htmlAttribution
desc: A set of HTML data provider attributions that must be shown with the result. Supported for PLACES photos only. See: go/understanding-places-api-attribution-requirements
meaning: Attribution HTML that must be displayed alongside a Places photo.

name: isDefault
desc: True when the photo is synthetic or generated (i.e. a monogram or default photo), false when the person has a custom photo.
meaning: True when the photo is an auto-generated placeholder rather than a real one.

name: isMonogram
desc: Indicates if the photo is a monogram avatar. Combined with is_default, the type of photo can be determined by: is_default=true, is_monogram=true: Default monogram avatar. is_default=true, is_monogram=false: Default silhouette avatar. is_default=false: Custom photo. is_monogram is irrelevant in this case.
meaning: True when the avatar is a letter monogram image.

name: monogramBackground
desc: When is_monogram=true, this is the background color of the monogram photo as a hex RGB formatted string "RRGGBB".
meaning: The hex background color of a monogram avatar.

name: originalPhoto
desc: Read-only. A reference to the original, undecorated profile photo in storage. This field is not stored. It is populated by a live read to /SocialGraphImageService.GetActiveProfilePhoto. This field is only returned when "person.photo.original_photo" is specified in the request mask.
meaning: Reference to the undecorated original profile photo in storage.

name: photoId
desc: For writes only. Indicates photo content for person photo-field update. Currently only used for profile-photo updates (not contact photos yet).
meaning: Identifier of photo content supplied when updating a profile photo.

name: photoToken
desc: Most clients don't need to worry about this field and should just use the
meaning: Internal token for a photo that most clients are told to ignore.

name: url
desc: See go/people-api-concepts/photos for info on the different representations of URLs.
meaning: The address where a person's photo can be fetched.

name: viewerUrl
desc: A URL for a UI to view the photo in its original context. For example, for a place photo, this is the url of a Google Maps page displaying the photo. Supported for place photos only.
meaning: Link to a page where a place photo can be viewed in its original context.

name: mediaKey
desc: For writes only, pass the media key that represents the image in photos backend. Note, this is not populated on reads.
meaning: Write-only key pointing at an image in the photos backend.

name: googleUrl
desc: A URL hosted by Google providing more information about this place This is the URL returned by Places API in the Place.Url.google field
meaning: A Google-hosted link with more information about a place.

name: primaryTypeName
desc: The name of the primary type. Examples of primary type are: "art_school", "clothing_wholesaler", etc. All primary types can be found at
meaning: The name of a place's main category, such as art school.

name: achievements
desc: User's top achievements that are sorted for example by rarity.
meaning: A user's top Play Games achievements.

name: avatarImageUrl
desc: The avatar image to display for the user.
meaning: The avatar image shown for a Play Games user.

name: failure
desc: Failure type if there is an error when fetching product profile data.
meaning: Error type recorded when product profile data could not be fetched.

name: gamerTag
desc: The gamer tag set by the user. Not set if the user hasn't set a gamer tag yet.
meaning: The gamer nickname a user chose for Play Games.

name: playerLevel
desc: User's level.
meaning: The user's Play Games level.

name: profileVisibility
desc: Specifies the visibility of the player's profile.
meaning: Who is allowed to see the player's games profile.

name: totalFriendsCount
desc: Total number of friends.
meaning: How many friends the player has.

name: totalUnlockedAchievements
desc: How many achievements this player has unlocked.
meaning: How many achievements the player has unlocked.

name: achievementName
desc: The name of the achievement.
meaning: The name of a Play Games achievement.

name: achievementUnlockedIconUrl
desc: The achievement icon url shown to the user if it is unlocked.
meaning: Icon shown for an achievement once it is unlocked.

name: rarityPercentage
desc: Rarity of unlocking this achievement (3% of players unlocked would be 3)
meaning: Share of players who have unlocked this achievement.

name: applicationId
desc: Int64 ID of packaging-service entry; if set, the plus page is associated with a third-party application.
meaning: ID linking a Google+ page to a third-party application.

name: accountId
desc: The user visible value is used to distinguish identical posix account fields with different customer key values.
meaning: Value that tells apart identical POSIX account entries across customers.

name: accountNamespace
desc: Value indicates the uniqueness namespace that applies to the POSIX information. The value is included in all POSIX account uniqueness indices. The indexing prevents two accounts within the same customer from having the same username. Namespacing allows Windows and Linux users to share the same username.
meaning: Namespace that keeps POSIX usernames unique within a customer.

name: accountType
desc: Value indicates whether the POSIX information is associated with a non-human entity and the validation logic to apply during PosixAccount mutation.
meaning: Whether a POSIX account belongs to a person or a service entity.

name: customerKey
desc: The customer associated with the POSIX identity. If the user is already associated with a G Suite Customer, this field has the same value as
meaning: The customer that a POSIX identity belongs to.

name: fingerprint
desc: The value is automatically set to a SHA-256 fingerprint of the POSIX account. A fingerprint should uniquely identify a POSIX account entry.
meaning: A SHA-256 hash that uniquely identifies a POSIX account entry.

name: gecos
desc: The GECOS (user information) entry for this account.
meaning: The free-text user information line for a POSIX account.

name: gid
desc: The default group ID.
meaning: The default group ID for a POSIX account.

name: homeDirectory
desc: The path to the home directory for this account.
meaning: The home directory path for a POSIX account.

name: operatingSystemType
desc: Value indicates whether to use Linux or Windows specific validation logic during PosixAccount mutation.
meaning: Whether Linux or Windows validation rules apply to the account.

name: shell
desc: The path to the login shell for this account.
meaning: The login shell path for a POSIX account.

name: systemId
desc: System identifier for which account Username or Uid apply to. If not specified on mutate by a caller it will default to empty value if either Username or Uid are being set. SystemId does require to have a value (even an empty one) because it is included into null-filtered Spanner index used to enforce uniqueness on Username and Uid fields.
meaning: Identifier of the system a POSIX username or user ID applies to.

name: uid
desc: The user ID.
meaning: The numeric user ID of a POSIX account.

name: username
desc: The username of the account.
meaning: The login name of a POSIX account.

name: incomingAnyCircleCount
desc: Replacement for deprecated follower_count. Comes from the EdgeSummary.
meaning: How many people follow or link to this profile.

name: viewCount
desc: Deprecated. This field is no longer populated by the server.
meaning: Deprecated count of profile views, no longer filled in.

name: dataSet
desc: The data set within the account that this raw contact belongs to.
meaning: Which data set inside an account a raw phone contact came from.

name: dirty
desc: The CP2 dirty field which indicates the sync state of the raw contact:
meaning: Flag showing whether a phone contact still needs syncing.

name: sourceIdExist
desc: Whether the source ID exists for non-Google contacts. Won't set for Google contacts.
meaning: Whether a non-Google phone contact has a source ID.

name: syncInfo
desc: The Sync Info of a raw contact.
meaning: Sync bookkeeping for a raw contact taken from a device.

name: accountName
desc: Account name of raw contact, e.g. "google@gmail.com".
meaning: The account a phone contact belongs to, such as a Gmail address.

name: accountType
desc: Account type of raw contact, e.g. "com.google" or "com.linkedin.android".
meaning: The account type a phone contact came from, such as Google or LinkedIn.

name: appContactData
desc: The detailed app-specific endpoint data available for the given RawDeviceContactInfo instance. This proto should be used to obtain the list of actions and mimetypes supported by the third-party app. Design: go/3p-contact-upload
meaning: Per-app contact details listing what actions a third-party app supports.

name: appInfo
desc: The app-specific endpoint data needed for app action fulfillment. Usage of this field should be avoided on the server-side, and should use the more detailed |full_app_info| field.
meaning: Basic app endpoint data used to carry out an app action for a contact.

name: crossDeviceAllowed
desc: If true, this raw contact can be used on other devices than the one it originated from. Assigned by the server.
meaning: Whether a phone contact may be used on devices other than its origin.

name: deviceContactMetadata
desc: Extra metadata for this raw contact.
meaning: Extra bookkeeping attached to a raw phone contact.

name: googleContactId
desc: The focus contact id for Google contacts.
meaning: The main contact ID used for Google contacts.

name: id
desc: The base64 serialized social.graph.peopleapi.proto.internal.RawDeviceContactId. This id should be used to correlate to field.metadata.encoded_container_id when the field.metadata.container_type is RAW_DEVICE_CONTACT The id also correlates to person.metadata.identity_info.source_id.id. For value format, see google3/social/graph/api/proto/main_merged_person.proto?q=symbol:SourceIdentity.id
meaning: Encoded identifier for a raw contact taken from a device.

name: photoType
desc: The type of photo from the device (if any).
meaning: What kind of photo, if any, came from the device contact.

name: rawContactId
desc: The id of the raw contact on the device.
meaning: The contact's ID as stored on the device.

name: rawDeviceContactAnalyticalInfo
desc: Only to be used by Romanesco team specifically for analytics.
meaning: Analytics-only details about a device contact, for one internal team.

name: accountEmail
desc: The account email linked to the profile, if any exists and is visible to the requester.
meaning: The account email tied to a profile when the requester may see it.

name: blockType
desc: Indicates whether the profile owner has blocked this person.
meaning: Whether the profile owner has blocked this person.

name: customerInfo
desc: CustomerInfo for dasher user. The reader has to explicitly request this in the field_mask as 'read_only_profile_info.customer_info'
meaning: Workspace customer details, returned only when explicitly requested.

name: domainInfo
desc: DEPRECATED. Use the
meaning: Deprecated block of hosted-domain details for a profile.

name: inViewerDomain
desc: DEPRECATED. Proxying trust between users in a domain should use go/flex-orgs-platform. For more info see:
meaning: Deprecated flag for whether a person is in the viewer's domain.

name: incomingBlockType
desc: Indicates whether this person is blocking the profile owner.
meaning: Whether this person has blocked the profile owner.

name: objectType
desc: DEPRECATED.
meaning: Deprecated field describing the kind of profile object.

name: ownerId
desc: The Focus-obfuscated Gaia ID of the profile owner (go/obfuscated-ids).
meaning: The obfuscated account ID of the profile owner.

name: plusPageType
desc: DEPRECATED. Please use
meaning: Deprecated field for the kind of Google+ page a profile is.

name: profileOwnerStats
desc: Stats/counters pertaining to followers and incoming edges.
meaning: Counters about a profile's followers and incoming connections.

name: unjoinedEmailCertificates
desc: Returned only when explicitly requested in the request mask as read_only_profile_info.unjoined_email_certificates. Equivalent to fetching the Emails & the Email Certificates with the acls ignored.
meaning: Email certificates returned only on explicit request, ignoring access rules.

name: domainBadge
desc: DEPRECATED. Organization badge for the domain this person is a member of. The badge is the primary hosted domain.
meaning: Deprecated organization badge for a person's hosted domain.

name: domainName
desc: DEPRECATED. Hosted domain this person is a member of. Formerly only available via PersonExtendedData.
meaning: Deprecated hosted domain that a person belongs to.

name: canonicalValue
desc: Canonicalized
meaning: A relationship label rewritten into a standard form.

name: formattedType
desc: The
meaning: The display label shown for a relationship type.

name: relationDetails
desc: The person whose email matches the Relation.value field, if it is a valid email address. This field is read-only and ignored on update.
meaning: Profile details of the person matched by a relationship's email address.

name: type
desc: The relation type. The type can be free form or one of these predefined values:
meaning: The kind of relationship, such as spouse or manager.

name: value
desc: The person this relation applies to. Custom value provided by the user.
meaning: The person a relationship points to, as typed by the user.

name: displayName
desc: Equivalent to Name.display_name for the person_id profile.
meaning: The display name from the related person's profile.

name: jobTitle
desc: Equivalent to Organization.title for the primary organization of the person_id profile.
meaning: The job title from the related person's main organization.

name: photoUrl
desc: Equivalent to Photo.url for the person_id profile.
meaning: The photo link from the related person's profile.

name: formattedType
desc: The
meaning: The display label for who a person is interested in dating.

name: type
desc: These fields may give away the sexual orientation of the user.
meaning: The relationship interest recorded for a person.

name: formattedType
desc: The
meaning: The display label for a person's relationship status.

name: abridgedRosterMemberships
desc: Abridged / sample subset of member details of the roster. NOTE: This field is only returned if the request's field mask includes "person.roster_details.abridged_roster_memberships".
meaning: A sample of the members of a group roster, returned only on request.

name: rosterMemberCount
desc: Indicates the number of members and sub-rosters of the roster. Corresponds to
meaning: How many members and sub-groups a roster contains.

name: memberType
desc: Type of the member.
meaning: What kind of member an entry in a roster is.

name: personId
desc: Focus-Obfuscated Gaia Id of the member.
meaning: The obfuscated account ID of a roster member.

name: directGroupCount
desc: Indicates the number of direct sub-rosters of the roster. This comes from
meaning: How many sub-groups sit directly inside a roster.

name: directUserCount
desc: Indicates the number of direct, non-roster members of the roster. This comes from
meaning: How many individual people sit directly inside a roster.

name: formattedType
desc: The
meaning: The display label shown for a SIP address type.

name: type
desc: The type of the SIP address. The type can be free form or or one of these predefined values:
meaning: The kind of SIP address recorded for a person.

name: interactionRank
desc: Deprecated. This field is only populated with 0.000 for legacy reasons. Clients should not use this field.
meaning: Deprecated contact ranking value that is now always zero.

name: nameRaw
desc: Raw name strings that were used to generate the name and last_name sort keys fields above. Contacts+ need them to generate section headers for list view (b/30642866).
meaning: The raw name strings used to build contact sorting keys.

name: container
desc: The type of source. To be deprecated infavor of container_type
meaning: The kind of source a person's data came from, being replaced by container_type.

name: containerType
desc: The type of the source.
meaning: The kind of source a person's data came from.

name: deleted
desc: In sync responses, indicates whether the identity source has been deleted. Not applicable to GOOGLE_GROUP.
meaning: Whether a data source for this person has been deleted.

name: id
desc: The encoded id of the data source. This field correlates to PersonFieldMetadata.encoded_container_id. The possible values of this
meaning: The encoded identifier of the data source for a person record.

name: lastUpdated
desc: Last update timestamp of this source. NOTE: Only populated for CONTACT container type in Java PeopleAPI. Populated for CONTACT, PROFILE, DOMAIN_PROFILE in Sharpen implementation. NOTE: Not populated for GOOGLE_GROUP.
meaning: When this particular data source for a person was last changed.

name: sourceEtag
desc: NOTE: Not populated for GOOGLE_GROUP.
meaning: Version tag for a person data source.

name: fingerprint
desc: The value is automatically set to a SHA-256 fingerprint of an SSH public key. A fingerprint should uniquely identify an SSH public key.
meaning: A SHA-256 hash that uniquely identifies an SSH public key.

name: formattedType
desc: The phone formatted type. See docs from mirrored proto:
meaning: The display label for a structured phone number's type.

name: type
desc: The type of phone. See docs from mirrored proto:
meaning: The kind of structured phone number recorded.

name: code
desc: The phone code. See docs from mirrored proto:
meaning: The short code digits stored for a phone entry.

name: incomingAnyCircleCount
desc: Replacement for deprecated follower_count. Comes from the EdgeSummary.
meaning: How many people follow or connect to this profile.

name: isIncomplete
desc: Used by Contacts client-side to indicate whether a person is not completed.
meaning: Marks a contact the web Contacts app considers not fully filled in.

name: formattedType
desc: The
meaning: The display label shown for a website link's type.

name: rel
desc: Currently in Oz: "Links": Links with no rel. "Other profiles": Links with rel=ME. "Contributor to": Links with rel=CONTRIBUTOR_TO or PAST_CONTRIBUTOR_TO.
meaning: The relationship tag on a profile link, such as me or contributor-to.

name: type
desc: The type of the website. The type can be free form or one of these predefined values:
meaning: The kind of website link, such as home page or blog.

name: channelData
desc: Information about a channel created by the user. A user can create multiple Youtube channels.
meaning: Information about YouTube channels a user created.

name: failure
desc: Failure type if there is an error when fetching product profile data.
meaning: Error type recorded when YouTube profile data could not be fetched.

name: expressUrlInSettingsResponseSupported
desc: This flag is used to work around a bug in AGSA 6.8 that got away. The bug prevents users from accessing their shopping list if the URL of the shopping list is not a keep.google.com URL. This will happen when switch the backend that stores the shopping list from Keep to a backend maintained by the Google Shopping Express team.
meaning: Workaround flag for an old Assistant app bug about shopping list URLs.

name: reconnectClientInputSupported
desc: Whether client supports reconnect client input in action v2 payload. This capability is needed to determine if client supports parsing client input payload from actionv2 proto for workflow purposes. See go/personal-workflow. OWNER:nyzstar,vvvemuri.
meaning: Whether an Assistant client can parse reconnect input in its payload.

name: simpleActionV2PuntSupported
desc: Whether or not the surface supports a simple UnsupportedAction instead of a ModalState punt card for rendering. For ActionV2 punt cards, the ModalState extension on the ResourceSet is the canonical way of building punt cards. However, while most all devices support the ActionV2 protocol, not all devices handle the ModalState rendering as part of the ActionV2. For these devices, we want to build a modified ActionV2 for punt cards which omits this ModalState. At present, this is only Android Wear
meaning: Whether a device can show a plain unsupported-action reply instead of a card.

name: supportedActionType
desc: A list of all the action types supported by the client. These should be the string representation of majel.ActionTypes within "quality/majel/api/proto/action_v2.proto".
meaning: The list of Assistant action types a client can handle.

name: takeScreenshotSupported
desc: Checks if screenshots can be taken on the client. This field is set on the client from AGSA 7.2 onwards.
meaning: Whether the Assistant client can take screenshots.

name: voiceDelightImmersiveUiSupported
desc: If IMMERSIVE_ACTIONS UiType is supported by the client.
meaning: Whether the client supports the immersive Assistant action interface.

name: voiceDelightStickersSupported
desc: If Voice Delight Stickers are supported by the client. In order to support Voice Delight stickers, the client should know how to extract sticker_url from VoiceDelightSystemInteractionSegment.
meaning: Whether the client can display Assistant stickers.

name: voiceDelightSuggestionsSupported
desc: If Voice Delight Suggestion Chips are supported by the client. In order to support Voice Delight Suggestion Chips, the client should know how to extract suggestions form VoiceDelightSystemInteraction.ResourceSet.
meaning: Whether the client can display Assistant suggestion chips.

name: intentActionName
desc: The Action name of the Android Intent in standard notation (
meaning: The Android intent action name a device can handle.

name: packageNames
desc: The Android provider packages that support the intent, e.g. "com.google.android.deskclock".
meaning: The Android apps that support a given intent.

name: allowlistedForMediaFulfillment
desc: Indicates whether the provider is compatible for media fulfillment on this surface. For example, Amazon Music isn't compatible with the driving mode.
meaning: Whether a media provider is allowed to fulfil requests on this surface.

name: appIntegrationsSettings
desc: Currently unused. Will be used in the future when integrating with incremental app capabilities.
meaning: Unused placeholder for future app integration settings.

name: disabledSystemApp
desc: This system app is disabled in settings.
meaning: Whether this built-in app is turned off in settings.

name: provider
desc: The installed app of the provider.
meaning: The installed app belonging to a provider.

name: routableToProviderCloud
desc: This provider has integrated its cloud backend with Google, and Google can route the user queries to the provider's cloud.
meaning: Whether user queries can be sent on to the provider's own cloud backend.

name: searchableOnDevice
desc: This provider has an app that supports on-device search through the provider's own inventory.
meaning: Whether the provider's app can search its own catalogue on the device.

name: searchableOnServer
desc: This provider has integrated its content with Google, and Google has enabled to serve its content as a server-side solution.
meaning: Whether the provider's content is integrated so Google can serve it server-side.

name: supports3pPodcastPlayback
desc: Indicates whether the provider supports playback of 3P(externally hosted) podcasts.
meaning: Whether the provider can play podcasts hosted elsewhere.

name: supportsScreenlessInitiation
desc: This provider has an app that supports starting new media playback when there is no screen (e.g. by integrating with the Bisto SDK).
meaning: Whether the app can start media playback when no screen is present.

name: whitelistedForAnnotation
desc: This provider is an app which should be used for query annotations. This is useful for apps which may not be already indexed by Google or are client specific.
meaning: Whether the app should be used when annotating spoken queries.

name: appIntegrationsSettings
desc: Currently unused. Will be used in the future when integrating with incremental app capabilities.
meaning: Unused placeholder for future app integration settings.

name: providerDelta
desc: The installed app of the provider.
meaning: The changed installed app of a provider.

name: sendMessageSuppressed
desc: If true, disable send message AppControl/SD flow. This is needed to suppress the feature for specific device. If we decide to turn down this feature for all devices, then this field will become obsolete and should be removed. See context in b/275727627.
meaning: Turns off the send-message app control flow on a device.

name: handleRequestsWithPredictedApps
desc: Whether to enable Assistant to handle request with predicted apps.
meaning: Whether Assistant may handle a request using apps it predicts the user wants.

name: plateSupport
desc: Indicates in what cases assistant continued presence can be shown as a plate. This field is white-listed as being PII-free. Please do not add PII here.
meaning: When continued-presence Assistant interface may be shown as a plate.

name: isBluetoothConnectedProfileRequired
desc: If this surface needs to bluetooth pair a phone before using a feature.
meaning: Whether a phone must be paired over Bluetooth before a feature works.

name: callFormats
desc: The supported call formats on the surface.
meaning: The call formats a device supports.

name: callMediums
desc: The supported call mediums on the surface.
meaning: The calling methods a device supports.

name: callOptions
desc: The call options this surface can provide. For example, SPEAKERPHONE is available on Android OPA while iOPA doesn't support it yet.
meaning: Call features the surface offers, such as speakerphone.

name: fallbackToTetheredDeviceAppCapabilities
desc: If true, APP_ID queries initiated by this device should fall back to execution on the tethered device if it's available and if the primary device cannot perform the action (e.g. due to the app not being installed).
meaning: Whether app requests fall back to a paired device that can perform them.

name: supportedRecipientTypes
desc: Should only be checked if nonempty.
meaning: Which kinds of call recipients the surface accepts.

name: faceMatchCapable
desc: Whether the device supports Face Match.
meaning: Whether the device can recognise faces.

name: hasCamera
desc: Whether the device has a camera.
meaning: Whether the device has a camera.

name: hasLimitedCameraStreamCapability
desc: Whether the device has limited camera stream capability. If true, check supported_camera_receivers for detailed supported cameras.
meaning: Whether the device can only stream from certain cameras.

name: supportedCameraReceivers
desc: The camera receiver cast apps the device supports. Only used if has_limited_camera_stream_capability is true.
meaning: Which cast apps can receive camera streams on this device.

name: shouldPuntMultiAssistantMode
desc: Indicates whether the current Assistant should provide a multi Assistant specific punt when there are multiple Auto specific Google Assistants (Android Auto Projected (AAP) and Android Auto Embedded (AAE)) in the same GAS enabled car. This will be used by both AAP and AAE. Design doc: go/doubledash++
meaning: Whether the car Assistant should decline when several assistants are present.

name: playWarmerWelcome
desc: If true, it indicates that the auto surface client should receive a warmer welcome TTS for signed-out users. For signed-in user, we will rely on server side metadata. go/aaae:preview-lang
meaning: Whether a car surface plays a friendlier greeting for signed-out users.

name: supportsAddingCars
desc: If true, it indicates that the client can be used to add cars after account linking with the OEM.
meaning: Whether the client can add cars after linking a carmaker account.

name: castLinkingStatus
desc: Cast linking status for ATV surfaces. This is derived from error messages returned from Cast Orchestration Server and will be used for data profiling only(go/katniss-settings-dashboard).
meaning: The account-linking status of a cast TV device, kept for reporting.

name: truncatedErrorMsg
desc: The error msg returned from COS, truncated in case it's too large.
meaning: A shortened error message from the cast linking server.

name: cameraReceiverCapabilities
desc: Whether the device has limited camera stream capability and if yes, which receivers are supported.
meaning: Which camera stream receivers a cast device supports.

name: cameraStreamSupportedProtocols
desc: The supported protocols for camera streaming. The value is used as string in go/smarthome-internal-api#camera-stream, so using a string for this field instead of an enum. Supported protocols: (align the definition in go/smarthome-camerastream-trait) - "hls": HTTP Live Streaming - "dash": Dynamic Adaptive Streaming over HTTP - "smooth_stream": Smooth Streaming - "progressive_mp4": Progressive MP4 (will likely only be used for Clips) - "webrtc": We
meaning: The streaming protocols a device can use for camera video.

name: canReceiveCast
desc: True if we can cast things to this device.
meaning: Whether content can be cast to this device.

name: deviceId
desc: Optional for primarily cast devices (e.g., Chirp, Chromecast). For devices that are NOT primarily cast devices, but having a cast receiver as secondary functionality, this field SHOULD store the cast-device-id to be used to send remote casting commands to the device. Example: Android TV, which supports both Android-native actions as well as remote casting using its built-in cast receiver. Android TV device id contains a DUSI id, which is not a cast-device-id. When executing a cast command on the
meaning: The cast device ID used to send remote casting commands to a device.

name: dynamicGroupsSupported
desc: Whether this device supports dynamic groups or not. It implies if a Stream Control operation (transfer, expansion, and contraction) could be applied on this device since Stream Control is implemented as part of dynamic groups (ie, adding/removing devices from playback)
meaning: Whether the device can join dynamic speaker groups for stream control.

name: overlayApplicationsSupported
desc: Whether UI overlay applications are supported on this device. It's used by Chromecast only.
meaning: Whether the Chromecast supports overlay interface apps.

name: yetiGamingSupported
desc: Whether the device supports playing games through Yeti. This is set by the cast device when the device is updated: Chromecast updates -> Chromecast registers its capabilities with CCS -> CCS passes the capabilities to the AssistantSettingsService -> AssistantSettingsService stores the device's capabilities. go/yeti-gaming-supported-cast-capability
meaning: Whether the cast device can play games through Stadia.

name: skipAndroidAndGsaVersionCheck
desc: Additional specific setting capabilities. This boolean is used to indicate whether we want to skip the Android and GSA version check in CheckSettingSchemaAndMaybeGetUris() from assistant/vertical/device/fulfillment/utils/setting_utils.h. Consider setting this field to true if your device is neither Android or GSA (especially when the UserAgent string of your device's TaskRequest will not contain a valid/up-to-date Android/GSA version).
meaning: Whether to skip Android and app version checks when changing a device setting.

name: supportedSettings
desc: Uses DeviceSetting enum which corresponds to setting_id. This indicates which specific settings are supported by client. An empty list implies all settings are supported.
meaning: Which device settings the client is able to change.

name: supportsDoNotDisturbWithDuration
desc: Additional specific setting capabilities. This boolean is used to indicate if do not disturb with duration is supported through device.MODIFY_SETTING clientop on a client or not.
meaning: Whether the client supports do-not-disturb with a set duration.

name: supportsMuteUnmute
desc: Additional specific setting capabilities. This boolean is used to indicate if new unmute logic is enabled on a client or not.
meaning: Whether the client supports the newer mute and unmute behaviour.

name: keepsConversationAliveAfterOpeningApp
desc: Whether conversation is kept alive after opening the app. See go/keep-opa-conversation-alive for details.
meaning: Whether the Assistant conversation continues after an app is opened.

name: maxSupportedAlarms
desc: Maximum number of alarms that can be created on the client.
meaning: The largest number of alarms the client allows.

name: maxSupportedExtendedTimerDuration
desc: Maximum extended timer duration supported by the client. The extended timer duration is the total start-to-finish duration after an AddTimeToTimer operation. E.g. if a user sets a timer for 30 minutes, and later adds 10 minutes, the extended duration is 40 minutes.
meaning: The longest total timer length allowed after extra time is added.

name: maxSupportedTimerDuration
desc: Maximum duration of timers that can be created on the client.
meaning: The longest timer the client allows.

name: maxSupportedTimers
desc: Maximum number of timers that can be created on the client.
meaning: The largest number of timers the client allows.

name: preferredStopwatchProvider
desc: The preferred provider to use for stopwatch related functionality.
meaning: The app preferred for stopwatch features.

name: restrictAlarmsToNext24h
desc: Whether the client restricts alarms to ring within the next 24 hours.
meaning: Whether alarms are limited to ringing within the next day.

name: fallbackToTetheredDevice
desc: If true, contact.LOOKUP should be routed to the tethered device (if present) if the tethered device supports contact.LOOKUP and the primary device does not.
meaning: Whether contact lookups move to a paired device that supports them.

name: androidIntent
desc: Intent associated with the app. We include intents here as different versions of the same app may support different intents. In those cases, the package_name is not enough to identify the app and we should use the combination of package_name and android_intent. This field might contain sensitive data, if represents ClientOp with encapsulated PII such as user query.
meaning: The Android intent tied to an app, used with the package name to identify it.

name: appUniqueId
desc: Store the app unique id endpoint. This will be passed over to app to fulfill the action.
meaning: The app endpoint identifier passed along so the app can carry out an action.

name: appVersion
desc: The android app version. Deprecated because
meaning: The Android app version number, marked deprecated.

name: dataMimetype
desc: data_mimetype and account_type are the what AGSA uses to filter which contacts support this Android app in ContactProvider.
meaning: Data type used to filter which contacts support a given Android app.

name: isBroadcastIntent
desc: If true, client should broadcast the intent instead of open the intent.
meaning: Whether the client should broadcast the intent rather than open it.

name: isDefault
desc: App is the default app for it's core functionality. For example, it will be true for Android messages if it is the default app to send and receive SMS on the phone.
meaning: Whether this Android app is the phone's default app for its main job, such as the default SMS app.

name: localizedAppName
desc: The localized app name.
meaning: The app's name shown in the user's own language.

name: longVersionCode
desc: The long android app version.
meaning: The app's long-form Android version code.

name: mimetype
desc: Store mimetype of this endpoint. We will use this as the differentiator for Assistant to know whether to use the RawContact for messaging, call or video call. For example, send message mimetype for whatsapp: "vnd.android.cursor.item/vnd.com.whatsapp.profile" voice call mimetype for whatsapp: "vnd.android.cursor.item/vnd.com.whatsapp.voip.call"
meaning: A mimetype string telling Assistant whether a contact entry is for messaging, calling, or video calling.

name: packageName
desc: The android app package of the provider, like "com.spotify.music".
meaning: The Android package name of the app, such as com.spotify.music.

name: providerType
desc: The OemProviderType is specific for OEM system Android apps. For example, in Auto Embedded, the OEM will have a system Radio/Media app. The system app’s capabilities/core functionalities are captured here. For physical media sources, the OEM may decide to implement one media app (thus, one package name) that handles multiple physical media sources. For these cases, each physical media source will be sent as different providers even though the package name is the same.
meaning: Which kind of built-in carmaker or system app or media source this provider is.

name: shortcutId
desc: Id of the app's Android shortcut to be launched by Assistant. The client is expected to use the Android LauncherApps API to execute this shortcut which in turn will open the app. For example, Whatsapp may create an Android shortcut for a frequently messaged contact with an id "contact_123". This field will contain that id and the client can execute it to open up the chat with that particular contact. If this field is set, the package_name field must also be set since both will be used
meaning: The ID of an Android app shortcut that Assistant can launch.

name: targetClass
desc: The fully qualified target class name of the provider, like "com.example.myapp.GetOrderService".
meaning: The full class name of the app service being targeted.

name: versionName
desc: The android app version name, like "4.1.091.05.40d", "11.2.7.21.alpha". Android Docs:
meaning: The readable version string of the Android app.

name: activeLaunchableActivities
desc: Activities that are currently active and tagged as ACTION_MAIN and CATEGORY_LAUNCHER. Includes the activity corresponding to android_intent if it falls under CATEGORY_LAUNCHER.
meaning: The list of the app's currently active launcher screens.

name: localizedActivityName
desc: The localized user visible activity name.
meaning: The user-visible name of an app screen in the user's language.

name: shortClassName
desc: Short class name for activity, following
meaning: The short class name of an Android app screen.

name: androidAppInfo
desc: The android app information of the provider. Like, Spotify.
meaning: The Android app details for a provider, such as Spotify.

name: lastUpdateTimestamp
desc: The client-side timestamp in millis when the app is last updated, installed or deleted.
meaning: When the app was last installed, updated, or deleted on the device.

name: updateType
desc: App is installed or deleted.
meaning: Whether the app was installed or deleted.

name: attendees
desc: Attendees invited to the event, usually includes also the organizer.
meaning: The people invited to a calendar event.

name: backgroundColor
desc: The background color of the event, in RGB format.
meaning: The background color used to display a calendar event.

name: calendarId
desc: Optional calendar containing the event.
meaning: Which calendar the event belongs to.

name: creator
desc: The person who created this event.
meaning: The person who created the calendar event.

name: description
desc: Optional description of the event (plain text).
meaning: The plain text description of a calendar event.

name: end
desc: The end time of the event. Start and end time must either both be date or both be datetime. End is exclusive, ie. the first day / first second when the event is over.
meaning: When the calendar event ends.

name: eventId
desc: Optional event id provided by assistant server. Needs to be unique, at least on a per-user and calendar level, ideally globally unique. If none is given, the server will assign an id.
meaning: A unique identifier for a calendar event.

name: flairName
desc: The flair name, calculated according to the event title (go/as-cal-flair). With the flair name, background images can be got from gstatic (go/scs):
meaning: A name derived from the event title, used to pick a decorative background image.

name: foregroundColor
desc: The foreground color of the event, in RGB format.
meaning: The foreground color used to display a calendar event.

name: guestsCanInviteOthers
desc: Whether the guests can invite other guests.
meaning: Whether guests are allowed to invite more guests.

name: guestsCanModify
desc: Whether the guests can modify the event.
meaning: Whether guests are allowed to edit the event.

name: guestsCanSeeGuests
desc: Whether the guests of the event can be seen. If false, the user is reported as the only attendee to the event, even though there may be more attendees.
meaning: Whether guests can see who else is attending.

name: habitId
desc: Optional id of the Habit (Calendar Goal) this event is linked to
meaning: The ID of the Calendar goal this event is linked to.

name: habitStatus
desc: Optional status for this habit event instance.
meaning: The status of this instance of a recurring goal event.

name: htmlLink
desc: Absolute link to this event in the Calendar web UI.
meaning: A link that opens this event in the Calendar web interface.

name: location
desc: Optional location of the event (plain text).
meaning: The plain text location of the event.

name: organizer
desc: The organizer of this event.
meaning: The person organizing the event.

name: otherAttendeesExcluded
desc: Whether not all attendees are included in the attendee list. This is set when the attendees list has been truncated (e.g., when the number of attendees is beyond the maxAttendees limitation).
meaning: Whether the attendee list was cut short so some attendees are missing.

name: participationResponse
desc: The user's response (the owner of this copy of the event) to this event.
meaning: The event owner's own reply to the invitation.

name: recurringEventId
desc: If this is an instance of a recurring event, recurring_event_id identifies the recurring series as a whole.
meaning: The ID of the recurring series this event instance belongs to.

name: rooms
desc: Meeting rooms associated to this event.
meaning: The meeting rooms booked for the event.

name: start
desc: The start time of the event. This event is an all-day event if start has no time_of_day.
meaning: When the calendar event starts.

name: summary
desc: The title of the event.
meaning: The title of the calendar event.

name: visibility
desc: Optional visibility of the event.
meaning: How visible the event is to other people.

name: displayName
desc: Display name, present only if available.
meaning: The attendee's display name, when it is known.

name: email
desc: Email address of the attendee (calendar), for regular events. For +Events, this field is not populated, instead "id" is used.
meaning: The attendee's email address.

name: givenName
desc: Given (first) name, present only if available. This is used for generating meeting titles as given name is preferred over display (full) name (ie: "Jeff : Sundar" is better than "Jeff Dean : Sundar Pichai").
meaning: The attendee's first name, preferred when building meeting titles.

name: id
desc: Profile ID of the principal, for +Events. For regular events, this field is not populated, instead "email" is used.
meaning: The profile ID of an attendee on +Events.

name: organizer
desc: Is this the organizer?
meaning: Whether this attendee is the event organizer.

name: responseStatus
desc: Attendees response status.
meaning: The attendee's reply status to the invitation.

name: self
desc: Is this the owner of this copy of the event?
meaning: Whether this attendee owns this copy of the event.

name: conferenceId
desc: ID that corresponds to in ConferenceData.conference_id in calendar.common.ConferenceData proto. For Meet, this is the identifier used to join a meeting via URL.
meaning: The conference identifier used to join a meeting.

name: phoneNumberUri
desc: Default meeting phone number, for example: "tel:+1-475-777-1840"
meaning: The default dial-in phone number for the meeting.

name: pinNumber
desc: A PIN that the participant will need to input after dialing in the conference.
meaning: The PIN a caller types in after dialing into the conference.

name: provider
desc: Provider info for the meeting.
meaning: Which conferencing service hosts the meeting.

name: regionCode
desc: The region code for the default meeting phone number
meaning: The country code for the meeting's default dial-in number.

name: universalPinNumber
desc: The universal meeting PIN number for phone numbers in all available countries
meaning: A meeting PIN that works for dial-in numbers in any country.

name: url
desc: URL that can be used to join the meeting.
meaning: The link used to join the meeting.

name: email
desc: Room email that identifies the room and is used to book it.
meaning: The email address that identifies and books a meeting room.

name: locationDetails
desc: Additional room details. Read-only, populated on request.
meaning: Extra details about where a meeting room is located.

name: name
desc: Room name (ex: "MTV-PR55-5-A-Shadow 5K0 (13) GVC (No external guests)").
meaning: The full name of the meeting room.

name: building
desc: Building where the room is (ex: "PR55").
meaning: The building a meeting room is in.

name: city
desc: City where the room is (ex: "MTV").
meaning: The city a meeting room is in.

name: floor
desc: Floor where the room is (ex: "5").
meaning: The floor a meeting room is on.

name: latitude
desc: The latitude in degrees.
meaning: The latitude of a meeting room.

name: longitude
desc: The longitude in degrees.
meaning: The longitude of a meeting room.

name: section
desc: Section in the floor (ex: "A").
meaning: The section of the floor where a meeting room sits.

name: simpleName
desc: Room name (ex: "Shadow 5K0").
meaning: The short friendly name of a meeting room.

name: castAppId
desc: The cast app id. |cast_app_id| is the ID of the cast app used on the current device and |content_app_id| is the ID of the app that provides the actual content. For example, in a group playback, on a follower device, the |cast_app_id| is the follower cast app ID and the |content_app_id| is the leader cast app ID.
meaning: The ID of the cast app running on the current device.

name: contentAppId
desc: The id of the cast app that provides the content in a group. The field will always be filled. In the case of a group playback and the current device is a follower, the |cast_app_id| has the ID of the follower app, and |content_app_id| has ID of the actual content app. In all other cases, |content_app_id| and |cast_app_id| will be the same.
meaning: The ID of the cast app that actually supplies the content being played.

name: localizedAppName
desc: The localized app name.
meaning: The ChromeOS app's name in the user's language.

name: packageName
desc: Unique package name that identifies a ChromeOS app of the provider.
meaning: The unique package name of a ChromeOS app.

name: directoryUrl
desc: URL to a directory page about the third party agent in Assistant HQ. This is a universal (https) URL that may be handled natively by clients to show HQ or launch to the HQ directory web page.
meaning: A link to the third party agent's page in the Assistant directory.

name: logoUrl
desc: The logo url for the third party provider.
meaning: The logo image link for a third party provider.

name: name
desc: The user visible name of the cloud provider, which may be used for example in the chat header during a conversation with the third party.
meaning: The provider name shown to users, for example in a chat header.

name: backgroundColor
desc: The background color of the agent. Used if no background image is specified for the given display orientation, or if the provided background image does not fit.
meaning: The background color used when styling a third party agent's cards.

name: landscapeBackgroundImageUrl
desc: URL for the background image of the agent on landscape display.
meaning: The background image link for an agent shown on a landscape screen.

name: logoUrl
desc: URL for the image containing the 3p logo. This can include logomark and logotype, or logotype only. If present, this can be used in place of the square logo contained in the top level logo_url field in CloudProviderInfo. See go/cards-logo-customization for details on applying this logo.
meaning: A link to the third party logo image used on cards.

name: maskColor
desc: The color of the mask to apply to the background. See go/aog-cards-background-mask for details on applying this mask.
meaning: The color of the overlay applied on top of an agent's background.

name: portraitBackgroundImageUrl
desc: URL for the background image of the agent on portrait display.
meaning: The background image link for an agent shown on a portrait screen.

name: primaryColor
desc: The primary color of the agent. Used by the client to style the header and suggestion chips.
meaning: The main color used to style an agent's header and suggestion chips.

name: alpha
desc: The fraction of this color that should be applied to the pixel. That is, the final pixel color is defined by the equation: pixel color = alpha
meaning: How opaque a color is when drawn.

name: blue
desc: The amount of blue in the color as a value in the interval [0, 1].
meaning: How much blue is in a color, from zero to one.

name: green
desc: The amount of green in the color as a value in the interval [0, 1].
meaning: How much green is in a color, from zero to one.

name: red
desc: The amount of red in the color as a value in the interval [0, 1].
meaning: How much red is in a color, from zero to one.

name: agentId
desc: Pantheon Project ID that uniquely identifies the consumer project ID. Required
meaning: The project ID identifying the owner project of a third party device.

name: deviceId
desc: Unique identifier for the device. Example: DBCDW098234. Required
meaning: A unique identifier for a device.

name: agsaClientInstanceId
desc: The client_instance_id on devices with GSA. See 'client_instance_field' in go/androidids.
meaning: An identifier for the Google app instance installed on a device.

name: alloDeviceId
desc: Allo Id. Corresponds to the GBotRequest.Sender.sender. NOTE(dychen): This may change to standard android/ios physical device ids in order to enable shared data (e.g. installed app on physical device shared between Allo and Opa apps on Nexus).
meaning: The device identifier used by the Allo messaging app.

name: canonicalDeviceId
desc: A unique device ID for Assistant devices as proposed by go/ocelot-team to solve the device id fragmentation problem. The value of this id is the HomeGraph id of the device. See go/ocelot-track-0-registry-design. New surfaces should use the canonical_device_id instead of using other ids, and the registration should utilize the DeviceDataLayer (go/ddl-v0). Please contact the assistant-state-management@ team for guidance. Note: We didn't reuse |home_graph_device_id| because in Assistant code base |
meaning: One standard identifier for an Assistant device, taken from its home graph entry.

name: castDeviceId
desc: If set, indicates that the device is a cast device, and contains the UUID of the cast device. Corresponds to the device_id field of the CastDevice proto.
meaning: The unique identifier of a Cast device.

name: clientInstanceId
desc: DUSI (go/dusi) is used as the identifier here. This identifier is unique to the user and device. This will help identify which device or application the user's request originated from. This is not to be confused with the client_instance_id that android devices provide. This is currently used by surfaces that use the assistant-legacy-nexus and assistant-legacy-clockwork pipelines. DUSI is created and set in S3. This field is only filled for GAIA requests.
meaning: An identifier unique to one user on one device or app.

name: connectedDockId
desc: A device ID produced by a connected dock, which is registered in HomeGraph.
meaning: A device identifier reported by a connected dock.

name: deviceConfig
desc: The unique DeviceConfig to the specific third party device. It is also used by Android Auto Embedded first party device. See go/opa-ids.
meaning: The configuration that identifies a specific third party device.

name: deviceType
desc: DEPRECATED. assistant.api.core_types.governed.SurfaceIdentity.surface_type field should be used instead. The device's surface type. This is the string version of surface_type. The server should use the SurfaceType value derived from this string. If the device_type isn't supported within the SurfaceType enum, it will be set as UNKNOWN. Developers should use the enum in ServerParams instead of this string. WARNING: Clients are not actually setting this field. This field will be removed once refere
meaning: A deprecated text label for the kind of device surface being used.

name: homeGraphDeviceId
desc: The unique device ID for HomeGraph devices. This is the HomeGraph ID, created when the device is registered into HomeGraph. It is immutable for the same device unless it is completely deleted and recreated. See go/home-graph for details.
meaning: The unique identifier a device gets when registered in the home graph.

name: libassistantDeviceId
desc: The unique ID for libassistant based devices. See go/libassistant-id for details.
meaning: The unique identifier for devices built on the libassistant library.

name: multiHotwordArbitrationDeviceId
desc: If set, indicates that the device is participating the multi-hotword arbitration and the id is an UUID to distinguish it from other devices. It should also be consistent between requests from a single device within a session (or short duration).
meaning: A temporary identifier used when several devices compete to answer a hotword.

name: opaIosDeviceId
desc: The unique device ID for the Assistant App on iOS. See go/opa-ios-design for details.
meaning: The unique identifier for the Assistant app on iOS.

name: quartzDeviceId
desc: The unique ID of a Quartz device. See go/quartz-design-doc for more details. Quartz ID is a hash of (android_id + gaia).
meaning: The unique identifier of a Quartz device.

name: deviceId
desc: The identifier of the device.
meaning: The identifier of the device the request came from.

name: gaiaId
desc: The identifier of the user.
meaning: The identifier of the user account.

name: localizedAppName
desc: The localized app name.
meaning: The Home app's name in the user's language.

name: packageName
desc: Unique package name that identifies a Home app of the provider.
meaning: The unique package name of a Home app.

name: accessibilityText
desc: A text description of the image to be used for accessibility, e.g. screen readers.
meaning: A text description of the image for screen readers.

name: appIconIdentifier
desc: App identifier. This field is specific to mobile surfaces and stands for app package name for Android surface, and app bundle identifier for iOS. In case identifier is specified but invalid, some default icon will be used, e.g. PackageManager.getDefaultActivityIcon() for Android. If you want to show image for AGSA versions which don't support this field, you can specify source_url as backup.
meaning: The app identifier used to pull an app icon to show as the image.

name: badgeImage
desc: This is the image that is displayed as the badge on the main image.
meaning: A smaller image drawn as a badge on top of the main image.

name: content
desc: Content of the image in bytes.
meaning: The raw bytes of the image.

name: imageSource
desc: Indicate the data source where the image is fetched.
meaning: Where the image was fetched from.

name: jsonContent
desc: Content of image in form of JSON representation.
meaning: The image content expressed as JSON.

name: letterDrawableText
desc: Text used to generate a letter drawable (a letter icon with color). It will be the default icon if the source_url is empty or cannot be rendered.
meaning: Text used to build a fallback letter icon when no image loads.

name: providerUrl
desc: Url of the image provider, which is the website containing the image. For example,
meaning: The address of the website that hosts the image.

name: sourceUrl
desc: The source url of the image. For example,
meaning: The address the image itself is loaded from.

name: sourceUrlType
desc: Type of the source url.
meaning: What kind of source address the image uses.

name: width
desc: The width and height of the image in pixels.
meaning: The pixel size of the image.

name: type
desc: Specifying which type of internal provider.
meaning: Which kind of internal Assistant provider this is.

name: bundleIdentifier
desc: Bundle identifier that identifies an iOS app of the provider.
meaning: The bundle identifier that names an iOS app.

name: localizedAppName
desc: The localized app name.
meaning: The iOS app's name in the user's language.

name: openAppUrl
desc: A URL to open the provider's app.
meaning: A link that opens the provider's iOS app.

name: localizedAppName
desc: The localized app name.
meaning: The KaiOS app's name in the user's language.

name: openAppUrl
desc: A URL to open the provider's app.
meaning: A link that opens the provider's KaiOS app.

name: packageName
desc: Unique package name that identifies a KaiOS app of the provider.
meaning: The unique package name of a KaiOS app.

name: accuracyMeters
desc: The accuracy of the coordinates in meters.
meaning: How accurate the reported coordinates are, in meters.

name: latDegrees
desc: Latitude degrees.
meaning: The latitude of a location.

name: lngDegrees
desc: Longitude degrees.
meaning: The longitude of a location.

name: appName
desc: App name of the message notification, e.g. Hangouts.
meaning: The name of the app that produced the notification, such as Hangouts.

name: bundleId
desc: The key used to group this notification into a cluster.
meaning: The key used to group this notification with related ones.

name: dataUri
desc: Uri for the attachment (image, audio, video etc.).
meaning: A link to a file attached to the notification.

name: groupName
desc: Name of the group associated with the message notification. This field is set iff this is a group message.
meaning: The name of the group chat a message notification came from.

name: groupingKey
desc: The group key of a proactive notification. Details in assistant.api.client_op.NotificationArgs.grouping_key.
meaning: The grouping key attached to a proactive notification.

name: index
desc: Index of the message notification.
meaning: The position of this message notification in a list.

name: markAsReadActionAvailable
desc: Boolean indicating if the mark_as_read action is available for this message.
meaning: Whether the message can be marked as read from the notification.

name: messageLength
desc: Length of the message/notification content in characters. Note: We can't send the full content because of privacy restriction, preventing sending client content to our backends. Concatenated message_length of all notification_entries.
meaning: How many characters long the notification text is.

name: messageWordCount
desc: Word count of the message
meaning: How many words the message contains.

name: mimeType
desc: Mime type of the data_uri. e.g. 'audio/wav', 'video/mp4', 'image/png'.
meaning: The file type of the notification attachment.

name: notificationIconKey
desc: On-device cache key for notification icon.
meaning: The on-device cache key for the notification's icon.

name: notificationKey
desc: String key of the notification. It is the key from original StatusBarNotification received from Android OS. It is used to identify the original notification to send a reply.
meaning: The system key that identifies the original notification so a reply can be sent.

name: opaqueToken
desc: The opaque_token of a proactive notification. Details in assistant.api.client_op.NotificationArgs.opaque_token.
meaning: An opaque token attached to a proactive notification.

name: packageName
desc: App pkg of the message notification, e.g. "com.google.android.talk".
meaning: The package name of the app that sent the notification.

name: postTime
desc: Timestamp of the last notification's post time.
meaning: When the most recent notification was posted.

name: replyActionAvailable
desc: Boolean indicating if the reply action is available for this message.
meaning: Whether the message can be replied to from the notification.

name: senderName
desc: Sender's name of the message notification, e.g. Elsa. Last sender name in case of a group conversation.
meaning: The name of the person who sent the message.

name: audioDuration
desc: Duration of audio message.
meaning: How long an audio message lasts.

name: charCount
desc: Count of characters in the message body in the notification.
meaning: How many characters are in the notification's message body.

name: dataUri
desc: Uri for the attachment (image, audio, video etc.).
meaning: A link to a file attached to the notification.

name: messageBody
desc: Note that this is not present in production traffic. Content of the message body in the notification.
meaning: The text of the message body, not present in real traffic.

name: mimeType
desc: Mime type of the data_uri. e.g. 'audio/wav', 'video/mp4', 'image/png'.
meaning: The file type of the notification attachment.

name: postTime
desc: Timestamp of the notification's post time.
meaning: When this notification was posted.

name: sender
desc: Sender of the message notification.
meaning: Who sent the message in the notification.

name: wordCount
desc: Count of words in the message body in the notification.
meaning: How many words are in the notification's message body.

name: androidAppInfo
desc: The android app information of the provider.
meaning: The Android app details for this provider.

name: castAppInfo
desc: The cast app information of the provider.
meaning: The cast app details for this provider.

name: chromeosAppInfo
desc: The ChromeOS app information of the provider.
meaning: The ChromeOS app details for this provider.

name: cloudProviderInfo
desc: The third party provider information.
