meaning: The third party cloud service details for this provider.

name: fallbackUrl
desc: A URL to fallback to if app can not be opened.
meaning: A link to use when the provider's app cannot be opened.

name: iconImageUrl
desc: Public URL pointing to an icon image for the provider. e.g.
meaning: A public link to the provider's icon image.

name: internalProviderInfo
desc: The internal assistant provider information.
meaning: Details for a provider built into Assistant itself.

name: iosAppInfo
desc: The iOS app information of the provider.
meaning: The iOS app details for this provider.

name: kaiosAppInfo
desc: The KaiOS app information of the provider.
meaning: The KaiOS app details for this provider.

name: sipProviderInfo
desc: The sip information of the provider.
meaning: The internet calling details for this provider.

name: webProviderInfo
desc: The web provider information.
meaning: The web app details for this provider.

name: androidAppInfoDelta
desc: The android app information of the provider.
meaning: The changed Android app details for a provider.

name: fallbackUrl
desc: A URL to fallback to if app can not be opened.
meaning: A link to use when the provider's app cannot be opened.

name: iconImageUrl
desc: Public URL pointing to an icon image for the provider. e.g.
meaning: A public link to the provider's icon image.

name: category
desc: The category related with the ringtone. It's used to generate ringtone related with the category if the entity_mid is not be populated. E.g. for instrument, the ringtone may be piano sound.
meaning: The topic used to pick an alarm sound when no specific entity is given.

name: entityMid
desc: The freebase mid of the entity related to the ringtone. It will be used to generate the ringtone for the alarm or timer (with support for i18n). For instance, for the "cat" mid, the related ringtone will be a cat sound in some language, and for the "Beyonce" mid, the ringtone will be, e.g., a playlist of Beyonce's best hits.
meaning: The knowledge graph entity whose sound or music is used as the ringtone.

name: gentleWakeInfo
desc: Gentle wake information for this alarm.
meaning: Settings for the gradual wake-up effect before an alarm rings.

name: onDeviceAlarmSound
desc: Will be deprecated. Use OnDeviceAlarmMetadata.
meaning: The alarm sound stored on the device, a field being replaced by newer settings.

name: agentIds
desc: For character alarm, the media resources are provided through AOG apps. During alarm trigger phase, aog apps with the specified agent_ids are used to get the media resources. Multiple "AoG agents" can satisfy a character_tag. So the user will select the agents they want at alarm creation time. The chosen agents will be recorded so that the resources only from those agents will be used at trigger time. The number of selected agent_ids will not exceed 3. See go/character-alarm-aog.
meaning: The IDs of the third party apps that supply a character alarm's sounds.

name: characterTags
desc: The Character Alarm tag. Tags are needed to identify the theme of the alarm. For example, if the tag is 'astronaut', astronaut based audio is played during alarm ring. Note : We have made it repeated so that the user can choose multiple character alarm themes at one go. At present, the user is allowed to choose only one theme during alarm creation.
meaning: The theme tags chosen for a character alarm, such as astronaut.

name: iconUrls
desc: Icons urls corresponding to a character. Note : We have made it repeated so that we can show different images when the alarm rings. At present, we only support only one image.
meaning: Links to the icon images shown for an alarm character.

name: agentIds
desc: For FunTime alarms and timers, the media resources are provided through AOG apps during their ringtone. Multiple AoG agents can satisfy a label. So a random agent will be chosen from those that are supplied. See go/funtime-engdesign.
meaning: The IDs of the third party apps that supply FunTime alarm sounds.

name: animationBlob
desc: These bytes may represent the blob of the Rive animation that we pass to the Opal App. We will deprecate this field if we figure out a solution to load the animation from the web.
meaning: The raw animation data played when a FunTime alarm rings.

name: animationUrl
desc: Url for Rive animation that is brought up on ring. Rive is a lightweight animation library that is compatible with Flutter on Opal. See
meaning: A link to the animation played when the alarm rings.

name: timerHeroUrl
desc: The url used to load the image that is at the center of the timer during timer countdown visuals.
meaning: A link to the image shown in the middle of the timer countdown.

name: ttsServiceRequestBytes
desc: This is used to call S3 to realize the TTS. Is in the form of bytes because of a circular dependency issue in libassistant protos. It is a serialized proto of type speech.s3.TtsServiceRequest.
meaning: A packaged request used to generate the spoken audio for an alarm.

name: ringtoneLabel
desc: Label for the generated ringtone.
meaning: A label naming the generated ringtone.

name: effectDurationMs
desc: Specifies how long the effect lasts. Allowed for effect to last after the alarm has started ringing. If unset or negative or 0, effect is assumed to last until alarm trigger time.
meaning: How long the gradual wake-up effect lasts.

name: isEnabled
desc: Indicates if gentle wake action is to be performed before this alarm fires. This is enabled only if the device supports sunrise alarm capability.
meaning: Whether a gradual wake-up effect runs before the alarm rings.

name: startTimedeltaMs
desc: Specifies how long before the alarm fire time, the wakeup effect will start. ALWAYS POSITIVE.
meaning: How long before the alarm the wake-up effect starts.

name: onDeviceAlarmSound
desc: Opal/UI layer will set this bit based on the user selection.
meaning: The alarm sound the user picked on the device.

name: onDeviceAlarmSoundLabel
desc: A string label to identify the alarm sound name. Opal/UI layer will set this as per product definition. This will be used to display the name of the selected ringtone.
meaning: The display name of the selected alarm sound.

name: ttsServiceRequestBytes
desc: This is used to call S3 to realize the TTS. Is in the form of bytes because of a circular dependency issue in libassistant protos. It is a serialized proto of type speech.s3.TtsServiceRequest. This request will contain an ssml with the url to the ringtone files hosted on gstatic.
meaning: A packaged request used to generate the spoken audio for an alarm.

name: routineId
desc: The unique id for each routine. When the alrm is dismissed, it will trigger the routine of the routine alarm's creator if feasible.
meaning: The ID of the routine that runs when this alarm is dismissed.

name: providerId
desc: The providers id (MID) which is the primary identifier for a call provider within the Assistant. A MID, or machine identifier, is a unique identifier issued by Knowledge Graph for all entities contained in it's graph.
meaning: The knowledge graph ID of the calling provider.

name: realm
desc: Calling realm to be use for each call. i.e. For anonymous, this would be set to anonymous.chirp.google.com
meaning: The calling realm used for each call.

name: useBirdsongTacl
desc: If true, client should use the Birdsong TaCL API for this call. Uses the VoiceCallManager API by default. For more details: go/birdsong-migration-google-home
meaning: Whether the client should use the newer calling API for this call.

name: deviceId
desc: The identifier of the device.
meaning: The identifier of the device.

name: legacySurfaceType
desc: DEPRECATED: The legacy device's surface type enum. NOTE: Prefer using the ontological
meaning: A deprecated code for the old style of device surface.

name: surfaceType
desc: The device's surface type. The types are defined at google3/assistant/api/core_types/surfaces.gcl. For more details, refer to go/ontologicalize-surface-type.
meaning: The kind of device surface the request came from.

name: surfaceTypeString
desc: DEPRECATED. The legacy device's surface type string. NOTE: Prefer using the ontological
meaning: A deprecated text label for the old style of device surface.

name: surfaceVersion
desc: The version of the surface/client. This is different from the Conversation protocol version.
meaning: The version of the client software on the device.

name: homeStorage
desc: Serialized storage (context) persisted and retrieved for the app and home.
meaning: Saved context data kept for the web app and the home.

name: localizedAppName
desc: The localized app name.
meaning: The web app's name in the user's language.

name: openAppUrl
desc: A URL to open the provider's app.
meaning: A link that opens the provider's web app.

name: thirdPartyCustomNluInfo
desc: Info about 3P Custom NLU used in this web provider. TODO(b/321644453) remove when QRewrite is able to call SERoot.
meaning: Details about the third party language understanding used by this web provider.

name: locale
desc: The locale of this agent version, represented by BCP-47 language strings, such as "en", "en-US", "fr", "fr-CA", "sr-Latn", "zh-Hans-CN", etc.
meaning: The language and region this agent version serves.

name: nluAgentId
desc: Unique internal identifier of 3P Custom NLU agent. UUID.
meaning: The internal identifier of a third party language understanding agent.

name: nluAgentVersion
desc: Identifies the 3P Custom NLU agent version.
meaning: The version of the third party language understanding agent.

name: localConnectivityEnabled
desc: Whether the device has torus/usonia capabililities enabled or not.
meaning: Whether the device has local connectivity features turned on.

name: remoteCastMediaEnabled
desc: Whether the device supports cast media originated from a remote device to be executed through local execution and can upload results asynchronously. Needs to be checked before sending remote media initiation through local channel since it needs an async result upload path.
meaning: Whether the device can play cast media started from another device locally.

name: fallbackToTetheredDevice
desc: If true, data.VALIDATE should be routed to the tethered device (if present) if the tethered device supports data.VALIDATE and the primary device does not.
meaning: Whether a validation request should be sent to a tethered device instead.

name: day
desc: The day, in 1...31.
meaning: The day of the month, from 1 to 31.

name: month
desc: The month, in 1...12.
meaning: The month of the year, from 1 to 12.

name: year
desc: The year, e.g. 2016.
meaning: The year, such as 2016.

name: date
desc: A Gregorian calendar date.
meaning: A calendar date.

name: timeOfDay
desc: A civil time relative to a timezone.
meaning: A clock time within a given time zone.

name: timeZone
desc: A time zone in IANA format.
meaning: The time zone, written in standard IANA form.

name: endDate
desc: End date of the range.
meaning: The date and time a range ends.

name: startDate
desc: Start date of the range.
meaning: The date and time a range begins.

name: movement
desc: These capabilities are scoped to abilities of the device to move around.
meaning: How much the device is able to move around.

name: surfaceIdentity
desc: The set of information that helps the server identify the surface.
meaning: Information the server uses to identify what kind of device is calling.

name: screen
desc: These capabilities are scoped to the ability to see and interact with the Assistant through a screen. If the device has no screen it should send an empty ScreenCapabilities. Sending no ScreenCapabilities will cause this to be overridden with the surface default.
meaning: What the device's screen can display and how users interact with it.

name: callCapabilities
desc: The call capabilities of this device. go/call-capabilities
meaning: What kinds of phone calls the device can make.

name: systemNotificationRestrictions
desc: Restrictions related to system-level notifications. This field is superficially similar to ProactiveNotificationOutput, but unlike that field which tracks a per-user preference on the OPA side, this field captures system level notifications restrictions. This field is not stored and is merged to capabilities from conversation params. It exists mostly for logging purposes of android channel state and global app-level notification opt out.
meaning: System-level notification restrictions, kept mainly for logging.

name: sodaCapabilities
desc: Capabilities related to SODA (Speech On-Device API).
meaning: Which on-device speech recognition features the device supports.

name: hasVoiceTelephony
desc: Indicates that the device has connection to cellular network that allows it to make voice calls. This is distinct from device just being capable of voice telephony, because the device can be capable yet miss the suitable SIM card (for example, it could miss SIM card altogether, or have data-only SIM card).
meaning: Whether the device can actually place voice calls over a cell network.

name: lensPerceptionCapabilities
desc: Capabilities related to Lens Perception, i.e. image understanding. See go/lens-perception-sdk.
meaning: Which image-understanding Lens features the device supports.

name: cast
desc: These capabilities are scoped to the cast abilities of this device.
meaning: Which casting features the device supports.

name: deviceId
desc: This is the same device id that is specified in the conversation protocol and should be unique to each device/user/model combination. For example, if a request is coming from a watch through AGSA the watch and AGSA should have different device_ids. Note: this field should only be used to determine which device the capabilities belong to and not to access the id of the device. Instead DeviceProperties should be used and accessed through ParamsAccessor.
meaning: An identifier saying which device these capabilities belong to.

name: thirdPartyCapabilities
desc: Capabilities related to third party integration.
meaning: Which third-party integrations the device supports.

name: androidIntentCapabilities
desc: Capabilites related to Android intent support.
meaning: What Android app intents the device can handle.

name: camera
desc: These capabilities are scoped to the camera abilities of this device.
meaning: What the device's camera can do.

name: deviceUxMode
desc: Capabilities related to Android tablet UX experience.
meaning: Which Android tablet interface mode the device runs.

name: assistantCapability
desc: Capabilities if surface supports Google Assistant.
meaning: Whether and how the device supports Google Assistant.

name: bluetoothCapabilities
desc: Bluetooth capabilities related to usage of a feature.
meaning: Which Bluetooth features the device supports.

name: location
desc: These capabilities are scoped to the location abilities of this device.
meaning: Which location features the device supports.

name: notificationOutputRestrictions
desc: Settings, that reflect whether a specific notification type is allowed for current device, e.g. if the user opted out from notification category or category group. This settings are server-side stored and evaluated unlike SystemNotificationRestrictions field.
meaning: Which notification types the user has allowed on this device.

name: loggingOnlyData
desc: Data which is produced for logging and debugging. Servers MUST NOT use this for any other purposes, such as branching on it.
meaning: Device details kept only for logging and debugging.

name: notificationCapabilities
desc: DEPRECATED: Use SystemNotificationRestrictions instead. Specifies whether the surface is able to display notifications. This field is superficially similar to ProactiveNotificationOutput, but unlike that field which tracks a per-user preference on the OPA side, this field captures whether the surface is capable of displaying notifications.
meaning: Deprecated flag for whether the device can show notifications.

name: audioInput
desc: These capabilities are scoped to the ability to gather audio. It includes information like the type of audio that can be gathered (e.g. public, private).
meaning: What kinds of audio the device can record.

name: outputRestrictions
desc: These are user configured restrictions indicating what the device is allowed to output from the privacy point of view.
meaning: User privacy settings for what the device is allowed to output.

name: software
desc: These capabilities are scoped to the software available on the device as well as the set of supported Assistant features.
meaning: Which software and Assistant features are available on the device.

name: carUxRestrictions
desc: UX restrictions for Auto.
meaning: Interface limits applied when the device is used in a car.

name: audioOutput
desc: These capabilities are scoped to the ability to play audio. It includes information like the type of audio that can be played (e.g. public, private).
meaning: What kinds of audio the device can play.

name: popOnLockscreenCapability
desc: Capability to support Pop on lockscreen.
meaning: Whether the device can show Assistant content on the lock screen.

name: surfaceTypeString
desc: DEPRECATED. surface_identity field below already contains this information. The device's surface type. This is the string version of the assistant.api.core_types.SurfaceType enum. The server should not use this field, rather it should use the SurfaceType value derived from this string.
meaning: Deprecated text name of the device surface type.

name: jwnCapabilities
desc: Indicates if the client supports Javascript Whatsnext (go/jwn). Also contains the Jwn libraries present on the client along with their versions.
meaning: Whether the client can run this Javascript system, and which libraries it holds.

name: safetyRestrictions
desc: Indicates if the client has safety related restriction.
meaning: Whether the client has safety-related restrictions in place.

name: supportedLocale
desc: Locales supported by assistant settings for speaking and display. This is independent from device language that is defined in device setting. New locales are added based on rollout, whitelist and app version releases because older versions does not have model support. Currently supported locale list differs by surface type.
meaning: Which languages and regions Assistant can speak and display here.

name: speechCapabilities
desc: DEPRECATED Capabilities related to speech detection on devices.
meaning: Deprecated description of the device's speech detection abilities.

name: nanos
desc: Signed fractions of a second at nanosecond resolution of the span of time. Durations less than one second are represented with a 0
meaning: The fractional-second part of a length of time.

name: seconds
desc: Signed seconds of the span of time. Must be from -315,576,000,000 to +315,576,000,000 inclusive.
meaning: The whole-second part of a length of time.

name: clarificationDataSupported
desc: Whether client supports clarification suggestion chip to be displayed see |assistant.suggestions.ClarificationData|
meaning: Whether the client can show clarification suggestion chips.

name: supportedActivities
desc: A list of fitness activity types supported by this client.
meaning: Which fitness activity types the client handles.

name: stateSyncMethod
desc: Specifies the params proto that Fluid Actions uses to sync state with server.
meaning: Which message format the client uses to sync state with the server.

name: deviceId
desc: DeviceId of the accessory device (eg. watch) Commonly the go/dusi (eg. client_instance_id) is provided.
meaning: Identifier of an accessory device such as a watch.

name: responseConfig
desc: Configuration sent by device.
meaning: Response settings sent by the device.

name: ttsEncoding
desc: DEPRECATED: Format of TTS audio requested by the device.
meaning: Deprecated audio format the device asked for spoken responses in.

name: gcmRegistrationId
desc: GCM registration id for the device. Used to pass messages to the device.
meaning: The push-messaging registration ID used to reach the device.

name: supportsAssistantGcm
desc: Assistant supports GCM on the device. ClientOps can be sent to it over GCM and will be executed.
meaning: Whether Assistant can send this device commands over push messaging.

name: supportsClientInputOverGcm
desc: If it is set to true, then it indicates to server that device is capable of receiving a GCM payload with serialized client input. The client input will be sent back to Assistant Server over conversation protocol.
meaning: Whether the device can receive client input inside a push message.

name: gestureSensing
desc: Whether Gesture is supported. When false, override the value for tap and omniswipe.
meaning: Whether the device can detect gestures at all.

name: omniswipeGestureCapable
desc: Whether omniswipe is supported
meaning: Whether the device recognizes the omniswipe gesture.

name: tapGestureCapable
desc: Whether tap is supported
meaning: Whether the device recognizes tap gestures.

name: confirmationMessageSupported
desc: Whether the client supports confirmation messages in Immersive Canvas actions.
meaning: Whether the client can show confirmation messages in Immersive Canvas.

name: pauseSignalSupported
desc: Whether the client support canvas pause signal. If true, the Assistant Server will send a signal when canvas transitioning to pause mode.
meaning: Whether the client understands a signal that the canvas is pausing.

name: librariesVersionMap
desc: The name and version of the jwn libraries currently stored on the client. These are the same that the server communicated when the library was first sent down.
meaning: Names and versions of the code libraries currently stored on the client.

name: supportedCompressionMode
desc: Compression algorithms supported on the client. Server can choose one of these to compress WhatsNext Javascript programs and libraries.
meaning: Which compression methods the client can decode.

name: supportsJwn
desc: Whether the client supports running jwn code.
meaning: Whether the client can run this Javascript code.

name: hasLensPerception
desc: Whether the device supports Lens Perception.
meaning: Whether the device supports Lens image understanding.

name: isLensDirectIntentAvailable
desc: Indicates whether Lens supports Lens Direct Intent (go/lensdirectintent).
meaning: Whether Lens can be opened straight into a specific mode.

name: isLensLiveViewfinderAvailable
desc: Indicates whether Lens supports Live view-finder experience.
meaning: Whether Lens supports the live camera viewfinder experience.

name: isLensPostCaptureAvailable
desc: Indicates whether Lens supports Post-capture experience with an image payload.
meaning: Whether Lens can work on an already-captured image.

name: lensCapabilities
desc: Contains the capabilities that Lens can support.
meaning: The set of Lens features the device supports.

name: dining
desc: The presence of this message means that Dining is supported.
meaning: Present when the device supports the Lens dining feature.

name: education
desc: The presence of this message means that Education is supported.
meaning: Present when the device supports the Lens education feature.

name: outdoor
desc: The presence of this message means that Outdoor is supported.
meaning: Present when the device supports the Lens outdoor feature.

name: shopping
desc: The presence of this message means that Shopping is supported.
meaning: Present when the device supports the Lens shopping feature.

name: text
desc: The presence of this message means that intenting directly into the text filter is supported.
meaning: Present when the device can open Lens straight into text mode.

name: translate
desc: The presence of this message means that Translation is supported.
meaning: Present when the device supports Lens translation.

name: isTextToSpeechSupported
desc: Indicates whether text-to-speech is supported.
meaning: Whether the device can read detected text aloud.

name: supportedLanguageTags
desc: The list of language IETF BCP 47 tags that are supported. See the full details in the comment on the equivalent field in:
meaning: Which languages the translation feature supports.

name: channelsByProvider
desc: A list of channel providers each of which provides a list of its channels.
meaning: The TV channel lineups available, grouped by provider.

name: channels
desc: A list of channels provided by this input. Keep the performance impact in mind when the number/size of the channels is large. When there are too many channels, consider stripping out some data.
meaning: The list of TV channels one provider offers.

name: inputId
desc: An identifier to identify the input source. For example for TIF based channels, this will be the TIF input ID to differentiate different tuner apps. See
meaning: Identifier for the TV input source or tuner app.

name: providerType
desc: Type of provider who provides this channel input.
meaning: What kind of provider supplies this TV channel input.

name: channelId
desc: Unique channel identifier.
meaning: A unique identifier for a TV channel.

name: channelName
desc: A list of channel names and synonyms.
meaning: The channel's name and alternative names.

name: channelNumber
desc: Channel number displayed to user. Optional.
meaning: The channel number shown to the user.

name: deeplink
desc: A deep link into the Live player app that tunes to this channel.
meaning: A link that opens the TV app tuned to this channel.

name: mid
desc: KG mid of the channel if it exists in KG.
meaning: The Knowledge Graph entity ID for the TV channel.

name: networkMid
desc: Network KG mid of the channel if it exists in KG
meaning: The Knowledge Graph entity ID for the channel's TV network.

name: providerInfo
desc: Contains detailed provider information such as android app package name.
meaning: Details about the TV provider, such as its Android app name.

name: providerKey
desc: A provider enum string for OTT providers. The available key can be found in go/ump-provider-enum For Tuner provider, the provider key would be an ID the tuner app uploaded from TIF. See
meaning: A short code naming the TV or streaming provider.

name: acpVersion
desc: A user-readable string describing the ACP version (go/acp-version) of the client app used by the user to originate the conversation.
meaning: The client app's protocol version, recorded for logs.

name: androidId
desc: Random identifier assigned to Android mobile devices. Older logs may have previously stored other kinds of android IDs in this field, but all current logs should use the GServices Id. See go/androidids.
meaning: A random identifier assigned to an Android device.

name: appVersion
desc: A user-readable string describing the version of the client app used by the user to originate the conversation.
meaning: The version of the client app the user is running.

name: assistantSettingsSource
desc: An enum specifying when was this ATV AssistantSettings entry initially created.
meaning: Where the device's Assistant settings entry was first created.

name: boardName
desc: The type of board used by manufacturer for this device
meaning: The hardware board type used in the device.

name: boardRevision
desc: The revision of board used
meaning: The revision number of the device's hardware board.

name: castAssistantSettingLinkingResult
desc: This field records the linking status between Assistant setting entry and Cast setting entry. Currently only ATV surface populates this field for profiling purpose.
meaning: Whether the Assistant and Cast settings entries are linked.

name: deviceModel
desc: A user-readable string describing the device's hardware platform.
meaning: A readable name for the device's hardware.

name: embedderBuildInfo
desc: Any relevant info concerning the build options of the embedder (that is the software which runs as the 'driver' of an Assistant library, such as libassistant. the embedder is typically built by a third party)
meaning: Build details of the third-party software that runs Assistant.

name: initialAppVersion
desc: A string recording the app version that is initially used to created this settings entry.
meaning: The app version in use when this settings entry was first created.

name: isPrimaryUser
desc: Boolean field to indicate whether a certain user is the primary user of a device or not. This is useful for distinguishing the user0 from other users given user0 might have certain privileges (Eg: Hubmode on Tangor)
meaning: Whether this user is the device's main user.

name: mdnsDisplayName
desc: default display name of device over mdns. This is specified at the factory, not specified by the user.
meaning: The factory-set network display name of the device.

name: platformBuild
desc: A user-readable string describing the device's software platform.
meaning: A readable name for the device's software platform.

name: virtualReleaseChannel
desc: A string describing device's release channel. For cast devices, the string will look like "qa-beta-channel", "eng-no-update", etc.
meaning: Which software release channel the device is on.

name: skipConfirmationsWhilePlaying
desc: Whether to prevent confirmations (text, tts) for media control actions while media is playing so that the media session is not interrupted.
meaning: Whether to skip spoken confirmations so playing media is not interrupted.

name: fallbackToTetheredDeviceAppCapabilities
desc: If true, APP_ID queries initiated by this device should fall back to execution on the tethered device if it's available and if the primary device cannot perform the action (e.g. due to the app not being installed).
meaning: Whether app requests should fall back to a paired device that can handle them.

name: preferTargetingPrimaryDevice
desc: For chat_message.SEND targeting, when either the primary or secondary (tethered) device is capable of handling the chat_message.SEND action, prefer targeting it to the primary device.
meaning: Whether to send message actions to the main device when both devices can.

name: supportedRecipientTypes
desc: Should only be checked if nonempty.
meaning: Which kinds of message recipients the device supports.

name: deviceSettingStatus
desc: The current setting status of message summary on current device.
meaning: The current on or off state of message summaries on the device.

name: lastVoiceOptInFlowTimestamp
desc: Last time that voice opt-in flow has been triggered.
meaning: When the voice opt-in prompt was last shown.

name: readNotificationSummarizationSupported
desc: Whether the client supports message summarization.
meaning: Whether the client can summarize messages.

name: voiceOptInFlowCounter
desc: The voice consent flow counter on current device.
meaning: How many times the voice consent prompt has run on the device.

name: mobility
desc: Indicates how much the device moves around. E.g., TV has a low mobility level, while Auto has a very high level.
meaning: How much the device typically moves around.

name: cloudCapability
desc: The OEM Cloud execution capability of this device, containing routing details for cloud fulfillment.
meaning: Where to route requests handled in the device maker's cloud.

name: cloudDeviceCapabilities
desc: If fulfillment is done via 3P cloud and 3P supports device capabilities, this field will be set.
meaning: Device abilities reported when a third party handles fulfillment.

name: deviceModelId
desc: Device Model Id from DeviceModelPackage.
meaning: The manufacturer's model identifier for the device.

name: deviceModelRevisionId
desc: Device Model Revision Id from DeviceModelPackage.
meaning: The revision identifier of the device model.

name: deviceSpecificData
desc: Opaque supported action data related to a specific domain of devices, for example for car. go/car-talk-registration-model
meaning: Opaque data about actions supported by one category of device, such as cars.

name: internalCapability
desc: Internal-only config containing metadata about the Device Model, for example to control the ranking behavior.
meaning: Internal notes about the device model, including how its actions are ordered.

name: thirdPartyActionConfig
desc: 3P Action Metadata, populated from the Device Model lookup and the client request parameters. For example, an Assistant SDK request would have the billed project id of the Assistant request added here in order to enable any Device Actions developed using the same Google Cloud project. This data is sent to Service Engine to mask triggering for Device Actions.
meaning: Settings that let third-party device actions be triggered.

name: isLocalNetworkArbitrationSupported
desc: Capabilities related to local network arbitration (go/local-network-arbitration). Indicates if the device is capable of being a host device in the LAN whiling doing local network arbitration.
meaning: Whether the device can act as host when devices decide which one answers.

name: isOnDeviceArbitrationSupported
desc: Capabilities related to on-device arbitration(go/arbitration-on-device).
meaning: Whether the device can decide locally which device should respond.

name: isOnDeviceAssistantSupported
desc: Indicates if on-device assistant is enabled on this device. Example usecases: NGA (go/nga) or Marble (go/marble).
meaning: Whether Assistant can run directly on the device.

name: isOnDeviceUnderstandingSupported
desc: This may be used by NGA. E.g. if understanding happens on device, we can have more aggressive logic when fulfilling some features on the server side, like teleport.
meaning: Whether the device can interpret requests itself instead of on the server.

name: isOnDeviceSmartHomeSupported
desc: Master bit for on-device Smart Home features.
meaning: Whether smart home features run on the device itself.

name: isSupported
desc: Determines if an on-device storage is supported.
meaning: Whether the device can store data locally.

name: googlePhotoContent
desc: The type of Google Photo content which the device can output.
meaning: Which kind of Google Photos content the device may show.

name: guestAccessOutput
desc: Access settings for guests.
meaning: What guests are allowed to access on the device.

name: personalData
desc: The level of personal data which the device can output. See go/personal-readout for detail.
meaning: How much personal information the device may read out.

name: proactiveNotificationOutput
desc: This controls if the server can proactively send notification to users, and it does not affect scenarios that users ask for information. The notification may include TTS and lights. It could be only lights for chirp.
meaning: Whether the server may send unprompted notifications to this device.

name: proactiveOutput
desc: Restrictions on displaying and interacting with content on proactive surfaces (e.g. Dragonglass home screen). Note: NEVER access this field of OutputRestrictions directly, use the code in assistant/assistant_server/settings/device/device_settings_util.h instead.
meaning: Limits on content shown on always-on ambient screens.

name: youtubeAutoplayRestriction
desc: Whether YouTube autoplay is allowed for queries from the user to this device. See go/assistant-youtube-settings for details.
meaning: Whether YouTube videos may autoplay on this device.

name: youtubeContent
desc: The type of YouTube content which the device can output.
meaning: Which kind of YouTube content the device may show.

name: youtubeTvContent
desc: The type of YouTube TV content which the device can output.
meaning: Which kind of YouTube TV content the device may show.

name: allowAllPersonalData
desc: Allows displaying all personal data on proactive surfaces with no face match capability.
meaning: Whether all personal data may show on screens that cannot recognize faces.

name: androidTvAssistantSettingsSource
desc: For ANDROID_TV devices, the location that this setting was last changed from. Note: this structure allows to extend to more per-vertical bits in the future.
meaning: Where this Android TV setting was last changed from.

name: healthAndFitnessProactive
desc: Allows displaying Health and Fitness content on proactive surfaces. This is a sub bit of the device-wide PR bit - the device-wide PR bit must be enabled AND this vertical sub bit must be enabled for H&F content to be shown. This bit will be available on all surfaces that have the proactive-bit enabled. If the proactive-bit is not enabled, then we do not show health and fitness content at all (or even allow access to this setting).
meaning: Whether health and fitness content may appear on ambient screens.

name: photosProactive
desc: Allows displaying photos content on Dragonglass proactive surfaces. This is a sub bit of the device-wide PR bit - the device-wide PR bit must be enabled AND this vertical sub bit must be enabled for photos content to be shown on Dragonglass surfaces. This bit will be available on all Dragonglass surfaces that have the proactive-bit enabled. If the proactive-bit is not enabled or it's not a Dragonglass surface, then we do not show proactive photos content at all, nor allow access to this setting.
meaning: Whether photos may appear on ambient screens.

name: userMatchProactive
desc: Settings for displaying personal data on proactive surfaces with face match capability.
meaning: Settings for showing personal data on screens that recognize faces.

name: protobufData
desc: The serialized protocol buffer.
meaning: A message stored in its packed binary form.

name: protobufType
desc: The type of the protocol buffer to use. This must be a resolvable name (Namespace.ProtoName) and refer to a proto which is either compiled in to both client and server (e.g. a base proto type) or to one which is part of the conversation package.
meaning: The name of the message type stored alongside the data.

name: begin
desc: The first day of the recurrence. If begin is not set, then the reminder will start infinitely in the past.
meaning: The first day a repeating reminder applies.

name: blacklistedRanges
desc: A list of blacklisted dates to skip the alarm on.
meaning: Date ranges on which the repeating alarm is skipped.

name: dayOfMonth
desc: Specifies the date in a month. For example, if day_of_month is 15, then it represent the 15th day of the specified month.
meaning: Which day numbers of the month the event repeats on.

name: dayOfWeek
desc: Specifies a weekly or daily recurrence. Constraint: The date falls on one of these days of the week, in 0...6 (Sunday...Saturday).
meaning: Which weekdays the event repeats on.

name: end
desc: The last day of the recurrence.
meaning: The last day a repeating reminder applies.

name: every
desc: Multiplier on the frequency of the recurrence. Use this to specify patterns that recur every X days, months, years, etc. Example: [remind me to call mom every 2nd week]. Default is 1 (every day, every month, every year).
meaning: How many intervals to skip between repeats, such as every second week.

name: monthOfYear
desc: Specifies the month in a year. Constrain: the month falls on one of these months, in 1, 2, ... 12 (January...December).
meaning: Which months of the year the event repeats in.

name: numOccurrences
desc: The number of occurrences after which the recurrence should end.
meaning: How many times the event repeats before it stops.

name: weekOfMonth
desc: Specifies the index of week in a month. For example, the second Tuesday every month, in this case, week_of_month should be 2.
meaning: Which week of the month the event repeats in.

name: enabledExtensions
desc: List of enabled Robin extensions.
meaning: Which Robin extensions are turned on.

name: supportedRobinOps
desc: List of supported RobinOps.
meaning: Which Robin operations the client can perform.

name: fontScaleFactor
desc: The scale factor used to convert Scalable Pixel (SP) units to Density-independent Pixel (DP) units (DP = SP * scale factor). Fonts are measured in units of SP, and on some platforms such as Android the SP to DP scale factor can be affected by the font size a user selects in accessibility settings.
meaning: How much text is scaled up or down on the device's screen.

name: inputType
desc: The types of input that this screen supports. Note that this can be empty in which case the screen's input type is unknown.
meaning: Which kinds of input the screen accepts.

name: mask
desc: Mask defined for this device, if any.
meaning: The screen shape mask defined for the device, if any.

name: protoLayoutTargetedSchema
desc: The targeted schema version for ProtoLayout requests.
meaning: Which layout schema version the device targets.

name: resolution
desc: If this field is absent, the resolution of the screen is unknown.
meaning: The screen's resolution, if it is known.

name: screenOff
desc: If screen is turned off.
meaning: Whether the screen is currently off.

name: screenStateDetection
desc: The ability of the client to correctly report screen state.
meaning: How reliably the client can report whether its screen is on.

name: supportedRenderingFormat
desc: The primary supported rendering format for display on the device's screen. This may be used to determine what format of card to be returned when rendering cards.
meaning: Which card format the device can display.

name: supportedScreenStates
desc: The screen states that the client supports. The current screen state is specified in DeviceProperties.screen.
meaning: Which screen states the client can handle.

name: visionHelpEnabled
desc: Whether the device enabled vision help features in accessibility settings. The settings is config in Assistant App and on-device settings, and stored in footprints. When enabled, font, color and TTS will be adjusted.
meaning: Whether vision accessibility features are turned on.

name: dpi
desc: Dots (pixels) per inch of the screen.
meaning: How many pixels per inch the screen has.

name: mSize
desc: m_size is the smallest square box size to display a capital letter M so that the user can still easily understand it.
meaning: The smallest box size in which a capital M stays readable.

name: nengSize
desc: neng_size is the smallest square box size to display a letter 螚 (Neng, U+879A) so that the user can easily understand it. (Neng is a visually dense Chinese letter, and so may require a larger box than an M.)
meaning: The smallest box size in which a dense Chinese character stays readable.

name: widthPx
desc: The dimensions of the application window, in pixels.
meaning: How wide the app window is in pixels.

name: gestureCapabilities
desc: A list of gestures that selina supports
meaning: Which gestures this feature supports.

name: selinaSupported
desc: Whether the client supports selina.
meaning: Whether the client supports the Selina feature.

name: sleepSensingSupported
desc: Whether the client can monitor sleep. This allows us to show sleep CUJ related information: go/TwilightDesign
meaning: Whether the device can track sleep.

name: anyUserHasSetPersonalPhotos
desc: Whether any user sets personal photos on this device. See go/ambient-setting-in-assistant-design.
meaning: Whether any user has chosen personal photos for this device.

name: recentHighlightsEnabled
desc: Whether or not the user's current selection for their ambient photo frame includes the auto-generated "Recent Highlights" album. This is used to determine which users to display the go/opa-photos-memories-tile. See go/opa-photo-memories-imax-optin for more discussion on why this bit was created.
meaning: Whether the photo frame includes the auto-made Recent Highlights album.

name: showPersonalPhotoData
desc: Whether to enable the personal photo data in the ambient settings:
meaning: Whether personal photo data is turned on in the ambient settings.

name: showPersonalPhotos
desc: Whether current user sets personal photos on this device. See go/ambient-setting-in-assistant-design.
meaning: Whether this user has chosen personal photos for this device.

name: carSettingsCapabilities
desc: Capabilities that are associated with Assistant Settings on auto surfaces.
meaning: Which Assistant settings features are available in cars.

name: reissueQueryAfterMusicSetup
desc: Whether the client supports reissuing query after setting up in Music Settings.
meaning: Whether the client can repeat the request after music setup finishes.

name: supportsPaymentsSettingsUpdate
desc: Whether the client supports updating payments setting.
meaning: Whether the client can change payment settings.

name: allowIncomingCalls
desc: Whether this device is allowed to receive incoming PSTN calls.
meaning: Whether the device may receive incoming phone calls.

name: targets
desc: The set of users of this device that will have these downtime settings applied. Must have at least one element.
meaning: Which users of the device these quiet-hours settings apply to.

name: enabled
desc: Enables/disables all the filters at the same time. For new devices or non-Cast devices this is always false.
meaning: Whether all the feature restrictions are switched on at once.

name: featureFilters
desc: The filters (feature restrictions) to apply when
meaning: The set of feature restrictions to apply.

name: targets
desc: The set of users of this device that will have these settings applied. Must have at least one element.
meaning: Which users of the device these settings apply to.

name: optInEnabled
desc: Indicates whether the crash logs can be uploaded and the device logs can be enabled
meaning: Whether crash and device logs may be uploaded.

name: voiceEnrollmentStatus
desc: Indicates whether the user's voice has been successfully enrolled on this device.
meaning: Whether the user finished enrolling their voice on this device.

name: paymentsEnabled
desc: DEPRECATED: Use DeviceCapabilities.OutputRestrictions.personal_data instead. Whether the user has enabled payments for this device.
meaning: Deprecated flag for whether payments were turned on for the device.

name: linkedUsers
desc: Please do NOT use this field without prior approval from PWG. Users who have signed in onto this device, go/linked-users-in-pkg.
meaning: The users who have signed in on this device.

name: ancillaryDeviceId
desc: The additional device ids. Currently used only for ATV. go/project-yellowstone Note: This field is for internal (Within settings) use only.
meaning: Extra internal device identifiers, currently used for Android TV.

name: speakerIdEnabled
desc: Indicates whether the user has enabled speaker-id for this device. See go/google-assistant-multi-user for more info on this project.
meaning: Whether the user turned on voice recognition of speakers on this device.

name: faceEnrollmentStatus
desc: Indicates whether the user's face has been successfully enrolled on this device. See go/face-match-server-design for more info.
meaning: Whether the user's face was successfully enrolled on this device.

name: speechSettings
desc: Speech/hotword detection related settings.
meaning: Settings for speech and hotword detection on the device.

name: colocationStatus
desc: Status of colocation. go/co-location-work-v2 Note: this is a cache at the Assistant level. The source of truth is inside CastAuthenticationServer, which is only used for Home devices.
meaning: Whether the device is known to sit near other devices.

name: lastUsedCoarseTimestamp
desc: Coarsened hourly timestamp of when the device was last used.
meaning: The hour when the device was last used, rounded for privacy.

name: supervisionSettings
desc: Restrictions on how and when certain users can use a device. See go/home-ft-prd.
meaning: Rules limiting how and when certain people can use the device.

name: humanFriendlyName
desc: The human-friendly name of the cast device, e.g., my living room tv. This field is set by the user and already localized.
meaning: The user-chosen nickname for a cast device, such as my living room tv.

name: homeGraphData
desc: Holds the data that should be written to HomeGraph. Note: this field is not persisted in Assistant Settings storage. It is simply used for transporting data when client calls UpdateSettings.
meaning: Data being passed through to be written into the home device graph.

name: blueSteelEnabled
desc: Indicates whether the user has enabled Blue Steel. See go/blue-steel for more info on this project.
meaning: Whether the user turned on the Blue Steel feature.

name: locationFeature
desc: The feature proto of the location of the device. Note: client does not need to populate this. It will be auto-populated based on "address" field on server side. Currently, only "bound" and "type" are persisted, since the entire FeatureProto is too big.
meaning: Map data about the device's location, filled in automatically from its address.

name: defaultAudioDeviceId
desc: The identification of the default device which user want to output audio. See go/default-media-output-design for more info.
meaning: Which device the user wants audio played on by default.

name: speechOutputSettings
desc: Settings related to TTS output.
meaning: Settings for how the device speaks responses aloud.

name: oauthClientId
desc: OAuth client id for the device. This field is available for Assistant SDK devices. It is written when the device is registered to the user (AssistantSettingsUiService.LinkAssistantDeviceUi). When user revokes grant on the Assistant device, Assistant Devices Platform Service will receive Pubsub notification with OAuth client id for the revoked device, and we will compare that with this stored id to identity device to remove.
meaning: The OAuth client id assigned to the device when it was registered.

name: marketplaceDisclosure
desc: See go/marketplace-disclosure for more info.
meaning: Record of the marketplace disclosure shown for the device.

name: locale
desc: The locale for the device: language + region, i.e., en-US, ja-JP.
meaning: The device's language and region setting, such as en-US.

name: linkedDeviceId
desc: Stores pairing between different devices. See go/quartz-design-doc for more info.
meaning: Ids of other devices paired with this one.

name: deviceModelId
desc: The model ID of the device. This should be globally unique across manufactures/OEMs. Examples: "nest_cam_iq_2017", "comcast_voice_box_2017".
meaning: A globally unique model identifier for the device.

name: verboseTtsForChromecastEnabled
desc: Indicates whether to play verbose tts for Elementary on chirp. See: go/opa-cast-a11y-impl-design fore more info on this project. Note: this should probably be in SpeechOutputSetting below.
meaning: Whether the device should read out longer spoken responses for accessibility.

name: shortenedAddress
desc: A human-readable shortened address. This is usually the street address. Note: client does not need to populate this. It will be auto-populated based on "address" field on server side. Developers can use this field to avoid reading out the full address everytime.
meaning: A short street address for the device, generated automatically from its full address.

name: deviceBrand
desc: The brand of the device, populated from DeviceOemParams. Examples: "google", "samsung".
meaning: The brand name of the device, such as Google or Samsung.

name: creationTimestampMs
desc: The timestamp that the device is linked with the user in milliseconds.
meaning: When the device was first linked to the user.

name: deviceId
desc: The identification of the device.
meaning: The identifier of the device.

name: faceEnrollmentErrors
desc: List of errors that happened during the face enrollment process if it failed. See go/face-match-enrollment-error for more info.
meaning: Errors that happened while setting up face recognition.

name: faceMatchEnabled
desc: Indicates whether the user has enabled Face Match for this device. See go/face-match-server-design for more info on this project.
meaning: Whether the user turned on Face Match for this device.

name: locationCoordinates
desc: Coordinate information of the device location.
meaning: The latitude and longitude of the device.

name: allowIncomingCalls
desc: Whether this device is allowed to receive incoming calls.
meaning: Whether the device may receive incoming calls.

name: isCloudSyncDevice
desc: Indicates whether the device is also managed through HA cloud sync. go/ha-dev-guide
meaning: Whether the device is also managed through Home cloud sync.

name: politeMode
desc: Specify whether polite mode is enabled for this device. See go/pretty-please-dd.
meaning: Whether polite mode is turned on for the device.

name: hotwordThresholdAdjustmentFactor
desc: HotwordThresholdAdjustmentFactor contains threshold_adjustment_factor, and it's validity. TAF is a measure of adjustment applied to the hotword threshold as a result of go/autotune. Currently, this is updated from query_settings_frame, but if we move to updating it from the client, this could also contain TAFs as a result of Hotword Sensitivity, in addition to Autotune.
meaning: How much the device's hotword detection threshold has been tuned, plus whether that adjustment is valid.

name: autoFramingSettings
desc: Auto framing settings associated with a device. See go/auto-framing-presentation.
meaning: Camera auto-framing settings for the device.

name: onDeviceAppSettings
desc: Device specific app related settings.
meaning: App-specific settings stored for this device.

name: kidsMode
desc: Specifies if kids-mode is enabled for the device. See go/aff-parentalsupervision-dd.
meaning: Whether kids mode is turned on for the device.

name: gcmSettings
desc: Stores GCM info associated with a device. See go/quartz-design-doc for more info.
meaning: Push messaging details stored for the device.

name: tetheredInfo
desc: Presence indicates a tethered wearable. go/wearable-device-ids.
meaning: Marks that the device is a wearable tethered to another device.

name: hotwordSensitivity
desc: The level of hotword sensitivity. go/hotword-sensitivity-prd
meaning: How sensitive the device is when listening for the wake word.

name: reauthTrustedDeviceSettings
desc: Trusted device preferences Assistant reauth. go/assistant-reauth-verify-skip.
meaning: Which re-authentication prompts can be skipped on this device.

name: ambientSettings
desc: Ambient settings contains the configuration of Photo Frame on DG device. This field relies on IMAX service to do the update, sync happenes after user updates IMAX device settings or a device registers in CloudCastDevice. So it's more like a cached version instead of definitive source-of-truth. More details at go/ambient-setting-in-assistant-design.
meaning: The device's photo frame configuration, cached from the photos service.

name: hospitalityModeStatus
desc: Indicates whether the device is currently in Hospitality mode. go/hospitality-mode-design. This is moved to a per user setting in assistant settings. ref. go/hospitality-settings-v2
meaning: Whether the device is in hotel or guest mode.

name: personalizationMetadata
desc: Metadata about how personalization settings were configured.
meaning: Notes about how the user's personalization settings were set up.

name: defaultVideoDeviceId
desc: The identification of the default device which user want to output video. Note that, we don't fallback to this for audio playback when default_audio_device_id is not set. See go/default-media-output-design for more info.
meaning: Which device the user wants video played on by default.

name: optInStatus
desc: Specifies if device logs and crashes can be captured during SendFeedback
meaning: Whether device logs and crashes may be collected when feedback is sent.

name: surfaceType
desc: The type of assistant surface. Only use this field when device type is ASSISTANT.
meaning: Which kind of Assistant surface the device is.

name: truncatedLocalNetworkId
desc: Local network ID of the device (truncated to obfuscate devices and households globally). This is a temporary signal to determine proximity of Assistant devices in a house (HGS place).
meaning: A shortened local network id used to tell which devices sit in the same home.

name: vmLastUsedCoarseTimestamp
desc: Coarsened hourly timestamp of when the user was last verified by VoiceMatch on this device. This is used for enforcing VoiceMatch model TTL. go/voicematch-pdd-ttl
meaning: The hour when the user was last verified by Voice Match on this device.

name: ackStatus
desc: LINT.ThenChange(//depot/google3/assistant/ui/assistant_device_settings_ui.proto)
meaning: Has no real description; the text is only a code maintenance note.

name: deviceModelRevision
desc: The Device Platform Service lookup revision. (go/device-model-revision) For 1p devices, and most 3p devices with no custom feature, this should be always 0, which means no lookup needed. For 3p devices with custom assistant feature, this is provided directly by OEM as incremental (e.g. 1, 2, 3, ...)
meaning: Which revision of the device model record should be looked up.

name: notificationProfile
desc: Information about how to send the user a notification. This won't be populated for fb-conv users (allo group chat users).
meaning: How to reach the user with a notification.

name: voiceInputEnabled
desc: A boolean indicates whether voice input (mic-button, hotword, etc) is enabled.
meaning: Whether voice input such as the mic button or hotword is turned on.

name: city
desc: city and postal_code are sent to third party AoG Apps as location when permission is granted for precise or coarse location.
meaning: The device's city, shared with third-party apps when location is allowed.

name: dusi
desc: Only valid for ATV. Stores the android DUSI for the corresponding user. More details: go/auto-logout-on-unlink.
meaning: An Android user identifier stored for Android TV sign-out handling.

name: timeZone
desc: Device time zone. It's mainly used for a one-time notification for new users when they just bought and activated their devices. They may not have used Search or Assistant before, so their timezone info may not available elsewhere when we want to send a notification. This should be used as a fallback only when other timezone sources such as assistant_settings:user_attribute#inferred_user_timezone are not available. Also, when both |time_zone| and |location| are set, the |location| should be prefe
meaning: The device's time zone, used as a fallback when better time zone info is missing.

name: lastCastRegistrationTimestamp
desc: Device's latest registration timestamp provided by Cast side. This field is not necessarily up to date. The update frequency is defined in last_registration_update_frequency_in_days field of AssistantConfig in java/com/google/chrome/dongle/common/proto/home_assistant_config.proto. go/cast-last-registration-time
meaning: When the device was last registered on the Cast side.

name: crossSurfaceAvailability
desc: Availability of this device for Assistant Cross-surface handoffs. (go/assistant-cross-surface)
meaning: Whether this device can receive handoffs from other devices.

name: type
desc: The type of the device. Note: this should only be used for grouping devices for UI presentation purpose. Use |capabilities| to decide what the device can do.
meaning: The device's type, used for grouping devices in the interface.

name: aliasName
desc: The alias names of the device, e.g. my living room tv, tv, living room and etc., which user will usually use to refer to the device in addition to human_friendly_name. It can help speech biasing and query understanding. This field is set by the user and already localized.
meaning: Nicknames the user gave the device, such as living room TV.

name: homeGraphId
desc: The home graph ID that can be used to lookup the corresponding entry in HomeGraph. go/home-graph. Note: when this field is empty, it doesn't necessarily mean that the device is not in home graph. It just means that Assistant doesn't know about the mapping.
meaning: The identifier linking this device to its entry in the home graph.

name: address
desc: A human-readable address string for the location; generally a one-line address such as "34 Masonic Ave, San Francisco CA 94117, United States". Set this field to empty string for deletion, in which case the rest of the location related fields below will be cleared as well.
meaning: A one-line street address for the device's location.

name: internalVersion
desc: Internal version of the DeviceSettings for measurement of the DeviceSettings mutation race conditions. See go/consistent-assistant-settings-update.
meaning: An internal version stamp used to detect conflicting updates to a device's settings.

name: isDeviceActivationCacheEnabled
desc: When true, the user has explicitly allowed audio and visual data collection on this device
meaning: Whether the user allowed audio and visual data collection on this device.

name: capabilities
desc: Describes roughly what a device is capable of doing and metadata around those capabilities. Note: this includes device limitations as well as user configurable settings.
meaning: What the device can do, plus its limits and user-chosen settings.

name: lastKnownClientLocale
desc: Last known locale of the client.
meaning: The last language and region reported by the client.

name: lastParamsWriteTimestamp
desc: This is the timestamp when the AssistantRequestParams (in ASSISTANT_SNAPSHOT corpus) were last written for this device.
meaning: When this device's Assistant request parameters were last written.

name: downtimeSettings
desc: Specification of times that a device shouldn't respond to certain users. See go/home-ft-prd.
meaning: Times when the device should not respond to certain users.

name: featureFilters
desc: Restrictions on features that certain users can access on a device. See go/home-ft-prd.
meaning: Which features certain users are blocked from on the device.

name: enabled
desc: True if downtime should be enabled during this period.
meaning: Whether downtime is turned on for this time period.

name: endTime
desc: Time of day that this downtime period should end. Required. If end_time > start_time, end_time is relative to start_day. Otherwise, end_time is relative to the day after start_day. For example, start_day: MONDAY, start_time: 9 p.m., end_time: 6 a.m. means that the downtime period starts at 9 p.m. on Monday and ends at 6 a.m. on Tuesday.
meaning: The time of day this downtime period ends.

name: startDay
desc: The day of the week when this downtime period starts. Required.
meaning: The day of the week the downtime period begins.

name: startTime
desc: Time of day that this downtime period should start. Required.
meaning: The time of day this downtime period starts.

name: enabled
desc: True if this downtime schedule should be enabled.
meaning: Whether this downtime schedule is turned on.

name: periods
desc: Downtime entries for the days of the week, in no particular order. There can be at most one period defined for each day of the week. Days of the week with no explicit period defined are treated as disabled, so the device is available all day (modulo an end time that may spill over from the previous day).
meaning: The list of downtime periods for each day of the week.

name: allowKnockKnock
desc: True if Duo Knock Kncok feature is enabled on the device.
meaning: Whether the Duo Knock Knock feature is on for the device.

name: shouldBeLinked
desc: Boolean indicating if user has explicitly marked this device to be linked or not. This bit is used in case where unexpected errors occur and we have to check for account/device status and mark the device linked after verification.
meaning: Whether the user asked for this device to be linked to a calling account.

name: state
desc: The call state of the device (i.e. whether a Duo call account has been setup on the device).
meaning: Whether a Duo calling account is set up on the device.

name: talkbackEnabled
desc: Client device settings: settings which are populated by client to give to duocore. TalkBack is an accessibility service that helps blind and vision-impaired users interact with their devices. Indicates whether talkback is enabled for the device. Note: this is per device settings currently filled by client for all users.
meaning: Whether the TalkBack screen reader is turned on for the device.

name: agentId
desc: Agent ID, aka project ID. Used as the AgentDeviceId.agent_id of device when calling Home Graph Service.
meaning: The project id of the agent that owns the smart home device.

name: attributes
desc: See go/ha-dev-guide and HomeGraphItem.attribute in //assistant/verticals/homeautomation/proto/home_graph.proto
meaning: Extra attributes describing the smart home device.

name: deviceId
desc: Device ID, used as AgentDeviceId.device_id of device when calling Home Graph Service.
meaning: The device's id used when calling the Home Graph service.

name: deviceType
desc: HGS device type. See java/com/google/home/graph/service/config/protoconf.pi for the exhaustive list of type strings.
meaning: The smart home category of the device.

name: shouldWriteToHomeGraph
desc: Whether device data should be written to Home Graph via Assistant device_settings. Assistant SDK and Google Home write their devices into Home Graph through AssistantSettingsService, while Home Automation Partner devices (e.g. SmartThings, Philips Hue, Nest, TP-Link, etc.) don't need to be written to Home Graph through AssistantSettingsService. This field decides whether AssistantSettingsService writes devices to Home Graph or not.
meaning: Whether this device's data should be written into Home Graph.

name: supportedTraits
desc: Supported traits of the device. See java/com/google/home/graph/service/config/protoconf.pi for the exhaustive list of trait-strings.
meaning: The smart home capabilities the device supports.

name: supportsDirectResponse
desc: Whether the device supports direct response. See HomeGraphItem.supports_direct_response in //assistant/verticals/homeautomation/proto/home_graph.proto
meaning: Whether the device can answer smart home commands directly.

name: cardConfig
desc: Config for Hospitality UI modules.
meaning: Settings for the hospitality interface cards.

name: showMediaTapGestureTutorial
desc: Toggle media tap gesture tutorial card.
meaning: Whether to show the media tap gesture tutorial card.

name: showPhotoSwipeGestureTutorial
desc: Toggle photo swipe gesture tutorial card.
meaning: Whether to show the photo swipe gesture tutorial card.

name: youtubeCardConfig
desc: Config for YouTube video cards.
meaning: Settings for the YouTube video cards shown on the device.

name: activeActionRequired
desc: Whether the UI module requires user action. If true, the UI module can peek on to the top of Ambient. See SmartDisplayModuleState::ACTIVE_ACTION_REQUIRED.
meaning: Whether the card needs user action and may pop to the top of the screen.

name: dismissable
desc: Whether the UI module is dismissable.
meaning: Whether the user can dismiss the card.

name: effectiveTime
desc: The time that the module is effective and visible to the user. If not set, the module is effective immediately.
meaning: When the card becomes visible to the user.

name: expiryTime
desc: The time that the module is expired and invisible to the user. If not set, the module never expires.
meaning: When the card stops being shown.

name: imageUrl
desc: The image URL for the UI module.
meaning: The image shown on the card.

name: moduleId
desc: Module ID.
meaning: An identifier for the interface card.

name: payloadQuery
desc: Payload query to the partner AoG action when user responds to UI Module, e.g. “Tell the hotel how my stay is going”.
meaning: The query sent to the hotel's app when the user responds to the card.

name: title
desc: Title of the message to be shown to user at the top of the UI Module.
meaning: The headline shown at the top of the card.

name: imageUrl
desc: URL of image to go on card. The URL must be a public link accessible from ZeroState.
meaning: The image shown on the YouTube card.

name: playlistId
desc: ID of YouTube playlist to play on card tap. A playlist is used instead of a single video id to avoid autoplaying related videos. The playlist and the videos it contains must be public or unlisted to be accessible from ZeroState.
meaning: The YouTube playlist that plays when the card is tapped.

name: text
desc: Text on card (i.e., video title).
meaning: The text shown on the YouTube card, usually the video title.

name: aogContextId
desc: List of AOG app context ids that are linked to this device. These apps will have access to the structure information for the device.
meaning: Ids of partner apps allowed to see this device's structure information.

name: aogInvocationPhrase
desc: Invocation phrase for hotel's AoG action. Used for ZS promotion card and "talk to my hotel" rewrites. Setting this to an empty value will mark it unset.
meaning: The phrase used to invoke the hotel's app.

name: deviceClearRequest
desc: The time when we received a request to reset the device.
meaning: When a request to reset the device was received.

name: dialogTtlOverrideMicros
desc: Should the dialog have a shorter ttl. See go/ipp-consumer-prd#heading=h.ibu9b1ysdl4t and go/interpreter-device-clear#bookmark=id.hw8ey1bzjadn for context.
meaning: A shorter lifetime for the conversation on this device.

name: enterpriseId
desc: Identifier for the enterprise which owns the device. Setting this to an empty value will mark it unset.
meaning: Identifier of the business that owns the device.

name: hospitalityModeEnabled
desc: Indicates whether this device is in the hospitality mode.
meaning: Whether the device is in hotel mode.

name: lastDeviceClear
desc: Last time the device was cleared and placed in hospitality mode. Will be set when the switch is toggled on and reset when a guest checks out. On the device this triggers removing alarms, timers, etc.
meaning: When the device was last wiped and put into hotel mode.

name: lastModifiedTimestamp
desc: Indicates when hospitality settings were last updated.
meaning: When the hospitality settings were last changed.

name: lastWelcomed
desc: Last time the welcome message was played for the guest. If last_welcomed < welcome_request, the message should be replayed and this time set.
meaning: When the welcome message was last played for the guest.

name: manualResetRequired
desc: Indicates whether or not the device must be reset manually (by voice or touch), as opposed to being automatically reset. go/hospitality-manual-reset
meaning: Whether the device has to be reset by hand rather than automatically.

name: promotedLanguages
desc: In order promoted languages for interpreter devices. This represents languages by BCP-47 language strings, such as "en", "en-US", "fr", "fr-CA", "sr-Latn", "zh-Hans-CN", "zh-Hant-HK",etc.
meaning: The languages to offer first on interpreter devices.

name: verbalResetSupported
desc: Whether we allow users to initiate clearing the device verbally. We generally allow this for private devices and not for public ones.
meaning: Whether users may clear the device by voice.

name: welcomeRequest
desc: The time when we received a request to welcome the user.
meaning: When a request to welcome the guest was received.

name: displayName
desc: Brand display in the UI
meaning: The brand name shown in the interface.

name: displayNameForLanguage
desc: Brand display in the UI for languages that the enterprise has a localized name that is different from its global branding name. For example, Hilton is 'ヒルトン' in Japanese and '希爾頓' in Chinese. The keys are hospitality supported display locales, e.g. en, ja-JP, etc, defined in experiment parameter Hospitality__hospitality_display_supported_locales.
meaning: Localized versions of the brand name for different languages.

name: isValid
desc: Currently, is_valid is set to false whenever the TAF is not an Autotune aware value. This includes hotword sensitivity users, or devices not eligible for autotune.
meaning: Whether the hotword threshold adjustment came from the automatic tuning system.

name: deviceId
desc: Contains device ids known to devices. eg. For ATV, it contains client_instance_id and cast_id.
meaning: Additional device ids that the device knows about itself.

name: generationTime
desc: Contains the timestamp when this version was generated.
meaning: When this settings version was created.

name: id
desc: Integer value of the version, it is a monotonically increasing number and starts at 0. On every update it is incremented by 1.
meaning: A counter that increases by one each time the settings are updated.

name: obfuscatedGaiaId
desc: Identifier of the account currently specified to be used with kids mode.
meaning: The masked account id used with kids mode.

name: displayName
desc: User-provided name for this schedule.
meaning: The name the user gave this downtime schedule.

name: castLinkingTime
desc: Time of linking of the device with the user provided by Cast.
meaning: When the user was linked to the device by Cast.

name: email
desc: Primary email address of the user.
meaning: The user's main email address.

name: names
desc: Supports features which depend on profile name, when no matching contact is found.
meaning: Profile names for the linked user.

name: confirmed
desc: True if the user has confirmed the marketplace disclosure.
meaning: Whether the user accepted the marketplace disclosure.

name: timestampMs
desc: The time user confirmed the marketplace disclosure.
meaning: When the user accepted the marketplace disclosure.

name: availableProviders
desc: Providers available at the time user updated settings.
meaning: Music providers that existed when the user last changed settings.

name: providerFilterState
desc: Represents the state for the music provider filter.
meaning: The current state of the music provider filter.

name: whitelistedProviders
desc: Contains the list of whitelisted music providers.
meaning: Music providers the user allows.

name: alloNotificationProfile
desc: Each device can have only one type of notification profile.
meaning: The notification profile used for the device.

name: botSendToken
desc: The send token of the conversation with the user.
meaning: A token for sending messages in the user's chat conversation.

name: id
desc: The fireball id of this user.
meaning: The chat platform id of the user.

name: carrierCallDeviceSettings
desc: On device carrier call related settings.
meaning: Settings for phone carrier calling on the device.

name: duoCallDeviceSettings
desc: On device duo call related settings.
meaning: Settings for Duo calling on the device.

name: trustSettingsForClient
desc: Mapping from integrator client id to device's trust settings. Id from assistant/agent_platform/transactions/reauth/reauth_client.proto.
meaning: Trust settings for the device, keyed by partner client id.

name: neverAskAgain
desc: If true, don't ask user to trust this device again.
meaning: Whether to stop asking the user to trust this device.

name: neverAskExpirationTimestamp
desc: DEPRECATED: Use never_ask_again instead. Expiration timestamp of "never ask again" status. If this field is set and is later than current timestamp, we should NOT ask the user whether they'd like to trust this device.
meaning: Deprecated expiry time for the do-not-ask-again setting.

name: trustDeviceExpirationTimestamp
desc: Expiration timestamp of "trusted" status. If this field is set and is later than current timestamp, we can consider this device to be trusted.
meaning: When the device stops counting as trusted.

name: continuedConversationEnabled
desc: Indicates whether Continued Conversation is enabled for this device.
meaning: Whether follow-up questions without the hotword are turned on.

name: deviceModelType
desc: Stores the device model type e.g Pixel.
meaning: The device's model name.

name: dspAvailable
desc: Whether the device has DSP chip to enable always on hotword detection.
meaning: Whether the device has a chip for always-on hotword detection.

name: hotwordInNavigationEnabled
desc: Whether hotword has been enabled by the user during navigation.
meaning: Whether the hotword is turned on while navigating.

name: hotwordSetting
desc: Stores hotword setting status for the locales which don't support voice match.
meaning: The hotword setting for languages that do not support voice match.

name: lockscreenEnabled
desc: Whether pin/pattern lockscreen has been enabled by the user.
meaning: Whether the user set a pin or pattern lock screen.

name: opaEligibilityState
desc: Stores if Assistant is available for the user's device/locale, where Enabled means it is available and disabled means it is not.
meaning: Whether Assistant is available for this device and language.

name: opaEligible
desc: Stores if Assistant is available for the user's device/locale. Deprecated as bools do not give accurate true/false ratios due to old clients reporting the default value.
meaning: Deprecated flag for whether Assistant is available on the device.

name: sdkVersion
desc: Stores the Android SDK version. This comes from android.os.Build.VERSION.SDK_INT.
meaning: The Android SDK version of the device.

name: speakerIdModelPresent
desc: Whether speaker ID model is present for the user.
meaning: Whether a voice recognition model exists for the user.

name: speakerIdRecognitionEnabled
desc: Indicates whether the user has enabled speaker-id (fromAnyScreen/alwaysOn) for this device. Deprecated - use voice_match_setting instead
meaning: Deprecated flag for whether speaker recognition is turned on.

name: trustedVoiceEnabled
desc: Indicates whether the user has enabled trusted voice for this device.
meaning: Whether trusted voice unlocking is turned on.

name: unlockWithHotwordAvailable
desc: A bool indicating whether device supports unlocking device with hotword.
meaning: Whether the device can be unlocked with the hotword.

name: userMigratedToDeclined
desc: Stores if user was migrated from undecided to declined as apart of Mariko project. Used for potential growth targeting.
meaning: Whether the user was switched from undecided to declined in a past migration.

name: voiceMatchSetting
desc: Stores the hotword/voice match setting status for the locales which support voice match.
meaning: The voice match setting for languages that support it.

name: primaryHostDeviceId
desc: The host this wearable is tethered to (e.g. phone). When host is AGSA then this is agsa_client_instance_id. When host is IOPA then this is opa_ios_device_id.
meaning: The id of the phone this wearable is paired with.

name: autoplayToggleState
desc: State that indicates whether autoplay is enabled for youtube videos.
meaning: Whether videos autoplay on the device.

name: availableProviders
desc: Providers available at the time user updated settings.
meaning: Video providers that existed when the user last changed settings.

name: providerFilterState
desc: Represents the state for the video provider filter.
meaning: The current state of the video provider filter.

name: whitelistedProviders
desc: Contains the list of whitelisted video providers.
meaning: Video providers the user allows.

name: jasperWebviewConsent
desc: Indicates if user has consented Jasper warning message.
meaning: Whether the user accepted the web view warning message.

name: signInRequired
desc: Make Google sign-in mandatory for using Google Assistant on the device.
meaning: Whether users must sign in to use Assistant on the device.

name: supportsHotwordSensitivity
desc: Whether the device supports different levels of hotword sensitivity. go/hotword-sensitivity-prd
meaning: Whether the device offers adjustable hotword sensitivity.

name: supportsSimpleStop
