desc: Whether Simple Stop (go/simple-stop) is enabled on the device. Simple stop allows users to stop firing alarms and timers by just saying "stop" without first saying the hotword.
meaning: Whether the user can stop alarms by saying stop without the hotword.

name: supportsSpeakerId
desc: Whether the device supports speaker-id (speaker identification based on hotword and/or spoken query - go/speaker-id). Note: there are existing devices that support speaker-id but does not have this capability set. Not having this field populated doesn't necessarily mean the device doesn't support speaker-id.
meaning: Whether the device can identify who is speaking.

name: supportsWarmWords
desc: Whether the device supports WarmWords (go/warm-words-framework).
meaning: Whether the device supports short command words spoken without the hotword.

name: appCapabilities
desc: IMPORTANT: Only one of AppCapabilities and AppCapabilitiesDelta should be in the SoftwareCapabilities. In the edge case if the client sends up both AppCapabilities and AppCapabilitiesDelta, AppCapabilitiesDelta is ignored. Complete list of app capabilities.
meaning: The full list of what apps on the device can do.

name: appCapabilitiesDelta
desc: Incremental update for app capabilities.
meaning: An incremental update to the device's app capability list.

name: appIntegrationsSettings
desc: App integrations settings for each packge name.
meaning: Integration settings for each app package on the device.

name: carAssistantCapabilities
desc: Capabilities related to Assistant on Auto surfaces.
meaning: What Assistant can do on car surfaces.

name: clockCapabilities
desc: Capabilities related to clock functionality, like alarms, timers, etc.
meaning: What the device can do with alarms and timers.

name: conversationVersion
desc: A top-level version of Conversation protocol where the versions are explicitly defined at go/conversation-versions.
meaning: Which version of the conversation protocol the device speaks.

name: crossDeviceExecutionCapabilities
desc: For torus x-device execution support
meaning: What the device can run on behalf of other devices.

name: liveTvChannelCapabilities
desc: Capabilities related to live TV channels.
meaning: What the device can do with live TV channels.

name: oemCapabilities
desc: List of actions OEM supports. This includes built-in actions and custom actions.
meaning: The actions the device manufacturer supports.

name: onDeviceAssistantCapabilities
desc: on-device Assistant capabilities
meaning: What the on-device Assistant can do without the server.

name: onDeviceSmartHomeCapabilities
desc: Capability bits for on-device Smart Home. go/framework-for-local-semex
meaning: What smart home actions the device can handle locally.

name: onDeviceStorageCapabilities
desc: Reflects the storage capabilities on the device.
meaning: How much storage the device has available.

name: operatingSystem
desc: The operating system of the device.
meaning: The operating system the device runs.

name: orderedLiveTvProviders
desc: An ordered list containing the live tv providers available in the client. The order of the providers reflects the ranking in the client and will be respected by server as well.
meaning: The live TV providers on the device, in the client's preferred order.

name: robinCapabilities
desc: Capabilities of Robin client.
meaning: What the Robin client on the device supports.

name: selinaCapabilities
desc: The Soli capabilities on Elaine. go/dingo-dc-software
meaning: The motion sensing capabilities of the device.

name: dspAvailable
desc: A bool indicating whether device supports dsp based hotword detection.
meaning: Whether the device has a chip for hotword detection.

name: unlockWithHotwordAvailable
desc: A bool indicating whether device supports unlocking device with hotword.
meaning: Whether the device can be unlocked using the hotword.

name: clickImpersonationSupported
desc: Whether client supports user impersonation on suggestion chip click. go/suggestion-click-impersonation
meaning: Whether the client can act as the user when a suggestion chip is tapped.

name: debugDataSupported
desc: Whether client supports suggestions debug data to be displayed.
meaning: Whether the client can display debug information about suggestions.

name: drlHistoryChipSupported
desc: Whether DRL history chip is supported. Related bug:
meaning: Whether the client supports the history suggestion chip.

name: escapeHatchSupported
desc: Whether client supports escape hatches aka post execution suggestions go/nga-escape-hatch-prd
meaning: Whether the client can show follow-up suggestions after an action runs.

name: executedTextSupported
desc: Whether the client can rewrite suggestion query text into executed text, if the latter is present. If this feature is disabled, the rewrite happens in Assistant Server.
meaning: Whether the client can swap a suggestion's text for the wording actually run.

name: executionContextSupported
desc: Whether the client supports passing back
meaning: Whether the client can pass execution context back to the server.

name: featureSpecificActionSupport
desc: Whether the client supports features in |SuggestionFeatureSpecificAction|.
meaning: Which special suggestion actions the client can handle.

name: featureSpecificAppActionsNotificationSupported
desc: Whether the client supports handling App Actions' notification when the suggestion is clicked. This will allow the server to populate the
meaning: Whether the client handles app action notifications when a suggestion is tapped.

name: multiStepTrySayingSupported
desc: Whether the multi-step try saying suggestion feature is supported. dd: go/tng-multi-step-simplified
meaning: Whether the client supports multi-step try saying suggestions.

name: ruleIdInExecutionContextSupported
desc: Whether the rule_id field in the execution_context is supported. This is a temporary workaround to be able to identify clicks on Person entity suggestions on Sabrina and is expected to be eventually deprecated. TODO(b/185517153) : Deprecate (but do not delete) once click tracking is correctly sent up from the Katniss client.
meaning: Whether the client supports the rule id used to track suggestion clicks.

name: showExecutedTextSupported
desc: Whether the client can show executed_text after the click on the suggestion chip. Must be set to false on TNG. TNG disregards |SuggestionProcessingParams.show_executed_text| field and always treats it as if |show_executed_text=true|.
meaning: Whether the client shows the executed wording after a suggestion chip is tapped.

name: showTranslationSupported
desc: Whether the client can show chip as (text | translation). go/lang-partner-doc
meaning: Whether the client can show a chip with its translation next to the text.

name: supportedDisplayTargets
desc: A list of suggestions display targets supported by this client. If unset only DEFAULT SuggestionDisplayTarget is supported.
meaning: The places the client can display suggestions.

name: widgetDataSupported
desc: Whether client supports widget suggestion chip to be displayed.
meaning: Whether the client can display widget suggestion chips.

name: executedTextSupported
desc: Whether the client can rewrite suggestion query text into executed text, if the latter is present for the display target.
meaning: Whether the client can swap suggestion text for executed wording on this display.

name: headerTextSupported
desc: Whether PresentationParams.header_text is supported for the display target.
meaning: Whether the client can show header text for this display target.

name: repressImpressionSupported
desc: Whether Suggestion.repress_impression is supported. If not repressed suggestions are not returned.
meaning: Whether the client can handle suggestions that are held back from display.

name: target
desc: Display target that is supported.
meaning: Which display target is supported.

name: sunriseSimulationSupported
desc: If true, the device can slowly brighten the screen and simulate sunrise experience. Alarms with sunrise field enabled can be set on this device.
meaning: Whether the device can gradually brighten its screen to simulate sunrise.

name: clientOpName
desc: This should be the same as the name of the SemanticClientOp that is supported.
meaning: The name of the client operation the device supports.

name: clientOpProperties
desc: The properties associated with the ClientOp. This proto should be associated with the client_op_name.
meaning: Extra settings attached to a supported client operation.

name: version
desc: A version of 0 is the equivalent to not having support for that client_op type. Note that a client_op is also unsupported if it is not included at all in the list of supported client_ops.
meaning: The version of a client operation supported, where zero means unsupported.

name: supportsPartialFulfillment
desc: ClientOp execution supports special rendering behavior while the user is in the middle of expressing their query. This behavior includes: 1) New partial output always over-writes prior partial output. 2) Canceling the interaction removes partial fulfilment from any user visible interaction history. If this is true, whether to apply the special rendering behavior will be determined by PartialFulfillmentRenderingParams. More details can be found at go/ma-natcon-pf-api.
meaning: Whether the client can render partial results while the user is still speaking.

name: supportsSynchronousExecution
desc: Client can support synchronous execution of the client op. For tts.OUTPUT client op it means that client would honor |synchronous_playback_args| argument. Please see more at go/synchronous-sounds-design.
meaning: Whether the client can run an operation synchronously.

name: supportsConversationProtocol
desc: Whether conversation protocol is supported explicitly. If true, SingleDeviceCapabilityChecker::SupportsConversationProtocol will always return true.
meaning: Whether the device explicitly supports the conversation protocol.

name: version
desc: The supported version number.
meaning: The conversation protocol version number supported.

name: readNotificationSummarizationSupported
desc: Whether the client supports message summarization. Deprecated, use message_summary_support instead.
meaning: Deprecated flag for whether the client can summarize messages.

name: fitnessFeatureSupport
desc: Information about what support this device has for fitness.
meaning: What fitness features the device supports.

name: masqueradeModeSupported
desc: Whether the device supports masquerade mode (go/masquerade).
meaning: Whether the device supports masquerade mode.

name: appControlSupport
desc: The client information for app control support. More details in: go/acaia.
meaning: What app control features the client supports.

name: gearheadNotificationSourceSupported
desc: Whether the client supports the Gearhead message notification source, in which case notification-related operations can access it.
meaning: Whether the client can use the Gearhead car messaging source for notifications.

name: parentalControlsSupported
desc: Whether or not the client supports enabling parental controls. When a device to supports parental controls, it has the software necessary to store the relevant information required for parental controls to work. This information includes a boolean "enabled bit" as well as the obfuscated gaia ID of the kid account selected for use with parental controls. Devices supportings kids mode send this information to S3 via S3ClientInfo in every request. See go/aff-kidsproduct for details.
meaning: Whether the device can store and enforce parental control settings.

name: mediaControlSupport
desc: Information about how client handles media controls (play, pause, skip ...)
meaning: How the client handles media controls such as play, pause and skip.

name: sunriseFeaturesSupport
desc: Whether the client supports the sunrise screen brightening feature before the alarm fires. This is used to indicate whether sunrise alarms can be set on the device.
meaning: Whether the device can brighten the screen before an alarm goes off.

name: shLockScreenSupported
desc: Whether the client supports SmartHome lock screen logic (i.e. on Tangor).
meaning: Whether the client handles smart home actions from the lock screen.

name: fluidActionsSupport
desc: Fluid Actions features supported by the client. If this field is not set in the incoming request, it could mean that the client does not support Fluid Actions. Alternatively, it could mean that the client supports Fluid Actions, but syncs state with server using the old protocol, namely ConversationStateParams. When b/140733618 is resolved, Surface Adaptation Layer will add this field for old clients that support Fluid Actions framework.
meaning: Which Fluid Actions features the client supports.

name: bypassMsgNotificationDismissal
desc: Whether or not Assistant should enforce the dismissal of communication notifications associated with messages.
meaning: Whether Assistant should skip dismissing message notifications.

name: justInTimeSupported
desc: Whether the client supports confirmation flow when a permission is missing. If set to true, the user will be prompted and on confirmation the original flow will continue.
meaning: Whether the client can prompt the user for a missing permission and then continue.

name: sleepSensingSupported
desc: Whether the client can monitor sleep. This allows us to show sleep CUJ related information: go/TwilightDesign Use for development only, see the same field in DeviceCapabilities.SoftwareCapabilities.SelinaCapabilities.
meaning: Whether the device can monitor the user's sleep.

name: mediaSessionDetection
desc: The ability of the client to detect media sessions on the device.
meaning: Whether the client can detect media sessions playing on the device.

name: gdiSupported
desc: Whether account linking via Google Deep Integrations (GDI) is supported. go/opa-gdi-design
meaning: Whether the device can link accounts through Google Deep Integrations.

name: zoomSupported
desc: Whether the client supports joining a Zoom meeting.
meaning: Whether the client can join a Zoom meeting.

name: persistentDisplaySupported
desc: Whether the client supports persistent display. The new feature allows Assistant devices with screen to display a continuously updating permanent display, such as ambient weather, without the need for a user to ask the Assistant. Design doc: go/assistant-persistent-display.
meaning: Whether the screen can show a continuously updating ambient display.

name: alarmTimerManagerApiSupported
desc: Whether the client supports AlarmTimerManager API (go/alarm-timer-manager-api).
meaning: Whether the client supports the alarm and timer manager interface.

name: bypassDiDcCheckForComms
desc: Whether communications flows for the client can bypass the DI/DC check. The client will enforce some other equivalent permission as necessary concerning access to device contacts and apps.
meaning: Whether the client may skip a permission check for contacts and apps in messaging.

name: readMessagesTtsTaperingSupported
desc: Whether the client supports tts tapering for the read messages flow. If set to true the tapered tts variant would be used during the read messages flow.
meaning: Whether spoken message reading can use the shortened, tapered voice style.

name: funtimeSupported
desc: Whether the surface client op performer supports Funtime alarms and timers. go/funtime-engdesign
meaning: Whether the device supports themed alarms and timers.

name: webBrowserSupported
desc: Whether the supports opening a URL in a web browser. For example, we want to disable this for clients like Chirp.
meaning: Whether the client can open a URL in a web browser.

name: mapsDialogsSupported
desc: Whether the client supports Assistant dialogs within Maps. This field will be set only when the Maps on the surface supports Assistant dialogs embedded within Maps. go/gsa-gmm.
meaning: Whether Assistant dialogs can appear inside the Maps app on this device.

name: opaOnSearchSupported
desc: When the entry source is search, whether the client supports rendering a similar response as OPA one does. Entry source is defined at
meaning: Whether the client can render an Assistant-style response when entered from search.

name: isPairedPhoneContactUploadNeededForComms
desc: Whether paired-phone contact upload is needed for communications queries to work (e.g. on AAE).
meaning: Whether contacts must be uploaded from a paired phone for calling and messaging to work.

name: noInputResponseSupported
desc: Whether the client can render no input response or just ignore it. No input response is returned when client has a no speech input interaction, eg. user tapped mic but didn't say anything.
meaning: Whether the client can show a response when the user says nothing after tapping the mic.

name: smartspaceCrossDeviceTimerSupported
desc: Whether the client supports smart space cross-device timers. (go/ss-x-device-timer)
meaning: Whether the client supports timers shared across devices in Smartspace.

name: clientOpResultBatchingSupported
desc: Whether the client can batch client op results before sending them to the server.
meaning: Whether the client can group operation results before sending them.

name: usesSeparateFullViewer
desc: If set, it indicates that the client can open a separate HTML browser/webviewer (full viewer) to display certain visual results. These visual results usually require more memory to render (e.g. high resolution photos). Compared to the regular viewer that display all other Assistant result, the full viewer does not have memory limit. The field is copied from the device model. See
meaning: Whether the client can open a separate full-screen web viewer for heavy visual results.

name: confirmationBeforeReadingMultipleMessagesSupported
desc: Whether the client supports confirmation flow before announcement of multiple messages. If set to true the user will be prompted once and confirmation will be taken before all the messages are announced.
meaning: Whether the client asks once before reading out several messages.

name: messageSummarySupport
desc: The client information for message summary. More details in: go/roadwayrecap-prd
meaning: How the client handles summarizing incoming messages.

name: acpSupport
desc: In what way is assistant continued presence supported. (go/opa-acp-prd)
meaning: How the client supports keeping Assistant present after a response.

name: viewReminderHubPageNotSupported
desc: Whether the client supports viewing of reminder hub page or not. Default is supported. Set to true to disable returning reminder hub page url in reminder responses.
meaning: Whether the client cannot open the reminder hub page.

name: duoGroupCallingSupported
desc: Whether the client supports Duo group calling.
meaning: Whether the client supports group calling.

name: client1mProvidersSupported
desc: Whether the client supports 1m providers (go/1m-partner-expansion).
meaning: Whether the client supports the expanded set of partner providers.

name: hasPhysicalRadio
desc: Whether the client has a physical radio installed.
meaning: Whether the device has a physical radio receiver installed.

name: liveCardsSupported
desc: Whether the surface supports LiveCards. In cases where the user intent flow cannot be completed within the Assistant, LiveCards are used to take the user to an external app or website. These cards will be pushed to the Google Home app via the PushMessage ClientOp.
meaning: Whether the surface can show LiveCards that hand the user off to an app or website.

name: signInMethod
desc: Which kind of sign in the client supports.
meaning: Which kind of sign-in method the client supports.

name: lottieAnimationSupport
desc: Whether the client supports the Lottie animation library for the broadcast feature.
meaning: Whether the client can play Lottie animations for broadcasts.

name: serverGeneratedFeedbackChipsEnabled
desc: Whether the Assistant Server should generate feedback suggestion chips.
meaning: Whether the server should create feedback suggestion chips for this client.

name: transactionFeaturesSupport
desc: Transactions features, supported by the client. Transactions feature may includes how Transactions team want to populate additional information from the device to the server.
meaning: Which transaction and payment features the client supports.

name: tapToReadOptimizationSupported
desc: Whether the client supports faster optimization for tap_to_read feature.
meaning: Whether the client supports the faster path for the tap-to-read feature.

name: remoteCloudCastingEnabled
desc: Whether the client has remote casting enabled. For ex: we want to disable this for clients like Auto.
meaning: Whether casting to remote devices is turned on for this client.

name: crossDeviceBroadcastSupported
desc: Whether the client supports cross-device broadcast (i.e. on Torus).
meaning: Whether the client can broadcast messages to other devices.

name: suggestionsSupport
desc: Suggestion chips features, supported by the client.
meaning: Which suggestion chip features the client can display.

name: crossDeviceBroadcastVersion
desc: The version of cross device broadcast (ie; broadcast on torus) which the client supports.
meaning: Which version of cross-device broadcast the client supports.

name: conversationalCareSupported
desc: Whether the client can render conversational care responses. go/conversational-care
meaning: Whether the client can show conversational care responses.

name: assistantForKidsSupported
desc: Whether Assistant for Kids (a.k.a. Designed for Family) features are supported.
meaning: Whether family-oriented Assistant features work on the client.

name: isPairedPhoneNeededForComms
desc: Whether a Bluetooth-paired phone is a core component of communications flows on the client.
meaning: Whether a Bluetooth-paired phone is required for calling and messaging on this device.

name: csatVisualOverlaySupported
desc: Whether the client supports csat visual overlay. (go/sd-od-csat)
meaning: Whether the client can show the satisfaction survey overlay.

name: transactionsVersion
desc: The version of transactions which the client supports.
meaning: The transactions protocol version the client understands.

name: duoClientApiFeatures
desc: The features set which duo client on the device supports. This should be serialized from proto {@code duo_client_api.DuoClientApiFeatures}.
meaning: The serialized list of Duo calling features the client supports.

name: aaeNotificationSourceSupported
desc: Whether the client supports the alternative message notification sources on AAE, in which case notification-related operations can access it.
meaning: Whether the client supports alternate message notification sources in cars.

name: soliGestureDetectionSupported
desc: Whether or not the client supports gesture detection via soli chips. The reason to prepend the name with soli is to distinguish it from computer vision based methods, e.g. Newman devices.
meaning: Whether the device can detect hand gestures using Soli radar chips.

name: lensSupported
desc: Whether the client has Google Lens (Assistant Eyes).
meaning: Whether the device has Google Lens available.

name: privacyAwareLockscreenSupported
desc: Whether the client supports the privacy-aware lockscreen protocol (go/assistant-lockscreen-spec).
meaning: Whether the client follows the privacy-aware lock screen rules.

name: assistantExploreSupported
desc: Whether the client supports the assistant explore section. This field will be active only when the Explore section is available to the user. This means that the user is (a) signed-in, (b) a IOPA / AGSA user, and (c) in a locale where explore is available.
meaning: Whether the client can show the Assistant explore section.

name: meetSupported
desc: Whether the client supports joining a Google Meet meeting.
meaning: Whether the client can join a Google Meet meeting.

name: launchKeyboardSupported
desc: Which way of launching the keyboard the client supports.
meaning: How the client opens an on-screen keyboard.

name: immersiveCanvasConfirmationMessageSupported
desc: Whether the client supports confirmation messages in Immersive Canvas actions. Deprecated: use the filed in immersive_canvas_support.
meaning: Deprecated flag for showing confirmation messages in Immersive Canvas actions.

name: warmWelcomeTutorialSupported
desc: Whether the client supports the programmatic warm welcome tutorial. Design doc: go/opal-pww-design.
meaning: Whether the client can run the guided first-time welcome tutorial.

name: inDialogAccountLinkingSupported
desc: Whether the client supports account linking in-dialog (askForSignIn). This is used before this feature is moved to conversation protocol. To support this, the client needs to: - Integrate with Google Deep Integrations. - Have logic to send the result of account linking back to AS.
meaning: Whether the client can handle signing in to an account during a conversation.

name: thirdPartyGuiSupported
desc: Whether the device supports the 3p GUI framework, which allows third parties to enter the conversation with the user, showing their logo next to their chat bubbles, etc. go/3p-phone
meaning: Whether the device can show third-party branded chat bubbles in conversation.

name: messageName
desc: The full path of a message which should start from the package name. e.g. "assistant.api.core_types.Timer".
meaning: The full package path name of a protocol message.

name: version
desc: The supported version number.
meaning: The supported version number of a protocol message.

name: prefersGlanceableUi
desc: Indicates if the surface prefers glanceable UI when rendering Assistant response. (see go/mobile-dr-hbird-glanceable-comms-cuj for more context).
meaning: Whether the surface prefers a quick-to-read layout for responses.

name: responseDisplayFormat
desc: If this field is unset, the response format is unknown
meaning: The format in which the surface displays a response.

name: supportsMultiResponse
desc: If true, the client supports receiving multiple responses. See go/multiple-response-in-media-use-cases for more details.
meaning: Whether the client can receive more than one response to a query.

name: supportsClientOpPreloading
desc: Completes the preloading ie., sets up the stage for the execution of client ops on the device while the previous conv delta is being executed. Refer to go/preload-convdelta for more information.
meaning: Whether the client can start preparing operations while the previous ones still run.

name: supportsNonFinalizedResponses
desc: A value of true indicates that the client supports streaming of non-finalized responses by use of ClientExecutionParams.response_stream_id. and ClientExecutionParams.to_be_finalized.
meaning: Whether the client can receive streamed, not-yet-final responses.

name: supportsNonMaterializedInteractions
desc: If true, the client supports receiving non-materialized interactions (go/as-streaming-protocol-nm).
meaning: Whether the client can receive interactions that have not been fully built out.

name: notificationCapabilities
desc: Specifies whether the surface is able to display notifications.
meaning: Whether the surface is able to display notifications.

name: categoryId
desc: Notification channel type.
meaning: The numeric identifier of a notification category.

name: disabled
desc: Weather the notifications on this channel are disabled.
meaning: Whether notifications on this channel are turned off.

name: channelType
desc: Notification channel type.
meaning: The type of notification channel.

name: enabled
desc: Whether the notifications on this channel are enabled.
meaning: Whether notifications on this channel are turned on.

name: deviceActionCapability
desc: DeviceActionCapability from DeviceModelPackage.
meaning: The set of device actions this device model declares it can perform.

name: projectConfigs
desc: List of Action project capabilities.
meaning: The list of third-party project capabilities registered for the device.

name: projectId
desc: Google cloud project id for which the Action Package or Device Model is registered.
meaning: The Google Cloud project id the device model or action package is registered under.

name: dataSharingRestrictions
desc: Restrictions for the device to share any data with third party apps. See details in go/atv-dsc.
meaning: Rules limiting what device data can be shared with third-party apps.

name: hour
desc: The hour, in 0...23.
meaning: The hour of day, from 0 to 23.

name: minute
desc: The minute, in 0...59.
meaning: The minute of the hour, from 0 to 59.

name: nanosecond
desc: The fraction of seconds in nanoseconds, in 0..999999999.
meaning: The fractional part of a second, in nanoseconds.

name: second
desc: The second, in 0...59. Leap seconds are not supported.
meaning: The second of the minute, from 0 to 59.

name: ianaId
desc: Time zone in IANA format, e.g. America/Los_Angeles for USA Pacific Time.
meaning: The time zone name in standard IANA form, such as America/Los_Angeles.

name: nanos
desc: Non-negative fractions of a second at nanosecond resolution.
meaning: The fractional part of a timestamp, in nanoseconds.

name: seconds
desc: Seconds of UTC time since the Unix epoch.
meaning: The number of seconds since the Unix epoch.

name: voicePinSuppressed
desc: If true, setting this boolean means the device should not support voice PIN. For example, although the phone supports both voice and PIN pad, but we don't want users using voice.
meaning: Whether the device should be blocked from accepting a spoken PIN.

name: defaultVolumePercentage
desc: The volume percentages for spelled out values.
meaning: The default volume percentage used for spoken volume levels.

name: levelStepSize
desc: The number of levels to move for a step.
meaning: How many volume levels one step moves.

name: maximumVolumeLevel
desc: The max number of volume levels the client supports.
meaning: The highest volume level the client supports.

name: maxSupportedAlarms
desc: Maximum number of alarms that can be created on the client. Zero or unset indicates no maximum limit.
meaning: The largest number of alarms that can exist on the device.

name: restrictAlarmsToNextDay
desc: Whether the client restricts alarms to ring within the next 24 hours.
meaning: Whether alarms on this device must ring within the next 24 hours.

name: supportsGenericMutations
desc: Whether the client supports mutation of any alarm attribute such as time_pattern, recurrence_pattern, etc through the MUTATE action. If this is false, MUTATE may only be used to disable or dismiss an alarm. This field is true by default for backwards-compatibility; clients which don't support mutation outside of Disable/DismissAlarm should explicitly set this to false.
meaning: Whether the client can change any attribute of an existing alarm.

name: supportsStopAction
desc: Whether the client supports the STOP alarm action. If this is false, stop actions will be represented by the MUTATE action, and the device may need to check alarm state to determine if there's a firing alarm that needs to be dismissed.
meaning: Whether the client supports a dedicated stop action for alarms.

name: cloudEndpoints
desc: The list of CloudEndpoints supported by this Device Model. Note that each should have a unique |name|. If any cloud endpoints are provided here, then the first one in the list will be used by default for all Cloud Execution. An Intent may override the default by providing an |execution_config|.
meaning: The list of cloud endpoints this device model can call.

name: name
desc: The name for this cloud endpoint. It's unique per Locale. This is not an API resource name. Ex: sample-nlu-endpoint
meaning: The name given to a cloud endpoint.

name: scopes
desc: The list of scopes to be provided in the OAuth2 token. They must be a subset of the scopes registered in the Account Linking flow, or the request will fail. If the client itself provides the token, then this field is ignored.
meaning: The OAuth permission scopes requested for a cloud endpoint token.

name: url
desc: The URL for this endpoint, it must start with https.
meaning: The HTTPS address of a cloud endpoint.

name: assistantDeviceInRoomOptOut
desc: Integrate your device with Google's Smart Home solution by putting your device into Google's Home Graph, a database that stores and provides contextual data about the home and its devices. For example, Home Graph can store the concept of a living room that contains multiple types of devices, when you say "turn on the light" to a device, if you have light in the living room, that light will be turned on.
meaning: Whether the device opts out of being placed in a room in the Home Graph.

name: builtInIntentMode
desc: Specifies behavior for built-in device actions for this device model. If not specified, defaults to ENABLE_CONFIGURED_INTENTS_ONLY.
meaning: Which built-in device actions are enabled for this device model.

name: customIntentMode
desc: Specifies which custom device actions should be enabled for this device model. This will only affect the behavior of intents corresponding to those from the Action Package of this project. If not specified, defaults to ENABLE_ALL.
meaning: Which custom device actions are enabled for this device model.

name: defaultExecutionConfig
desc: Default instructions for routing of any Intent. The data here could be overridden for specific Intents if provided directly in the 'intents' field.
meaning: The default routing instructions used for any intent on this device.

name: inlinedActionCapability
desc: Specifies capabilities for device actions that are inlined in the google.assistant.embedded.v1.DeviceAction message.
meaning: The capabilities for device actions carried inline in the device action message.

name: intents
desc: Intent configurations. Built-in and custom intents may be configured here. Note that built-in intents will always behave with IntentMode of ENABLE_CONFIGURED_INTENTS_ONLY. The IntentMode for custom intents can be changed using the custom_intent_mode. To configure an intent, list it here with its intent name, e.g. "MY_CUSTOM_INTENT", "google.assistant.car.model.capabilities.AC_TEMPERATURE".
meaning: The list of configured intents the device model can handle.

name: providedData
desc: Provided data which augments the device action capabilities. Some built-in intents may require additional configuration to be provided. One example could be the list of channels available for the
meaning: Extra configuration data supplied to support certain device actions.

name: traits
desc: List of built-in traits such as "action.devices.traits.OnOff" See java/com/google/home/graph/service/config/protoconf.pi As of Nov. 2017, we also support custom traits for EAP users. We'll eventually disable custom traits once custom actions are in place.
meaning: The list of smart home traits, such as on/off, that the device supports.

name: understandingConfig
desc: Specifies the format how Google routes queries to 3P cloud. By default, this field is unset, all partners should get shallow NLU. This is needed
meaning: How queries are formatted when routed to a third-party cloud service.

name: cloudEndpointName
desc: Instructions for performing a cloud execution request for the Intent when the execution_type is set to CLOUD. If non-empty, then the device execution would be routed to the CloudEndpoint specified by this name. The Account Linking exchange may be performed to fetch the OAuth access token, and the access token will be included in the HTTP header.
meaning: Which named cloud endpoint an intent's execution is routed to.

name: cloudIntentTranslationDisabled
desc: If this field is set, then the Syndication cloud call will be disabled for this intent. Note this only applies if any Syndication cloud endpoint is associated with the Device Model, otherwise setting this field does nothing. By default, all Intents that are enabled and supported by the Syndication API will be routed through the Syndication cloud endpoint if it's provided.
meaning: Whether the syndication cloud call is turned off for this intent.

name: intentCommandFormat
desc: Specifies the intent command format for this Action. For example, in order to launch an Android intent instead of receiving the device action payload on the client, then this field can be set with "intent:/#Intent;...;my_extra={$.params.channels[0].channelCode};end" The parameter "{$.params.channels[0].channelCode}" is in JSON path format, and will be replaced with the content from the original device action payload. Thus, with # JSON "execution": [ { "command&
meaning: The command template used to launch this action, such as an Android intent string.

name: localDisabled
desc: If this field is set, then local execution capability is disabled for all matching intents.
meaning: Whether running this action on the device itself is turned off.

name: localExecutionType
desc: Specifies how to execute this Action when it is invoked locally (from the same device.)
meaning: How the action runs when triggered from the same device.

name: remoteDisabled
desc: If this field is set, then remote execution capability is disabled for all matching intents.
meaning: Whether running this action from another device is turned off.

name: remoteExecutionType
desc: Specifies how to execute this Action when it is invoked remotely (from a different device.)
meaning: How the action runs when triggered from a different device.

name: alarm
desc: Specifies capabilities for handling on-device alarms. The presence of this field, even if empty, implies that the device supports alarms.
meaning: The device's alarm handling capabilities.

name: responseLimits
desc: Specifies the size limits on responses. If message is not defined then no limits exist.
meaning: The size limits the device places on responses.

name: supportSdkExecute
desc: Whether this device model package support sdk.EXECUTE client_op (a.k.a action.devices.EXECUTE intent), which will be filled into google.assistant.embedded.v1.DeviceAction.device_request_json. It is default to true (and not public), since all 3P will depends on the device_request_json. Only internal projects like Edoras will set this to false.
meaning: Whether the device model supports the SDK execute operation for smart home actions.

name: supportedDeviceOps
desc: Specifies capabilities for handling assistant.embedded.v1.DeviceOp.
meaning: Which device operations the client can carry out.

name: supportsMultiResponse
desc: Specifies whether server can send a series of responses for a single query. Example: Routines where multiple actions to be executed one after another.
meaning: Whether the server may send several responses for one query.

name: timer
desc: Specifies capabilities for handling on-device timers. The presence of this field, even if empty, implies that the device supports timers.
meaning: The device's timer handling capabilities.

name: ttsOutput
desc: Specifies whether client supports receiving
meaning: The device's text-to-speech output capabilities.

name: argSpecs
desc: List of arguments associated this intent. Each of which depends a template for the expected argument.
meaning: The named arguments an intent expects and their templates.

name: executionConfig
desc: Instructions for the routing of this Intent.
meaning: The routing instructions for this intent.

name: name
desc: The name of the intent.
meaning: The name of the intent.

name: providedDataNames
desc: List of provided data names used by this intent. Note that some built-in intents will not function properly without provided data, such as
meaning: The names of extra data sets this intent relies on.

name: securityConfig
desc: Security configuration for this Intent.
meaning: The security settings applied to this intent.

name: triggerConditions
desc: The conditions which must be met by the device before executing this Intent. More than one can be provided, in which case the conditions operate with the "AND" operator, i.e. the first condition which is failed will be used to restrict the execution of this Intent.
meaning: Device state conditions that must all hold before this intent runs.

name: allowedAssistantSdkAuthProjectIds
desc: When using the Assistant SDK (Embedded Assistant API), the project id used to authenticate the gRPC request is checked and must match against the project id of the Device Model. We will additionally allow the project ids listed in the device model here to be let through. See
meaning: Extra cloud project ids allowed to authenticate Assistant SDK requests for this model.

name: appCapabilitiesFromDeviceInstallApps
desc: Load the assistant.api.AppCapabilities from DEVICE_INSTALLED_APP footprint corpus. See go/edoras-geller.
meaning: Whether app capabilities are loaded from the installed-apps record for the device.

name: cloudDeviceActionEndpoint
desc: Uses this endpoint for device action fulfillment when there's no endpoint in syndication_metadata. 1p surfaces/devices such as telephone can enable this for its cloud action fulfillment without enabling the whole syndication experience.
meaning: The cloud endpoint used for device action fulfillment when none is otherwise set.

name: deviceActionsEligibleForHighConfidence
desc: Signals that the model will have updated ranking behavior as described in
meaning: Whether this device model uses the updated device action ranking behavior.

name: forceSignIn
desc: Make Google sign-in mandatory for using Google Assistant on the device. (This bit is initially added for Samsung TV.)
meaning: Whether signing in to Google is required to use Assistant on the device.

name: forceThirdPartyDeviceIdForDeviceLookup
desc: When looking up device (for example for disclosure consent check), then always use the third party device id for lookup instead of any other device id which would normally have higher precedence, such as cast_device_id.
meaning: Whether device lookup must always use the third-party device id.

name: forceTransactionsAuthentication
desc: Adds "transactions.AUTHENTICATION" for car automation probers. Since the probers run as Assistant SDK requests, voice match always fails for car automation requests, so we add this client op as a hack to allow probers to appear as personal devices and bypass voice match. See b/137221645.
meaning: Whether an authentication client op is forced on for car automation test traffic.

name: hasCustomSearchResultsRendering
desc: Signals that this device can "render" raw search results even with no screen (e.g., using a text reader). If this is true, fallback search results can be returned as a custom device action in a SearchResults message.
meaning: Whether the device can present raw search results, for example by reading them aloud.

name: overrideProjectIdForDeviceLookup
desc: When looking up device (for example for disclosure consent check), use this project id as part of the primary key for the device lookup (i.e. instead of the device_config.agent_id.) The precedence is as follows: 1) this field, if set for the device's device model 2) device_config.agent_id 3) device_model.project_id
meaning: A project id that overrides the normal key used to look up the device.

name: telephoneAttribution
desc: Telephone server is able to send attribution to user feature phone. See go/telephone-attribution.
meaning: Whether the telephone server can send attribution to a feature phone.

name: maxAssistResponseSizeBytes
desc: Max size in bytes of the total serialized AssistResponse receivable by the client. If response exceeds this max, response may be modified by the server.
meaning: The largest total response size in bytes the client can receive.

name: maxDisplayLinesBytes
desc: Maximum size in bytes (not characters) of text the display can handle (which may be different from how much the display can show at a time due to scrolling).
meaning: The largest amount of display text in bytes the client can handle.

name: maxSuggestionChipBytes
desc: Maximum size in bytes (not characters) for each suggestion chip.
meaning: The largest size in bytes of a single suggestion chip.

name: maxSuggestionChips
desc: Maximum number of suggestion chips the device can handle to display.
meaning: The largest number of suggestion chips the device can display.

name: authMechanismForRemoteRequests
desc: Specifies auth mechanism to be used upon remote request for device action.
meaning: The authentication method required for device actions requested from another device.

name: callCall
desc: |call_call| specifies the support for the call.CALL clientop, and the corresponding call_call field in assistant.embedded.v1.DeviceOp.
meaning: Whether the client supports the place-a-call device operation.

name: clientReconnect
desc: |client_reconnect| indicates support for client.RECONNECT using assistant.embedded.v1.DeviceOp. There is an alternative API/capability for client.RECONNECT specified in RoutineCapability.supports_reconnect. Client should choose between this and RoutineCapability but not both.
meaning: Whether the client supports the reconnect device operation.

name: coreDismissAssistant
desc: [core_dismiss_assistant] specifies the support for core.DISMISS_ASSISTANT client_op and the corresponding core_dismiss_assistant field in assistant.embedded.v1.DeviceOp.
meaning: Whether the client supports the dismiss-Assistant device operation.

name: deviceModifySetting
desc: |device_modify_setting| specifies the support for device.MODIFY_SETTING client_op, and the corresponding device_modify_setting field in assistant.embedded.v1.DeviceOp.
meaning: Whether the client supports the change-device-setting operation.

name: deviceTakePhoto
desc: [device_take_photo] specifies the support for the device.TAKE_PHOTO clientop, and the corresponding device_take_photo field in assistant.embedded.v1.DeviceOp.
meaning: Whether the client supports the take-photo device operation.

name: executionWait
desc: |execution_wait| specifies the support for execution.WAIT client_op, and the corresponding execution_wait field in assistant.embedded.v1.DeviceOp.
meaning: Whether the client supports the wait device operation.

name: getHealthObservation
desc: |get_health_observation| specifies the support for get_health_observation client_op, and the corresponding get_health_observation field in assistant.embedded.v1.DeviceOp.
meaning: Whether the client supports the get-health-observation operation.

name: providerFulfill
desc: |provider_fulfill| specifies the support for provider.FULFILL client_op, and the corresponding provider_fulfill field in assistant.embedded.v1.DeviceOp.
meaning: Whether the client supports the provider fulfill operation.

name: providerOpen
desc: |provider_open| specifies the support for provider.OPEN client_op, and the corresponding provider_open field in assistant.embedded.v1.DeviceOp.
meaning: Whether the client supports the provider open operation.

name: sendChatMessage
desc: |send_chat_message| specifies the support for the chat_message.SEND clientop, and the corresponding send_chat_message field in assistant.embedded.v1.DeviceOp.
meaning: Whether the client supports the send-chat-message operation.

name: uiShowInterpreter
desc: |ui_show_interpreter| specifies the support for ui.SHOW_INTERPRETER client_op, and the corresponding ui_show_interpreter field in assistant.embedded.v1.DeviceOp.
meaning: Whether the client supports the show-interpreter operation.

name: maxSupportedExtendedTimerDuration
desc: Maximum extended timer duration supported by the client. The extended timer duration is the total start-to-finish duration after an AddTimeToTimer operation. E.g. if a user sets a timer for 30 minutes, and later adds 10 minutes, the extended duration is 40 minutes. Zero or unset indicates no maximum limit.
meaning: The longest total timer length allowed after time has been added to it.

name: maxSupportedTimerDuration
desc: Maximum timer duration supported by the client. Zero or unset indicates no maximum limit.
meaning: The longest timer duration the client supports.

name: maxSupportedTimers
desc: Maximum number of timers that can be created on the client. Zero or unset indicates no maximum limit.
meaning: The largest number of timers that can exist on the client.

name: supportsMutateAction
desc: Whether the client supports the MUTATE timer action. If this is false, mutate operations may be handled by sending a pair of REMOVE and CREATE timer actions to replace the existing timer instead of mutating it.
meaning: Whether the client can change an existing timer rather than replacing it.

name: requiredStateValues
desc: The map of state keys along with their values which must be returned by the device, for example to start the dishwasher you may require states: {"door": "CLOSED", "detergent_status": "READY"}.
meaning: Device state values that must be present before an action can run.

name: simpleTts
desc: A simple TTS to play.
meaning: A short spoken message to play.

name: status
desc: Refers to a defined ConditionalResult keyed by its status. It could be a built-in or custom ConditionalResult for this Intent. Note: the states provided by the device MUST contain all of the states required by the ConditionalResult.
meaning: The status name of a predefined conditional result for an intent.

name: supportsStructuredTts
desc: Specifies whether client supports out-of-band TTS synthesis. When this is enabled, client could receive TTS request message in
meaning: Whether the client can receive text-to-speech requests to synthesize separately.

name: nluLevel
desc: Specifies the NLU level for the intent.
meaning: How much language understanding is applied to the intent.

name: streams
desc: All active media streams while the user issues the query.
meaning: A log of all media streams playing when the user made the request.

name: targetStream
desc: The stream selected by stream transfer logic to be transferred to another device. It will be empty for other features. Target_stream is different from target_device since target_stream could have multiple devices.
meaning: A log of the media stream chosen to be moved to another device.

name: ambiguousDeviceIndex
desc: Device index of the initial ambiguous devices. The device index in this message is consistent with the device index in DeviceInfoLog. It would be used to track more detailed information of a device if needed.
meaning: Log indexes of the devices that were initially ambiguous targets.

name: devicesAfterPromoters
desc: DeviceInfo for devices after the filters and promoters. - When device targeting is only configured for single target, these are ambiguous devices that would have been the output of Lumos. Downstream may perform extra check before disambiguation dialog. For example, Media Initiation checks playability for devices. The output here is before the check. - When configured for multi-target, these are just the target devices. For privacy consideration, we may only log device id field inside.
meaning: Log of the candidate devices remaining after filtering and promotion.

name: finalTargetDevice
desc: the final targeted device selected by playability filter or DeviceSelectionDialog
meaning: Log of the device finally chosen as the target.

name: playabilityFilteredDevicesIndex
desc: Device index of the devices after playability filter
meaning: Log indexes of devices remaining after the playability filter.

name: puntInfoLog
desc: When there is no qualified devices after playability check, it would populate punt_info below. If all devices are filtered out for the same reason, there would only be one item. Otherwise, there will be multiple items.
meaning: Log of why no device qualified after the playability check.

name: structureFilteredDeviceIndex
desc: Device index of the devices after structure filter
meaning: Log indexes of devices remaining after the structure filter.

name: deviceIndex
desc: Index of devices that have the same punt info during playability check, i.e. same media_excuse and provider_mid.
meaning: Log indexes of devices sharing the same reason for being ruled out.

name: mediaExcuse
desc: Excuse for media action triggering. See: assistant/verticals/media/proto/media_excuse.proto.
meaning: A code explaining why a media action could not be triggered.

name: providerMid
desc: Provider id that the excuse belongs to. This is the KG MID of the provider, e.g., "/m/09jcvs" for Youtube.
meaning: The knowledge graph id of the media provider the excuse belongs to.

name: localNetworkIdDiff
desc: The diff between AvailableDevice and CTF for the local network ID of the device.
meaning: Logged difference in the device's local network id between two context sources.

name: locationFeatureDiff
desc: The diff between AvailableDevice and CTF for the feature proto of the location of the device.
meaning: Logged difference in the device's location data between two context sources.

name: rawContactInfo
desc: This list provides account information from the raw contact which is the source of this field.
meaning: Logged account details of the raw phone contact behind a device contact.

name: accountProvenance
desc: Google AccountProvenance of the contact.
meaning: Logged origin of the Google account a contact came from.

name: commonNameAliasConfidence
desc: Populated if matched_name_type is GIVEN_NAME_ALIAS or FULL_NAME_ALIAS.
meaning: Logged confidence that a nickname matched a contact's name.

name: conceptId
desc: Concept id for relationships in English, e.g. "Mother" for all non-English locales. It's only populated for source = RELATIONSHIP.
meaning: Logged English concept id for a family relationship such as mother.

name: deviceContactAttributes
desc: Integer value corresponding to DeviceContactExtraMetadata.Attribute enum.
meaning: Logged numeric attributes attached to a device contact.

name: emailIdCount
desc: # emails stored for the contact.
meaning: Logged count of email addresses stored for a contact.

name: fuzzyNgramMatch
desc: Populate only if ContactRecognitionAlternate.Source is 'FUZZY_CONTACT_MATCH'.
meaning: Logged details of a fuzzy text match against a contact name.

name: gaiaId
desc: Contact owner's gaia id from cs/symbol::symbol:quality_qrewrite.PersonalContactData.shared_contact_owner_gaia_id. Only populated for is_shared = true and non sign-out mode and user is not the owner of the contact(shared contact from other user). This field is not being logged in P2.
meaning: Logged account id of the owner of a shared contact.

name: isContactFromSecondaryAccount
desc: Boolean value indicating whether selected contact is from different account than the logged in account.
meaning: Logged flag for whether the contact came from a non-primary account.

name: isExactMatch
desc: If the contact is matched exactly from the query name.
meaning: Logged flag for whether the contact name matched the query exactly.

name: isShared
desc: If this is a shared contact. This is true in 2 cases: - User is calling their own contacts that have been marked as shared. - User is calling shared contacts from some other user's contact list. This field is not being logged in P2.
meaning: Logged flag for whether the contact is shared with or by another user.

name: isTransliteratedMatch
desc: Indicate the contact matches the transliterated query.
meaning: Logged flag for whether the contact matched a transliterated version of the query.

name: isVanityContact
desc: True if the contact is a vanity contact(has email = user's email address).
meaning: Logged flag for whether the contact is the user's own entry.

name: isVisibleToGuestsRelationship
desc: If the lookup was done using relationship which is visible to guests. This value will only be set if lookup was done using relationship. E.g. user has a guest relationship (doctor) -> (John) And user says "call doctor", then this value will be true.
meaning: Logged flag for whether the contact was found through a guest-visible relationship.

name: matchedNameType
desc: The matched name type of a contact candidate.
meaning: Logged type of contact name that was matched.

name: matchedRecognitionAlternateName
desc: Alternate recognition term which was used to match this contact.
meaning: Logged alternate speech transcription that matched the contact.

name: matchedStarlightLookupName
desc: Ngram matched by starlight lookup for fuzzy matching in fulfillment. We need this to analyze how many contacts are returned by starlight lookup that is not matched by fuzzy matching. For example, "Komal Dear" is matched to "Komal Dr" by fuzzy match. When doing starlight lookup, "Komal" and "Dr" will be looked up separately. So "Dr xxx" will also be returned. We want to see how often this happens.
meaning: Logged name fragments matched during contact lookup.

name: metadata
desc: PersonMetadata of the selected contact.
meaning: Logged metadata about the contact that was chosen.

name: nameMatchedContactIndex
desc: The indices of the contact in |candidate_contact| whose name matches the |selected_contact_data|. |candidate_contact|:
meaning: Logged positions of candidate contacts whose names matched.

name: originalQueryName
desc: The original name in the query as transcribed by ASR.
meaning: Logged name exactly as speech recognition transcribed it from the query.

name: phone
desc: Information regarding the phone endpoints of the selected contact. Currently it is only logged for selected candidate.
meaning: Logged phone number details for the chosen contact.

name: phoneNumberCount
desc: # phone_numbers stored for the contact.
meaning: Logged count of phone numbers stored for a contact.

name: pkgReferenceType
desc: Encodes if pkg_person was resolved via a name or relationship reference.
meaning: Logged flag for whether a person was found by name or by relationship.

name: recognitionAlternateScore
desc: Populate only if ContactRecognitionAlternate.Source is not NONE.
meaning: Logged score of an alternate speech recognition match for a contact.

name: recognitionAlternateSource
desc: Recognition alternative source type. If not none, then it indicates the personal contact data is alternative and how the alternative is fulfilled.
meaning: Logged source of the alternate speech recognition used for a contact.

name: relationshipMemoryCount
desc: The number of resolved relationship names and contact pointers from Assistant Memory.
meaning: Logged count of relationships remembered by Assistant for the user.

name: selectedPhone
desc: Information regarding the selected phone endpoint. Currently it is only logged for selected candidate.
meaning: Logged details of the phone number actually chosen for the call.

name: shortcutContactInfo
desc: Shortcut information of the contact.
meaning: Logged shortcut information stored for the contact.

name: source
desc: The contact source of a contact candidate.
meaning: Logged source that a contact candidate came from.

name: systemContactGroupId
desc: Integer value corresponding to SystemContactGroup enum.
meaning: Logged numeric ids of the system contact groups a contact belongs to.

name: whatsappPhoneNumberCount
desc: DEPRECATED. Use phone instead. Used before 2020-01-13. Number of phone numbers annotated with Whatsapp.
meaning: Deprecated logged count of phone numbers marked as WhatsApp numbers.

name: rawDeviceContactInfo
desc: This list provides account information from the raw contact which is the source of this field.
meaning: Logged account details of the raw contact behind a phone number.

name: type
desc: Label for phone number in the Contacts app. It can have standard values provided by the app e.g. MOBILE, HOME, WORK etc, but users are allowed to modify. So essentially it becomes user content.
meaning: Logged label for a phone number, such as mobile, home or work.

name: accountType
desc: Account type of raw contact, e.g. "com.google" or "com.linkedin.android".
meaning: Logged account type of a raw phone contact, such as com.google.

name: nearbyDefaultDevices
desc: Default settings of nearby devices.
meaning: Logged default settings for devices near the user.

name: deviceIdLog
desc: The identification of the device. The logging version of the full DeviceId.
meaning: Logged identifiers of a device referred to in the request.

name: rawTextFromQuery
desc: The raw text mentioning a device from the query, such as "any tv".
meaning: Logged raw wording the user used to refer to a device.

name: type
desc: The annotation type mentioned in the query.
meaning: Logged type of device reference found in the request.

name: userDefinedName
desc: The matched device name set by the user, such as "big screen tv".
meaning: Logged user-chosen device name that matched the request.

name: arbitrationDeviceId
desc: Device identifier string for the current device used in the arbitration service.
meaning: Logged device identifier used by the arbitration service.

name: availableDeviceAndCtfContextDiff
desc: A list of diffs for the device's context between AvailableDevice and CTF.
meaning: Logged differences between two sources of context about a device.

name: deviceId
desc: The identification of the device. DeviceId (go/as-device-id) has multiple fields. To consloidate it to a single to make dremel easier, we use the string obtained by calling go/get-device-id.
meaning: Logged single-string identifier for a device.

name: deviceIdLog
desc: The identification of the device. The logging version of the full DeviceId.
meaning: Logged full structured identifier for a device.

name: deviceIndex
desc: We index linked devices and log these index to avoid logging device_id. device_index should always be a positive number or -1. -1 means this device is not in homegraph.
meaning: Logged index number standing in for a device id.

name: deviceModelId
desc: This is the device_model_id field in device_settings proto. It has the same value for the same type of devices. e.g. Sonos.Sonos One.S13
meaning: Identifier for the model of an Assistant device, shared by all devices of that type.

name: distance
desc: LINT.ThenChange(//depot/google3/assistant/context/proto/device_arbitration.proto:EstimatedRelativeDistance)
meaning: A pointer to a related proto definition for device distance; the description carries no real content.

name: eliminatingLumosProcessor
desc: The lumos processor which eliminated this device, if applicable
meaning: Name of the Assistant device-picking step that ruled this device out.

name: homeStructureId
desc: The home structure id of the device.
meaning: Identifier of the home a device belongs to.

name: isTethered
desc: This flag indicates this is a non-local device that is tethered to local/originating device. Tethered device is a special case of is_remote and typically used in wearable scenarios. This is always false for local device and when it is true, it implies is_remote is also true.
meaning: Whether the device is tethered to another device, as with a wearable.

name: name
desc: User defined device name
meaning: The name the user gave the device.

name: sessions
desc: This field should be populated only when there is at least one session on this device.
meaning: List of media sessions currently running on the device.

name: surfaceType
desc: This field should be populated only when the device is an Assistant device.
meaning: What kind of Assistant surface the device is.

name: mediaType
desc: The type of the media session. If provider does not report this field, we ## compute it by mapping provider type to media type. Here is the mapping: |ProviderType |MediaItemMetadata.Type| |-------------------------------------- |MUSIC |TRACK | |VIDEO |VIDEO | |LIVE_TV |TV_CHANNEL | |AUDIOBOOK |AUDIO_BOOK | |PODCAST |PODCAST_EPISODE | ## |LIVE_STREAMING|VIDEO |
meaning: The kind of media in a session, such as track, video, or podcast.

name: playbackState
desc: The playback states of the session.
meaning: Whether the media session is playing, paused, or otherwise.

name: providerMid
desc: The KG mid of the media provider.
meaning: Knowledge Graph identifier of the media provider.

name: allDefaultDevices
desc: Default settings of all nearby devices Deprecated, use default_devices_log instead.
meaning: Deprecated log of default settings for nearby devices.

name: allMediaStreamLog
desc: Logs all active media sessions.
meaning: Log of all active media sessions.

name: availableDevicesLog
desc: The list of
meaning: Log of the devices available to be targeted.

name: counterfactualDeviceSelectionLog
desc: DeviceSelectionLog for counterfactual logging.
meaning: A duplicate device selection log kept for counterfactual analysis.

name: defaultDevices
desc: Include default tv and default speaker Deprecated, use all_default_devices below.
meaning: Deprecated record of the default TV and speaker.

name: devicesStr
desc: Temporaray field for debugging ANDROID_AUTO multi_target_devices punt. This will be removed once we identify the root cause.
meaning: Temporary debugging list of devices for an Android Auto issue.

name: localDevice
desc: Now we just log the media sessions on local device Deprecated, use NearbyDevicesLog::LocalDevice instead.
meaning: Deprecated record of the local device and its media sessions.

name: logDataSource
desc: Indicates which library populated the device_selection_log for this query.
meaning: Which library filled in the device selection log for this query.

name: mediaFocus
desc: The Media Focus information. This field should be populated only when there is a Media Focus. Deprecated, use media_focuses below instead.
meaning: Deprecated record of which device currently has media focus.

name: mediaFocusesLog
desc: Media focuses on all devices.
meaning: Record of media focus across all devices.

name: nearbyDevicesLog
desc: All nearby devices and local device.
meaning: Record of the local device and all nearby devices.

name: queryAnnotation
desc: This should log the query annotation features found in the device, such as the device annotation, the room annotation, and the structure annotation from the query.
meaning: Logged device, room, and structure mentions found in the spoken query.

name: selectionResult
desc: The result of device selection.
meaning: The outcome of choosing which device should handle the request.

name: ambiguousTargetDevices
desc: Deprecated, please use qualified_devices.
meaning: Deprecated list of candidate devices when the target was ambiguous.

name: finalLumosStage
desc: The class name for the final filter/promoter used by Lumos for device targeting. This filter or promoter runs for all users, and contains no data specific to the individual user.
meaning: Name of the last filter or promoter used when picking the target device.

name: lowConfidenceTargetDevice
desc: ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// Ambiguous Results: the library failed to select the final target device(s) but it narrows down to a set of devices which are all valid target device candidates. The client needs to do further disambiguation, e.g., giving a dialog or having customized logic. The low confidence target device means the library falied to select the target device but it picked two devices for the client to do disambiguation.
meaning: Devices kept for user disambiguation when no confident target could be chosen.

name: mediaFocusSelectionErrorType
desc: ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// This field log the error while selecting target device in media_focus_selector.
meaning: The error hit while choosing a target device by media focus.

name: processorInfo
desc: The log for each stage of Lumos, showing the number of eliminated devices from each processor.
meaning: Per-stage log of how many devices each selection step eliminated.

name: qualifiedDevices
desc: We will apply several filters and dialogs to select a target device if media_focus_selector fail to select one. This field should log the devices left after each filter or dialog. It also log the detailed info of the final target device.
meaning: Devices remaining after each filter, plus details of the final target device.

name: singleTargetDevice
desc: ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// Unambiguous Results: the library successfully selected the final target device(s) and no further disambiguation is needed. Deprecated, please use target_device.
meaning: Deprecated field holding the single chosen target device.

name: fallbackDeviceLog
desc: The fallback device.
meaning: The fallback device recorded for a low confidence selection.

name: lowConfTargetDeviceLog
desc: The selected low confidence focus device.
meaning: The low confidence focus device that was picked.

name: devicesAfterRun
desc: Number of candidate devices after this stage is run.
meaning: How many candidate devices remain after this selection stage.

name: devicesBeforeRun
desc: Number of candidate devices before this stage is run.
meaning: How many candidate devices existed before this selection stage.

name: processorName
desc: Name of the processor for this stage.
meaning: Name of the device selection stage.

name: currentFocusDurationSec
desc: How long the device is in focus so far
meaning: How long the device has held media focus so far.

name: dialogTriggered
desc: TODO(b/134944092) Log MediaFocusDialogTrigger Enum in focus_status.
meaning: Placeholder flag with a to-do note about logging a dialog trigger.

name: focusDevice
desc: LINT.ThenChange(//depot/google3/logs/proto/majel_gws/media_action_triggering_info.proto) The focus device.
meaning: The device that currently has media focus.

name: mediaFocusState
desc: The media focus state at the time of the request.
meaning: The media focus state at the time of the request.

name: sourceDeviceId
desc: The source device of media focus.
meaning: Identifier of the device that media focus came from.

name: mediaFocuses
desc: Deprecated, use nearby_media_focuses instead.
meaning: Deprecated list of media focuses.

name: nearbyMediaFocuses
desc: MediaFouces found on nearby devices.
meaning: Media focuses found on nearby devices.

name: deviceIndex
desc: The device index in this message is consistent with the device index in DeviceInfoLog. This field refers to the devices that hosting the session.
meaning: Indexes of the devices hosting a media session.

name: deviceArbitrationCreationTimestampMs
desc: The timestamp that DeviceArbitration is created in milliseconds.
meaning: When the device arbitration object was created, in milliseconds.

name: deviceTargetingInputCreationTimestampMs
desc: The timestamp that DeviceTargetingInput is built in milliseconds.
meaning: When the device targeting input was built, in milliseconds.

name: deviceAnnotation
desc: Deprecated, please use room_annotations.
meaning: Deprecated single device mention taken from the query.

name: deviceAnnotations
desc: Log the device annotations mentioned in the query.
meaning: Device mentions detected in the spoken query.

name: providerAnnotation
desc: Log the provider annotations annotated from the query.
meaning: Media provider mentions detected in the spoken query.

name: roomAnnotation
desc: TODO(b/171250187) Deprecates the optional RoomAnnotationLog and DeviceAnnotationLog. Deprecated, please use device_annotations.
meaning: Deprecated single room mention taken from the query.

name: roomAnnotations
desc: Log the room annotations mentioned in the query.
meaning: Room mentions detected in the spoken query.

name: structureAnnotations
desc: Log the structure annotations mentioned in the query.
meaning: Home or building mentions detected in the spoken query.

name: createdSecondsAgo
desc: The reminder is created N seconds ago. This helps tracking how the user issues follow-up actions after reminder is created. For example, whether the user likes to issues another [show reminders] query right after reminder is created?
meaning: How many seconds ago the reminder was created.

name: retrievedRankingClass
desc: If the reminder is retrieved by a ranking class (see go/opa-reminders-ranker), this will be populated with the class info. Refer to assistant.productivity.ReminderRankingClass.RankingType. Since that proto is in proto2 format, we can only wire by int type.
meaning: Which reminder ranking class retrieved this reminder.

name: rawTextFromQuery
desc: The raw text mentioning a room from the query, such as "my living room".
meaning: The exact words in the query that named a room.

name: roomCount
desc: The number of rooms annotated, if there are multiple structures. They are guaranteed to have the same text_from_query and name due to exact matching.
meaning: How many rooms matched the mentioned room name.

name: roomId
desc: The identification of the room.
meaning: Identifiers of the matched room.

name: type
desc: The annotation type mentioned in the query.
meaning: The kind of room annotation found in the query.

name: agsaClientInstanceId
desc: The client_instance_id on devices with GSA. See 'client_instance_field' in go/androidids.
meaning: Client instance identifier on devices running the Google app.

name: alloDeviceId
desc: Allo Id. Corresponds to the GBotRequest.Sender.sender. This ID type should be deprecated by now, yet we've observed it serving prod traffic in GB.
meaning: Legacy Allo device identifier that was meant to be retired.

name: canonicalDeviceId
desc: A unique device ID for Assistant devices as proposed by go/ocelot-team.
meaning: A unique identifier for an Assistant device.

name: castDeviceId
desc: If set, indicates that the device is a cast device, and contains the UUID of the cast device. Corresponds to the device_id field of the CastDevice proto.
meaning: The unique identifier of a Cast device.

name: clientInstanceId
desc: DUSI (go/dusi) is used as the identifier here. This identifier is unique to the user and device. This will help identify which device or application the user's request originated from. This is not to be confused with the client_instance_id that android devices provide. This is currently used by surfaces that use the assistant-legacy-nexus and assistant-legacy-clockwork pipelines. DUSI is created and set in S3. This field is only filled for GAIA requests.
meaning: A per-user, per-device identifier showing which device sent a request.

name: deviceConfigId
desc: The unique DeviceConfig to the specific third party device. It is also used by Android Auto Embedded first party device. See go/opa-ids.
meaning: Configuration identifier for a specific third party device.

name: homeGraphDeviceId
desc: The unique device ID for HomeGraph devices. This is the HomeGraph ID, created when the device is registered into HomeGraph. It is immutable for the same device unless it is completely deleted and recreated. See go/home-graph for details. }
meaning: The device's identifier in Home Graph.

name: libassistantDeviceId
desc: The unique ID for libassistant based devices.
meaning: Identifier for devices built on libassistant.

name: opaIosDeviceId
desc: The unique device ID for the Assistant App on iOS. See go/opa-ios-design for details.
meaning: Identifier for the Assistant app on iOS.

name: rawTextFromQuery
desc: The raw text mentioning a structure from the query, such as "my house".
meaning: The exact words in the query that named a home or building.

name: structureId
desc: The identification of the structure.
meaning: Identifiers of the matched home or building.

name: type
desc: The annotation type mentioned in the query.
meaning: The kind of structure annotation found in the query.

name: hasAmbiguousResolutions
desc: True if there are more than one possible resolutions to the RD.
meaning: Whether more than one thing could match the device the user referred to.

name: hasResolvedDeviceId
desc: True if there's at least one device id that gets resolved. Note this is different from is_grounded = true: it is possible that is_grounded = false (num_grounded_args =0) but there is resolved device ids. E.g.: "turn on the blue light" Power_on(device_object = [d1, d2]:RD(category=DeviceObject(name='blue light')) where there are "blue light 1" and "blue light 2" hence two resolved device ids. But since the quantifier is single, GB can't resolve the ambiguity and woul
meaning: Whether at least one device identifier was resolved for the request.

name: deviceRdMetadata
desc: Each DeviceRdMetadata represents one device RD (device slot) in the intent. Note that each device RD could have multiple device groundings inside of it.
meaning: Metadata for each device slot in a smart home command.

name: isExactMatch
desc: When num_constraints == num_constraints_satisfied, indicating all slot matchings are exact match.
meaning: Whether every slot in the intent matched exactly.

name: isGrounded
desc: When num_grounded_args > 0, indicating there is at least one top-level argument is grounded.
meaning: Whether at least one top-level argument was resolved to a real thing.

name: fulfillableDominantMedia
desc: Whether this is a fulfillable, dominant Media intent.
meaning: Whether this is a dominant media request that can actually be carried out.

name: generatedByLegacyAquaDomain
desc: Whether or not the intent was generated by a legacy Aqua domain that PFR should care about.
meaning: Whether a legacy Assistant domain produced this interpretation.

name: hasAnswerGroup
desc: Whether the interpretation has a Search answer group object, signifying it came from Search resolution.
meaning: Whether the interpretation carries a Search answer group object.

name: isIntentFromOrbit
desc: Whether the intent is from ORBIT.
meaning: Whether the ORBIT system produced this intent.

name: usesGroundingBox
desc: Whether the interpretation should run through grounding box or not.
meaning: Whether the interpretation should be resolved by the grounding box.

name: effectiveArgSpanLength
desc: The total effective length of the spans for the arguments used to construct the parse. May include vertical specific adjustments. Eg: For the query [delete my 7 p.m. alarm called chicken] and intent Delete_alarm(alarm_object=RD(category=AlarmObject( label="chicken", trigger_time_datetime=<< 7 PM >>))), the effective argument span is "7 p.m." + "chicken" (total length of 13).
meaning: Total length of the query text used to fill the intent's arguments.

name: phase
desc: Query understanding phase the intent was produced in.
meaning: Which query understanding phase produced this intent.

name: isFullyGrounded
desc: Whether the intent is fully grounded.
meaning: Whether every argument in the intent resolved to something real.

name: isSageInNageIntent
desc: Whether the intent is produced by the Sage IntentGenerator invoked by the NSP intent-generator (thus, Sage-in-NSP-invoking_Sage, or Sage-in-Nage).
meaning: Whether Sage produced this intent when invoked by the NSP generator.

name: isSageDisabledIntent
desc: Whether the intent is an intent marked disabled by the Sage IG.
meaning: Whether the Sage generator marked this intent as disabled.

name: deepMediaDominant
desc: Whether the intent is dominant according to NSP deep-media.
meaning: Whether the media model considers this interpretation the dominant one.

name: isVideoIntent
desc: Whether the intent is a media object video intent.
meaning: Whether this is a video media request.

name: parsingScoreMse8BucketId
desc: A ID corresponding to which bucket a given parsing score belongs in.
meaning: Which bucket the parsing score falls into.

name: predictedIntentConfidence
desc: Intent confidence predicted by the AssistantVerticalClassifier QRewrite servlet.
meaning: Confidence a classifier assigned to the predicted intent.
