name: nspIntentParseScore
desc: Parse score generated by NSP. If NSP intent has been pruned due to dededuplication, It will have highest parse score for deduplicated intent.
meaning: Parse score the NSP parser gave this intent.

name: numConstraints
desc: Signals as proposed in go/improved-grounding-signals. Sum of the number of constraints used by the Grounding Box to ground each variable.
meaning: How many constraints were used to resolve the intent's variables.

name: isPodcastIntent
desc: Whether the intent is a podcast intent.
meaning: Whether the request is about podcasts.

name: isScoreBasedIntent
desc: Whether this intent is a score-based intent, relying on PFR for scoring and pruning to the top intent.
meaning: Whether this intent depends on the prefulfillment ranker to be chosen.

name: platinumSource
desc: Whether the intent comes from the Sage IntentGenerator's "platinum" source, signifying high-confidence in quality.
meaning: Whether the intent came from a high-confidence source list.

name: nspRank
desc: Rank of the intent as reported by NSP.
meaning: Rank the NSP parser gave this intent.

name: dominant
desc: Indicates interpretation dominance predicted by KScorer
meaning: Whether the scorer predicts this interpretation is the dominant one.

name: isRadioIntent
desc: Whether the intent is a PlayMedia radio intent.
meaning: Whether the request is to play radio.

name: searchDispatch
desc: The determination made by the SearchDispatchingConfig as to whether and how this interpretation should be dispatched to Search.
meaning: Whether and how this Assistant interpretation should be sent on to Search.

name: isHighConfidencePodcastIntent
desc: Used for PFR manual rule to prefer high confidence podcast intent (e.g. topical, genre) over generic podcast intents.
meaning: Whether this is a specific, high confidence podcast request.

name: calibratedParsingScore
desc: A parsing score that is independently calibrated by each parser/IG.
meaning: A parse quality score calibrated separately by each Assistant parser.

name: intentNameAuisScoreExp
desc: Assistant User Interaction Score which is aggregated using intent name from exp laelaps.
meaning: Experimental version of the intent-name user interaction score.

name: inQueryMaxEffectiveArgSpanLength
desc: This is a cross-intent feature which is calculated by iterating all intent candidates. This feature should be populated in post-IG stage (before GB).
meaning: The largest argument span length among all candidate interpretations of the query.

name: pq2tVsAssistantIbstCosine
desc: Cosine similarity between predicted query-to-term model and assistant intent-type-based salient terms. This is intended to be only used for ACE ranking and only populated for assistant traffic.
meaning: Similarity between predicted query terms and Assistant intent salient terms.

name: isTvmIntent
desc: Whether the intent is a media object tvm intent.
meaning: Whether this is a TV or movie media request.

name: numGroundedArgs
desc: Number of grounded arguments the intent has, populated by the Grounding Box.
meaning: How many of the intent's arguments were actually resolved.

name: numGroundableArgs
desc: Grounding Signals. Number of groundable arguments the intent has, populated by the Grounding Box.
meaning: How many of the intent's arguments could be resolved.

name: intentType
desc: intent_type differentiates between intents that share the top level intent name. For eg: for TV_FALLBACK_SEARCH_INTENT, the top level intent name must be "Find_media" and the media_object argument within it must be of type "Media_unspecified".
meaning: A finer-grained type distinguishing intents that share the same name.

name: pq2tVsIbstCosine
desc: Cosine similarity between predicted query-to-term model and intent-type-based salient terms. This is intended to be used as a backoff to pq2t_vs_qibst_cosine if it is missing.
meaning: Similarity between predicted query terms and intent-type salient terms.

name: isNspIntent
desc: Whether this interpretation was genearted by NSP.
meaning: Whether the NSP parser produced this interpretation.

name: isSageIntent
desc: Whether this intent was generated by Sage.
meaning: Whether Sage generated this intent.

name: intentNameAuisScore
desc: QUS intent-based ranking signals. Assistant User Interaction Score which is aggregated using intent name.
meaning: A user interaction score aggregated by Assistant intent name.

name: kScore
desc: Used for PFR manaul rule to prefer high kscore radio intent. The k-score comes from twiddled_ranking_scores in query interpretations.
meaning: A ranking score for the interpretation taken from query interpretation scoring.

name: isAquaMediaIntent
desc: Whether the intent aqua intent from media domain enabled in QBT
meaning: Whether this is a media-domain intent from the Aqua system.

name: isValidSmarthomeIntent
desc: Whether the intent is a Smarthome-domain intent with valid device arguments.
meaning: Whether this is a smart home command with valid device arguments.

name: smarthomeIntentMetadata
desc: SmartHome intent metadata used for the SmartHome business-rules twiddler.
meaning: Smart home details used by a business-rules reranking step.

name: numConstraintsSatisfied
desc: Sum of the number of constraints satisfied for each variable. Depending on the match score for a constraint, this number can be fractional and is in the range [0, num_constraints]. Populated by the Grounding Box.
meaning: How many of those constraints were satisfied, possibly a fractional amount.

name: isMediaControlIntent
desc: Whether the intent is a media control intent.
meaning: Whether the request is a playback control command.

name: isPodcastGenericIntent
desc: Used for PFR manual rule to prefer high confidence podcast intent (e.g. topical, genre) over generic podcast intents.
meaning: Whether the request is a generic podcast request.

name: maxHgrScoreAcrossBindingSets
desc: The maximum score assigned by the Horizontal Grounding Ranker (HGR) across all of the intent's binding sets.
meaning: Highest grounding ranker score among the intent's possible argument bindings.

name: intentName
desc: intent_name is used by PFR ensemble model. See go/pfr_ha_launch_doc
meaning: The name of the Assistant intent, used by the ranking model.

name: kscorerRank
desc: The rank order of the interpretation as determined by kscorer. The kscorer-determined dominant interpretation, if any, gets a rank of 0. The remaining N interpretations get a rank of 1 through N.
meaning: The rank the scorer gave this interpretation, with zero as the top one.

name: isPlayGenericMusic
desc: Whether the intent is a PlayGenericMusic-type intent.
meaning: Whether the request is to play music generally.

name: name
desc: [REQUIRED] The name of the list item.
meaning: The name of an item on a user's list.

name: id
desc: REQUIRED. An unique identifier for the attachment. We have a plan to index this field, so it's marked as REQUIRED. Chat with opa-reminders-eng@ if you have a use case without an attachment ID.
meaning: A unique identifier for a reminder attachment.

name: surfaceType
desc: REQUIRED. Surface types this attachment should be shown.
meaning: Which device surfaces should display this reminder attachment.

name: linkUrl
desc: REQUIRED. The link to surface to frontends (e.g., Hubpage, notifications.) This could also be a surface-specific deeplink (be sure to set
meaning: The link shown to the user for a reminder attachment.

name: notificationText
desc: REQUIRED. The text for the notification link button. Note: We cannot take nlp_generation.TemplateData yet due to cyclic dependency. The plan is to cut dependency from TemplateData to quality.actions.Reminder. DEPRECATED. No longer used as part of the notification flow.
meaning: Deprecated text template for a reminder notification button.

name: hasReferencedEntityAtCreation
desc: Whether the reminder created has a referenced_entity attached to it or not(go/hub-memory-payload). Since we plan to set this in Assistant reminder creation path flow, in case later the referenced_entity is removed from the reminder, then this bit might still remain true. Also in case referenced_entity is later added to reminder(for example when referenced_entity is attached by Server), then also this bit might remain false. This bit will be used to
meaning: Whether the reminder had a linked entity when it was created.

name: recordId
desc: Id of record that is associated with Reminder. This will be set for all Assistant reminders created after the first launch of the Reminder Memory integration, see go/reminders-memory for more details. Also, this might apply to all other types of reminders.
meaning: Identifier of the memory record tied to a reminder.

name: messageSet
desc: REQUIRED.
meaning: Identifier of the message set for a text template.

name: templateName
desc: REQUIRED.
meaning: Name of the text template.

name: hasLocationInterpretation
desc: Whether the nickname could also refer to a location. For example, "walmart", "starbucks".
meaning: Whether an app nickname could also refer to a place.

name: installInfo
desc: Indicates whether the user has the app installed.
meaning: Whether the user has the app installed.

name: isGeneric
desc: True when the name is generic, i.e when it could refer to multiple packages from different developrs. For example, "mail" is considered a generic name (since it can refer to "gmail", "yahoo mail" etc.) but "facebook" although could refer to both "facebook" and "facebook lite" is not considered generic (both packages are from the same third party).
meaning: Whether the nickname could refer to apps from several different developers.

name: nicknameTier
desc: The tier of the nickname.
meaning: The tier assigned to an app nickname.

name: matchScore
desc: Neural contact match similarity score.
meaning: How closely a spoken name matches one of the user's contacts.

name: contextId
desc: Actions-on-Google action context ID. See go/sdm-hospitality-design.
meaning: Identifier for an Actions on Google action context.

name: agentId
desc: The agent's ID. Generally it is the agent's Google pantheon project id.
meaning: Identifier of the smart home partner agent.

name: deviceId
desc: Device ID defined by the agent.
meaning: The device identifier assigned by the partner agent.

name: id
desc: Unique Agent ID which maps to a specific Agent. Not using Agent Name here as it may change over time.
meaning: Unique identifier for a smart home agent.

name: key
desc: Agent's foreign key that uniquely identifies a user's device.
meaning: The agent's own key identifying a user's device.

name: eventTriggerPayload
desc: Detailed settings for the event trigger; unset if not applicable.
meaning: Settings for a smart home event trigger.

name: eventTriggerType
desc: Different event type may have different settings. For example:
meaning: The kind of event that triggers a home routine.

name: triggerSource
desc: Unique identifier for the EventTrigger, e.g. SCHEDULED_ROUTINES. See the enum values of cs/symbol:WorkflowTriggerInput.TriggerSource
meaning: Identifier of what triggered the routine.

name: enabled
desc: Whether this Routine is enabled or not. If false, then this Routine can't be triggered by Voice.
meaning: Whether a home routine is turned on.

name: googlePreconfigWorkflowId
desc: The unique identifier for a class of workflows. For example:
meaning: Identifier for a preconfigured class of home routines.

name: payload
desc: Internal format payload primarily for Routines team use.
meaning: Internal routine data used by the Routines team.

name: securityLevel
desc: The security level of the Structure Based Routine as determined by the most security-sensitive task.
meaning: How security-sensitive a home routine is.

name: triggers
desc: Voice or event triggers.
meaning: The voice or event triggers that start a routine.

name: uiPayload
desc: UI format payload primarily for external team use.
meaning: Routine data formatted for display by other teams.

name: annotatedSpanDevice
desc: The query span for device mention.
meaning: The part of the query that names a device.

name: annotatedSpanRoom
desc: The query span for room mention.
meaning: The part of the query that names a room.

name: annotatedSpanStructure
desc: The query span for structure mention.
meaning: The part of the query that names a home or building.

name: processedMentionedSpan
desc: This field is from query_info.processed_mentioned_span in DTO.
meaning: The cleaned-up piece of query text mentioning a target.

name: deviceSelectionLog
desc: the next 3 fields are for Lumos output (DTO) that needs to be propagated to the Fulfilment through the HomeAutomationDevice proto.
meaning: Device selection logging carried through to fulfillment.

name: dtoQueryInfo
desc: This field is from query_info in DTO.
meaning: Query span information passed along from device targeting.

name: homeautomationMetadata
desc: Device meta data.
meaning: Metadata about a smart home device.

name: list
desc: list of HomeAutomationDeviceItem. After migration completes, we will mark the above 4 field as deprecated and only use this field.
meaning: The list of smart home device items.

name: matchedItemKey
desc: Corresponding to casse matched_item CustomTypeItem key.
meaning: Key of the matched smart home item.

name: matchedItemRawvalue
desc: Corresponding to casse Argument raw_value.
meaning: The raw argument text that matched the item.

name: matchedItemValue
desc: Corresponding to casse matched_item CustomTypeItem value.
meaning: Values of the matched smart home item.

name: homeautomationMetadata
desc: Device meta data.
meaning: Metadata about a smart home device item.

name: matchedItemKey
desc: Corresponding to casse matched_item CustomTypeItem key.
meaning: Key of the matched smart home item.

name: matchedItemRawvalue
desc: Corresponding to casse Argument raw_value.
meaning: The raw argument text that matched the item.

name: matchedItemValue
desc: Corresponding to casse matched_item CustomTypeItem value.
meaning: Values of the matched smart home item.

name: supportedStructureFeatures
desc: The features that are available for a structure. Will only be populated if the item_type == STRUCTURE.
meaning: Features available for a home structure.

name: traitRoutingHints
desc: For SHED devices, some traits can only be executed on 3P cloud, e.g. "action.devices.traits.MediaInitiation", "action.devices.traits.Channel" go/shed-per-trait-routing
meaning: Which smart home device capabilities must be run on a third party cloud.

name: parentNode
desc: LINT.IfChange(home_graph_single_parent) At the moment, we just have a single string. In future this will expand with additional metadata from client or cloud execution data store. In today's 'tree' HomeGraph each object has a single parent. In the future this may have a mesh for complex cases -- zones, doors, etc -- so we make this a repeated element today. LINT.ThenChange(//depot/google3/assistant/assistant_server/settings/user_defined_actions/footprints/footprint_accessor.cc:home_graph_single_
meaning: The parent room or structure the device sits under.

name: actionProjectConfigs
desc: Custom actions that this item supports.
meaning: Custom partner actions this device supports.

name: zoneNameSaftDocument
desc: SAFT Document with linguistic annotations for the zone name, if applicable.
meaning: Language annotations for the name of a room or zone in a home.

name: operationalNodeId
desc: Operational CHIP Node ID that combines the fabric ID and node id in format of . (Hex format without 0x prefix, for example, 0F001234FA67AA39.1234ABCD1111DDDD).
meaning: The device's combined fabric and node identifier.

name: saftDocument
desc: SAFT Document with linguistic annotations for the primary device name.
meaning: Linguistic analysis of the device's main name.

name: opaqueCustomData
desc: Store custom data for agent calls here. This will likely be short-lived -- we will replace this with calls to HGS. (Note: This may end up not temporary if we only need it for a couple partners -- more efficient to have it on a few users than require HGS reads for all users.
meaning: Partner-specific data stored for calls back to the partner.

name: lanscanOptedIn
desc: Whether local home platform should discover new devices via LAN for the structure.
meaning: Whether the home allows discovering new devices over the local network.

name: plural
desc: We use this to determine if the synonyms matched in the aqua interpretation is plural. Then we will return disambiguate dialog or execute commands with all the targets.
meaning: Whether the matched name was plural, meaning several targets.

name: deviceModelId
desc: See note in home_graph.proto; loaded into DE now to avoid having to double-read assistant settings records as per go/smarthome-removing-assistant-settings
meaning: Identifier of the device model, copied in from Home Graph.

name: notificationSupportedByAgent
desc: Indicates whether the device is capable of sending notifications. This field will be set by the agent (partner) on an incoming SYNC. If a device is not capable of generating notifications, the partner should set this flag to false. If a partner is not capable of calling ReportStateAndNotification to send notifications to Google, the partner should set this flag to false. If there is a user setting in the partner app to enable notifications and it is turned off, the partner should set this flag t
meaning: Whether the partner is able to send notifications for this device.

name: parentType
desc: The type of the parent. Currently only set for devices, to distinguish between structure and room parents. Items currently have only one parent, and entries after the first parent_type are ignored.
meaning: Whether the parent is a room or a whole structure.

name: gcmExecutionAddress
desc: GCM address for cloud execution across google cloud messaging rather than 3p cloud.
meaning: Messaging address used to send commands to the device.

name: smartDeviceManagementData
desc: Data needed for SDM (fleet management). See go/enterprise-id-in-assistant.
meaning: Fleet management data for enterprise-managed devices.

name: voiceMatchRequired
desc: Set to which level of voice match is needed. Enum based on string input from the partner in json sync. Values accepted: "none" (but in this case partners won't set it), "owner" [requires matching one of the creator gaia IDs], or "member" [any recognized voice 'enrolled' on the device]. This may expand; only "owner" is in use for first partner, Tile.
meaning: What level of voice recognition is required before the device will act.

name: personalizedNicknames
desc: User-given nicknames for an entity (e.g. "My house"). These nicknames are unique to the gaia user. Nickname in DeviceInfo is per-entity level nickname, while personalized_nicknames is per-user per-entity.
meaning: Nicknames one particular user has given the device or place.

name: primaryName
desc: Which of the values was the original, user-provided name -- or our disambiguated, cleaned-up version of it. This is what we use in TTS when we need to identify an object that wasn't just spoken uniquely by the user -- in disambiguation dialogue, or in response to a collective interrogative (e.g. "what lights are on in the kitchen?")
meaning: The main name used when speaking aloud about the device.

name: attributes
desc: Attributes data as provided from SYNC. This gets used in mutation and execution and in some potential cases, in biasing.
meaning: Device attributes reported by the partner during sync.

name: hashValue
desc: The hash value from go/de-consistency-check
meaning: A hash value used for a consistency check.

name: willReportState
desc: This device will report state; we can query realtime state from local HGS rather than slow QUERY intent to the 3p cloud.
meaning: Whether the device pushes its state to Google so it need not be asked directly.

name: matterUniqueId
desc: Matter Unique ID. Contains VID/PID information
meaning: The device's Matter identifier, including vendor and product info.

name: userDefinedDeviceType
desc: The priority order of speech targeting: 1. user_defined_device_type 2. derived_device_type 3. device_type
meaning: A device type the user set themselves, which wins when naming the device out loud.

name: supportsDirectResponse
desc: This device supports direct response -- if the device itself is issuing the query (which means it's also an assistant surface) we can return its payload directly rather than via cloud.
meaning: Whether the device can answer its own query directly.

name: targetDeviceSignalStrengths
desc: Only present for an AoGH device. HGS Device ID of a target device and the signal strength (RSSI in dB, higher is better) between that target device and the AoGH device. If this map is empty, there are no target devices reachable by this AoGH device.
meaning: Signal strength between this hub device and each device it can reach.

name: roleInformation
desc: User's role information for this device. This will be used in Home Automation server to decide if user has authority to fulfill its request.
meaning: The user's permission role for this device.

name: traitToAttributeProtos
desc: Map of trait to a proto representing the attribute. This is different from the attributes field above which is represented as a struct. The attributes here are represented as protos and will require specific support per trait.
meaning: Device attributes for each capability, stored as protocol buffers instead of a struct.

name: traitRoutingTable
desc: Map from traits to routing table. Metadata includes preferred execution path per trait and, when Matter is preferred, which endpoint should be used for the trait.
meaning: A table saying which execution path to use for each smart home device capability.

name: assistantDeviceId
desc: Device ID that matches the ID passed from the device to discourse_context when a user issues a query to an Assistant-enabled device that is registered with Cast (via CCS (see go/castservers)), or some other service.
meaning: Device identifier passed from the device when a user speaks to it.

name: derivedType
desc: Any types that are not the given item type, but derived later. For example, if an item has type action.devices.types.OUTLET but is named "floor lamp" we can derive that it also has type action.devices.types.LIGHT. Also considered along with |type| when triggering type-based actions.
meaning: Extra device types inferred beyond the declared one, such as light for a lamp.

name: modelName
desc: Model name from HomeGraph, populated from model_manifest.model_name. See b/200087451.
meaning: The device's model name from Home Graph.

name: notificationEnabledByUser
desc: Indicates whether notifications have been enabled by a user and will be announced for this device. This is set by the user within the Google app settings, and Google will announce the device notification only if both notification_supported_by_agent and notification_enabled_by_user are true.
meaning: Whether the user turned on notifications for this device.

name: otherDeviceIds
desc: Other agent id + foreign id pairs associated with the device. This can be used to represent a group of devices (e.g. Sonos' bonded zone) as a single device, or a device that comes in through different sync flows (e.g. Newman with a Nest camera).
meaning: Other agent and device identifier pairs for the same device.

name: smartHomeFeatures
desc: SmartHome feature flags that may be enabled per-item.
meaning: Feature flags enabled for this device.

name: supportedTraitsByAgent
desc: Map from agent ID to supported traits. Some devices (e.g. Newman) have multiple agents, with each agent being associated with a specific set of traits. This could alternatively have been formatted as map as {trait, agent} pairs instead of the {agent, list of trait} pairs, but we retain this format to be consistent with HomeGraph's representation. In practice, a trait should only be paired with a single agent (i.e. we should not have two agents with the same trait in their value list). This field
meaning: Which device capabilities each partner agent supports.

name: type
desc: The item type, such as "action.devices.types.VACUUM" - to be used in triggering type-based actions, e.g. "start vacuuming": go/smarthome-type-based-actions.
meaning: The kind of smart home device, such as vacuum, used to trigger spoken commands.

name: tdssUpdateTimestamp
desc: The timestamp at which the TDSS map was last updated. This information is used to help determine which hub would be preferred if multiple hubs report the same reach-ability for a device.
meaning: When the smart home device routing map was last refreshed, used to pick between hubs.

name: creatorGaiaId
desc: See Device.creator_gaia_ids in //home/graph/proto/service/types.proto. If empty, the GAIA ID from the request EUC is assumed to be the creator. We only need at most one creator_gaia_id.
meaning: Account identifier of whoever created the device entry.

name: reportStateStatus
desc: Whether device report state is out of sync with Query response.
meaning: Whether the device's reported state matches its query response.

name: routableViaGcm
desc: Only present for a target device. Indicates this target device is reachable by a local (AoGH) path via an AoGH device.
meaning: Whether the device can be reached over a local path.

name: groupIds
desc: List of parent group IDs, if the device is added to one or multiple device groups (see go/home-groups). Will be consumed by Smart Home APIs and (in the future) Assistant CTF to populate the group member list of device groups.
meaning: Identifiers of the device groups this device belongs to.

name: physicalLocation
desc: Stores the location for the STRUCTURE type.
meaning: The stored location of a home structure.

name: otherDeviceSources
desc: Additional device sources. This can be the result of the device being merged with other devices with a different source.
meaning: Additional sources this device record was merged from.

name: agentInformation
desc: Agent details.
meaning: Details about the partner agent for this device.

name: iamCheckRequired
desc: When true, role_type will be ignored, Nest IAM RPC will called to check authority.
meaning: Whether permission must be checked with Nest's access service instead of a stored role.

name: enterpriseId
desc: The enterprise that owns the structure. E.g. Disney, Dream Hotel, etc. This is used for log/analytics purpose. For privacy reasons, we log at enterprise level instead of structure level.
meaning: Identifier of the business that owns a smart home building, kept for analytics.

name: circadianLightingEnabled
desc: Flag indicating whether the background Circadian Lighting effect is enabled for a particular light (go/circadian-lighting-e2e).
meaning: Whether the daylight matching lighting effect is turned on for a light.

name: energySavingsEnabled
desc: Flag indicating whether automatic Energy Savings are enabled for this item.
meaning: Whether automatic energy saving is turned on for this device.

name: gentleWakeupEnabled
desc: Flag indicating whether Gentle Wake Up is enabled for this item (go/sleep-wake-design).
meaning: Whether the gradual wake up feature is turned on for this device.

name: homeAwayOverMatterEnabled
desc: Flag indicating whether the user has enabled / disabled sending Home/Away status updates to the device through the Google custom IntelligenceEvents Matter cluster. (go/google-clusters-design)
meaning: Whether the user allows home and away status to be sent to this device.

name: deviceId
desc: The unique device on which the mention occurred. For example, if the user has two Google Home devices, this indicates which of the two was used.
meaning: Which of the user's devices an assistant conversation mention happened on.

name: eventId
desc: ID of the event that resulted in this entity mention. For user and system turn AEs, this is taken from the ConversationSnapshotId of the snapshot containing this mention. For client AEs, this is empty. This can be used to join back this particular mention to the specific "turn" in which this mention took place.
meaning: Identifier of the conversation turn in which an entity was mentioned.

name: factoidScore
desc: If this mention corresponds to a WebAnswer, then this defines the score associated with that answer.
meaning: The score of the web answer that an assistant conversation mention came from.

name: listEntryInfo
desc: If present, this entity was mentioned as part of a larger list.
meaning: Marks that the mentioned entity was part of a list read out to the user.

name: recency
desc: Estimates the recency of the mention. This is internally computed at runtime on a turn-by-turn basis.
meaning: How recently the entity was mentioned in the conversation.

name: role
desc: The semantic role that the entity was used in.
meaning: The role the entity played in the conversation, such as which slot it filled.

name: salience
desc: How salient this mention is. This field will only be set if the mention is derived from a SearchAnswerValue. See go/webresultsdata-as-aes for more details.
meaning: How prominent a mention was, set only when it came from a search answer.

name: source
desc: Contains metadata about the source of the mention.
meaning: Details about where a conversation mention came from.

name: spatialProperties
desc: If present, properties of visual mentions (e.g., how they are displayed to the user, visibility, etc.).
meaning: Details of how a mention shown on screen appeared to the user.

name: surfaceForm
desc: Details about how this mention was presented.
meaning: Details of the wording used when the entity was presented.

name: timestamp
desc: Unix timestamp noting (approximately) when this mention occurred. We do not guarantee that the time will correspond precisely to when the user uttered/heard a response. If mentions within a single turn have
meaning: Roughly when the conversation mention happened.

name: index
desc: The index of the entity presented to the user. NOTE: Indexing starts from 0.
meaning: The position of the item in the list shown to the user, counting from zero.

name: lexicalGroundingsId
desc: A string which uniquely identifies the list item this entity represents in the list. For example, consider the "OrderPizza" intent with the "size" slot: U: I want to order a pizza A: Sure. What size do you want: large, medium, or small? U: Gigantic The lexical_groundings_id can be "large" to identify the large item in the list. This lexical_groundings_id together with the semantic role fields (i.e., role.intent_id & role.role_id) can be used to match the nlp_semanti
meaning: A string identifying which choice in a spoken list this entity stands for.

name: intentId
desc: Semantic roles will be defined locally, within the context of a single task/feature. The |intent_id| is a unique identifier for such a local cluster. In most cases, this should be exactly the same as the name of the intent used for TaskState (see go/assistant-intent-catalog). In cases where the intent isn't well-defined, this can be an arbitrary, feature-defined identifier.
meaning: Identifier of the task or intent that a conversation role belongs to.

name: roleId
desc: Identifier for a semantic role, unique within the namespace of |intent_id|. When this role corresponds to a slot in the intent, the |role_id| should be equal to the name of that argument. For example, consider an entry in the intent catalog: core_intent { id { id: "BookARide" } slot { name: "provider" type { string_type { } } } slot { name: "num_riders" type { number_type { } } } } Then, the |role_id| would be "provider" or "num_riders" when refe
meaning: Identifier of a particular slot or role inside an intent.

name: compressedName
desc: A fingerprint of the actual name of the field.
meaning: A fingerprint standing in for the biasing field's real name.

name: value
desc: The value, under various representations to get maximum compression. Exactly one of them is guaranteed to be filled. value as a double.
meaning: The document's biasing value, stored as a decimal number.

name: valueFloat
desc: a floating value, represented as an integer by converting using floating_value * 1000. Useable for all floating values that need 3 digits of precision, and are small enough.
meaning: The document's biasing value stored as an integer scaled by one thousand.

name: valueInt
desc: value as an int32. When the value is encode-able as an integer.
meaning: The document's biasing value when it fits in a plain integer.

name: Name
desc: Fingerprint of the attribute name (no need to keep long field names)
meaning: A fingerprint standing in for the biasing attribute's name.

name: Value
desc: Biasing value translated into a double for uniform comparison
meaning: The document's biasing value converted to a decimal so values compare uniformly.

name: Size
desc: Size of the complete blob, in bytes.
meaning: How many bytes the stored blob takes up.

name: SourceV2BlobID
desc: The ID of the V2 blob this blob has
meaning: The identifier of the underlying blob in storage.

name: V2ReadBlobToken
desc: Deprecated.
meaning: A retired blob storage read token.

name: authorName
desc: The username of the author of the microblog post represented by this node.
meaning: The username of the author of a post in a conversation thread.

name: children
desc: A list of docids of child nodes.
meaning: The document ids of replies hanging under this post.

name: date
desc: The creation date of the doc.
meaning: The date the post in the conversation thread was created.

name: docid
desc: Docid of the microblog post represented by this node.
meaning: The document id of the post at this point in a conversation.

name: parent
desc: The docid of the parent node. The root of the tree will leave this empty.
meaning: The document id of the post this one is replying to.

name: convId
desc: The id of this conversation.
meaning: The identifier of a conversation thread.

name: nodes
desc: The nodes in this conversation. No particular order is assumed.
meaning: The set of posts that make up a conversation thread.

name: modules
desc: List of supported modules for a business.
meaning: The list of bookable service areas a business supports.

name: name
desc: Module name, e.g. hairdresser_reservation. from quality/views/extraction/kcube/bg/modules/modules.bzl.
meaning: The name of a bookable service area, such as hairdresser reservations.

name: services
desc: Services of this module that are supported by the business, e.g. haircuts.
meaning: Which services inside that area the business actually offers.

name: end
desc: The interval ends at the start of this second
meaning: The second at which a business opening period ends.

name: start
desc: Time in seconds since Midnight-Monday-Morn
meaning: When a business opening period starts, counted in seconds from Monday midnight.

name: expiryTimeMicros
desc: Time since epoch (micros) that this will expire
meaning: When a chat bot sending token stops being valid.

name: sendToken
desc: Encrypted InternalSendToken
meaning: An encrypted token that lets a chat bot send messages.

name: id
desc: When used as a user ID, it's the phone number of the sender. When used as a session ID: For group conversation, it is the group ID. For 1 to 1, it is the receiver or sender phone number. For 1 to bot, it is the receiver phone number or empty.
meaning: The phone number or group id identifying a chat user or conversation.

name: imageBasedDetectionDone
desc: Records whether the image linker is run already. This is only used for Alexandria but NOT for Segindexer.
meaning: A bookkeeping flag saying the image based adult check has already run.

name: csaiClassification
desc: This field is only filled for the CSAI vertical.
meaning: A child abuse imagery label, filled in only for that abuse pipeline.

name: debug
desc: Human-readable debug information about the classification. This field is only set if output_debug is set in the classification input.
meaning: Human readable debug text explaining a classification.

name: isPositive
desc: The bit that shows if this classifier outputs positive classification for the input query. Set by thresholding with a recommended threshold.
meaning: Whether the query counts as adult after applying the recommended cutoff.

name: score
desc: The score that the classifier assigned to the input query. This is filled by all verticals.
meaning: The adult content score the classifier gave the query.

name: queryTextPornScore
desc: A query text porn score for the queries which have clicks to the image: query_text_porn_score := sum(clicks(query) * text_porn_score(query)) / sum(clicks(query))
meaning: A click weighted average of how adult the queries that click this image are.

name: porn
desc: Number of referrers which are classified as porn and as adult.
meaning: How many referring pages are classified as porn or adult.

name: total
desc: Total number of referrers.
meaning: The total number of referring pages counted.

name: avgPedoPageScore
desc: The average pedo page score for the site.
meaning: The site's average score for suspected child exploitation pages.

name: numberOfPages
desc: The number of pages that were used to compute the scores and ratios.
meaning: How many pages of the site were used to compute these adult content scores.

name: numberOfPedoPages
desc: The number of pages with pedo restrict.
meaning: How many pages of the site were flagged under the child exploitation restriction.

name: site
desc: Sitechunk used to compute the signals. The field is present only for data created after December 2022.
meaning: The site grouping these adult content scores were computed for.

name: sitePornRatio
desc: The ratio of porn/softporn of the site this page belongs to.
meaning: The share of the site's pages that are porn or soft porn.

name: violenceScore
desc: The cubic mean aggregation of violence page scores in the site.
meaning: An aggregate of how violent the pages on the site score.

name: verticals4Score
desc: Please talk to safesearch@ before relying on any of these internal fields:
meaning: An internal safe search score from one model version.

name: cloudSqlInstanceConnectionName
desc: Output only. The CloudSQL instance connection name.
meaning: The connection name of a provisioned cloud database instance.

name: cloudSqlInstanceName
desc: Input/Output [Optional]. The CloudSQL instance name within SLM instance. If not set, a random UUIC will be generated as instance name.
meaning: The name of a cloud database instance, randomly generated when not given.

name: kmsKeyReference
desc: Input [Optional]. The KMS key name or the KMS grant name used for CMEK encryption. Only set this field when provisioning new CloudSQL instances. For existing CloudSQL instances, this field will be ignored because CMEK re-encryption is not supported.
meaning: The encryption key used when creating a cloud database instance.

name: mdbRolesForCorpAccess
desc: Input [Optional]. MDB roles for corp access to CloudSQL instance.
meaning: Internal roles that get corporate access to the database instance.

name: slmInstanceName
desc: Output only. The SLM instance's full resource name.
meaning: The full resource name of the managed service instance.

name: slmInstanceTemplate
desc: Input [Required]. The SLM instance template to provision CloudSQL.
meaning: The template used to set up the cloud database.

name: slmInstanceType
desc: Input [Required]. The SLM instance type to provision CloudSQL.
meaning: The instance type used to set up the cloud database.

name: bucketName
desc: Input/Output [Optional]. The name of a GCS bucket with max length of 63 chars. If not set, a random UUID will be generated as bucket name.
meaning: The name of a storage bucket, randomly generated when not given.

name: entityName
desc: Input/Output [Optional]. Only needed for per-entity tenant GCP resources. During Deprovision API, the on-demand deletion will only cover the tenant GCP resources with the specified entity name.
meaning: A per customer name attached to tenant resources so they can be cleaned up.

name: kmsKeyReference
desc: Input/Output [Optional]. The KMS key name or the KMS grant name used for CMEK encryption. Only set this field when provisioning new GCS bucket. For existing GCS bucket, this field will be ignored because CMEK re-encryption is not supported.
meaning: The encryption key used when creating the storage bucket.

name: ttlDays
desc: Input/Output [Optional]. Only needed when the content in bucket need to be garbage collected within some amount of days.
meaning: How many days before the bucket's contents are deleted.

name: viewers
desc: Input/Output [Required]. IAM roles (viewer/admin) put on the bucket.
meaning: The access roles applied to the storage bucket.

name: members
desc: Input/Output [Required]. The member service accounts with the roles above. Note: placeholders are same as the resource above.
meaning: The service accounts granted the listed role.

name: resource
desc: Input/Output [Required]. The resource name that will be accessed by members, which also depends on resource_type. Note: placeholders are supported in resource names. For example, ${tpn} will be used when the tenant project number is not ready.
meaning: The resource that the listed accounts are allowed to reach.

name: resourceType
desc: Input/Output [Required]. Specifies the type of resource that will be accessed by members.
meaning: What kind of resource the access rule applies to.

name: role
desc: Input/Output [Required]. The role for members below.
meaning: The permission role granted to the listed accounts.

name: createDatabaseOptions
desc: Input [Optional]. The options to create a spanner database. Note: give the right options to ensure the right KMS key access audit logging and AxT logging in expected logging category.
meaning: Options used when creating a managed database.

name: kmsKeyReference
desc: Input [Optional]. The KMS key name or the KMS grant name used for CMEK encryption. Only set this field when provisioning new Infra Spanner databases. For existing Infra Spanner databases, this field will be ignored because CMEK re-encryption is not supported. For example, projects//locations//keyRings//cryptoKeys/
meaning: The encryption key used when creating a managed database.

name: sdlBundlePath
desc: Input [Required]. The file path to the spanner SDL bundle.
meaning: The file path to the database schema bundle.

name: spannerBorgServiceAccount
desc: Input [Optional]. The spanner borg service account for delegating the kms key to. For example, spanner-infra-cmek-nonprod@system.gserviceaccount.com, for the nonprod universe.
meaning: The service account allowed to use the encryption key for the database.

name: spannerUniverse
desc: Input [Required]. Every database in Spanner can be identified by the following path name: /span//:
meaning: Which database universe the instance lives in.

name: cmekCloudResourceName
desc: The cloud resource name for the CMEK encryption. For example, projects//locations/
meaning: The cloud resource name used for customer managed encryption.

name: cmekCloudResourceType
desc: The cloud resource type for the CMEK encryption. For example, contentwarehouse.googleapis.com/Location
meaning: The cloud resource type used for customer managed encryption.

name: cmekServiceName
desc: The service name for the CMEK encryption. For example, contentwarehouse.googleapis.com
meaning: The service name used for customer managed encryption.

name: serviceAccountEmail
desc: Output only. The service account email that has been created.
meaning: The email address of a service account that was created.

name: tag
desc: Input/Output [Optional]. The tag that configures the service account, as defined in google3/configs/production/cdpush/acl-zanzibar-cloud-prod/activation_grants/activation_grants.gcl. Note: The default P4 service account has the empty tag.
meaning: A tag describing how the service account is configured.

name: billingConfig
desc: Input/Output [Required]. The billing account properties to create the tenant project.
meaning: The billing account used to create the tenant project.

name: folder
desc: Input/Output [Required]. The folder that holds tenant projects and folder-level permissions will be automatically granted to all tenant projects under the folder. Note: the valid folder format is
meaning: The folder holding tenant projects, whose permissions they inherit.

name: policyBindings
desc: Input/Output [Required]. The policy bindings that are applied to the tenant project during creation. At least one binding must have the role
meaning: Access rules applied when the tenant project is created.

name: services
desc: Input/Output [Required]. The API services that are enabled on the tenant project during creation.
meaning: Which APIs are turned on for the tenant project.

name: cloudSqlInstances
desc: The CloudSQL instances that are provisioned under the tenant project.
meaning: The cloud database instances created inside the tenant project.

name: gcsBuckets
desc: The GCS buckets that are provisioned under the tenant project.
meaning: The storage buckets created inside the tenant project.

name: iamPolicyBindings
desc: The dynamic IAM bindings that are granted under the tenant project. Note: this should only add new bindings to the project if they don't exist and the existing bindings won't be affected.
meaning: The access rules granted inside the tenant project.

name: infraSpannerConfigs
desc: The Infra Spanner databases that are provisioned under the tenant project. Note: this is an experimental feature.
meaning: The managed databases created inside the tenant project.

name: tag
desc: Input/Output [Required]. The tag that uniquely identifies a tenant project within a tenancy unit. Note: for the same tenant project tag, all tenant manager operations should be idempotent.
meaning: A tag that uniquely names a tenant project within its group.

name: tenantProjectConfig
desc: The configurations of a tenant project.
meaning: The configuration used for a tenant project.

name: tenantProjectId
desc: Output only. The tenant project ID that has been created.
meaning: The id of the tenant project that was created.

name: tenantProjectNumber
desc: Output only. The tenant project number that has been created.
meaning: The number of the tenant project that was created.

name: tenantServiceAccounts
desc: The service account identities (or enabled API service's P4SA) that are expclicitly created under the tenant project (before JIT provisioning during enabled API services).
meaning: Service accounts explicitly created inside the tenant project.

name: p4ServiceAccounts
desc: A list of P4 service accounts (go/p4sa) to provision or deprovision.
meaning: Service accounts to create or remove for the tenant.

name: tenantProjectResources
desc: A list of tenant projects and tenant resources to provision or deprovision.
meaning: The tenant projects and resources to create or remove.

name: serviceAccountEmail
desc: Output only. The email address of the generated service account.
meaning: The email address of the generated tenant service account.

name: serviceName
desc: Input/Output [Required]. The service that the service account belongs to. (e.g. cloudbuild.googleapis.com for GCB service accounts)
meaning: Which service the tenant service account belongs to.

name: confidence
desc: The confidence of the tag, encoded to 14 bits (range [0, 16383]). Due to modeling details, a large number of tags become trustworthy with confidence greater than 0.001, so two bytes of precision are required.
meaning: How confident a shopping image tag is, packed into fourteen bits.

name: tag
desc: A Deep Tag enum in uint32 form.
meaning: Which shopping image tag this is, written as a number.

name: modelOutputs
desc: The set of outputs for a series of model versions. The size of this field should not extend beyond 4 at any time: two versions for slow-update track dependencies, and two versions for fast-update track dependencies.
meaning: Tag outputs from several versions of the shopping image models.

name: cropping
desc: We are looking to deploy a model for the Ads team to identify images with bad cropping. The model will be for Ads only and we will not populate the cropping field in CDS.
meaning: An ads only bad cropping tag that is not filled in for shopping data.

name: nfs
desc: Tag corresponds to the shopping non-family safe (nfs) image signal.
meaning: A tag marking a shopping image as not family safe.

name: overlay
desc: Tag corresponding to unwanted text overlay (watermarks, logos, promotional elements, artifacts, etc).
meaning: A tag marking unwanted text or watermarks laid over a shopping image.

name: textOverlay
desc: Tag corresponding to the text overlay classifier (watermarks, logos, promotional elements, artifacts, etc).
meaning: Tags from the classifier that spots text laid over shopping images.

name: NoTransientChecksum96
desc: Same as ContentChecksum96 but without transient boilerplate.
meaning: A content checksum computed after stripping changing boilerplate.

name: SimHash
desc: Deprecated. Use simhash_v2 and simhash_v2_significance instead.
meaning: A retired near duplicate hash replaced by a newer one.

name: simhashV2
desc: Simhash-v2 is generated by SimHashParseHandler, designed as a complete replacement of simhash-v1 (a.k.a. the original simhash above) from ApproxDupsParseHandler. Simhash-v2 uses a revised algorithm so that it is expected to work better in most cases than simhash-v1. They coexist in current transition period, then simhash-v1 will be retired.
meaning: A newer near duplicate hash of the page's content.

name: simhashV2Significance
desc: Simhash-v2-significance is used to describe the confidence about the corresponding simhash-v2 value. It is defined as the average absolute difference from zero of all internal state components when finalizing a simhash-v2 value in HashMultiSetDotCauchy. We used to compare the significance against some pre-defined threshold (default: 20) to get a boolean value "trusted_simhash_v2". However, it is possible that this field is missing while "simhash_v2" is present, in such case (
meaning: How trustworthy the near duplicate hash of the page is.

name: UrlEncoding
desc: See webutil/urlencoding
meaning: Which character encoding an alternate address uses.

name: ecnFp
desc: Fp96 of webmirror equivalence class as of last time this was exported.
meaning: A fingerprint of the duplicate cluster this alternate name belonged to.

name: ecnFp
desc: Fp96 of webmirror equivalence class as of last time this was exported.
meaning: A fingerprint of the duplicate cluster for this extra duplicate address.

name: url
desc: The url of the non-forwarding dup.
meaning: The address of a duplicate page that does not pass its data along.

name: ecn
desc: The name of the url's webmirror equivalence class.
meaning: The name of the duplicate cluster the address belongs to.

name: purposes
desc: The purpose(s) of the forwarding dup indicating if it is used for forwarding signal/anchors generally, or only for forwarding some specific signal (e.g. navboost), or for some other purposes (e.g., not for forwarding any data but for making "info:" complete). See indexing/dups/public/dups.h for more details.
meaning: Which data a duplicate passes to the main page, such as anchors or click boost.

name: rawPagerank
desc: Raw pagerank of the url.
meaning: The raw pagerank of the duplicate address.

name: repid
desc: The webmirror repid of the forwarding dup.
meaning: The internal duplicate cluster record id for the forwarding address.

name: url
desc: The url of the forwarding dup.
meaning: The address of the duplicate page that passes its data to this one.

name: urlencoding
desc: The encoding of the url (see webutil/urlencoding for details).
meaning: Which character encoding the duplicate address uses.

name: perLiveExperimentInfo
desc: List of necessary information for each live experiments.
meaning: The details attached to this document for each live experiment.

name: experimentId
desc: ID of a live experiment.
meaning: The id of the live experiment this document data belongs to.

name: partialCdoc
desc: Partial CDoc for a live experiment.
meaning: A partial copy of the document record used for a live experiment.

name: goldmineAnnotatorNames
desc: List of goldmine annotator updates present in the enclosing partial cdoc.
meaning: Names of the annotators that were updated in this partial document record.

name: imagesSignalNames
desc: List of images signal updates present in the enclosing partial cdoc. Images signal name for a images signal is the unique name for the signal according to SignalSpec.
meaning: Names of the image signals included in this partial document update.

name: lastFullIndexingInfo
desc: Contains last full indexing information for partial updates.
meaning: Bookkeeping about the last full indexing pass, kept alongside partial updates.

name: shouldLookupDocjoinsTier
desc: Which tier we should do cdoc lookup to merge partial cdocs. This uses the integer value of indexing.selection.CorpusId. NOT intended for other usage.
meaning: Which storage tier to read when merging partial document records.

name: shouldLookupDocjoinsVerticalCorpus
desc: Which vertical docjoin corpus we should do cdoc lookup to merge partial cdocs. This uses the string value of table name in google3/indexing/docjoins/spanner/schema/global_tables_data.sdl. For example, Voce and ShortVideo. NOT intended for other usage.
meaning: Which vertical document table to read when merging partial document records.

name: signalNames
desc: List of signal updates present in the enclosing partial cdoc. Signal name for a signal is unique name for the signal according to SignalSpec.
meaning: Names of the signals included in this partial document update.

name: id
desc: uint64 bring lots of issues, and string a better practice.
meaning: A string identifier for a concept.

name: mustangBytes
desc: Compact representation for Mustang storage. See image/search/utils/packed_crops.h for details on the packing format.
meaning: A packed binary form of image crop data for storage.

name: canonicalLexicalMid
desc: Mid for an entity that has lexical data (a LexiconEntry). See
meaning: An entity identifier for a word that has dictionary data.

name: personalReferenceType
desc: The manner in which the entity was referenced (e.g. "my hotel", "the airport").
meaning: How a person referred to something, such as 'my hotel' or 'the airport'.

name: referenceScore
desc: The strength of the personal reference. For example "my flight" may receive a high reference_score, whereas "the airport" may receive a low score.
meaning: How strongly a spoken phrase points at something personal to the user.

name: references
desc: A list of all references made. Empty if no personal references exist. Multiple references can be present when multiple references were made in a single query, or the type of reference was ambiguous.
meaning: The list of personal references found in a user's request.

name: subreferenceMetadata
desc: Subreference metadata for all compound references on this span.
meaning: Extra detail about compound personal references in a phrase.

name: contactAnnotationId
desc: Annotation ID of a contact annotation, e.g. a relationship set via Assistant. This ID is generated by People Write Server. It is used to delete Contact Annotations via People API.
meaning: An identifier for a saved contact relationship annotation.

name: emailIdentifier
desc: Only used if personal_data_provenance == PERSONAL_SOURCE_GMAIL. Used to create a link to the source email in the form: mail.google.com/mail/u/0/?extsrc=sync&client=h&plid={email_identifier}
meaning: An identifier used to link back to the source Gmail message.

name: eventId
desc: Populated for some footprints data sources; uniquely identifies the footprint that generated the personal data that this provenance is attached to.
meaning: An identifier for the stored user activity record behind this data.

name: sensitivity
desc: Sensitivity applying to this copley annotation.
meaning: How sensitive this personal annotation is.

name: mostCompoundResolvedEntities
desc: Resolved entities are sorted from highest resolution score to lowest.
meaning: Entities matched to a personal reference, ordered by match score.

name: mostNestedUnresolvedReference
desc: This is a merged representation of the compound reference having the most_compound_resolved_entities as an argument.
meaning: A merged view of the innermost personal reference that was not matched.

name: personalReferenceTypes
desc: Type of reference. There may be multiple for a single reference (e.g. relationship and contact).
meaning: The kinds of personal reference found in one phrase.

name: referenceScore
desc: Highest reference score for any references merged in this span.
meaning: The highest personal reference strength among phrases merged together.

name: relationshipLexicalInfo
desc: Only set for unresolved relationship references and can be used to get the canonical word for the relationship (e.g. "mother") in TTS.
meaning: Dictionary data for a relationship word so it can be spoken back.

name: mid
desc: Can be used with PKG Service for looking up metadata about this entity at fulfillment/GenX time.
meaning: An entity identifier for the thing a personal reference resolved to.

name: name
desc: Name of the entity represented by this resolution.
meaning: The name of the entity a personal reference resolved to.

name: resolutionScore
desc: A resolution score of 0 indicates that it did not resolve to a real entity.
meaning: How confidently a personal reference matched a real entity.

name: corpusScore
desc: Corpus specific score for an image
meaning: A per-corpus score for an image.

name: isSelectedForIndexing
desc: Whether an image was selected for indexing.
meaning: Whether the image was chosen to be indexed.

name: referrerDocid
desc: Set of referrers indexed with the image.
meaning: Identifiers of the pages indexed as carrying this image.

name: referrerUrls
desc: Set of referrer urls indexed with the image.
meaning: URLs of the pages indexed as carrying this image.

name: confidence
desc: To store confidence in the distribution in cases when total is not set.
meaning: How trustworthy the recorded spread of clicks by country is.

name: total
desc: To store total clicks on this page/domain.
meaning: The total number of clicks counted for the page or domain.

name: debug
desc: A non critical field to store debug info for a country attachment. Used in experiments and for debugging.
meaning: Free-text debugging notes about the country data.

name: countryidFromUgc
desc: Is true if the country attachment was computed through the UGC pipeline.
meaning: Whether the country data came from the user-generated content pipeline.

name: weightAboveIdealForLocalness
desc: If result is global, store weight above ideal, as a confidence signal. Used in query localness, cleared in production CountryAttachment.
meaning: A confidence number about how global a result is; cleared in production.

name: fromLanguageFallback
desc: Booleans to keep track of where the country-id of the page came from. These are used for debugging and/or unittests, and cleared in production.
meaning: A debug flag showing the country came from language; cleared in production.

name: salientCountries
desc: [Experimental]: Top salient countries for a doc. If a country can not be found on this field it can be considered that this doc is not relevant to it.
meaning: The countries a document is most relevant to.

name: relatedCountries
desc: two-letter(lower-case) countrycode, e.g. us countries that is related to, but not local to
meaning: Countries the page relates to without being local to them.

name: sitename
desc: Domain name of keys in filtering metro reducer class, used only by the intermediate mapreduces to produce filtered data.
meaning: A domain name used as a key inside intermediate batch jobs.

name: localCountryCodes
desc: Fields that actually store the country id in docjoins. The format of this data is defined in //i18n/identifiers/stableinternalregionconverter.cc. Converter defined there can be used to convert it to RegionCode format.
meaning: The stored numeric country codes for the page.

name: clickDistribution
desc: Store weighted click distribution for page level country-id classification.
meaning: How a page's clicks spread across countries, used to guess its country.

name: localCountries
desc: two-letter(lower-case) countrycode, e.g. us countries that is local to
meaning: The countries the page is considered local to.

name: geoLocations
desc: New MetroID: Now called GeoLocations since the locations could be sublocalities, cities or states. GeoLocations are always more fine grained than country. TODO (jayeshv): Once new MetroID/GeoLocations is launched everywhere, deleted old MetroID related fields.
meaning: The specific places, such as cities or states, tied to the page.

name: superGlobal
desc: Super global pages get lesser demotion than global pages. A document can only be either global or super_global but not both.
meaning: A flag marking a page as super global, which gets a smaller country demotion.

name: isValidForCountryRestrict
desc: Set to true if the local_countries field can be used for country restricts as well.
meaning: Whether the page's country list can be used for country-restricted searches.

name: documentLocationSource
desc: Specifies the origin of
meaning: Where the document's location information came from.

name: userVisibleCountryFromLogs
desc: This is used to store the visible country id computed from logs data
meaning: The country for the page worked out from log data.

name: metroIdList
desc: Metro locations: list of NavBoost feature V2 associated with a doc, along with the enclosing province. Metro locations with new tags.
meaning: Metro-area features tied to the page, with the surrounding province.

name: restrictCountries
desc: List of two-letter(lower-case) countrycodes(e.g. us) valid for restricts. Typically cloned out of local_countries if is_valid_for_country_restrict is set to true.
meaning: Country codes used to filter results by country.

name: debugSourceUrl
desc: Set to the signal source URLs when merging country signals in Alexandria during sitemoves. Essentially if sites A and B move to C, and we merge A and B's signal to C, in the countryattachment signal C will have URL A and B as source_url. Only used for debugging and it doesn't show up in docjoins.
meaning: Source URLs kept only for debugging after site moves.

name: wmxCountry
desc: Country specified for a web-site through webmaster console.
meaning: The country a site owner declared in the webmaster console.

name: metroNavboost
desc: Metro navboost: list of (NavBoost feature V2, navboost float) pairs.
meaning: Per-metro NavBoost multipliers to apply to the page.

name: urlPatternBasedLanguage
desc: Language and country extracted using the URL pattern map.
meaning: Language and country guessed from the shape of the URL.

name: metroLocationId
desc: Metro level data. metro_location_id stores geotokens for metro restricts.
meaning: Tokens that let searches be restricted to a metro area.

name: userVisibleLocalCountry
desc: This is the country id we show to users on the result page. This is kept different from country demotion country id because we dont want to expose our backoff and url based detection algorithm - also we want to be ultra conservative in showing this.
meaning: The country shown to users on the results page for this page.

name: clickRadius50Percent
desc: The radius (in miles) around the assigned location that the document gets 50% of its clicks.
meaning: The distance around the page's location that covers half of its clicks.

name: confidence
desc: Confidence on the location. Ranges in [0.0, 1.0]. Cleared during index creation.
meaning: How sure the system is about the location; removed when the index is built.

name: confidencePercent
desc: Confidence mapped to [0, 100]. Converted to integer for efficient storage. Populated during index creation.
meaning: How sure the system is about the assigned location, on a 0 to 100 scale.

name: internalId
desc: Used for compressed docloc data. In compressed data, instead of location_info, only an integer ID for that LocationInfo is stored. A separate lookup table is used to get full LocationInfo from the internal ID.
meaning: A short lookup number standing in for full location details.

name: propagatedFromASubpage
desc: True if this location is assigned to one of the subpages, and not to the page itself. If the total number of locations assigned to all the subpages of a page is small (usually up to 5), then that page also gets assigned those locations, and this flag is set for those locations.
meaning: Whether the location came from a subpage rather than the page itself.

name: isNonLocationSpecific
desc: This will be set to true for documents which receive several clicks but are not assigned any location because the click distribution is flat. Typical examples are global sites like facebook.com, chains like walmart.com, informational sites like wikipedia.org etc. This flag is not propagated to deeper pages since this signal is meant to indicate that a website or a part of website is conclusively non-local, so propagating this information to deeper pages does not make sense. If this flag is set,
meaning: A flag for pages that get many clicks but belong to no particular place.

name: propagationDepthFromParent
desc: Depth of the URL from it's nearest parent in GeoLocation data. Webpages inherhit locations from their parent pages. For example, if foo.com/a is assigned location L1, and foo.com/a/b is not assigned any location, then
meaning: How many URL levels away the parent page that supplied the location is.

name: center
desc: The latitude and longitude of the conceptual center of the location. For cities, this would be the center of the downtown, or maybe the location of city hall. For states and countries it might be the capital city. But there are no guarantees and this may be any random point inside the location.
meaning: The latitude and longitude of the middle of a place.

name: country
desc: Human readable name hierarchy. Only the relevant fields will be present. For example for city GeoLocations, sub_locality field will not be present. Cleared during index creation.
meaning: The readable country name for a place; removed when the index is built.

name: enclosingStateFeatureId
desc: Oyster feature ID of the enclosing state. Cleared during index creation.
meaning: The map identifier of the surrounding state; removed when the index is built.

name: featureId
desc: Oyster feature ID of the location. Cleared during index creation.
meaning: The map identifier of a place; removed when the index is built.

name: stateIdFprint
desc: 32 bit fingerprint of the feature id of the state of this location. For cities and sub-localities it will be the enclosing state. For state locations, it will be fingerprint of the feture-id of the location itself. Populated during index creation.
meaning: A short fingerprint of the state a place sits in.

name: type
desc: Type of the location (sub-locality, city, state etc).
meaning: What kind of place this is, such as a city or a state.

name: enclosingProvinceGeotoken
desc: The enclosing_province_geotoken is a 32 bit fingerprint of the state encosing the (metro) id. MetroId's can span multiple states. Enclosing geotoken is filled in with the state name for disambiguation. ProvinceGeotoken field is different as it indicates an "interest". Format: 32 bit fingerprint(
meaning: A fingerprint of the state around a metro area, used to tell metros apart.

name: id
desc: A 32 bit navboost v2 feature id encoding (country, language, metro). NavBoosterUtils class (google3/quality/navboost/nav_booster_utils.h) provides functions to decode this feature.
meaning: A packed identifier combining country, language and metro area.

name: navboost
desc: This is the multiplier to apply to the result for this locale & query. NOTE: This is for serving purposes only and should not be populated in the index.
meaning: The multiplier to apply to a result for a given locale and query.

name: ClusterId
desc: Fingerprint combination of all urls in a cluster
meaning: A fingerprint identifying a cluster of related news URLs.

name: ClusterSize
desc: This is the X in the "and X related >>" link on headlines and search results
meaning: How many related articles are in the cluster, shown in the related link.

name: ClusterTimeStamp
desc: When was this clustered (needed for keeping last X iterations around and discarding earlier ones)
meaning: When the news clustering ran, used to drop older rounds.

name: cropBytes
desc: Compact representation for indexing, see creatism::CropBitmap for details on the packing format.
meaning: A packed binary form of an image crop box for indexing.

name: x0
desc: Pixels version of the DeepCropIndexing bytes, this corresponds to the crop box for a given image (based input image size and desired aspect ratio).
meaning: A pixel edge of the crop box chosen for an image.

name: avgTermWeight
desc: The average weighted font size of a term in the doc body
meaning: The average weighted font size of words in the page body.

name: badTitle
desc: Missing or meaningless title
meaning: A flag that the page's title is missing or meaningless.

name: languages
desc: A Language enum value. See: go/language-enum
meaning: The languages the document is written in.

name: leadingtext
desc: Leading text information generated by google3/quality/snippets/leadingtext/leadingtext-detector.cc
meaning: Information about the text leading into the page's content, from snippet code.

name: numTokens
desc: The number of tokens, tags and punctuations in the tokenized contents. This is an approximation of the number of tokens, tags and punctuations we end up with in mustang, but is inexact since we drop some tokens in mustang and also truncate docs at a max cap.
meaning: An approximate count of words, tags and punctuation in the page.

name: proseRestrict
desc: The restricts for CSE structured search.
meaning: Restriction tags used by custom structured search.

name: timestamp
desc: The time CDocProperties::StartDocument() is called, encoded as seconds past the epoch (Jan 1, 1970). This value is always refreshed and not reused.
meaning: The time document processing started, refreshed on every run.

name: title
desc: Extracted from the title tag of the content. This is typically extracted by TitleMetaCollector defined at google3/segindexer/title-meta-collector.h. Please see its documentation for the format and other caveats.
meaning: The page title taken from the title tag.

name: inRangeBitstream
desc: in_range_bitstream is the string produced by range coder, while out_of_range_bitstream corresponds to the overflow stream, which is used whenever a quantized value is out of range. See
meaning: The compressed byte stream produced by the feature encoder.

name: extra
desc: If extra is present it must be of the same length as value.
meaning: Optional extra values attached alongside each feature value.

name: value
desc: Dense data.
meaning: The list of raw numbers making up a dense machine learning feature.

name: extra
desc: If extra is present it must be of the same length as value.
meaning: Optional extra values attached alongside each token value.

name: extra
desc: Extra information for this particular FeatureSetData (example timestamp of this frame in the video). (Almost never used).
meaning: Optional extra information about one set of extracted features.

name: feature
desc: The following can have multiple FeatureSetElement(s) Each of these FeatureSetElement correspond to the various feature groups. One concrete example is the way these features are generated - example audio, video or OCR.
meaning: The groups of extracted features, such as audio, video or text in images.

name: label
desc: Labels for this particular FeatureSetData. (Almost never used). Only interesting when you have (for example) frame level labels.
meaning: Labels attached to one set of extracted features, such as per frame.

name: name
desc: A name for the feature group: example "AUDIO", "VIDEO", "OCR", etc.
meaning: The name of a feature group, such as audio or video.

name: element
desc: FeatureSetData contains the features. In most scenarios, you only have one element. However, multiple elements are appropriate in case of videos where each element may correspond to a frame in the video.
meaning: The feature records in a sequence, one per video frame when needed.

name: extra
desc: Some extra information about this FeatureSetDataSequence. (Almost never used).
meaning: Optional extra information about a sequence of feature records.

meaning: Which crawler user agent fetched the URL, such as desktop or smartphone.

name: ContentLength

name: ContentType
desc: See enum ContentType in //depot/google3/webutil/http/content-type.proto.
meaning: The content type of the fetched document, such as HTML or PDF.

name: CrawlTime
desc: Seconds since Unix epoch.
meaning: When the page was crawled, in seconds since 1970.

name: Encoding
desc: See //depot/google3/i18n/encodings/public/encodings.h Encoding of representation
meaning: The character encoding of the stored content.

name: HasHttpHeader

meaning: Whether the stored content includes the HTTP headers.

name: Language

meaning: The language the page content is written in.

name: OriginalEncoding

meaning: The page's character encoding before it was converted to UTF-8.

name: Representation
desc: Possibly compressed for old documents. It is not compressed for docjoins produced by Raffia after ~2012.
meaning: The stored copy of the crawled page content.

name: UncompressedLength
desc: Historically present if Representation is compressed.
meaning: The size of the content before compression.

name: VisualType
desc: Whether the content was visual right-to-left, and if so, what type of visual document it is. Must be one of the values in enum VisualType from google3/repository/rtl/visualtype.h Default is NOT_VISUAL_DOCUMENT. See
meaning: Whether the document is a right to left visual layout, and of what kind.

name: crawledFileSize
desc: Crawled file size of the original document.
meaning: The file size of the document as it was crawled.

name: encodedGeometryAnnotations
desc: GeometryAnnotations, encoded with GeometryUtil::DeltaEncode() to reduce disk space usage. Use GeometryUtil::DeltaDecode() to decode this field.
meaning: Page layout geometry stored in a compressed form.

name: Category
desc: encoded in UTF8
meaning: The web directory category the page was listed under.

name: Description
desc: encoded in UTF8
meaning: The web directory's written description of the page.

name: Identifier
desc: "gwd", etc.
meaning: Which web directory the entry came from.

name: Language
desc: go/language-enum
meaning: The language of the directory entry.

name: Title
desc: encoded in UTF8
meaning: The title the web directory gave the page.

name: TitleScore

meaning: A deprecated score for the directory title that nothing populates.

name: UncompressedLength
desc: present iff rep is compressed
meaning: The size of the original content before compression.

name: debugInfo
desc: Per-doc debug information.
meaning: Debug text about the document for engineers.

name: info
desc: Servlet-specific response info.
meaning: A container for response data specific to the serving code.

name: rankingSnippet
desc: The experimental ranking snippet field. This will be populated only when
meaning: An experimental snippet field that is only filled in some of the time.

name: snippet

However, for very old browsers, gws may insert break tags after each snippet line. This field is confusing and poorly named; "snippet_line" would be better. In particular, note that this does not return multiple snippets for a result. Nor are these fields the individual tidbits of the snippet.
meaning: The lines of snippet HTML shown beneath the result.

name: title

name: wwwSnippetResponse
desc: Snippet-specific members (tag ids 16+, must be optional!) Example: optional NewContentResponse new_response;
meaning: A pointer to the web snippet response message.

name: allowsGuestCheckout

meaning: Whether the place lets people book without an account.

name: isAsynchronousRestaurantReservation
desc: Whether or not this local entity supports asynchronous restaurant reservations, through the above restaurant_reservation_url.
meaning: Whether the place's reservations are confirmed later instead of instantly.

name: restaurantReservationUrl
desc: URL for the Madden restaurant reservation flow, e.g. for display in a WebView. Not populated if restaurant reservations are not supported for the local entity.
meaning: A link to the restaurant booking flow for this place.

meaning: A reserved, unused flag on a map access point.

name: canExit

meaning: A reserved, unused flag on a map access point.

meaning: The id of the map feature that defines this entry point.

name: featureType

For access points to TYPE_SEGMENT features, this is used to find to find the nearest segment of the given type.
meaning: What kind of map feature the entry point belongs to.

name: levelFeatureId
