desc: This holds the list of languages spoken within a locale.
meaning: The list of languages spoken within a locale.

name: localizationPolicyId
desc: The ID of the localization policy (from googledata/geostore/localization/localization_policies.textpb) to apply to features that have this locale as their best match locale. Localization policy IDs are arbitrary identifiers that uniquely distinguish a set of language-selection rules.
meaning: Identifier of the language-selection policy applied to a locale.

name: borderSegment
desc: All the border segments which make up this logical border. Border segments must be TYPE_BORDER features which have the same left/right features. This is a many-to-many bidirectional relationship, so any border segment within this list might be part of another logical border.
meaning: The border segments that make up a logical border.

name: status
desc: The logical border status identifies its legal status. This is similar to the BorderStatus present within border segments, but applies to the group as a whole.
meaning: The legal status of a logical border taken as a whole.

name: googleUrl
desc: The FIFE url associated with the media. NOTE: This FIFE URL must be PII-free, see go/product-catalogue-photo-storage
meaning: The image hosting URL for a piece of media.

name: mediaKey
desc: The mediaKey associated with the media. NOTE: This media key must be PII-free, see go/product-catalogue-photo-storage
meaning: The internal key identifying a piece of media.

name: flag
desc: clang-format on The set of flags that apply to this name.
meaning: Flags describing properties of a place name, such as being abbreviated.

name: language
desc: The external form of a Google International Identifiers Initiative (III) LanguageCode object. See google3/i18n/identifiers/languagecode.h for details. These strings should be treated as opaque blobs. You can use LanguageCodeConverter::FromOther to convert the string to a LanguageCode reference. You can then call methods on the LanguageCode class to extract language/script/region subtags (if any). See also
meaning: The language a place name is written in.

name: metadata
desc: Field-level metadata for this name. NOTE: there are multiple NameProto fields in the Geo Schema. Metadata here is only expected to be present on FeatureProto.name[].
meaning: Per-field bookkeeping metadata for a place name.

name: shortText
desc: The short name text (UTF-8 encoding). Acronyms/abbreviations should be consistently used, for example "NE 57th St" rather than "Northeast 57th Street", "N.E 57th St." or some other variant. This field should be populated with the chosen canonical version of the shortened name, based on per-term transformations. For feature specific abbreviations (such as 'CA' for 'California'), one should define a separate name with FLAG_ABBREVIATED set. For other variants of the sh
meaning: The shortened, abbreviated form of a place name.

name: temporaryData
desc: A place for clients to attach arbitrary data to a name. Never set in MapFacts.
meaning: Scratch space for clients to attach data to a name; never set in production map data.

name: text
desc: The name text (UTF-8 encoding). Acronyms/abbreviations should be fully expanded, for example "Northeast 57th Street" rather than "NE 57th St". They can be shortened at display or geocode time. This decision prevents ambiguity over such issues as whether "St" represents "Street" or "Saint". However, it pushes language-specific knowledge into code. We will have libraries and data files to contract acronyms/abbreviations at run-time.
meaning: The full, spelled-out name of a map feature.

name: instance
desc: This is the 'public' section of the GConceptInstance.
meaning: The public portion of a category concept assignment.

name: isInferred
desc: RESERVED
meaning: Reserved placeholder flag on a raw category instance.

name: exception
desc: Date delimited exceptions to the typical recurring opening hours. May only be present if regular weekly hours are also specified.
meaning: Dates when a place's hours differ from its usual weekly schedule.

name: regularHours
desc: Typical recurring opening hours, expressed as a weekly schedule. NOTE: this field was introduced to have a more client-friendly format for representing weekly hours but, as of November 2018, it's not used for the main opening hours of TYPE_ESTABLISHMENT features (instead, the data is stored in the
meaning: A place's usual weekly opening hours.

name: temporaryClosure
desc: Records temporary status changes of the feature, such as remodel, vacation, etc.: the feature is temporarily (but not permanently) unavailable. See go/geo-schema-reference:operational-lifecycle#temporary-closure for guidance on interpreting this data and constraints on writing it. NOTE: Order of the TemporaryClosureProtos is
meaning: Records that a place is temporarily closed, for example for remodeling.

name: countryCode
desc: The two-letter ISO 3166-1 country code corresponding to the domain this status override applies to, when rendering the border polyline.
meaning: The country whose map view this border status override applies to.

name: status
desc: The override status, from the BorderStatus enumeration. The value here must be different from the main status (otherwise there's no point in providing the override).
meaning: The overriding legal status used when drawing a border for one country.

name: allowanceType
desc: The type of parking for this allowance. Allowance details only apply to the type of parking specified.
meaning: The kind of parking that an allowance covers.

name: isDiscount
desc: If true, this allowance represents a discount rather than an individual rate; any rate values specified in this allowance describe a discount to be applied to the non-discount allowances in the ParkingProto.
meaning: Whether this parking allowance describes a discount rather than a rate.

name: minPurchaseForValidation
desc: If this rate requires validation, this expresses the minimum purchase required for validation in each applicable currency. Should have an ID of /measurement_unit/money_value and consist of two properties: one with an ID of /measurement_unit/money_value/amount and a float value with the amount, and another with the ID /measurement_unit/money_value/currency and an ID value with the MID of the proper currency (from the /finance/currency type). A value of 0 suggests that no purchase is required. If
meaning: Minimum purchase needed to get parking validated, per currency.

name: permitType
desc: Any additional details about the permit type; e.g. “Zone A”. In any local languages. Should only be set if allowance_type is PERMIT.
meaning: Extra detail about the parking permit required, such as a zone name.

name: serviceType
desc: The types of services that this parking allowance applies to. For instance, some cities have streets that only allow traditional taxis to pick up passengers.
meaning: Which services, such as taxis, a parking allowance applies to.

name: timeBasedRate
desc: Describes the rate structures. Each TimeBasedRateProto defines a rate which may apply based on a particular arrival, departure or utilization time; for example, one rate might apply if arriving before 9am, and another might apply regardless of arrival or departure time.
meaning: Parking rates that depend on arrival, departure or duration.

name: vehicleType
desc: Restrictions on which vehicle type(s) the allowance applies to. By default, the allowance applies to any vehicle types.
meaning: Which vehicle types a parking allowance applies to.

name: allowance
desc: Describes the parking allowances for the feature, which are the situations and requirements under which one is permitted to park at the feature’s parking facilities, or discounts that a user may be eligible for.
meaning: The conditions under which parking is permitted at a place.

name: openingHours
desc: Hours in which the parking facility is open; that is, permits both arrivals and departures of the facility. Should only be set on compounds (i.e. parking lots or garages); roads are considered to always be “open,” though parking at certain times may be prohibited via restrictions. If unset on a compound, this suggests we don’t know the opening hours, or they are the same as the hours of the entity for which this feature offers parking facilities.
meaning: The hours during which a parking facility is open.

name: parkingAvailable
desc: Indicates whether long-term parking is available at the feature; if true, long-term parking is available at the feature and parking allowances may be present on this feature, or parking_provider_feature may indicate deferred parking feature(s). If false, this is an explicit statement that there is no long-term parking associated with this feature. If unset, we don't know whether there is long-term parking associated with this feature. If false or unset, only additional restrictions or short-term
meaning: Whether long-term parking is available at a place.

name: parkingProviderFeature
desc: If empty, indicates that the feature containing this ParkingProto provides parking facilities, which are described by this proto. If nonempty, indicates that the feature with this ParkingProto does not contain parking facilities itself, but visitors of this feature may use the parking available to the referent feature(s). The referent feature(s) may themselves contain parking facilities or defer to other features. A ParkingProto may defer parking details to another feature, but still include its
meaning: Other places whose parking visitors of this place may use.

name: restriction
desc: Describes any parking restrictions that apply to this feature. Should only be set on road segments for which parking is explicitly prohibited for some or all times; for roads which do not prohibit parking and for all other facilities, the ability to park should be expressed using allowances. In the instance that both a restriction and an allowance applies at a given time, restrictions always have precedence over the same parking allowances. However, explicit short-term allowances (PICKUP_GOODS,
meaning: Parking restrictions that apply to a road or place.

name: restrictedHours
desc: Times at which parking is prohibited.
meaning: The times during which parking is prohibited.

name: restrictionType
desc: clang-format on The type of restriction that applies at this time.
meaning: The kind of parking restriction that applies.

name: serviceType
desc: The types of services that this parking restriction applies to. We expect most parking restrictions to apply to all services, but some airports have specific rideshare parking or taxi parking zones.
meaning: Which services a parking restriction applies to.

name: vehicleType
desc: The types of vehicles that this parking restriction applies to. For instance, some streets may allow motorcycles to park but not automobiles or trucks.
meaning: Which vehicle types a parking restriction applies to.

name: prominenceMeters
desc: Topographic prominence in meters: the height of the peak’s summit above the lowest contour line encircling it and no higher summit.
meaning: The topographic prominence of a mountain peak in meters.

name: angleDegrees
desc: This value specifies the angle of the crosswalk. Zero degrees represents a crosswalk perpendicular to the direction of travel, towards the right side of the segment. The crosswalk angle, winds clockwise. Range [-90, 90]. The following crosswalk would have a 15 degree angle: / / <--/-------------------------------- / /
meaning: The angle of a crosswalk relative to the direction of travel.

name: crossAnywhere
desc: This value enables crossing anywhere (not just at the segment’s endpoint), typically used on long, low-traffic residential streets. This attribute is only respected for trivial segment -> sibling routes. All other routes can cross at a MapFacts intersection.
meaning: Whether pedestrians may cross the street anywhere along it.

name: crossingType
desc: Crossing type is used as a restriction and can also be used for rendering.
meaning: The type of pedestrian crossing.

name: offset
desc: The crossing offset defines a fraction between the distance from the segment endpoint to the centerline of the crosswalk and the length of the segment. For example, the segment length is 20 meters and the distance from segment end to center of crosswalk is 2 meters, the value of offset will be 0.1.
meaning: How far along the road segment the crosswalk sits, as a fraction.

name: restriction
desc: Restrictions for this crossing (such as constructions on the crosswalk). They must not have subpath or travel_mode.
meaning: Restrictions on a pedestrian crossing, such as construction.

name: width
desc: This value defines the full width of the crossing in the direction perpendicular to the direction which pedestrians walk on the crossing (in meters). The crossing is allowed to "spill" into the next segment (0.5 * width can be greater than the offset). Cannot be a negative value.
meaning: The width of a pedestrian crossing in meters.

name: dashLengthMeters
desc: Applicable for DASHED and DOTTED_DASHED lines.
meaning: Length of each dash in a dashed road line.

name: gapColor
desc: This should be rarely needed, but can represent patterns of alternating colors.
meaning: Color used in the gaps of an alternating road line pattern.

name: gapLengthMeters
desc: Applicable for DASHED, DOTTED, and DOTTED_DASHED lines.
meaning: Length of the gaps in a dashed or dotted road line.

name: paintColor
desc: Color for the painted elements. Applicable to all types.
meaning: The paint color of a road marking.

name: physicalLineToken
desc: A token that can be used to identify the version of the data about this marker line.
meaning: A token identifying the version of a road marker line's data.

name: radiansPerMeter
desc: Curvature in radians per meter. Negative is a curve to the left and positive is a curve to the right.
meaning: How sharply a road curves, and in which direction.

name: startPointFraction
desc: How far along the line this curvature value starts to apply, in the format of decimal between 0 and 1.
meaning: Where along a line a curvature value starts to apply.

name: metadata
desc: NOTE: If removing metadata, remove 'option objc_class_prefix = "GS";' together. See cl/189921100. Field-level metadata for this point. NOTE: there are multiple PointProto fields in the Geo Schema. Metadata here is only expected to be present on FeatureProto.point[] and FeatureProto.center.
meaning: Per-field bookkeeping metadata for a map point.

name: temporaryData
desc: A place for clients to attach arbitrary data to a point. Never set in MapFacts.
meaning: Scratch space for clients to attach data to a point; never set in production map data.

name: altitudeMeters
desc: Altitude of this point is assumed to be relative to the ground level.
meaning: Height of a point above ground level in meters.

name: capital
desc: Many political regions have a conceptual center (capitals of a country or a top-level division are examples). If set, the target feature must be a TYPE_LOCALITY feature.
meaning: The locality that serves as a political region's capital.

name: claim
desc: Feature IDs of the features claimed by this feature's government that are not necessarily included in the feature's geometry.
meaning: Features claimed by this region's government but outside its mapped shape.

name: grossDomesticProductUsdMillions
desc: The Gross Domestic Product of the political region measured in millions of current United States dollars. It must not be negative.
meaning: The region's gross domestic product in millions of US dollars.

name: literacyPercent
desc: Percentage of population that are literate within a political region. It must be between 0 and 100.
meaning: Share of a political region's population that is literate.

name: population
desc: The number of people in this political region. This field is intended to store accurate population, not an estimation such as representative value for population range. It must not be negative.
meaning: The number of people living in a political region.

name: metadata
desc: Field-level metadata for this polyline. NOTE: there are multiple PolyLineProto fields in the Geo Schema. Metadata here is only expected to be present on FeatureProto.polyline[].
meaning: Per-field bookkeeping metadata for a polyline shape.

name: temporaryData
desc: A place for clients to attach arbitrary data to a polyline. Never set in MapFacts.
meaning: Scratch space for clients to attach data to a polyline; never set in production map data.

name: vertex
desc: A sequence of vertices connected by geodesics (the equivalent of straight lines on the sphere). Adjacent vertices are connected by the shorter of the two geodesics that connect them, i.e. all edges are 180 degrees or less. Note that the edge definition becomes numerically unstable as the arc length approaches 180 degrees. Polylines are generally expected to be non-self-intersecting, but any such restriction is imposed by the user of the polyline rather than the polyline itself.
meaning: The ordered points that make up a polyline shape.

name: baseMeters
desc: The polygon loops above are basically flat: each point has a latitude and a longitude but no altitude. We don't want to build real 3D models here, but we do want to be able to generate 2.5D models. A 2.5D model is built by translating the flat polygon upward some distance (base) then extruding it upward some additional distance (height). The elevation of the bottom of the extruded polygon (above ground level).
meaning: How high above ground an extruded map polygon starts.

name: encoded
desc: Encoding of the polygon using S2Polygon::Encode()'s compressed representation.
meaning: The polygon's shape stored in a compressed encoding.

name: heightMeters
desc: The distance from the bottom of the extruded polygon to the top.
meaning: How tall an extruded map polygon is, from its base to its top.

name: metadata
desc: Field-level metadata for this polygon.
meaning: Bookkeeping metadata attached to a map polygon.

name: temporaryData
desc: A place for clients to attach arbitrary data to a polygon. Never set in MapFacts.
meaning: Scratch space where clients can hang arbitrary data on a polygon; never set in production map data.

name: unsuitableForDisplay
desc: Some polygons are known to be rough proxies for a feature's "real" polygonal representation. Such polygons are generally unsuitable for display. Rendering clients should not show these in most cases. Polygons unsuitable for display do have other uses, such as user location or containment analysis, or as an input to learning algorithms. This is an orthogonal concept to FeatureProto.synthetic_geometry, which only pertains to the method by which a polygon was created, rather than its fide
meaning: Marks a map polygon as a rough approximation that should not be drawn on the map.

name: altitude
desc: The height of the pose. A positive height is above the WGS-84 ellipsoid in meters; negative is below.
meaning: Height of a camera pose above or below the reference ellipsoid, in meters.

name: index
desc: The index of the PoseProto in a list of PoseProtos.
meaning: Position of this pose within a list of poses.

name: lat
desc: The latitude of the pose in degrees [-90, 90].
meaning: Latitude of a camera pose in degrees.

name: lng
desc: The longitude of the pose in degrees (-180,180].
meaning: Longitude of a camera pose in degrees.

name: pitch
desc: The rotation around the longitude line East tangent in degrees [-90, 90].
meaning: Up and down tilt angle of a camera pose.

name: roll
desc: The rotation around the latitude line North tangent in degrees (-180, 180].
meaning: Sideways tilt angle of a camera pose.

name: yaw
desc: The rotation around the Up vector, from North, in degrees (-180, 180].
meaning: Compass heading of a camera pose, measured from north.

name: cholesterol
desc: Cholesterol information for a given food dish.
meaning: Cholesterol content listed for a dish on a restaurant menu.

name: protein
desc: Protein information for a given food dish.
meaning: Protein content listed for a dish on a restaurant menu.

name: sodium
desc: Sodium information for a given food dish.
meaning: Sodium content listed for a dish on a restaurant menu.

name: totalCarbohydrate
desc: Carbohydrate information for a given food dish.
meaning: Carbohydrate content listed for a dish on a restaurant menu.

name: totalFat
desc: Fat information for a given food dish.
meaning: Fat content listed for a dish on a restaurant menu.

name: unit
desc: Unit of the given calories information.
meaning: The unit that a menu item's calorie figure is expressed in.

name: unit
desc: Unit of the given nutrition information.
meaning: The unit that a menu item's nutrition figure is expressed in.

name: priceList
desc: The actual food menus. This is a repeated field because a restaurant may offer multiple menus, e.g. for different language or for different available time, such as holidays vs non-holidays.
meaning: The actual menus a place offers, one entry per menu.

name: priceListUrl
desc: All URLs that give price list information for this establishment. For food menus, this would represent menu_urls. Note that this field is a repeated list of UrlListProtos. Each UrlListProto instance in the list is intended to hold lists of URLs that are translations of the same URL.
meaning: Web addresses where a business's menu or price list can be found.

name: status
desc: Message containing metadata about the verified status of the PriceInfo. Only verified listings should be displayed.
meaning: Whether a business's price list has been verified enough to be shown.

name: id
desc: IDs are intended to be unique identifiers of PriceInfoLists, Sections, and Menu items. This is enforced by the ID_DUPLICATE_PRICE_LIST_ID lint.
meaning: Unique identifier for a menu, menu section, or menu item.

name: language
desc: The external form of a Google International Identifiers Initiative (III) LanguageCode object. See google3/i18n/identifiers/languagecode.h for details. We place extra restrictions on languages in addition to what the III library requires. See go/geo-schema-reference/feature-properties/languages.
meaning: Language code for a menu name entry.

name: aggregatorId
desc: For third party lists, represents the ID of the aggregator which provided this data. Optional.
meaning: Identifier of the third party aggregator that supplied a price list.

name: availableTime
desc: The time period when this price list is available. Establishments are not required to give available_time for any given price list, however, when this field is not set, the price list is understood as available any time the establishment is open.
meaning: The hours or dates during which a given menu or price list applies.

name: cuisines
desc: Cuisine information if the location the price lists attached to is an eligible feature for a food menu price list. Cuisine information should also only show up in a food price list.
meaning: Cuisine types associated with a restaurant's food menu.

name: nameInfo
desc: The repeated name_info field is for price lists listed in multiple languages. When a price list has no names or descriptions, the size of the repeated field name_info may be 0. There should be at most one name_info for any given language.
meaning: Names and descriptions of a price list, one per language.

name: section
desc: Each price list may have multiple sections. Note that these sections within the same price list should most times contain only the same type of items for sale, e.g. all sections should usually contain only food items if the enclosing price list is representing food menu. However, sometimes such a requirement may be wrong, for example, McDonald's may sell burgers as well as toys, and the toys may be in its own section. Thus we don't enforce any requirement that all sections contain only the same
meaning: The sections a menu or price list is divided into.

name: sourceUrl
desc: Where this price list comes from. If set, this must also be a member of the price_list_url field, and represents translations of a single URL.
meaning: The web address a price list was taken from.

name: callToAction
desc: Call to action for the section.
meaning: An action prompt, such as an order button, attached to a menu section.

name: foodItem
desc: To store food and drink items when the containing PriceListSectionProto is a food menu section.
meaning: The food and drink items listed in a menu section.

name: item
desc: To store any items when the containing PriceListSectionProto is not food / legacy services.
meaning: The non-food items listed in a price list section.

name: itemType
desc: This has to have at most one value.
meaning: What kind of items a price list section contains.

name: language
desc: The external form of a Google International Identifiers Initiative (III) LanguageCode object. See google3/i18n/identifiers/languagecode.h for details. We place extra restrictions on languages in addition to what the III library requires. See go/geo-schema-reference/feature-properties/languages. When set, represents the language of the section and its items. Any section and item level name infos must match this language. Optional.
meaning: Language code for a menu section and the items inside it.

name: media
desc: One or more media items (photos, videos, etc.) describing this section / category.
meaning: Photos or videos illustrating a menu section or category.

name: nameInfo
desc: The repeated name_info field is for price list sections listed in multiple languages. When a price list section has no names or descriptions, the size of the repeated field name_info may be 0. There should be at most one name_info for any given language.
meaning: Names and descriptions of a menu section, one per language.

name: currency
desc: Currency code for the price range: a valid currency code from i18n/identifiers/currencycode.h. Lower and upper price are both assumed to use the same currency.
meaning: Currency used for both ends of a price range.

name: lowerPrice
desc: This message allows unbounded price ranges. e.g. Lower_price is undefined. At least one of the two prices must be set for the price range to be meaningful.
meaning: The bottom end of a price range, which may be left open.

name: units
desc: clang-format on
meaning: A units field in the price range record; the description is only a formatting comment.

name: propertyId
desc: The property ID whose value status is defined by this proto.
meaning: Which map feature property this value status record refers to.

name: dataset
desc: The dataset from which this the referenced data was created. The content of this string will be determined by the data provider, and may encode extra information, such as data confidence.
meaning: Name of the supplier dataset the referenced map data came from.

name: provider
desc: The data provider from which the referenced data was generated.
meaning: Name of the data provider that supplied the referenced map data.

name: signal
desc: A list of signals. Each one is extracted separately by a SignalExtractor.
meaning: The list of extracted signals used to rank a map feature.

name: signalMixerType
desc: The signal mixer that was used to calculate the rank.
meaning: Which mixing method combined the signals into a map feature's rank.

name: metadata
desc: Field-level metadata for this signal.
meaning: Bookkeeping metadata attached to a map ranking signal.

name: rank
desc: A value in the range [0, 1] estimating Oyster Rank according to this signal. Non-provider specific signals (e.g. SIGNAL_POPULATION) are interpreted by some common code in the ranking pipeline. Because of that, data providers should leave this field empty when setting such signals (so that the rank assignment can be uniform across all features regardless of contributing data providers). On the other hand, provider-specific signals (e.g. SIGNAL_ZENRIN_CITY_CATEGORY) are required to specify the ran
meaning: A zero to one estimate of a map feature's prominence from one signal.

name: rawScalar
desc: The raw scalar value that was used to compute 'rank' above. The meaning of this attribute changes depending on the signal type.
meaning: The raw number that a map feature's rank estimate was computed from.

name: rawString
desc: The raw string value that was used to compute 'rank' above. The meaning of this attribute changes depending on the signal type.
meaning: The raw text value that a map feature's rank estimate was computed from.

name: key
desc: The key associated with this data item. For source data in shape file format, this will typically be a column name. Keys need to be unique with respect to a particular data source (see DataSourceProto), but they do not need to be globally unique. You can look up the documentation for a key (e.g. a longer label and description) by following the source_id link of the parent SourceInfoProto, which takes you to a TYPE_DATA_SOURCE feature, and then looking up the corresponding RawMetadataProto object
meaning: The key name of a raw imported map data item, such as a source column name.

name: valueString
desc: All data items are represented as strings, the logic being that it is easy to convert other data types to strings, and there is no need to access this data efficiently.
meaning: The value of a raw imported map data item, always stored as text.

name: conflationMethod
desc: Method to use when conflating together RawDataProto values at the same key NB: If you add a new ConflationMethod, then you must add the corresponding logic to MergeRawData to conflate the RawDataProto values using this method.
meaning: Which method to use when merging raw map values that share a key.

name: description
desc: Self-contained documentation about what this field represents and how its values are encoded.
meaning: Documentation text explaining what a raw map data key means.

name: key
desc: The key being described.
meaning: The raw map data key that this documentation record describes.

name: label
desc: A longer, human-readable name associated with this key. The label might be used in a data explorer tool, for example.
meaning: A human readable label for a raw map data key.

name: displayableAsAlternativeName
desc: If true, this region specific name should be appended, in parentheses, to the appropriate name from FeatureProto.name, for the default rest of world behavior.
meaning: Whether a region specific place name should be shown in parentheses after the main name.

name: name
desc: Name to be used for this feature in a specific region and language.
meaning: The place name to use in a particular region and language.

name: regionCode
desc: Region code (or other identifier) for the region.
meaning: Which region a region specific place name applies to.

name: restriction
desc: The set of restrictions that apply to a zone. These restrictions may limit the routability of every segment contained within the defined feature.polygon. Repeated restrictions are treated collectively as an OR meaning that segments in the zone are only routable if none of the restrictions apply. If any segments within the defined polygon should not have these restrictions applied, they must list this regulated area's feature id in their feature.exempt_regulated_area field.
meaning: Driving restrictions that apply inside a regulated zone.

name: metadata
desc: Field-level metadata for this relation.
meaning: Bookkeeping metadata attached to a relation between map features.

name: otherFeatureCountryCode
desc: If and only if the other feature is of TYPE_COUNTRY, the 2-letter country code. This is the FLAG_COUNTRY_CODE_2 name of the country component.
meaning: Two letter country code of the related map feature when it is a country.

name: otherFeatureId
desc: The feature ID of the feature to which we're relating. WARNING: the related feature does not necessarily have a bound that encloses this feature, so in a bucketing MapReduce, you may not be able to follow all relationships. Relations that use strong references are annotated above but you can also refer to IsRelationStrong() in geostore/base/public/relation.h.
meaning: Identifier of the other map feature in a relationship.

name: otherFeatureName
desc: RESERVED
meaning: A reserved and unused slot for the related feature's names.

name: otherFeatureTerritorialAdministrator
desc: If and only if the other feature is of TYPE_DISPUTED_AREA, the territorial administrator found in its GeopoliticalAttachmentProto.administered_by field, if any. Since this string is copied exactly, it may be a 2-letter country code or another type of descriptive string.
meaning: Who administers the related feature when it is a disputed area.

name: otherFeatureType
desc: The type of the feature to which we're relating.
meaning: The feature type of the other map feature in a relationship.

name: relation
desc: The relationship of the feature that contains this RelationProto to the feature other_feature_id. Note the relation_is_reversed field below. Some relations imply weak references, other strong ones. Strong references are annotated above but you can also refer to IsRelationStrong() in geostore/base/public/relation.h.
meaning: What kind of relationship links this map feature to another one.

name: relationIsReversed
desc: RESERVED
meaning: A reserved and unused flag for reversed relations.

name: temporaryData
desc: A place for clients to attach arbitrary data to a relation. Never set in MapFacts.
meaning: Scratch space for arbitrary client data on a relation; never set in production map data.

name: metadata
desc: Field-level metadata for this restriction group.
meaning: Bookkeeping metadata attached to a road restriction group.

name: segment
desc: FeatureId of all segments that have a RestrictionProto referring back to this RestrictionGroup.
meaning: The road segments that belong to a restriction group.

name: autonomousDrivingProducts
desc: The restriction only applies in these specific autonomous driving product scenarios. NOTE: This should only be set on restrictions with TRAVEL_AUTONOMOUS_VEHICLE travel mode.
meaning: Which self driving product scenarios a road restriction applies to.

name: intersectionGroup
desc: Actually
meaning: A pointer to an intersection group on a road restriction; description is truncated.

name: metadata
desc: Field-level metadata for this restriction.
meaning: Bookkeeping metadata attached to a road restriction.

name: restrictionGroup
desc: Restriction group this restriction belongs to.
meaning: Which restriction group this road restriction belongs to.

name: restrictionToken
desc: A token that can be used to identify the version of the data about this restriction.
meaning: Version token identifying the data revision of a road restriction.

name: schedule
desc: When specified, restriction applies only at particular times (operating hours or times of the year: reversing lanes, seasonal roads, no left turns from 3-5pm Mon-Fri except holidays). Otherwise, restriction is in effect at all times.
meaning: The times or dates when a road restriction is in force.

name: scope
desc: The scope that the restriction applies to. - SCOPE_DIRECTION means the segment/sibling pair is restricted in the direction of the segment that contains this RestrictionProto. For segment/sibling pairs with pedestrian facilities (and thus side-of-road routing) the RestrictionProto restricts both facilities in the direction of the segment (assuming that the restriction applies to travel mode TRAVEL_PEDESTRIAN). - SCOPE_SIDE means the RestrictionProto applies only to the side of road that the conta
meaning: Which part of a road, such as direction or side, a restriction covers.

name: style
desc: Restriction Style defines the semantics of the subpath field, as defined above in the documentation of subpath.
meaning: How to interpret the list of segments a road restriction covers.

name: subpath
desc: "subpath" specifies the GeoStore segments that this restriction applies to, according to the restriction_style field below. Segments that are referenced by this subpath field also refer to this feature back via the same subpath field. For all styles of restriction, all segments in the subpath must have identical copies of the restriction. In other words, restrictions are duplicated along every segment in the subpath. Note that subpaths of length 1 do not have any purpose and are disall
meaning: The sequence of road segments a restriction applies along.

name: temporaryData
desc: A place for clients to attach arbitrary data to a restriction. Never set in MapFacts.
meaning: Scratch space for arbitrary client data on a restriction; never set in production map data.

name: travelMode
desc: Restriction applies only to the given travel modes. This field should always be set, but may be missing in old data. WARNING: Restrictions with no travel modes are DEPRECATED. Historically, no travel modes has meant "all travel modes", except they didn't really even mean that, because Pathfinder would use a complex set of heuristics to interpret the "correct" travel modes. Pathfinder currently (last updated August 2013) has heuristics to cope with incomplete data that reduce
meaning: Which travel modes, such as car or pedestrian, a road restriction applies to.

name: type
desc: LINT.ThenChange(//depot/google3/google/geo/entities/v1/fields/segment.proto) clang-format on The type of restriction. This is not a condition, but rather tells you what kind of restriction it is. This field should always be set.
meaning: What kind of road restriction this is.

name: vehicleAttributeFilter
desc: The restriction only applies to vehicles that meet all of the attributes defined here. If this is empty, it does not affect the scope of the restriction.
meaning: Vehicle characteristics that narrow which vehicles a road restriction applies to.

name: timeSchedule
desc: Specifies what times the information is applicable. This can be specific times (3-5 PM) or days of the week (Mon - Fri), as well as more general times like school hours, dusk to dawn, etc. If no value is set, the restriction is applicable at all times.
meaning: The times or days when a conditional road rule applies.

name: vehicleAttribute
desc: Additional attributes that apply to the applied vehicle types.
meaning: Extra vehicle characteristics for a conditional road rule.

name: vehicleType
desc: Restrictions applying to specific types of vehicles.
meaning: Which vehicle types a conditional road rule applies to.

name: monitoredRoad
desc: The TYPE_ROAD segment features that this road monitor may observe.
meaning: The road segments a traffic camera or monitor can observe.

name: featureId
desc: The id of the feature referred to by this component, typically the route or locality feature this sign points towards. In the ASCII art example above, this field would contain the id for the routes A11 and E50 and the localities Chartres and Paris in the corresponding component.
meaning: The map feature, such as a route or town, that a road sign line points to.

name: featureType
desc: The type of the feature referred to by this component. If feature_id is specified type of that feature should be the same as this field.
meaning: The feature type referred to by a road sign line.

name: majorPosition
desc: This is the "major" position of this component within the set of components that make up a sign. This number can be thought of as the "row" of the sign on which the component appears, but no guarantees are made that there is a one-to-one mapping between "major_position" and the rows of information on the actual sign being modeled. A "major_position" value of zero would indicate that the component is near the top of the sign.
meaning: Which row of a road sign a component appears on.

name: minorPosition
desc: This is the position of a component within the components of a sign that share a common "major_position". It can be though of as the "column" of the component, but like "major_position", no guarantees are made regarding its mapping to reality. For data sources that don't provide enough information to determine a component's major and minor positions, major position should be populated and minor position should not be present. A "minor_position" value of ze
meaning: Which column within a road sign row a component appears in.

name: routeDirection
desc: The direction of traffic for the referenced TYPE_ROUTE feature.
meaning: Traffic direction of the route named on a road sign.

name: semanticType
desc: The semantic type of sign.
meaning: What kind of road sign this is, semantically.

name: text
desc: If this sign component is of type "TYPE_TEXT", this field contains the text of the component. A NameProto is used to allow language and flags to be associated with the text.
meaning: The literal text printed on a road sign component.

name: component
desc: The list of components for a single road sign. A sign may be composed of multiple components, each with its own position and content.
meaning: The individual pieces that make up one road sign.

name: displayPreference
desc: clang-format on
meaning: A display preference on a route association; the description is only a formatting comment.

name: metadata
desc: Field-level metadata for the route association.
meaning: Bookkeeping metadata for a segment to route association.

name: route
desc: Identifies the route feature to which this metadata applies. This is one of the routes the segment refers to via the SegmentProto.route field.
meaning: Which route this association record describes.

name: routeDirection
desc: The direction of the TYPE_ROUTE feature in this route association. A small number of countries (mostly just the United States, Mexico, and Canada) use directional routes. For example, in the United States highway US-1 is referred to as US-1 North or US-1 South on the sides where flow of traffic moves in those directions.
meaning: Which direction of a route, such as north or south, a segment carries.

name: childType
desc: The feature type of the route children. Should be set if and only if all children are of the same feature type.
meaning: The feature type shared by all children of a route.

name: subpath
desc: Specifies a sequence of feature ids of GeoStore segments. The feature ids are ordered. The path "AB" is not the same as the path "BA". The segments along the path are assumed to be connected via the appropriate intersections. The segment features that are referenced by this subpath refer to this feature back via the road_sign field in segment proto extension.
meaning: An ordered list of road segments forming a path.

name: surface
desc: clang-format on LINT.ThenChange(//depot/google3/geostore/base/proto/lane.proto) Specific lanes may override this segment-level surface type.
meaning: The paving surface of a road segment, which individual lanes can override.

name: visibleLandmark
desc: A collection of landmarks that are visible when traveling along this segment and useful for wayfinding to users following routes using this segment. The landmark need not be on the segment. Each segment in a pair of siblings specifies its landmarks independently. A landmark applicable to both appears in both.
meaning: Landmarks visible while travelling a road segment, used for turn guidance.

name: bicycleFacility
desc: clang-format on
meaning: Bike lane facilities on a road segment; the description is only a formatting comment.

name: barrier
desc: clang-format on
meaning: A barrier type on a road segment; the description is only a formatting comment.

name: covered
desc: Whether the segment is covered by a roof etc. If this field is missing, the status is unknown.
meaning: Whether a road segment is covered by a roof or similar structure.

name: endpointMetadata
desc: Field-level metadata for the endpoint.
meaning: Bookkeeping metadata for a road segment's endpoint value.

name: distanceToEdgeMetadata
desc: Field-level metadata for distance_to_edge.
meaning: Bookkeeping metadata for a road segment's distance to edge value.

name: pedestrianFacility
desc: clang-format on
meaning: Sidewalk facilities on a road segment; the description is only a formatting comment.

name: constructionBeginDate
desc: If known, the date that construction is scheduled to begin.
meaning: Date construction on a road segment is scheduled to start.

name: constructionStatusMetadata
desc: Field-level metadata for the construction status.
meaning: Bookkeeping metadata for a road segment's construction status.

name: usage
desc: clang-format on LINT.ThenChange(//depot/google3/maps/pathfinder/pgraph/pgraph-segment-categories.cc)
meaning: The usage class of a road segment; description is only a code pointer.

name: avgSpeedKphMetadata
desc: Field-level metadata for the average speed.
meaning: Bookkeeping metadata for a road segment's average speed value.

name: barrierMetadata
desc: Field-level metadata for the barrier.
meaning: Bookkeeping metadata for a road segment's barrier value.

name: roadMonitor
desc: The road monitors that monitor this segment for traffic violations.
meaning: Traffic monitors watching a road segment for violations.

name: altitude
desc: RESERVED
meaning: A reserved and unused altitude field on a road segment.

name: sweep
desc: The geometric sweeps between this segment and nearby segments, used for real road width rendering. A sweep describes the surface that connects to segments.
meaning: Geometry describing the paved area joining a road segment to nearby segments.

name: maxPermittedSpeedKph
desc: LINT.IfChange(speed_limits) The maximum speed that is permitted on this segment, in kilometers per hour. This should be the segment's legal speed limit; however, note that it may contain estimated values based on country-wide defaults and other heuristics (see 'is_max_permitted_speed_derived' below). Before exposing this field to users as the legal speed limit please consult with Google lawyers.
meaning: The top permitted speed on a road segment in kilometers per hour.

name: distanceToEdge
desc: Average distance between the segment's polyline and edge of the road on this side in meters. It need not be equal to the sum of width of all lanes in this direction. This width includes on-street bicycle lanes but excludes off-street lanes such as sidewalks. The edge of the road is the rightmost edge for segments in right side driving countries and leftmost edge for left side driving countries. Width of the road is sum of this and sibling's distance_to_edge.
meaning: Average distance in meters from a road segment's centerline to the road edge.

name: pedestrianCrossing
desc: Defines the pedestrian crossing(s) between the end point of this segment and the start point of this segment's sibling.
meaning: Pedestrian crossings between a road segment and its opposite side.

name: tollRoad
desc: If this segment is part of a toll road. It would be nice to have data about the toll cost, locations of toll booths, and so forth. Sadly, we don't have this data at this time.
meaning: Whether a road segment is part of a toll road.

name: constructionEndDate
desc: If known, the date that construction is scheduled to end.
meaning: Date construction on a road segment is scheduled to finish.

name: conditionMetadata
desc: Field-level metadata for the condition.
meaning: Bookkeeping metadata for a road segment's condition value.

name: route
desc: The route(s) to which this segment belongs.
meaning: The numbered routes a road segment is part of.

name: roadSign
desc: The road sign(s) which this segment refers to. These are features of TYPE_ROAD_SIGN that are applicable to this segment. For example, a sign that says "TO KIRKLAND" might apply to several segments on a freeway off-ramp (until the end of the ramp). Note that this field makes it easy to find the signs for a given road segment. The feature for the sign lists the segments that refer to it.
meaning: Road signs that apply to a given road segment.

name: onRight
desc: Specifies whether this segment carries right-hand traffic (cars keep to the right side of the road) instead of left-hand traffic (cars keep to the left side). This is true for US roads and false for UK roads, for example. See go/wikip/Left-_and_right-hand_traffic.
meaning: Whether traffic on this road drives on the right or the left.

name: ramp
desc: May only be set when the segment's usage is
meaning: Ramp details for a road segment, set only when the segment is a ramp.

name: surfaceMetadata
desc: Field-level metadata for the surface.
meaning: Bookkeeping metadata for a road segment's surface value.

name: routeAssociation
desc: Holds metadata about the associations between this segment and the route features listed in the route field. This metadata need not be present; the only consistency requirement is that every feature ID that appears inside 'route_association' must also appear in the repeated 'route' field. If a route does not appear in route_association, consumers should assume that it has a default initialized RouteAssociationProto.
meaning: Extra detail about how a road segment relates to each of its routes.

name: internal
desc: Internal-only data.
meaning: Internal only extra data attached to a road segment.

name: endpoint
desc: clang-format on
meaning: Endpoint type of a road segment; the description is only a formatting comment.

name: elevationMetadata
desc: Field-level metadata for the elevation.
meaning: Bookkeeping metadata for a road segment's elevation value.

name: gradeLevel
desc: Detailed information about grade levels along the segment. If a GradeLevelProto is not present for any point (index) along the segment, the default grade level is zero. In between two points (indexes), the grade level of the segment is taken to be the max of the grade levels on either side of it. See gradelevel.proto for semantics of repeated indexes.
meaning: Which level or deck a road segment sits on at points along its length.

name: priority
desc: LINT.ThenChange(//depot/google3/maps/pathfinder/pgraph/pgraph-segment-categories.cc)
meaning: The importance class of a road segment used by routing; description is only a code pointer.

name: interpolationOffsetMeters
desc: If specified, the perpendicular offset in meters from a road segment to an interpolated address along that road segment. See go/synthetic-address-positions.
meaning: How far off a road an interpolated street address is placed, in meters.

name: slope
desc: Each slope instance is tied to a point along the segment polyline (unrelated to the vertices in the segment's polyline) and represents the slope of the segment between that point and the point tied to the next slope istance, or the end of the segment if it's the last slope instance. A segment should have at least one slope.
meaning: How steeply a road segment rises or falls along its length.

name: legalMinimumSpeed
desc: LINT.ThenChange(//depot/google3/geostore/base/internal/segment.cc:has_speed_limit)
meaning: The minimum speed limits that apply to a road segment.

name: intersection
desc: The intersection feature corresponding to the destination of this segment. Intersections are used to represent the connectivity between segments. Each intersection stores the segment ids of all the incoming and outgoing segments that meet at that intersection. Turns can be made from this segment to any of the outgoing segments of its intersection, unless there is a restriction that explicitly disallows the turn (see below). Every segment has an intersection object, even if there are no other seg
meaning: The intersection at the end of a road segment, linking it to other segments.

name: sibling
desc: The other segment of this segment pair (see above). The segment that is referenced by the sibling field refers to this feature back via the same sibling field. Both segment and sibling should have the same properties such as geometry, country code, elevation, level relation, priority etc. Since routes are required to have segment and sibling at the same time, the set of routes on a segment is same to that of the sibling.
meaning: The paired road segment carrying traffic in the opposite direction.

name: isMaxPermittedSpeedDerived
desc: Specifies whether the max_permitted_speed_kph was derived from a heuristic as opposed to coming from an authoritative source.
meaning: Whether a segment's speed limit was guessed rather than taken from an official source.

name: lane
desc: Detailed information about each lane in this direction, if available. Lanes are numbered from inside of the road outward, i.e. the lane next to the center line has lane_number 0. Note that lanes that are valid for travel in both directions appear in both segments of a segment pair (left turn lanes, one-lane roads, some passing lanes, reversing lanes). Some lanes may not be usable by cars, such as bike lanes. Also, some lanes may not exist along the entire segment, e.g. left- or right-turn lanes
meaning: Details about each traffic lane on a road segment.

name: maxPermittedSpeedKphMetadata
desc: Field-level metadata for the maximum permitted speed.
meaning: Bookkeeping metadata for a road segment's maximum speed value.

name: avgSpeedKph
desc: The average speed that should be expected along this route under normal conditions, in kilometers per hour. (Hopefully we'll replace this with something a lot more sophisticated.)
meaning: Typical driving speed along a road segment in kilometers per hour.

name: separatedRoadways
desc: Indicates whether the segment's opposing lanes of traffic are separated from this segment, and hence have been represented in a separate feature. This means that there are two pairs of siblings instead of one.
meaning: Whether opposing lanes of a road are stored as physically separate features.

name: edgeFollowsSegmentBeginFraction
desc: These indicate for what portion of the segment does the outer curb of the segment follow the segment polyline - i.e., where do the sweep curves connect along the outer curb. If unspecified, may be assumed to be equal to lane retraction, preferring outermost lane.
meaning: Where along a road segment the curb starts following the centerline.

name: priorityMetadata
desc: Field-level metadata for the priority.
meaning: Bookkeeping metadata for a road segment's priority value.

name: legalMaximumSpeed
desc: The legal maximum, legal minimum, and advisory (recommended but non-legally binding) maximum speed limits that are permitted on this segment. These should be the segment's legal limits; however, note that it may contain estimated values based on country-wide defaults and other heuristics (see 'AppliedSpeedLimitProto.trust_level'). Before exposing these fields to users as the legal speed limit please consult with Google lawyers.
meaning: The maximum speed limits that apply to a road segment.

name: restriction
desc: The set of restrictions that apply to this segment. Restrictions may make a single segment, turn, or more complex maneuver along a set of segments unroutable for the specified travel modes, or may only add penalties or warnings, depending on the restriction type. Turn restrictions are one example of a restriction. By default, turns are allowed onto all outgoing segments from this segment's intersection (including the sibling of this segment, i.e. U-turns are allowed by default). If any of these
meaning: Restrictions such as banned turns that apply to a road segment.

name: elevation
desc: clang-format on
meaning: Elevation type of a road segment; the description is only a formatting comment.

name: maxConnectedPriority
desc: The highest priority of any TYPE_ROAD endpoint segment which is transitively connected to this ramp via other ramp segments. For instance, if we have two roads connected through a series of ramps (omitting intersections): Road(P=96)-> Ramp 1 -> Ramp 2 -> Ramp 3 -> Road(P=122) -> Road(P=144) The
meaning: The highest road class reachable from a ramp through connected ramps.

name: servedFeature
desc: The features that make up the service area for this establishment. These features are subject to the following constraints applied by editing middleware (notably, not strictly enforced by lints in storage): 1. The following feature types (and their subtypes) may be used: + TYPE_ISLAND + TYPE_POLITICAL, except the following prohibited subtypes: - TYPE_CONSTITUENCY - TYPE_LAND_PARCEL + TYPE_POSTAL 2. There is a maximum limit (currently 20) to the number of areas which may be provided. This is due
meaning: The areas a business says it serves, listed as map features.

name: id
desc: Reference to a Transit POI feature (gcid:transit_station) or platform compound section (gcid:railway_platform) serviced by the line variant.
meaning: Identifier of a transit stop or platform served by a transit line.

name: index
desc: An index representing the order in which the above station is serviced by the line variant.
meaning: Position of a stop in the order a transit line serves them.

name: type
desc: clang-format on
meaning: The kind of ski lift; the description is only a formatting comment.

name: slopeValue
desc: Slope value as elevation change divided by horizontal distance, in the format of decimal, e.g., ‘0.1234’ means a 12.34% slope. If a slope_value is unset, it indicates we don’t have enough information to compute slope at this location.
meaning: The steepness of a stretch of road expressed as rise over run.

name: startPointFraction
desc: Indicates how far along the segment this slope value starts to apply, in the format of decimal between 0 and 1.
meaning: How far along a segment a given slope measurement begins.

name: baseGaiaId
desc: WARNING: Please do NOT introduce new uses; treat this field as if it were deprecated.
meaning: An account identifier on a place record that is treated as deprecated.

name: claimedGaiaId
desc: GAIA ID used when a business has been claimed. This value is a robot GAIA ID. Robots are a special type of GAIA account used to denote identity for a user or a group of users, but are not logged-in directly by a user.
meaning: The account identifier recorded when a business listing has been claimed.

name: gaiaIdForDisplay
desc: WARNING: Please do NOT introduce new uses; treat this field as if it were deprecated.
meaning: A display account identifier on a place record that is treated as deprecated.

name: attributionUrl
desc: This is the URL of a page representing all the data from this source in this feature. It may have be the ultimate source of the data (in case of scraping) or merely the same data styled according the provider's taste. There is a similar field in DataSourceProto which is NOT cached in this field, since it has a different meaning.
meaning: A web page credited as showing this source's data for a map feature.

name: collectionDate
desc: The time that this particular piece of data was collected. If different attributes were collected on different dates, this is the date of the most recent edit.
meaning: When this piece of map data was collected or last edited.

name: cookie
desc: A source info may have a magic cookie whose content and semantics are defined by the specific import process or third-party feed. For feeds that are processed by Distillery, the cookie, when set, should contain the unique identifier for the feature as provided by the feed.
meaning: An opaque identifier a data feed uses to track its own record.

name: dataset
desc: The dataset from which this SourceInfoProto was created. The content of this string will be determined by the data provider (e.g. for MultiNet data, "fra" would indicate the dataset for France). This field is unnecessary for providers that deliver a single dataset per release (e.g. Basarsoft).
meaning: Which provider dataset this map source record came from.

name: gaiaId
desc: The Gaia ID of the user who provided us with this data. This field should never be set on source infos present on features, but may be set on source infos present on edits. DEPRECATED: Most clients should use the "user" field instead where Gaia IDs are encrypted.
meaning: Account identifier of the user who supplied a map edit; marked deprecated.

name: impersonationUser
desc: Information about an internal user or system that is operating on behalf of
meaning: Details of an internal user or system acting on someone else's behalf.

name: layer
desc: The name of the layer from which this SourceInfoProto was created.
meaning: Name of the import layer this map source record came from.

name: ogrFid
desc: The OGR feature identifier from which this SourceInfoProto was created. This is an internal OGR record identifier and has nothing to do with any of the feature's fields or the FeatureIdProto for the FeatureProto containing this SourceInfoProto. This field is present only for debugging purposes and possible use in the match pattern of a FeatureChangeProto designed to fix bad source data very early in the importing process.
meaning: An internal import record number kept only for debugging.

name: provider
desc: The data provider from which this source info was generated. The value must be equal to the one on the TYPE_DATA_SOURCE feature referenced by this source info via the source_id reference (see above).
meaning: Which data provider generated this map source record.

name: rawData
desc: A source info may optionally have a set of key-value pairs that provide "raw data" specific to that source. The types of raw data available will vary from one provider to another and should not be used in production code. Instead, new fields and/or protocol buffers should be defined to represent this information in a canonical form, and the relevant importers should be modified to populate these new fields.
meaning: Provider specific key value pairs kept alongside imported map data.

name: release
desc: The data release from which this SourceInfoProto was created. The format for this string is provider-dependent (e.g. a MultiNet release would look like "2008.01").
meaning: Which provider data release this map source record came from.

name: sourceId
desc: A source info may have a corresponding TYPE_DATA_SOURCE feature that describes it (provider, copyright information, date of release, etc). In the context of edits and issues, this field should not be set.
meaning: Pointer to the data source feature describing this source.

name: temporaryData
desc: A place for clients to attach arbitrary data to a source info. Never set in MapFacts.
meaning: Scratch space for arbitrary client data on a source record; never set in production map data.

name: user
desc: RESERVED
meaning: A reserved and unused user field on a map source record.

name: level
desc: The level of trust for the source of the observation.
meaning: How much the source of a map observation is trusted.

name: category
desc: The type of speed limit.
meaning: What kind of speed limit this record describes.

name: condition
desc: The conditions under which this speed limit is applicable. If multiple conditions are set, at least one of them must be true.
meaning: The conditions under which a speed limit applies.

name: sourceType
desc: The source of the speed limit.
meaning: Where a speed limit value came from.

name: speedWithUnit
desc: A constant speed limit.
meaning: A fixed speed limit value with its unit.

name: unlimitedSpeed
desc: A speed limit with no limit value. When there is no speed limit in place.
meaning: Marker for a road with no speed limit at all.

name: variableSpeed
desc: A dynamic speed limit that can vary within a range of values based on road conditions.
meaning: A speed limit that changes with road conditions.

name: speed
desc: All speed values are stored in kilometers per hour.
meaning: A speed value, stored in kilometers per hour.

name: unit
desc: Mapfacts only allows unit to be KILOMETERS_PER_HOUR.
meaning: The unit of a speed value, restricted to kilometers per hour.

name: fieldPath
desc: A sequence of field selectors to be traversed starting from the root message.
meaning: A path of field selectors pointing into a nested map record.

name: fieldNum
desc: Field number to select.
meaning: The numeric field to select when walking into a map record.

name: versionToken
desc: Select repeated field entry by its version token. If this is used, then the message referenced by field_num must have a token field annotated with the (version_token) field option. Must be omitted for leaf non-repeated fields. If unset for a repeated field, we consider this selector to apply equally to all descendants.
meaning: A version token used to pick one entry out of a repeated field.

name: otherSegmentFeatureId
desc: The segment feature connected to this segment via the sweep geometry.
meaning: The neighboring road segment joined by this piece of paved geometry.

name: polygon
desc: Polygonal geometry representing the area between this segment and the other segment.
meaning: The polygon covering the area between two joined road segments.

name: sweepCurve
desc: Describes parameters for generating the edge of this sweep that starts at edge_follows_segment_end_fraction. The other side of the sweep should be described on the sweep present on the sibling pair.
meaning: Parameters describing the curved edge where two road segments meet.

name: sweepToken
desc: A token that can be used to identify the version of the data about this sweep.
meaning: Version token identifying the data revision of a road sweep.

name: callRate
desc: RESERVED
meaning: A reserved and unused call rate field on a phone record.

name: contactCategory
desc: Disambiguates between the types of information or service a caller might seek when contacting this phone number.
meaning: What a phone number is for, such as sales or support.

name: isSharedNumber
desc: True if this phone number is not unique to this establishment and might be shared with other features. In case an establishment shares a phone number with a business chain of which it is a member, and the number canonically belongs to that chain, it should be marked as shared for the establishment but not shared for the chain.
meaning: Whether a phone number is shared with other businesses rather than unique to this one.

name: label
desc: RESERVED
meaning: A reserved and unused label field on a phone record.

name: language
desc: RESERVED
meaning: A reserved and unused language field on a phone record.

name: metadata
desc: Field-level metadata for this telephone number.
meaning: Bookkeeping metadata attached to a phone number record.

name: phoneNumber
desc: An internationalized representation of a phone number. See //java/com/google/i18n/phonenumbers/phonenumber.proto
meaning: The phone number itself in international format.

name: serviceLocationFeature
desc: The features from which this phone number can be called from. For instance, if a phone number can only be called from Europe, this field will contain a reference to the TYPE_CONTINENT feature of Europe. This field is analogous to
meaning: The places a phone number can be dialed from.

name: endAsOfDate
desc: The latest when this closure may end, if the exact date is unknown. If set, the feature is operational again no later than this date.
meaning: The latest date a place's temporary closure might end.

name: endDate
desc: RESERVED
meaning: A reserved and unused closure end date field.

name: startAsOfDate
desc: The latest when this closure may start, if the exact date is unknown. If set, the feature is temporarily closed starting no later than this date.
meaning: The latest date a place's temporary closure might begin.

name: startDate
desc: RESERVED
meaning: A reserved and unused closure start date field.

name: language
desc: The external form of a Google International Identifiers Initiative (III) LanguageCode object. See google3/i18n/identifiers/languagecode.h for details. These strings should be treated as opaque blobs. You can use LanguageCodeConverter::FromOther to convert the string to a LanguageCode reference. You can then call methods on the LanguageCode class to extract language/script/region subtags (if any). See also
meaning: The language code for this piece of prefix or suffix text.

name: prefix
desc: Text to prepend to the primary text, including any necessary trailing whitespace. At least one of prefix or suffix is required.
meaning: Text added in front of a name or address, including any trailing space.

name: suffix
desc: Text to append to the end of the primary text, including any necessary leading whitespace. At least one of prefix or suffix is required.
meaning: Text added after a name or address, including any leading space.

name: pointIndices
desc: Triangle vertex indices, each triple defines a triangle.
meaning: Indices saying which stored points form each triangle of a 3D map model.

name: points
desc: We store a triangular mesh in indexed format. Points array.
meaning: The list of 3D points that make up a map model's mesh.

name: durationBasedRate
desc: The rates for this rule. Each duration_based_rate defines the costs associated with a particular duration of a stay. There must be at least one rate with range_start_seconds set to 0 and there cannot be gaps between durations (i.e. there should be no interval uncovered between 0 and the largest range_end_seconds of any duration-based rate).
meaning: Price rules for a stay, broken down by how long the stay lasts.

name: taxIncluded
desc: If true, tax is included in the prices in this rate. If false, additional taxes may apply.
meaning: Whether the listed prices already include tax.

name: validStartWithin
desc: Time period during which utilization of this rate must start in order to be eligible for the rate. If not set, there is no restriction on the time when the utilization starts.
meaning: The time window in which a stay must begin to qualify for this rate.

name: interval
desc: The time component is the intersection of these intervals
meaning: A set of time intervals whose overlap defines this time component.

name: day
desc: Valid ranges are 0-7, 1-31, and 1-366 (see day_type below)
meaning: The day number used by a time endpoint, on a week, month, or year scale.

name: hour
desc: Valid range is 0-24. Because it could be unclear what wrapping hours mean in relation to days, 24 is used to denote midnight at the end of a day.
meaning: The hour of day for a time endpoint, where 24 means midnight at day's end.

name: minute
desc: Valid range is 0-59, except when a repetitive minute interval ends at the end of an hour, in which case 60 is a legal end value.
meaning: The minute value of a time endpoint.

name: second
desc: Valid range is 0-59, except when a repetitive second interval ends at the end of a minute, in which case 60 is a legal end value.
meaning: The second value of a time endpoint.

name: week
desc: Valid ranges are 0-5 and 1-53 (depending on the value of week_type, see below).
meaning: The week number used by a time endpoint.

name: begin
desc: Begin and end are used to specify a range of times: [begin, end). If one is present, the other must be present as well. Additionally, both must have matching time granularities - all fields specified in the begin TimeEndpointProto must be present in the end TimeEndpointProto and vice-versa. Hours are not allowed to wrap (begin.hour() <= end.hour()).
meaning: The start of a time range, paired with a matching end value.

name: inverted
desc: If true, then this interval actually encodes the complement of the specified occasion or range. For example, the following TimeIntervalProto encodes all times other than the month of May. TimeIntervalProto[ type = TYPE_RANGE inverted = true begin = TimeEndpointProto[ month = MAY ] end = TimeEndpointProto[ month = JUNE ] ]
meaning: Whether this interval means everything except the stated time range.

name: occasion
desc: clang-format on
meaning: A named occasion for a time interval; the description text is missing.

name: component
desc: The schedule is the union of these components.
meaning: The list of time pieces that together make up a schedule.

name: id
desc: i18n recognized time zone identifier. For the full list of identifiers, see google3/i18n/identifiers/data/timezones.txt.
meaning: The standard identifier for a time zone.

name: metadata
desc: Field-level metadata for this relation.
meaning: Bookkeeping information about where this time zone value came from.

name: intersection
desc: The list of gcid:toll_intersection features that this toll cluster. A toll cluster can consist of either a single or a group of intersection points called toll intersections at the end of various road segments in MapFacts that represent one or more lanes passing through a toll fixture that all go to the same routing destination. This relationship is reciprocal, as a toll intersection also stores a reference to the toll cluster it belongs to. A toll cluster must have a reference to one or more to
meaning: The toll intersection points that belong to this toll cluster.

name: tollClusterSequence
desc: Details the /geo/type/toll_cluster features which constitute this toll path.
meaning: The ordered set of toll clusters that make up a toll road path.

name: cluster
desc: The /geo/type/toll_cluster feature at this position.
meaning: The toll cluster that sits at this position on the path.

name: index
desc: The position along the path where this cluster appears.
meaning: The position of this toll cluster along the toll path.

name: indexedTollClusters
desc: There must be at least one toll cluster in a toll path, and there may not be duplicates. For ordering, one should rely on
meaning: The list of toll clusters, with positions, that form a toll path.

name: index
desc: The index of this TrackProto in a list of TrackProtos.
meaning: The position of this track within a list of tracks.

name: pose
desc: The instantaneous pose of points along this track. The fields set inside each pose must be set consistently along the track.
meaning: The recorded positions and orientations of points along a track.

name: agency
desc: The transit agencies responsible for operating this line. All lines should have at least one agency, and most will have exactly one. The following cases are reasons for multiple agencies: - Code share: Two or more agencies share trips - Alternations: Each trip is run by one of multiple agencies - Additional: All trips run by one agency, but a second one sells tickets In all cases the order has no meaning. Clarification comes from the trips.
meaning: The transit agencies that operate this transit line.

name: labelBackgroundColor
desc: The background color of labels for that transit line. The encoding is like in HTML or CSS, eg. 0x11ff00 means a bit of red, full green, no blue, in sRGB color space. The most significant byte must be zero, i.e. no transparency.
meaning: The background color used when drawing this transit line's label.

name: labelTextColor
desc: The text color of labels for that transit line. Encoding like label_background_color.
meaning: The text color used when drawing this transit line's label.

name: stations
desc: The transit stations (establishment POIs with gcid:transit_station) which this transit line can go through, in no particular order. Usage note: The source of truth are the transit leg features in Transit Oyster. In MapFacts, that information is cached in two locations: in this field, and in transit station attachments on POIs. Do not assume these locations are always up to date and/or synchronized with each other.
meaning: The transit stations this line can pass through.

name: vehicleType
desc: The type of vehicle that applies to all trips that use this line.
meaning: The kind of vehicle, such as bus or train, used on this line.

name: lineConcept
desc: Reference to the line variant’s line concept.
meaning: A pointer to the parent line concept for this line variant.

name: stops
desc: Ordered list of stations or platforms serviced by this line variant. The order is captured by the ServicedStopProto.index field.
meaning: The ordered stops served by this variant of a transit line.

name: agencyAssociations
desc: All the transit agencies which service this station. A station can be serviced by multiple stations. There may only be one agency association per transit agency. See go/transit-agency-relation-migration for more details.
meaning: The transit agencies that serve this station.

name: agency
desc: The transit agency which services this station.
meaning: The transit agency in an agency-to-station link.

name: stationCode
desc: A station code uniquely identifies a transit station within the transit agency's network.
meaning: The agency's own code for this station.

name: sourceTrust
desc: Trust signals for the source of a given observation, typically based on historical evidences or status (like internal Google operator).
meaning: A trust rating for the source that supplied a piece of map data.

name: language
desc: The external form of a Google International Identifiers Initiative (III) LanguageCode object. See google3/i18n/identifiers/languagecode.h for details. We place extra restrictions on languages in addition to what the III library requires. See
meaning: The language of this URL entry.

name: metadata
desc: Field-level metadata for this URL. NOTE: there are multiple UrlProto fields in the Geo Schema. Metadata here is only expected to be present on FeatureProto.website[].
meaning: Bookkeeping information about where this URL value came from.

name: url
desc: The URL.
meaning: A web address stored on a map feature, such as a place's website.

name: encryptedGaiaId
desc: The user Gaia ID in encrypted form. Wipeout ids take value of "" in bytes.
meaning: The user's Google account ID, stored in encrypted form.

name: encryptionKeyName
desc: Required. The name of the key used to encrypt the Gaia ID.
meaning: The name of the key used to encrypt the stored account ID.

name: keystoreConfigId
desc: Required (valid default provided). The config ID of the owner of the above encryption_key_name. This field must be set if the encryption key name is
meaning: The keystore configuration ID that owns the encryption key.

name: username
desc: If possible, writers should set this to a full user email, including the domain. Readers should not assume that this is a well-formed email address. This field may only be set by Atlas, Pushpin and OneRing because they are internal tools which have a PWG exception to store textual usernames in the clear.
meaning: A stored username or email for an internal map editing tool.

name: axleCount
desc: A repeated value here is treated as an AND operation. This allows for ranges to be represented by two values (ex: "count < 4" AND "count >= 2" means "2 <= count < 4").
meaning: Axle count conditions used to decide whether a road rule applies.

name: hasTrailer
desc: Whether the applied vehicle types have a trailer attached to them.
meaning: Whether the rule applies to vehicles pulling a trailer.

name: hazardousGoods
desc: List of prohibited hazardous goods for a vehicle to carry. A repeated value here is treated as an OR operation, meaning that they may not carry ANY of the goods listed.
meaning: Hazardous goods a vehicle may not be carrying under this rule.

name: numTrailers
desc: A repeated value here is treated as an AND operation. This allows for ranges to be represented by two values (ex: "count <= 4" AND "count > 2" means "2 < count <= 4").
meaning: Trailer count conditions used to decide whether a road rule applies.

name: trailerLength
desc: A repeated value here is treated as an AND operation. This allows for ranges to be represented by two values (ex: "length <= 53ft" AND "length > 48ft" means "48ft < length <= 53ft").
