meaning: Trailer length conditions used to decide whether a road rule applies.

name: vehicleHeight
desc: A repeated value here is treated as an AND operation. This allows for ranges to be represented by two values (ex: "height > 3m" AND "height <= 5m" means "3m < height <= 5m").
meaning: Vehicle height limits used to decide whether a road rule applies.

name: vehicleLength
desc: A repeated value here is treated as an AND operation. This allows for ranges to be represented by two values (ex: "length <= 40m" AND "length > 35m" means "35m < length <= 40m").
meaning: Vehicle length limits used to decide whether a road rule applies.

name: vehicleWeight
desc: A repeated value here is treated as an AND operation. This allows for ranges to be represented by two values (ex: "weight < 8T" AND "weight >= 3T" means "3T <= weight < 8T").
meaning: Vehicle weight limits used to decide whether a road rule applies.

name: vehicleWidth
desc: A repeated value here is treated as an AND operation. This allows for ranges to be represented by two values (ex: "width < 4m" AND "width >= 2m" means "2m <= width < 4m").
meaning: Vehicle width limits used to decide whether a road rule applies.

name: level
desc: The level represents the relative vertical ordering of a feature among all overlapping features. For example, we may have features along freeway surface have level = 0, and features on an overpass have level = 1. NOTE: It’s assumed that all features have level 0 by default, so that it’s not necessary for all overlapping features to have this set.
meaning: How high a map feature sits relative to other features that overlap it.

name: Anchor
desc: There is a generic method for composing such strings. Please take a look at GoodocUtils::GenerateUniqueAnchorName(...) in ocr/goodoc/goodoc-utils.h.
meaning: A name marking a spot in a scanned document that links can point to.

name: Label
desc: Optional magic label, so objects can be sorted on bounding box dimensions easily
meaning: An optional sorting label attached to a bounding box.

name: Left
desc: BoundingBox coordinates and sizes are expressed in pixels
meaning: The left pixel coordinate of a bounding box on a scanned page.

name: span
desc: "span" is width or height, determined by "direction". If there are k partitions, then there are k - 1 "span" values, one for each except the last symbol (which is redundant).
meaning: Widths or heights that split a box into parts, one per symbol.

name: isPrefix
desc: True if break prepends the element
meaning: Whether a line break comes before the element rather than after.

name: BaseLine
desc: The shift of a character from the base line of the string in pixels
meaning: How far a character sits off the text baseline, in pixels.

name: CharacterHeight
desc: Height of small characters in pixels on the source image
meaning: The height of small characters on the scanned page, in pixels.

name: Color
desc: The foreground color of the symbol; the default color is 0 (black)
meaning: The color of the recognized character.

name: Confidence
desc: Symbol recognition confidence from OCR. Range depends upon OCR Engine.
meaning: How sure the OCR engine is that it read this character correctly.

name: FontId
desc: The font ID refers to the fonts table in the document header
meaning: A pointer to the font entry used for this character.

name: FontSize
desc: Size in points (JFYI: point is 1/72"). This is rounded to the nearest whole number.
meaning: The character's font size in points, rounded to a whole number.

name: FontSizeFloat
desc: Size in points represented as float.
meaning: The character's font size in points as a decimal number.

name: HasUncertainHeight
desc: If CharacterHeight is defined uncertainly
meaning: Whether the measured character height is unreliable.

name: HorizontalScale
desc: The horizontal scaling for a character, in percents. The default value for this property is 100, which corresponds to no scaling.
meaning: How much the character is stretched horizontally, as a percentage.

name: IsSuspicious
desc: If OCR Engine marked the character as "suspicious" (this character is likely to be recognized incorrectly).
meaning: Whether the OCR engine flagged this character as likely misread.

name: NotOcrablePerQA
desc: True if a QA operator has marked this as not OCRable. This is used for complex equations, scripts that the operator can't type, or handwriting.
meaning: Whether a human reviewer marked this text as impossible to read by OCR.

name: Penalty
desc: Symbol-level penalty from the garbage text detector. Lower is better; range = [0,100].
meaning: A penalty score from the garbage text detector for this character.

name: SerifProbability
desc: The probability that a character is written with a Serif font
meaning: The chance that the character uses a serif font.

name: EditingHistory
desc: Debug info, recording the history of any editing done through the interface in goodoc-editing.h. The strings look like "MoveParagraph(page_index = 0, source_block_index = 3, ...);
meaning: A debug log of edits made to the scanned document.

name: LogicalEntity
desc: Logical entities are stored as blobs. Depending on the kind of thing this is a goodoc of, a separate .proto file is expected to define the logical entity structure. Hence we can still parse this as a goodoc for people who dont care about this, and people who care about this can parse it specifically. ocr/goodoc/logical-entity-utils.h has methods to read and write these. See Goodoc++ doc
meaning: Extra structured data about the document, stored as an opaque blob.

name: LogicalEntityMessageName
desc: The names of the proto messages serialized in LogicalEntity, one for each LogicalEntity. The repetitions should number 0 to leave this unspecified, or they should equal the number of LogicalEntity strings.
meaning: The message type names for the stored logical entity blobs.

name: SubDocuments
desc: For multi-goodoc documents
meaning: Nested documents inside a multi-part scanned document.

name: OrientationLabel
desc: Which way is upright for this block, and what is the reading order (applicable if there is text here).
meaning: Which way the block is upright and in what order its text reads.

name: RotatedBox
desc: If RotatedBox is set, Box must be set as well. See RotatedBoundingBox.
meaning: The tilted bounding box for a block of text on a scanned page.

name: TextConfidence
desc: Block text recognition confidence. Range depends on the algorithm but should be consistent in a given volume. 0 is bad, 100 is good.
meaning: How sure the system is that this block's text was read correctly.

name: fontId
desc: CharLabel.FontId and FontSize
meaning: The font entry these size statistics describe.

name: medianHeight
desc: The measurements are in pixels
meaning: The typical character height for this font, in pixels.

name: medianLineHeight
desc: top to bottom
meaning: The typical line height for this font, top to bottom.

name: medianLineSpace
desc: bottom to next top in para
meaning: The typical gap between lines for this font.

name: medianLineSpan
desc: top to next top in para
meaning: The typical distance from one line's top to the next line's top.

name: numLineSpaces
desc: Lines (out of num_lines) that have a successor line within their para
meaning: How many lines of this font are followed by another line in the paragraph.

name: numLines
desc: Line stats for this font. "top" corresponds to the highest ascender and "bottom" to the lowest descender. num_lines = # lines with > 50% symbols having this font
meaning: How many lines are mostly set in this font.

name: AnchorLabel
desc: AnchorLabel identifies a link target.
meaning: Link target markers attached to this document element.

name: CharLabel
desc: CharLabel is specifically intended for symbols
meaning: Character-level details attached to a recognized symbol.

name: LanguageLabel
desc: Languages used in the element (page, block, paragraph or word). Ordered by dominant-language first. Note: content scanjobs processed by the garbage_text_detector before CL 9223538 (Dec. 2008) have LanguageLabels in arbitrary order (within Page and Block elements) -- the confidence value should be inspected to find the dominant language guess for these, rather than just taking the first.
meaning: The languages detected in this part of the scanned document, best guess first.

name: SemanticLabel
desc: SemanticLabel is defined in goodoc-semantics.proto, it allows rich annotation of content, identifying the nature of page elements.
meaning: A rich annotation describing what kind of page element this is.

name: bcp47Tag
desc: Bcp47 language code. Note, this is not the same as OceanCode used by goodoc::Document.
meaning: A standard language tag for one language in a combination.

name: weight
desc: Weight of language. This specifies how likely it is to see the language in the input text. The values don't have to add up to 1.
meaning: How likely this language is to appear in the input text.

name: ClosestLanguageId
desc: Closest id from i18n/languages/proto/languages.proto; caveat: may not accurately capture the language. GoodocLanguageCodeToLanguage() declared in ocr/goodoc/goodoc-utils.h may be used to convert a Language enum (i18n/languages/proto/languages.proto) to a string suitable for this field.
meaning: The closest matching internal language ID for the detected language.

name: Confidence
desc: Confidence level on that language, between 0 and 100
meaning: How sure the detector is about the detected language, 0 to 100.

name: LanguageCode
desc: Old (Ocean) Language Code Usage: The language code is inferred during the running of the Garbage Text Detector and gets set at the paragraph, block and page level. Language code is a string of 3 or more characters. The first 3 letters specify the language, according to ISO 639. Optionally, the 3-letter code can be extended with an underscore and a language variant specifier. Specifiers exist for regional variants or for different forms of language spelling. The regional variants are specified as
meaning: The older style language code set by the garbage text detector.

name: Anchor
desc: The preferred way to link to an element is to create an AnchorLabel in the target element and name it here. Multiple elements may contain the same Anchor string.
meaning: The name of the anchor this link points at.

name: DocId
desc: Links may also specifically locate the target element with the following indices. Note that during the course of layout analysis, goodoc elements may move around, so such hard links should be created only very late (or not at all -- Anchors would be more reliable target addresses).
meaning: The document index a link uses to point directly at a target element.

name: Url
desc: If not defined, link points to the current doc
meaning: The address of another document that this link points to.

name: sectionValueType
desc: The following vars describe the section component of an ordinal (if exists). They are used to express situation where a page number has a section component, usually denoating the chapter number. For example pages 5-14, 5-15 will both have the common section 5. (If exists). The semantcis of the section variables correspond to that of the primary part of the ordinal. (Described above).
meaning: What kind of value the chapter part of a page number uses.

name: stringValue
desc: The string page value.
meaning: The page number written as text.

name: value
desc: The numeric page value.
meaning: The page number as a number.

name: valueDelta
desc: The delta in which the value increases between pages.
meaning: How much the page number increases from one page to the next.

name: valueType
desc: A value type from the Type enum above.
meaning: What kind of value the page number is, such as roman or arabic.

name: deskewAngle
desc: After rotating so that the text orientation is upright, how many radians does one have to rotate the block anti-clockwise for it to be level? We guarantee: -Pi/4 <= deskew_angle <= Pi/4
meaning: How many radians the block must be turned to sit level.

name: mirrored
desc: Whether a text line is mirrored (e.g. reflected in a shiny surface or seen through the opposite side of a storefront window). The intent is that this is a quality of the text line image. It needs to be reflected according to a vertical axis along the direction of upright characters to make it readable. This does not affect the shape of the bounding box. A mirrored line with top to bottom writing remains top to bottom. A mirrored horizontal line will flip left to right. However any child entities
meaning: Whether the text line appears mirrored in the scanned image.

name: blockImagination
desc: For text blocks only: do not allow this block to be turned into an image when rendering, even if your algorithms want to do so:
meaning: An override stopping a text block from being rendered as an image.

name: doNotExpandGraphicBox
desc: For graphic blocks, we often expand the block a bit for rendering, to compensate for bad image segmentation. do_not_expand_graphic_box forces this behavior to be turned off.
meaning: An override stopping a picture block from being padded when rendered.

name: fullPageAsImage
desc: For Pages only: explicitly specify whether or not this page should be rendered fully as an image
meaning: An override forcing a whole page to render as an image, or not.

name: fullPageLineated
desc: For Pages only: explicitly specify whether or not all text on this page should be treated as "LINEATED"
meaning: An override forcing all text on a page to be treated as lineated.

name: fullPageSkipped
desc: For Pages only: explicitly specify whether or not this page should be skipped.
meaning: An override saying whether to skip the page entirely.

name: needNotSuppressPhoto
desc: This GRAPHIC block's image can be shown even when GoodocToHTMLOptions.suppress_photos_with_this is specified.
meaning: An override letting this picture show even when photos are suppressed.

name: pageBreakBefore
desc: For blocks: explicitly specify whether or not this block should get a page-break before it.
meaning: An override saying whether a page break goes before this block.

name: wordHtml
desc: For Words only: replace the rendered HTML by this:
meaning: Hand-written HTML that replaces the rendered output for a word.

name: name
desc: css attribute name: "margin-left", for eg.
meaning: The name of a CSS property used in a rendering override.

name: value
desc: css attribute vale: "1em", for eg.
meaning: The value of a CSS property used in a rendering override.

name: OrientationLabel
desc: Which way is upright for this paragraph and what is the dominant reading order?
meaning: Which way the paragraph is upright and how its text reads.

name: RotatedBox
desc: If RotatedBox is set, Box must be set as well. See RotatedBoundingBox.
meaning: The tilted bounding box for a paragraph.

name: SubsumedParagraphProperties
desc: If we merge any paragraphs into this one (through the MergeParagraphWithNext() interface in goodoc-editing.h), then we append the properties of the merged paragraph here, for debugging and to avoid losing any info. Note that the SubsumedParagraphProperties Paragraphs do not contain Routes.
meaning: Saved properties of paragraphs that were merged into this one.

name: TextConfidence
desc: Paragraph text recognition confidence. Range depends on the algorithm but should be consistent in a given volume. 0 is bad, 100 is good.
meaning: How sure the system is that this paragraph's text was read correctly.

name: EndPoint
desc: Route end point
meaning: The ending point of a reading route through a paragraph.

name: StartPoint
desc: Route start point
meaning: The starting point of a reading route through a paragraph.

name: Weight

meaning: The time zone the device is currently in.

meaning: A compressed copy of the installed-app list.

meaning: A request for aggregated counts across matching documents.

name: offset
desc: An integer that specifies the current offset (that is, starting result location, amongst the documents deemed by the API as relevant) in search results. This field is only considered if page_token is unset. The maximum allowed value is 5000. Otherwise an error is thrown. For example, 0 means to return results starting from the first matching document, and 10 means to return from the 11th document. This can be used for pagination, (for example, pageSize = 10 and offset = 10 means to return from t

name: pageToken
desc: The token specifying the current offset within search results. See SearchDocumentsResponse.next_page_token for an explanation of how to obtain the next set of query results.

name: value
desc: The node value is applicable for TEXT_NODEs, DOCUMENT_TYPE_NODEs, COMMENT_NODEs, and user input elements such as , and <option>. For DOCUMENT_TYPE_NODEs, the value contains the publicId and SystemId. For input elements, the value reflects the current value in the element at the time the snapshot was taken.
meaning: Stored value of a text, comment, or form input node in the page.

name: htmlAttributeType
desc: Identifies the HTML attribute type (src, width, height, etc). For a list of possible types refer HtmlAttributeEnum defined in webutil/html/htmlattrenum.h.
meaning: Numeric code for which HTML attribute is stored.

name: baseUri
desc: Document's base uri.
meaning: The base address a page uses to resolve relative links.

name: charset
desc: Document's charset.
meaning: Character encoding the page was interpreted with.

name: contentLanguage
desc: Document's language.
meaning: The language the rendered page is written in.

name: contentWidth
desc: These fields contain the actual width and height of the document content, which may exceed the size of the rendering viewport.
meaning: Actual width of the page content, which can be wider than the viewport.

name: domTreeNode
desc: A flat list of all the DOMTreeNodes in the DOM. A flat list is preferred to a tree to avoid recursion and potential stack overflows. Note that the first node in this list will always be the root node.
meaning: Flat list of every node in the page structure.

name: frameId
desc: A unique identifier for the frame (browser window of iframe) this document is loaded in. This identifier matches the identifiers used in the timeline data to identify frames and therefore only set if the record_timeline field of the RenderRequest message was set to true. frame_id is not supported on Chromium.
meaning: Internal identifier for the browser frame a document loaded in.

name: frameName
desc: The name of the frame (browser window of iframe) this document is loaded in. May not be set if the frame name was empty.
meaning: Name of the browser frame a document loaded in.

name: javascriptTimeOfDay
desc: -------------------------------------------------------------------------- Input context. These fields are copied from RenderRequest so that Document can be a self contained protobuf. We would've liked to place them in a ## nested InputContext message but it's too late now. ## Time specified to RenderRequest.JavaScriptOptions.time_of_day, if any. ## End of input context. Output-only fields below.
meaning: The clock time handed to JavaScript during a render, copied from the request.

name: redirectHop
desc: The chain of redirects (and redirect methods) used to get to the final resource for this Document. Deprecated: Use the redirect events in the render_event field instead.
meaning: Old list of redirects followed to reach the page, replaced by render events.

name: referencedResource
desc: Contains a list of Resources which the renderer requested -- both those that were found and those that were not. Resources are returned in the order that they were requested.
meaning: List of the resources the renderer asked for, found or not.

name: renderEvent
desc: Different types of events which happened during rendering. All events for this document's frame are included, so for example if a confirmation dialog is created before a client redirect to this document the ConfirmationDialogEvent will still be included even though the dialog was created by a different document. See render_event.proto for the types of events which are recorded. Note that this is present regardless of whether record_timeline was set in the RenderRequest.
meaning: Events that happened while the page was being rendered.

name: renderStyle
desc: See htmlrender_webkit_headless_utils::SerializeRenderStyle() if a serialized css string is wanted.
meaning: The visual styles that were applied while rendering the page.

name: renderTreeNode
desc: A flat list of all the RenderTreeNodes from the render tree. A flat list is preferred to a tree to avoid recursion and potential stack overflows. Note that the first node in this list will always be the RenderTreeNode for the #document node (aka root).
meaning: Flat list of the page's layout entries.

name: renderTreeQualityScore
desc: DEPRECATED - This field to be removed mid-2011. If you need this, use the library directly: //google3/htmlrender/webkit_headless/snapshot_quality Indicates how good or bad the rendering is from the perspective of the render tree. This is different from snapshot_quality_score in that the quality analysis examines everything that can be rendered, not just the portion within the document's viewport. It also ignores missing resouces with fixed width/height specified in the tag. A score of 1 (100%) i
meaning: Old score for how completely the page's layout could be rendered, now removed.

name: renderedContentArea
desc: The bounding box which represents the whole area of rendered content, which may exceed the size of the rendering viewport. It doesn't include the body's margin.
meaning: Bounding box covering the whole rendered content area of the page.

name: scrollX
desc: Scroll offset of this document within the frame. Note that if expand_frame_to_content_height or expand_frame_to_content_width is true, this field reflects the final scroll offset after frame expansion.
meaning: How far the document was scrolled inside its frame.

name: snapshotQualityScore
desc: DEPRECATED - This field to be removed mid-2011. If you need this, use the library directly: //google3/htmlrender/webkit_headless/snapshot_quality Indicates how good or bad the rendered snapshot is within the rendered content area within the document's viewport. A score of 1 (100%) implies the snapshot is of best quality and a score of 0 implies the snapshot is unusable.
meaning: Old score for how usable the rendered page screenshot was, now removed.

name: title
desc: Document's title.
meaning: The title of the rendered page.

name: uri
desc: Document uri is the URL that this document was fetched from. The displayed URL and base URL may be different. If this document was not fetched from any URL (e.g. iframe with no src, populated by script) uri will be "about:blank".
meaning: The address the document was fetched from.

name: viewport
desc: The page's layout size.
meaning: The layout size of the page during rendering.

name: data
desc: The binary image data, stored in a format decided by the application and a particular RenderService implementation.
meaning: Raw bytes of a rendered page image.

name: pageNumber
desc: The page number if this is an image of a page from a print-mode rendering.
meaning: Page number for an image taken from a print style rendering.

name: viewport
desc: The viewport from which this image was generated. This is relative to the upper left of the page's document.
meaning: The screen area a rendered image was captured from.

name: width
desc: The width and height of the image stored in the data field.
meaning: Pixel width of a stored rendered image.

name: confirmed
desc: Whether a confirm() or prompt() dialog was confirmed. Will not be present for an alert() dialog.
meaning: Whether a JavaScript confirm or prompt dialog was accepted.

name: result
desc: For a prompt() dialog, the result of the prompt. Will not be present for other types of dialogs. If confirmed == false and the prompt had a default value, result will contain the default value.
meaning: The text answer given to a JavaScript prompt dialog.

name: cookie
desc: Cookies at the time of snapshot creation.
meaning: Cookies present when a partial render snapshot was taken.

name: currentClientUrl
desc: Current url as would appear in the web browser's address bar at the time of snapshot creation.
meaning: The address shown in the browser bar when a snapshot was taken.

name: document
desc: Snapshot of the document DOM + Render trees, if requested
meaning: Snapshot of the page structure captured mid render.

name: id
desc: ID set by the render extension
meaning: Identifier assigned to a partial render by the render extension.

name: image
desc: Image of the render, if requested
meaning: Image captured for a partial render snapshot.

name: data
desc: The binary PDF data.
meaning: Raw bytes of a PDF produced from a page.

name: top
desc: A missing value for any field in this message means 'auto'.
meaning: Top edge of a rectangle used in page styling.

name: httpMethod
desc: The HTTP method of the request for the redirect target.
meaning: HTTP method used when requesting a redirect target.

name: httpStatusCode
desc: For HTTP redirects, the HTTP status code returned in the initial HTTP response.
meaning: HTTP status code returned by a redirecting response.

name: targetContentDownloaded
desc: True if the redirect led to a download instead of loading a new page. Note that such redirects can appear anywhere in the list of redirect events.
meaning: Whether a redirect ended in a file download instead of a page.

name: url
desc: The redirect target url.
meaning: The address a redirect pointed to.

name: canceled
desc: True if this fetch was canceled due to render server policy. e.g. the page exceeded the fetch budget or an extension canceled the fetch.
meaning: Whether a resource fetch was stopped by render server policy.

name: contentType
desc: Content type of this resource (webutil/http/content-type.h). The content type is from guess based on the file extension, any mime type in http headers at the beginning of the content, any content-disposition http header, and the content body itself. Note: the content type defined in webutil/http/content-type.proto is incomplete. If you are interested in missing types, please update the enum and the logic of content type detection.
meaning: Detected content type of a fetched resource.

name: domTreeNodeIndex
desc: DOMTreeNode index which has the url as one of its attributes specified using either src, href or background attributes. src attribute applies to img, script, frame and iframe nodes, href applies to link nodes and background applies to body node. It is possible for a url to be referenced by multiple DOM nodes. For e.g. an tag with the same src attribute can occur in multiple places within a document. It is possible for a url to not have any DOM node reference. For example, redirects don't have DO
meaning: Which page nodes reference a fetched resource.

name: failedHttpAccessControlCheck
desc: True when a HTTP request succeeded but the resource was not made accessible to script due to a HTTP Access Control (CORS) failure. This field is not implemented on Chromium.
meaning: Whether a fetched resource was blocked from scripts by cross origin rules.

name: fetchSourceInfo
desc: Where this resource comes from.
meaning: Where a fetched resource was served from.

name: fetchStatus
desc: The FetchStatus returned by the fetcher. Values are taken from wireless_transcoder_fetch.FetchConstants.FetchStatus in fetch_service.proto. The default value is SUCCESS(0).
meaning: Status the fetcher returned when retrieving a resource.

name: httpHeader
desc: HTTP headers from the fetcher.
meaning: HTTP response headers received for a fetched resource.

name: httpResponseCode
desc: HTTP response code if we had tried to fetch the url. Absence of this field indicates either we have not tried to fetch the url or the fetcher never got back to us with any response.
meaning: HTTP response code received when fetching a resource.

name: postData
desc: The post_data field is only valid when the HTTP request method is POST.
meaning: Body data sent along with a POST request for a resource.

name: redirectTarget
desc: If the http_response_code is a HTTP redirect, the redirect target will be stored here.
meaning: The address a fetched resource redirected to.

name: referencedResourceContentIndex
desc: Indicates which referenced_resource_content (in RenderResponse) this RefencedResource points to. This field will be set only when there is referenced_resource_content for this RefencedResource in RenderResponse.
meaning: Position of the stored body content for a fetched resource.

name: requestHeader
desc: Only necessary headers are recorded. See google3/htmlrender/webkit_headless/resource_key.cc
meaning: HTTP request headers recorded when fetching a resource.

name: requestMethod
desc: The HTTP request method (GET, HEAD, POST, etc) used for this request. Values are taken from the HTTPHeaders::Protocol enum in webutil/http/httputils.h. HTTPHeaders::PROTO_GET
meaning: HTTP method used to request a resource.

name: styleIndex
desc: style index which has the url specified using either the background-image property or the list-style-image property.
meaning: Which style rules reference a fetched resource such as a background image.

name: synchronouslyFetched
desc: Whether it is synchronously fetched.
meaning: Whether a resource was fetched in a blocking way.

name: url
desc: Does not have a #fragment.
meaning: Address of a fetched resource, without any fragment part.

name: webkitMetadata
desc: Additional information webkit about this resource. e.g. intended usage
meaning: Extra renderer notes about a fetched resource, such as how it was used.

name: name
desc: A string identifying the fetcher that added this timing information.
meaning: Name of the fetcher that recorded a timing measurement.

name: startMsec
desc: UNIX epoch timestamps in milliseconds.
meaning: Start time of a resource fetch, as a millisecond timestamp.

name: scriptOriginUrl
desc: The URL of the script which caused this event, if any. Analogous to origin_url in DOMTreeNode.
meaning: URL of the script that triggered a rendering event.

name: virtualTimeOffset
desc: Virtual time of the event, as an offset from the beginning of the render in seconds.
meaning: When a rendering event happened, measured from the start of the render.

name: consoleLogEntry
desc: Log messages and errors generated by extension script.
meaning: Console messages produced by a render extension script.

name: chromiumTrace
desc: Contains chromium trace generated during page rendering. This is present if a chromium_trace_config was provided in the request.
meaning: Browser trace collected during a page render.

name: cookie
desc: Contents of the browser's cookie jar. (if cookies_enabled was set to true in the RenderRequest).
meaning: Cookies held by the browser after rendering a page.

name: document
desc: Contains the DOM tree, render tree and more. For details consult document.proto.
meaning: The full page structure produced by rendering.

name: exceptionDetail
desc: Provides extra debugging details when certain exception bits are set.
meaning: Extra debugging detail about rendering exceptions.

name: exceptions
desc: Exceptions (possibly serious conditions) that occurred during this rendering. 0 means none. Bitfield encoding. See the RenderingException enum above for an explanation.
meaning: Bit flags recording problems that occurred during rendering.

name: extensionResult
desc: Render extension results (if
meaning: Results returned by a render extension.

name: finalClientUrl
desc: This field contains the final url as would appear in the web browser's address bar. Note that JavaScript can modify the contents of the location bar so this URL may not appear on the list of referenced resources. If we fail to follow a redirect this field will contain the URL that we failed to redirect to, not the last one we successfully loaded.
meaning: The final address shown in the browser bar after rendering.

name: image
desc: Contains the viewport images rendered by webkit (if generate_image was set to true in the RenderRequest). Will also contain the print-mode images (if generate_print_mode_images was set to true).
meaning: Images produced by rendering the page.

name: localStorage
desc: Contents of the browser's local storage.
meaning: Contents of the browser's local storage after rendering.

name: partialRender
desc: Partial render snapshots (if requested by a render extension)
meaning: Snapshots captured partway through rendering.

name: pdf
desc: Contains the PDF document (if generate_pdf was set to true in the RenderRequest)
meaning: PDF document produced from the rendered page.

name: referencedResourceContent
desc: Contents for all the urls fetched by the render server. This field is present only if generate_referenced_resource_content was set to true in the RenderRequest.
meaning: Full contents of every resource the render server fetched.

name: renderStats
desc: Time to render the url, total size of a document, number of referenced images, etc will be part of RenderStats.
meaning: Timing and size statistics for a page render.

name: sessionStorage
desc: Contents of the browser's session storage.
meaning: Contents of the browser's session storage after rendering.

name: title
desc: Contains the page title produced by webkit, in the UTF-8 encoding.
meaning: The page title produced by the renderer.

name: anonRenderFineTimingStats
desc: Deliberately non-named fine timing stats. These are all related to each other and unrelated to other timing stats in this message.
meaning: Unlabeled fine grained timing measurements for a render.

name: consoleLogEntry
desc: Any messages logged by the renderer to the console. Note that we capture a subset of the messages logged by the renderer here to avoid explosion.
meaning: Console messages captured by the renderer.

name: documentBuildTimeMsec
desc: Time to build document and render tree response data.
meaning: Time spent building the page structure response.

name: droppedLogEntryCount
desc: Number of dropped log messages. Since we capture only a subset of the messages in console_log_entry this field is included just so that the consumers can get an idea of how many actual attempts were made by the renderer.
meaning: How many console messages were dropped instead of recorded.

name: imageEncodingTimeMsec
desc: Image encoding (e.g. raw -> PNG) time.
meaning: Time spent encoding a rendered image.

name: imageScalingTimeMsec
desc: Image scaling time.
meaning: Time spent resizing a rendered image.

name: layoutTimeMsec
desc: Time from starting render to document finished loading. This includes all fetches, parsing, decoding, running JavaScript, etc.
meaning: Time from starting a render until the document finished loading.

name: paintTimeMsec
desc: Time required to paint a document into our buffer.
meaning: Time spent painting the page into a buffer.

name: renderCostMgcu
desc: Total cost this render spent running and RPC cost in milliGCUs.
meaning: Compute cost of a render, in machine units.

name: renderEngine
desc: Render engine used to render this document.
meaning: Which rendering engine was used for the page.

name: renderRunningTimeMsec
desc: Total CPU time this render spent running in milliseconds.
meaning: Total processor time a render used.

name: renderServerBaselineCl
desc: The CL from which the render engine was built.
meaning: The code revision the render engine was built from.

name: renderTimeMsec
desc: Total wall time taken to render a document in milliseconds.
meaning: Total wall clock time taken to render a page.

name: sandboxRenderTimeMsec
desc: Total time spent in the sandbox in milliseconds. This time includes all phases measured individually below.
meaning: Total time a render spent inside the sandbox.

name: name
desc: By convention, counters may contain a "." which we use to separate a metric name from a counter name in streamz.
meaning: Name of an internal counter recorded during rendering.

name: box
desc: Box is set for render blocks ( , , etc). Box for any RenderTreeNode can be found either in the RenderTreeNode itself or by traversing up the ancestors until a RenderTreeNode with a Box is found.
meaning: Bounding box of a laid out block in the rendered page.

name: childRenderTreeNodeIndex
desc: child_render_tree_node_index is an index into the list of RenderTreeNodes stored in the Document.
meaning: Positions of a layout entry's children in the page layout list.

name: domTreeNodeIndex
desc: Index of the DOMTreeNode for which this RenderTreeNode is applicable. This index can be used to lookup a DOMTreeNode from list of DOMTreeNodes stored in the Document.
meaning: Position of the page node a layout entry corresponds to.

name: renderedText
desc: The actual text that was rendered. This is applicable only for text nodes.
meaning: The actual visible text that was rendered for a text node.

name: styleIndex
desc: Style index is set for rendered nodes (text nodes, image nodes, widgets, etc). The style_index can be used to lookup the style from the list of styles stored in the Document.
meaning: Position of the style applied to a rendered node.

name: content
desc:
content contains a complete HTTP response message including the HTTP status line, headers and body. For example: HTTP/1.1 200 OK
 Content-Type: text/html
 
 ... content ... For inputs (RenderRequest.resource): Any HTTP content encoding (e.g. gzip) and transfer encoding (e.g. chunked) MUST be decoded. HTTP content and transfer encoding headers will be ignored if present. For outputs (RenderResponse.referenced_resource_content): The body will be decoded (no content or transfer encoding) h
meaning: The full HTTP response, headers and body, for a fetched resource.

name: fetchSourceInfo
desc: Where this resource comes from.
meaning: Where a fetched resource was served from.

name: finalContentUrl
desc: The url that contributes the final content. Only existed when metadata contains FetchReplyData.
meaning: The address that supplied the final content of a resource.

name: method
desc: The HTTP request method (GET, HEAD, POST, etc) used for this request. Values are taken from the HTTPHeaders::Protocol enum in webutil/http/httputils.h. If it's not set, we will infer GET or POST based on the presence of post_data.
meaning: HTTP method used to request a resource.

name: requestHeader
desc: Only necessary headers are included in the resource key by default. See google3/htmlrender/webkit_headless/resource_key.cc
meaning: Request headers recorded for a fetched resource.

name: columnNumber
desc: The current column number for the stack frame.
meaning: Column number of a frame in a script call stack.

name: functionName
desc: The function name of the stack frame.
meaning: Function name of a frame in a script call stack.

name: lineNumber
desc: The current line number for the stack frame.
meaning: Line number of a frame in a script call stack.

name: url
desc: The URL of the script being executed.
meaning: URL of the script running in a call stack frame.

name: marginTop
desc: Margin
meaning: Top margin applied to a rendered element.

name: referencedResourceIndex
desc: List of referenced resource indexes for any resources that this style references. (e.g. background images.) (see document.proto)
meaning: Resources referenced by a style rule, such as background images.

name: foregroundColorArgb
desc: Foreground color encoded as ARGB
meaning: Text color of a rendered element.

name: backgroundImageUrl
desc: The url of the background image in the first layer.
meaning: Address of the first background image used by an element.

name: clip
desc: Default value for clip is "auto", which is represented here as !has_clip().
meaning: Clipping rectangle applied to a rendered element.

name: backgroundSizeWidth
desc: Only present (but may be missing) if background_size == SIZE_LENGTH.
meaning: Width a background image was sized to, when given as a length.

name: paddingTop
desc: Padding
meaning: Top padding applied to a rendered element.

name: hasBackground
desc: Starting from Chromium, has_background is set when there is a non-empty specification for background_image, whether it be a url, gradient or other cases, such as cross-fade. Besides setting this field, We additionally parse url and gradient cases and populate some of the following background fields.
meaning: Whether an element has any background image specified.

name: backgroundImageXPos
desc: Background image position (x, y).
meaning: Position of a background image within an element.

name: backgroundColorArgb
desc: Background color encoded as ARGB
meaning: Background color of a rendered element.

name: zIndex
desc: Default value for z-index is "auto" which means "inherit from parent".
meaning: The default stacking order value for a rendered element, inherited from its parent.

name: devtoolsFrameId
desc: Chromium DevTools frame ID of the frame that initiated this fetch. Only populated in the streaming render service with FETCH_MODE_CLIENT.
meaning: An internal browser frame identifier for the frame that started a resource fetch.

name: allowed
desc: Whether or not the window was allowed to be opened by the popup blocker. Unless user events are created with a render extension this should be false.
meaning: Whether the popup blocker let a new window open during rendering.

name: url
desc: The URL for the new window. Note that this is the URL after it has been processed by WebKit, so, for example, relative links passed to window.create() will have been made absolute.
meaning: The absolute address a page tried to open in a new window.

name: windowFeatures
desc: Window features passed to window.open().
meaning: The window settings a page passed when trying to open a new window.

name: windowName
desc: Window name passed to window.open(). If no name is provided this defaults to "_blank".
meaning: The name a page gave to a new window it tried to open.

name: countryCode
desc: The country calling code for this number, as defined by the International Telecommunication Union (ITU). For example, this would be 1 for NANPA countries, and 33 for France.
meaning: The international dialing code of a phone number, such as 1 or 33.

name: countryCodeSource
desc: The source from which the country_code is derived.
meaning: Where the phone number's country code was worked out from.

name: extension
desc: Extension is not standardized in ITU recommendations, except for being defined as a series of numbers with a maximum length of 40 digits. It is defined as a string here to accommodate for the possible use of a leading zero in the extension (organizations have complete freedom to do so, as there is no standard defined). Other than digits, some other dialling characters such as "," (indicating a wait) may be stored here.
meaning: The extension digits that follow a phone number.

name: italianLeadingZero
desc: In some countries, the national (significant) number starts with one or more "0"s without this being a national prefix or trunk code of some kind. For example, the leading zero in the national (significant) number of an Italian phone number indicates the number is a fixed-line number. There have been plans to migrate fixed-line numbers to start with the digit two since December 2000, but it has not happened yet. See
meaning: Whether the phone number keeps a meaningful leading zero.

name: nationalNumber
desc: The National (significant) Number, as defined in International Telecommunication Union (ITU) Recommendation E.164, without any leading zero. The leading-zero is stored separately if required, since this is an uint64 and hence cannot store such information. Do not use this field directly: if you want the national significant number, call the getNationalSignificantNumber method of PhoneNumberUtil. For countries which have the concept of an "area code" or "national destination code&q
meaning: The main part of a phone number without its country code or leading zero.

name: numberOfLeadingZeros
desc: Full description of this field in the comment for italian_leading_zero since this field will only be set when italian_leading_zero is true.
meaning: How many leading zeros the phone number starts with.

name: preferredDomesticCarrierCode
desc: The carrier selection code that is preferred when calling this phone number domestically. This also includes codes that need to be dialed in some countries when calling from landlines to mobiles or vice versa. For example, in Columbia, a "3" needs to be dialed before the phone number itself when calling from a mobile phone to a domestic landline phone and vice versa. Note this is the "preferred" code, which means other codes may work as well.
meaning: The carrier code usually dialed before this number within its own country.

name: rawInput
desc: This field is used to store the raw input string containing phone numbers before it was canonicalized by the library. For example, it could be used to store alphanumerical numbers such as "1-800-GOOG-411".
meaning: The phone number exactly as it was written before being cleaned up.

name: byteSize
desc: the size of the stored thumbnail
meaning: How many bytes the stored thumbnail image takes up.

name: crops
desc: SmartCrop crop-hints By default, this field is not populated.
meaning: Suggested crop areas for the thumbnail, normally left empty.

name: deepCrop
desc: DeepCrop crop-hints. Usage in thumbnails could be deprecated in favor or deep_crop_pixels (below). By default, this field is not populated.
meaning: An older style of suggested crop area for the thumbnail, normally left empty.

name: deepCropPixels
desc: DeepCrop signal in pixels, equivalent to deep_crop (above) but with pixels instead of percentages. By default, this field is not populated.
meaning: Suggested crop area for the thumbnail expressed in pixels, normally left empty.

name: docid
desc: the Amarna docid of the thumbnail
meaning: The internal storage identifier of the thumbnail.

name: encryptedDocid
desc: encrypted version of docid
meaning: An encrypted form of the thumbnail's internal identifier.

name: expirationTimestampMicros
desc: expiration timestamp of thumbnail
meaning: When the stored thumbnail is allowed to be dropped from serving.

name: fprint
desc: the fprint of the thumbnail
meaning: A fingerprint used to identify the thumbnail's bytes.

name: height
desc: the height of the stored thumbnail
meaning: The height in pixels of the stored thumbnail.

name: mimeType
desc: The mime_type of the thumbnail ("image/jpeg", "image/png", etc.).
meaning: The file type of the stored thumbnail, such as JPEG or PNG.

name: originalWidth
desc: Not populated by Amarna/image pipelines, ever. This was apparently introduced by a customer that wished to extend ThumbnailMetadata with this custom data.
meaning: A custom width field that image pipelines never fill in.

name: width
desc: the width of the stored thumbnail
meaning: The width in pixels of the stored thumbnail.

name: byteSize
desc: Size of the stored preview.
meaning: How many bytes the stored video preview clip takes up.

name: docid
desc: 64 bit docid of the original video.
meaning: The internal identifier of the video the preview came from.

name: duration
desc: TODO (yzliu): consider using duration_ms as field name since it is number of milliseconds. Duration of the preview in ms.
meaning: How long the video preview clip runs, in milliseconds.

name: expirationTimestampMicros
desc: Expiration timestamp of preview in microseconds since epoch.
meaning: When the stored video preview is allowed to be dropped from serving.

name: fprint
desc: LINT.ThenChange(//depot/google3/video/crawl/indexing/signal_combiner.cc:video_preview) Fingerprint of the preview.
meaning: A fingerprint used to identify the video preview's bytes.

name: height
desc: Height of the stored preview.
meaning: The height in pixels of the stored video preview.

name: mimeType
desc: Mime type of the preview ("video/mp4").
meaning: The file type of the stored video preview, such as MP4.

name: state
desc: Indicates the state in Venom for this preview type.
meaning: The processing status of this preview in the video storage system.

name: timestamp
desc: Timestamp of start of preview in ms.
meaning: Where in the source video the preview clip starts, in milliseconds.

name: type
desc: LINT.IfChange
meaning: Which kind of video preview this is; the description carries no detail.

name: videoSegmentEndUs
desc: The end timestamp of the video segment in microseconds that this preview is generated from. Used for segmented video previews.
meaning: The end point in the source video of the segment this preview covers.

name: videoSegmentStartUs
desc: The start timestamp of the video segment in microseconds that this preview is generated from. Used for segmented video previews.
meaning: The start point in the source video of the segment this preview covers.

name: width
desc: Width of the stored preview.
meaning: The width in pixels of the stored video preview.

name: starburst
desc: Repeated so that multiple versions can exist in prod simultaneously.
meaning: A holder allowing several versions of image content features to coexist.

name: boost
desc: Score multiplier (fully normalized 1 is nop).
meaning: A multiplier that raises or lowers an image's score for a particular query.

name: query
desc: Canonicalized query string.
meaning: The cleaned-up query text that a per-query image boost applies to.

name: descriptorFloat
desc: Raw dense float feature vector.
meaning: A list of numbers describing what an image looks like.

name: descriptorFloatBeforeProjection
desc: Raw dense float feature vector prior to embedding. Only for Starburst V6.
meaning: The image feature numbers before they are compressed into an embedding.

name: descriptorShort
desc: Short descriptor for image content features, e.g. compressed bytes. This is the compressed version of descriptor_float below. It can be can be decompressed to descriptor_float with a tiny bit of compression error (in most cases it should be totally fine).
meaning: A compact compressed version of the image's feature numbers.

name: starburstTokens
desc: Starburst tokens.
meaning: Short codes standing for the visual clusters an image belongs to.

name: starburstTokensDistances
desc: Squared distance of the current embedding to each cluster center. Elements are aligned with starburst_tokens.
meaning: How far the image sits from each of the visual clusters assigned to it.

name: version
desc: The following integers are currently used: Starburst V1: 1 Starburst V2: 2 Starburst V3: 3 Starburst V4: 4 Starburst Visual V4: 1004 This field is deprecated. Please try to use the 'enum_version' in future.
meaning: A deprecated number saying which generation of image features was used.

name: entityId
desc: Entity ID.
meaning: The identifier of a real-world thing the image is linked to.

name: score
desc: Multibang score.
meaning: How strongly the image is tied to that real-world thing.

name: name
desc: List the string representation of the vertical that this image is indexed into.
meaning: The name of a specialized index this image was placed into.

name: confidence
desc: Associated confidence scores for the image for the query.
meaning: How confident the system is that this image matches the stored query.

name: imageClickRank
desc: Click-based rank of the image for this query.
meaning: Where the image ranks for this query based on clicks it received.

name: navFp
desc: Query fingerprint.
meaning: A compact identifier standing in for the query text.

name: navQuery
desc: The normalized raw query text.
meaning: The tidied-up text of a query the image is strongly associated with.

name: referrerDocid
desc: List of all referrers, sorted by their rank (stored in Moosedog).
meaning: Identifiers of the pages that show this image, ordered by their rank.

name: referrerRank
desc: Rank of the current web doc referrer (stored in docjoins).
meaning: Where the current page ranks among the pages that show this image.

name: acquireLicensePage
desc: Page URL about how to acquire this licensable image.
meaning: A link to the page where a license for the image can be bought.

name: creator
desc: IPTC authorship & copyright related fields.
meaning: The credited creator of the image from its embedded metadata.

name: dateCreated
desc: Time (in seconds)
meaning: The creation date recorded in the image's embedded metadata.

name: digitalSourceType
desc: See go/gi-annotations-indexing for more information.
meaning: A tag in the image metadata saying how the image was originally produced.

name: imageSupplier
desc: PLUS field, not used.
meaning: A metadata slot for the image supplier that is not used.

name: licenseUrl
desc: License URL about how to distribute the image.
meaning: A link to the terms describing how the image may be distributed.

name: locationCreated
desc: Location of the camera
meaning: Where the camera was when the picture was taken.

name: locationShown
desc: Location shown on the image
meaning: The place or places shown in the picture.

name: title
desc: IPTC description related fields.
meaning: The title given to the image in its embedded metadata.

name: title
desc: Other fields omitted.
meaning: The title of the artwork shown in the image.

name: modificationTime
desc: in time_t
meaning: The time the image file was last modified, from its metadata.

name: meteringMode
desc: 1-6, see EXIF definition
meaning: How the camera measured light for the shot.

name: focalLength35mm
desc: convert to match 35mm film camera
meaning: The lens focal length converted to the traditional 35mm scale.

name: copyright
desc: EXIF_TAG_COPYRIGHT
meaning: The copyright notice stored inside the image file.

name: description
desc: EXIF_TAG_IMAGE_DESCRIPTION
meaning: A description of the picture stored inside the image file.

name: xResolution
desc: pixels per inch
meaning: The horizontal print resolution recorded in the image file.

name: cameraMaker
desc: Device - Camera raw text without normalization
meaning: The camera brand recorded in the image file, exactly as written.

name: lensId
desc: Device - Lens We use this extended id to identify a lens uniquely. Canon: "%d %d %d"=.. Nikon: "%.2X %.2X %.2X %.2X %.2X %.2X %.2X %.2X" Don't change the format of the internal lens id because we use them to look up the lens names.
meaning: An internal code identifying the exact lens used.

name: keywords
desc: EXIF_TAG_XP_KEYWORDS
meaning: Keywords the author stored inside the image file.

name: cameraModel
desc: raw text without normalization
meaning: The camera model recorded in the image file, exactly as written.

name: longitude
desc: +/- 180 inclusive
meaning: The longitude where the picture was taken.

name: comments2
desc: EXIF_TAG_XP_COMMENT
meaning: A second free-text comment field stored inside the image file.

name: hPositioningError
desc: in meters
meaning: The estimated error in the recorded position, in meters.

name: imgDirection
desc: GPS Heading 0.00 to 359.99 degrees
meaning: The compass direction the camera was pointing, in degrees.

name: exposureProgram
desc: 1-8, see EXIF definition
meaning: The exposure setting the camera used when taking the picture.

name: subject
desc: EXIF_TAG_XP_SUBJECT
meaning: A subject line stored inside the image file.

name: author2
desc: EXIF_TAG_XP_AUTHOR
meaning: A second author field taken from the image file's metadata.

name: destLatitude
desc: GPS location of destination point.
meaning: The coordinates of a destination point recorded by the camera.

name: author
desc: Text fields EXIF_TAG_ARTIST
meaning: The artist credited inside the image file's metadata.

name: latitude
desc: GPS location +/- 90 inclusive
meaning: The latitude where the picture was taken.

name: gpsDop
desc: Dilution of precision. HDOP/PDOP depends on measure mode. Find out more at
meaning: How precise the camera's satellite position reading was.

name: software
desc: EXIF_TAG_SOFTWARE
meaning: The program that last saved the image file.

name: deprecatedCity
desc: Location from IPTC @deprecated: Use iptc.location instead.
meaning: An old city field from image metadata, replaced by a newer location field.

name: cameraSerialNumber
desc: This is the extracted serial number from EXIF (the source depends on camera, most of the cameras store it in makers note tag).
meaning: The serial number of the camera that took the picture.

name: destBearingRef
desc: Bearing and distance to destination point.
meaning: The compass bearing toward the destination point recorded by the camera.

name: yResolution
desc: pixels per inch
meaning: The vertical print resolution recorded in the image file.

name: captureTime
desc: Capturing settings in time_t
meaning: The time the photograph was taken, from the image file's metadata.

name: comments
desc: EXIF_TAG_USER_COMMENT
meaning: A free-text comment stored inside the image file.

name: title
desc: EXIF_TAG_XP_TITLE
meaning: A title stored inside the image file by the author.

name: inspirationScore
desc: How an image is inspirational, [0, 1].
meaning: How inspirational a picture is judged to be, scored from zero to one.

name: detailedReason
desc: Each of the above not_crawled_reason will have a set of detailed reason defined in crawler/trawler/trawler_enums.proto.
meaning: A more specific code explaining why an image was not fetched.

name: internalStatus
desc: The status returned when RPCs are used to internally fetch the image (eg. from FIFE).
meaning: The internal status returned when fetching the image over an internal service.

name: isTerminal
desc: Specifies if the current crawl state is terminal.
meaning: Whether the current fetch state is final.

name: noIndexAfterTimestamp
desc: Time in seconds since epoch after which this image should be considered unavailable.
meaning: The time after which this image should be treated as no longer available.

name: overrodeTerminalState
desc: When true, it means that a non-terminal state has overwrote a terminal one.
meaning: Whether a non-final fetch state overwrote a final one.

name: repid
desc: The repid for the urls. This repid is the id given to the dupe cluster this url belongs to.
meaning: The identifier of the duplicate group this address belongs to.

name: robotedAgents
desc: A comma separated list of user agents for which this image should be considered roboted. All images are crawled using googlebot-images and this exists here purely for informative reasons.
meaning: Crawler user agents blocked from this image, recorded for information only.

name: url
desc: The url at which we crawled this content. With us starting to use repids the crawl table key no longer is suggestive of the url. In addition this is used in Amarna to detect race conditions between a reference changing its crawl directive and the original crawl job finishing.
meaning: The address the image content was actually fetched from.

name: urlDeleted
desc: Set to true if the url is taken down by clients. This indicates that this crawl state is used to fast remove the crawl result of the url instead of waiting for Multiverse crawl results. For more information, please refer to go/amarna-url-deletion.
meaning: Whether the address was taken down so its fetch result can be removed quickly.

name: webRelevanceScore
desc: score calculated in image selection phase, higher imagelink_selection_score more relevant the link is related to the web page
meaning: How well an image matches the page it was picked from.

name: gveClicks
desc: Good clicks that are defined using GVE (go/gve-history).
meaning: Counts of clicks judged to be good ones for this image.

name: mediaEntitiesId
desc: Similar to above, but for media entities (movie name, fictional character, musical band)
meaning: Identifiers of media things such as films or bands linked to the document.

name: peopleEntitiesId
desc: hrid of the 5 people entities with higher topicality in the document
meaning: Identifiers of the five people the document is most about.

name: boundingBox
desc: The bounding box of the region.
meaning: The rectangle marking where a detected object sits in the image.

name: boundingBoxScore
desc: The confidence score associated with the bounding box.
meaning: How confident the system is in that detected rectangle.

name: id
desc: A unique identifier for the region within the image. The id is unique only among other regions in the image.
meaning: A local identifier distinguishing this region from others in the image.

name: isProduct
desc: Set true if the region represents a product, i.e., if any of its labels are on a product labels whitelist. See ImageRegionsConfig for details on the product whitelist.
meaning: Whether the detected region is considered a product.

name: knnScore
desc: The score for this region based on how visually similar its neighbors are.
meaning: How visually similar this region is to its closest look-alikes.

name: labelGroup
desc: The label group corresponding to the first LabelParams listed in ImageRegionsConfig.
meaning: The set of labels attached to this part of the image.

name: labelVersion
desc: The version string of the labels with which the region was processed.
meaning: Which version of the labeling system processed this region.

name: primaryLabel
desc: The primary label associated with the region. Specifically, the highest-scored whitelisted label associated with the region. See ImageRegionsConfig for details on the whitelist.
meaning: The best label describing what is in this part of the image.

name: starburstV4
desc: The starburst v4 features and tokens for the region.
meaning: Visual feature embeddings and tokens computed for one region of an image.

name: finalPornScore
desc: The final_porn_score for the image.
meaning: Final adult-content probability score assigned to the image.

name: finalViolenceScore
desc: The final_violence_score for the image.
meaning: Final violence probability score assigned to the image.

name: flowOutput
desc: The output of various features generated by the Flow framework, most importantly data from Starburst (go/starburst).
meaning: Container holding image features produced by the Flow framework, including Starburst data.

name: has300kThumb
desc: True if the image has a 300k thumb.
meaning: Whether a 300k-size thumbnail exists for the image.

name: hasNavboost
desc: True if the image has navboost.
meaning: Whether the image has Navboost click data attached to it.

name: isIuInappropriate
desc: True if the image is iu-inappropriate.
meaning: Whether the image is flagged as inappropriate for Images Universal.

name: pedoScore
desc: The pedo_score of the image.
meaning: Score estimating child-abuse risk in the image, used by abuse tooling.

name: precomputedRestricts
desc: The precomputed restricts for the image.
meaning: Precomputed restriction flags attached to the image for filtering at serving time.

name: racyScore
desc: The racy_score of the image.
meaning: Score for how sexually suggestive the image is.

name: region
desc: The list of regions.
meaning: The list of detected regions inside the image.

name: duplicateOfYtS3Asr
desc: If this field is set to true, it means that Youtube already processed the ASR from S3 for the langID. Please find the ASR result from transcript_asr in google3/image/repository/proto/video_search.proto instead.
meaning: Flag saying YouTube already produced this speech transcript, so it should be read elsewhere.

name: langWithoutLocale
desc: DEPRECATED: Please switch to
meaning: A deprecated language code field with the locale removed.

name: langidInput
desc: The language identification input used to generate this ASR. This field is populated in Kronos Amarna Cloud Speech operator and passed to Amarna, but cleared before stored in Amarna's metadata table.
meaning: The language-detection input used to produce the transcript, cleared before storage.

name: results
desc: Raw results from Cloud Speech API
meaning: Raw speech-to-text output returned by the Cloud Speech API for the video.

name: s3RecognizerMetadataResponse
desc: The metadata about the S3 recognizer used.
meaning: Metadata about which speech recognizer backend was used.

name: transcriptAsr
desc: This field contains full (stitched) transcription, word-level time offset , and word-level byte offset. The value of this field is derived from the SpeechRecognitionResult field above.
meaning: The full stitched speech transcript of the video with word timing offsets.

name: signalsBlobId
desc: Blob id for AmarnaSignalsBlob (see
meaning: Storage identifier for the blob holding video signal data.

name: signalsBlobUpdateTimestamp
desc: Additional timestamp field for when the blob is written/updated, serving as the dirty field to help checksum-based update push (see
meaning: Timestamp of when the signals blob was last written, used for update bookkeeping.

name: aggregatedPornScores
desc: Aggregated porn scores for animated images. Aggregated using max sampling rate / max duration. Note the plan is to fold these scores into existing summarized scores, for cases where these scores are available. See tracking bug b/63580795.
meaning: Combined adult-content scores computed across the frames of an animated image.

name: durationMs
desc: Total duration of animation, in ms.
meaning: Total length of the animation in milliseconds.

name: expirationTimestampSec
desc: Timestamp (measured in seconds since epoch) after which Amarna will delete the serving transcode.
meaning: Time after which the stored video transcode is deleted.

name: genus
desc: The Venom Genus that this transcode was produced for.
meaning: The internal client category the video transcode was made for.

name: state
desc: Indicates the state in Venom for this transcode type.
meaning: Processing state of this transcode in the video pipeline.

name: transcodeItag
desc: transcode type which are available for the video.
meaning: Identifier of the transcode format available for the video.

name: videoId
desc: The Venom ID that this transcode was produced for.
meaning: Internal pipeline video ID this transcode was produced for.

name: xtagsList
desc: Indicates xtags if present. Xtag makes the different transcode. For transcode "MP4_AVCBASE640_AAC/af=sq" (itag 18 with xtag), "af=sq" is the xtag part. This is a different transcode than "MP4_AVCBASE640_AAC" (itag 18).
meaning: Extra tags that distinguish variants of the same transcode format.

name: name
desc: Names are all stored case-sensitive, and no case-folding is done for comparisons.
meaning: Case-sensitive name of a transcode variant tag.

name: value
desc: The value associated with this Xtag. Values are all stored case-sensitive, and no case-folding is done for comparisons.
meaning: Case-sensitive value of a transcode variant tag.

name: aresClassificationRequestTimestamp
desc: Timestamp of the last successful Ares classification request.
meaning: Timestamp of the last successful video classification request.

name: videoPreviewBytes
desc: video_preview_bytes is only exported as virtual dataset by IE VideoUnderstanding and should not be persisted. It will be used by downstream IE functions to push for serving.
meaning: The raw bytes of a generated video preview, passed along for serving only.

name: loudnessData
desc: When Transcode itag 140 is requested, MediaAnalyzer (as the part of Viper graph) generates audio info including loudness_data, which is then published to Streamer. For Audio news client, we extract this loudness data from Streamer to this field.
meaning: Audio loudness measurements extracted during transcoding.

name: cloudSpeechSignals
desc: Transcript generated from Cloud Speech API
meaning: Speech transcript generated for the video by the Cloud Speech API.

name: featureSetData
desc: Video Understanding Golden features. (go/amarna-video-signals#golden-signals) Note: Golden6 features (names matching "video_
meaning: Stored set of video understanding features describing the video's content.

name: videoPornScoreV4
desc: The video porn confidence score extracted from WhisperV4 featureSet: "VideoFeatures.whisper_v4_labels", with CR2 label: "/tns/porn".
meaning: Newer model confidence score that the video contains pornographic content.

name: transcriptAsr
desc: Speech related metadata The transcript_asr field is generated from the YT caption's SPEECH_RECOGNIZER asset.
meaning: Speech transcript of the video generated from the caption speech recognizer.

name: lmsPreviewFramePerdocs
desc: LMS preview frame perdocs. Timestamps of the frame perdocs are from the original video, not from the preview.
meaning: Per-frame data records for frames sampled from a generated video preview.

name: signalsBlob
desc: Amarna signals blob that contains large-size signals like VCA frame-level signals.
meaning: Blob holding large video signal data such as frame-level features.

name: frameLevelStarburstEmbeddings
desc: Frame-level Starburst embeddings. They are IE only signals for short videos initially and will be supported for all videos later. (go/frame-level-sbv5-on-ie)
meaning: Per-frame visual embeddings computed for short videos.

name: golden7SoapboxTracksBlobInfo
desc: Information on frame-level people feature blob. (go/vpf-frame-features)
meaning: Pointer to the blob holding frame-level people features.

name: videoStreamInfo
desc: Deprecated, please use media_info.
meaning: Deprecated video stream details replaced by the media info field.

name: transcodeMetadata
desc: Metadata about each transcode requested.
meaning: Details about each transcode that was requested for the video.

name: truncationInfo
desc: Data about whether or not the video was truncated.
meaning: Whether the stored video file was cut short when fetched.

name: mediaInfo
desc: Information about the media file, such as duration, resolution, and detail about each audio/video stream. Note that it contains no PII.
meaning: Basic facts about the media file such as duration, resolution and stream details.

name: venomId
desc: The video id in the venom pipeline for STAMP purposes. DEPRECATED: Use transcode_metadata or venom_processing_info instead, which includes the ID and contains information for all clients.
meaning: A deprecated internal video pipeline ID.

name: s3Asr
desc: Trnascript generated through AMARNA_CLOUD_SPEECH asset in Venom. Note that AMARNA_CLOUD_SPEECH uses S3 as the speech engine backend, similar to YT caption's SPEECH_RECOGNIZER asset. However, they may use different S3 models.
meaning: Speech transcript generated for the video by the internal speech engine.

name: venomProcessingInfo
desc: Information about the video's status in Venom, including IDs and processing times.
meaning: Status and processing times for the video inside the transcoding pipeline.

name: safesearchVideoContentSignals
desc: Contains SafeSearch video classification outputs which are vertical_name/float pairs.
meaning: SafeSearch classifier scores for the video's content across sensitive categories.

name: videoPornScore
desc: The video porn confidence score extracted from Whisper featureSet: "video_labels:whisper_v3", with CR2 label: "/cr2/1".
meaning: Confidence score that the video contains pornographic content.

name: thumbnailQualityScore
desc: Thumbnail quality score predict how visual pleasing a thumbnail is, based on the model trained with deep neural networks.(go/thumb_features_dd) Note the signal currently only available for Youtube videos.
meaning: Model score for how visually appealing a video thumbnail is.

name: videoDurationSec
desc: Set from the video header if truncated, or is the verified length if completely crawled.
meaning: Length of the video in seconds.

name: inlinePlayback
desc: Metadata related to Inline playback on the Interest Feed. This field is filled by Hamilton.
meaning: Metadata for playing the video inline in the Interest Feed.

name: signalsBlobInfo
desc: Information for the amarna signals blob.
meaning: Bookkeeping details about the stored video signals blob.

name: audioOnly
desc: Both audio- and audio-video-files are treated as videos during indexing (whether they share a container format, like .mp4, or not, like .mp3). This bool indicates that there's no video track, just an audio track.
meaning: Whether the file has only an audio track and no video track.

name: golden7SoapboxSummary
desc: Golden7 video-level people features. (go/ypf-video-features)
meaning: Video-level features about people appearing in the video.

name: videoAnchorSet
desc: Video anchor sets hold set of anchors with multiple anchor types and sequence of VideoAnchor which contains metadata about the anchor, such as thumbnail, perdoc data.
meaning: Sets of anchor points in the video with thumbnails and metadata for key moments.

name: amarnaDocid
desc: A hash of the video bytes used as a key to Amarna's video_metadata table.
meaning: A hash of the video bytes used as a storage key.

name: multiThumbnailsFramePerdocs
desc: multi_thumbnails_frame_perdocs contains perdocs(go/vss-signals#perdoc) for all frame thumbnails generated by multiple frames per minutes. See more details in go/multiple-thumbnails-per-minutes.
meaning: Per-frame data records for the many thumbnails sampled from the video.

name: videoPreviews
desc: video_previews contain the preview metadata but no bytes. It exits for IE and non-IE cases.
meaning: Metadata describing available video previews without the preview bytes.

name: legosAnnotationData
desc: Legos results
meaning: Stored output of the Legos video annotation system.

name: youtubeProcessingFilter
desc: Contains lists of reasons why YT videos were filtered from specific processing.
meaning: Reasons why a YouTube video was skipped by certain processing steps.

name: unwantedContent
desc: If set, video has been deleted using the deletion service (MediaDeletionService).
meaning: Marks that the video was removed through the media deletion service.

name: searchDocid
desc: 64 bit docid used for retrieving video previews.
meaning: Internal document ID used to fetch video previews.

name: videoTranscriptAnnotations
desc: VideoTranscriptAnnotations holds sentence segmented text and timing information to be used for VideoAnswers (go/video-answers). Note that only punctuated_transcript, timing_info, and lang field are filled, and other fields will be filled in the later stage.
meaning: Sentence-split video transcript with timing, used to build video answers.

name: score
desc: DeepImageEngagingness score.
meaning: Model score predicting how engaging an image is.

name: originalFileSizeLowerBoundBytes
desc: A lower bound on the original file's size.
meaning: A lower bound on the size of the original file.

name: truncationState
desc: Indicates whether the stored file is equal to the original file (COMPLETE), is only a prefix (TRUNCATED), or that we don't know (UNKNOWN, the default).
meaning: Whether the stored file is complete, only a prefix, or unknown.

name: timestampMs
desc: Offset of the frame from the beginning of the video (in milliseconds).
meaning: How far into the video this frame occurs, in milliseconds.

name: xtagList
desc: All xtags used in the generation of the preview. The same frame generated from the same preview with different xtags will likely have different bytes (such as, for example, resulting from a different aspect ratio).
meaning: The variant tags used when generating this preview frame.

name: starburstV5Embeddings
desc: Frame-level Starburst V5 embeddings computed by SUP. See
meaning: Per-frame visual embeddings for the video computed by a newer model.

name: starburstV5EmbeddingsBlobInfo
desc: Frame-level Starburst V5 embeddings blob id.
meaning: Storage pointer to the blob holding per-frame embeddings.

name: errorStatus
desc: Error, if any, while generating the frame perdoc. It is mutually exclusive to the perdoc, only set when perdoc is missing.
meaning: Error recorded when per-frame data could not be generated.

name: timestampMsec
desc: Timestamp (in msec) of the frame from the original video DEPRECATED: Use the timestamp_ms field in frame_identifier instead.
meaning: Deprecated frame timestamp field replaced by the frame identifier.

name: localeStripped
desc: Whether the locale got stripped from the original result before further processing.
meaning: Whether the locale part was removed from the detected language result.

name: s3TopLocale
desc: From cs/symbol:speech.s3.LanguageIdentificationResult owned by go/s3.
meaning: Top language and locale detected by the speech language identifier.

name: ytCapsAudioLanguage
desc: From cs/symbol:video_platform.operation.AudioLanguage owned gy go/ytcaps.
meaning: Audio language reported by the YouTube captions system.

name: audioInputCap
desc: Audio input processing cap.
meaning: Debug value for how much audio the language detector processed.

name: failedSegments
desc: Number of failed segments. Successful segments are stored in
meaning: Debug count of audio segments that failed language detection.

name: processedSegments
desc: Number of processed segments.
meaning: Debug count of audio segments processed for language detection.

name: segmentDuration
desc: Duration of each segment (except for the last one if capped).
meaning: Debug value for the length of each analyzed audio segment.

name: segmentStride
desc: If >1, every N segment is processed.
meaning: Debug value for how many segments are skipped between analyzed ones.

name: waveHeader
desc: Wave header of the audio input.
meaning: Technical header describing the audio input format.

name: containsSpeech
desc: Whether this audio chunk has speech or not.
meaning: Whether this chunk of audio contains speech.

name: langidResult
desc: S3 langID result. We keep langid_result even if contains_speech = false.
meaning: The raw language detection result for an audio chunk.

name: languageIdentification
desc: Converted version of the langid_result field, so that we have the YT compatible version of the langID result.
meaning: The language detection result converted to the YouTube-compatible format.

name: modelVersion
desc: The version of the model used for S3 LangID service.
meaning: Version of the model used for language detection.

name: startSec
desc: The audio chunk which corresponds to this langID result expressed as a start_sec and end_sec.
meaning: Start time of the audio chunk this language result covers.

name: totalFrameCount
desc: Count the number of total frames in the audio chunk as well as the number of speech frames.
meaning: Count of audio frames in the analyzed chunk.

name: embedding
desc: Embedding of the frame.
meaning: Numeric embedding representing one video frame.

name: timeOffset
desc: Time offset of the frame.
meaning: Time position of the frame the embedding belongs to.

name: embeddings
desc: All the frame-level embeddings of the video.
meaning: All per-frame embeddings computed for the video.

name: productSets
desc: Information about versioned product sets found. There will be at most two versions present. The results from the current version of the models used in VSS and the results from the previous version of the models used. Note that not all products may have two version since the model might detect the product in one version and not the other.
meaning: Versioned sets of products detected inside the image by shopping models.

name: h
desc: The vertical height of the bounding box (ymax - ymin + 1), normalized by image height with range [0,1].
meaning: Height of a detected product box as a fraction of image height.

name: w
