desc: The horizontal width of the bound box (xmax - xmin + 1), normalized by image width with range [0,1].
meaning: Width of a detected product box as a fraction of image width.

name: x
desc: The x coordinate (xmin), normalized by image width with range [0,1).
meaning: Left edge of a detected product box as a fraction of image width.

name: y
desc: The y coordinate (ymin), normalized by image height with range [0,1).
meaning: Top edge of a detected product box as a fraction of image height.

name: score
desc: The normalized recognition score between 0 and 1.
meaning: Confidence that a recognized shopping entity is correct.

name: categoryId
desc: The possible Merlot ids for the item. There may be more than one if the product detector result corresponds to a collection of merlot ids, which can't be easily grouped up to a common ancestor, for which the detector would still make sense for all the children. E.g. a detected "chair" can be either an indoor chair or an outdoor one, however in Merlot the common ancestor of the two is furniture.
meaning: Product category identifiers that a detected item may belong to.

name: clusterIds
desc: The k-d tree clusters for retrieval. Will be deprecated, use the token_groups instead. To add tokens/cluster_ids from new tokenization model in the future, add it to the token_groups.
meaning: Cluster identifiers used to retrieve similar products.

name: detectionScore
desc: The localization detection score.
meaning: Confidence that a product was correctly located in the image.

name: embedding
desc: The serialized embedding values.
meaning: Serialized numeric embedding of a detected product.

name: entities
desc: The recognized entities and scores.
meaning: Entities recognized for a detected product along with their scores.

name: featureType
desc: Feature type (different detectors and embedders) requested.
meaning: Which detector and embedder model type produced this product result.

name: productLocation
desc: The bounding box.
meaning: The box marking where the product sits in the image.

name: modelType
desc: The type of the model.
meaning: The type of model that produced this set of product results.

name: products
desc: List of ProductInformation for this version.
meaning: The list of products found by one version of the shopping models.

name: version
desc: The version of the models used in VSS. Newer version will have a higher version number.
meaning: Version number of the shopping models used.

name: confidence
desc: The confidence estimate between 0.0 and 1.0. A higher number indicates an estimated greater likelihood that the recognized words are correct. This field is set only for the top alternative of a non-streaming result or, of a streaming result where
meaning: How confident the speech recognizer is in a transcript alternative.

name: transcript
desc: Transcript text representing the words that the user spoke.
meaning: The recognized spoken text from the audio.

name: words
desc: A list of word-specific information for each recognized word. Note: When
meaning: Per-word details for each recognized word in a transcript.

name: alternatives
desc: May contain one or more recognition hypotheses (up to the maximum specified in
meaning: Alternative transcript hypotheses returned by the recognizer.

name: channelTag
desc: For multi-channel audio, this is the channel number corresponding to the recognized result for the audio from that channel. For audio_channel_count = N, its output values can range from '1' to 'N'.
meaning: Which audio channel this recognition result came from.

name: languageCode
desc: The
meaning: Language code of the recognized speech.

name: resultEndTime
desc: Time offset of the end of this result relative to the beginning of the audio. This field is internal-only and is used to order results based on their timestamps.
meaning: Internal end time used to order speech recognition results.

name: venomStatus
desc: Contains one status for each Genus that this video belongs to in Venom. For example, a video that is both 1) Found on the web, and 2) Opted-in by an Interest Feed partner would have two entries, one for GENUS_CRAWL and one for GENUS_VIDEO_INTEREST_FEED
meaning: Processing status of the video for each internal client of the pipeline.

name: acl
desc: Venom ACL of the video. Used to check if other systems, such as Ares, are able to process the video.
meaning: Access control settings for the video inside the media pipeline.

name: genus
desc: The Genus (Venom's client ID) that this media belongs to.
meaning: The internal client category this media belongs to in the pipeline.

name: insertionResponseTimestampUsec
desc: Time that VideoNotification result was received from Venom.
meaning: Time the pipeline notification result was received.

name: lastInsertionAttemptsNum
desc: Record the attempts num of previous insertion. It's only updated when either the insertion succeeds or fails with reason INSERTION_ATTEMPTS_EXCEEDED, but it's always set so that we can easily construct venom_id with this attempts num for future insertions.
meaning: How many times insertion into the pipeline was attempted.

name: settings
desc: The Settings that were used to customize the Venom request for this media.
meaning: Settings used to customize the media pipeline request.

name: transition
desc: Transition contains the Objective and Outcome of the latest Venom run.
meaning: Goal and outcome of the most recent pipeline run.

name: venomId
desc: The media's unique identifier within Venom.
meaning: The media's unique identifier inside the video pipeline.

name: venomMutationGeneration
desc: The generation number returned by Venom.
meaning: Generation number returned by the video pipeline.

name: videoVenomSetting
desc: This field is not persisted anywhere. It is only used in deletion service for converying the VideoVenomSetting when deleting Venom data.
meaning: Temporary field used only when deleting video pipeline data.

name: crawlStatusInfo
desc: Fields for crawl-status-related debugging information.
meaning: Debugging details about the crawl status of a video link.

name: url
desc: The video URL.
meaning: The address of the video file.

name: lastAmarnaProcessingTime
desc: Last Amarna processing timestamp.
meaning: Time the video was last processed by the media pipeline.

name: processingEngine
desc: The underlying processing engine, like 'viper' or 'kronos'.
meaning: Which internal engine processed the video preview.

name: content
desc: The actual video preview bytes generated for the video.
meaning: The actual bytes of the short preview clip generated for the video.

name: debuggingInfo
desc: Used for debugging only.
meaning: Debug-only information about preview generation.

name: metadata
desc: The metadata associated with the preview (i.e. the type: 8k, 90k, etc.)
meaning: Metadata describing the type and size of a video preview.

name: previewFrameZero
desc: 0th frame image of the preview. This frame has the same resolution as the associated preview video bytes, as it is taken directly from the preview bytes in Venom/Viper processing. Right now, we only populate preview_frame_zero only for the VPREVIEW_TYPE_540K_ORIGINAL_HQ_LICENSED preview type. Note that preview_frame_zero.thumbnails(0).timestamp_ms() is the timestamp from the full video, not from the preview.
meaning: The first still frame taken from the video preview.

name: audioOnly
desc: Both audio- and audio-video-files are treated as videos during indexing (whether they share a container format, like .mp4, or not, like .mp3). This bool indicates that there's no video track, just an audio track.
meaning: Whether the file has only an audio track and no video track.

name: contentBasedMetadata
desc: Information derived from fetched video bytes.
meaning: Pointer to the bundle of information derived from the fetched video bytes.

name: crawlState
desc: The raw crawl state.
meaning: The raw record of how the video was crawled.

name: firstCrawlTimestampSec
desc: Timestamp of the first time that the video was successfully crawled.
meaning: When the video was first successfully fetched.

name: firstProcessingTimestampSec
desc: Timestamp when this video's videoProperties is populated for the first time, measured in seconds since epoch.
meaning: When the video's stored properties were first filled in.

name: indexedVerticals
desc: Proto to store vertical indexing information for the document. The video can be indexed to multiple verticals, including video search. It can also be indexed only in verticals, not in video search.
meaning: Which search verticals the video has been indexed into.

name: inlinePlayback
desc: DEPRECATED: please use content_based_metadata.inline_playback. Metadata related to Inline playback on the Interest Feed
meaning: Deprecated inline playback metadata moved to another field.

name: lastCrawlRequestTimestampSec
desc: Timestamp when this video's last crawling is requested, measured in seconds since epoch.
meaning: When the most recent crawl of the video was requested.

name: lastProcessingTimestampSec
desc: Last timestamp when this video's videoProperties is populated, measured in seconds since epoch.
meaning: When the video's stored properties were last updated.

name: url
desc: This is the video url taken from the key of the Amarna references table row corresponding to this message.
meaning: The address of the video taken from the storage table key.

name: name
desc: List the string representation of the vertical that this image is indexed into.
meaning: Name of a vertical the item is indexed into.

name: confidence
desc: The confidence estimate between 0.0 and 1.0. A higher number indicates an estimated greater likelihood that the recognized words are correct. This field is set only for the top alternative of a non-streaming result or, of a streaming result where
meaning: How confident the recognizer is that a word was heard correctly.

name: endTime
desc: Time offset relative to the beginning of the audio, and corresponding to the end of the spoken word. This field is only set if
meaning: Time in the audio where the spoken word ends.

name: speakerTag
desc: A distinct integer value is assigned for every speaker within the audio. This field specifies which one of those speakers was detected to have spoken this word. Value ranges from '1' to diarization_speaker_count. speaker_tag is set if enable_speaker_diarization = 'true' and only in the top alternative.
meaning: Which detected speaker said this word.

name: startTime
desc: Time offset relative to the beginning of the audio, and corresponding to the start of the spoken word. This field is only set if
meaning: Time in the audio where the spoken word begins.

name: word
desc: The word corresponding to this set of information.
meaning: The individual recognized word text.

name: childScore
desc: The probability that the youngest person in the image is a child.
meaning: Probability that the youngest person shown in the image is a child.

name: csaiScore
desc: This score correlates with potential child abuse. Google confidential!
meaning: Score flagging possible child abuse imagery, used by abuse tooling.

name: csamA1Score
desc: Experimental score. Do not use. Google confidential!
meaning: An experimental abuse-detection score marked not for use.

name: csamAgeIndeterminateScore
desc: Experimental score. Do not use. Google confidential!
meaning: An experimental abuse-detection score marked not for use.

name: iuInappropriateScore
desc: This field contains the probability that an image is inappropriate for Images Universal, according to this policy: go/iupolicy.
meaning: Probability the image is inappropriate for general image results.

name: racyScore
desc: This score is related to an image being sexually suggestive.
meaning: Score for how sexually suggestive the image is.

name: semanticSexualizationScore
desc: This score is related to racy/sexual images where scores have semantic meaning from 0 to 1.
meaning: Graded score for how sexualized the image content is.

name: ytPornScore
desc: Deprecated, use porn_score instead. The most recent model version does not produce this anymore.
meaning: Deprecated adult-content score no longer produced by current models.

name: ocrAnnotationVersion
desc: A string that indicates the version of SafeSearch OCR annotation.
meaning: Version string of the SafeSearch text-recognition annotation.

name: ocrProminenceScore
desc: The score produced by Aksara geometry and spoof score. Describes the 'visibility' or 'importance' of the text on the image [0, 1]
meaning: How visible or prominent the detected text is within the image.

name: pornScore
desc: Image OCR racyness/pornyness, computed by porn query classifier.
meaning: How adult or racy the text found inside the image is.

name: prominentOffensiveScore
desc: Same as offensive_score, but weighted by prominence.
meaning: Offensiveness of the image's text weighted by how prominent that text is.

name: prominentVulgarScore
desc: Same as vulgar_score, but weighted by prominence.
meaning: Vulgarity of the image's text weighted by how prominent that text is.

name: qbstOffensiveScore
desc: The score produced by offensive salient terms model.
meaning: Offensiveness score for salient terms found in the image's text.

name: score
desc: Confidence score of the match. The higher, the more likely to match the symbol.
meaning: Confidence that an offensive symbol was matched in the image.

name: imageLinkSelectionInfo
desc: Image Selection Info
meaning: Details about which images on the page were picked for image indexing.

name: rejectedNotIndexedImageLink
desc: URLs and Amarna status of images on the page for which image data is not yet available and weren't selected for indexing in image search. Used by consumers of docjoins that need a complete view of image urls on the page (i.e. Digdug).
meaning: Images on the page that were neither ready nor selected for image indexing.

name: selectedNotIndexedImageLink
desc: URLs and Amarna status of images on the page for which image data is not yet available and were otherwise selected for indexing in image search. Used by consumers of docjoins that need a complete view of selected image urls on the page (i.e. Hearse, the index selection testbed).
meaning: Images on the page selected for indexing but whose data is not ready yet.

name: acquireLicensePage
desc: Records web page url about how to use the licensed image.
meaning: Page address explaining how to license the image.

name: copyrightNotice
desc: Provides copyright info.
meaning: Copyright notice text recorded for the image.

name: copyrightNoticeSourceType
desc: Source type for copyright_notice field.
meaning: Where the copyright notice text was taken from.

name: creator
desc: creator, authors.
meaning: Names of the creators or authors of the image.

name: creatorSourceType
desc: Source type for creator field.
meaning: Where the creator information was taken from.

name: creditText
desc: Text for crediting persons or organizations.
meaning: Text used to credit the people or organizations behind the image.

name: creditTextSourceType
desc: Source type for credit_text field.
meaning: Where the credit text was taken from.

name: isRetiredCcUrl
desc: Whether this license url is in retired license list, which is from:
meaning: Whether the image's license link is on the retired licenses list.

name: licenseUrl
desc: Records license URL.
meaning: The address of the license that applies to the image.

name: safesearchFlags
desc: A bitwise-OR of SafeSearch filtering flags. If present, the flags will be a bitwise-AND between this value and all the classifier_porn::query::Vertical enums. If the value is -1, it indicates there is some error with SafeSearch classifier. The default value 0 means no filtering flags are set.
meaning: Bit flags recording which SafeSearch filters apply to the image.

name: imageLinkSelectionInfo
desc: Image Selection Info.
meaning: Details about how an image on the page was selected for indexing.

name: url
desc: The image URL.
meaning: The address of the image.

name: amarnaStatus
desc: Insight on why we do not have data for this imagelink.
meaning: Explanation of why image data is missing for this link.

name: crawlStatusInfo
desc: Fields for crawl-status-related debugging information.
meaning: Debugging details about the crawl status of an image link.

name: url
desc: The image URL.
meaning: The address of the image.

name: feature
desc: Multiple feature embeddings for this bounding box.
meaning: Feature embeddings stored for a detected box in an image.

name: labelGroup
desc: Multiple label annotations for this bounding box.
meaning: Label annotations describing what is inside a detected box in an image.

name: roi
desc: Detected bounding box. Leave it not set for whole image annotation.
meaning: The detected box coordinates, left unset for whole-image annotations.

name: bytesValue
desc: Multiple fields can be set. For example for Starburst V3, they can be used to store compressed byte, raw float feature, and tokens, respectively.
meaning: Raw byte storage for an image feature vector.

name: imageTemplate
desc: Local features.
meaning: Local visual features stored for the image.

name: box
desc: Bounding box normalized to [0,1] scale independent on the image size. For example if the original image has the size 1600x1200, the rectangle [200, 200, 800, 600] from the image would have a normalized bounding box [1/8, 1/6, 1/2, 1/2].
meaning: Box coordinates scaled to a 0-1 range independent of image size.

name: score
desc: Box confidence score. This is used to store the confidence of the box proposal, not the score associated with any specific labels. The box proposal confidence score is a float number per region between [0, 1] indicating how likely a box contains an "object".
meaning: Confidence that a detected box actually contains an object.

name: canonicalText
desc: Human readable text.
meaning: Human readable text of the label attached to image content.

name: entityId
desc: KG entity id.
meaning: Knowledge Graph entity identifier for a label found in the image.

name: metaData
desc: Meta data for topicality, visible labels, attribute, etc.
meaning: Extra label details covering topicality, visibility and attributes.

name: score
desc: Confidence score.
meaning: Confidence score for an image label.

name: urlWithBadSslCertificate
desc: The URL where the bad SSL certificate really comes from. Present iff it is different from the source URL, i.e. a redirect target of the source URL).
meaning: The address that the bad SSL certificate actually came from.

name: rawFinalTargetFromRendering
desc: Final redirect target found from rendering. It is the same as the last element of raw_redirect_chain_from_rendering. It is used as an input source for the indexable fragment detection pipeline and also downstream phases.
meaning: The last URL a redirect chain landed on when the page was rendered.

name: rawFinalTargetFromTrawler
desc: This is with-fragment version of redirect_with_contents. This field is populated only if there was a fragment. This field is used by indexing::mobile::GetRedirectTarget() defined in indexing/mobile/internal/smartphone-util.cc, which extracts the redirect target for smartphone optimized pages. The extracted target in turn is served in search results for smartphone users. We need with-fragment version because with-fragment url can return different content than fragment-stripped url. For example,
meaning: The redirect target including its fragment, used to serve smartphone versions of pages.

name: rawRedirectChainFromRendering
desc: Redirect chain generated from redirect events in rendering. At the beginning of it, there could be some redirects from trawler (i.e. could be partial or entire trawler redirect chain), other redirects have their RedirectParams::is_redirect_from_rendering fields set to true. Redirects here have no RedirectChain::Hop::raw_target fields populated, and targets stored in RedirectChain::Hop::target fields are likely cleaned while keeping fragments (also sometimes they could be uncleaned ones because o
meaning: The ordered list of redirects seen while rendering the page.

name: renderingRedirectLimit
desc: This is used to describe how many redirect hops from Webkit were kept in the raw_redirect_chain_from_rendering. If it is -1, it means it kept all the hops from Webkit in redirect chain.
meaning: How many redirect hops from the renderer were kept in the stored chain.

name: rawTarget
desc: Redirect target with fragment. This field is populated only if there was a fragment.
meaning: A redirect hop's target URL including the fragment.

name: target
desc: Redirect target URL and params of the current hop in the redirect chain.
meaning: The target URL of one hop in a redirect chain.

name: delay
desc: The time difference between page loading and redirect occurrence. When missing, it means the redirect happens immediately (i.e. delay = 0). In seconds.
meaning: How many seconds after page load the redirect happened.

name: frameTargetDeniesFraming
desc: Populated for SINGLE_FRAME and SINGLE_IFRAME redirects only and indicates that the target url requested not to be framed, by virtue of using the "X-Frame-Options" HTTP header.
meaning: Whether the redirect target refuses to be shown inside a frame.

name: isDownload
desc: Indicates corresponding redirect is a download. This field is only set when rendering redirect chain is used. This field represents the value of corresponding "RedirectEvent.target_content_downloaded" field.
meaning: Whether the redirect resulted in a file download.

name: isRenderingRedirect
desc: Indicates corresponding redirect is from rendering if set to true.
meaning: Whether this redirect was observed during rendering.

name: metaRedirectFromTrawler
desc: If set, it means that the redirect of type META was detected by Trawler (as opposed to the content processor.) Only makes sense when type is META.
meaning: Whether a meta refresh redirect was spotted by the crawler rather than the content processor.

name: size
desc: Range size when uncompressed, in bytes.
meaning: Size in bytes of this chunk of content when uncompressed.

name: sourceType
desc: The source of this range of content. Present iff 'type' is PROCESSED_ONLY or INTERMEDIATE_ONLY. Note: 'source_type' is not present for ORIGINAL_AND_PROCESSED, ORIGINAL_ONLY, and ORIGINAL_AND_INTERMEDIATE because for those range types the source of their content is the original crawled content.
meaning: Where this chunk of content came from, such as a frame or iframe.

name: sourceUrl
desc: The source URL of this range of content. Present iff 'source_type' is present and 'source_type' is FRAME or FLASH or IFRAME.
meaning: The URL that this chunk of content was pulled from.

name: text
desc: The content of the range, compressed with 'text_compression_method'. Present iff 'type' is ORIGINAL_ONLY or ORIGINAL_AND_INTERMEDIATE or INTERMEDIATE_ONLY. Useful to reconstruct the original content or the intermediate content. Note: 'text' is not present for ORIGINAL_AND_PROCESSED and PROCESSED_ONLY because the processed content is already stored separately (in the contents column, and in CompositeDoc.doc.Content.Representation).
meaning: The stored, compressed copy of a chunk of the page's original content.

name: textCompressionMethod
desc: Method used to compress the 'text' field. May be present only when the 'text' is present.
meaning: Which compression method was used on the stored text.

name: contentExpiry
desc: time in unix time format after which this content should not be shown in the results. This in inferred from the X-Robots-Tag HTTP header with unavailable_after: Do not use this field directly. There is a column called content_expiration in Alexandria that includes this and other signals.
meaning: The time after which the page should no longer be shown in results.

name: indexifembeddedReason
desc: IMPORTANT: if you add a new field here, update the MergeRobotsInfo() function to merge the new field.
meaning: Code recording why the indexifembedded robots rule applied.

name: maxImagePreview
desc: Max image preview restriction applied to this data. A value of THUMBNAIL_UNSPECIFIED can be treated as though there is no restriction.
meaning: The largest image preview size the page allows.

name: maxSnippetLength
desc: Max snippet preview restriction applied to this data. If this field is zero, it indicates that no snippet data can be displayed, therefore this field should be checked using has_max_snippet_length to determine if it was set.
meaning: The maximum snippet length the page allows.

name: noindexReason
desc: Bit map of RobotedReasons values. When set to a non-zero value, the document should not be indexed or archived etc. based on the name of the tag.
meaning: Bit flags saying why a page is marked noindex.

name: value
desc: Repeated to allow for fingerprints larger than 64-bits.
meaning: Fingerprint values used to compare page content.

name: anchorCount
desc: Count of anchors kept from forwarding.
meaning: How many anchors were kept for this duplicate URL.

name: collectType
desc: This is EcnCollectType in anchor-ecn-matcher.h for the latest ECN of this dup: - kCollectNormal = 0, // Normal collection. - kCollectUnforwarded = 1, // Forwarding leader docid match only. - kCollectWhitelisted = 2, // Collected anchors matching whitelist. - kCollectNone = 4 // Skipped ECN anchor cluster.
meaning: Code for how anchors were collected for this duplicate.

name: dupUrl
desc: If missing, the same as the canonical.
meaning: The duplicate URL these anchor counts belong to.

name: offdomainAnchorCount
desc: Count of offdomain anchors.
meaning: How many anchors came from other domains.

name: redundantAnchorCount
desc: Count of redundant anchors.
meaning: How many anchors were considered redundant.

name: scannedAnchorCount
desc: The number of anchors being scanned from storage per dupforwarding.
meaning: How many anchors were read from storage for this duplicate.

name: timestamp
desc: Walltime when this was scanned last.
meaning: When this duplicate's anchors were last scanned.

name: matchedScore
desc: Difference in KL-divergence from spam and non-spam anchors. Value >0 indicate that anchor text from this trusted source is similar to anchors classified as spam which means that spammy anchors are legitimate.
meaning: Score for how closely a trusted site's anchor text resembles the spammy anchors.

name: matchedScoreInfo
desc: Detailed debug information about computation of trusted anchors match. Populated only when --anchorspam_penalizer_debug=true
meaning: Debug-only breakdown of the trusted anchor match calculation.

name: phrasesScore
desc: Count of anchors classified as spam using anchor text.
meaning: How many of the site's anchors were classified as spam by their text.

name: site
desc: Site name from anchor.source().site().
meaning: The name of the linking site.

name: text
desc: Tokenized text of all anchors from the site.
meaning: The tokenized anchor text from that site.

name: trustedScore
desc: Fraction of pages with newsy anchors on the site, >0 for trusted sites.
meaning: Fraction of the site's pages with newsy anchors, higher for trusted sites.

name: navboost
desc: BEGIN DATA FIELDS
meaning: Timestamp record for when navboost data was last updated.

name: nsrFdpData
desc: Must be used together with quality_nsr_nsr_data
meaning: Timestamp record for when NSR FDP data was last updated.

name: spambrainDomainSitechunkData
desc: END DATA FIELDS
meaning: Timestamp record for when SpamBrain domain data was last updated.

name: considerationTimestampMicros
desc: Sometimes, a piece of data may not exist for a document (and we don't want to delete it), so timestamp_micros won't exist. However, consideration_timestamp_micros will be set to indicate we tried to update that piece of data for tracking purposes.
meaning: When an update to a piece of data was attempted.

name: timestampMicros
desc: The timestamp when a piece of data is updated (or deleted if the data doesn't exist in the update).
meaning: When a piece of data was last updated.

name: clusterId
desc: The unique id to distinguish members in cluster. It could be generated in different ways according to reason, e.g. LINK_REL_NEXT_PREVIOUS: it is the fingerprint of the URL of index 0; PAGE_PARAMETER_INFO: it is the fingerprint of pagination pattern (pagination_pattern_fp field in PageParamInfo message).
meaning: Identifier grouping a page with related pages such as paginated sets.

name: indexForDebugging
desc: The member index of this document in cluster. Starts from "0". Note that indices of pages in a cluster may not be consistent with each other, because we may update them at different points in time. Currently only used for debugging.
meaning: The page's position in its cluster, kept only for debugging.

name: reason
desc: The reason why this document is clustered into this cluster.
meaning: Why the page was placed in this cluster.

name: clusterId
desc: The exact cluster metadata for each individual cluster if any.
meaning: The list of clusters this page belongs to at serving time.

name: clusterId
desc: Cluster-ID of that locale entry. Not Populated if the message is part of a Cluster-Proto (e.g. when loaded as a signal). The data is being populated when the proto is used outside of the cluster context. For instance, when being used as a dups-computed-localized-alternate-name.
meaning: Identifier of the cluster this language version belongs to.

name: deviceMatchInfo
desc: Device match info calculated only by URL pattern.
meaning: Whether the URL pattern suggests a desktop or mobile version.

name: language
desc: Language/Region code. E.g. "en-US" or "de". Allowed values are language-region codes based on the W3C recommendation
meaning: The language and region this alternate URL serves.

name: url
desc: The alternate url representing the content for a specific language and region (or language only).
meaning: The alternate URL for a particular language or region.

name: urlEncoding
desc: see webutil/urlencoding
meaning: Numeric code for how the URL is encoded.

name: urlRegionCode
desc: The region code that was extracted from the URL, either by the TLD or via a pattern (like 'en-ca' as a path element).. Always filled in if known, unlike the sometimes left out region part of the language field. Unknown Region Code
meaning: The region code taken from the URL itself.

name: clusterId
desc: The cluster id, a unique int64 id for the cluster.
meaning: The cluster's unique numeric identifier.

name: deprecatedDebugInfo
desc: Debug Info being attached to each cluster, to understand how it was created. That info is stored in Alexandria, but not available during serving.
meaning: Debug notes about how the cluster was built, unavailable at serving.

name: filteringEnabled
desc: Indicates that filtering can be applied on the category (if many results of one cluster show up on the SERP, only one should be kept).
meaning: Whether only one page from this cluster should be kept on a results page.

name: language
desc: The language as represented by the URL, e.g. 'use this document on the cluster for German queries'.
meaning: The language the URL indicates.

name: regionCode
desc: Same as language, except for the country. This is the Stable Region Code. This value may be UNKNOWN even though the URL region code is known, namely when the known region code was the main region for the language and for that language no other region is specified (e.g. de-DE being the only german variation). Unknown Region Code
meaning: The stable region code for the cluster.

name: urlRegionCode
desc: Similar to region_code, but always has the value filled in if known. Unknown Region Code
meaning: The region code taken from the URL.

name: crossDomain
desc: For a link A->B where B is represented by this proto, cross_domain := Host(A) != Host(B).
meaning: Whether the link crosses from one host to another.

name: url
desc: The URL the information in TargetLink refers to.
meaning: The URL this link record describes.

name: anchorText
desc: Optional field for storing the anchor text the language code was extracted from. Applies to outlinks only.
meaning: The anchor text the language code was read from.

name: annotationSource
desc: Information about where the language code was extracted from.
meaning: Where the language code was found, such as hreflang or a sitemap.

name: languageCode
desc: Language code extracted from the URL (hreflang or outlink). One URL can represent multiple language codes, like e.g. de-at and de-ch
meaning: The language code found for the linked URL.

name: sourceFeedUrl
desc: Optional field that stores the feed URL where a Sitemap annotation was discovered. Only populated if annotation_source is SITEMAP.
meaning: The sitemap feed URL where the annotation was found.

name: firstSeenMs
desc: When was the first time a link seen. Defaults to last crawled timestamp.
meaning: When the link was first seen.

name: lastVerifiedMs
desc: When was the last time a link validated. Validation is the process of (re)reading the relevant information for a linked document from its respective row in the document table. Data needed for understanding the correctness of the cluster is copied over to have it available locally.
meaning: When the link was last re-checked.

name: directTargetLink
desc: Direct links are the simplest scenarios where A simply links to B.
meaning: Links where the page points straight at the other URL.

name: indirectTargetLink
desc: Repeated field for URLs that are not directly linking to the document TargetLink refers to. We can encounter the following scenario: A -> Links to B -> links to C (i.e. without (A) linking to (C)). In the context of B, indirect_inclusion would include the link to 'C' but not the link back to 'A'.
meaning: Links reached through another page rather than directly.

name: contentLanguage
desc: The detected on-page content language of the document.
meaning: The language detected in the linked page's text.

name: crawlTimestampSeconds
desc: The timestamp of the last crawl attempt from crawl_timestamp column.
meaning: When the linked page was last crawled.

name: isCanonical
desc: Whether the URL being validated is canonical at the time of processing.
meaning: Whether the URL was the canonical one when checked.

name: outgoingLinkData
desc: Repeated field for data about the outgoing hreflang links that appear in the document that the currently processed URL refers to.
meaning: Data about the hreflang links found on the linked page.

name: compressedDocumentTrees
desc: The document's DOM and render tree produced by WebKit as a side effect of rendering the page. It might be compressed or not. Thus, use indexing::embedded_content::UncompressWebkitDocument to decode it.
meaning: The stored DOM and render tree produced when the page was rendered.

name: convertedContents
desc: The converted contents, as produced by the same DocumentUpdater transaction that generated the render tree. Useful whenever one of our users wants to experiment with deriving an annotation from the render tree.
meaning: The converted page contents produced alongside the render tree.

name: embeddedLinksInfo
desc: Information about all external resources needed to render this page, a.k.a. embedded links. This includes .css files, images embedded in a page, external javascripts, iframes etc.
meaning: Details of the external files the page needs to render.

name: headlessResponse
desc: The headless response for rendering the document.
meaning: The raw response from the headless rendering service.

name: isAlternateSnapshot
desc: Indicate if the snapshot is generated from alternate snapshot. If true, the snapshot will be exported even if the snapshot quality score is low.
meaning: Whether the screenshot came from an alternate snapshot.

name: originalEncoding
desc: The original encoding of the content crawled from trawler. It's the value of enum i18n::encodings::encoding. We put a int32 here instead of encoding proto to maintain the compatibility of "py_api_version = 1"
meaning: Numeric code for the character encoding of the crawled page.

name: referencedResource
desc: Information about all external resources used to render this page, a.k.a. embedded links. This includes .css files, images embedded in a page, external javascripts, iframes etc.
meaning: List of external resources used while rendering the page.

name: renderedSnapshot
desc: Only exist in dry run mode.
meaning: A rendered screenshot kept only during dry runs.

name: renderedSnapshotImage
desc: Snapshot image of a rendered html document (possibly encoded as png, jpeg, or webp).
meaning: The screenshot image of the rendered page.

name: renderedSnapshotMetadata
desc: A collection of values which are needed by the users of the Kodachrome bigtable.
meaning: Bookkeeping values needed by the snapshot storage system.

name: renderedSnapshotQualityScore
desc: The quality of the image, 0.0 is the worst, 1.0 is the best. If all dependencies are successfully crawled, the quality should be 1.0. If one or more of the dependencies are unknown, the quality will be lower.
meaning: How complete the rendered screenshot is, from 0 to 1.

name: richcontentData
desc: The rich content data to recover the original contents from the converted_contents. Useful for offline content analysis.
meaning: Stored data allowing the original page content to be reconstructed.

name: embedderInfo
desc: This field is optional only because we're adding it late and want to support records written before that. For newly produced records, this field should always be set.
meaning: Record of the page that embedded these resources.

name: pageSizeInfo
desc: Page download size.
meaning: How much data the page and its resources weigh.

name: sumHttpResponseLength
desc: This field is the sum of http_response_length for the embedder and all embedded resources. This is expected to be set only in the docjoins, not in the pinax tables or the exported bigtable.
meaning: Combined byte size of the page and all resources it loads.

name: crawlStatus
desc: The field always exists, and has four options: UNKNOWN, CONTENT, ROBOTED and ERROR, which are defined in indexing.converter.CrawlStatus.
meaning: Whether the fetch returned content, was blocked by robots, or errored.

name: fetchWithSmartphoneUa
desc: True if the response is fetched with SMARTPHONE user agent.
meaning: Whether the fetch used the smartphone crawler.

name: numTrawlerFetches
desc: Number of trawler fetches while fetching this URL. In most cases, this number will be 0 or 1.
meaning: How many crawler fetches this URL took.

name: rewriteMethod
desc: Used for logging purposes only here.
meaning: Which URL rewrite method was used, kept for logging.

name: robotsInfo
desc: Note that this robots_info should only be used for noindex_reason and will only be present for TARGET_MAIN_FRAME / TARGET_SUBFRAME fetches.
meaning: Robots directives from the fetch, used only for the noindex reason.

name: contentLength
desc: Size of the HTTP body (payload of the HTTP response, excluding headers), pre-decompression. Equal to the value of the Content-Length header if any. NOTE: if this proto is converted to from ReferencedResource, we have to use the size of the full HTTP response (i.e. http_response_length) as an approximation, as we could not get the size of HTTP headers.
meaning: Byte size of the response body before decompression.

name: crawlDuration
desc: Time spent downloading this resource, in milliseconds. Not a timestamp!
meaning: How many milliseconds the resource took to download.

name: crawlStatus
desc: Enum values for crawl_status are defined in indexing/converter/proto/converter.proto
meaning: Whether the resource fetch returned content, was blocked, or errored.

name: fetchSourceInfo
desc: Where this resource comes from.
meaning: Where this resource was fetched from.

name: fetchStatus
desc: Fetch status from trawler.
meaning: The crawler's fetch status for the resource.

name: fetchUrlResponseMetadata
desc: Populated from embedded-content fetch server.
meaning: Metadata returned by the embedded content fetch server.

name: frd
desc: FetchReplyData from trawler.
meaning: The raw crawler reply data for the resource.

name: httpResponseLength
desc: Size of the full HTTP response (headers and body pre-decompression). Semantically equal to content_length plus size of the HTTP headers.
meaning: Byte size of the whole HTTP response including headers.

name: uncompressedContentLength
desc: Size of the HTTP body (payload of the HTTP response, excluding headers), post-decompression. Equal to content_length if the body was not compressed to begin with. NOTE: if this proto is converted to from ReferencedResource, we have to use the size of the full HTTP response as an approximation, as we could not get the size of HTTP headers.
meaning: Byte size of the response body after decompression.

name: cacheExpireTimestampUsec
desc: When the rendered content would expire from the cache in microseconds.
meaning: When the cached rendering of the page expires.

name: lastRenderedTimestampUsec
desc: The last time the document was rendered, in microseconds. Does not update in case of cache use.
meaning: When the page was last actually rendered.

name: fetchHostCount
desc: A host->count mapping to log how many embedded_links in each host finally goes to trawler during rendering.
meaning: Per-host counts of embedded links sent to the crawler during rendering.

name: exceptions
desc: The exceptions observed during the rendering. In bit-field encoding of enum values of RenderResponse.RenderingException.
meaning: Bit flags for errors that occurred while rendering.

name: experimentalRenderTimeMsec
desc: Total GCU time for rendering the document in millisecond. This data is from render_stats.render_cost_mgcu in RenderResponse proto. Note that this is
meaning: How much compute the rendering used, in milliseconds.

name: importance
desc: The importance value of the rendered document.
meaning: An importance value assigned to the rendered page.

name: lastNewContentProbingTimestamp
desc: The timestamp of last new content probing.
meaning: When the system last checked the page for new content.

name: newTokensPercentageAfterRendering
desc: Percentage of new tokens in the rendered the document content.
meaning: Share of the page's words that only appeared after rendering.

name: renderCacheStats
desc: A collection of fields to track stats on cache use in the Rendering microservice.
meaning: Statistics about rendering cache use.

name: renderEvent
desc: Different types of events which happened during rendering.
meaning: The list of events that occurred during rendering.

name: renderServerCl
desc: The CL from which the render engine was built.
meaning: The build version of the rendering engine.

name: renderedSnapshotSignature
desc: Short signature (usually less than 1 KB) which captures a perceptual hash on the rendered image. This is used to determine whether successive renderings should be output. See the library in googlen/snapshot/shared/similarity.* for more info about how this value is interpreted and used.
meaning: A short perceptual hash of the rendered screenshot.

name: renderedTimeUsec
desc: Current time in microseconds the document is going through rendering system. This field is set regardless of whether the document is being rendered or if we are skipping rendering by using a cache.
meaning: When the page passed through the rendering system.

name: selectionResult
desc: The corpus selection result. Can be used for offline analysis.
meaning: The outcome of choosing which corpus the page belongs to.

name: snapshotQualityScore
desc: These scores are copied from htmlrender_webkit_headless_proto.Document.
meaning: How good the rendered screenshot is, copied from the renderer.

name: withMissingResources
desc: True if there were any missing resources during the rendering.
meaning: Whether some resources were missing when the page was rendered.

name: selectorId
desc: Indicate which selector has made the decision.
meaning: Which selector made the corpus decision.

name: pipelineEpoch
desc: Epoch of the interstitial offline pipeline generating this signal.
meaning: Which run of the interstitial pipeline produced this value.

name: pipelinePattern
desc: If present, pipeline_pattern identifies the cluster of URLs for which the signal value was smeared.
meaning: The URL pattern the interstitial value was copied across.

name: urlTree
desc: URL tree of interstitial patterns belong to the host, to be used as site-level signal in Index Signals. A pattern may contain a payload InterstitialPatternPayload, which will indicate the violated interstitial types of this pattern.
meaning: Tree of URL patterns on the host that show intrusive interstitials.

name: violatesDesktopInterstitialPolicy
desc: Overall policy violation status. If this is true, at least one of the InterstitialSignal below indicates a violation.
meaning: Whether the page breaks the desktop interstitial rules.

name: isSmearedSignal
desc: Indicates whether the signal value is "smeared", e.g. extrapolated from other URLs.
meaning: Flag saying the interstitial signal was estimated from other URLs rather than measured on this page.

name: absoluteBox
desc: Stores the geometry of detected interstitial in absolute page pixels.
meaning: The on-page position and size of a detected interstitial overlay, in page pixels.

name: cls
desc: Cumulative Layout Shift.
meaning: The page's Cumulative Layout Shift score, a measure of visual stability while loading.

name: fid
desc: First Input Delay.
meaning: The page's First Input Delay, how long it takes to react to a first user interaction.

name: lcp
desc: Largest Contentful Paint.
meaning: The page's Largest Contentful Paint time, how long the main content takes to appear.

name: desktopCwv
desc: Desktop Core Wev Vital metrics. NOTE(yunchengz): This field will not be populated in Muppet.
meaning: Holds the desktop page-speed metrics for a document; noted as not filled in one pipeline.

name: mobileCwv
desc: Mobile Core Web Vital metrics. NOTE(yunchengz): This field will not be populated in Muppet.
meaning: Holds the mobile page-speed metrics for a document; noted as not filled in one pipeline.

name: averageChanceTime
desc: Weighted averged timestamps of the decayed chances.
meaning: The average time of the time-decayed chances a URL had to be shown.

name: chances
desc: Numbers below are all total in the decayed manner. To get rate of impression/clicks, divide by chances.
meaning: The time-decayed count of chances the URL had to be seen, used as the denominator for click and impression rates.

name: coverageTimestamp
desc: Epoch seconds at which this weighted coverage data was calculated.
meaning: The time at which this coverage data was computed.

name: dwells
desc: Dwells from KnowledgePanel and WebAnswers.
meaning: Count of time-decayed dwells the page got from Knowledge Panel and Web Answers.

name: firstBaseCoverageTimestamp
desc: Epoch seconds at which this url first gets coverage in BASE.
meaning: When this URL first appeared in the BASE index coverage.

name: firstCoveragePagerankNs
desc: The pagerank when the url was serving for the first time.
meaning: The URL's PageRank value at the time it was first served.

name: firstCoverageTimestamp
desc: Epoch seconds at which this url first gets coverage data.
meaning: When this URL first got any coverage data.

name: intervalData
desc: Interval Data to track the average time between clicks_total, clicks_good, and ctr_weighted_impression.
meaning: Tracks the average time between clicks, good clicks, and weighted impressions for the URL.

name: lastDwellDateInDays
desc: Indicates the date when this document received the last KnowledgePanel or WebAnswer dwell. Note: The date is identified in terms of number of days since Epoch.
meaning: The most recent day the page received a Knowledge Panel or Web Answer dwell.

name: lastGoodClickDateInDays
desc: Indicates the date when this document received the last good click. Note: The date is identified in terms of number of days since Epoch.
meaning: The most recent day the page received a good click.

name: lastImpressionDateInDays
desc: Indicates the date when this document received the last impression. Note: The date is identified in terms of number of days since Epoch.
meaning: The most recent day the page was shown in results.

name: lastLuDwellDateInDays
desc: Indicates the date when this document received the last LocalUniversal dwell. Note: The date is identified in terms of number of days since Epoch.
meaning: The most recent day the page received a Local Universal dwell.

name: lastPseudoImpressionsDateInDays
desc: Indicates the date when this document received the last pseudo-impression. I.e., when it was retrieved as a result but GWS would not show it because of the document's age in the index. Note: The date is identified in terms of number of days since Epoch.
meaning: The last day the page was retrieved as a result but withheld because of its age.

name: luDwells
desc: Dwells from LocalUniversal.
meaning: Count of time-decayed dwells the page got from Local Universal results.

name: repid
desc: Repid in Alexandria pipeline.
meaning: An internal pipeline record identifier.

name: totalChances
desc: Total number of chances on this urls (not decayed).
meaning: The raw, undecayed number of chances this URL had to be shown.

name: urlfp
desc: Temporary variable, only used during mapreduce.
meaning: A scratch URL fingerprint used only while the data is being processed.

name: deviation
desc: A number reflecting the deviation of Url scores.
meaning: How spread out the individual URL scores are within the group.

name: m2
desc: State variables for West & Chan variance algorithm used to be stored here directly. Now they are stored inside RunningMeanAndVarianceInternalState.
meaning: An old storage slot for variance state, now kept in a separate internal message.

name: maxScoreUrl
desc: Input UrlScore with max score.
meaning: The individual URL that had the highest score in this group.

name: meanScore
desc: Overall stats that are only available in final aggregation results. The aggregated score.
meaning: The averaged score across all URLs in this group.

name: minScoreUrl
desc: Input UrlScore with min score.
meaning: The individual URL that had the lowest score in this group.

name: numUrlsMatched
desc: Final Stats that are also available in intermediate output. Number of Urls matching the class.
meaning: How many URLs matched this pattern or class.

name: numUrlsWithSignal
desc: Not every matching url has a signal.
meaning: How many of the matching URLs actually had a signal value.

name: patternLayer
desc: Experimental layer of the corresponding pattern.
meaning: Which experimental layer the pattern belongs to.

name: patternsUsedInMediation
desc: Optionally populated in mediators. A list of patterns that actually contributed to the final mediated signal.
meaning: The list of URL patterns that actually contributed to the combined signal.

name: percentile
desc: Score percentile of matching urls. If present, it has N entries for buckets of roughly equal number of urls. N is specified the aggregation. The value is the min score in that bucket.
meaning: Score cut-offs that split the matching URLs into equal-sized buckets.

name: samples
desc: Random samples.
meaning: A random sample of individual URL scores kept for inspection.

name: scores
desc: for calculating percentile
meaning: The collected list of scores used to work out percentiles.

name: signalId
desc: For debugging purposes, this is an id of the signal associated with this AggregatedScore. For pattern score, this may be the length of the pattern.
meaning: An identifier for the signal, kept for debugging.

name: singleUrlScore
desc: If this field presents, it is for a single url. No other field should appear.
meaning: Holds the score when this record covers just one URL.

name: totalScore
desc: summation varaible used to get mean
meaning: A running sum of scores used to compute the mean.

name: totalScoreLow
desc: low-order part of total_score
meaning: The low-order half of the running score sum, kept for numeric precision.

name: totalScoreSqr
desc: summation variable for calculating deviation note, these are now only used for legacy and debugging purposes
meaning: A legacy sum of squared scores kept for deviation maths and debugging.

name: totalScoreSqrLow
desc: low order part of total_score_sq
meaning: The low-order half of the legacy squared-score sum.

name: totalWeight
desc: for calculating weighted mean/dev
meaning: A running sum of weights used for weighted averages.

name: totalWeightLow
desc: low order part of total_weight
meaning: The low-order half of the running weight sum.

name: m2
desc: The variable which in the Wikipedia page is referred to as M_2: m2 = w_1
meaning: An internal accumulator used by the running variance calculation.

name: mean
desc: Mean of the data set, mean = (w_1
meaning: The running mean held as internal state by the variance calculation.

name: totalWeight
desc: Total weight of the data set, total_weight = w_1 + ... + w_n.
meaning: The total weight of the data set held as internal variance state.

name: pattern
desc: The most immediate pattern data.
meaning: The closest matching URL-pattern record for this data.

name: dsacNumWeeklyPerfRecords
desc: The number of weekly performance records if the UrlScore is extracted from the DSAC data. It should be used in case a URL is no longer served. As of 2014-10-14, this field is for the evaluation purpose only.
meaning: How many weekly performance records back this score; marked as evaluation only.

name: eligibleExperimentalLayer
desc: If this field is set, it indicates the url is eligible to be aggregated to one of the experimental layers.
meaning: Marks that the URL may be aggregated into an experimental layer.

name: firstServedTimestamp
desc: The timestamp of the first time this document is served anywhere.
meaning: The first time this document was ever served anywhere.

name: isImportant
desc: Whether this url has important signal. Used for keeping patterns that match too few URLs but some of them have good clicks.
meaning: Marks a URL as having a notable signal, such as good clicks.

name: score
desc: score might be missing if the url does not have signal.
meaning: The signal score for this URL, absent when the URL has no signal.

name: url
desc: url might be missing if we can get it from sstable key.
meaning: The URL string, which may be left out when it can be read from the record key.

name: weight
desc: weight for this url.
meaning: How much this URL counts when scores are combined.

name: audioDuration
desc: Duration of audio in processed fragment (including non-speech), in seconds.
meaning: How many seconds of audio were processed in this media fragment.

name: audioOnly
desc: If true, the media file is audio-only. If false, also has video track(s).
meaning: Whether the media file has only audio and no video track.

name: estimatedAudioDuration
desc: Estimated duration of audio in the whole file (including non-speech), in seconds. If this is greater than 0, then it will either be equal to audio_duration (when truncated_file is false), or to the length of the content (audio or video) according to the file header (when truncated_file is true).
meaning: The estimated total audio length of the whole media file, in seconds.

name: estimatedAudioDurationConfidence
desc: Our confidence in the duration estimate, on a scale from 0 (not confident) to 1 (very confident). An estimate should have a confidence of at least 0.5 if it is to be shown to users.
meaning: How much to trust the audio length estimate, on a zero to one scale.

name: languageCode
desc: The spoken language, see i18n/identifiers/languagecode.h and go/gl2014. This may or may not match the language of the written page. (Examples: "en", "sv", "zh-CN").
meaning: The language spoken in the audio, which may differ from the page's language.

name: numWords
desc: Total number of recognized words in processed fragment.
meaning: How many words the speech recogniser picked out of the audio.

name: recognizerAccuracy
desc: Measure of the estimated output accuracy from the speech recognition code, from 0 to 1. Based on word-level confidence and possibly other factors.
meaning: The estimated accuracy of the speech recognition output, from zero to one.

name: speechDuration
desc: Duration of speech in processed fragment, in seconds.
meaning: How many seconds of actual speech were in the processed audio.

name: truncatedFile
desc: If true, we may have processed a truncated file (most likely due to a size-cutoff when crawling). As a result, the audio duration is a lower bound and the other fields reflect only the processed prefix of the file.
meaning: Whether only part of the media file was processed, usually due to a crawl size limit.

name: patternId
desc: The fingerprint of the features string.
meaning: A fingerprint identifying the URL feature string for this branch.

name: bigBranch
desc: Keeping information for dominating branches separately, to prevent docs on smaller branches from being dropping during sampling.
meaning: Holds dominant URL-tree branches separately so smaller branches survive sampling.

name: node
desc: node(0) is root.
meaning: The list of nodes making up the URL tree, the first one being the root.

name: retrievalTimestamp
desc: Used in url pattern matcher for cache invalidation.
meaning: The time the tree was fetched, used to invalidate caches.

name: site
desc: The key for this UrlTree, also will be the key in sstable. The old format is site, while the new format will be UrlTreeKey. Only one field can be set in the same time for site and key.
meaning: The site key this URL tree is stored under.

name: timestamp
desc: The time when this UrlTree is built, encoded as seconds past the epoch (Jan 1, 1970).
meaning: The time the URL tree was built.

name: treeInfo
desc: Any additional information.
meaning: A catch-all slot for extra information about the tree.

name: numGibberishSegments
desc: The number of the above segments that were classified as gibberish.
meaning: How many transcript segments were judged to be gibberish.

name: numSegmentsClassified
desc: The number of ASR segments that were sent for classification.
meaning: How many transcript segments were sent off for gibberish classification.

name: regionType
desc: The particular type of region should be explicitly set to disambiguate.
meaning: Says which kind of region list this is so the codes are not ambiguous.

name: regions
desc: Values are go/iii RegionCode in capital case. It is a good practice to keep elements in this list unique, although not enforced. In case of duplicated entries, they'll be treated as if there were only one entry of the same value.
meaning: A list of country or region codes attached to a knowledge record.

meaning: Notes which internal data contracts this type definition is available for.

desc: Use in parsing: the value filled with must be in the list of this. If no attribute ids are specified, this value can be filled with any attribute.

meaning: Names the pivot slot the attribute should be applied to.

name: allowAllRangeResolutions
desc: If true, will allow all resolutions that are ranges.
meaning: A parsing option allowing any date or time answer that is a range.

name: allowAllResolutions
desc: If true, overrides all other options in this message and allows any kind of DateTime annotation.
meaning: A parsing option allowing any kind of date or time answer.

name: allowAllResolutionsExceptHolidays
desc: If true, will allow all resolutions except holidays.
meaning: A parsing option allowing any date or time answer except holidays.

name: allowAllResolutionsWithout4digit24hrTime
desc: If true, will allow resolutions that aren't contiguous sequences of 4 digits annotated as 24-hr times. These are often mis-interpreted years or postcodes.
meaning: A parsing option that excludes bare four-digit strings read as 24-hour times.

name: allowAllResolutionsWithoutTime
desc: If true, will allow resolutions without an explicit hour. Symbolic ranges such as [this evening] are not considered as explicit hour, but the range [1-3pm] is considered as explicit.
meaning: A parsing option allowing dates that do not state an hour.

name: allowDayResolution
desc: If true, will parse a mention to DateTime of resolution day. This allows parsing strings like "August 30th", "2012-12-25";
meaning: A parsing option allowing dates resolved down to a particular day.

name: allowDayResolutionExceptHolidaysOrOrdinal
desc: If true, will allow day resolutions except holidays or ordinal numbers, such as "today", "December 13", but "Christmas", "first" are not allowed.
meaning: A parsing option allowing day dates but not holidays or ordinals.

name: allowHourResolution
desc: If true, will allow resolutions with an explicit hour such as "8am", "5pm".
meaning: A parsing option allowing times that state an explicit hour.

name: allowMonthResolution
desc: If true, will parse a mention to DateTime of resolution month. This allows parsing strings like "this August", "2012-12";
meaning: A parsing option allowing dates resolved down to a particular month.

name: allowNowResolution
desc: If true, will allow "now" resolutions, but not any other time
meaning: A parsing option allowing only 'now' as a time answer.

name: allowSymbolicTime
desc: If true, will allow symbolic time resolutions such as "tonight".
meaning: A parsing option allowing vague times such as tonight.

name: allowTimeResolutionsWithoutExplicitTimezone
desc: If true, will allow time resolutions without an explicit timezone.
meaning: A parsing option allowing times with no timezone given.

name: allowYearResolution
desc: If true, will parse a mention to DateTime of resolution year. This allows parsing strings like "Next year ", "2010";
meaning: A parsing option allowing dates resolved down to a particular year.

name: refersToFullMrf
desc: True iff this ReferentialResolution is part of an intent and refers to the full MRF subtree (rather than just the intent).
meaning: Marks that a dialog reference points at the whole meaning tree rather than just the intent.

name: componentSpecificContracts
desc: Contains data about the contracts that this ValueType level is available for. For more information see go/contract-based-conformance.
meaning: Notes which internal data contracts this type definition is available for.

name: rangeConstraint
desc: Range constraint limits the set of durations accepted. The values of the range are in milliseconds. Currently, this constraint is only enforced in Loose Parser.
meaning: Limits which durations are accepted, given in milliseconds.
