name: excludedCollection
desc: The entity that this value is filled with must not be any of these collections (denoted by a /collection/* id). This restriction does not affect parsing; it is used only to filter attributes in the extraction flow.
meaning: Lists knowledge collections the filling entity must not belong to.

name: id
desc: The entity that this value is filled with must be one of the following explicitly specified KG-ids.
meaning: Lists the exact knowledge graph IDs allowed to fill this slot.

name: identifier
desc: The entity that this value is filled with must be of the explicit type and/or contain the explicitly specified id. This field can not be used for kg mids, which should directly use the id field above.
meaning: Lists allowed entity types or identifiers for filling this slot.

name: includeGeolocationData
desc: If this is set to true for a slot and the entity is a location, the latitude and longitude will be available in variables $SlotName_Latitude and $SlotName_Longitude, respectively. The latitude and longitude data comes from KG.
meaning: An option that exposes an entity's latitude and longitude as variables.

name: remodelings
desc: Contains data about current schema remodelings at this ValueType level. For more information see go/meaning-remodeling-framework.
meaning: Notes pending schema reshaping work for this type definition.

name: facetName
desc: Optional, as this can take the name of the slot/schema its associated with or it might need to map onto something different.
meaning: An optional name for the facet this parsed slot maps to.

name: inputSlotName
desc: Required, the slot into which we put any ungrounded string or mid
meaning: Names the slot that receives the raw unresolved string or entity ID.

name: outputSlotName
desc: Optional, if absent output_type will be used for typing, or this is a MRF operator
meaning: Names the slot that receives the parsed output.

name: alternateLanguage
desc: Language of all of the non-annotation tokens of the query interpretation, if it is different than |language|. This can happen with English smearing, e.g. [height rousseau] will trigger as "fr" when issued in fr/FR, but really the language is "en". This can also happen when we have extra information about the language model, e.g. language="zh", alternate_language="zh-Hant".
meaning: The real language of the query words when it differs from the detected language.

name: language
desc: Language of parsed query.
meaning: The language the query was parsed as.

name: mood
desc: Since there's only IMPERATIVE, consider using Marker.command instead.
meaning: The grammatical mood of the parsed query, such as a command.

name: polarQuestion
desc: Whether or not the question is a polar (yes/no) question.
meaning: Whether the query is a yes or no question.

name: sentiment
desc: Sentiment analysis attached to an intent implies the sentiment user expressed behind that query. This is generated by the Empathetic Servlet in the QRewrite.
meaning: The sentiment detected behind the user's query.

name: evalData
desc: This field is used inside Aqua and outside Aqua for identifying the token indices and/or byte offsets of this argument
meaning: Records which part of the query text this parsed argument came from.

name: heuristicEvalData
desc: Eval_data was not derived at parsing time (i.e. is not expected to be produced by the IG), but heuristically determined by matching the ArgumentValue to an annotation/query fragment.
meaning: Query-span info worked out afterwards by matching text rather than during parsing.

name: key
desc: Slot schema key for this Argument. Note: This is still under development and not available for general use. Contact meaning-platform-eng@ for questions. Note: Currently MeaningSchemaSlotKey proto has both mid and unique_id. In future, only mid will be present in it. We are in the process of moving "unique_id" out of it. See (b/168907943). Note: The logged version of intent_query will only have "mid" populated in it to save space and avoid data duplication.
meaning: The schema key saying which slot this argument fills.

name: modifiers
desc: A flattened representation of all intent modifiers that apply to this argument.
meaning: A bundled copy of the query modifiers that apply to this argument.

name: name
desc: Name of this argument. If this Argument is part of a FunctionCall, it must have a name or it is not well-formed. If this Argument is from an Annotator, the name field should be empty.
meaning: The name of this argument within a parsed function call.

name: signals
desc: Signals associated with this argument.
meaning: A bundle of extra signals attached to this parsed argument.

name: value
desc: The value of this argument.
meaning: The actual value filled into this parsed argument.

name: anaphor
desc: If populated, the current query contains an anaphor that refers to the value. For example: U: Weather in Paris. [Weather(location=paris)] G: 65 degrees and sunny. U: How many people live there? [Population(city=paris)] The "there" in the current query would have the "anaphor" field set. NOTE: after a string rewrite this field will not be populated anymore if the rewrite replaced the anaphor with the corresponding value. For example, if we rewrite [How many people there] to [H
meaning: Records that a word like 'there' in the query pointed back at this value.

name: currentQuery
desc: NOTE: PreviousQuery is used for values that originate directly from QRef entities annotated in the user query. AttentionalEntity is used for values that come from the system (entities published by a dialog). These values could also originate from an entity annotated by QRef in the query, but this is not necessarily the case. SearchAnswerValue is used for values that come from the system as part of the answer of the user query. For example: U: Wife of Barack Obama G: Barack Obama's wife is Michel
meaning: Records that the value came straight from the current query.

name: attentionalEntityKey
desc: This key can be used to recover the attentional entity from the corresponding attentional_entities::EntityCache.
meaning: A key for looking up the remembered entity in the conversation cache.

name: mentionProperties
desc: Source information from the AttentionalEntityReader.
meaning: Details about where the remembered entity mention came from.

name: evalData
desc: The span(s) in the query where the value comes from. Note that if the argument is split across the current and previous query, this message should
meaning: The spans of the current query the value was taken from.

name: currentQueryEvalData
desc: The span(s) in the current query where the value comes from. This is used when the argument spans both the current and previous query. Eg jfk death -> [death, when] spans both queries.
meaning: The current-query spans used when a value spans two queries.

name: evalData
desc: The span(s) in the query where the value comes from.
meaning: The spans of the earlier query the value was taken from.

name: eventId
desc: The event ID of the query where this value was pulled from.
meaning: The event ID of the earlier query the value came from.

name: argumentName
desc: Argument names in the DialogIntentState that the argument corresponds to. This is repeated so it can handle complex argument update paths. (ordered from outermost argument to innermost argument)
meaning: The argument names in the earlier dialog state that this value maps to.

name: currentQueryEvalData
desc: The span(s) in the current query (if any) used to resolve the previous query's DIS. Example: U: Barack Obama G: Do you want his age or his height? U: The first one. G: Age(/m/obama) In this example, the intent is derived from the previous query's DIS, but also needs to be resolved in the current query since the user was presented with multiple options.
meaning: The current-query spans used to resolve a value carried over from an earlier dialog state.

name: dialogIntentStateId
desc: The id of the specific DialogIntentState instance that the argument corresponds to.
meaning: The ID of the earlier dialog state this argument came from.

name: intentName
desc: Intent name of the DialogIntentState that the argument corresponds to.
meaning: The intent name of the earlier dialog state this argument came from.

name: candidateIndex
desc: The presented_index of the field_candidate in the DialogIntentState field_signals that the argument corresponds to.
meaning: Which item in a presented list the user picked.

name: evalData
desc: If populated, the spans in the current query where this value was annotated. This is a repeated field because some values can be annotated from a set of discontiguous spans (e.g. some intent phrases), but in most cases this field will contain only one item or it will be empty (for values inferred from context without the use of anaphora).
meaning: The query spans where a referring word for this value was annotated.

name: eventId
desc: This identifies the SearchAnswerValues where this value was pulled from.
meaning: The event ID of the search answer this value was taken from.

name: metadataValueIndex
desc: Each SearchAnswerValue can have a primary value and a list of metadata values. If this index is set, this value was pulled from the metadata value at this index, otherwise it was pulled from the primary value.
meaning: Which metadata value of a search answer this value came from.

name: text
desc: The display text of this answer value. It's taken from the search answer value display text if present, or the canonical name if it's an entity.
meaning: The text shown to the user for this answer value.

name: valueIndex
desc: The index of the SearchAnswerValue where this value was pulled from.
meaning: Which search answer value this value was taken from.

name: gaiaId
desc: The gaia id for the entity (person or plus page).
meaning: The internal account ID for a person or page entity.

name: expressionStatus
desc: Status indicating whether the user has completely expressed the semantics of the argument.
meaning: Says whether the user fully expressed what this argument means.

name: deprecatedSupportingMid
desc: A list of mids that "support" this argument in voting, i.e., results that support these mids will be treated as if they support the argument. This field has been deprecated in favor of related_entity. b/27363861
meaning: A deprecated list of entity IDs that used to back this argument.

name: onDeviceAnnotationSignals
desc: Additional signals for on-device annotations.
meaning: Extra details for annotations produced on the device.

name: ungroundedValueType
desc: Type of ungrounded argument. It is exclusively used when simple_value.ungrounded_value is populated.
meaning: Type tag for an argument value that could not be matched to a known entity.

name: isIntentgenAnnotation
desc: Whether this argument was annotated by Intentgen QUIK model (go/intentgen-quik)
meaning: Marks that the argument was annotated by a particular model.

name: locationClassificationScore
desc: Confidence score of this argument being a location.
meaning: How confident the system is that this argument is a place.

name: allowedFuzzyMatch
desc: For this argument, backend performed fuzzy match.
meaning: Marks that the backend matched this argument loosely.

name: isEvalDataHeuristic
desc: Set when the eval_data was not derived at parsing time, but heuristically determined by matching the ArgumentValue to an annotation/query fragment.
meaning: Marks that the query-span info was guessed by text matching, not produced while parsing.

name: supportTransferSignals
desc: Support Transfer signals for this entity.
meaning: Pointer to the support-transfer data held for this entity.

name: deprecatedFreebaseType
desc: If the literal.obj_type of the argument value is ID (Entity), this represents freebase types of the entity in this argument.
meaning: Old Freebase types of the entity, marked deprecated.

name: rawQueryText
desc: A copy of the span of canonical (raw) parser input text corresponding to this annotation.
meaning: Copy of the exact words in the query that this annotation covers.

name: isEnum
desc: Set when the argument has an enum value - a normalized_string_type from the intent catalog.
meaning: Marks that the argument holds a fixed choice value from the intent catalogue.

name: supportTransferRules
desc: go/stbr supportthis is an
meaning: Internal rules for passing supporting evidence between entities.

name: qrefInterpretationIndex
desc: The index of the QueryJoin interpretation from which this annotation is taken. We copy over the value given by nlp.semantic_parsing.annotators.QrefAnnotator. The value will be "-1" if the annotation is coming from low confidence Qref annotations. NOTE - this is generated from as QRef's interetation_number.
meaning: Index of the query interpretation this annotation was copied from.

name: relatednessSignals
desc: Relatedness Matrix signals about this argument, e.g., query_popularity.
meaning: Relatedness signals about the argument, such as how popular the query is.

name: locationType
desc: The type category for the location stored in this Argument, if it exists.
meaning: The kind of place stored in this argument.

name: mergedImpliedEntity
desc: List of QRef implied entities merged into this entity during parsing. Clients should not rely on the order, as it is derivation-dependent.
meaning: Other entity annotations that were folded into this one while parsing.

name: multipleHorizontalListSelectionMatches
desc: Whether there were multiple equally good matches from horizontal_list_selection.
meaning: Marks that several list items matched a selection equally well.

name: midEquivalentToCollection
desc: For collection arguments, it is useful to save what was the original mid that qref annotated. For example, if the collection is /collection/films, we'll have the mid for /en/film here (/m/02vxn).
meaning: The original entity ID that matched before it was turned into a collection.

name: saftSignals
desc: Signals derived from SAFT.
meaning: Pointer to language-parsing signals produced by the SAFT parser.

name: relatedEntity
desc: List of entities that are semantically related to the argument as well as details of the relationship.
meaning: Entities related to this query argument and how they are related.

name: personalEntity
desc: Personal entities are compound entities made up of entities and their attributes, where the entities can be compound too. E.g., "my father's mother" can have a summary node annotation of "Mother(Father(Myself))"
meaning: Compound personal entities such as someone's father's mother.

name: resolvedFromPronoun
desc: Whether this argument was resolved from a pronoun mention in the query. Eg: [how old was obama when
meaning: Flag saying the argument came from a pronoun such as 'he' in the query.

name: chainId
desc: One or more ChainIds from a ChainAnnotation whose "organization_mid" matches the MID. As of 2021-01 multiple chain_ids may be specified if the organization for MID controls multiple chains. See go/chains-lckp-robust-triggering for motivation.
meaning: IDs of business chains linked to the entity in this argument.

name: addedByCloseAnswers
desc: Whether this argument was added by CloseAnswers in Postref. This bit is used to mark the corresponding interpretation/intent query as such by setting is_close_interpretation bit.
meaning: Marks that a later close-answers step added this argument.

name: location
desc: Entity location information (latitude/longitude) from freebase.
meaning: The latitude and longitude of the entity in this argument.

name: personalQrefReferenceScore
desc: The confidence (in [0, 1]) that the annotation is a reference that implies another entity (e.g., "my hotel" in "navigate to my hotel" is a reference to an explicit hotel from the user's hotel reservations).
meaning: How confident the system is that a phrase points at another entity.

name: mediaEntitySignals
desc: Signals about the media entity for this argument.
meaning: Extra details about the media entity in this argument.

name: collectionMembership
desc: If the literal.obj_type of the argument value is ID (Entity), this represents the collection that the entity in this argument is a member of.
meaning: The knowledge collections the argument's entity belongs to.

name: locationMarkersSignals
desc: The usual semantic role associated with the signal from lightweight tokens attached to this argument span.
meaning: Hints from small location words attached to this part of the query.

name: source
desc: What added this argument.
meaning: Name of the component that added this argument.

name: clusterInfo
desc: If the literal.obj_type of the argument value is ID (Entity), this stores cluster scoring information for that entity, if the entity belongs to a cluster.
meaning: Scoring information about the entity's cluster, when it belongs to one.

name: qrefConfidenceScore
desc: The QRef confidence score for an entity argument.
meaning: Confidence that the entity matched to this part of the query is the right one.

name: isGenieAnnotation
desc: Whether this annotation was propagated as part of a Genie rewrite (go/genie-aqua).
meaning: Marks that the annotation was carried over by a query rewrite system.

name: resolvedFromContext
desc: Whether this argument was resolved through context from a previous query. Examples: obama -> "he" is resolved from the Obama entity starbucks -> Q2 is resolved from the list of shops
meaning: Flag saying the argument was filled in from an earlier query rather than this one.

name: valueSource
desc: What added the argument value.
meaning: Name of the component that supplied the argument's value.

name: webrefListSource
desc: This represents which list entities index refers to.
meaning: Says which entity list the entity index refers to.

name: isDefaultValue
desc: If true, the value of the argument is populated with the default value specified by the system if the value can't be inferred from the input query. In IntentConfig case, the default value is specified by using IntentConfig.slot.default_value.
meaning: Marks that the argument was filled with a system default rather than from the query.

name: parsedDueToExperiment
desc: Experiment ID for experiments that were used to parse this FunctionCall. Empty indicates no experiments used.
meaning: The experiment IDs that caused this parse to happen.

name: facet
desc: If this slot was transformed from or could be transformed to a facet on a categorical, that information is stored here.
meaning: Records how this slot maps to or from a facet on a category.

name: isNimbleAnnotation
desc: Whether this argument was annotated by nimble (go/nimble-annotator)
meaning: Marks that the argument was annotated by a particular annotator.

name: fromSymbolAnnotation
desc: Whether the argument entity comes from a graphic symbol annotation. This is later used as a heuristic for poor web result quality.
meaning: Marks that the entity came from a graphic symbol annotation.

name: entityNumber
desc: Signals about what other entities this entity implies / is implied by. This is useful for grounding. Example: b/138388207: suppressing song intents if the artist entity doesn't link to the song title. This value specifies the order of annotations in a QRef annotation chain so they can refer to each other.
meaning: The position of this entity in a chain of query annotations.

name: copleySourceTypeList
desc: Contains the source and type information related to a personal entity, for example if it is a hotel or a restaurant (type) and if it comes from Gmail, Calendar, etc. (source).
meaning: Where a personal entity came from, such as Gmail or Calendar, and what type it is.

name: webrefEntitiesIndex
desc: Webref entity index for this argument, necessary for interpreting the relationship structure, and the list to index into. Specifically we need this to understand qref implications since they edges are represented with entity indexes.
meaning: Position of this argument's entity in the Webref entity list.

name: entityRelationship
desc: Signals about what other entities this entity implies / is implied by. This is useful for grounding. Example: b/138388207: suppressing song intents if the artist entity doesn't link to the song title.
meaning: Records which other entities this entity implies or is implied by.

name: muninSignals
desc: Signals derived from Munin Function call annotations.
meaning: Extra details taken from Munin function-call annotations.

name: shoppingIds
desc: Equivalent shopping ids for the argument.
meaning: Shopping catalog identifiers matching this query argument.

name: contextResolution
desc: How this argument was resolved through context from a previous query. Examples: obama -> "he" is resolved from the Obama entity starbucks -> Q2 is resolved from the list of shops (Attentional Entities)
meaning: How this argument was resolved from an earlier query's context.

name: annotationLayerSignals
desc: Signals to facilitate orchestration of TUIG annotations.
meaning: Bookkeeping used to orchestrate annotation layers.

name: annotatedRelationship
desc: Relationships between entities
meaning: Records relationships found between entities in the query.

name: personalQrefResolutionScore
desc: The confidence (in [0, 1]) that the annotation was created on an implicit mention (e.g., "my hotel") as opposed to an explicit mention (e.g., "the westin copley square").
meaning: How confident the system is that the mention was indirect rather than explicit.

name: resultSupport
desc: The list of result supports for this Argument.
meaning: List of results that back up this query argument when assembling the answer.

name: isAUngroundedTypeOf
desc: If the argument is entity, the ungrounded type the entity is. For example, the entity argument is /m/0p83l (Jasmine), the value of this field should be "Plant" if it is present.
meaning: A plain-language type for the entity, such as calling jasmine a plant.

name: oysterId
desc: The oyster feature id. NOTE: As of Mar 2017, the cell ID field of the feature ID might not be set. See
meaning: An internal geographic feature ID for the entity.

name: provenance
desc: Information about where the value of this argument came from. For example, it could have been explicitly provided in the query, pulled in from the previous state, or pulled from attentional entities.
meaning: Notes where this query argument's value came from, such as the typed query or an earlier turn.

name: fromManualSymbolAnnotation
desc: Whether the argument entity comes from a manual graphic symbol annotation. This is later used as a heuristic for poor web result quality.
meaning: Marks that the entity came from a hand-made graphic symbol annotation.

name: complexQueriesRewrite
desc: Custom type used by Complex Queries. This is populated based on the output of the RPC to the Complex Queries Boq node.
meaning: Rewritten version of a complex question produced by another service.

name: appAnnotation
desc: Device actions custom types.
meaning: Custom value type used for device app actions.

name: scalarValue
desc: A scalar value with optional unit; used ONLY for resolved values after grounding.
meaning: A resolved number with an optional unit attached.

name: componentReference
desc: Component reference between WebrefEntity and Mention. This should only ever be set in argument values in WebrefEntities (e.g. in a QueryJoin). The processing expectation is that the value including the component reference is discarded altogether and replaced by reference target. Use QueryJoinToMeaningStructConverter to perform the replacement. An example value parallel to this reference may exist, but it's meant purely for human consumption and should not be used.
meaning: Internal pointer that is meant to be replaced by the value it refers to.

name: timer
desc: Productivity custom types. Team: go/productivity-assistance.
meaning: Timer object used by Assistant productivity requests.

name: money
desc: Represents: money expressions (e.g. 25$). Annotated by: number subgrammar.
meaning: A money amount mentioned in the request.

name: deviceId
desc: DeviceId custom types. Details in go/reply-broadcast
meaning: Identifier of a device named in an Assistant request.

name: recurrence
desc: Represents: intervals of recurrence for repeated tasks. See go/recurrence-subgrammar Annotated by: recurrence subgrammar.
meaning: How often something repeats, as stated in the request.

name: shoppingOffer
desc: Shopping custom types. See go/sopa-attentional.
meaning: Shopping offer referenced in an Assistant shopping request.

name: sensitiveValue
desc: Sensitive value, see go/sensitive-intents and go/a4w-multi-turn-dialog
meaning: Placeholder holding a sensitive argument value.

name: deviceUserIdentity
desc: DeviceUserIdentity custom types. Details in go/reply-broadcast
meaning: Identity of the device user for Assistant broadcast features.

name: location
desc: Represents: location expressions. Annotated by: location subgrammar.
meaning: A place expression pulled out of the request text.

name: calendarEvent
desc: Calendar custom types. Details in go/cal-ref.
meaning: Calendar event value used by Assistant calendar requests.

name: homeAutomationDevice
desc: HomeAutomation custom types. Details in go/smarthome_with_monastery.
meaning: Smart home device referenced in the request.

name: simpleValue
desc: When literal is a datetime, it's really just an ISO 8601 datetime string. This case will eventually be replaced with the date_time field, which is more expressive and can also represent recurrences, ranges, etc. Likewise, simple_value will replace the other types of simple values that literal is currently being used to represent.
meaning: Container for plain values such as strings or dates.

name: sensitivity
desc: Argument level query sensitivities. 1) Statically defined Sensitivity is copied from IntentSlot at serving time so it can be propagated along with FunctionCall to places where the Intent Catalog is not available. See go/sensitive-intents for details. 2) For the same reason, contextual sensitivites (eg., from AttentionalEntity mentions) are populated here too. See go/tagging-sensitive-ae for details.
meaning: Privacy sensitivity labels attached to this argument.

name: duration
desc: Represents: duration expressions (e.g. 5 minutes). Annotated by: datetime subgrammar.
meaning: A length of time mentioned in the request, such as five minutes.

name: onDevice
desc: OnDevice custom types. Device on which an intent should be fulfilled. Differs semantically from device fields used by Media and HomeAutomation: this is annotated by the on_device subgrammar, and will not output any metadata beyond what the subgrammar outputs. See go/on_device_induction_quality.
meaning: Which device the request should be carried out on.

name: messageNotification
desc: Custom type used by tap-to-read for embedding a MessageNotification message in a GetMessageContent intent.
meaning: Message notification embedded in a read-my-messages request.

name: coreference
desc: A value that is a coreference or variable binding to some other part of the tree. See go/mrf-variables.
meaning: Link to another part of the parse tree that this value refers to.

name: narrativeNewsProvider
desc: Custom type used by NarrativeNews. This is populated by the narrative news provider annotator, and it differs semantically from a mid for a news brand in that it doesn't refer to the field of widely known news brands but rather but to the specific audio news RSS feeds that the narrative news feature serves. (There is of course substantial overlap between those two concepts)
meaning: Identifier of an audio news feed used by the narrative news feature.

name: device
desc: Media custom types. For example use, see go/valyrian-media-dd.
meaning: Cast or media device named in the request.

name: calendarEventWrapper
desc: Details in go/multi-account-event-representation.
meaning: Calendar event value that can cover multiple accounts.

name: number
desc: Represents: number expressions. Annotated by: number subgrammar.
meaning: A number mentioned in the request.

name: aogSlot
desc: Custom type used by actions-on-google in-dialog queries. See go/3p-custom-intents-wrt-meaning-catalog
meaning: Slot value used for third-party Actions on Google conversations.

name: personalIntelligenceEntity
desc: Entity parsed from manual grammar interpretation in the Personal Intelligence domain.
meaning: Entity parsed from a request about the user's own personal data.

name: person
desc: Represents: structured person names, including common names and personal contacts. Annotated by: go/person-subgrammar.
meaning: A person name recognised in the request, including personal contacts.

name: timezone
desc: Represents: timezone expressions (e.g. Eastern Daylight Time). Annotated by: datetime subgrammar.
meaning: A time zone mentioned in the request.

name: collectionId
desc: Human readable id of the collection.
meaning: Readable name of a group of entities.

name: collectionMid
desc: Identifier of the collection, usually a MID (/m/xyz or /g/zyw).
meaning: Knowledge Graph identifier of a group of entities.

name: collectionScore
desc: The collection score for a entity.
meaning: How strongly an entity belongs to a given group of entities.

name: score
desc: Different types of scores for the collection. Each score type has at most one score.
meaning: The different kinds of membership scores an entity has for a group.

name: dataEpochId
desc: Concepts data epoch used to annotate the queries.
meaning: Which data snapshot was used to annotate the queries.

name: argPath
desc: A coreference is represented by an argument path starting from the root of the whole tree to the referenced value.
meaning: Path from the root of the parse tree to the value being referred to.

name: additionalAnnotationData
desc: Stores any additional data which is required only at the intent fulfilment phase.
meaning: Extra data kept only for carrying out a vehicle action.

name: argument
desc: A list of arguments of this function call.
meaning: The list of arguments belonging to this parsed function call.

name: catalogVersion
desc: The corresponding meaning catalog version that was used to generate this FunctionCall.
meaning: Version of the meaning catalog used to build this parse.

name: conceptInfo
desc: Information about the corresponding Concept for this MRF Expression. For more details see go/concepts-roofshot.
meaning: Pointer to concept details for this parsed expression.

name: contextualSensitivity
desc: Contextual Sensitivity (go/contextual-sensitivity) metadata indicating that a policy- or privacy- sensitive conversation context (previous queries, rewritten user queries, and previous system responses, like attentional entities) is used to generate this FunctionCall. This needs propagation (1) from Interp to DialogIntentState (DIS) (see b/148479837) and (2) from QRewrite/QUS down to Assistant Server's memory finalizer. One can use knowledge/answers/sensitivity/sensitivity_reader.h to parse this
meaning: Marks that privacy-sensitive conversation context was used to build this parse.

name: enabledRemodelings
desc: Contains data about which remodelings are being used for this funcall. For more information see go/meaning-remodeling-framework.
meaning: Which schema remodelling variants are in use for this parse.

name: ignoredTokens
desc: A list of token lists that were ignored during parsing because they are known context phrases for this interpretation. For example, for query [tell me how tall height of Obama really], assuming "tell me", "tall", "of", "really" are explained and thus ignored, with corresponding prior 0.9, 0.8, 0.7, 0.6, following ignored tokens will be populated: { ignored_tokens { token { ngram: "tell me", prior: 0.9} score: 0.9 } ignored_tokens { token { ngram:
meaning: Words skipped while parsing because they are known filler phrases.

name: key
desc: The primary key for this FunctionCall. Note: This is still under development and not available for general use. Contact meaning-platform-eng@ for questions.
meaning: Primary key identifying this parsed function call.

name: marker
desc: The marker specifies the purpose of this meaning struct / function call: Is it asking a question, and if yes, for which slot(s)? Is it a command, statement, etc? This corresponds to a (very coarse) notion of dialog acts. In the absence of this field, it will be inferred using the following algorithm (subject to marker applicability rules specified in marker.proto, see also go/requested-slots): 1) Use the underlying Meaning Schema's default marker, if applicable. 2) Assume that the Meaning Struct
meaning: Says whether the parsed meaning is a question, command or statement.

name: modifiers
desc: A flattened representation of all intent modifiers that apply to this function call.
meaning: Flattened list of modifiers that apply to this parsed meaning.

name: name
desc: Name of this function call. The name must be present. If it is omitted, the FunctionCall is not well-formed.
meaning: The name of this parsed function call.

name: sensitivity
desc: Intent level query sensitivity (go/sensitive-intents). This metadata comes directly from Intent Catalog, indicating a single-shot query sensitivity without putting context into considerations. Therefore, this requires a one-to-one match with each intent registered in Intent Catalog.
meaning: Privacy sensitivity label for the parsed intent.

name: signals
desc: Signals at the function call level
meaning: Pointer to the bundle of signals kept for this function call.

name: unexplainedTokens
desc: A list of tokens that were ignored during parsing that cannot be explained by context phrases.
meaning: Words skipped while parsing that no known phrase accounts for.

name: expressionStatus
desc: Status indicating whether the user has completely expressed their intended semantics. (See go/streaming-nlu-fulfilment-protocol-v1 for more info. )
meaning: Whether the user has finished saying what they mean.

name: attributeSignals
desc: The attributes from which this intent was generated during execution of AttributeSignalsProvider. |attribute_signals| is only populated for single entity funcalls.
meaning: The attributes this intent was generated from.

name: isRefinedMeaning
desc: Whether the FunctionCall is created as a refined_meaning in resolution. Downstream code will look at this field to see if it needs to create a new refined QueryInterpretation.
meaning: Flag that this parse was created as a refinement during resolution.

name: argumentComposingMid
desc: The argument mid that was used to compose the entity for a concept interpretation, along with the intent_composing_mid (one of the intent's equivalent MIDs).
meaning: Entity id of the argument used to build a combined concept entity.

name: isCloseInterpretation
desc: Whether the interpretation was generated using similar queries in POSTREF. In case POSTREF_AQUA generated the same entity-attribute interpretation, this is still set to true.
meaning: Flag that the interpretation came from similar past queries.

name: prefulfillmentSignals
desc: All the input signals to the Prefulfillment Ranker.
meaning: Pointer to all the inputs of the pre-fulfilment ranker.

name: dedupedFuncalls
desc: FunctionCall-s that this funcall was deduped against.
meaning: Other duplicate parses that were merged into this one.

name: localSignals
desc: Information about Local results to be used in the Packer for Local Categorical derived intent deduplication and conformance.
meaning: Pointer to local-result signals used when merging duplicate intents.

name: isDisambiguationIntent
desc: Denotes whether this is a sub-intent of an ambiguous SystemUncertain intent go/intent-disambiguation.
meaning: Flag marking this as one option of an ambiguous request.

name: intentProvenance
desc: Information about where the value of this intent came from. For example, it could have been explicitly provided in the query, pulled in from the previous dialog state, or pulled from previous queries.
meaning: Where this intent came from, such as the query or an earlier turn.

name: highConfidence
desc: Used to indicate that an interpretation is high confidence and triggers different voting behavior. This bit should only be set for verticals. DEPRECATED. Use confidence_level instead.
meaning: Deprecated flag marking an interpretation as high confidence.

name: conceptEntityMid
desc: An entity that represents the concept of an entity-attribute intent by being composed of an intent equivalent MID and the argument MID.
meaning: Combined entity id representing an entity-plus-attribute concept.

name: selectedByPrefulfillmentRanking
desc: Identifies whether the Prefulfillment Ranker selected this intent for emission. This is needed temporarily while migrating intent emitters from ACE to QUS/PFR. See go/pfr-intent-emitter for more info
meaning: Flag that the pre-fulfilment ranker picked this intent.

name: conceptSignals
desc: Information about the corresponding Concept attached to the FunctionCall. go/concept-roofshot.
meaning: Pointer to concept information attached to the function call.

name: groundingSignals
desc: Grounding signals for ranking/filtering, as well as whether to use Grounding Box and PGRP in AnswersRewriter. See comment on GroundingSignals for details.
meaning: Pointer to grounding signals used when ranking parsed intents.

name: refxSummaryNodeId
desc: The id of the summary node if this funcall represents an mdvc interpretation
meaning: Id of the summary node for this interpretation.

name: signalsFallbackIntents
desc: Additional intents to be used for intent scoring. This field must only be populated when we cannot find a single unified intent. For example, when we compute signals for a LocalEntities function call, this means we could not find a unified intent to capture all the local results. In this case, we add a fallback intent for each local result (e.g. GeoSchool, GeoRestaurant, and GeoBank if those are the results we show).
meaning: Backup intents used for scoring when no single intent fits.

name: isDisambiguationCardIntent
desc: Denotes whether this is an intent being fulfilled from user tapping a disambiguation card. More info in go/cardea-deck.
meaning: Flag that the intent came from the user tapping a disambiguation card.

name: prefulfillmentRankingScore
desc: Identifies a score, determined before fulfillment but after grounding. Written by the Prefulfillment Ranker, and used as a signal for ACE Ranking.
meaning: Score given to a parsed request before it is acted on, used to rank Assistant intents.

name: isNeuralCategoricalInterpretation
desc: Whether the interpretation was generated from the neural categorical parser.
meaning: Flag that this reading came from the neural categorical parser.

name: parsedDueToExperiment
desc: Experiments that caused this FunctionCall to parse, without which this would not have parsed.
meaning: Names of experiments without which this parse would not exist.

name: referentialResolution
desc: Describes how this intent was resolved via external data (either elsewhere in the query, or in a previous query).
meaning: How this intent was resolved using other parts of the query or earlier turns.

name: intentComposingMid
desc: An intent_relevant_mid that was used to compose the entity for a concept interpretation, along with argument_composing_mid (the question's argument MID).
meaning: Entity id of the intent used to build a combined concept entity.

name: shoppingIds
desc: Equivalent shopping ids for the function call.
meaning: Shopping catalog identifiers matching this parsed request.

name: responseMeaningSignals
desc: Signal data from SRM generation. Solely used internally. See: go/srm-design.
meaning: Internal data produced while generating a response meaning.

name: osrpJourneyTag
desc: A tag to annotate user's journey (e.g., JourneyFollowCampusUpdates). This will be used for Journey OSRP demo (go/josrp-sprint). !!NOTE!! This field is reserved for Journey OSRP demo, and will be deprecated shortly after its completion. DO NOT USE.
meaning: Temporary demo tag labelling a user journey, marked as do not use.

name: parsingSignals
desc: Parsing signals for ranking/filtering.
meaning: Pointer to parsing signals used to rank and filter interpretations.

name: resultSupport
desc: The list of result supports for this FunctionCall.
meaning: List of results that back up this parsed request when assembling the answer.

name: intentRelevantMid
desc: KG mids of entities that represent this intent. These entities are seen as equivalent to the Intent definition, and are specified in the Intent Catalog as relevant_mid.
meaning: Knowledge Graph ids of entities treated as equivalent to this intent.

name: usesPrefulfillmentRanker
desc: Identifies whether this intent intends to be scored and pruned by the prefulfillment ranker after intent-generation.
meaning: Flag that this intent should be scored by the pre-fulfilment ranker.

name: isUiCompositionIntent
desc: Denotes this is a sub-intent used for composing an Assistant UI response. The assistant dialog should output ui_composition_shelf in the SystemResponse if it can fulfill the intent. More info in go/davinci-design and go/davinci-di-fulfillment
meaning: Flag marking a sub-intent used to build an Assistant screen response.

name: groundabilityScore
desc: Score indicating how grounded the intent is, populated by the Grounding Box, used by the pre-fulfillment ranker, see
meaning: How well the parsed request could be matched to known things.

name: numConstraints
desc: Sum of the number of constraints used by the Grounding Box to ground each variable.
meaning: Count of constraints used when matching parse variables to entities.

name: numConstraintsSatisfied
desc: Sum of the number of constraints satisfied for each variable. Depending on the match score for a constraint, this number can be fractional and is in the range [0, num_constraints].
meaning: Count of those matching constraints that were met.

name: numGroundableArgs
desc: Number of groundable arguments in the parsed intent.
meaning: How many arguments in the parse could in principle be matched to entities.

name: numGroundedArgs
desc: Number of arguments that got actually grounded.
meaning: How many arguments actually got matched to entities.

name: numVariables
desc: Number of arguments, possibly nested, that the Grounding Box tried to ground.
meaning: How many parse variables the matcher tried to resolve.

name: numVariablesGrounded
desc: Number of arguments, possibly nested, that the Grounding Box was able to ground. This includes ambiguously grounded arguments.
meaning: How many parse variables were resolved, including ambiguous ones.

name: pgrpOutputFormat
desc: PGRP outputs PROD_INTENT_FACTORY intent format by default. See go/intent-conversion-locations-in-sage. Experimental flags can change or make PGRP output additional intents formatted for PORTMON_FULFILLMENT (e.g. with RDs). This is used by the PortMon/ARM dark launch (go/arm-dark-launch-infra). Longer term, this will be replaced by DGS system-internal transformations (go/if-dgs).
meaning: Which output format the intent post-processing stage produces.

name: usesGroundingBox
desc: If true, then GroundingBox and PGRP are used in AnswersRewriter to process the intent. Other post-processing steps, including IGDP, are adjusted accordingly. Note this will be removed once GroundingBox is fully launched and all prod traffic goes through it. Before that happens, each IG that needs to go through GB and PGRP (post GB ranking pruning) will need to explicitly set this field to true. See
meaning: Flag that the grounding pipeline handles this intent.

name: annotatedSpan
desc: A copy of the span of canonical (raw) parser input text corresponding to this annotation. Copied from QRefAnnotation.annotated_span.
meaning: Copy of the query words in which this implied entity was found.

name: evalData
desc: This field is used inside Aqua for evaluation purposes.
meaning: Data kept only for offline evaluation of annotations.

name: isUngroundedValue
desc: TODO (b/143536264): Create a new ImpliedTokens message and remove this. Whether the implied entity is ungrounded value, set to true when the entity doesn't have a KG mid.
meaning: Flag that the implied entity has no Knowledge Graph id.

name: mid
desc: The KG mid of the implied entity.
meaning: Knowledge Graph id of an entity implied by the query.

name: qrefConfidenceScore
desc: The QRef confidence (in [0, 1]) of the entity being correctly annotated.
meaning: Confidence between zero and one that the entity was correctly spotted.

name: shoppingIds
desc: All ShoppingIds for this implied entity that need to be copied to IntentQuery (FunctionCall) if this implied entity is used in intent generation. See go/iql-shopping-ids for details.
meaning: Shopping identifiers to copy along if this implied entity is used.

name: iqlEncodingVersion
desc: The version of encoder for the IQL FunctionCalls. We bump up the version when, but not limited to, we change how an IQL is converted to a byte array, or the change of byte compression algorithm.
meaning: Version number of the encoding used for stored intent parses.

name: iqlFuncalls
desc: A compressed byte array that represents IQL FunctionCalls. A list of IQL FunctionCalls are first encoded as a byte array. The byte array is then compressed. For more details on the encoding, see go/iql-in-wma.
meaning: Compressed blob of stored intent parses attached during indexing.

name: piannoConfidenceScoreE2
desc: The Pianno confidence scores of all intents of the IQL FunctionCalls. For space reasons this is stored as a [0, 100] integer that represents the confidence up to two decimal points (fixed point). Convert it to confidence_score using the following formula: float pianno_confidence_score = pianno_confidence_score_e2 / 100.0f It should have the same number of elements as the IQL expressions after decoding. For non-Pianno top level intents, this score is 0.
meaning: Confidence scores of stored intents, kept as small whole numbers.

name: piannoIqlBitmap
desc: A bit map indicating if the intents in the IQL FunctionCalls are top level intents for Pianno (go/pianno). This is a repeated field. In the event of more than 32 intents, the first uint32/ represents the 1st to the 32nd intents, and the second uint32 represents/ the 33rd to the 64th intents, and so on. Within each uint32, the bits are in reversed order, i.e. the right-most bit of the first uint32 indicating if the first intent in IQL expressions is a top level intent for Pianno. The prevailing (
meaning: Bit map marking which stored intents are top level ones.

name: gcidIntent
desc: Geo intents corresponding to the gcids obtained from the Local result.
meaning: Place-category intents taken from a local result.

name: salientTermSet
desc: Salient terms associated with this Local result based on the result gcids.
meaning: Notable terms tied to a local result based on its place categories.

name: localResultSignals
desc: Signals relating to each Local result.
meaning: Pointer to the signals held for each local result.

name: minSalientTermSimilarity
desc: Minimum salient term similarity between Local results.
meaning: Lowest similarity of notable terms between the local results shown.

name: type
desc: The type of the lightweight token match.
meaning: The kind of lightweight token match that was found.

name: artistTitle
desc: For songs, this is the name of the primary artist, i.e. "Shallow" would "Lady Gaga" set.
meaning: Name of the main artist for a song entity.

name: name
desc: Name of the media entity, i.e. "Lady Gaga".
meaning: Name of the media entity, such as an artist name.

name: isIsolated
desc: If the modifier is only a good soft modifier by itself, then we would trigger only if it's the only modifier
meaning: Flag that a modifier only works when it is the only modifier present.

name: softModifierCollection
desc: Signals for $ListQueryRuleWithSoftModifier. Collections allowed by the soft modifier.
meaning: Entity groups that a soft modifier is allowed to apply to.

name: textIsGenerated
desc: If true, the text for this argument did not come from the query, but was generated somehow else.
meaning: Flag that the argument's text was generated rather than taken from the query.

name: annotationSource
desc: Where the annotation has been read from.
meaning: Where the annotation was read from.

name: type
desc: A client-controlled identifier that the client can use to distinguish between different sets of annotations.
meaning: Client-chosen label separating different sets of annotations.

name: version
desc: Version identifier used to isolate different clients from each other. A client should intersect this list of versions with the ones the client is interested in, and use the annotation if the intersection is non-empty.
meaning: Version tags letting clients pick which annotations apply to them.

name: provenance
desc: Provenance of the annotator. Equivalent to the
meaning: Which annotator produced this on-device annotation.

name: calibratedParsingScore
desc: A parsing score that is independently calibrated by each parser/IG, used by pre-fulfillment ranker, see
meaning: A parser's own calibrated score for one reading of the request.

name: effectiveArgSpanLength
desc: The total effective length of the spans for the arguments used to construct the parse. May include vertical specific adjustments. Eg: For the query [delete my 7 p.m. alarm called chicken] and intent Delete_alarm(alarm_object=RD(category=AlarmObject( label="chicken", trigger_time_datetime=<< 7 PM >>))), the effective argument span is "7 p.m." + "chicken" (total length of 13).
meaning: Total length of the query text covered by the parse's arguments.

name: inQueryMaxEffectiveArgSpanLength
desc: This is a cross-intent feature which is calculated by iterating all intent candidates. This feature should be populated in post-IG stage (before GB).
meaning: Largest covered argument length across all candidate readings of the query.

name: qrewriteCallPathInfoFingerprint
desc: This proto holds the fingerprint of the call path info of QRewrite client (e.g. the QUS's phase like "RBT","QBT"; the QUS's candidate type like "Identity"; and the ACE's candidate type like "FuzzyMatcher").
meaning: Fingerprint identifying which rewrite path produced this parse.

name: source
desc: The parser that calibrated the parsing score below.
meaning: Which parser produced the calibrated parsing score.

name: attributeId
desc: Attribute ID of a personal_summary_node_child.
meaning: Identifier of an attribute on a personal data node.

name: freebaseMid
desc: The mid of the entity in freebase associated with this span.
meaning: Knowledge Graph id of the entity behind a personal reference.

name: personalEntityChild
desc: Every PersonalEntity might itself rescursively contain related Personal Entities, e.g. for, "my father's mother" a parent Personal Entity for 'Mother()' contains a child Personal Entity of the form 'Mother(Myself)'.
meaning: Nested personal entities, such as mother inside my father's mother.

name: entityIndex
desc: The index of the other entity in the relationship.
meaning: Position of the other entity in a relationship.

name: linkPropertyName
desc: Names of the relationship links.
meaning: Names of the links describing how two entities are related.

name: score
desc: Numeric value associated with each annotation within the Qref servlet output.
meaning: Score attached to an entity annotation found in the query.

name: trustedNameConfidence
desc: Trusted name confidence signal
meaning: Confidence that a name in the query is a trusted name for the entity.

name: answersHeaderSignals
desc: Signals that are used to generate answers header.
meaning: Data used to build the header shown above an answer.

name: responseMeaningApplication
desc: The intended application this response meaning is used for. It is intended for downstream dispatching.
meaning: Which application the generated response is meant for.

name: isVerb
desc: Saft often marks verbs as head of intent and we may want to ignore those.
meaning: Flag that the parser marked this query word as a verb.

name: category
desc: Name of the subgrammar category this annotation is associated with.
meaning: Name of the grammar category this annotation belongs to.

name: domain
desc: Name of the subgrammar domain.
meaning: Name of the grammar domain this annotation belongs to.

name: score
desc: Numeric value associated with each subgrammar annotation. Used for in-domain ranking inside the Aqua Analyzer. This field is not guaranteed to be in any range. Furthermore, this field should never be compared for annotations with differing 'domain' value. The field is included here for making the Aqua Analyzer work with subgrammar annotations that have been generated in a different Aqua Analyzer (typically by TUIG SemanticAnnotationServlet). TL;DR: Consumers of this message are STRONGLY DISCOURA
meaning: Internal grammar score used only for ranking within one parsing domain.

name: doNotUseDebugOnlyDecryptedValue
desc: Decrypted and deserialized contents of |encrypted_value|. This field should never be populated in prod. This is only provided for easier human inspection when using dev builds (dev keys are public).
meaning: Debug-only readable copy of an encrypted value, never set in production.

name: encryptedValue
desc: Encrypted protobuffer of type ArgumentValue.
meaning: Encrypted copy of a sensitive argument value.

name: aspectClusterIds
desc: A shopping aspect cluster id. These are attributes mined from mentions in web articles.
meaning: Shopping aspect ids mined from mentions in web articles.

name: brandEntityId
desc: Brand entity id. Brands are fully reconciled with KG entities so there should never be ambiguity as to which brand applies (those would be separate MIDs).
meaning: Knowledge Graph id of a product brand.

name: bxCategoryIds
desc: A category in the shopping browseonomy, a taxonomy of product types that can be found at go/bx. This field is expected to contain the deepest node in the browseonomy that the intent or argument pertains to, which may be an internal node. It does not contain the entire path of categories.
meaning: Deepest shopping category that the request refers to.

name: merchantIds
desc: List of merchant customer account IDs associated with a merchant entity in KG. NOTE: Soon to be deprecated, see go/merchant_mids_in_indexer design
meaning: Merchant account ids linked to a merchant entity, being retired.

name: merchantSourceIds
desc: A shopping merchant source id, i.e. the key used to identify Shopping Merchants as they are imported into KG. For reference, these IDs are populated in:
meaning: Source ids used when importing shopping merchants.

name: tagIds
desc: Moka attributes of a product. This includes color tags but currently not brand. We allow the possibility for multiple tag ids, as multiple Moka tag ids may map to the same mid, and we may not be able to find a single matching Moka tag. Also, cross-category Moka colors intentionally map a single color mentioned in the query to an expansion of many tags representing points in LAB color space (although this representation is expected to change).
meaning: Product attribute tags such as colour tags.

name: intent
desc: The intent name of the fallback intent.
meaning: Name of the fallback intent used for scoring.

name: ungroundedValue
desc: Ungrounded value contains the part of the query (or web snippet, etc.) that was not understood. For more information on this field, see the "Ungrounded value" item in the table of contents of go/iql-v1
meaning: The part of the query that the parser could not make sense of.

name: supportTransferSource
desc: Entities that transferred support to this entity (mids).
meaning: Entities that passed supporting evidence to this entity.

name: supportTransferTarget
desc: Entities that received support from this entity (mids).
meaning: Entities that received supporting evidence from this entity.

name: evalData
desc: This field is used inside Aqua and outside Aqua for identifying the token indices and/or byte offsets of this Token.
meaning: Token positions and byte offsets used for lookup and evaluation.

name: ngram
desc: |ngram| should be populated with a string from the raw query, not the normalized tokens. E.g. The ngram in the ignored token for the Height intent on the query [Height of barack obama], will be "Height". The ngram in the ignored token for the Videos intent on the query [vidéos] will be "vidéos".
meaning: The raw query word or phrase this token stands for.

name: parsedDueToExperiment
desc: Experiments that caused this Token to parse, without which this would not have parsed.
meaning: Experiments without which this token would not have parsed.

name: provenanceId
desc: Unique identifiers for the provenance of this token, for example, NLP Repository Example IDs.
meaning: Identifiers of where this token came from, such as example ids.

name: score
desc: Score for this group of tokens is currently product of priors.
meaning: Score for a group of tokens, currently the product of their priors.

name: slotKey
desc: Note: This is still under development and not available for general use. Contact meaning-platform-eng@ for questions.
meaning: Identifier of the slot being asked about, still under development.

name: slotName
desc: One or multiple slots may be requested by the marker. See go/mrf-multiple-output-slots for details on requesting multiple output slots.
meaning: Names of the slots the question is asking to fill.

name: deprecatedVersion
desc: The version has been changed to be defined as a horizontal version on the entire meaning catalog instead of per-schema.
meaning: Old per-schema version field, replaced by a catalog-wide version.

name: mid
desc: The minted MID for an intent.
meaning: Identifier minted for an intent definition.

name: mid
desc: The minted MID for the slot. This ID uniquely identifies the slot globally.
meaning: Globally unique identifier minted for a slot.

name: uniqueId
desc: A stable unique ID for this intent minted from go/uniqueid. NOTE: This is considered a private field used only for internal Intent Catalog purposes (i.e. as a source ID for generating this intent's associated MID). Additionally, this field is only populated on the schema. TODO (b/168907943): Move "unique_id" out of MeaningSchemaSlotKey proto message. Note: Please do not use this field. It is going to be moved out of this proto message.
meaning: Private internal id for a slot, marked as not to be used.

meaning: Which internal contracts this value type is available for.

meaning: Flag saying an Assistant intent is approved to work across linked accounts.

name: allArguments
desc: Policy for all arguments, so no need to repeat on every argument.
meaning: A shared privacy policy applied to every argument of an intent.

name: enabled
desc: Controls whether to enabled limited logging (rpc whitelisting + GWS log query redaction) if the intent wins post-fulfillment ranking.
meaning: Switch that turns on limited logging when an intent wins fulfillment.

name: nestedIntentOnly
desc: The eval policy won't apply if the annotated intent is a root. This check is majorly to prevent calling IntentScrubber halfway from InterpretationScrubber via nested intents.
meaning: Flag limiting a policy so it applies only to nested, not root, intents.

name: scrubEntireIntent
desc: Scrub entire intent before saving to eval storage, leaving only intent name and sensitivity info.
meaning: Flag to strip an intent down to its name before saving it for evaluation.

name: scrubArgumentValue
desc: The contents of the argument value should be scrubbed before being written to logs.
meaning: Flag saying an argument's value must be removed before logging.

name: scrubContext
desc: If this is set to true, this Sensitivity's presence will result in QRewrite to enable AS logging to scrub any discourse context.
meaning: Flag telling logging to strip the conversation context.

name: myActivityRedactionKey
desc: This field will be translated by footprints and is used to describe the content that was redacted that will be displayed to the user in MyActivity.
meaning: Key naming what was redacted so it can be shown in MyActivity.

name: accountProvenance
desc: Used to annotate the provenace of cross-account personal data. See go/cross-account-understanding. Sensitivity could be annotated at query, intent, and argument levels. Query and intent could have data from multiple accounts, so this field is repeated. A sensitive knowledge_context.PreviousQuery might be dropped to prevent leaking cross-account data via Genie rewrite. For arguments, the best practice is to not blend multi-account data, and this field should be treated as singular to make ownersh
meaning: Records which user accounts a piece of personal data came from.

name: instruction
desc: Instruction of handling sensitive intent/argument data. Can be specified in Intent Catalog.
meaning: Pointer to the handling instructions for sensitive intent or argument data.

name: source
desc: This should be systematically added without requiring the feature developers to add a source. This is for debug purpose as to whether the Sensitivity's trace/path included any of landmark code path helpful for tracing back the sensitivity sources. One should add a new source when one sees fits. It's chronological order as to which source is added first. One should not manually add a source. The same source can be repeated if the Sensitivity object went through the same code path twice.
meaning: Debug list of code paths the sensitivity object passed through.

name: type
desc: Sensitivity type. See the enum definition below.
meaning: The kind of sensitivity attached to a query, intent, or argument.

name: enableRpcWhitelist
desc: If this is set to true, QRewrite will enable RPC Whitelist to be applied in Assistant Server and Genie Rewriter.
meaning: Flag that turns on an RPC allowlist in Assistant serving.

name: encryptArgumentValue
desc: The contents of the argument value should be encrypted before being written to a persistent storage (even if the storage has short time-to-live). No-op when specified at intent level.
meaning: Flag saying an argument value must be encrypted before storage.

name: encryptFieldCandidateValueTerm
desc: If true, triggers encryption of |value_term| [1] and move into |sensitive_value_term|. This is useful to support finer grain encryption controls for disambiguation, where the broader |encrypt_argument_value| is too restrictive. In particular, when we know that the values being disambiguated are non-sensitive (e.g. opaque event IDs), but the value_terms are sensitive (e.g. event titles), it can be helpful for debugging purposes to circulate the value unencrypted. This policy only has an effect wh
meaning: Flag to encrypt only the display term of a candidate value instead of the whole value.

name: encryptQueryAnnotationData
desc: If this is set true, we encrypt QueryAnnotationDataProto prior to writing it to Footprint ASSISTANT_EPHEMERAL corpus. This enables restricting ACL to the data.
meaning: Flag to encrypt query annotation data before writing it to storage.

name: scrubAuxiliaryFieldsInConversationSnapshot
desc: If this is set to true, the following fields in ConversationSnapshot are scrubbed:
meaning: Flag to strip certain extra fields from a saved conversation snapshot.

name: componentSpecificContracts
desc: Contains data about the contracts that this ValueType level is available for. For more information see go/contract-based-conformance.
meaning: Notes which internal schema contracts this value type is available for.

name: remodelings
desc: Contains data about current schema remodelings at this ValueType level. For more information see go/meaning-remodeling-framework.
meaning: Notes in-progress schema restructuring for this value type.

name: componentSpecificContracts
desc: Contains data about the contracts that this ValueType level is available for. For more information see go/contract-based-conformance.
meaning: Notes which internal schema contracts this string type is available for.

name: remodelings
desc: Contains data about current schema remodelings at this ValueType level. For more information see go/meaning-remodeling-framework.
meaning: Notes in-progress schema restructuring for this string type.

name: singleToken
desc: If true, this value will match a single token. If false, this value will match any nonzero number of tokens.
meaning: Says whether this value matches exactly one word or several.

name: componentSpecificContracts
desc: Contains data about the contracts that this ValueType level is available for. For more information see go/contract-based-conformance.
meaning: Notes which internal schema contracts this time zone type is available for.

name: remodelings
desc: Contains data about current schema remodelings at this ValueType level. For more information see go/meaning-remodeling-framework.
meaning: Notes in-progress schema restructuring for this time zone type.

name: componentSpecificContracts
desc: Contains data about the contracts that this ValueType level is available for. For more information see go/contract-based-conformance.
meaning: Notes which internal schema contracts this tracking number type is available for.

name: remodelings
desc: Contains data about current schema remodelings at this ValueType level. For more information see go/meaning-remodeling-framework.
meaning: Notes in-progress schema restructuring for this tracking number type.

name: anyType
desc: This type is meant to accept "any" type and allow any and all composition. As such, it should not be used for any composition algorithms, e.g. in Loose Parser. See more detailed discussion at go/any-type-in-mrf. This type may appear on an answer_type, implying that the output of that Meaning Schema is allowed to nest in any other slot. However, support for this is NOT implemented in Loose Parser due to risk of overcomposition, but the MRF Conformance checker allows for this. If you are
meaning: A wildcard type that accepts any other type in a meaning schema slot.

name: dependencyType
desc: Used for configuring dynamic types to allow for type transparency. See: go/type-dependencies
meaning: Configuration for types that depend on another slot's type.

name: inputCompositionConfig
desc: When specified on a slot's type, restricts composition based on the enum value. This does not mean anything when the value type is to be interpreted as an output_type.
meaning: Setting that restricts how a slot's value can be combined with others.

name: normalizedStringType
desc: Note that normalized_string_type is NOT supported in the loose parser. A slot with this type will cause the intent to not be parsed.
meaning: A normalized string type that the loose parser does not support.

name: viewSpecificNumberTypes
desc: LINT.IfChange Contract-specific typing (go/view-based-options-for-valuetype). NOTE: To facilitate writing macros for view-specific filtering, all view-specific fields should be named with the format "view
meaning: Number types that apply only to particular internal consumers.

name: days
desc: A day of month, 1-31. If present, year and month must be present as well, and must form a valid date.
meaning: The day of month in a knowledge graph date value.

name: hours
desc: Hour of the day, 0-23
meaning: The hour of day in a knowledge graph time value.

name: microseconds
desc: Microsecond, in the interval [0, 999999]. If present, seconds have to be present as well.
meaning: The microseconds part of a knowledge graph time value.

name: minutes
desc: Minute, 0-59. If present, hours have to be present as well.
meaning: The minutes part of a knowledge graph time value.

name: months
desc: A month, 1-12. If present, year must be present as well.
meaning: The month in a knowledge graph date value.

name: seconds
desc: Second, in the interval [0, 60], where 60 is an exceptional value reserved for leap seconds. If present, minutes have to be present as well.
meaning: The seconds part of a knowledge graph time value.

name: tzOffset
desc: Timezone offset in seconds (can be positive/negative). If present, hours have to be present as well If absent, we expect the time above to be in local time (a.k.a. civil time, go/httat#civil_time).
meaning: The time zone offset in seconds for a knowledge graph time value.

name: years
desc: A year.
meaning: The year in a knowledge graph date value.

name: predicateObjs
desc: predicate_objs.pred should be unique within the list.
meaning: A list of property and value pairs attached to a knowledge graph node.

name: pred
desc: The qualifier pred must be a qualifier property defined in KG schema as applying to the predicate of the triple this qualifier is attached to.
meaning: The property name of a qualifier attached to a knowledge graph fact.

name: isNegation
desc: If is_negation is set to true then this triple is considered a statement that the fact is false. This allows for the storage of both what we know to be true and what we know to be false.
meaning: Marks a stored knowledge graph fact as known to be false.

name: obj
desc: obj is the value of a relationship.
meaning: The value side of a knowledge graph relationship.

name: pred
desc: pred is an arbitrary node id representing the predicate (name) of a graph relationship.
meaning: The relationship name in a knowledge graph fact.

name: qualifierSets
desc: WARNING: This is currently defined for experimentation purposes only. Please do not set. Data set in this field will not be published to any systems downstream of Livegraph. Together with the SPO of this triple, each qualifier set here represents a different logical assertion/fact.
meaning: Experimental extra qualifiers on a fact that are not published downstream.

name: sub
desc: sub is an arbitrary node id representing the source entity of a graph relationship.
meaning: The subject entity of a knowledge graph relationship.

name: data
desc: The encoded proto data.
meaning: Raw encoded bytes of a structured value.

name: descriptorFullName
desc: The full name of the proto descriptor, such as 'music.AlbumSummary'.
meaning: The name of the message type describing the encoded value.

name: accessRequired
desc: Specifies the contract or legal visibility required to see the Triple. See go/kg-triple-level-access-controls for details and background. Note that we use an int32 here so that we won't lose values when decoding on a stale binary. The int32 references to the enum storage_graph_bfg.Triple.Provenance.AccessRequirement.
meaning: The access level required to view this knowledge graph fact.

name: creator
desc: Historically, this field was used to encode the Freebase User ID, Google username, or Google MDB group that was responsible for the pipeline that is producing this data. However, there is currently no horizontal validation in place, and as of Q3 2018, this field is used essentially as a free-form string by multiple data providers. NOTE: Do not use this field in new pipelines without first consulting with the OWNERS of this proto.
meaning: Free form name of the team or pipeline that produced the data.

name: datasetMid
desc: The dataset which asserted this data. Must be a valid mid. See go/kg-provenance
meaning: Identifier of the dataset that asserted this fact.

name: isSupportingData
desc: Indicates that the corresponding data is supporting evidence for reconciliation only, and is
meaning: Marks data that exists only as evidence for entity reconciliation.

name: lgMetadata
desc: Internal metadata used by Livegraph and possibly other horizontal KG infra systems. This is not part of the logical triple or its provenance, and contents may not be visible downstream of LG.
meaning: Internal bookkeeping used by the Livegraph storage system.

name: policyMetadata
desc: Metadata specifying data governance policies. This information will be processed and enforced in KE systems. For more context, see go/ke-triple-dg-policy-and-metadata. WARNING: This field is WIP and please do not populate it without consulting ke-data-governance@.
meaning: Data governance policy metadata attached to a fact.

name: process
desc: An identifier for the process that asserted this triple.
meaning: Identifier of the process that asserted this fact.

name: sourceCategory
desc: Used to measure impact of 3P contributions. See go/ke-metrics.
meaning: Label used to measure how much third party sources contribute facts.

name: sourceDocId
desc: The websearch doc_id of the source_url. Used in conjunction with source_category for measuring 3P contributions.
meaning: The search document id of the page a knowledge graph fact was taken from.

name: sourceUrl
desc: If the triple was extracted from the web, the source URL where the assertion was found. Used for citation if needed (see restrictions field below).
meaning: The web address a knowledge graph fact was extracted from, kept for citation.

name: spiiCertification
desc: A fact about potentially sensitive personal info (
meaning: Marker about potentially sensitive personal information in a fact.

name: featureId
desc: (Mandatory) Oyster ID.
meaning: The map feature id of the place a weather request is about.

name: latLng
desc: (Mandatory) Coordinates of the location for which weather is requested.
meaning: The coordinates of the place a weather request is about.

name: locationName
desc: The name to display. If specified it will override the formatted address of "feature_id".
meaning: A place name to show instead of the stored address in weather results.

name: mid
desc: MID corresponding to the location from feature_id.
meaning: The entity id matching the weather location.

name: timezone
desc: The timezone to display the current conditions observation time. Optional and will override the timezone of "feature_id".
meaning: The time zone used to display weather observation times.

name: CountryCode
desc: For Courts, the country the court is in. For Statues,? 3 leter country code ISO 3166 alpha2
meaning: The country of a court or statute in a legal citation.

name: State
desc: State or province of the court or statue (if applicable) What standard?
meaning: The state or province of a court or statute in a legal citation.

name: Type
desc: DocType
meaning: The kind of legal document being cited.

name: ArguedBefore
desc: One entry per judge who listened to the case in this court
meaning: The judges who heard the case in this court.

name: CertiorariCourtName
desc: For an appeal, the name of the lower court that sent this up Abbreviation form? Verbose form?
meaning: The lower court that sent an appealed case up.

name: CourtTerm
desc: Usually the name of a month. Not sure really what it means.
meaning: The court term, usually a month name, for the case.

name: DecidedDate
desc: Various dates related to the generation of document most of these are opinion-centric
meaning: The date the case was decided.

name: MemoID
desc: Not sure what this is. But I've seen it.
meaning: An identifier of unclear purpose seen on some court documents.

name: Syllabus
desc: A summary of the document or a syllabus for this document
meaning: A summary of the court document.

name: DisplayName
desc: The name of the court to be displayed to users.
meaning: The court name shown to users.

name: Level
desc: Maybe be redundant with the Name. We can remove this later if we don't find it useful. Court Level
meaning: A number describing how high up the court sits.

name: Name
desc: Court id for matching records; "name" is a historic misnomer.
meaning: The internal court id used for matching records.

name: OriginalName
desc: The name of the court as taken directly from the source document
meaning: The court name exactly as it appeared in the source document.

name: DeliveredBy
desc: if Type == PER_CURIAM, then DeliveredBy is unnecessary since it is delivered by the full court. Who delivered the opinion?
meaning: The judge who delivered the opinion.

name: JoinedBy
desc: Who agrees with the opinion
meaning: The judges who joined the opinion.

name: Type
desc: OpinionType
meaning: The kind of opinion, such as majority or dissent.

name: DocketID
desc: An alpha-numeric (usually, mostly numeric) string used to identify the case by the court
meaning: The case number the court uses to identify the case.

name: Petitioner
desc: Who is bringing the action? (X in X vs. Y)
meaning: The party bringing the legal action.

name: PetitionerCounsel
desc: Who represents the petitioner?
meaning: The lawyers representing the petitioner.

name: Respondent
desc: Who is responding to the action? (Y in X vs. Y)
meaning: The party responding to the legal action.

name: RespondentCounsel
desc: Who represents the respondent?
meaning: The lawyers representing the respondent.

name: Topic
desc: The "in re" or "matter of" field.
meaning: The subject matter line of the case, the in re field.

name: Page
desc: Page number
meaning: The page number of the published opinion.

name: Paragraph
desc: Paragraph number
meaning: The paragraph number of the published opinion.

name: Reporter
desc: The publisher of the opinion. For example, 'U.S.' - United States Reports 'S. Ct.' - Supreme Court Reporter 'L. Ed. 2d' - Lawyers Edition Second Series
meaning: The reporter that published the opinion.

name: Volume
desc: For documents published by a court reporter. Vendor/Media neutral citations will probably not have this.
meaning: The volume number of the reporter that published the opinion.

name: Year
desc: This is the publication year. In many citations, there is one year listed and it is typically the year the opinion was handed down. For example: Roe v. Wade, 410 U.S. 113 (1973) Occasionally, the publication year of the reporter is included. This happens typically when the law reporter volume numbers are numbered within a calendar year. For example, Swiss Bank Corp. v. Air Canada, [1988] 1 F.C. 71. It some (most?) areas, publication date is denoted by [] while opinion date is denoted by ().
meaning: The year the opinion was published.

name: Status
desc: LawStatus
meaning: The current status of a law being cited.

name: Type
desc: LawType
meaning: The kind of law being cited.

name: Depth
desc: A counter that specifies the depth of the level in the parse
meaning: How deep this level sits in the parsed structure of a law.

name: LevelTypeNormalized
desc: "SECTION, TITLE, PART, etc."
meaning: The standardized name of a level in a law, such as section or title.

name: LevelTypeSourceText
desc: "Section, Sect., §, etc"
meaning: The level label exactly as written in the source, such as Sect. or the section sign.

name: LevelTypeString
desc: deprecated
meaning: A retired field that used to hold the level label text.

name: Name
desc: The name of the chapter/section/etc.
meaning: The name of the chapter or section of a law.

name: Type
desc: deprecated
meaning: A retired numeric field for the level type of a law.

name: Value
desc: "3", "42(a)", etc
meaning: The number of a section of a law, such as 3 or 42(a).

name: discretizedAestheticsScore
desc: Aesthetics score discretized into range [0, 100].
meaning: A zero to one hundred score for how attractive an image looks, used by Lens.

name: discretizedFaceVisibilityScore
desc: The visibility of the face of the most iconic person in the image discretized into range [0, 100].
meaning: A zero to one hundred score for how visible the main person's face is in an image.

name: discretizedMaleConfidence
