desc: Male and female confidence scores are discretized into the [0, 100] range.
meaning: A confidence score that the main person in an image is male.

name: discretizedPredictedAge
desc: Age prediction is rounded to the first decimal place and multiplied by 10 (e.g. 12.3 -> 123).
meaning: An estimate of the main person's age in an image, stored times ten.

name: discretizedVisualSaliencyScore
desc: The area ratio of the most iconic person to the whole image discretized into range [0, 100].
meaning: How much of the image the main person takes up, scored zero to one hundred.

name: personBoundingBox
desc: Bounding box of the most iconic person in the image.
meaning: The box outlining the main person in an image.

name: predictedAgeBucket
desc: Bucketed version of the predicted age.
meaning: The age range bucket predicted for the main person in an image.

name: discretizedPersonVisibilityScore
desc: A measure of the visibility of the most iconic person between [0, 100], derived by combining all label predictions by the Person Visibility model according to go/person-visibility-formula. Higher values indicate greater visibility while lower values indicate lesser visibility.
meaning: A combined zero to one hundred score for how visible the main person is.

name: personVisibilityPredictions
desc: Repeated for # of PersonVisibility types.
meaning: The list of per type person visibility predictions for an image.

name: discretizedIconicPersonVisibilityConfidence
desc: Confidence score of the visibility type prediction discretized into range [0, 100].
meaning: Confidence in a specific person visibility prediction, scored zero to one hundred.

name: iconicPersonVisibilityType
desc: Classification of how much of the body of the most iconic person in the image is visible.
meaning: Label for how much of the main person's body is showing, such as head only.

name: detectedPersons
desc: Information of all detected people in the image, sorted by decreasing size of the bounding box. We store a maximum of 10 detected people.
meaning: Boxes and details for every person detected in an image, up to ten.

name: boundingBox
desc: Bounding box of the detected person.
meaning: The box outlining one detected person in an image.

name: styleImageTypePredictions
desc: Repeated for # of StyleImageType types.
meaning: Predictions of which style photo categories an image belongs to.

name: discretizedStyleImageTypeConfidence
desc: Style image type confidence discretized into range [0, 100].
meaning: Confidence that an image is of a given style category, scored zero to one hundred.

name: styleImageType
desc: Predicted style image type.
meaning: The predicted style category of an image, such as outfit or product shot.

name: isTable
desc: Should list be formatted as a table?
meaning: Whether a list snippet should be laid out as a table.

name: totalRows
desc: The number of rows annotated in the doc, of which 'row' is a subset.
meaning: How many rows were found in the page's list, of which the shown rows are a subset.

name: category
desc: The category associated with this chain, currently only used for subchains.
meaning: The business category tied to a chain, used for subchains.

name: prominentEntityId
desc: The Knowledge Graph (KG) entity of the chain, found and used in chain mining.
meaning: The knowledge graph entity representing a business chain.

name: sitechunk
desc: The website sitechunk/domain that is owned by the chain.
meaning: The website or domain owned by a business chain.

name: actionType
desc: The action type of this action metadata.
meaning: The kind of food ordering action described.

name: hasPrimarilyFoodIntent
desc: If true, it indicates that the merchant has a primarily food intent. This field will only be set when enable_food_gcid_strict_check in FoodOrderingRestrictionProto is true, see go/togo-unified:overlapping-for-le. See go/togo-unified-gcid for how this is calculated.
meaning: Whether the merchant is primarily a food business.

name: isOutOfOperationalHours
desc: If set, indicates that the food ordering service is out of operational hours. This could only be populated if the request explicitly asks for ignore_operational_hours in request (universalsearch/rpc/geo/food_ordering_restriction.proto). Design doc: go/fo-persistent-v1.
meaning: Whether the restaurant's ordering service is currently closed.

name: isWhitelistedExternalRestaurant
desc: When true, indicates that this is a whitelisted restaurant from a first party (but non FO) partner, i.e. a merchant from the orderig app, who is Google owned first party food ordering platform. Design doc: go/onboard-mavn-to-fo. Tracking bug: b/150331855
meaning: Whether the restaurant comes from an approved first party ordering partner.

name: nextOpeningTime
desc: Next opening time when the food ordering service will be available. This is only present if the unavailability reason is OUT_OF_OPERATIONAL_HOURS.
meaning: When the food ordering service opens again.

name: onlyOrderAheadServicesAvailable
desc: Indicates whether only order ahead services are available. Order ahead services allow only to place order for future and ASAP order can not be placed via them.
meaning: Whether only scheduled ahead orders can be placed, not immediate ones.

name: serviceInfo
desc: Aggregated service information by service type. Each service type would only have one ServiceInfo. Optional.
meaning: Ordering details grouped by service type such as pickup or delivery.

name: supportedServiceType
desc: Food ordering service type.
meaning: The food ordering service type offered.

name: unavailabilityReason
desc: Reason for unavailability of internal food ordering action. This is only present when FOPA is unavailable for a particular restaurant. When this is set, all other fields in this proto will not be populated. Note(fo-search): If there are log only partners and this particular restaurant is only supported because of log only partners, this field will not be set to NOT_INTEGRATED_WITH_FOPA.
meaning: Why food ordering is unavailable for this restaurant.

name: availablePartnerId
desc: Available partner's id.
meaning: The identifier of an available food ordering partner.

name: logOnly
desc: Indicates whether the partner is log only.
meaning: Whether this ordering partner is only recorded in logs, not offered.

name: availablePartnerInfo
desc: Information about Food Ordering partner, which is used for whitelisting the partner in Food Ordering entry points such as Placesheet.
meaning: Details of the food ordering partners available for this service.

name: maxWaitTimeSec
desc: Maximum max_wait_time in second.
meaning: The longest expected wait time in seconds for an order.

name: minDeliveryFee
desc: Only present for delivery case, service fee is not included.
meaning: The cheapest delivery fee offered.

name: minWaitTimeSec
desc: Minimum min_wait_time in second.
meaning: The shortest expected wait time in seconds for an order.

name: serviceType
desc: Food ordering service type. Please note that only ServiceType.PICKUP and ServiceType.DELIVERY are valid values for this field.
meaning: Whether the service is pickup or delivery.

name: country
desc: The country to crawl the country from, defaults to the default non-specified crawling node (which is interpreted by most web-servers as USA). When specified, the crawling will fetch the document from a node in that country instead.
meaning: The country whose crawling machines fetched the page.

name: deviceType
desc: The device type, which maps into the useragent to be set when initiating the fetch-request, e.g. desktop-googlebot vs. smartphone-googlebot.
meaning: Whether the page was fetched as desktop or smartphone Googlebot.

name: indexGrowthExptType
desc: Specifies whether the document is a duplicated document from the index growth experiment, detailed at go/indexsize_exp, defaults to not in any experiment.
meaning: Marks a page as a duplicate copy created for an index size experiment.

name: language
desc: The language being set by the crawler. Defaults to UNKNOWN_LANGUAGE which indicates to not apply an accept-language header on the FetchRequest. When a language is specified, on crawling this language is converted into an accept-language header (e.g. GERMAN -> "Accept-language: de"). Script variations, e.g. ZH-HANS vs. ZH-HANT, are handled as different enum values (e.g. CHINESE vs. CHINESE_T).
meaning: The language header the crawler sent when fetching the page.

name: languageCode
desc: Language-code used for identifying the locale of the document. 'language' and 'country' above are used for web-based documents, representing the detected language of the document and the country it was crawled from. The language code here, however, rather represents an artifical language_code applied to manually translated webpages (e.g. feeds), for instance for the pidgin-usecase. They are limited to the set of III-codes being supported by the client, yet are beyond the enum in 'language', e.g.
meaning: A language label applied to manually translated pages such as feeds.

name: resolution
desc: Has not been useful since at least 2015 (before this was logged).
meaning: A logged field about link resolution that has been useless since 2015.

name: kcLinkName
desc: Not set for a while.
meaning: A knowledge card link name that has not been filled in for a long time.

name: header
desc: Is this a header or normal paragraph?
meaning: Whether this piece of a structured snippet is a heading or a paragraph.

name: text
desc: The text of the header or paragraph.
meaning: The wording shown in this part of a structured snippet.

name: isAlleyAffix
desc: An affix that indicates an alley. Alleys are unnamed, numbered routes that are always linked to a "parent street". As these parent streets can be named e.g. "7th street" and alleys might be referred to as "7th alley", we need to be able to distinguish those affixes. For more details about alleys see go/vn-alley-geocoding.
meaning: Marks an address word that signals an alley rather than a street.

name: isCommonWord
desc: Common words E.g.: center, park, etc.
meaning: Marks a common place word such as center or park.

name: isDeconstructible
desc: Whether this special word is part of a name without a separator (like e.g. suffix "strasse" in Freigutstrasse).
meaning: Marks a word that can be glued onto a name without a space.

name: isDirectionalModifier
desc: Directional modifier. E.g.: north, south, etc.
meaning: Marks a direction word such as north or south in an address.

name: isDistanceMarker
desc: An affix that indicates distance marker on a route, e.g., 'km'.
meaning: Marks a word that indicates a distance marker on a route, such as km.

name: isForbiddenWord
desc: Whether geo paths are forbidden to contain this word.
meaning: Marks a word that is not allowed to appear in map location paths.

name: isHouseIdIdentifier
desc: A keyword for a house id.
meaning: Marks a word that introduces a house number.

name: isIntersectionConnector
desc: Intersection. E.g.: and, at, corner.
meaning: Marks a word that joins two streets in an intersection, such as and or corner.

name: isLandmarkIdentifier
desc: An affix that indicates a landmark, e.g. "opposite", "near" etc.
meaning: Marks a word that indicates a nearby landmark, such as opposite or near.

name: isLanguageIndicator
desc: Language indicator. E.g.: platz in German, straat in Dutch.
meaning: Marks a word that reveals the language of an address, such as platz in German.

name: isNameSynonym
desc: Whether this is a name synonym and should be allowed to be matched on when searching (that is, added to the retrieval query with the name/ prefix).
meaning: Marks a word that counts as a name synonym for map searching.

name: isNotForLegacyStreetNumberDetection
desc: Terms which are not allowed to be used by the legacy street number detection.
meaning: Marks words the older street number detector may not use.

name: isNotOptionalizable
desc: Terms which are not allowed to be treated as optional.
meaning: Marks words that may not be treated as optional in an address.

name: isNumber
desc: Numbers. E.g.: 1, one, 2, two.
meaning: Marks a number word such as one or two.

name: isNumberSuffix
desc: E.g. suffixes in French: bis, ter.
meaning: Marks a suffix used after a house number, such as bis or ter.

name: isOptional
desc: Is this special word optional?
meaning: Whether this address word can be left out.

name: isOrdinalNumber
desc: E.g.: 1st, first.
meaning: Marks an ordinal number word such as first or 1st.

name: isPenalizedIfMissing
desc: Optional terms that should not geocode by themselves.
meaning: Marks optional words that must not stand alone as a location.

name: isPersonalTitle
desc: Personal titles (e.g. doctor, professor, general, etc.)
meaning: Marks a personal title such as doctor or professor.

name: isStopWord
desc: E.g.: the, in, near, where.
meaning: Marks a filler word such as the, in, or near.

name: isStreetNumberIdentifier
desc: A keyword that denotes a street number, e.g. "number", "unit" etc.
meaning: Marks a word that introduces a street number, such as number or unit.

name: alternate
desc: Alternate versions of this canonical form. This is mainly abbreviations of the canonical form e.g. "St", "NE", etc. This should be present as it is used in the specified language with the correct capitalization, accents, etc. in UTF-8.
meaning: Shorter or alternate spellings of an address word.

name: canonical
desc: Canonical versions: the version which is in oyster. This should be present as it is used in the specified language with the correct capitalization, accents, etc. in UTF-8. The canonical can be a single or a multi-token string. There can be several canonicals, e.g. "center" and "centre" in English.
meaning: The standard spellings of an address word in a given language.

name: country
desc: If empty, apply this rule to any country. Otherwise, a list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (2-letter uppercase) country codes that this description applies to.
meaning: The countries this address word rule applies to.

name: flags
desc: Boolean flags indicating what type of special word this is.
meaning: The set of flags describing what kind of address word this is.

name: language
desc: The III language code of the language that this description applies to. No language means that this applies worldwide. This could be useful for codes like country codes or airport codes or for displayed language neutral icons. A special word with a language code here also applies to the regional variants of that language (e.g. "en" applies to "en-GB" and "en-US" as well).
meaning: The languages this address word rule applies to.

name: visibleTypeId
desc: visible_type_id from VisibleTypeProto for visible types converted to the special words. For original special words this field is empty.
meaning: Identifiers of map feature types that were turned into address words.

name: areaFraction
desc: The area of the region as a fraction of the image. The value is in the range (0, 1).
meaning: How much of the picture a marked region covers, as a fraction.

name: customSource
desc: The custom source should only be a-z[0-9] dashes, underscores, and colons. Special characters should be avoided.
meaning: A naming rule for the custom source label on a detected entity.

name: timestampMs
desc: Offset of the frame from the beginning of the video (in milliseconds).
meaning: How far into the video, in milliseconds, this frame sits.

name: xtagList
desc: All xtags used in the generation of the preview. The same frame generated from the same preview with different xtags will likely have different bytes (such as, for example, resulting from a different aspect ratio).
meaning: The rendering options used when a video preview frame was generated.

name: boundingBox
desc: The bounding box corresponding to the region.
meaning: The box marking off a region inside an image.

name: entityFields
desc: Detected Entities found within this region.
meaning: The entities recognized inside a marked region of an image.

name: labels
desc: The labels associated with the region encoded as a SparseFloatVector to facilitate dot product computation during sorting. The columns are the fingerprints of the labels and the values are the corresponding confidence scores. The vector is L2 normalized.
meaning: Labels with confidence scores for an image region, stored to make sorting fast.

name: primiApparelFeaturesV2
desc: PRIMI Apparel Features v2 embedding and tokens.
meaning: A stored apparel-specific image embedding and tokens for a region of a media item.

name: primiGenericFeaturesV25
desc: PRIMI Generic Features v2.5 embedding and tokens.
meaning: A stored generic image embedding and tokens for a region of a media item.

name: starburstFeaturesV4
desc: Starburst v4 embedding and tokens.
meaning: A stored Starburst v4 visual embedding and tokens for a media region.

name: starburstFeaturesV5
desc: Starburst v5 embedding and tokens.
meaning: A stored Starburst v5 visual embedding and tokens for a media region.

name: columns
desc: Parallel arrays of column / value. Exactly one of those columns vector should be set. Columns must be in monotonically increasing order.
meaning: The column indices of a sparse vector, stored in increasing order.

name: columnsInt64
desc: Columns are fixed integers, used for accelerated parse.
meaning: The same sparse vector column indices stored as fixed integers for faster parsing.

name: domain
desc: The domain this score was generated for.
meaning: The domain name that a video centroid score was computed for.

name: numDocs
desc: Number of pages from the domain used to generate this DomainScore.
meaning: How many pages from that domain were used to compute the video domain score.

name: score
desc: In general, lower scores indicate the video is appearing on more diverse pages.
meaning: A score that is lower when a video appears across more varied pages of a domain.

name: docid
desc: The canonical docid of the frame.
meaning: The internal document identifier of a video frame.

name: regions
desc: Metadata associated with regions within this frame.
meaning: Metadata attached to sub-regions detected inside a video frame.

name: starburstFeaturesV4
desc: Starburst v4 embedding and tokens.
meaning: A stored Starburst v4 visual embedding and tokens for a video frame.

name: starburstTokensV4
desc: Note: due to the migration to Golden7-source Starburst v4 embedding, no starburst_tokens_v4 will be provided in video content corpus (go/video-content-corpus). But this field is kept in case other purposes may still use it in the proto.
meaning: Older Starburst tokens for a frame that are no longer populated after a migration.

name: thumbnailType
desc: Set of available thumbnail types for this frame. Should be valid image_base.ThumbnailType values (enumerated at
meaning: Which thumbnail formats are available for this video frame.

name: name
desc: Names are all stored case-sensitive, and no case-folding is done for comparisons.
meaning: The case-sensitive name of a generic tag attached to a media item.

name: value
desc: The value associated with this Xtag. Values are all stored case-sensitive, and no case-folding is done for comparisons.
meaning: The case-sensitive value of a generic tag attached to a media item.

name: mobileurl
desc: DEPRECATED: Url of the mobile version of the document. This is set during canonicalization if we do not know that the Web url also serves the mobile version.
meaning: A retired field holding the address of the mobile version of a page.

name: transcodedPageScore
desc: DEPRECATED: The transcoded page quality repesented in 7-bits range from 0 to 127.
meaning: A retired 0-127 quality rating for a transcoded mobile page.

name: present
desc: Whether the field (data field or pointer) is defined.
meaning: Whether a given data field or pointer exists in the record.

name: implicitLength
desc: If the layer is not materialized but things point into it, this gives the effective length.
meaning: The effective length of a data layer that is referenced but not stored.

name: present
desc: Whether the layer is present.
meaning: Whether a given data layer exists in the record.

name: index
desc: The index of the node that this pointer points to.
meaning: The position of the node a pointer refers to.

name: limit
desc: The exclusive end index for the span of nodes that this pointer points to -- i.e., one plus the index of the last node in the span. Must be greater than or equal to
meaning: The end position, exclusive, of a range of nodes a pointer covers.

name: start
desc: The inclusive start index for the span of nodes that this pointer points to -- i.e., the index of the first node in the span.
meaning: The start position of a range of nodes a pointer covers.

name: name
desc: Name corresponds to the names in WebChooserScorer::FeatureNames.
meaning: The name of a feature used by the snippet chooser scorer.

name: header
desc: The texts of header and listing items.
meaning: The header text and list item text pulled from a page for a list-style snippet.

name: headerTitleRedundancy
desc: The ratio of header tokens covered by title.
meaning: How much of the snippet header text is already covered by the page title.

name: headerUsedInSnippet
desc: If the header being used in organic snippet.
meaning: Whether the extracted header was actually used in the shown snippet.

name: originalTotalItems
desc: The number of items in the original list.
meaning: How many items the original list on the page contained.

name: radishScore
desc: The score of the radish signal.
meaning: A score for the list-snippet detector applied to this page.

name: dataSourceType
desc: data_source_type corresponds to the ChosenSnippet::SnippetType enum.
meaning: Which source the snippet candidate text was taken from.

name: browserWidth
desc: Browser width.
meaning: The width of the user's browser, recorded with snippet features.

name: candidates
desc: Features for snippets candidates, generated by both old and new scorer. Currently only features for chosen candidate is generated.
meaning: Recorded features for the snippet candidates produced by the snippet scorers.

name: displaySnippet
desc: Snippet features for the final chosen snippet. This field is firstly populated by Muppet, and then overwriten by Superroot if SnippetBrain is triggered.
meaning: Recorded features for the snippet that was finally displayed.

name: documentLanguage
desc: locale of the document.
meaning: The language or locale of the document, logged alongside snippet features.

name: originalQueryTermCoverages
desc: Original query term coverage in titles and / or snippets.
meaning: How much of the original query wording appears in the title and snippet.

name: queryLanguage
desc: locale of the query,
meaning: The language or locale of the query, logged alongside snippet features.

name: snippetDataSourceType
desc: Snippet data source.
meaning: Which source the displayed snippet came from.

name: snippetQueryTermCoverage
desc: Query term coverage in snippets.
meaning: How much of the query wording appears in the snippet text.

name: snippets
desc: Snippet features for Muppet snippet candidates. In production, only the data for chosen snippet will be recorded.
meaning: Recorded features for each snippet candidate considered.

name: titleDataSourceType
desc: Title data source.
meaning: Which source the displayed title came from.

name: titleQueryTermCoverage
desc: Query term coverage in titles.
meaning: How much of the query wording appears in the title.

name: titleSnippetQueryTermCoverage
desc: Query term coverage in titles and snippets.
meaning: How much of the query wording appears in the title and snippet combined.

name: titles
desc: Per-candidate title features for ranklab models, sorted from the best candidate to the worst candidate (i.e., the first element is the actually selected title).
meaning: Recorded features for each title candidate, best first, with the chosen one first.

name: bolded
desc: Is the rendered token bolded (insided )
meaning: Whether this word is shown in bold in the rendered snippet.

name: byteOffsetBegin
desc: Byte offset range in the rendered text that corresponds to this token. [byte_offset_begin, byte_offset_end) inclusive
meaning: Where this word starts in the rendered snippet text.

name: byteOffsetEnd
desc: exclusive
meaning: Where this word ends in the rendered snippet text.

name: section
desc: Section and TokenPos of the token.
meaning: Which part of the page the rendered snippet word came from.

name: value
desc: The NSR value corresponding to this version.
meaning: A site quality (NSR) value stored for one particular version of that measure.

name: versionId
desc: The version id.
meaning: The version number that a stored NSR value belongs to.

name: id
desc: required
meaning: An internal virtual network identifier used by networking code.

name: deletion
desc: This field can be set to true to indicate that the associated part of the schema is being deleted as part of the remodeling.
meaning: A flag marking that part of a schema is being removed during a remodeling.

name: id
desc: The remodeling ID. Each remodeling has a unique ID that is used to associate changes with that remodeling.
meaning: The unique identifier of a schema remodeling change.

name: name
desc: Semantic type name.
meaning: The name of a semantic type in an internal schema.

name: name
desc: Semantic type name.
meaning: The name of a semantic type in an internal schema.

name: info
desc: Annotation for this phrase.
meaning: A generic container for extra information attached to an annotated phrase.

name: phrase
desc: Contains start and end pointers to the token array for this span.
meaning: The start and end token positions of an annotated phrase.

name: child
desc: An arbitrary number of children, ordered from left to right; empty for preterminals. Represented via indices into Document.constituency_node.
meaning: The child positions of a node in a grammatical parse tree.

name: label
desc: The label of the current node.
meaning: The grammatical label of a node in a parse tree.

name: phrase
desc: A phrase that contains information about the span and the (optional) head token. For terminal nodes the head of the phrase holds the word.
meaning: The span of words covered by a node in a parse tree.

name: relation
desc: Relations between entities in the document.
meaning: Extracted relationships between entities mentioned in the document.

name: annotations
desc: Generic annotations.
meaning: A generic container for miscellaneous annotations on the document.

name: contentage
desc: Age of the content of the document. For details, see: quality/historical/shingle/signals/contentage.proto The format has been translated to a canonical timestamp (seconds since epoch).
meaning: How old the content of the page is, stored as a timestamp.

name: bylineDate
desc: Document's byline date, if available: this is the date that will be shown in the snippets in web search results. It is stored as the number of seconds since epoch. See segindexer/compositedoc.proto
meaning: The byline date of the page, stored as a timestamp and shown in search snippets.

name: date
desc: Document anchor date in YYYYMMDDhhmmss format.
meaning: The document's anchor date written as a full year-month-day timestamp.

name: entity
desc: Entities in the document.
meaning: The list of entities that were recognised in the document text.

name: semanticNode
desc: The semantic nodes for the document represent arbitrary types of higher-level abstractions beyond entity mention coreference and binary relations between entities. These may include: n-ary relations, semantic frames or events. The semantic nodes for a document are the nodes in a directed acyclic graph, with an adjacency list representation.
meaning: Higher level semantic structures extracted from the document, stored as a graph.

name: lastSignificantUpdate
desc: Last significant update of the page content, in the same format as the contentage field, and also derived from ContentAge.last_significant_update in quality/historical/shingle/signals/contentage.proto.
meaning: The time of the last meaningful change to the page content.

name: token
desc: Tokenization of the document.
meaning: The document text split into individual words.

name: measure
desc: Measures in the documents. This covers both time expressions as well as physical quantities.
meaning: Quantities and time expressions found in the document text.

name: hyperlink
desc: The hyperlinks in the document. Multiple hyperlinks are sorted in left-to-right order.
meaning: The list of links found in the document, in the order they appear.

name: annotatedPhrase
desc: Annotated phrases in the document that are not semantically well-defined mentions of entities.
meaning: Phrases marked up in the text that are not clean references to a known entity.

name: contentFirstseen
desc: Stores minimum of first time google successfully crawled a document, or indexed the document with contents (i.e, not roboted). It is stored as the number of seconds since epoch. See quality/historical/signals/firstseen/firstseen.proto
meaning: The earliest time Google crawled or indexed the page with content, as a timestamp.

name: contentType
desc: Optional document content_type (from webutil/http/content-type.proto). Used for setting the content_type when converting the SAFT Document to a CompositeDoc. Will be inferred if not given here.
meaning: The content type of the document, used when converting between formats.

name: entityLabel
desc: Entity labels used in this document. This field is used to define labels for the Entity::entity_type_probability field, which contains corresponding probabilities. WARNING: This field is deprecated. go/saft-replace-deprecated-entity-type
meaning: A retired list of entity type labels used with per-type probabilities.

name: httpHeaders
desc: HTTP header for document. If the HTTP headers field is set it should be the complete header including the HTTP status line and the trailing cr/nl. HTTP headers are not required to be valid UTF-8. Per the HTTP/1.1 Syntax (RFC7230) standard, non-ASCII octets should be treated as opaque data.
meaning: The full HTTP response header captured for the document.

name: docid
desc: Identifier for document.
meaning: The internal identifier for the document.

name: language
desc: Document language (default is English). This field's value maps cleanly to the i18n.languages.Language proto enum (i18n::languages::Language in C++).
meaning: The language the document is written in.

name: text
desc: Raw text contents of document. (In docjoin attachments from the SAFT goldmine annotator this field will be empty.)
meaning: The raw text of the document.

name: trace
desc: Whether to enable component tracing during analysis of this document. See
meaning: A debug flag that turns on tracing while the document is analysed.

name: labeledSpans
desc: Generic labeled spans (produced by the span labeling framework, go/saft-span-labeling). The map key identifies spans of the same type. By convention, it should be of the form "team_name/span_type_name".
meaning: Generic labelled text spans produced by a shared span-labelling framework.

name: golden
desc: Flag for indicating that the document is a gold-standard document. This can be used for putting additional weight on human-labeled documents in contrast to automatically labeled annotations.
meaning: A flag marking the document as human-labelled training data.

name: focusEntity
desc: Focus entity. For lexicon articles, like Wikipedia pages, a document is often about a certain entity. This is the local entity id of the focus entity for the document.
meaning: The single entity that the page is mainly about, such as a Wikipedia subject.

name: constituencyRoot
desc: The root node of the constituency tree for each sentence. If non-empty, the list of roots will be aligned with the sentences in the document. Note that some sentences may not have been parsed for various reasons; these sentences will be annotated with placeholder "stub parses". For details, see //nlp/saft/components/constituents/util/stub-parse.h.
meaning: The top parse tree node for each sentence in the document.

name: author
desc: Document author(s).
meaning: The name or names of the people credited as authors of the document.

name: syntacticDate
desc: Document's syntactic date (e.g. date explicitly mentioned in the URL of the document or in the document title). It is stored as the number of seconds since epoch. See quality/timebased/syntacticdate/proto/syntactic-date.proto
meaning: A date taken from the page URL or title, stored as a timestamp.

name: url
desc: Source document URL.
meaning: The address the document was fetched from.

name: privacySensitive
desc: True if this document contains privacy sensitive data. When the document is transferred in RPC calls the RPC should use SSL_PRIVACY_AND_INTEGRITY security level.
meaning: A flag marking that the document holds privacy sensitive data.

name: subsection
desc: Sub-sections for document for dividing a document into volumes, parts, chapters, sections, etc.
meaning: Nested sub-documents used to split a document into chapters or sections.

name: constituencyNode
desc: Constituency parse tree nodes for the sentences in this document.
meaning: Parse tree nodes for the sentences of the document.

name: rpcError
desc: True if some RPC which touched this document had an error.
meaning: A flag marking that a remote call handling this document failed.

name: title
desc: Optional document title.
meaning: The title of the document.

name: name
desc: Topic name or identifier.
meaning: The name of a topic assigned to the document.

name: score
desc: Topic score.
meaning: How strongly the document matches an assigned topic.

name: antecedent
desc: Antecedent for entity. This is used to make coreference chains before the mentions in the document are grouped by entity.
meaning: A pointer used to chain together mentions that refer to the same thing.

name: entityType
desc: Entity type (e.g. PER, ORG, LOC). WARNING: This field is deprecated. go/saft-replace-deprecated-entity-type
meaning: A retired short label for the kind of entity, such as person or place.

name: entityTypeProbability
desc: Probability distribution over entity types. These values correspond to Document.entity_label values: doc.entity[e].entity_type_probability[n] is the probability that the correct label for doc.entity[e] is doc.entity_label[n]. These probabilities sum to 1.0 (with possible rounding error). WARNING: This field is deprecated. go/saft-replace-deprecated-entity-type
meaning: A retired probability spread across the possible entity type labels.

name: gender
desc: Gender for entity.
meaning: The grammatical gender recorded for an entity.

name: info
desc: Application-specific information about this entity.
meaning: A generic container for extra information about an entity.

name: mention
desc: Mentions of the entity in the document.
meaning: The places in the document where this entity is mentioned.

name: name
desc: Representative entity name.
meaning: The main name used for this entity.

name: profile
desc: Profile for entity.
meaning: The knowledge profile attached to this entity.

name: referent
desc: Referent information for discourse context entities that are not mentioned in the document. These can be merged with mentioned entities during analysis if they are deemed to be coreferent. Entities with referents should not have any mentions if they do not corefer with anything. For example, when adding context entities to an input document prior to SAFT analysis, those entities should have a referent and no mentions.
meaning: Information about an entity from surrounding context that is not mentioned in the text.

name: representativeMention
desc: Representative mention, as an index into mention.
meaning: Which of the entity's mentions is treated as the representative one.

name: salience
desc: Score indicating the saliency (centrality) of this entity to the document.
meaning: How central this entity is to what the document is about.

name: type
desc: Entity types of the entity. These can include SAFT types (/saft/location, /saft/art, /saft/other/living_thing, etc), collections types (/collection/tv_personalities, /collection/statistical_regions, etc), and more. This refers to the type of the entity itself: in "She is on TV", "She" refers to a specific actor, with type "/collection/tv_personalities". Cf. Mention.Type, which is the type of the referring mention.
meaning: The categories this entity belongs to, such as person, place or TV personality.

name: annotations
desc: Generic annotations.
meaning: A generic container for extra annotations on an entity profile.

name: attribute
desc: List of attributes for the entity.
meaning: The list of stored facts about an entity, such as height or birth date.

name: canonicalName
desc: Canonical entity name.
meaning: The standard name for an entity.

name: disambiguation
desc: Disambiguation phrase. The combination of entity name and disambiguation phrase should be unique within the corpus.
meaning: A short phrase that tells apart entities sharing the same name.

name: embedding
desc: Entity embeding vector, representing the entity in a dense low-dimensional embedding space.
meaning: A numeric vector representing an entity in a compact knowledge space.

name: frame
desc: Profile frame in binary SLING encoding.
meaning: The entity profile encoded in an internal binary format.

name: gender
desc: Gender of the entity.
meaning: The gender recorded for an entity.

name: id
desc: Unique global id for entity.
meaning: The unique internal identifier for an entity.

name: identifier
desc: External identifiers for entity.
meaning: External identifiers that refer to the same entity in other systems.

name: mid
desc: Freebase MID for entity. This field should be the same as FREEBASE_MID identifier for the entity profile.
meaning: The Freebase knowledge graph identifier for an entity.

name: name
desc: Representative name for entity.
meaning: The usual name used for an entity.

name: nameLanguage
desc: Language for the name and disambiguation.
meaning: The language of the entity's name and disambiguation phrase.

name: nature
desc: Nature of the entity.
meaning: What kind of thing the entity is, in broad terms.

name: type
desc: Entity type.
meaning: The type recorded for an entity.

name: form
desc: see nlp/saft/resolution/name-form.h for values
meaning: Which form an alternate entity name takes, given as an internal code.

name: frame
desc: frame in SLING encoding
meaning: An alternate entity record encoded in an internal binary format.

name: sources
desc: (1 << SRC_DEFAULT)
meaning: A bitmask recording which sources supplied an alternate entity name.

name: boolValue
desc: Boolean attribute value, e.g. for IsDeceased.
meaning: A true or false fact about an entity, such as whether a person has died.

name: floatValue
desc: Double attribute value, e.g. for height/weight.
meaning: A numeric fact about an entity, such as height or weight.

name: intValue
desc: Integer attribute value, e.g. IntId("April").
meaning: A whole number fact about an entity.

name: language
desc: Language, in case the attribute value is a string.
meaning: The language used when an entity fact is written as text.

name: type
desc: String name of the type of attribute, e.g. /birth/date
meaning: The name of the kind of fact being stored, such as birth date.

name: typeId
desc: Any id of the type of the attribute, e.g. IntId(/birth/date)
meaning: A numeric code for the kind of fact being stored.

name: value
desc: String attribute value, e.g. "April 2010" or "3,235,121".
meaning: A text fact about an entity, such as a date or a number written out.

name: valueType
desc: The type of the value.
meaning: What kind of value an entity fact holds.

name: score
desc: Score associated with the keyword. For fine-grained types this is a probability.
meaning: How strongly a keyword is associated with an entity.

name: count
desc: Number of occurrences.
meaning: How many times a relationship between two entities was seen.

name: inverse
desc: Inverse relations can be marked in a bidirectional graph.
meaning: A flag marking a relationship as the reverse direction of another.

name: relationId
desc: Optional integer id for the relation.
meaning: A numeric code for the kind of relationship between two entities.

name: relationIdentifier
desc: Optional external identifier for the relation.
meaning: An outside identifier for the kind of relationship between two entities.

name: score
desc: Score for related entity, i.e. p(e->r | e).
meaning: How likely a related entity is given the starting entity.

name: targetId
desc: Profile id of related entity.
meaning: The identifier of the entity on the other end of a relationship.

name: targetIdentifier
desc: Optional external identifier for the target entity.
meaning: An outside identifier for the entity on the other end of a relationship.

name: targetName
desc: Name of related entity.
meaning: The name of the entity on the other end of a relationship.

name: type
desc: Type of relation.
meaning: What kind of relationship links two entities.

name: basedOnMention
desc: This field can be used to specify if the entity type has been annotated or predicted from a specific mention of the entity. However, the entity type does still apply to the entity as a whole, and not just a specific mention.
meaning: Which single mention an entity type was inferred from.

name: domain
desc: A domain name for the set that this particular type belongs to.
meaning: The grouping that an entity type name belongs to.

name: info
desc: Application-specific information about this entity type.
meaning: A generic container for extra information about an entity type.

name: name
desc: The type name, like "/saft/person". See README.entity-types for the inventory of SAFT type tags.
meaning: The name of the category an entity belongs to, such as person or place.

name: score
desc: A score for this type.
meaning: How confident the system is that an entity belongs to this category.

name: anchorText
desc: Clean anchor text (no HTML markup).
meaning: The plain visible text of a link, with markup stripped out.

name: byteEnd
desc: note: inclusive
meaning: Where the link text ends in the document bytes.

name: byteStart
desc: begin/end options are for goldmine AnnotationsFinder to locate the offsets of saft tokens. Start is inclusive by default and end is marked. The indices of the first and last byte covered by the hyperlink.
meaning: Where the link text starts in the document bytes.

name: phrase
desc: The indices of the first and last token covered by the hyperlink.
meaning: The range of words covered by a link.

name: url
desc: (Absolute) URL that the links to.
meaning: The full address that a link points to.

name: domain
desc: Domain for the identifier.
meaning: Which outside system an identifier comes from.

name: id
desc: Identifier within domain.
meaning: The identifier value within its outside system.

name: byteEnd
desc: note: inclusive
meaning: Where a labelled stretch of text ends in the document bytes.

name: byteStart
desc: The indices of the first and last byte covered by the span.
meaning: Where a labelled stretch of text starts in the document bytes.

name: label
desc: The label associated with the span.
meaning: The label attached to a stretch of text.

name: labelScores
desc: Optionally stores alternative labels with associated scores for the span.
meaning: Alternative labels for a stretch of text with their scores.

name: score
desc: A score associated with the span.
meaning: A score attached to a labelled stretch of text.

name: tokenEnd
desc: note: inclusive
meaning: Where a labelled stretch of text ends, counted in words.

name: tokenStart
desc: The indices of the first and last token covered by the span.
meaning: Where a labelled stretch of text starts, counted in words.

name: canonical
desc: Canonical value for measurement.
meaning: The standardised numeric value of a quantity found in the text.

name: granularity
desc: Granularity for measurement.
meaning: How precise a quantity found in the text is.

name: info
desc: Application-specific information about this measure.
meaning: A generic container for extra information about a quantity in the text.

name: phrase
desc: Phrase containing the measure.
meaning: The stretch of text that states a quantity.

name: value
desc: Measurement value and unit.
meaning: The number and unit of a quantity found in the text.

name: confidence
desc: Estimate of the confidence that this mention is in the correct cluster. Zero means this mention is probably in the wrong cluster, 1 means this mention is probably in the correct cluster. See nlp/saft/components/coreference/coreference-confidence.h for details about what "correct cluster" might mean.
meaning: How sure the system is that a mention was grouped with the right entity.

name: info
desc: Application-specific information about this mention.
meaning: A generic container for extra information about a mention.

name: phrase
desc: Phrase for the mention.
meaning: The stretch of text making up a mention.

name: resolution
desc: Mention-level resolution. This is used for encoding the meaning of the mention rather than the entity. For example, definite references and appositions are resolved to the mid for the concept rather than the entity.
meaning: What a mention itself refers to, which can differ from the entity it belongs to.

name: profile
desc: Profile for mention information.
meaning: The knowledge profile attached to a resolved mention.

name: attrValue
desc: A list of morphology attribute-value pairs.
meaning: Grammatical properties of a word stored as attribute and value pairs.

name: head
desc: The head token in the phrase is the id of the top-most token within the phrase. It either has an arc from outside the phrase going to it, or it is a root token of the sentence. A value of -1 indicates that the head has not yet been computed for the phrase (not the same semantics as the head of a token!). Note that even when it is uniquely defined, there is no guarantee that the head is set for entities and measurements within a document: you may need to explicitly compute it.
meaning: Which word is the grammatical head of a phrase, or -1 if not worked out.

name: start
desc: First and last token in the phrase. The phrase goes from start to end (inclusive).
meaning: The first and last word positions of a phrase.

name: distance
desc: Distance of this referent from the markables in the Document. Smaller values imply that the referent is more accessible to be an antecedent for a markable in the Document. The expectation is that this field would increase with every new Document in which this referent is not mentioned.
meaning: How far back in the conversation a referred-to thing was last mentioned.

name: info
desc: Application-specific information about this referent.
meaning: A generic container for extra information about a referred-to thing.

name: phrase
desc: Entity name phrase. The phrase indices are relative to the token array above. The phrase should normally cover all the tokens in the name and the head must be set to be the head token of the name.
meaning: The stretch of text holding the name of a referred-to thing.

name: prominence
desc: Prominence score for referent. This is roughly equivalent to the number of previous mentions of the referent.
meaning: Roughly how often a referred-to thing has been mentioned before.

name: token
desc: Tokenized representation for the canonical name of the referent entity.
meaning: The name of a referred-to thing split into individual words.

name: identifier
desc: External identifier for relation.
meaning: An outside identifier for an extracted relationship.

name: info
desc: Application-specific information about this relation.
meaning: A generic container for extra information about an extracted relationship.

name: mention
desc: Mentions of the relation in the document.
meaning: The places in the text where a relationship is stated.

name: score
desc: Relation score.
meaning: How confident the system is in an extracted relationship.

name: source
desc: Source and target entity indices. These are indices into the entity array in the document. If this is an attribute relation the target is the index of a measure in the document.
meaning: Which entities sit at each end of an extracted relationship.

name: type
desc: Relation type.
meaning: What kind of relationship was extracted.

name: typeId
desc: Relation type id.
meaning: A numeric code for the kind of extracted relationship.

name: info
desc: Application-specific information about this relation mention.
meaning: A generic container for extra information about a stated relationship.

name: phrase
desc: Phrase in the document that indicates the relation mention.
meaning: The stretch of text that states a relationship.

name: source
desc: Source and target mention indices. These are indices into the mention arrays for their respective entities. The target is not used for attributes.
meaning: Which mentions sit at each end of a stated relationship.

name: sourceInfo
desc: The info of the source models or systems of the relation mention.
meaning: Which models or systems produced a stated relationship.

name: arc
desc: The arcs from this node. For example, if this node is the root of a subgraph representing a predicate-argument structure, this node will typically refer to the predicate, and there will typically be one arc per argument.
meaning: The outgoing links from a semantic node, typically one per argument.

name: confidence
desc: Confidence score for the annotation.
meaning: How confident the system is in a semantic annotation.

name: description
desc: Human-readable description of the information in the subgraph represented by this node. This field is only meant for display purposes.
meaning: A human-readable description of a semantic node, for display only.

name: entity
desc: The entity and mention fields specify a unique entity mention referred to by this semantic node.
meaning: Which entity mention a semantic node points at.

name: implicit
desc: Indicates whether the semantic node is not explicit (grounded) in the text (e.g. pro-drop for a text author or an implicit predicate node for interpreting a compound noun), rather than any explicit phrase or text inside the document.
meaning: A flag marking a semantic node that has no matching words in the text.

name: info
desc: Application-specific information about this node.
meaning: A generic container for extra information about a semantic node.

name: kind
desc: Encodes the kind of this node and, possibly, the entire subgraph rooted at this node. For example, if this node represents a predicate-argument structure in PropBank, then this node's kind will be PROPBANK, its phrase field will be set to correspond to the span of tokens corresponding to the predicate (such as a verb) and it will have one arc per argument. If the kind is MONOTONIC this node corresponds to a semantic graph node, and arcs correspond to semantic graph edges outgoing from the node.
meaning: Which annotation scheme a semantic node and its subtree follow.

name: measure
desc: The index of the measure referred to by this semantic node.
meaning: Which quantity in the text a semantic node points at.

name: phrase
desc: Phrase (span of text) for this node. This field does not need to be set, but if it is, this node has a textual "payload" corresponding to the specified token span. For example, if this node is the root of a subgraph corresponding to a predicate-argument structure, then the phrase field will be set to be the span of tokens corresponding to the predicate (e.g., a verb).
meaning: The stretch of text a semantic node is anchored to.

name: type
desc: Arbitrary type string for this semantic node, or for the subgraph rooted at this node. This type string might come from an external resource, type system or ontology that contains a predefined set of types.
meaning: A free-form type name for a semantic node, often from an outside ontology.

name: value
desc: Arbitrary value string for this semantic node.
meaning: A free-form value stored on a semantic node.

name: description
desc: Human-readable description of this arc's type (for display purposes).
meaning: Human-readable text describing what this semantic link type means, for display.

name: implicit
desc: Indicates the arc is for an implicit semantic relation between nodes, for example one that does not correspond to a grammatical relation in the text.
meaning: Flags that a semantic link is implied rather than shown by the sentence's grammar.

name: info
desc: Application-specific information about this arc.
meaning: Extra application-specific data attached to this semantic link.

name: semanticNode
desc: Index of the semantic node pointed to by this arc.
meaning: Index pointing to the semantic node this link connects to.

name: type
desc: Arc type (akin to an edge label, or semantic operator).
meaning: The label naming what kind of semantic relation this link represents.

name: breakSkippedText
desc: Whether the break skipped over non-tag text (excluding script/style).
meaning: Whether a sentence break jumped over some non-tag text on the page.

name: category
desc: Coarse-grained word category for token. See README.categories for category inventory.
meaning: Broad word category assigned to this token.

name: head
desc: Head of this token in the dependency tree: the id of the token which has an arc going to this one. If it is the root token of a sentence, then it is set to -1.
meaning: Id of the token this one attaches to in the sentence's grammar tree.

name: info
desc: Annotation for this token.
meaning: Extra annotation data attached to this token.

name: label
desc: Label for dependency relation between this token and its head. See README.labels for label inventory.
meaning: Name of the grammatical relation between this token and its parent token.

name: lemma
desc: Word lemma. This is only filled if the lemma is different from the word form.
meaning: The dictionary base form of the word when it differs from the written form.

name: morph
desc: Morphology information.
meaning: Word form details such as number, gender or tense for this token.

name: scriptCode
desc: A string representation (typically four letters, sometimes longer) of the token's Unicode script code, based on BCP 47/CLDR, capitalized according to ISO 15924. See i18n/identifiers/scriptcode.h for details.
meaning: Which writing script the token's characters belong to.

name: start
desc: [start, end] describe the inclusive byte range of the UTF-8 encoded token in document.text. End gives the index of the last byte, which may be a UTF-8 continuation byte, and the length in bytes is end - start + 1. begin/end options are for goldmine AnnotationsFinder to locate the offsets of saft tokens. Start is inclusive by default and end is marked.
meaning: Byte position where this token begins in the document text.

name: tag
desc: Part-of-speech tag for token. See README.tags for tag inventory.
meaning: Part-of-speech tag for this token.

name: tagConfidence
desc: Confidence score for the tag prediction -- should be interpreted as a probability estimate that the tag is correct.
meaning: How sure the tagger is that the part-of-speech tag is correct.

name: word
desc: Token word form. This may not be identical to the original. For example, in goldmine annotation we do UTF-8 normalization and punctuation normalization. The punctuation normalization includes inferring the directionality of straight doublequotes -- that is, we map " to open quote (``) or close quote (''), and sometimes we get it wrong. SAFT processing in other contexts (such as queries in qrewrite) involves different normalizations.
meaning: The cleaned-up text of the token as the parser sees it.

name: analyzedText
desc: All the text in this article, separated into Sections and Paragraphs. See nlp_sciencelit.ScaleSetExtensions for the extensions to ScaleSet used.
meaning: Full text of a science article split into sections and paragraphs.

name: citation
desc: All references from this article (Bibliography).
meaning: The list of references in the article's bibliography.

name: earliestPubDate
desc: The result of selecting the earliest date from various metadata (PMC, PubMed Metadata, scholar citations).
meaning: The earliest publication date found across the article's metadata sources.

name: parsedFrom
desc: Path of the source document from which this was parsed.
meaning: File path of the source document this article record was parsed from.

name: pubDate
desc: All dates from the PMC article metadata Year/Mon/Day.
meaning: All publication dates listed in the article's metadata.

name: referencedBlock
desc: All figure captions within this article.
meaning: The figure captions found in the article.

name: scholarCitation
desc: Citation for this article.
meaning: Scholar's citation record for this article.

name: scholarDocument
desc: DocJoins with full text article.
meaning: The stored full-text document records for this article.

name: scholarSignal
desc: May also add the Scholar index signal information:
meaning: Scholar index signal data attached to the article.

name: source
desc: Source of this article data (e.g., PubMed, scholar index, other source.).
meaning: Which corpus the article data came from, such as PubMed or the Scholar index.

name: wordCount
desc: Number of words in the entire article and everywhere outside of abstract sections.
meaning: Number of words in the article outside the abstract sections.

name: abstract
desc: Abstract of article from metadata.
meaning: The article's abstract text taken from metadata.

name: author
desc: Author of article.
meaning: The authors listed for the article.

name: dataset
desc: Datasets referenced from this article.
meaning: Datasets the article refers to.

name: dateStr
desc: Most recent date YYYY-MM-DD.
meaning: The most recent date on the article record.

name: deleted
desc: Citation for flagged for deletion by source.
meaning: Marks that the source flagged this citation record for deletion.

name: heading
desc: Mesh Terms.
meaning: Medical subject heading terms assigned to the article.

name: journal
desc: Title of journal. For books: Journal = Publisher Volume = Collection
meaning: Name of the journal, or the publisher for books.

name: lastRevisedDateStr
desc: Last entry revision date YYYY-MM-DD.
meaning: Date the article record was last revised.

name: parsedFrom
desc: Source Pubmed/Medline XML file.
meaning: The source XML file the article metadata was parsed from.

name: pmid
desc: PMID of article (for non-pubmed data, this is the docid).
meaning: PubMed id of the article, or the document id for other sources.

name: scamRestrictTokens
desc: Optional ScaM restrict tokens to be added to all GFVs generated from this article's data.
meaning: Restriction tokens attached to vectors built from this article.

name: title
desc: Title of article.
meaning: Title of the article.

name: url
desc: URL(s) for the document. If possible, order by decreasing desirability.
meaning: URLs for the document, listed most preferred first.

name: reference
desc: Reference used in text (e.g., PMC rid).
meaning: The in-text key used to point at this citation.

name: scholarCitation
desc: Scholar citation information from scholar index.
meaning: Citation record pulled from the Scholar index for this reference.

name: title
desc: Optional information about the publication.
meaning: Title of the cited publication when it is known.

name: pubType
desc: "ppub" for a print ISSN and "epub" for an electronic ISSN.
meaning: Whether the date belongs to the print or the electronic version.

name: name
desc: Display name for the publication type, e.g. "Journal Article"
meaning: Display name of the publication type, such as journal article.

name: ui
desc: MeSH unique identifiers for publication types, e.g. "D016428"
meaning: MeSH identifier code for the publication type.

name: caption
desc: Caption tokens - all text in the caption other than the block.
meaning: Caption text for a figure or table, without the block itself.

name: reference
desc: Reference used from the text to point to this figure.
meaning: The key the article text uses to point at this figure.

name: title
desc: Title tokens - these come from a block within a caption.
meaning: Title text taken from inside a figure caption.

name: type
desc: Type of figure (table, figure, etc.).
meaning: Whether the referenced block is a table, a figure or something else.

name: scamQueryEncoding
desc: The query encoding sent to scam for retrieval.
meaning: The encoded query vector sent to the retrieval service, kept for debugging.

name: articleData
desc: Only set if RequestOptions.debug_return_article_data is true.
meaning: Full article data returned only when a debug option is switched on.

name: isGold
desc: Not set by server; only used by evals.
meaning: Marks a result as a known-correct example used by evaluations.

name: rerankingScore
desc: See SearchResultInternal.reranking_score.
meaning: Debug copy of the score used to reorder science-literature results.

name: reverseRerankingOrder
desc: See SearchResultInternal.reverse_reranking_order.
meaning: Debug copy of a result's place in the reversed reranking order.

name: sectionIrScore
desc: See SearchResultInternal.section_ir_score.
meaning: Debug copy of per-section retrieval scores for a result.

name: goldHighlightSentenceIndices
desc: Which highlights have sentence overlap with gold snippets. Not ordered. Might only be set for the first gold highlight.
meaning: Which highlighted sentences overlap the reference snippets during evaluation.

name: highlightIdxToOverlap
desc: Map of highlight index to best overlap with any gold snippet [0,1].
meaning: How much each highlight overlaps the closest reference snippet.

name: highlightIdxToSentenceOverlap
desc: Map of highlight index to best overlap with any gold sentence [0,1].
meaning: How much each highlight overlaps the closest reference sentence.

name: isGold
desc: Not set by server; only used by certain evals. Might only be set for the first gold snippet.
meaning: Marks a snippet as a reference example used only in evaluations.

name: offsetWithinSection
desc: Byte index of text within the full section text (or within title).
meaning: Byte position of the snippet text inside its section or the title.

name: sectionIndex
desc: Section within the document. -1 if title.
meaning: Which section the snippet came from, with -1 meaning the title.

name: sectionIrScore
desc: IR score of the section the snippet is coming from.
meaning: Retrieval score of the section that produced the snippet, shown for debugging.

name: snippetBleuScore
desc: BLEU score for the entire snippet.
meaning: Text-similarity score of a snippet against a reference, used in evaluation.

name: additionalSpans
desc: Additional spans after the first. Empty in all additional_spans.
meaning: Extra text spans beyond the first one in an evaluation annotation.

name: startByte
desc: Byte position within the utterance. Safe to use across different components of the NLU stack as long as said components have access to the same query.
meaning: Byte position of the annotation inside the spoken or typed request.

name: startToken
desc: Token position. This is cleared when normalizing examples for storage because tokenization changes over time. DO NOT use these two fields across components that use different tokenizations.
meaning: Token position of the annotation, cleared when examples are stored.

name: appInfo
desc: The app_info is to store specific information about installed/uninstalled apps annotated by app annotator servlet. It contains app name, package name, confidence, and source.
meaning: Details about apps installed on a device that a request referred to.

name: startDate
desc: NOTE: None of these are co-indexed. If the query is 'morning', there could be multiple start_time's, start_date's, end_date's, and end_time's, and they do not correspond to one another in any structured way.
meaning: Start dates pulled out of a request, not paired with the other time fields.

name: allowPersonal
desc: allow_personal determines if personal datetimes are allowed to be used in the resolution of the personal datetime. If allow_personal is false and a personal date exists, the entire parse will be thrown out.
meaning: Whether personal dates may be used when working out the time meant.

name: deleted11
desc: Deprecated fields. Do NOT use.
meaning: A retired field kept only as a placeholder.

name: holiday
desc: season, quarters and holidays will be soon handled as fetched relative datetimes and will be removed from the AbsoluteDateTime message.
meaning: The holiday named in a time expression.

name: hour
desc: Time is 24-hour military time.
meaning: Hour of the parsed time, on a 24-hour clock.

name: hourState
desc: Note: This is marked as deprecated as we are moving into explicit parses using the
meaning: Deprecated marker of whether the stated hour was ambiguous.

name: isBc
desc: |is_bc| is true if and only the date is Before Christ/Common Era. If |is_bc| is true, only year is meaningful in this proto, as Gregorian calendar is only meaningful for A.D. date/times.
meaning: Whether the parsed date falls before the common era.

name: meridiem
desc: For expressions such as "am", "pm". Note: the name "meridiem" has been taken by a field in message ResolutionProperties. Examples: * "9 am": point { hour: 9 meridiem: AM hour_state: UNAMBIGUOUS }
meaning: Whether the time was said as am or pm.

name: modifier
desc: For expressions such as "around 2 pm".
meaning: An approximation word attached to a time, such as around.

name: nonGregorianDate
desc: If present then: 1) the incoming non-Gregorian datetime will be converted to Gregorian. 2) exported DateTimeProperty fields will contain the converted Gregorian datetime. 3) DateTimeProperty.source_calendar will be set to the calendar-system that was used to specify the non-Gregorian date.
meaning: A date given in another calendar system, converted to the Gregorian one.

name: rangeModifier
desc: Modifier that return the appropriate subrange. For more information, see the description of RangeOfDateTimeModifier. Example:
meaning: Which part of a time range the expression points at.

name: timezone
desc: A string representation of the timezone information, see i18n/identifiers/timezones.{h,cc}.
meaning: The timezone attached to the parsed time.

name: weekday
desc: The |weekday| field is populated to indicate that a day-of-the-week is explicitly mentioned in an absolute date utterance, such as [Tuesday, July 6th, 2021]. Note that when a day-of-the-week is included in other, non-absolute-date expressions, such as [on Tuesday], then this this field is not populated (and in fact an AbsoluteDateTime is not used at all.) Note: This field is populated only when the original expression contains a day-of-the-week. It is not populated by the grounding library to in
meaning: The weekday when it was said outright as part of a full date.

name: year
desc: Date.
meaning: Year of the parsed date.

name: compositionElement
desc: For temporal expressions that consist of components with different types, the elements in the composition are nested according to the order they should be grounded/resolved. For example, "tomorrow at 8am" has a relative component [tomorrow] and an absolute datetime component [8am] so the annotation will be represented in the following way, indicating that the relative datetime for tomorrow should be grounded first, and then resolve the actual 8am point for that given date: point { hour
meaning: The nested parts of a combined time phrase, ordered for resolving.

name: deleted7
desc: Deprecated fields. Do NOT use.
meaning: A retired field kept only as a placeholder.

name: evalData
desc: This field of the DateTime message should not in general be used by outside clients of the grammar. It is intended to be used internally in Aqua for evaluation purposes. The rationale is that token counts depend on the particular tokenization used in Aqua which may be different from the one used by the client and may change from time to time. Outside clients should not create a dependency on the current tokenization used in Aqua.
meaning: Internal span data used only for grammar evaluation.

name: range
desc: Note that there is a difference between this scenario and an ambiguous date/time expression. The latter is resolved to multiple proto messages, not multiple values within one proto message. To be concrete, consider "Monday" in "Monday football". It is ambiguous and can be reasonably resolved to "Monday last week," "Monday this week" and "Monday next week." The 3 values are represented as 3 separate DateTime messages, not 3 values within one DateT
meaning: Time ranges expressed inside a single parsed date-time.

name: span
desc: See comments of Span.
meaning: The stretch of text this date-time was read from.

name: metadata
desc: Note: this may be changed to a repeated field in the future.
meaning: A tag recording how the date was phrased.

name: personalReferenceMetadata
desc: Metadata about the personal reference if the date was generated from a personal reference.
meaning: Details when the date came from a personal reference such as a saved event.

name: relative
desc: Expresses the relative DateTime query that gave rise to these grounded semantics.
meaning: The relative time phrase that produced this resolved date.

name: sourceTypeList
desc: If the annotation was created by using personal data, we record the provenance for that data here.
meaning: Record of which personal data sources fed this date annotation.

name: timezoneIsExplicit
desc: True iff the timezone value in AbsoluteDateTime is explicit in the annotated text or not. In the following examples the timezone is explicit: Query Timezone -------------------------- -------- 10pst Pacific Standard Time 10 utc UTC 10 sydney time Australia Eastern Time
meaning: Whether the timezone was actually stated in the text.

name: evalData
desc: This field of the Duration message should not in general be used by outside clients of the grammar. It is intended to be used internally in Aqua for evaluation purposes. The rationale is that token counts depend on the particular tokenization used in Aqua which may be different from the one used by the client and may change from time to time. Outside clients should not create a dependency on the current tokenization used in Aqua.
meaning: Internal span data for duration parsing, used only in evaluation.

name: modifier
desc: For expressions such as "about 2 hrs".
meaning: An approximation word attached to a length of time, such as about.

name: span
desc: See comments of Span.
meaning: The stretch of text this duration was read from.

name: count
desc: How many to fetch (e.g. [next weekend] vs. [next two weeks])
meaning: How many units the relative time phrase asks for.

name: metadata
desc: Can be used to tag relative datetime expressions with metadata information in the grammar.
meaning: A free tag the grammar attaches to a relative time phrase.

name: ordinal
desc: Encodes expressions like next (+1), last (-1), after next (+2), this (0).
meaning: Which instance is meant, such as next, last, or the one after next.

name: range
desc: The restriction range on which fetching is operated, e.g., "April" in "first Tuesday in/of April." If this field is missing, the operation is done relative to the base_type (or if not given, to the query's reference datetime). When the fetching operation is performed relative to a reference time point, positive ordinal values represent upcoming instances from the reference point, negative ordinal values represent previous instances from the reference point. Similarly, ordinal
meaning: The window the lookup happens inside, such as in April.

name: rangeModifier
desc: Modifier that return the appropriate subrange. For more information, see the description of RangeOfDateTimeModifier. Example:
meaning: Which smaller part of the expression's range is meant.

name: relativeRange
desc: If the underlying range comes from a relative datetime expression, encode the expression here instead.
meaning: The relative phrase that supplies the lookup window.

name: target
desc: The target to be fetched. This could be a named day-of-week or month (e.g., "Monday", "April"), or a date/time unit (e.g., "day", "week", "month").
meaning: The day, month or time unit being looked up.

name: nonFixed
desc: There are 3 types of holidays supported by the datetime subgrammar: 1) NonFixedHolidayEnum: e.g., "easter", "chinese new year". 2) FetchedRelativeDateTime: e.g., "Thanksgiving" => [4th Thursday of November] 3) HolidayByMonthDay: e.g., "xmas" => [December 25] Each holiday of the first type is resolved by a C++ function; the 2nd and 3rd type of holidays are mapped to AbsoluteDateTime and FetchedRelativeDateTime, respectively, in grammar and are not needed to
meaning: Which movable holiday the phrase names, such as Easter.

name: day
desc: The day is the offset within the month, same as in Gregorian calendars.
meaning: Day within the month for a date in a non-Gregorian calendar.

name: year
desc: The year is relative to the calendar (e.g. 5777 for Hebrew calendar).
meaning: Year as counted by a non-Gregorian calendar.

name: modifier
desc: For internal use - DateTime subgrammar users should look at Duration.modifier. = MORE in [3 more days].
meaning: Internal marker for wording like more in three more days.

name: number
desc: = 3 in "3 milliseconds".
meaning: The numeric amount in a time quantity.

name: numberSpan
desc: This field keeps the span info of the number element in a quantity expression, which is useful for downstream components to obtain the number annotations inside a quantity when necessary.
meaning: Where the number sits in the original text of a quantity phrase.

name: symbolicQuantity
desc: Quantities are typically converted into milliseconds, regardless of the units the user used. Sometimes this loses crucial information, e.g., "5 days" vs "5 nights". When quantities are converted to milliseconds, 'symbolic_quantity' will contain the sequence of units that the user actually supplied. This can be more than one element in cases like "one minute and 30 seconds". In cases where 'symbolic_quantity' has more than one element, THERE IS NO GUARANTEED ORDER be
meaning: The units the person actually said before conversion to milliseconds.

name: unit
desc: = MILLISECOND in "3 milliseconds".
meaning: The unit of the time quantity, such as milliseconds.

name: begin
desc: Deprecated fields. Do NOT use.
meaning: A retired field that should no longer be used.

name: duration
desc: if |duration| is set, one field from start or finish must be populated, but not both. |exclusive| value is still relevant to decide if the endpoints of the range are included in the range (value defined in the start/finish fields as well as the datetime value resulting of offseting the duration over the given range endpoint).
meaning: Length of a time range when only one endpoint is given.

name: rangeModifier
desc: Modifier that return the appropriate subrange. For more information, see the description of RangeOfDateTimeModifier. Example:
meaning: Which smaller part of the range is meant.

name: start
desc: |start| and |finish| are inclusive unless exclusive field is true. the values in start and finish can be an absolute point, a relative or another range. Recurrences and repeated values are not expected/allowed.
meaning: The starting point of a parsed time range.

name: symbolicValue
desc: The field is set if the range is the result of resolving/grounding a relative datetime expression referring to a part of the day. E.g. "morning", "afternoon", "evening", "night", "tonight", etc.
meaning: Names the part of day a range came from, such as morning or evening.

name: countRestriction
desc: How many times it repeats.
meaning: How many times a repeating event repeats.

name: exception
desc: An arbitrary exception to the recurrence. This can be an absolute point, a relative, a range or a recurrent expression. Examples:
meaning: Times left out of a repeating expression.

name: frequency
desc: |frequency| is used to represent the frequency of the recurrence over a given recurrent period. E.g. "twice a week", "once a month". An unknown frequency is represented with 0, as in just "repeating".
meaning: How often the event happens per period, such as twice a week.

name: period
desc: |period| and |unit| specify how often |start_point| or |start_range| repeats. |period| should not be 0.
meaning: How many units apart the repetitions are.

name: restriction
desc: A recurrent expression can be restricted by either a datetime |restriction| or |count_restriction| below. The restriction datetime can be expressed as an explicit range a relative datetime expression, a datetime point or a recurrent datetime. E.g. "every monday [next month]", "every second tuesday [this year]", etc. If |period| is > 0 and |restriction| is not set, repeat indefinitely. Note that this can support recurrent expressions as |restriction| as well. For example in th
meaning: The time window that limits a repeating expression.

name: start
desc: |start| is used to represent the starting points, ranges or relative datetims in a recurrent expression, for example: "every morning", (range) "everyday at 5 pm", (point) "every second monday" (relative) |start| should never contain a recurrent element.
meaning: The starting points or ranges of a repeating time expression.

name: startPoint
desc: DO NOT USE: deprecated fields soon to be removed.
meaning: A retired field due to be removed.

name: target
desc: The target to be fetched. This could be a named day-of-week or month (e.g., "Monday", "April"), or a date/time unit (e.g., "day", "week", "month").
meaning: The day, month or unit the repetition targets.

name: timeInterval
desc: |time_interval| is a time amount or duration, used to described the time interval between the instances of the recurrence. (e.g. "every 3 hours", "every 35 minutes", "every 2 months and 15 days", etc)
meaning: The gap between repetitions, such as every three hours.

name: modifier
desc: When a relative datetime which resolves into a range is being used as the endpoint of a range (begin_relative/end_relative), its begin/end will be taken accordingly unless this modifier indicates the opposite: begin_relative with relative range and modifier == AFTER means that its end will be taken as the beginning of the resulting range. Similarly, end_relative with a relative range and modifier == BEFORE means that its begin will be taken as the end of the resulting range. E.g. "after nex
meaning: Says whether the start or the end of a relative range is used as an endpoint.

name: meridiem
desc: Simple enum container for exporting meridiem mentions. Note: this is marked as deprecated as we are moving to properly parse expressions with explicit meridiem information.
meaning: Deprecated holder for am or pm mentions.

name: metadata
desc: Encodes whether the datetime was phrased in a specific way, see enum above.
meaning: Records that the date was phrased in a particular way.

name: relative
desc: Expresses the relative DateTime query that gave rise to these grounded semantics.
meaning: The relative time phrase behind the resolved meaning.

name: base
