desc: The base could be an absolute datetime point for example: "March 1", a relative datetime point, for example: "2 days before March 1" or a symbolic base type, for example: CURRENT_DATETIME. This could also be used to combine EXPLICIT_PRONOUN with the actual value of that reference being setup as a datetime point in base or relative_base
meaning: The reference point a shifted time expression is measured from.

name: metadata
desc: Can be used to tag relative datetime expressions with metadata information in the grammar.
meaning: A free tag the grammar attaches to a shifted time phrase.

name: shiftPast
desc: If true, shifting to the past; if false, shifting to the future.
meaning: Whether the shift goes backward or forward in time.

name: startByte
desc: 0-based start byte offset of the span.
meaning: Byte offset where the matched piece of text starts.

name: text
desc: The text of the span: a substring of ParserInput's canonical_input.
meaning: The exact text the parser matched.

name: unit
desc: Unnamed target: "week", "month" etc. E.g., "1st week of April".
meaning: An unnamed time unit target such as week or month.

name: weekday
desc: Named target: only one of the following is expected.
meaning: A named weekday that the lookup targets.

name: entitySources
desc: Indicates backends from which parts of an entity were retrieved.
meaning: Which backend systems supplied parts of the entity.

name: textCompletenessProbability
desc: Completeness probability as calculated by the parser's completeness layer.
meaning: How likely the parser thinks the phrase is a complete thought.

name: type
desc: Applied amenity constraints. Nothing should be inferred about the ordering of the values in this field.
meaning: Which amenity filters the request asked for.

name: hotel
desc: Also youth hostels, guest houses, etc.
meaning: Marks the phrase as lodging, including hostels and guest houses.

name: vehicleType
desc: All of the vehicle types serviced by this business or business category. e.g. VEHICLE_TYPE_RAIL and VEHICLE_TYPE__BUS for "transit stop". This allows downstream to serve different result types for transit station categories in different languages. e.g. In en-US "train station" seeks both railway station and subway station results. But the equivalent word in French/Italian/German seeks only railway stations.
meaning: Which vehicle types the business or category serves.

name: venue
desc: Stadiums, theaters, cinemas, etc.
meaning: Marks the phrase as a venue such as a stadium, theater or cinema.

name: transitOperator
desc: Operator of a transit line, e.g., "MTA", "BART", "CTA", etc.
meaning: Marks the phrase as a transit operator such as a city agency.

name: transitLine
desc: A particular line in a transit system, e.g., "3 train", "Red Line", "Cirle Line", etc.
meaning: Marks the phrase as a particular transit line.

name: university
desc: Also colleges
meaning: Marks the phrase as a university or college.

name: cuisineGcid
desc: If the element implies a cuisine type then we include the gcid string when available. Currently this happens for BUSINESS_CATEGORY type. The field is repeated to model categories like "mandarin buffet restaurant" with multiple cuisine gcid's: mandarin_restaurant and buffet_restaurant.
meaning: Cuisine category codes implied by a business phrase.

name: emergency
desc: This field is used to determine the emergency type of the element, which is specified by the grammar parse in (
meaning: Which emergency service type the phrase refers to.

name: restaurant
desc: Also bars and cafes
meaning: Marks the phrase as a restaurant, bar or cafe.

name: transitStation
desc: The different types of transit station business types will be used to figure out which vehicle types to use when querying Tripfinder's SearchStations service. The stations in that backend seem to be divided into HEAVY_RAIL, SUBWAY, and TRAM. There isn't a very reliable division between intercity rail and commuter rail -- Amtrak, LIRR, PATH, and NJ Transit are all classified as HEAVY_RAIL. That's why in these types we make a distinction between train and subway, and not train and muni_rail, (unli
meaning: Marks the phrase as a transit station type, used to pick vehicle kinds.

name: qrefTransitStation
desc: This is used for transit stations annotated by QRef. The transit_station business_type above is only used for business categories, and therefore is used downstream to find nearby stations rather than a particular station, and so cannot be present in a Location that is a specific station from QRef. For these cases, this business_type is used instead. e.g. "grand central" "millbrae station" "union station" will have business_type qref_transit_station
meaning: Marks that the phrase names one specific transit station.

name: school
desc: Pre-k to high school
meaning: Marks the phrase as a school from pre-k through high school.

name: chainIds
desc: Specifies which parent chain mids to filter by.
meaning: Ids of the parent chains that results should be limited to.

name: location2
desc: If location_2 is absent, it should likely be interpreted as an implicit "here". For example, "nearest Starbucks" will be represented as a compound location with "Starbucks" as location_1, "nearest" as the joiner, and empty location_2.
meaning: The second place in a compound phrase; if missing it means here.

name: contact
desc: Contact as a location.
meaning: A saved contact used as the place in the request.

name: contactType
desc: The type of contact address (home, work, etc).
meaning: Which of the contact's addresses is meant, such as home or work.

name: nonSpecificValue
desc: True for values like "a few".
meaning: Marks that the amount was vague, like a few.

name: unitsString
desc: String representation, e.g., for debug.
meaning: Text form of the units, mainly for debugging.

name: value
desc: For approximate values such as "a few" or "several", we populate |value| with a specific numeric value which is a generous (i.e., high) interpretation of the text, and we set |non_specific_value| to true.
meaning: The numeric amount of distance or extent that was asked for.

name: valueString
desc: Can hold numbers as well as "a few".
meaning: Text form of the amount, which may be a word like a few.

name: gcid
desc: GCID - with the 'gcid:' prefix.
meaning: A place category code used as a filter.

name: hotel
desc: Basic accommodation types.
meaning: Marks the lodging type as a hotel.

name: other
desc: Any other lodging related type.
meaning: Marks any other kind of lodging.

name: cabin
desc: Other accommodation types.
meaning: Marks the lodging type as a cabin.

name: vacationRental
desc: Vacation rental accommodation types.
meaning: Marks the lodging type as a vacation rental.

name: japaneseInn
desc: Japanese accommodation types.
meaning: Marks the lodging type as a Japanese inn.

name: allInclusiveResort
desc: Basic accommodation types variations.
meaning: Marks the lodging type as an all-inclusive resort.

name: commodityStrength
desc: Whether a location is a commodity (distance is an important metric), neutral or non-commodity (distance is not important). Commodity locations are "atm", "gas station", etc. Non-commodity locations are "restaurant", "hotel", etc, and all others are neutral. The value is 1 for commodity queries, 0 for non-commodity queries, no-value for neutral queries (when the field doesn't exist in the grammar). The reason it is a float is to prepare for future changes w
meaning: How much distance matters for this kind of place, high for things like ATMs.

name: retrievalGcids
desc: Categories used for retrieval and used in Artemis diversity tiers as restricts. See
meaning: Place categories used to fetch and group local results.

name: startByte
desc: The raw input span corresponding to this joiner.
meaning: Where the joining word starts in the raw request text.

name: startByteForConversion
desc: Byte data added for conversion between this proto and IntentQuery in LooseParser. Must not be used for downstream triggering.
meaning: Byte offset kept only for converting between two parser formats.

name: text
desc: The original joiner string from the tokenized query. Particularly important if the type is OTHER.
meaning: The joining word as it appeared, such as near or in.

name: geocodingAddress
desc: The full address of the result. This should be a verbose address string that geocodes reliably.
meaning: Full address of the place, written so it maps reliably.

name: kgMid
desc: The knowledge graph reference of the result.
meaning: Knowledge Graph id of the place.

name: position
desc: The position of the result.
meaning: The coordinates of the place.

name: rect
desc: The position of the result, if it can't be expressed as a pointproto.
meaning: The area of the place when a single point will not do.

name: basicLocation
desc: Exactly one of the location types should be populated.
meaning: The plain place reading of the phrase; only one place type is filled in.

name: contactLocation
desc: DEPRECATED. Instead, use LocationElement.contact_location.
meaning: Deprecated slot for a contact used as a place.

name: isMerged
desc: True if the location is merged, for example by CombineLocationsFn.
meaning: Marks that this place came from combining several parsed places.

name: locationConstraint
desc: The constraint includes various constraints on the location such as amenities, price range, ratings, or attributes such as new, cheap, etc. These constraints are a part of the location but are not modeled as location elements and are not included in the location text. The (debatable) motivation is that they do not stand on their own and are not an intrinsic part of the location. Note on texts and spans. For a location such as "kid friendly hotels with an indoor pool" we expect to get a
meaning: Filters attached to the place, such as amenities, price range or ratings.

name: resolvedLocalResult
desc: A LocalResult corresponding to the location the user specified, populated by local dialog (generally following a search). This field will only be set if the location is unambiguous, possibly following a series of disambiguation turns of dialog.
meaning: The single local result the user's words were resolved to during dialog.

name: startByte
desc: The span, in the raw input, which corresponds to this location, expressed as a byte offset and byte size. This allows the extraction of the location string as it appears in the raw text.
meaning: Where the place phrase starts in the raw request text.

name: text
desc: A string representation of the location. Depending on the annotators and the location itself the string may represent the raw query, the pre-processed query, or something else. As a non-trivial example, for [target address mountain view] we will generate the text "target mountain view" without "address". We make a best-effort to come up with a good string, but make no formal guarantees. You should never present this text directly to outside users.
meaning: A best-effort text form of the place, not meant to be shown to users.

name: userSpecifiedLocation
desc: A location info including featureId and lat/lng that uniquely identifies the location the user specified.
meaning: Feature id and coordinates identifying the place the user named.

name: amenities
desc: LINT.IfChange
meaning: Amenity filters requested for the place.

name: evcsConnectorConstraint
desc: Used for populating ElectricVehicleConnectorRefinement from QBF go/evcs-qbf-connector
meaning: Electric vehicle charging connector filter taken from the request.

name: evcsPaymentConstraint
desc: Used for populating ElectricVehiclePaymentRefinement from QBF go/evcs-qbf-payment
meaning: Electric vehicle charging payment filter taken from the request.

name: gcidConstraint
desc: Used for GCID filter. Unlike other grammar, for now this is populated in Superroot (currently based on QBLD classification, and an allowlist of GCID).
meaning: Place category filter applied to local results.

name: healthInsurance
desc: Used for health insurance filter populator.
meaning: Health insurance filter for a place search.

name: hyperReliableData
desc: Some constraints are also hyper-reliable, such as [brunch] and [coffee].
meaning: Marks constraints treated as very reliable, such as brunch or coffee.

name: startByte
desc: The span, in the raw input, which corresponds to this constraint, expressed as a byte offset and byte size.
meaning: Where the constraint phrase starts in the raw request text.

name: ungroundedConstraint
desc: Experimental, may change.
meaning: Experimental flag for a constraint that was not resolved.

name: unspecified
desc: Used to remove all constraints, e.g. [forget all the filters]
meaning: Used to clear all filters, as in forget all the filters.

name: vaccineType
desc: Used for vaccine refinement: go/covid-vaccine-refinement.
meaning: Vaccine filter for a place search.

name: aliasIcon
desc: For elements with a NICKNAME alias location, this field will hold all matching alias icons, which are used in search to resolve the location.
meaning: Icons matching a nicknamed saved place, used to resolve it.

name: aliasLocation
desc: The following fields (alias_location, qref_location, and saft_location) should have at most one non-empty value between them.
meaning: A saved nickname for a place, such as home or work.

name: businessType
desc: Set only when type is BUSINESS_NAME or BUSINESS_CATEGORY.
meaning: The kind of business, filled only when the phrase names one.

name: dialogReferents
desc: This will hold semantics from the dialog_referents subgrammar with offsets and indices relating to a list of results shown to the user. This field is repeated while in the future we could support multiple item list selection. i.e. [the starbucks] where multiple entries in the results will be indicated here
meaning: Which shown results the user was pointing at in the conversation.

name: directionalModifier
desc: Set only when type is DIRECTIONAL_MODIFIER.
meaning: A direction word in the place phrase, such as north.

name: genericLocation
desc: DEPRECATED. See basic_location.element.type == LOCATION_REFERENT to determine this instead. Populated by a type VISITED local action, this field is used to indicate a location element is a general-case $PT_visited_location string.
meaning: Deprecated flag marking a general visited-place phrase.

name: hotelType
desc: Set only when business_type is hotel.
meaning: The kind of lodging, filled only when the business is a hotel.

name: localResultId
desc: A field used to store the ID of a specific location entity, especially one not extracted via QRef. For example, - a location selected by the users via a dialog follow-up query like [the second one]. Will only be populated in the LocalSemanticsServlet, not in the grammar. - a location resolved based on a full search, e.g., following the geocoding step for a directions query. This field is also used by NoramlizeLocationForFingerprinting as the canonical place to store FeatureIds.
meaning: Holds the ID of a place the user picked or that was resolved by a full location search.

name: number
desc: Represents zip codes, street numbers, etc. that were detected directly by the grammar (and not, e.g., by QRef). DEPRECATED. We ran into problems with zip codes having leading zeroes. Now we store numbers only in the text field.
meaning: Deprecated numeric value for zip codes or street numbers detected in the query.

name: personalReferenceLocation
desc: A collection of QRefAnnotations repesenting Reference and Resolution data for Personal References. See go/copley-local and go/copley-annotator.
meaning: Annotations that resolve personal place references such as home or work.

name: startByte
desc: The byte span, in the raw query, which corresponds to this location element.
meaning: Byte position in the raw query where this location phrase begins.

name: text
desc: A string representation of the location element. Typical, this field will be populated by the MakeLocationElementFn semantic function with the substring of the raw_query defined by start_byte and num_bytes. However, the field can also be populated explicitly in the grammar, in which case MakeLocationElementFn leaves it alone.
meaning: The words in the query that name the location.

name: transitLineNumber
desc: Train number associated with /collection/geo/transit_line. Populated when user requests specific instance of a transit line. For example, long distance trains in India have two numbers for each train, one for up direction and other for down. And user use these numbers in queries along with name to specify the specific trip of the train. More details in go/number-transit-line-queries.
meaning: Train number the user said when asking about a specific transit line.

name: menuItemId
desc: This ID corresponds to the name of the menu item in the query. For example [restaurants that serve thai curry] has menu_item_id = "thai curry".
meaning: The dish name mentioned in a restaurant query, such as thai curry.

name: currencyCode
desc: The currency codes are expected to be string from the list in i18n/identifiers/currencycode.*
meaning: Currency code attached to a price limit the user mentioned.

name: unspecified
desc: The user mentioned something about price, but didn't mention a specific constraint. This is used to indicate an intent to remove all price constraints, in queries like [forget the price].
meaning: Flag that the user mentioned price without giving an actual limit.

name: unspecified
desc: The user mentioned something about quality, but didn't mention a specific constraint. This is used to indicate an intent to remove all quality constraints, in queries like [forget the rating].
meaning: Flag that the user mentioned quality or rating without giving an actual limit.

name: minNumBathrooms
desc: It is possible to have fractional bathrooms.
meaning: Minimum number of bathrooms the user asked for, which may be fractional.

name: orMore
desc: If this field is set, exactly one of the star classes above should be set, and the interpretation should be that at least that many stars should be present.
meaning: Flag meaning the stated star rating should be read as at least that many stars.

name: base
desc: If the base is missing then clients should assume that it implicitly means "here". E.g., "within five miles" really means "within five miles from here"
meaning: The place a distance phrase is measured from, defaulting to the user's current spot.

name: connector
desc: The text between the extent and the base, e.g., for "50 miles from here" the connector is "from".
meaning: The linking words between a distance and a place in the query, such as from.

name: evalData
desc: Required, but should only be used inside Aqua and must not be used by outside clients!!
meaning: Internal evaluation data for annotation testing, not for outside use.

name: isAnnotatedFromText
desc: Whether the annotation is from $Text.
meaning: Flag for whether this annotation came from plain text matching.

name: normalizedText
desc: Normalized (canonicalized) text, e.g. "mobile".
meaning: The standardized wording of a phone type, such as mobile.

name: originalText
desc: Original text in query, e.g. "cell".
meaning: The phone type wording exactly as the user said it, such as cell.

name: rawText
desc: DEPRECATED. Used original_text instead.
meaning: Deprecated text field replaced by original_text.

name: contact
desc: Contact details (e.g. gaia_id, phone, etc). Replaces 'focus_name' above.
meaning: Contact details for the person a message is addressed to.

name: evalData
desc: Required, but should only be used inside Aqua and must not be used by outside clients!!
meaning: Internal evaluation data for annotation testing, not for outside use.

name: nameAnnotationSource
desc: Deprecated in favor of recipient.contact.name_annotation_source.
meaning: Deprecated field replaced by a name source field on the contact.

name: rawText
desc: NOTE: for CONTACT recipient, this is
meaning: The raw recipient text taken from the query.

name: relationship
desc: A reference to a person by relationship name. eg. my father.
meaning: A reference to a person by relationship word, such as my father.

name: sensitiveStartByte
desc: The beginning and end of the recipient name that should be removed before logging.
meaning: Marks the part of a recipient name that must be stripped before logging.

name: alias
desc: The alias of the relationship in the query, e.g. "mom".
meaning: The relationship word the user used, such as mom.

name: canonical
desc: The canonical format of the relationship, e.g. "Mother".
meaning: The standard form of the relationship, such as Mother.

name: canonicalLexicalMid
desc: Mid for an entity that has lexical data (a LexiconEntry). See
meaning: Entity ID for the relationship word used in the query.

name: deviceName
desc: The name of the device (Nexus 5, Nexus 10, etc).
meaning: The model name of the user's device.

name: deviceType
desc: The type of the device (phone, tablet, watch, etc).
meaning: The kind of device, such as phone, tablet or watch.

name: evalData
desc: Required, but should only be used inside Aqua and must not be used by outside clients!!
meaning: Internal evaluation data for annotation testing, not for outside use.

name: field
desc: The field mentioned in the user's utterance, if any.
meaning: Which field of a dialog list the user referred to.

name: index
desc: Used for a grammar mention of an index.
meaning: An index number the user spoke when picking an item.

name: next
desc: Represents a tied referent in a different field of the same label
meaning: Link to a related referent stored in another field of the same label.

name: selection
desc: The requested value(s) for selection from a list of alternatives.
meaning: The item or items the user chose from a list of options.

name: taskMention
desc: Set when the user's utterance refers to the (an) overall task/goal of the dialog (e.g. "the meeting starts at 10 am" mentions the goal, "meeting"). The field is repeated in case the user ambiguously identifies a task (two tasks named 'meeting').
meaning: Marks that the user referred to the overall goal of the conversation.

name: id
desc: A unique identifier that is the canonical value for the chosen list item. If we are selecting among fields, this is the field_id specified in the corresponding DialogField.
meaning: Canonical identifier of the list item the user chose.

name: looseOffsetRestriction
desc: If true, semantic function should look at watch actions in the following display entity if the first one is not playable. This is useful for "Play it" on entity page.
meaning: Flag telling the system to try the next entity if the first one cannot be played.

name: offset
desc: The offset within the list, if know. If the list of values wasn't known (e.g. from the discourse context) then the offset is a zero-based mapping of the ordinal value of the selection ("first one" maps to zero; "last one" to minus one).
meaning: Position in the list that the user's selection maps to.

name: rawText
desc: When the user selects a list value by name then this is the matched text from the utterance. Note that, if the list of values is known, then the aqua annotator should have mapped it to an offset.
meaning: The words the user said when picking a list item by name.

name: annotationList
desc: Annotations from custom media annotator.
meaning: Media annotations attached by the custom media annotator.

name: evalData
desc: Required, but should only be used inside Aqua and must not be used by outside clients!!
meaning: Internal evaluation data for annotation testing, not for outside use.

name: favorite
desc: If true, indicates the user wants their favorite album. Like [play my favorite album my Eminem]
meaning: Flag that the user asked for their favorite album.

name: first
desc: If true, indicates the user wants the first album. Like [play adele's first album]
meaning: Flag that the user asked for an artist's first album.

name: isFromFastPath
desc: Is annotated by Nimble for the media Fast Path.
meaning: Flag that a fast path annotator produced this annotation.

name: latest
desc: If true, indicates the user wants the latest album. Like, [play adele's latest album]
meaning: Flag that the user asked for an artist's newest album.

name: playMore
desc: More from this album.
meaning: Flag that the user asked for more from this album.

name: rawText
desc: Required, corresponds to the raw text, like "The White Album."
meaning: The album name as it appeared in the query.

name: book
desc: Like an audio book. "Listen to (moby dick) audiobook"
meaning: The audiobook the user asked to listen to.

name: dateTime
desc: A date time constraint for audio entity, for example, "jazz station 1980".
meaning: A date or time limit the user put on the audio they want.

name: episodeConstraint
desc: Constraining the query to some detail about the episode. Example: "listen to episode (13) of this american life with (mike birbiglia)" would have the 2 constraints in parens.
meaning: Details that narrow down which episode the user wants.

name: game
desc: Soundtrack or theme song (see score_type param that indicates whether the user refers to a soundtrack or a theme song) of the game. "Play soundtrack from (Deus Ex Human Revolution)".
meaning: The game whose soundtrack or theme song was requested.

name: movie
desc: Soundtrack or theme song (see score_type param that indicates whether the user refers to a soundtrack or a theme song) of the movie. E.g. "Play (Let It Go) from (Disney's Frozen)"
meaning: The movie whose soundtrack or theme song was requested.

name: newsTopic
desc: News topic. "Listen to news about (Ukraine)"
meaning: The news subject the user asked to hear about.

name: noExplicitAudio
desc: True when the query does not contains an explict audio name. E.g. When user says "play" or "listen to".
meaning: Flag that the query names no specific thing to play.

name: podcast
desc: Podcast feeds. "Listen to (This American Life)"
meaning: The podcast feed the user asked for.

name: radioNetwork
desc: E.g. "play NPR radio", "Play BBC radio".
meaning: The radio network the user named, such as NPR.

name: rawText
desc: The query for backends to use in search. e.g. for an user query of "play kids song video on tv" from assistant, this field would be "kids song". Note: there is no guarantee this field is populated; when it is not, backends should fall back to "raw_text" fields in song, artist, album etc.
meaning: The trimmed query text that backends should search with.

name: scoreType
desc: If any of movie, game or tv show fields is populated this field indicates specific score type requested in the query. E.g. for [play soundtrack from frozen] this field is SOUNDTRACK, for [play frozen song] this field is THEME_SONG.
meaning: Whether the user asked for a soundtrack or a theme song.

name: seasonConstraint
desc: Constraining the query to some detail about the season. Example: "listen to season 2 of serial"
meaning: Which season the user asked for.

name: tag
desc: Optional tags associated with how the media entity should be played. For example, this can be set to SEED_RADIO to signify that the user wants to play a radio station seeded by the entity.
meaning: Tags describing how the requested media should be played.

name: tvShow
desc: Soundtrack or theme song (see score_type param that indicates whether the user refers to a soundtrack or a theme song) of the tv show. E.g. "Play soundtrack from (Friends)".
meaning: The TV show whose soundtrack or theme song was requested.

name: audiobookMid
desc: The MID of the audiobook entity (/book/book_edition).
meaning: Entity ID of the audiobook edition.

name: bookMid
desc: The MID of the book entity (/book/book) which this audiobook is associated with.
meaning: Entity ID of the book that the audiobook comes from.

name: annotationList
desc: Annotations from custom media annotator.
meaning: Media annotations attached by the custom media annotator.

name: evalData
desc: Required, but should only be used inside Aqua and must not be used by outside clients!!
meaning: Internal evaluation data for annotation testing, not for outside use.

name: isAnnotatedFromText
desc: Annotation comes from a text annotator. Needed to boost recall. Typically need to be verified in superroot, and have separate scoring.

name: time
desc: Optional time included with some types of recurrence phrases, such as "every morning".
meaning: An optional time of day attached to a repeating phrase like "every morning".

name: weeklyPattern
desc: Specify a weekly recurrence. Valid and required for WEEKLY frequencies only.
meaning: The weekly pattern for a repeating task.

name: yearlyPattern
desc: Specify a yearly recurrence. Valid only for YEARLY frequencies.
meaning: The yearly pattern for a repeating task.

name: lastDay
desc: Special flag to indicate the last day of the month, equivalent to setting month_day to -1. Deprecated, use month_day=-1 instead.
meaning: Deprecated flag meaning the last day of the month for a repeating task.

name: lastWeek
desc: Special flag to indicate a week_day in the last week of the month, as this cannot be captured by week_day_number. Deprecated, use week_day_number=-1 instead.
meaning: Deprecated flag meaning the last week of the month for a repeating task.

name: monthDay
desc: Absolute day of the month (if positive) or relative day from the end of the month (if negative). Example: 2nd and 20th of the month [2, 20]. Example: Last day of the month [-1]. Positive values should correspond to actual calendar day number (indexing starts at 1).
meaning: Which days of the month a task repeats on, counted from the start or the end.

name: weekDay
desc: For capturing the nth weekday of the month. Use together with week_day_number or last_week to specify n.
meaning: Which weekday a monthly repeat lands on.

name: weekDayNumber
desc: The nth occurrence of week_day to match. I.e. For 3rd Wednesday of the month, week_day = WEDNESDAY and week_day_number = 3. Values beyond the end of the month are skipped. If negative, this is interpreted as the nth-to-last occurrence of the week day in the month. I.e. for last Thursday of the month, week_day = THURSDAY and week_day_number = -1.
meaning: Which occurrence of the weekday in the month, such as the third Wednesday.

name: autoRenew
desc: Should be used in cases where the size of the recurrence is infinite (no end date specified), in which case we rely on an offline process to extend. Set by server only, setting it on a new recurrence will throw an exception.
meaning: Server-set flag saying an endless repeating task gets extended by a background process.

name: autoRenewUntil
desc: Used in cases where the recurrence is too large to create in a single transaction. In this case we create a manageable number of instances initially and rely on an offline process to continually extend the recurrence until this date. Set by server only, setting it on a new recurrence will throw an exception.
meaning: Server-set date until which a long repeating task keeps being extended in the background.

name: endMillis
desc: Deprecated - prefer end_date_time.absolute_time_ms.
meaning: Deprecated end time in milliseconds for a repeating task.

name: numOccurrences
desc: Note that auto-renewing is not supported in conjunction with num_occurrences. Therefore we impose a hard limit of 1000 when using this field.
meaning: How many times a task repeats, limited to 1000.

name: startDateTime
desc: Only the year/month/day portion are used to find the start date of the recurrence. To specify a time or period of each instance, use DailyPattern.
meaning: The start date of a repeating task.

name: startMillis
desc: Deprecated - prefer start_date_time.absolute_time_ms.
meaning: Deprecated start time in milliseconds for a repeating task.

name: weekDay
desc: Set of weekdays the recurrence applies to.
meaning: Which weekdays a weekly repeat applies to.

name: monthlyPattern
desc: The monthly pattern to recur.
meaning: The monthly pattern used inside a yearly repeat.

name: yearMonth
desc: The months of the year to apply the pattern.
meaning: Which months of the year a yearly repeat applies to.

name: evalData
desc: This field should not be used by clients of the grammar. It is intended to be used internally in Aqua for metric and regression tests.
meaning: Internal evaluation data for the merchant annotation, used for Google's own tests.

name: localMerchantId
desc: Merchant Center identifier for LIA merchants.
meaning: The Merchant Center ID for a local inventory merchant.

name: merchantId
desc: Merchant Center identifier for GSX merchants. Deprecated: use MerchantCenterId.
meaning: Deprecated Merchant Center ID for shopping merchants.

name: mid
desc: Optional. Knowledge Graph identifier for the merchant.
meaning: The Knowledge Graph ID for a merchant.

name: name
desc: A name for the merchant. Example: Walmart
meaning: The merchant's name, such as Walmart.

name: docid
desc: The offer document id as used in Shopping's metadata.
meaning: The document ID of a shopping offer in Shopping's own metadata.

name: merchant
desc: The merchant selling the product.
meaning: The merchant selling the product in a shopping offer.

name: price
desc: The price of the product sold by the merchant.
meaning: The price the merchant charges for the product.

name: product
desc: The product for sale.
meaning: The product being offered for sale.

name: store
desc: Optional. The physical store where the product can be purchased.
meaning: The physical store where the product can be bought.

name: catalogId
desc: The shopping catalog identifier.
meaning: The shopping catalog ID for a product.

name: maxPrice
desc: The highes price this product is available for.
meaning: The highest price the product is available for.

name: mediaProduct
desc: TODO(ppoudyal) Add logging for media_product.
meaning: Placeholder for media product details inside a shopping product.

name: mid
desc: Optional. Knowledge Graph identifier for the product.
meaning: The Knowledge Graph ID for a product.

name: minPrice
desc: The lowest price this product is available for.
meaning: The lowest price the product is available for.

name: title
desc: Title of the product. Example: Moto X Blue 64GB Note: This refers to only the catalog title not user specified phrase
meaning: The catalog title of a product, such as Moto X Blue 64GB.

name: bookConfidence
desc: TODO(ppoudyal) Expand confidence to cases where the product phrase might be a book/movie/video_game but isn't just a title The score (between 0 - 1) measuring the confidence that product
meaning: A 0 to 1 score for how likely a shopping phrase names a book.

name: isVideoGame
desc: TODO(ppoudyal) Deprecate is_video_game once the score covers all cases covered by $VideoGameProductPhrase The product phrase contains a video game title.
meaning: Flag, slated for deprecation, saying a shopping phrase contains a video game title.

name: movieConfidence
desc: phrase mentions a book title The score (between 0 - 1) measuring the confidence that product
meaning: A 0 to 1 score for how likely a shopping phrase names a movie.

name: videoGameConfidence
desc: phrase mentions a movie title The score (between 0 - 1) measuring the confidence that product
meaning: A 0 to 1 score for how likely a shopping phrase names a video game.

name: evalData
desc: This field should not be used by clients of the grammar. It is intended to be used internally in Aqua for metric and regression tests.
meaning: Internal evaluation data for the product expression, used for Google's own tests.

name: phrases
desc: Ordered list of phrases that the user used to describe a product.
meaning: The ordered phrases a user used to describe a product.

name: shoppingListItemInfo
desc: Associated shopping list item info. Only set when the product is come from a shopping list item.
meaning: Details of the shopping list item a product came from.

name: author
desc: The author of the media
meaning: The author of a media product.

name: genre
desc: The genre of the media
meaning: The genre of a media product.

name: mediaTitle
desc: The title of the media Example: The assasin's creed
meaning: The title of a media product.

name: orderInSeries
desc: Order in media series (series title is given by the product title)
meaning: The position of a media item within its series.

name: topic
desc: The topic of the media
meaning: The topic of a media product.

name: mid
desc: The knowledge graph identifier for the attribute
meaning: The Knowledge Graph ID for a media attribute such as an author.

name: rawText
desc: Raw text of the media attribute (eg. author)
meaning: The raw text of a media attribute such as an author name.

name: id
desc: Local store identifier.
meaning: The identifier of a local store.

name: location
desc: The location of the store.
meaning: The location of a store.

name: name
desc: A name for the store. Example: Walmart - Cranberry
meaning: The store's name, such as Walmart - Cranberry.

name: numerator
desc: Fields for fraction numbers
meaning: The numerator part of a fraction parsed from text.

name: precision
desc: This field is used to indicate the number of digits after the decimal point in the normalized_value field in number.proto, which contains the floating point representation of the fraction
meaning: How many digits after the decimal point the parsed fraction uses.

name: wholeNumber
desc: This field is set only for mixed fraction
meaning: The whole number part of a mixed fraction.

name: evalData
desc: Span info of the annotation - mostly used for evaluation purpose. Note: this data must never be used outside Aqua because it relies on the internal tokenization used in Aqua that could change over time.
meaning: Internal span data for the number annotation, for Google's Aqua system only.

name: isSpelledOut
desc: An optional field that holds whether the number_type number is a normalized spelled-out number or not. This field will not be set in cases when this information is not available.
meaning: Flag saying a number was written out in words rather than digits.

name: modifier
desc: NumberModifier is used to capture when the expression is not an absolute number, but a number expression to represent an increase/decrease/comparison. E.g. [10 more percent], [5 less].
meaning: Marks a number as a change or comparison, such as "10 more percent".

name: normalizedValue
desc: Contains a normalized string representation of the numeric value that has:
meaning: A cleaned up string form of a parsed number.

name: rawText
desc: The raw text of the annotation.
meaning: The original text of the number as it was written.

name: spelledOutType
desc: We expect this field to be set only when is_spelled_out is true.
meaning: The kind of spelled out number, set only when the number was written in words.

name: decimalMark
desc: The type of decimal mark that was present before normalization. Note: different locales may use different decimal marks.
meaning: Which decimal mark the original number used before it was normalized.

name: groupingDelimiter
desc: The type of digit grouping delimiter that was present before normalization. Note: different locales may use different digit grouping delimiters.
meaning: Which digit grouping separator the original number used, such as a comma.

name: groupingSystem
desc: We expect this field to be set only when grouping_delimiter is set.
meaning: Which digit grouping system was used, set only when a grouping separator exists.

name: normalizedValue
desc: Contains a normalized string representation of the numeric value that has:
meaning: A cleaned up string form of a parsed simple number.

name: prefix
desc: Stores prefix output by the GRM number grammar (
meaning: A prefix produced by the number parsing grammar.

name: suffix
desc: Stores suffix output
meaning: A suffix produced by the number parsing grammar.

name: airlineConfig
desc: Used if the entity is an airline with an airline annotation.
meaning: Airline settings used when the recognized entity is an airline.

name: evalData
desc: Required, but should only be used inside Aqua. Must not be used by outside clients!!
meaning: Internal evaluation data for the entity annotation, for Google's Aqua system only.

name: name
desc: raw string representation
meaning: The raw text of the recognized entity.

name: reference
desc: A Copley Personal Reference represents a user's reference to a something that could be personal entity, e.g. "my hotel", "mom", "brunch".
meaning: A user's reference to a personal thing, such as "my hotel" or "mom".

name: resolutions
desc: A Copley Personal Resolution represents the resolution of a Reference, e.g. if the user has a reservation at The Kendall Hotel, the reference "my hotel" could be resolved to The Kendall Hotel, and there would be a QRefAnnotation containing the mid and other data. It is possible for there to be zero resolutions for a given reference.
meaning: The actual personal entities a reference like "my hotel" resolved to.

name: entityId
desc: ID of the entity of this slot.
meaning: The entity ID for a filled slot in a third party action request.

name: numBytes
desc: Number of bytes of this slot in resolved query.
meaning: How many bytes the slot takes up in the resolved query.

name: original
desc: Part of input text, matched by that slot. In the case of composite slots, each slot should have its own original.
meaning: The part of the input text that matched this slot.

name: parameterName
desc: Name of parameter of this slot.
meaning: The parameter name for this slot.

name: slotList
desc: Represents a "list parameter". Each parameter may be declared as a list and have multiple slot values, referenced by a single alias. Each slot value in a list may contain multiple possible values. For example: aqua return 3 dates if the year is not specified in a query - one for the current year, one for the past year, and one for the following year. If user defines a list parameter with type @sys.date, and the query contains multiple dates - we should return a list of possible values
meaning: A list of values for a slot declared as a list parameter.

name: slotMap
desc: Represents a structured value. Used in composite entities. Composite entities can have arbitrary structure.
meaning: A structured value for slots built from composite entities.

name: startByte
desc: Start byte position of this slot in resolved query.
meaning: Where the slot starts in the resolved query, counted in bytes.

name: value
desc: One or more possible values. This field does not represent a list parameter.
meaning: One or more possible values for a slot.

name: date
desc: Date value. Note, that month and day are 1 based. If this DateTime is a PARTIAL datetime, then fields have value -1, which means these fields are inferred rather than derived directly from query.
meaning: A date value parsed from a request, with -1 marking inferred parts.

name: property
desc: Property of this DateTime value that can be used to match user specification of parameters, e.g. date.recent.
meaning: Extra properties of a parsed date or time, such as whether it is recent.

name: time
desc: Time value. Only hours and minutes are used. Hours are in 24h format.
meaning: A time of day value, using hours and minutes in 24 hour form.

name: timeZone
desc: Timezone field specified only if this DateTime has type TIME or DATETIME.
meaning: The time zone for a parsed time or datetime.

name: datetimeType
desc: Since datetime is a superset of date, time and date&time, this field is used to indicate which type the associated DateTime object belongs to.
meaning: Whether the parsed value is a date, a time, or both.

name: relativeDatetimeType
desc: The relative relationship between this DateTime value and DateTime&Timezone info provided in ClassifyRequest.
meaning: How the parsed date relates to the reference time in the request, such as past or future.

name: dateTimeValue
desc: Represents date or time.
meaning: A date or time held as a single slot value.

name: stringValue
desc: Represents a string value.
meaning: A plain string held as a single slot value.

name: typeValue
desc: This field is only populated by on-device Heron. This field should not be populated by any other service.
meaning: A typed slot value filled in only by on-device parsing.

name: boolValue
desc: Represents a boolean value.
meaning: A true or false slot value.

name: dateTimeValue
desc: Represents date or time.
meaning: A date or time slot value.

name: numberValue
desc: Represents number value. In accordance to ParamValue fields(
meaning: A numeric slot value.

name: stringValue
desc: Represents a string value.
meaning: A string slot value.

name: globalProductClusterId
desc: The shopping global product cluster id(s) of the annotated entity (in KG, the key(s) of type /business/variant_cluster).
meaning: Shopping product cluster IDs for the matched entity.

name: gaiaId
desc: The Gaia ID for this entity. This is populated generally for people and businesses.
meaning: The internal Google account ID for a person or business entity.

name: sourceTypeList
desc: If the annotation was created by using personal data, we record the provenance for that data here.
meaning: Where the personal data used to build this annotation came from.

name: confidenceScore
desc: The confidence (in [0, 1]) of the entity being correctly annotated.
meaning: How confident the system is, from 0 to 1, that the entity was correctly identified.

name: referenceScore
desc: The confidence (in [0, 1]) that the annotation is reference that implies another entity. (eg "my hotel" in "navigate to my hotel" is reference to explicit hotel from user hotel reservation).
meaning: How confident the system is that a phrase like "my hotel" points at a personal entity.

name: displayName
desc: Copy the display info. This can be used by annotators to give grammars a canonical name for an entity. For instance, the media grammar could use it to output the same canonical name for "rock music" and "rock".
meaning: A canonical display name for the entity, so different phrasings map to one name.

name: entitySourceData
desc: Holds information about the backends which contributed to this entity.
meaning: Which backend systems contributed to producing this entity.

name: mdvcVerticals
desc: The set of verticals this summary node belongs to.
meaning: Which broad categories, or verticals, this compound entity belongs to.

name: deprecatedEquivalentMids
desc: DEPRECATED: Equivalent ids (e.g. de-duped mids) for this entity.
meaning: Deprecated list of duplicate entity IDs for this entity.

name: clusterId
desc: The ID of the cluster (set entity) this entity belongs to.
meaning: The internal ID of the entity cluster this entity belongs to.

name: deprecatedMdvcSupportingMid
desc: DEPRECATED: Higher level id's that support the given id. This field has been deprecated in favor of related_entity. b/27363861
meaning: Deprecated list of broader entity IDs that supported this one.

name: productLineId
desc: The shopping product line id(s) of the annotated /business/shopping_product_line entity.
meaning: Shopping product line IDs for the matched entity.

name: locationType
desc: The location type of the entity, as an int32 representing a TypeCategory enum value. For example, this could be TYPE_LOCALITY (37) or TYPE_COUNTRY (33). We store this type as an int because including FeatureProto would cause java/com/google/ads/adh/pipeline/bigquery:ProtoCatalog to become too large, resulting in OOM errors.
meaning: What kind of place the entity is, such as a city or a country, stored as a number.

name: mergedImpliedEntity
desc: A list of any implied entities merged into this annotation during parsing. Order is derivation-dependent.
meaning: Other implied entity annotations that were folded into this one during parsing.

name: isMdvcDimension
desc: True if this entity is an mdvc dimension of some other annotated entity. Only included if the QRefAnnotator is initialised with include_annotated_relationships.
meaning: Flag saying this entity is a dimension of another annotated entity.

name: clusterSiblingMid
desc: The set of mids that are members of the same cluster.
meaning: The other entity IDs that belong to the same cluster as this one.

name: relatedEntity
desc: Mids related to the given entity
meaning: Other entity IDs related to the matched entity.

name: lowConfidence
desc: Whether this entity is low confidence. Not used. Currently whitelisted entities below min_confidence threshold are marked as low confidence and maybe not trusted by downstreams.
meaning: Unused flag that once marked an entity match as low confidence.

name: addedByCloseAnswers
desc: Whether this qref annotation was created by CloseAnswers on Postref. Annotations of this type don't correspond to a particular mention of the entity on the query but rather to an interpretation of the full query.
meaning: Flag recording that an entity annotation came from the CloseAnswers component rather than a word in the query.

name: location
desc: The center point of this location. This is either directly provided by the FeatureProto.center field or the centroid using the points of the polygon in the FeatureProto.
meaning: The center point coordinates of a place entity.

name: otherMetadata
desc: Metadata to be passed through from the AnnotationContext API.
meaning: A generic bag of extra metadata passed through from the annotation API.

name: resolutionScore
desc: The confidence (in [0, 1]) that the annotation was created on an implicit mention (eg my hotel) as opposed to an explicit mention (eg: the westin copley square)
meaning: How confident the system is that the mention was indirect rather than naming the entity outright.

name: isNimbleAnnotation
desc: Whether this annotation originates from nimble. (go/nimble-annotator)
meaning: Flag saying the annotation came from the Nimble annotator.

name: entityNumber
desc: The index of the entity from which this annotation is obtained, within the WebrefEntities message in the interpretation defined by interpretation_number, above.
meaning: The position of this entity within the internal list it came from.

name: personalSummaryNodeChild
desc: Personal summary nodes are compound entities made up of entities and their attributes, where the entities can be compound too. E.g., "my father's mother" can have a summary node annotation of "Mother(Father(Myself))".
meaning: Nested annotations for personal compound references like "my father's mother".

name: mdvcChild
desc: Nested annotations that represent subparts of the given mdvc full annotation. An MDVC full annotation is outputted as the summary node as the root node, and all the children of it as leaves (mdvc_child). QRef outputs a graph of relationships between the mdvc enties, and for mdvc full the aquatator nests the relevant children inside the summary node's proto.
meaning: Nested child annotations that make up a larger compound entity annotation.

name: entityRelationship
desc: The relationship information from QRef. Only included if the QRefAnnotator is initialised with include_annotated_relationships.
meaning: Recorded relationships between this entity and other entities in the query.

name: annotatedSpan
desc: A copy of the span of canonical (raw) parser input text corresponding to this annotation.
meaning: A copy of the piece of query text this entity annotation covers.

name: interpretationNumber
desc: The index of the QueryJoin interpretation from which this annotation was obtained. This field is not used for entities coming from low-confidence annotations, since such entities are not included in any interpretation.
meaning: Which query interpretation this annotation came from, by index.

name: freebaseMid
desc: The mid of the entity in freebase associated with this span.
meaning: The Knowledge Graph ID of the entity matched to this piece of text.

name: attributeId
desc: Attribute ID of a personal_summary_node_child.
meaning: An internal attribute ID used inside personal summary entity nodes.

name: clusterSetScore
desc: Cluster set qref confidence score.
meaning: How confident the system is in the entity cluster it matched for the query.

name: oysterId
desc: The geo oyster_id of the entity, relevant only for locations. Only included if the QRefAnnotator is initialised with include_oyster_id.
meaning: The internal geographic feature ID for a place entity.

name: collectionId
desc: Identifier of the collection. Usually something like "/collection/us_states".
meaning: The identifier of an entity collection, such as US states, that the entity belongs to.

name: collectionScore
desc: A value in [0, 1] indicating the relevance of the collection given this entity. NOTE: This field is deprecated and will stop being populated soon. In the meantime, it will always be populated with 1.0.
meaning: Deprecated collection relevance score that is now always set to 1.0.

name: entityIndex
desc: The index of the other entity in the relationship.
meaning: The list position of the other entity in a relationship.

name: impliedBy
desc: True if this entity is implied by the other (includes geo contains).
meaning: Flag saying this entity is implied by another entity in the query.

name: implies
desc: True if this entity implies the other (includes geo contained by).
meaning: Flag saying this entity implies another entity in the query.

name: linkPropertyName
desc: Names of the relationship links.
meaning: The names of the relationship links between two entities.

name: clusterSupportTransferRelation
desc: Denotes whether or not the related entity is derived from cluster support transfer.
meaning: Whether the related entity came from transferring support across an entity cluster.

name: composedFromRelation
desc: Denotes whether or not the related entity composes a compound entity together with other related entities.
meaning: Whether the related entity is one part of a larger compound entity.

name: equivalentRelation
desc: Whether or not the given mid is related to the other mid. Equivalent mids are usually mutually exclusive with other kinds of relations.
meaning: Whether the two entity IDs are treated as the same thing.

name: mdvcRelation
desc: The mdvc relation with the related mid.
meaning: The dimension style relationship between this entity and a related one.

name: mid
desc: Mid that is related.
meaning: The ID of the related entity.

name: supportTransferRelation
desc: Denotes whether or not there was support transfer between the two entities.
meaning: Whether support was passed between the two entities.

name: targetIsStbrSource
desc: Set if the related entity is the source of an STBR rule and the target is not this one.
meaning: Flag recording which side of an internal rule the related entity sits on.

name: category
desc: Categories can be either a $PronounMention or $NominalMention.
meaning: Whether a referring phrase in the query is a pronoun or a noun phrase.

name: rawText
desc: The substring of the raw query spanned by this annotation.
meaning: The piece of the query text this coreference annotation covers.

name: referentText
desc: The name of the entity this mentions refers to.
meaning: The name of the thing a referring phrase in the query points back to.

name: category
desc: Defines the category of measure, like $Mass.
meaning: What kind of measurement the phrase expresses, such as mass.

name: rawText
desc: The substring of the raw query spanned by this annotation.
meaning: The piece of the query text this measurement annotation covers.

name: value
desc: The numerical value of the measure.
meaning: The numeric amount of a measurement found in the query.

name: coreference
desc: Annotations for spans that are resolved coreference mentions.
meaning: Annotations for query phrases that refer back to something mentioned earlier.

name: entity
desc: Annotations for spans like "san francisco giants".
meaning: Annotations for query phrases that name an entity, such as a sports team.

name: measure
desc: Annotations for spans "53 pounds".
meaning: Annotations for query phrases that state a measurement, such as "53 pounds".

name: title
desc: Annotations for spans like "the president of the United States".
meaning: Annotations for descriptive title phrases such as "the president of the United States".

name: category
desc: Categories can be either syntactic (NNS for fine-grained-POS) or semantics ($Mass for measures).
meaning: The grammatical or semantic label attached to a piece of query text.

name: rawText
desc: The substring of the raw query spanned by this annotation.
meaning: The piece of the query text this annotation covers.

name: document
desc: The document that contains this character.
meaning: A pointer from a byte to the document it belongs to in a text data structure.

name: document
desc: The document that contains this character.
meaning: A pointer from a character to the document it belongs to in a text data structure.

name: paragraph
desc: The paragraph that contains this character.
meaning: A pointer from a character to the paragraph that contains it.

name: sentence
desc: The sentence that contains this character.
meaning: A pointer from a character to the sentence that contains it.

name: text
desc: The character itself. Must contain valid UTF-8. Must be exactly one Unicode character.
meaning: The single character itself, stored as text.

name: token
desc: The token that contains this character.
meaning: A pointer from a character to the word token that contains it.

name: author
desc: The author(s) of this document.
meaning: Pointers to the author records for a text document in this NLP data structure.

name: bytes
desc: The bytes in this document.
meaning: The range of bytes belonging to this text document.

name: characters
desc: The characters in this document.
meaning: The range of characters belonging to this text document.

name: id
desc: The identifier of this document.
meaning: The identifier of this text document.

name: languageCode
desc: A set of BCP-47 codes indicating the language(s) of this document.
meaning: The language codes for this text document.

name: languageSpans
desc: The language spans in this document.
meaning: The stretches of different languages inside this text document.

name: mentions
desc: The mentions in this document.
meaning: The spans where entities are mentioned in this text document.

name: paragraphs
desc: The paragraphs in this document.
meaning: The paragraphs in this text document.

name: sentences
desc: The sentences in this document.
meaning: The sentences in this text document.

name: text
desc: The text of this document. Must contain valid UTF-8.
meaning: The full text of this document in the NLP data structure.

name: tokens
desc: The tokens in this document.
meaning: The word tokens in this text document.

name: url
desc: The url of this document.
meaning: The web address this text document came from.

name: gender
desc: Entity gender. Default label set is 'masculine', 'feminine', or 'neuter'. (Perhaps in the future we can split 'neuter' into 'inanimate', 'unknown', and 'non-binary'.)
meaning: The grammatical gender label for an entity in a text corpus.

name: mid
desc: Machine identifier, such as those from the Freebase database (or similar entity database).
meaning: The machine ID identifying an entity in a text corpus.

name: name
desc: Free-form entity name.
meaning: The free form name of an entity in a text corpus.

name: type
desc: Entity type, typically something like person/location/organization. The schema for types is not specified. If this entity has a MID, use the mid field instead or in conjunction with the type.
meaning: The type of an entity, such as person, place or organization.

name: bytes
desc: The bytes in this span.
meaning: The range of bytes covered by a single language stretch of text.

name: characters
desc: The characters in this span.
meaning: Pointer to the range of characters this span covers.

name: document
desc: The document that contains this span.
meaning: Pointer to the document that contains this span of text.

name: languageCode
desc: A set of BCP-47 codes indicating the language(s) of this span of text.
meaning: Language codes for the text in this span.

name: bytes
desc: The bytes in this mention.
meaning: Pointer to the bytes covered by this mention.

name: document
desc: The document that contains this mention.
meaning: Pointer to the document containing this mention.

name: entity
desc: The entity that this mention refers to.
meaning: Link from a name mentioned in text to the entity it refers to.

name: kind
desc: Mention kind, typically 'referential', 'attributive', or 'modifier'.

meaning: Removed flag that once blocked indexing when viewability dropped.

name: updatedByIndexer
desc: Whether the volume viewability was updated by the indexer as opposed to a direct update in goovols. The absense of this bit will indicate to the indexer that it should not short-circuit indexing side effects that should occur when viewability changes.
meaning: Whether the indexer, rather than a direct edit, changed the viewability.

name: locale
desc: The two-character ISO country code for the locale.
meaning: Country code for this viewability entry.

name: viewability
desc: The viewability specified for this locale.
meaning: Display rules that apply in this country.

name: angle
desc: Angle of rotation of (in degrees, clockwise is positive) of the box about the top-left corner.
meaning: Rotation angle of a detected text box in an image.

name: curvedBox
desc: Sequence of rotated boxes that tightly enclose the text.
meaning: Sequence of boxes tightly wrapping curved text in an image.

name: height
desc: Box height (bottom pixels at top + height - 1).
meaning: Height in pixels of a detected text box.

name: left
desc: x coordinate of top-left corner
meaning: Left pixel coordinate of a detected text box.

name: top
desc: y coordinate of top-left corner
meaning: Top pixel coordinate of a detected text box.

name: width
desc: Box width (rightmost pixels at left + width - 1).
meaning: Width in pixels of a detected text box.

name: points
desc: The sequence of points that approximate the curve.
meaning: Points approximating a curved line of text in an image.

name: y
desc: NOTE: if we wish to support perspective (varying thickness), later on we could extend this message with a thickness field. In that case, CurvedBoundingBox.thickness() would be used as a default if !Point.has_thickness().
meaning: Vertical coordinate of a point on a curved text line.

name: midLineCurve
desc: The curve of points along the middle of the text line.
meaning: Curve running through the middle of a line of text in an image.

name: thickness
desc: If top_to_bottom is true, this is the width of the curved box. Otherwise, it is the height of the curved box.
meaning: Thickness of the curved box around a line of text.

name: topToBottom
desc: If true, the curve is interpreted as top to bottom of the line image. Otherwise, it is from left to right.
meaning: Whether the text line runs top to bottom rather than left to right.

name: blockId
desc: ID of the text block that this line belongs to.
meaning: Identifier of the text block this detected line belongs to.

name: box
desc: Text bounding box.
meaning: Box outlining detected text in an image.

name: contentType
desc: Content type for this box.
meaning: What kind of content the detected text box holds.

name: symbolWidths
desc: Optional width of characters in the text.
meaning: Widths of individual characters in the detected text.

name: text
desc: Text string.
meaning: Text recognized inside an image.

name: queryCountryLanguageFingerprints
desc: This is the fingerprint of the OfficialKey queries in the queries field. The index of a fingerprint in this field corresponds to the index of the fingerprinted query in the queries field. The fingerprint is produced with the QueryCountryLanguageFingerprint function in external-utils.h
meaning: Hashed forms of the queries a page is listed as official for.

name: encodedEntity
desc: This is encoded using EntityCandidate::Encode
meaning: Encoded list of entities found in a document.

name: confidenceValue
desc: The PairwiseQ confidence value corresponding to this version.
meaning: How confident the stored PairwiseQ score is for this version.

name: value
desc: The PairwiseQ value corresponding to this version.
meaning: A stored PairwiseQ score value for a given version.

name: versionId
desc: The version id.
meaning: Which version this stored value belongs to.

name: application
desc: All evaluations are done within the context of a given application, e.g., "Gmail" and should not be reused in other apps.
meaning: Names the product app, like Gmail, that an internal-vs-external evaluation applies to.

name: stateStatus
desc: * There can be multiple states based on the context: 1. AUTOCOMPLETE + Gmail - context 1 2. AUTOCOMPLETE + Chat/Dynamite - context 2 3. "SOME OTHER ACTION" + Gmail - context 3 A client should identify whether a patrticular context is present in the list and only if one is found - use the state that goes alogn with the context, otherwise the client should default to whatever is the safe assumption about "internality/externality" the application should be making (likely, consid
meaning: A list of internal/external states, each tied to a particular app and action context.

name: Message
desc: depends on the source
meaning: Free-text debug message whose meaning depends on the source.

name: Source
desc: source tag, helps interpret value/message
meaning: A tag saying which system wrote this debug entry.

name: Timestamp
desc: seconds since the epoch
meaning: The time the debug entry was written, in seconds since 1970.

name: Value
desc: depends on the source
meaning: A debug value whose meaning depends on the source tag.

name: subId
desc: A unique identifier for this alias, this identifier is unique to the type of this Alias. This means that aliases of different types can have the same sub_id, hence always use the full AliasId message to refer to an alias, not this field only. Because HOME and WORK aliases are unique, aliases of type HOME or WORK always have sub_id 0.
meaning: An identifier for a saved Maps place alias, unique only within its alias type.

name: aliasId
desc: The id of the alias associated with this point. This is used to query for details for the info window and to display different icons depending on the AliasType contained in this message.
meaning: The saved Maps place alias that this map icon belongs to.

name: droppedPinS2cellId
desc: If this is a dropped pin alias, the leaf (level 30) S2 cell ID corresponding to the aliased lat/lng. Calculated once and stored here so that it can safely be used as an identifier across clients without risk of rounding differences leading to different values.
meaning: The map cell identifier for a dropped-pin alias location.

name: featureId
desc: The featureid that was associated with the alias when it was saved. If this is not set the lat/lng in 'point' is the aliased entity, i.e. this is a dropped pin alias.
meaning: The map feature that was saved with this alias.

name: featureName
desc: For non-address feature aliases (e.g. businesses), the name of the feature (formatted from the FeatureProto) when it was saved.
meaning: The name of the place saved as an alias, as it read when saved.

name: featureType
desc: The type of the feature associated with the alias.
meaning: The kind of map feature the alias points at.

name: formattedAddress
desc: One-line geocoded address that this lat/lng represents at the time this alias was created by the user.
meaning: The one-line address for the alias location at the time it was saved.

name: isAdsJoinCompliant
desc: Indicates whether this alias is Ads join compliant for use by 3p clients. See go/ios_address and go/aliased-locations-provenance for more details. Please contact oolong-team@ for additional questions regarding usage of this field.
meaning: Flag saying whether this saved place may be used by third-party ads joins.

name: nickname
desc: Free-text alias if alias type is NICKNAME. Otherwise unset. Limited to 40 characters.
meaning: The user's free-text nickname for a saved place, up to 40 characters.

name: point
desc: lat/lng the icon is to be shown at.
meaning: The latitude and longitude where the map icon is drawn.

name: ptoken
desc: Encapsulates the privacy policy relevant signals for this event. See go/kansas-embedded-ptokens for additional details. Keep the type fully qualified in case (when) we decide to make proto compiler enforce '.ptoken.PToken' as the only allowed type for the field number 9099. Hence, don't remove the leading '.'. See go/protobuf-ptoken-field for details around the 9099 field number.
meaning: Privacy policy metadata attached to this saved-place record.

name: stickerId
desc: The id of the sticker asset chosen by the user to replace the default asset for the alias.
meaning: The sticker image the user picked to represent the saved place.

name: syntheticFeature
desc: If the feature associated with the alias has synthetic_geometry.
meaning: Flag saying the saved place's map feature has synthetic geometry.

name: timestamp
desc: [INTERNAL ONLY] Last update of bigtable by kansas, in microseconds. Volatile only and not saved in kansas column. inmemory only because >= 16.
meaning: Internal timestamp of the last storage update, in microseconds.

name: opaRecipesContext
desc: Contexts regarding the preferences from OPA_RECIPES.
meaning: Context about which recipe preferences a local discovery setting came from.

name: uiEntryPoint
desc: The UI entry point from which the entity preference was set.
meaning: Which part of the interface the user set this preference from.

name: docId
desc: The recipe doc id where the setting comes from.
meaning: The identifier of the recipe document a saved setting came from.

name: url
desc: The recipe url where the setting comes from.
meaning: The URL of the recipe page a saved setting came from.

name: durationMs
desc: The duration of the animation or movie (not including any looping), in milliseconds. If there is only a single frame (and thus not animated), the duration will be 0.
meaning: How long an animation or movie runs, in milliseconds.

name: loopCount
desc: The number of times the animation plays. If 0, the animation will loop indefinitely. If positive, this number includes the initial playthrough. For example, a value of 3 means that each frame is shown 3 times.
meaning: How many times an animation plays before stopping; zero means forever.

name: version
desc: Currently there are two versions of DynamicDepth (go/ddv2). DynamicDepth photos without a set version should be assumed to be ddv1.
meaning: Which version of the depth-photo format the image uses.

name: far
desc: Depth map far plane distance.
meaning: The far plane distance of the image's depth map.

name: format
desc: Depth map format.
meaning: The format of the image's depth map.

name: imageHeight
desc: Depth map source image height.
meaning: The height of the source image for the depth map.

name: imageWidth
desc: Depth map source image width.
meaning: The width of the source image for the depth map.

name: mime
desc: Depth map mime type.
meaning: The mime type of the image's depth map.

name: near
desc: Depth map near plane distance.
meaning: The near plane distance of the image's depth map.

name: units
desc: Depth map units of distance.
meaning: The distance units used by the depth map.

name: gainmap
desc: Indicates the presence of some kind of gainmap-utilizing format.
meaning: Marks that the image carries a gainmap-based high dynamic range format.

name: adobeHdr
desc: Indicates that this image can be processed as an Adobe HDR (FlexDR) image by reading the MPF segments.
meaning: Flag saying the image can be read as Adobe high dynamic range.

name: appleHdr
desc: Indicates that this image can be processed as an Apple HDR image by reading the MPF segments (if JPEG) or HEIF segments (if HEIC).
meaning: Flag saying the image can be read as Apple high dynamic range.

name: googleHdr
desc: Indicates that this image can be processed as a go/ghdr (UltraHDR) image by reading the GContainer in the primary XMP block.
meaning: Flag saying the image can be read as Google UltraHDR.

name: caption
desc: Caption embedded in IPTC
meaning: A caption embedded in the image file's IPTC data.

name: chromasubsampling
desc: A typed representation that translates the values from ycbcrsubsampling.
meaning: A readable form of the image's chroma subsampling setting.

name: bitspersample
desc: Start of reflected fields. These do not duplicate the above fields.
meaning: The bits-per-sample value read straight from the image file.

name: gcameraspecialtypeid
desc: Camera creations metadata. The opaque id string created by the OEM. For bursts, this field should not be present. Instead, the two properties below will allow Photos to identify and provide special treatment for bursts.
meaning: An opaque identifier a device maker attached to a camera creation.

name: rotate
desc: This field is deprecated. Rotation is now accomplished via ImageInfo.exif_orientation and ImageInfo.edit_list. WARNING: the presence of rotate is used by FIFE to identify older images. Setting this (even to the correct number of degrees) on newer images can cause incorrectly rotated thumbnails. This was the cause of omg/58543 Number of degrees (0, 90, 180, 270)
meaning: A deprecated rotation value in degrees that newer images should not set.

name: microvideooriginaloffset
desc: This is similar to gcameramicrovideooffset, except it stores the unverified value that was provided in the motion photo file. This field is not part of the XMP or spec. It is used to ensure we preserve data from the original file when offset is modified.
meaning: The unchecked video offset as it was written in the original motion photo file.

name: mimeType
desc: Mime type of image
meaning: The image's file type.

name: motionphotovideodataboxheader
desc: The Motion Photo Video Data (MPVD) box header of a HEIF motion photo. It is used for reconstructing the original moton photo bytes. See go/photos-be-heic-motion-photos for more details.
meaning: A stored box header needed to rebuild the original motion photo bytes.

name: width
desc: width and height are before any rotation (including EXIF orientation).
meaning: The image width before any rotation is applied.

name: gcameramicrovideo
desc: The following XMP metadata are used specifically for MicroVideo. More information about MicroVideo format can be found at go/photos-microvideo-format A value of 1 indicates that this file was a MicroVideo at capture time. Otherwise, this is not a MicroVideo (not set or 0).
meaning: Marks the file as a MicroVideo captured by the camera.

name: orientation
desc: Exif camera orientation. "1" means "no rotation".
meaning: The camera orientation from EXIF, where one means no rotation.

name: gpsdatestamp
desc: This is in UTC time. Format is YYYY:mm:dd.
meaning: The GPS date stamp from the photo, in UTC.

name: DEPRECATEDGpstimestamp
desc: This field was originally marked incorrectly as optional (rather than repeated). In order to fix it, the first field has been marked as deprecated and replaced with a field with a new name and tag number.
meaning: An old GPS timestamp field kept only because it was declared wrongly and replaced.

name: gcameramotionphoto
desc: An indication that this item should be treated as a Motion Photo. 0 -> Not Motion Photo, 1 -> Motion Photo, everything else is undefined per the spec. If it's a motion photo, the previous gcamera fields should be ignored.
meaning: Marks the file as a Motion Photo.

name: dynamicDepthMetadata
desc: DynamicDepth (go/dynamic-depth) metadata is described in the metadata of sub-images in the container. The presence of this field can be used to determine that an image is in the dynamic depth format.
meaning: Depth information showing the photo is in the dynamic depth format.

name: longitude
desc: +/- 180 inclusive
meaning: The longitude recorded in the photo's GPS data.

name: bitDepth
desc: The number of bits per pixel used to express a color. Most images have 8-bit depth and Photos/thumbnailer currently do not support more than 8 bits (except RAW).
meaning: How many bits per pixel the image uses for color.

name: gcameramotionphotoversion
desc: Indicates the Motion Photo version of the spec (initially 1).
meaning: The version of the Motion Photo format used.

name: hdrMetadata
desc: Indicates that the image has some form of HDR present or available to it.
meaning: Information about high dynamic range data present in the image.

name: thumbnailerBuildCl
desc: The build CL for the version of thumbnailer that built this image.
meaning: The build number of the thumbnail tool that produced this image.

name: gcameraburstprimary
desc: A value of 1 indicates that this was the primary (“best shot”) at capture time. Within Photos we should only treat this image as the best shot if the user hasn’t made an explicit choice. Defining the initial primary allows consistency between OEMs, Photos clients, and the Photos backend. This value is optional, cameras are not required to set it on any photo in a burst. Clients will default to the 0th frame, but may run an algorithm to pick a better default.
meaning: Marks the photo the camera picked as the best shot of a burst.

name: daylightsavings
desc: 0 = no daylight savings, 1 = daylight savings enabled. Note that this field only represents whether the setting in the camera was turned on or off. It must not be used to modify the timestamp of the photo. That is, the capture time is already completely determined by exif_time, timezoneoffset and timezoneminutes.
meaning: Whether the camera had daylight saving time switched on.

name: hasAlpha
desc: The image has an alpha channel (potential transparency). If the image is decoded, this will be updated to indicate whether there is any active transparency. Formats supporting alpha: png, webp, gif, heif.
meaning: Flag saying the image has a transparency channel.

name: usepanoramaviewer
desc: GPano-related fields. A handful of these have been deprecated due to a change in the spec since its initial design.
meaning: Flag saying the image should be opened in a panorama viewer.

name: gcameramotionphotocreator
desc: Indicates the creator of the Motion Photo. This will be set if the MotionPhoto was generated from a LivePhoto from the iOS to Android conversion tool.
meaning: Which tool or source created the Motion Photo.

name: timezoneoffset
desc: The elements in the timezone and daylight savings field arrays correspond to the following date/time fields: 0) datecreated (ie. DateTimeOriginal) 1) datetime (ie. DateTime or last modified date) 2) datetimedigitized (ie. DateTimeDigitized) If the field does not exist, then there is no valid time zone information for that date/time field. Offset in hours.
meaning: The time zone offset in hours for each of the photo's date fields.

name: exifTime
desc: Timestamp embedded in the image. The value comes from the first valid date-time field extracted from the metadata in the order: 1) datecreated (ie. DateTimeOriginal) 2) datetimedigitized (ie. DateTimeDigitized) 3) datetime (ie. DateTime or last modified date) The type of this field is equivalent to a time_t (ie. number of seconds since the epoch - 00:00 hours, Jan 1, 1970) except that it is an int64 rather than an int.
meaning: The capture time embedded in the image, taken from the first valid date field.

name: latitude
