desc: GPS Info: +/- 90 inclusive
meaning: The latitude recorded in the photo's GPS data.

name: gcameramotionphotopresentationtimestampus
desc: The presentation timestamp in microseconds of the video frame corresponding to the image still. Value may be -1 to denote unset/unspecified.
meaning: Which video frame matches the still image in a Motion Photo, in microseconds.

name: gcameramicrovideooffset
desc: The offset in bytes from the end of the file to the point where the appended mp4 begins (equivalent to the length of the compressed mp4). This field might be provided in the original MicroVideo from client, but it might become invalid when the image component is edited, so it is expected that the thumbnailer will validate it and find the correct value (by scanning through the JPEG) if it is invalid. In other words, only a valid offset should be returned by thumbnailer.
meaning: How many bytes from the end of the file the embedded video starts.

name: gcameraisautoenhanced
desc: Indicates that an OEM has applied auto enhance via Photos' API.
meaning: Flag saying a device maker auto-enhanced the photo through the Photos API.

name: exif4c
desc: 4C metadata (caption, copyright, creator, credit) specific to each of the three metadata segments (EXIF, XMP, IPTC). These are used to keep separate the 4C data from each segment so that we can properly preserve the per-segment 4C data on write (when PreserveLevel is set appropriately).
meaning: Caption, copyright, creator and credit values kept separately per metadata segment.

name: cameramodel
desc: Exif camera model
meaning: The camera model recorded in the photo's EXIF data.

name: gcameramicrovideopresentationtimestampus
desc: The presentation timestamp in microseconds of the video frame corresponding to the image still. Value may be -1 to denote unset/unspecified.
meaning: Which video frame in the clip matches the still image, in microseconds.

name: autoenhance
desc: Indicates whether auto-enhance has been applied to the image.
meaning: Flag saying auto-enhance was applied to the photo.

name: exifTimeUtcSource
desc: The exif_time_utc_source indicates the source from which the exif_time_utc field is calculated.
meaning: Which source the UTC capture time was worked out from.

name: gcameraburstid
desc: A unique String. The property should be present and identical for all images that make up a burst. It should be unique across devices (UUID recommended). Unlike GCreations:CameraBurstId, we should use images with this property to create auto collages and animations.
meaning: A shared identifier marking all photos taken in the same burst.

name: ismpformat
desc: The image is a Multi-Picture Object.
meaning: Flag saying the file is a multi-picture object.

name: gpstime
desc: This is in UTC Time. Contains three floats: hour, minute and second. Supports subsecond resolution.
meaning: The GPS time from the photo as hours, minutes and seconds in UTC.

name: gcameramicrovideoversion
desc: Indicates the file format version of the MicroVideo (initially 1).
meaning: The version of the MicroVideo file format used.

name: destinationLatitude
desc: +/- 90 inclusive
meaning: The destination latitude recorded in the photo's GPS data.

name: destinationLongitude
desc: +/- 180 inclusive
meaning: The destination longitude recorded in the photo's GPS data.

name: exifTimeUtc
desc: The exif_time_utc field is a UTC-based alternative to the exif_time field, which is in local time, rather than UTC. If they were not separate, clients would be unable to distinguish if the source were UTC- or local-based.
meaning: The photo's capture time expressed in UTC rather than local time.

name: timezoneminutes
desc: Remaining minutes of offset.
meaning: The leftover minutes part of the photo's time zone offset.

name: gcameradisableautocreation
desc: The possible values are: “Animation”, “Collage”, “Pano”, “Movies”. Photos will avoid creating the listed types using the containing image or video. The property is optional. The property can be included multiple times to disable creation of multiple different types.
meaning: A list of creation types, such as collage or movie, that should not use this file.

name: cameramake
desc: Exif camera make
meaning: The camera manufacturer recorded in the photo's EXIF data.

name: uniqueid
desc: For unique hash:
meaning: A unique hash identifying the image file.

name: colorprofile
desc: Indicates whether or not the source image had an embedded color profile.
meaning: Flag saying the source image carried an embedded color profile.

name: gcreationstype
desc: String representation of creation type. Should be one of {"GCameraCollage", "GCameraAnimation", "GCameraGroupSmiles", "GPhotosCollage", "GPhotosAnimation"}.
meaning: The name of the creation type, such as collage or animation.

name: vr180Panorama
desc: True if the image is a VR180 image. See go/3d180 for details.
meaning: Flag saying the image is a VR180 photo.

name: floatData
desc: For single precision floating point data
meaning: The raw floating point numbers of an image recognition feature vector.

name: altitudeMeters
desc: Altitude of the point above the earth's surface, in meters.
meaning: How far above the earth's surface a point sits, in meters.

name: countryCode
desc: Country code string.
meaning: The country code for a recognized location.

name: fromGps
desc: Indicates if the lat/lon above is assumed to come from a GPS device.
meaning: Flag saying the coordinates are assumed to come from a GPS device.

name: lat
desc: Latitude in degrees north. Values south of the equator are negative.
meaning: The latitude of a point, negative south of the equator.

name: latErrorBound
desc: When applied to a single point, represents the estimated error bounds of manual geotagging. The estimate is based on size of the bounding box of the map used for manual geotagging. When applied to a group of points, the error bounds represent the dispersion around the group center (lat/lon above). The dispersion in this case is computed as half the interquartile range. Reference:
meaning: An estimate of how far off the stored latitude may be.

name: lon
desc: Longitude in degrees east. Values west of 0 deg are negative.
meaning: The longitude of a point, negative west of zero degrees.

name: additionalInfo
desc: Optional info provided by the feature extractor.
meaning: Optional extra notes supplied by the feature extractor.

name: tag
desc: Tag for this global feature. E.g., "DELG", "SBv4" or "DELG_region1".
meaning: A label naming which image feature extractor produced this data.

name: authorName
desc: Name of the author or image source. User-defined. Must be NULL-terminated.
meaning: The author or source name attached to an image by whoever supplied it.

name: corpus
desc: Identifier for which corpus the image belongs to. Currently Cyclone uses this field in: - photos_vision_objectrec.SpatialMatcherRequest.residual_template to select which spatial matcher should be applied to the candidate matches - photos_vision_objectrec.CustomCorpusQuantizer to map a custom corpus to one or more posting lists
meaning: A label saying which image collection this template belongs to.

name: geoLocation
desc: The geolocation of the image. Assumed to represent the location where the photo was taken from.
meaning: Where the photo was taken, stored with the image template.

name: imageId
desc: Unique identifier for the image used to compute this template.
meaning: An internal unique ID for the image this template came from.

name: imageUrl
desc: URL or filename of the image used to compute this template. User-defined. Must contain only ASCII characters and be NULL-terminated.
meaning: The URL or filename of the image the template was built from.

name: imageWidth
desc: Dimension of the image used to compute this template.
meaning: The pixel width of the image used to build the template.

name: objectInfo
desc: Tags pertaining to this image. User-defined. Must be NULL-terminated.
meaning: Free-form tags a user attached to the image.

name: objectName
desc: Name of the object/scene depicted. User-defined. Must contain only ASCII characters and be NULL-terminated.
meaning: The name of the object or scene shown in the image, supplied by a user.

name: opaqueData
desc: Opaque template data. May be used to pass through additional data from template sources to processing modules, that is not already covered by other members of this PB. It is the responsibility of processing modules to verify that the data is in a compatible format.
meaning: A pass-through blob of extra data whose format is not defined here.

name: roi
desc: Region-of-interest: The bounding box of the object or scene depicted in the image.
meaning: The bounding box around the object or scene in the image.

name: version
desc: Feature version.
meaning: The version string of the image feature format.

name: isBinaryDescriptor
desc: Used to indicate if the descriptor is binary or not. When decompressing feature this is useful to decide calling different decompression functions.
meaning: A flag saying whether the stored descriptor is binary, so the right decoder is used.

name: numDescriptors
desc: Used to store the number of descriptors for statistical purposes, if the descriptors themselves are not stored.
meaning: How many image descriptors there were, kept for counting when the descriptors are dropped.

name: affineMatrix
desc: Optional affine matrix. Supersedes scale and orientation if present. r' = affine_matrix.r + (x,y) defines an affine transform from the normalized image patch (in which the interest point is centered at the origin with scale 1) to the image. If the affine matrix is set, the following approximations are recommended: scale = sqrt(0.5
meaning: A matrix describing how an image patch maps onto the picture.

name: dataFactor
desc: data_factor and data represent the local descriptor vector in a compressed format, using only 8 bit per value. Each byte of the data string yields one component of the local descriptor by bit-casting it to an int8 and multiplying it by data_factor. Protocol buffers do not support int8 directly.
meaning: A multiplier used to unpack the compressed bytes of an image descriptor.

name: featureVector
desc: Unquantized feature vector (float).
meaning: The uncompressed numeric vector describing a local image patch.

name: opaqueData
desc: Opaque descriptor data. May be used to pass through descriptor data from descriptor sources to processing modules, that is not already covered by data/data_factor and/or cannot be expressed as a vector of numbers. It is the responsibility of processing modules to verify that the data is in a compatible format.
meaning: A pass-through blob of extra descriptor data with no fixed format.

name: orientation
desc: Orientation is optional, as some interest point detectors don't compute it. The range of orientation is [-pi,pi).
meaning: The rotation angle of an image interest point, when the detector computes one.

name: scale
desc: Each interest point must have a characteristic scale > 0.
meaning: The size scale of an image interest point.

name: strength
desc: The strength or weight, indicating the relative significance of this point.
meaning: How strong or significant a detected image interest point is.

name: x
desc: The position in the image with sub-pixel accuracy. The center of the upper left pixel has coordinates (0.0, 0.0). Thus the range for x and y is (-0.5, width - 0.5) x (-0.5, height - 0.5).
meaning: The horizontal pixel position of an image interest point.

name: debugInfo
desc: DebugInfo stores debug information from the overall classifier. This allows for instance to update counters related to blacklisting without running the full classifier again.
meaning: Debug output kept from the image classifier so it need not be rerun.

name: finalOffensiveScore
desc: Final offensive score based on image salient terms and image OCR vulgar and offensive scores.
meaning: The final offensive-content score for an image, built from its text and OCR scores.

name: finalViolenceScore
desc: Final violence score based on some image signals (brain pixel score, co-clicked images violence score, navboost queries score, etc.).
meaning: The final violence score for an image, combined from several image signals.

name: finalViolenceScoreVersion
desc: A string that indicates the version of SafeSearch classifier used to compute final_violence_score.
meaning: The version string of the classifier that produced the violence score.

name: internalSignals
desc: A proto that stores SafeSearch internal signals that are not exported to clients. SafeSearch team does not provide any guarantees about the presence or the semantics of these signals in the future.
meaning: A container of internal SafeSearch signals that are not exposed to clients.

name: numberFaces
desc: number of faces
meaning: How many faces were detected in the image.

name: ocrAnnotation
desc: Information about image OCR text. For details see image/safesearch/content/public/ocr_annotation.proto.
meaning: Text read out of the image by OCR, along with notes about it.

name: offensiveSymbolDetection
desc: QuimbyCongas-based detection of offensive symbols in the image (currently swastika and Nazi yellow badge).
meaning: Whether hate symbols such as a swastika were detected in the image.

name: photodnaHash
desc: Binary version of the PhotoDNA hash (144 bytes long). If not set (has_photodna_hash() == false) it means that it was not computed, if empty (has_photodna_hash() == true && photodna_hash() == "") it means that the computation failed (cannot be computed for images smaller than 50 x 50).
meaning: A fingerprint hash of the image used for matching known bad images.

name: pornWithHighConfidence
desc: This field is set to true when we are pretty confident that the image is porn (with higher precision than the img_porn_moderate restrict). In particular, it means that the image might be demoted for non-porn queries when SafeSearch is Off.
meaning: A flag marking an image as confidently pornographic, which can demote it on non-porn queries.

name: qbstOffensiveScore
desc: QBST-based image offensive score, Navboost based
meaning: An offensive score for an image derived from the queries people used to reach it.

name: qbstSpoofScore
desc: QBST-based image spoof score, Navboost based, unrelated to the pixel-based score in PornAnnotation.
meaning: A score for how misleading an image is, derived from query logs.

name: queryStats
desc: Query statistics from Navboost logs. For more details see classifier/porn/proto/image_porn_classifier_signals.proto.
meaning: Statistics about the queries that led to this image, taken from click logs.

name: queryTextViolenceScore
desc: Aggregated navboost query violence score.
meaning: A violence score for an image summed up from the queries that led to it.

name: referer
desc: url of the referer page
meaning: The address of the page that hosted the image.

name: referrerCounts
desc: Information about referrers and their porn classification. For details see classifier/porn/proto/image_porn_classifier_signals.proto.
meaning: Counts of pages linking to this image and how adult those pages are.

name: semanticSexualizationScore
desc: Starburst-based score predicting sexualization level of the image.
meaning: A model score for how sexualized the image looks.

name: url
desc: url of the image
meaning: The address of the image itself.

name: addressLine
desc: These correspond to the "AddressLine" elements in xAL, which are used to hold unstructured text. This is an addendum to the structured values; when the address is formatted, the provided lines are prepended to the formatted version of the street component fields for Western countries, and appended for CJK countries. These lines are in display order. Formerly users of PostalAddress were discouraged from mixing address_line with structured address elements. Mixing is now encouraged if ad
meaning: Free-text address lines that do not fit the structured address fields.

name: administrativeAreaName
desc: Top-level administrative subdivision of this country. Examples: US state, IT region, UK constituent nation, JP prefecture.
meaning: The top-level region of a country in an address, such as a US state.

name: countryName
desc: Name corresponding to country code. Optional. This can usually be inferred from country_name_code.
meaning: The spelled-out country name in an address.

name: countryNameCode
desc: xAL does not specify a scheme for country codes. We strongly recommend ISO 3166-1-alpha-2 (two letter codes, as used in DNS) if you use this field. (Use "GB", not "UK".)
meaning: The two-letter country code in an address.

name: dependentLocalityName
desc: Dependent locality or sublocality. Used for UK dependent localities, or neighborhoods or boroughs in other locations. If trying to represent a UK double-dependent locality, include both the double-dependent locality and the dependent locality in this field, e.g. "Whaley, Langwith".
meaning: A neighborhood or sub-locality part of an address.

name: dependentThoroughfareName
desc: Dependent thoroughfares are used to define UK-style dependent thoroughfares, and secondary streets in addresses in other locales, including intersections. Formatting is locale-dependent.
meaning: A secondary street name used in some addresses.

name: firmName
desc: NEW: The firm or organization. This goes at a finer granularity than address_lines in the address. Omit if not needed.
meaning: The company or organization named in an address.

name: isDisputed
desc: Required to support the suppression of country names from formatted results for addresses within geo-politically disputed areas. Note that we cannot achieve this by not setting the country, as this would prevent us from selecting a suitable formatting template. Addresses converted from Oyster, by the standard conversion libraries, will have this field set if the address lies within a geo-politically disputed area (ie, contained within features of type TYPE_DISPUTED_AREA) even if the disputed are
meaning: A flag marking that the address sits in a politically disputed area.

name: languageCode
desc: Language of the address. May affect address formatting for multi- lingual countries. Also allows storing multilingual location names as repeated PostalAddress. Not in xAL. Use language codes which are accepted by i18n_identifiers::LanguageCodeCoverter::FromOther(). Examples include "en" and "de-CH".
meaning: The language the address is written in, which affects how it is formatted.

name: localityName
desc: Locality. This is something of a fuzzy term, but it generally refers to the city/town portion of an address. In regions of the world where localities are not well defined or do not fit into this structure well (for example, Japan), leave locality_name empty and use address_line. Examples: US city, IT comune, UK post town.
meaning: The city or town part of an address.

name: postBoxNumber
desc: This corresponds to PostBoxNumber in xAL format. In xAL format, it's nested inside PostBox, which also contains a "Type" field to distinguish between PO Box, Private Bag etc. Current support in this proto is for PO Box only. Note that although this is modelled as a string, it should have the number only, with any necessary punctuation (such as "-"). For example, for "P.O. Box 123", this field would hold "123" - the template displaying this would prepend P.
meaning: The PO box number in an address.

name: postalCodeNumber
desc: Despite the name, postal_code_number values are frequently alphanumeric. Examples: "94043", "SW1W", "SW1W 9TQ".
meaning: The postal or ZIP code in an address.

name: postalCodeNumberExtension
desc: Used for postal-code suffixes, such as the 4-digit extension of a US ZIP+4 code.
meaning: The extra suffix on a postal code, such as the last four ZIP digits.

name: premiseName
desc: The "premise" is something like a house or building.
meaning: The building or house name in an address.

name: recipientName
desc: NEW: The recipient. This goes at a finer granularity than address_lines in the address. Not present in xAL. Omit if not needed.
meaning: The person the address is addressed to.

name: sortingCode
desc: This corresponds to the SortingCode sub-element of the xAL PostalServiceElements element. Use is very country-specific. Where it is used, the value is either a string like "CEDEX", optionally followed by a number (e.g. "CEDEX 7"), or just a number alone, representing the "sector code" (Jamaica), "delivery area indicator" (Malawi) or "post office indicator" (e.g. Côte d'Ivoire).
meaning: A country-specific mail sorting code in an address.

name: subAdministrativeAreaName
desc: Second-level administrative subdivision of this country. Examples: US county, IT province, UK county.
meaning: The second-level region of a country in an address, such as a county.

name: subPremiseName
desc: The "subpremise" is something like an apartment or suite. xAL offers more structured premise and subpremise values, but we don't.
meaning: The apartment or suite part of an address.

name: thoroughfareName
desc: Name of thoroughfare. Intersections should be represented with this field or address_line. Examples: "Amphitheatre Parkway", "N Shoreline Blvd & Charleston Rd"
meaning: The street name in an address.

name: thoroughfareNumber
desc: Thoroughfare numbers (street numbers) can be very complex indeed. xAL defines fancy structures like "ThoroughfareNumberRange" to represent the details, but we haven't included that yet. It is worth noting that this needs to be a string, not a number. Example: "1600"
meaning: The street number in an address.

name: Currency
desc: type froogle/currency/currency.h
meaning: Which currency a paid document's price is stated in.

name: Entitlement
desc: entitlement data
meaning: Data about who is allowed to read a paid document.

name: IsArchival
desc: True if a free document is archival in nature.
meaning: A flag marking a free document as archival material.

name: IsEntitled
desc: User is entitled to see the premium content for free.
meaning: Whether the current user can read the paid content without paying.

name: Price
desc: price * 100 if available
meaning: The price of a paid document, stored in cents.

name: Publication
desc: negative values for prior dates) FP of the Premium publication name
meaning: A hashed identifier for the paid publication a document came from.

name: AsrModel
desc: ASR model MPM version.
meaning: Which build of the speech recognition model made the transcript.

name: DocKey
desc: This should be the MustangDocId, we need to figure out how to generate a uint64 given the int64 we have in data_set
meaning: An internal document key for the transcribed item.

name: Lang
desc: Language of the recognizer used to generate transcript.
meaning: Which language the speech recognizer was set to.

name: MustangDocId
desc: This is the videodocid associate to the
meaning: The internal video document ID this transcript belongs to.

name: Url
desc: URL for document.
meaning: The address of the document the transcript came from.

name: s3ModelInfoLabel
desc: S3 ASR model info.
meaning: A label identifying the speech recognition model build.

name: Text
desc: The complete transcription text.
meaning: The full spoken-word transcript of the video or audio.

name: Confidence
desc: quantized to values in range 0-127
meaning: How sure the speech recognizer was about a piece of transcript, on a 0-127 scale.

name: androidIntent
desc: The list of android intents that the app is capable of executing.
meaning: The list of Android actions an app can handle.

name: appName
desc: This is the string matched from the query.
meaning: The app name text that was matched in the query.

name: category
desc: Category of this package.
meaning: The category an app package falls into.

name: displayName
desc: This is the display name of the app as shown below the app icon.
meaning: The app name shown under its icon.

name: fallbackUrl
desc: URL for the website associated with this app.
meaning: The website address linked to an app.

name: packageName
desc: Note that the package_name could be empty for two reasons: - The AppInfo is annotated by device content. - The ngram exists in app name fastmap, but there are a lot of packages associated with it. e.g., there could be a lot of apps for app name "recipes app".
meaning: The app's package identifier, which may be blank in some cases.

name: source
desc: For the future source, use the field in source_data.source().
meaning: Where this app record came from, now superseded by another field.

name: confidence
desc: Confidence from navboost.
meaning: How confident the app match is, based on click log data.

name: install
desc: Number of installs from marmot.
meaning: How many times the app has been installed.

name: teleportSourceData
desc: Signals present when the source is TELEPORT.
meaning: Extra data present when the app record came from the Teleport source.

name: preReleaseMode
desc: Whether the app is in the pre-release stage and only available for testing.
meaning: Whether the app is still a test release.

name: unknownAppDeviceCompatibility
desc: Whether app compatibility is unknown. This field is needed for apps like apple tv that have different package names on different devices. Play Gateway Service (PGS) lookup is needed to validate that the app is available on the user's device. go/app-fulfillment-quality
meaning: Whether it is unknown if the app runs on the user's device.

name: providerKey
desc: The unique provider key/enumeration string as used in KG. See also /base/mediaasset/provider/provider_enumerator.
meaning: The internal key naming the media provider behind an app.

name: providerType
desc: The type of content served by the App. See also chrome.dongle.pints.ProviderType.
meaning: What kind of content the app serves.

name: buttons
desc: Buttons on the notification
meaning: The buttons shown on a reminder notification.

name: surfaceType
desc: Surface type for the notification
meaning: Which device surface a notification is meant for.

name: tapAction
desc: Tap action on the notification body. This overwrites the default tap action on reminder trigger notification (which on mobile, is the reminders hub page).
meaning: What happens when the user taps a notification.

name: text
desc: Notification text
meaning: The wording shown in a notification.

name: label
desc: REQUIRED. text for the button label
meaning: The text printed on a notification button.

name: tapAction
desc: REQUIRED. tap action for the button
meaning: What happens when a notification button is tapped.

name: url
desc: Currently for payload we only support raw string url. More structured options may be added in the future
meaning: The link a notification tap opens.

name: locales
desc: List of supported locales for this provider. Must follow the format from go/iii, e.g.: 'en', 'en-US', 'en-GB', etc. Short forms without regions codes, such as, 'en' match all possible regions: en-US, en-GB, en-IN, etc.
meaning: Which language and country combinations a news provider supports.

name: officialName
desc: The official name of the provider. Used in TTS and should be localized.
meaning: The official name of a news provider, used when reading it aloud.

name: officialNamePronunciation
desc: TTS hint for the pronunciation of the name. Should be left blank unless TTS performs poorly on official_name. Example: Without hinting, TTS mispronounces "The Daily 202" as "the daily two hundred and two". Feeding tts the string "the daily two oh two" produces correct TTS.
meaning: A pronunciation hint so a provider name is read aloud correctly.

name: providerId
desc: The provider id used for news source URL lookup in Kansas. See b/27250779 for details.
meaning: The internal ID used to look up a news source.

name: score
desc: A score of how confident the annotated span is a news provider. For example, a high score is assigned for span "bbc news", but a low score for span "bbc", which only triggers narrative news aqua parse for a query with explicit news intent, e.g [play news from bbc].
meaning: How confident the system is that a phrase in the request names a news provider.

name: archived
desc: OPTIONAL. True if the reminder is archived. Not present implies false.
meaning: Whether a reminder has been archived.

name: archivedTime
desc: OPTIONAL. The time when this reminder is archived. Deprecated. Use
meaning: When a reminder was archived; this field is retired.

name: archivedTimestamp
desc: OPTIONAL. When the reminder was completed (only present when archived == true). Maps to apps_intelligence.dialog.Task's complete_time field.
meaning: When a reminder was marked complete.

name: asyncInteractionType
desc: REQUIRED. async_interaction_type of the reminder trigger notification
meaning: What kind of background interaction the reminder notification uses.

name: attachment
desc: OPTIONAL. Attachments associated with this Reminder. If the attachment has different behavior on different surfaces (e.g., deeplinks), specify multiple attachments here, and specify the surface types and links in the inner fields. There should be at most one attachment for each surface.
meaning: Extra items attached to a reminder, possibly one per device surface.

name: bareTitle
desc: OPTIONAL. Populated only for assignable reminders (E.g. "buy milk"). It will be used in the post-execution card-rendering. If not poulated, i.e. in non-assignable mode, caller should fallback to use $title.
meaning: The bare wording of an assigned reminder, without the sender prefix.

name: clientId
desc: OPTIONAL. The reminders "client" id. This ID uniquely identifies a reminder instance and may be generated by any client that writes to our Reminder backend.
meaning: The client-side unique ID of a reminder.

name: clientType
desc: REQUIRED. The type of this attachment. This is used for frontends (e.g., Hubpage) to customize UX. And also for customized VE logging.
meaning: Which client created the reminder, used for display and logging.

name: createTime
desc: OPTIONAL. The create time of this reminder. This field is propagated only for the reminders fetched from backend.
meaning: When the reminder was created.

name: createTimestamp
desc: OPTIONAL. The create time of this reminder. This field is propagated only only for the reminders fetched from backend.
meaning: When the reminder was created, as a timestamp.

name: creator
desc: OPTIONAL. Creator of a reminder (owned by the current user). Used in shared reminder RUD operations.
meaning: Who created a shared reminder.

name: customizedNotificationCard
desc: OPTIONAL. Contains fields needed to build the customized notification card DEPRECATED. No longer supported after migration to Tasks.
meaning: Fields for a custom reminder card; no longer supported.

name: datetime
desc: A representation of the Gregorian calendar date and timezone-relative time a reminder is scheduled for. This contains the date and time of either a single reminder or the upcoming instance of a recurring reminder.
meaning: The date and time a reminder is set to go off.

name: description
desc: OPTIONAL. Full-length description of the reminder.
meaning: The long description text of a reminder.

name: extraNotificationDeviceId
desc: OPTIONAL. Device ID for home notification which should have loud notification. See go/device-id-storage-in-tasks
meaning: Which home device should play the loud reminder alert.

name: id
desc: DEPRECATED. Use
meaning: An old reminder identifier that is no longer used.

name: log
desc: OPTIONAL. Associated logs to be plumbed through along with a reminder.
meaning: Logging data carried along with a reminder.

name: memoryPayload
desc: OPTIONAL. Memory record payload which is associated with this reminder. This will be set for all Assistant reminders created after the first launch of the Reminder Memory integration, see go/reminders-memory for more details. Also, this might apply to all other types of reminders.
meaning: The saved memory record tied to a reminder.

name: notifying
desc: OPTIONAL. True if the reminder is notifying on the device that is making the request to the server.
meaning: Whether the reminder is currently alerting on the requesting device.

name: personalReferenceMetadata
desc: OPTIONAL. Populated if the reminder is based off of a personal reference, e.g. [my hotel] when the user has a hotel reservation. Contains the information needed for suggestion chip attribution, e.g. a link back to the email reservation.
meaning: The personal item, such as a hotel booking, that a reminder was based on.

name: recipient
desc: OPTIONAL. Recipient of a reminder (created by the current user). Used for shared reminder CRUD operations.
meaning: Who a shared reminder was sent to.

name: serverId
desc: OPTIONAL. The reminders backend "server" id. Only filled in some scenarios, e.g. to generate the reminders hubpage detailed-reminder view.
meaning: The server-side ID of a reminder.

name: title
desc: REQUIRED. The main textual representation of the reminder with the final title. For assignable reminders, this would be e.g. "From John: buy milk".
meaning: The main text of a reminder.

name: updateTimestamp
desc: OPTIONAL. The last updated time of this reminder. This field is propagated only for the reminders fetched from ARIS (go/aris-dd).
meaning: When the reminder was last changed.

name: customLocationType
desc: Optional additional information about the types of the custom location. This field is not stored in backend, and is only used to plumb NLP information to fulfillment UI.
meaning: Extra notes about the kind of custom place a reminder points at.

name: displayAddress
desc: An address string that is suitable for displaying to the user in an application interface. It can be detailed, or brief. e.g. "80 Absolute Ave, Unit 1708, Mississauga, ON" e.g. "151 Charles Street West"
meaning: A readable address for a reminder location, for showing to the user.

name: geoFeatureId
desc: Filled if location_type is CUSTOM and this is a resolved instance of a business (not for specific address locations).
meaning: The map feature ID of a business used as a reminder location.

name: name
desc: Descriptive name, e.g. "43rd st new york", a user-edited place name (e.g. "Gym"), or a reverse geocoded business name. This can be any string.
meaning: A friendly name for a reminder location, such as Gym.

name: personalLocationMetadata
desc: Deprecated in favor of Reminder.personal_reference_metadata.
meaning: Old location provenance data, replaced by another reminder field.

name: ttsAddress
desc: A localized, shortened version of the address, suitable for TTS. This originates in the LocationFrame.
meaning: A shortened address wording suitable for being read aloud.

name: displayName
desc: A (localized) display string describing the category. This is s generic string describing the category, and may be different than the term the user actually said, e.g. name: "supermarket", display_name: "Grocery Stores"
meaning: A readable label for a place category, such as Grocery Stores.

name: chainMid
desc: The freebase mid of the chain entity.
meaning: The knowledge graph ID of a store chain.

name: chainName
desc: The geostore.NameProto.text (corresponding to the user's language) at the time of reminder creation. In most cases, this is the same as name, but there may be corner cases where they differ, e.g. name: "bestbuy", chain_name: "Best Buy".
meaning: The chain's name as it read at the time the reminder was made.

name: featureId
desc: The (corporate entity) chain's MapFacts feature id.
meaning: The map feature ID of the chain's parent company.

name: displayName
desc: REQUIRED. Their full name, which will be shown/spoken when referring to this person informally, e.g. "You have 2 reminders from Dave Smith."
meaning: A person's full name as spoken back in a reminder.

name: emailAddress
desc: OPTIONAL. Their email address.
meaning: A person's email address on a shared reminder.

name: gaiaId
desc: REQUIRED. Their gaia id (used by the backend for CRUD operations).
meaning: A person's account ID used by the reminder backend.

name: givenName
desc: REQUIRED. Their given name, which will be shown/spoken when referring to this person informally, e.g. "You have 2 reminders from Dave."
meaning: A person's first name as spoken back in a reminder.

name: photoUrl
desc: OPTIONAL. The URL of the photo. This field is read from photo field from go/people-api. Also see go/khdgk for URL formats. This field might be missing if user does not have photo URL available.
meaning: A link to a person's profile photo.

name: clientId
desc: OPTIONAL. Client-assigned-id for the recurring reminder
meaning: The client-assigned ID for a repeating reminder.

name: recurrence
desc: The recurrence pattern.
meaning: How often a reminder repeats.

name: recurrenceId
desc: An id which uniquely identifies a recurrence series.
meaning: The ID grouping all instances of a repeating reminder.

name: serverId
desc: REQUIRED. Server-assigned-id for the recurring reminder
meaning: The server-assigned ID for a repeating reminder.

name: pauseDuration
desc: The delay between each two sounds.
meaning: How long to wait between two alert sounds.

name: soundUrl
desc: The sound urls will be used to play.
meaning: The links to the sounds an alert plays.

name: creationTime
desc: The time when this timer was created
meaning: When a timer was created.

name: device
desc: Identifies the device this timer belongs to.
meaning: Which device a timer belongs to.

name: expireTime
desc: When not paused: the time the timer is (or was) scheduled to expire, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch. This should be deprecated and replaced by the expire_timer_time with DateTime type once DateTime proto includes unix timestamp (b/63636831).
meaning: When a running timer is due to finish.

name: expireTimerTime
desc: This is currently being only used only for the response generation when the user describe the expired datatime as a search constraint. We will used it for everything else once that for filtering once DateTime proto includes unix timestamp (b/63636831) and expire_time is deprecated.
meaning: The timer's finish time in a richer date format, used for spoken replies.

name: id
desc: A string key used as an identifier to this timer, unique for a given Provider.
meaning: The unique key identifying a timer.

name: label
desc: The label, provided by a user, associated with this timer.
meaning: The name a user gave a timer.

name: lastUpdated
desc: The time when this timer was last updated (creation, paused, resumed, etc.)
meaning: When a timer was last changed.

name: originalDuration
desc: The duration of the timer when it was started, in milliseconds.
meaning: How long the timer was set for when it started.

name: originalTimerDuration
desc: The duration set for the timer. The DateTimeModifier field is ignored. This field is currently only experimental until we switch the Dialog code and gramnar to the new format.
meaning: The timer's set length in a newer duration format.

name: provider
desc: The provider that owns this alarm. For Android, this includes the app that owns this alarm, where an intent should be sent to modify it.
meaning: Which app or service owns the timer.

name: remainingDuration
desc: When PAUSED: the remaining duration in milliseconds.
meaning: How much time is left on a paused timer.

name: remainingTimerDuration
desc: The duration remained for the timer. This is needed because there is no expiration date for paused timer. The DateTimeModifier field is ignored. This field is currently only experimental until we switch the Dialog code and gramnar to the new format.
meaning: The time left on a timer in a newer duration format.

name: ringtone
desc: The ringtone will be played when the timer fires, it will replace the beep sound if it is not empty.
meaning: The sound to play instead of a beep when the timer goes off.

name: ringtoneTaskMetadata
desc: Ringtone Task Metadata information used to generate sound for firing the timer.
meaning: Settings used to produce the timer's alert sound.

name: room
desc: Contains info about the room the timer is in
meaning: Which room the timer's device sits in.

name: status
desc: The current status of the timer.
meaning: Whether the timer is running, paused, or finished.

name: vibrate
desc: Whether or not the device will vibrate when the timer fires.
meaning: Whether the device buzzes when the timer goes off.

name: countryLevelScheduleInformation
desc: Key is country, and value is the schedule information in that country.
meaning: Per-country timing details for an in-app promotional event.

name: defaultFormatInformation
desc: Fallback option for the LiveOp format. We will try en-US -> en -> any locale and get the first one that is available.
meaning: The fallback wording and layout for an in-app event when no locale matches.

name: defaultScheduleInformation
desc: Fallback option for the LiveOp event scheduling information. Will use earliest start time and last end time from PDC LiveOps data dump.
meaning: The fallback timing for an in-app event when no country entry matches.

name: eventId
desc: android
meaning: The identifier of an in-app promotional event on Android.

name: eventType
desc: [REQUIRED] type of live op event.
meaning: What kind of in-app promotional event this is.

name: eventUrl
desc: ios
meaning: The link for an in-app promotional event on iOS.

name: localeLevelFormatInformation
desc: Key is locale, and value is the format information for that locale.
meaning: Per-language wording and layout for an in-app event.

name: endTimestampMillis
desc: [REQUIRED] End time in UTC for the live-op event.
meaning: When an in-app promotional event ends.

name: previewTimestampMillis
desc: If specified, a live-op event must be shown only after this preview-time (in UTC). Otherwise, the event can be shown at any time as long as its before the end time.
meaning: The earliest time an in-app event may be shown as a preview.

name: startTimestampMillis
desc: [REQUIRED] Start time in UTC for the live-op event.
meaning: When an in-app promotional event starts.

name: eyebrow
desc: iOS only, kind of event type
meaning: A short kicker line describing an iOS in-app event.

name: status
desc: iOS only, sort of start schedule
meaning: The schedule state shown for an iOS in-app event.

name: enhancedImage
desc: iOS cover image, which includes the uni image from UAM only.
meaning: The cover image used for an iOS app listing.

name: featureGraphic
desc: aka. promotional image / cover image.
meaning: The promotional banner image for an app listing.

name: blueGingerSupportedServices
desc: This field tells us whether this LocalResult supports any of the services that Blue Ginger offers.
meaning: Whether a local business supports a partner booking service.

name: maddenSupportedActions
desc: Google-internal actions supported by go/madden for this LocalResult.
meaning: Which internal actions are available for a local business.

name: intent
desc: LINT.ThenChange( //depot/google3/googledata/nlp/generation/messages/assistant/\ dialog_LOCAL_LocalAssistantSchema/\ dialog.LOCAL.LocalAssistantSchema_zxx.genx.textpb, //depot/google3/quality/dialog_manager/verticals/local/assistant/\ suggestion_chip_util.cc)
meaning: A list of intents for local results; the note here is only a code cross-reference.

name: adminArea1
desc: This field can represent different areas depending on the country. For example in the US it is state but in Canada it would be a province.
meaning: The state or province a local result sits in.

name: availableIntents
desc: The set of available intents changes with result. An intersection of available_intents and allowed_intents (See: local_config.proto), is shown to the user.
meaning: Which actions can be offered for a given local result.

name: businessType
desc: Bitset of business types this result falls into. Many fields in this message may be unset - expect good coverage for restaurants and hotels for now, but not for other verticals.
meaning: What kinds of business a local result is, such as restaurant or hotel.

name: countryCode
desc: The two-letter ISO 3166-1 country code of this result. Generated by FindFeatureCountryCode
meaning: The two-letter country code of a local result.

name: distanceMeters
desc: For a directions result, this field will be the distance from the origin to this result using the best measure we have available - the distance along a route, if we have one, or just the crow's flight distance. For a local result, this field will be the crow's flight distance from the user to the result.
meaning: How far a local result is from the user or route origin.

name: distanceUnits
desc: The standard units of the location where the user is based (not their current location). For example, miles for a user from the US, kilometers for the UK. A US user currently in the UK should have units read in miles.
meaning: Whether distances should be shown in miles or kilometers for this user.

name: externalIds
desc: Various external IDs that we may have for this result.
meaning: Outside identifiers held for a local result.

name: inUserAdminArea1
desc: If true, this LocalResult is located in the same state as the user's location.
meaning: Whether a local result is in the same state as the user.

name: inUserCountry
desc: If true, this LocalResult is located in the same country as the user's location.
meaning: Whether a local result is in the same country as the user.

name: inUserLocality
desc: Whether this result is in the same city or town that the user is in.
meaning: Whether a local result is in the same city as the user.

name: internalFoodOrderingMetadata
desc: Internal Food ordering action (i.e food ordering via Google) metadata.
meaning: Details needed to order food from this business through Google.

name: isBusinessChain
desc: If the original query had a chain intent, and this result is for a business chain.
meaning: Whether the result belongs to a chain the query asked about.

name: locality
desc: City/Town.
meaning: The city or town of a local result.

name: name
desc: The name of the result, extracted from its FeatureProto's name field.
meaning: The name of a local result.

name: neighborhood
desc: Neighborhood within a city. This field is not likely to be set for towns or smaller cities.
meaning: The neighborhood a local result sits in.

name: resultId
desc: All info we will need to lookup this result in search.
meaning: An identifier used to look up a local place result in a dialog system.

name: synonym
desc: A list of text synonyms the user could use to refer to the result.
meaning: Alternative words a user might say to refer to this local result.

name: ttsAddress
desc: The address of this result formatted for TTS output. This formatting removes acronyms like 2-letter state codes as they cannot be spoken well.
meaning: The result's address rewritten so it can be read aloud.

name: bylineDateSecs
desc: Publish date set by webmaster. See detailed description here:
meaning: The publication date the site owner declared for the page.

name: crawlTsUsec
desc: The time that the info in this attachment was computed during crawl, in microseconds.
meaning: The time this preview data was computed during crawling.

name: extendedNewsPreviewsDomain
desc: Whether this document comes from a domain that is affected by Extended News Previews (ENP) and its status (approved/rejected).
meaning: Whether the page's domain falls under the extended news preview rules, and its status.

name: faviconDisplay
desc: Whether the favicon for a given domain should be displayed. FAVICON_DISPLAY_UNSPECIFIED - Display the favicon DISABLE_FAVICON - the favicon should not be rendered by the feature
meaning: Whether the site's favicon may be shown next to the result.

name: firstseenDateSecs
desc: Firstseen date populated by indexing. It works as fallback to byline_date if it doesn't exist. Note that this will currently only be set for canonical documents where firstseen date could be populated.
meaning: The date indexing first saw the page, used when no byline date exists.

name: isAmp
desc: Only be true when the page itself is an AMP page. For paired AMP, the canonical page will have this bit as false.
meaning: Whether the page itself is an AMP page.

name: maxSnippetLength
desc: The max number of snippet characters allowed. Based on document markup. No limit if value is less than 0, Google could use any length of snippets. Default value 0 is the strictest restriction, to avoid violating mistakenly If not set, there is no snippet length policy to enforce. Features must first check has_max_snippet_length to avoid applying an overly strict policy.
meaning: The longest snippet allowed for this page, based on its markup.

name: maxSnippetLengthFromPublisher
desc: Same as the max_snippet_length, max_thumbnail_size, max_video_preview_secs listed above. But values are based on publisher's preferences from Search Console's robots meta tag tool.
meaning: Preview size limits taken from the publisher's Search Console settings.

name: maxThumbnailSize
desc: The max thumbnail size allowed. Based on document markup Default value NONE is the strictest restriction, to avoid violating mistakenly. If not set, there is no thumbnail policy to enforce.
meaning: The largest thumbnail allowed for this page.

name: maxVideoPreviewSecs
desc: The max seconds of video preview allowed. Based on document markup. No limit if value is less than 0, Google could show any seconds of video. Default value 0 is the strictest restriction, to avoid violating mistakenly If not set, there is no preview length policy to enforce. Features must first check has_max_video_preview_secs to avoid applying an overly strict policy.
meaning: The longest video preview allowed for this page.

name: snippetLengthSource
desc: Source of snippet length.
meaning: Where the snippet length limit came from.

name: thumbnailSizeSource
desc: Source of thumbnail size.
meaning: Where the thumbnail size limit came from.

name: videoPreviewSecsSource
desc: Source of video preview seconds.
meaning: Where the video preview length limit came from.

name: topCitiesVocabIds
desc: Compressed top locations and their scores.
meaning: The top locations linked to the document, with their scores, stored compactly.

name: confidence
desc: If global_label_value is present, confidence is ignored. confidence is DEPRECATED.
meaning: A deprecated confidence value attached to a label.

name: globalLabelBucket
desc: A byte-size value representing 64 * (1 + global_label_value). Use this instead of global_label_value to save on label storage. See quality_prose::LabelValueToBucket() for more info.
meaning: A compact bucketed form of the label's value, used to save storage.

name: labelId
desc: At least one of label_id and label_name must be filled in
meaning: The numeric id of the label.

name: feed
desc: This field is intended to be deprecated. If id == 0 and feed is true it means this label is from a feed. If id == 0 and feed is false, this label is from "Google" If id != 0, feed is meaningless.
meaning: A flag headed for deprecation saying the label came from a feed.

name: id
desc: We are currently using this field to indicate an id of the set of classifiers that produced this label. This deviates from the original intention. Also see ClassifierDescription and refer to
meaning: An id for the set of classifiers that produced the label.

name: labelBucket
desc: A byte-size value representing 64 * (1 + global_label_value). Use it instead of global_label_value to save on label storage.
meaning: A compact bucketed form of the label's value, used to save storage.

name: name
desc: This name will only sometimes be filled in! Frontends can in general expect this to be filled in, but it will not usually be stored in backends.
meaning: The label provider's name, often left empty in backends.

name: uxInterface
desc: An enum taken from GWSLogEntryProto that indicates what type of device a request came from. This includes an entry for DESKTOP(1), MOBILE(2), and TABLET(3) devices. Reference: - gwslog(608): GWSLogEntryProto.ux_interface
meaning: Whether the request came from a desktop, mobile, or tablet device.

name: uxTier
desc: Indicates the device browser tier for the given request. 1 means modern browsers, 3 means very old browsers, and 2 is everything in the middle. See Reference: - gwslog(609): GWSLogEntryProto.ux_tier
meaning: How modern the requesting browser is, on a three-step scale.

name: lookupKey
desc: The key used to lookup this data in the WSJ corpus. The WSJ data is sitechunk-level, however the documents in the MDU shards are simply urls. WSJ does a mapping from url -> {primary_chunk, secondary, fallbacks, etc.} and retrieves all the keys from the corpus. This lookup key field will keep track of which key was used for this particular lookup.
meaning: Which key was used to fetch this site's data from the corpus.

name: siteFrac
desc: What fraction of the site went into the computation of the site_score. Should be a number in (0, 1].
meaning: What share of the site's pages went into computing the site score.

name: siteScore
desc: Site-level aggregated keto score.
meaning: A site-wide aggregated keto quality score.

name: versionId
desc: Unique id of the version.
meaning: Which version of the keto data this entry is.

name: value
desc: The corresponding NSR value.
meaning: The site quality (NSR) value for one version.

name: versionId
desc: The unique id of the version, preferably just scaled: 19.1 x 10 = 191.
meaning: Which version this site quality value belongs to.

name: primaryChunk
desc: Primary NSR sitechunk. In most of the cases it's same as HOST_LEVEL_V3 sitechunked canonical url of the document. In rare, but important cases it's based on page markup (see quality/nsr/util/sitechunker.h for details).
meaning: The main site grouping key used to look up site-level data.

name: secondaryChunks
desc: Secondary NSR sitechunk. When present, it provides more granular chunking than primary sitechunks (see quality/nsr/util/sitechunker.h for details). Note that the NSRChunks class does not store trivial secondary chunks. Be aware of this when constructing NsrChunksProto from scratch.
meaning: Finer-grained site grouping keys used to look up site-level data.

name: siteChunkSource
desc: Annotated in the SitechunksAnnotator and copied over in NsrAnnotator.
meaning: Which pipeline stage produced the site grouping key.

name: confidence
desc: Confidence associated with the chunk.
meaning: How confident the system is in this topic group's numbers.

name: deltaNsr
desc: Subchunk delta in nsr.
meaning: How much this topic group shifts the site quality score.

name: pageWeight
desc: Weight with which this document belong to this subchunk (greater than 0).
meaning: How strongly this page belongs to the topic group.

name: type
desc: Type of this chunk. Eg, ymyl_health, d2v, etc.
meaning: Which topic group this chunk represents, such as health.

name: value
desc: The corresponding float value.
meaning: The decimal value of a signal for one version.

name: versionId
desc: Unique version id.
meaning: Which version this value belongs to.

name: value
desc: The corresponding int value.
meaning: The whole-number value of a signal for one version.

name: versionId
desc: Unique version id.
meaning: Which version this value belongs to.

name: intents
desc: The unique identifier for an Asteroid Belt document intent is being reused here
meaning: The list of intents assigned to an image.

name: scores
desc: The intent scores, scaled to integers between 0 and 100 for compactness.
meaning: The strength of each image intent, on a 0 to 100 scale.

name: imageIntent
desc: Intent of this proto instance.
meaning: Which intent this image classification entry is about.

name: remove
desc: Whether this intent should be removed when backfilling new classifications to the index. When backfilling a new version of a classifier to production we have cases where we actually want to
meaning: Whether this classification should be dropped when refreshing the index.

name: score
desc: Score of the intent.
meaning: How strongly the image matches this intent.

name: trigger
desc: Whether the intent triggered with the default threshold or not.
meaning: Whether the image intent passed its default threshold.

name: intents
desc: Intents with non-trivial scores.
meaning: The image intents that scored high enough to keep.

name: version
desc: Represents the version. Filled in Amarna (main version controller).
meaning: The version of the image intent data.

name: isVulgar
desc: Whether this snippet is a vulgar candidate.
meaning: Whether the snippet was flagged as vulgar.

name: snippetHtml
desc: The rendered snippet html.
meaning: The finished HTML of the snippet shown under the result.

name: source
desc: Source of the chosen snippet, decided in PORC. String value of quality.porc.TextSnippetCandidate.TextSnippetSource defined at google3/quality/porc/proto/text_snippet.proto
meaning: Which snippet generator produced the chosen snippet.

name: trailingEllipsis
desc: Whether this snippet has trailing ellipsis.
meaning: Whether the snippet ends with an ellipsis.

name: sectionName
desc: Section name of current snippet.
meaning: The page section the snippet fragment came from.

name: separator
desc: Separator to put before this tidbit.
meaning: The characters placed before this snippet fragment.

name: tidbitText
desc: Tidbit text for validation.
meaning: The text of a snippet fragment, kept for validation.

name: tokenBegin
desc: Tidbit token range in the section.
meaning: Where the snippet fragment starts within its section.

name: thirdPartyAccount
desc: Note google_account and third_party_account could both exist. For example, a user could share her Spotify account with other users registered on the same device.
meaning: A linked non-Google account tied to a user's contact data.

name: email
desc: Email address of the linked account (eg foo@outlook.com).
meaning: The email address of a user's linked third-party account.

name: thirdPartyProviderId
desc: Unique identifier for the third party provider. Defined by Google via AoG.
meaning: An identifier for the outside provider of a linked account.

name: accountProvenance
desc: Tracks the account owner of this contact. See go/cross-account-understanding.
meaning: Which account a personal contact record came from.

name: additionalContactMetadata
desc: Other metadata relating with the contact. This field is added so that the value can be copied to the corresponding field |additional_contact_metadata| in person.proto, that later will be logged to Assistant Interaction Event footprint from client side.
meaning: Extra metadata carried along with a personal contact for logging.

name: commonNameAliasConfidence
desc: Populated only if matched_name_type is GIVEN_NAME_ALIAS or FULL_NAME_ALIAS.
meaning: How confident the system is that a nickname matched a contact's name.

name: conceptId
desc: Concept id for relationships in query language, e.g. "Mother" in English, "Mère" in French. It's only populated for source = RELATIONSHIP.
meaning: An identifier for a family relationship word in the spoken language.

name: conceptIdEn
desc: Concept id for relationships in English, e.g. "Mother" for all non-English locales. It's only populated for source = RELATIONSHIP. It is used as the key to store relationship in memory (see
meaning: The English identifier for a family relationship word.

name: displayName
desc: TODO(shuaiwang) these are kept here temporarily because aqua regression tests are still referring to them, migrating aqua regression tests to use the new person_data field depends on binary change (i.e. this proto change) so there's a period we need to keep both.
meaning: A contact's display name, kept only for old regression tests.

name: ffracScore
desc: The ffrac score of the suggested contact from Starlight.
meaning: A ranking score for a suggested contact from an internal contacts service.

name: hasAddressForDeviceContacts
desc: Whether we have address info for this contact. IMPORTANT, READ BEFORE USING THIS FIELD: - This is a temporary solution to export this info for device contacts. - This could only be set for device contacts, contacts from other sources won't have this bit set even if there's address available inside person_data. - This will go away once Starlight supports device contacts, addresses will be available inside person_data the same way as Focus contacts. TODO(shuaiwang) remove after b/20412551
meaning: Whether an address is known for a contact stored on the device.

name: isFromOnDeviceLookup
desc: If the contact data is from on device lookup.
meaning: Whether the contact was found by looking on the device itself.

name: isTransliteratedMatch
desc: Indicate the contact matches the transliterated query.
meaning: Whether the contact matched a spelled-out version of the spoken name.

name: isVisibleToGuestsRelationship
desc: If the lookup was done using relationship which is visible to guests. This value will only be set if lookup was done using relationship. E.g. user has a guest relationship (doctor) -> (John) And user says "call doctor", then this value will be true.
meaning: Whether the relationship used to find the contact is visible to guest users.

name: matchSignal
desc: Populate only if AlternateSource is not NONE.
meaning: Details about how an alternate contact match was made.

name: matchedNameType
desc: LINT.ThenChange(//depot/google3/assistant/verticals/communication/\ fulfillment/proto/contact_logging_enums.proto, //depot/google3/assistant/api/dialog_state/values/person.proto, //depot/google3/assistant/context/proto/person.proto)
meaning: Which part of a contact's name was matched.

name: matchedRecognitionAlternateName
desc: Alternate name from recognition that has contact matched. Need this to make name correction history log consistent.
meaning: The alternate spoken name that ended up matching a contact.

name: personData
desc: Metadata such as name, email, phone, etc.
meaning: The contact's details such as name, email and phone number.

name: personalContactDataLog
desc: Log version of PersonalContactData. Holds e.g. FUZZY match results. It is populated in NamedContactFrame when fuzzy match is performed:
meaning: A logging copy of the contact match result.

name: pkgPerson
desc: Contains information about a Copley Person resolution (go/copley-people). This field is used to propagate metadata related to the resolved person, used for attribution and logging. Meaningful data (addresses, phone numbers) are copied into person_data.
meaning: Information about a resolved person record used for attribution and logging.

name: recognitionAlternateScore
desc: Populate only if AlternateSource is not NONE.
meaning: The score of an alternate speech-recognition contact match.

name: recognitionAlternateSource
desc: If not none, then it indicates the personal contact data is alternate and how the alternate is fulfilled.
meaning: How an alternate contact interpretation was produced.

name: relationshipLexicalInfo
desc: Lexical information for relationships in query language, e.g. "Mother" in English, "Mère" in French. It's only populated for source = RELATIONSHIP.
meaning: Wording details for relationship words in the user's language.

name: relationshipMemory
desc: Resolved relationship names and contact pointers from Assistant Memory. This field is populated into both relationship annotation (source = RELATIONSHIP) and Focus/device contacts retrieved by that contact name. The data from Assistant Memory comes from two different columns: ASSISTANT_SETTINGS and PWS_CONTACT_ANNOTATION. We support multiple people with same relationship (e.g. multiple brothers) by using a repeated relationship_memory field. Examples are at go/person-subgrammar-relationship.
meaning: Saved relationships and contact links remembered for the user.

name: sharedContactOwnerGaiaId
desc: Gaia ID of the user this contact belongs to. Only populates if contact is shared from another user. See go/shared-contacts-assistant. E.g. user A triggers the request and uses user B's contact data (which is marked as visible to user A). This field will be populated with user B's gaia id.
meaning: The account id of the other user who shared this contact.

name: source
desc: LINT.ThenChange(//depot/google3/assistant/verticals/communication/\ fulfillment/proto/contact_logging_enums.proto, //depot/google3/assistant/api/dialog_state/values/person.proto, //depot/google3/assistant/context/proto/person.proto) Data source of the contact data.
meaning: Where the contact data came from.

name: contactPointer
desc: The contact pointer. See
meaning: A reference to a stored contact record.

name: value
desc: The contact name copied from UserAttribute.value.
meaning: The contact name saved as a user attribute.

name: packedValue
desc: using fixed64 instead of uint64 saves ~14% is storage
meaning: The embedding numbers packed together to save storage space.

name: packageIdFingerprint
desc: Android package id of the application associated with this document (example: 'com.imdb.mobile'), encoded with the Fingerprint2011() function.
meaning: A hashed form of the Android app package name tied to this page.

name: perAppInfoEncoded
desc: A subset of the data in the PerAppInfo message, encoded to save on space. See quality/calypso/utils/app_info_utils.h for encoding/decoding.
meaning: App information squeezed into a compact encoded blob.

name: country
desc: 2-letter country format.
meaning: The two-letter code of a country this document is about.

name: salience
desc: How salient this country is for the document. [0,1] range.
meaning: How strongly the document relates to that country, from zero to one.

name: packedCountry
desc: Packed Country and salience optimized for index storage
meaning: Country codes and their salience values packed together for storage.

name: bigramDiscountTf
desc: The deduction of bigram counts from its unigram children. This field is only available in debug mode.
meaning: How much a two-word phrase's count is subtracted from its single words, debug only.

name: bigramness
desc: How much we trust this bigram. For bigrams only. Range: [0.0, 1.0] This field is only available in debug mode.
meaning: How much a two-word phrase is trusted, stored only in debug output.

name: centrality
desc: Measures how topical this term is to a particular signal. A term like "lincoln" in the Abraham Lincoln's Wikipedia page should have a centrality close to 1.0 while non-central terms like "florida" should have a centrality close to 0.0. Range: [0.0, 1.0] This field is only available in debug mode.
meaning: How central a term is to this source's text, stored only in debug output.

name: correctedTf
desc: The final term frequency for a particular term. This field is only available in debug mode.
meaning: The final adjusted count of a term, stored only in debug output.

name: expectedTf
desc: The term frequency we were expecting for a term given its IDF. Range: [0, observed_volume] This field is only available in debug mode.
meaning: The count a term was expected to have given its rarity, debug output only.

name: globalNpmi
desc: Global NPMI. For bigrams only. This is a measure of the quality of bigrams calculated using IDF. Range: [-1.0, 1.0] This field is only available in debug mode.
meaning: A corpus-wide quality measure for a two-word phrase, debug output only.

name: idf
desc: The IDF of the label of a particular term. For a canonical term, this is the mean IDF of its originals, weighted by their observed TF. This field is only available in debug mode.
meaning: How rare a term is across the corpus, stored only in debug output.

name: isBigram
desc: Whether or not this term is a bigram. This field is only available in debug mode.
meaning: Whether the term is a two-word phrase, stored only in debug output.

name: label
desc: Raw string that identifies a particular term. This field is only available in debug mode.
meaning: The raw text of the term, stored only in debug output.

name: localNpmi
desc: Local NPMI (normalized pointwise mutual information). For bigrams only. This is a measure of the quality of bigrams calculated using observed TF. Range: [-1.0, 1.0] This field is only available in debug mode.
meaning: A local quality measure for a two-word phrase, debug output only.

name: observedTf
desc: The observed term frequency in a particular signal. This field is only available in debug mode.
meaning: How many times the term appeared in this source, debug output only.

name: originalTerm
desc: The list of the original terms for a canonical. This is used in the pipeline and it is not present in the final output. This field is only available in debug mode.
meaning: The original spellings behind a normalized term, pipeline and debug only.

name: rawTf
desc: The raw term frequency in a particular signal. This field is only available in debug mode.
meaning: The unadjusted count of the term in this source, debug output only.

name: salience
desc: The measure of how important this term is in this signal. Range: [0.0, 1.0] This field is only available in debug mode.
meaning: How important the term is within this one source, debug output only.

name: source
desc: source is the type of the signal of this SignalTermData.
meaning: Which source this term data came from.

name: calibratedScore
meaning: A calibrated zero-to-one score for an entity annotation on the document.

name: equivalentMid
desc: in /m/ or /g/.
meaning: The knowledge-graph identifier of an equivalent entity.

name: score
meaning: A zero-to-one score for an entity annotation on the document.

name: languageId
desc: Use integers for fast scoring. Note: 26 is UNKNOWN_LANGUAGE_ID, 0 is UNKNOWN region, see i18n::languages::Language and StableInternalRegionconverter Use -1 as default for both.
meaning: A numeric language and region code kept for fast scoring.

name: fullTitle
desc: Field full_title may contain duplicate info from title and list_title.
meaning: The longer product title pulled out of a product block on the page.

name: imageDocid
desc: Ordering for
meaning: Identifiers of images in a product block.

name: title
desc: Product info extracted by Product Blocks go/sdu-shopping-page-intro and go/product-block-extraction. Here is an example of a page with a ## list_title (Shoes) and 3 blocks with their own titles: | Shoes | | ---------------------| |
meaning: The product title pulled out of a product block on the page.

name: count
desc: The number of web pages that contains the url in their breadcrumbs.
meaning: How many web pages list this address in their breadcrumb trails.

name: oslScore
desc: Score for normal oneline sitelink
meaning: A score for showing a plain one-line sitelink.

name: scrolltoScore
desc: Score for scroll-to sitelink
meaning: A score for showing a sitelink that scrolls to a spot on the page.

name: tocScore
desc: Score for table of contents sitelink
meaning: A score for showing a table-of-contents style sitelink.

name: urlFoundOnPage
desc: DEPRECATED. No longer populated, and not used anywhere.
meaning: A deprecated flag, no longer filled in or used.

name: dateExposureScore
desc: This is date_exposure after sigmoid transformation.
meaning: How prominently dates appear on pages of this kind, smoothed to a score.

name: dateVsContentageDistributionSkew
desc: Auxiliary scores. The unreliable_dates_score is a product of these scores excl. date_exposure. The definition for each of the scores you can find at go/unreliable-dates-dd
meaning: A component score comparing stated dates against page age.

name: petacatId
desc: go/verticals4
meaning: An internal identifier for the page's vertical category.

name: unreliableDatesScore
desc: This is a final score excl. date exposure component.
meaning: The final untrustworthy-dates score before the date-prominence part.

name: language
desc: Audio language of video classified by Automatic Language Identification. It corresponds to the first language (the highest confidence) in ALIResults.lang_results.
meaning: The spoken language detected in the video's audio.

name: speechClass
desc: Type of detected speech.
meaning: The kind of speech detected in the video.

name: clusterId
desc: The cluster_id represents the id of the set entity that WebRef provides.
meaning: An internal identifier for a group of related entities.

name: clusterSetScore
desc: Cluster set qref confidence score.
meaning: How confident the system is in the entity group interpretation.

name: clusterSiblingMid
desc: The mids of cluster members that are part of the same cluster. Note that cluster members may end up having their own interpretation (EntityInfo which includes a ClusterInfo) or not (eg because they do not explain the full query, and so aqua does not output an interpretation for them). The latter case (a cluster member is output only as part of this field), is equivalent to its score being 0.
meaning: Identifiers of other entities belonging to the same group.

name: score
desc: The score represents the score of the entity within the cluster.
meaning: How strong this entity is within its group.

name: amarnaDocid
desc: Should precisely match the amarna_docid in ContentBasedVideoMetadata.
meaning: An internal video document identifier.

name: asrRepair
desc: The results of ASR transcript quality analysis.
meaning: The outcome of checking how good the video's automatic transcript is.

name: lang
desc: The language of the transcript as recorded in Amarna.
meaning: The language the video transcript is written in.

name: timingInfo
desc: Timing information that maps sentence boundaries in the punctuated transcript with timing offsets for the start and end of those sentences.
meaning: Start and end times for each sentence in the video transcript.

name: begin
desc: Byte offsets in HTML. begin is inclusive and end is exclusive.
meaning: Byte positions marking where an annotation starts in the HTML.

name: createdDate
desc: This is the number of days since January 1st 1995 that this domain was last created. This should always fit in 15 bits.
meaning: The day the domain was last registered, counted from January 1995.

name: expiredDate
desc: This is the number of days since January 1st 1995 that this domain last expired. This should always fit in 15 bits. Jan 1st 1995 was chosen by the history project as a special epoch date. Both the registrationinfo dates and the linkage dates are measured in days since this epoch.
meaning: The day the domain last expired, counted from January 1995.

name: clusterList
desc: Token information of the embedding vector if available.
meaning: Grouping information about the parts of this embedding.

name: compressedValue
desc: Compressed value of the embedding. For example, different versions of starburst signals use different compressor to generate the value.
meaning: The embedding stored in a compressed form.

name: denseFeatureFloatValues
desc: Optional feature map output from the model. Note: this is not applicable to some models.
meaning: Extra feature numbers some models output alongside the embedding.

name: floatValues
desc: Values of the embedding vector.
meaning: The numbers that make up the embedding vector.

name: floatValuesBeforeProjection
desc: Optional embedding vector prior to projection. Note: this is not applicable to some models.
meaning: The embedding numbers before they were shrunk to fewer dimensions.

name: id
desc: Id of the cluster.
meaning: The identifier of an embedding cluster.

name: squaredDistance
desc: Squared distance of the current embedding to the cluster center.
meaning: How far this embedding sits from the center of its cluster.

name: clusters
desc: Clusters.
meaning: The list of clusters this embedding falls into.

name: deprecatedMagnitude
desc: Deprecated: use snippet_score instead
meaning: An old sentiment strength value, replaced by a snippet score.

name: deprecatedPolarity
desc: Deprecated: use snippet_score instead
meaning: An old sentiment polarity number that has been replaced by a snippet score.

name: snippetText
desc: This protobuffer is serving double duty as both a Mustang attachment and the response proto that gets returned by Mustang in the WWWSnippetResponse's info MessageSet. When stored as an attachment, this field will always be empty. However, when returned with the WWWSnippetResponse, Mustang will print and store the actual sentiment snippet's text here.
meaning: The actual text of a sentiment snippet, filled in only when a snippet is returned for display.

name: start
desc: begin and end are token offsets.
meaning: The token position where the snippet span begins.

name: title
desc: The text that represented this crumb in the document.
meaning: The visible text of one step in a breadcrumb trail.

name: url
desc: The URL linked from this crumb.
meaning: The address that one breadcrumb step links to.

name: playStoreAppType
desc: Top level app category type (GAME or APPLICATION). Copied from playwright.
meaning: Whether a Play listing is a game or an application.

name: currencyCode
desc: ISO 4217 currency code.
meaning: The currency an app price is quoted in.

name: price
desc: Price string converted from double value in a standard currency unit, like '199.35' or '1400'.
meaning: The app's price for one country as a plain number string.

name: language
desc: The chosen language
meaning: The language chosen for a set of app category tags.

name: localizedTg
desc: The TG tags matching the locale of the doc, if available
meaning: App category tags matching the page's language.

name: playwrightCategoryId
desc: Copied from the category_id field from Playwright docs. It helps decide which category to show in app ranking info.
meaning: The Play category used to decide which app ranking list to show.

name: index
desc: The set of indices in the Anchors::anchor() array that belong to the collapsed anchors.
meaning: Positions in the anchor list that were grouped together as one collapsed anchor.

name: collectionHrid
desc: The collection hrid for the category.
meaning: An internal identifier for the collection a category belongs to.

name: mid
desc: The mid of the entity representing the category.
meaning: The knowledge graph identifier of the entity that stands for this category.

name: description
desc: Only use for debugging, this should not be displayed to user or used for any kind of logic/processing.
meaning: A debugging-only text note about an annotation.

name: avgOpenWorld
desc: The average score for the open world for: - all ranges of this segment_type; - all capitalized ranges of this segment_type; - all uncapitalized ranges of this segment_type.
meaning: Average open-world score across text spans of one type, kept as pipeline statistics.

name: numRangesWithCandidates
desc: The number of ranges with candidates that made it past primary pruning for: - all ranges of this segment_type; - all capitalized ranges of this segment_type; - all uncapitalized ranges of this segment_type.
meaning: How many text spans still had candidates after early pruning.

name: tokenType
desc: The segment type.
meaning: Which kind of text span these statistics cover.

name: processorTimingsRoot
desc: Root/total of the timings from all the processors that worked on the given document or query.
meaning: Total processing time spent by the annotators on a document or query.

name: bookEditionIsbn
desc: Use varint encoding to save space.
meaning: The ISBN of a book edition, stored compactly.

name: confidence
