desc: Confidence of the category in the range [0.0, 1.0). If a page has the category "NBA" with high confidence we also expect it to have the "Basketball" with high confidence. Categories with a confidence lower than 0.05 are omitted. This can be interpreted as a confidence of 0, i.e. a strong signal that the category is not relevant for the page. For some categories this score is calibrated per-category to estimate the true precision. E.g., 70% of documents retrieved within the co
meaning: How confident the system is that a category describes the page.

name: cumulativeConfidence
desc: Calibrated cumulative confidence guaranteeing maxmial recall for a precision target. E.g., At least 90% of documents retrieved with cumulative_confidence >= 0.9 will be relevant. This score is always calibrated per-category to estimate the true cumulative precision and is not set for uncalibrated categories.
meaning: A calibrated confidence for the category aimed at a target precision.

name: experimentalConfidence
desc: Note: For testing the next version. May change at any time. Experimental confidence of the category in the range (0.0, 1.0).
meaning: A trial version of the category confidence that can change at any time.

name: isShoppingAnnotation
desc: Whether QPrime asserts that particular category.
meaning: Whether the shopping system asserts this category.

name: isSet
desc: If true, this entity is a synthetic entity created to represent a "set" in a cluster, i.e. to represent a set of entities (its children in the cluster graph) when we cannot disambiguate among them. This is similar to a KG Collection, but this is not in KG.
meaning: Flag marking an entity that was invented to stand for a group of entities.

name: ruleInstance
desc: Explanation of where this cluster, and this entity, come from. All entities in a cluster have this, not just entities that have been created because of the cluster.
meaning: A note on which rule created this entity cluster.

name: id
desc: Id of this rule; this is used to generate ids for the synthetic entities created for a cluster. Required.
meaning: The identifier of a clustering rule.

name: mid
desc: The mids of the entities that will be made into a cluster.
meaning: The entity ids that a clustering rule groups together.

name: rule
desc: The rule that this is an instance of. Required.
meaning: The clustering rule this instance came from.

name: relation
desc: The topic_property_name for the link that defines the relation, e.g. "/tv/tv_series_episode/series". Can start with a "!" to indicate that this link is reversed during extraction and we want the reversed case. Required.
meaning: The knowledge graph relation used to build a cluster.

name: rule
desc: The rule that this is an instance of. Required.
meaning: The relation rule this cluster instance came from.

name: target
desc: The one entity that the links of type R point to. Required.
meaning: The entity that the clustered relations point to.

name: midList
desc: Exactly one of these *RuleInstance fields needs to be present for clusters which have not been merged; it selects the specific kind of rule instance. For merged clusters both fields may be present.
meaning: Which kind of clustering rule produced this cluster.

name: propertyName
desc: The property corresponding to predicte_encoded_mid above. This is populated in some non-serving tables.
meaning: The name of a knowledge graph property, filled in only in non-serving tables.

name: debugEntity
desc: Optionally the freebase_mid of the WebrefEntity which the Component identifies via entity_index. This is purely to help humans diagnose the WebrefEntities structure, may not always be present and should not be used by production code. Use QueryJoinToMeaningStructConverter to compose a proper value in place of the component reference.
meaning: A human-readable entity id included only to help people read the data.

name: funcallName
desc: The WebrefEntity referenced by
meaning: The name of the referenced function-style expression.

name: index
desc: The index of the Component of the CompoundMention which has the mrf_index of this MRF expression in WebrefEntity. Required.
meaning: The position of the referenced part inside a compound mention.

name: nameTypeMask
desc: Bitfield of ConceptNameMetadata::NameType bits.
meaning: A packed set of flags describing what kind of name this is.

name: connectedness
desc: Represents how much the entity is connected/related to the other entities in the document. This signal partially influences the topicality score, but it is not totally aligned with it: an entity can be very related to the rest of the document, but not central for understanding it. Likewise, an entity can be central to understand a document, but not very related to the rest of the document. The value is in [0, 1].
meaning: How strongly an entity is related to the other entities on the page, which partly shapes topicality.

name: docScore
desc: How well the document scores for the entity. The score is unnormalized, and serves as a relative ranking signal between different documents for an entity.
meaning: How well a page scores for an entity, used to compare pages for that entity.

name: isAuthor
desc: True if the entity is the author of the document. This was mainly developed and tuned for news articles (e.g. /m/02x27qn on "www.vogue.com/article/flint-town-netflix") but is also popluated for other content (e.g. scientific articles). Important: the semantics of this field may change in the future or it might be removed and replaced with a different API. If you want to use this field, please reach out to ke-authors@ first.
meaning: Whether this entity is the author of the page.

name: isPublisher
desc: True if the entity is the publisher of the page (e.g. CNN on "
meaning: Whether this entity is the publisher of the page.

name: isReferencePage
desc: Set to true iff the entity matches the full URL of the document, meaning that it is a reference page or related page of the entity.
meaning: Whether the page's full address matches the entity, making it a reference page.

name: normalizedTopicality
desc: Representation of the topicality score that is normalized in [0, 1] and which sum over all entities in the document is 1. It represents the "proportion" of the document that talks about the entity. This score is less human interpretable as the bucketized topicality score (EntityAnnotations.topicality_score), but is more suited for some usages like aggregations.
meaning: The share of the page's overall topic that this entity accounts for.

name: profileUrl
desc: Contains the link to the author's profile url on the platform.
meaning: A link to the author's profile page on the site.

name: referencePageScores
desc: Signals used for mining new reference pages, set by the reference-page-scorer processor (that is turned off by default). This field is not populated, except for special reference page extraction runs.
meaning: Scores for finding new reference pages, normally not filled in.

name: relevanceScore
desc: Relevance score generated by a Machine Learning entity classifier. This signal is similar to topicality, but machine learning based and supported by EntitySignals, not Webref. See
meaning: A machine-learned score for how relevant the entity is to the page.

name: resultEntityScore
desc: How much support this mention received from the results for PostRef. This is populated only if explicitly requested and different from 0.
meaning: How much search results backed up this mention, filled in only on request.

name: displayName
desc: Per language display name from reliable sources.
meaning: Names for showing an entity, one per language, taken from trusted sources.

name: entityData
desc: The actual domain specific data. For example it can be freebase.Topic, repository_wikipedia.WikiJoin, ocean.WorkMetadata, geostore.Feature.
meaning: Raw entity data in whatever format its source system uses.

name: nonMidProperties
desc: Contains selected properties (from KG) whose values are not other entities (in which case they would be represented in link_info) but scalar values, possibly reachable through (multiple) CVTs.
meaning: Selected non-entity property values kept for debugging.

name: referencePage
desc: This field contains reference pages for this entity. A reference page is a page that is highly topical for this entity, which can be used to mine additional information about this entity. Example reference pages for Apple Inc. would be the composite docs for "
meaning: Pages strongly about the entity, stored as debug output.

name: relatedPage
desc: This field contains mined related pages for the entity. A related page is a page that is moderately topical for this entity (More details:
meaning: Pages moderately about the entity, stored as debug output.

name: confidenceScore
desc: The overall confidence that the entity is annotated somewhere in the document or query. For WebRef it is computed as a function of the mention confidences weighted by the importance of each mention, where for documents a mention is of greater importance if it occurs in the title, h1 or anchors. For QRef it is just the maximum of the confidence over all mentions. NOTE: You probably want to use the mention-level segment_mentions.mention.confidence_score field instead of this one.
meaning: Overall confidence that the entity really is mentioned in the page or query.

name: detailedEntityScores
desc: Additional information about how the entity relates to the page, for example whether it is a business entity which published the page.
meaning: Extra detail on how the entity relates to the page, such as being its publisher.

name: explainedRangeInfo
desc: All ranges explained by the entity or any other entity it implies. Used in the context of partial query interpretation (go/partial-understanding).
meaning: The parts of a query that this entity explains.

name: imageMention
desc: This is an experimental output for go/multiref. Don't use it without consulting the Webref team
meaning: Experimental record of the entity appearing in an image.

name: isImplicit
desc: An entity is marked as implicit if there is no explicit mention of the entity in the content of the page. For instance, all mentions of the entity are in query, url and/or anchors; or the entity has only implicit content mentions.
meaning: Whether the entity is only implied, with no plain mention in the page text.

name: isResolution
desc: True if the entity is an MDVC summary entity, i.e. it might not be mentioned directly on the query, but it is the product of resolving a set of explicit annotations. E.g. "2014 FIFA World Cup" can be the summary for the query: [soccer world cup in brazil] even though none of the names of the entity is mentioned on the query. Summary nodes can also be synthetic, i.e. have a /t/ mid, as they represent the intersection between a set of regular annotations. For more information, see
meaning: Whether the entity is a summary produced by combining other annotations.

name: segmentMentions
desc: All mentions of a given concept grouped by segments. For Webref, there are many different kinds of segment, such as content, title and anchors; while for QRef, there is only one segment called CONTENT. For QRef this field contains the primary output of the annotator, and for WebRef it together with topicality_score does.
meaning: All mentions of the entity, grouped by where they occur such as title or anchors.

name: topicalityRank
desc: Rank of the entity when sorted by topicality score.
meaning: The entity's place in the list when entities are sorted by topicality.

name: topicalityScore
desc: The WebRef topicality score of the entity for this document. This score indicates how related is the entity to the overall topic of the document. See
meaning: How closely the entity matches the overall topic of the page.

name: description
desc: A human-readable description of the entity. This can range from brief, machine-generated notes to lengthy human-written paragraphs from Wikipedia.
meaning: A readable description of the entity kept for debugging.

name: language
desc: The language (III LanguageCode) of the
meaning: The language of the debug description.

name: score
desc: Internal score to merge debug info. should not set in final entityjoins.
meaning: An internal score used only when merging debug information.

name: title
desc: A short human-readable name/title of the entity, similar to what is displayed at the top of a Hume page. Suitable to be displayed in a list.
meaning: A short entity name kept for debugging displays.

name: url
desc: Link to a page with more information about the entity (internal Hume page, external Wikipedia page, etc.).
meaning: A link to a page with more information about the entity, for debugging.

name: aggregateFlags
desc: The aggregate kind flags for the link.
meaning: Combined flags describing the kinds of a relationship between entities.

name: kindInfo
desc: Information about all the link kinds associated with the link.
meaning: Details of each kind of relationship attached to an entity link.

name: kgProperty
desc: KG-property if the SourceType is associated with a KG-property (TOPIC_PROPERTY, NEW_TOPIC_PROPERTY).
meaning: The knowledge graph property behind an entity relationship.

name: score
desc: Score in [0, \infty) that represents how relatively likely it is to see that entity cooccurring with the main entity (in the entity join). A value of 1.0 means that the two entities are basically independent. The higher the more likely (relatively to the individual entity probabilities) they are to cooccur.
meaning: How much more often two entities appear together than chance would suggest.

name: ratings
desc: Every entity name receives one or a few ratings from human raters.
meaning: Human rater judgments of entity names.

name: tags
desc: Multiple tags can be assigned to a rated entity name. The tags can be used when computing metrics in the Name Eval, so that different metrics are computed separately for different sets of examples that have the same tag.
meaning: Labels grouping rated names so evaluation metrics can be split by group.

name: comment
desc: Comment left by the rater to justify the rating decision.
meaning: A rater's written note explaining their judgment.

name: entityScore
desc: All the entity-name scores from that source. Keyed by the EntityNameScore.entity_id field.
meaning: All entity name scores contributed by one source.

name: type
desc: Describes where the data comes from.
meaning: Which system the name data came from.

name: explainedRange
desc: All ranges explained by the entity.
meaning: The stretches of text that an entity accounts for.

name: mention
desc: SegmentMention describing the occurrence of the token in the document.
meaning: The mention record showing where the text occurs in the document.

name: domain
desc: The domain name of the website, e.g. "play.google.com".
meaning: The website domain a region-specific name score applies to.

name: region
desc: The region in the III standard (
meaning: The region a name score applies to.

name: scoreRatio
desc: Score ratio for the entity, same as the EntityNameScore score ratio.
meaning: The entity's share of the name score for a given region or site.

name: bookEditionMetadata
desc: For a book entity, store its book editions metadata. Used by Juggernaut to do /book/book_edition recon, see ariane/265006. This field is used by Juggernaut only.
meaning: Book edition details used only by one internal reconciliation system.

name: categoryInfo
desc: Information about category types of the entity.
meaning: The category types that apply to an entity.

name: clusterMetadata
desc: Metadata about clusters.
meaning: Details about the entity cluster this entity belongs to.

name: displayInfo
desc: Information for displaying the entity in applications.
meaning: Information used to show the entity in products and interfaces.

name: entityScores
desc: Additional scores for the entity.
meaning: Extra numeric scores attached to the entity.

name: equivalentEntityId
desc: An entity in KG that represents the same (or equivalent) entity in the real world. In particular, this is used for mid-forwarding: when de-duping entities in KG, the old ids represent the exact same entity as the one they were merged with. So when we see one id in the query and the other in a document, they are treated as the same entity.
meaning: Other ids meaning the same real-world thing, so query and page mentions can match.

name: geoMetadata
desc: Geo-specific entity metadata.
meaning: Location-specific details about an entity.

name: kcAttributeMetadata
desc: Metadata related to KC attributes and Question & Answer triggering.
meaning: Details tied to knowledge attributes and question-and-answer triggering.

name: latentEntities
desc: A list of entities that are latent given this entity. For example, "Lionel Messi" can have the latent entity "FC Barcelona". The latent entity links are materialized in an offline pipeline using r/w/scripts/latent_entities/latent-entities.pq. For more information, see go/latent-entities.
meaning: Other entities strongly implied by this one, such as a player's club.

name: mdvcMetadata
desc: Metadata about MDVC.
meaning: Details about the multi-document meaning resolution system.

name: otherMetadata
desc: Other metadata.
meaning: A catch-all slot for other entity metadata.

name: primaryRecording
desc: The primary recording mid of a recording cluster entity. Used by Juggernaut to do /music/recording recon, see b/139901317. The primary recording is unique to a recording cluster. This field is used by Juggernaut only.
meaning: The main recording id for a music recording group, used by one internal system.

name: productMetadata
desc: Products-specific entity metadata. Only available in QrefMetadata output.
meaning: Product details for an entity, present only in query annotation output.

name: specialEntityType
desc: # LINT.ThenChange( //depot/google3/repository/webref/evaluation/query/metrics/util.cc)
meaning: A field whose description is only a source code maintenance note.

name: supportTransferRules
desc: Metadata about support transfer rules defined for this entity.
meaning: Rules describing how support is passed between related entities.

name: id
desc: The category ID from verticals4. See go/verticals4 and where we read them in
meaning: The identifier of a topic category from the vertical classification system.

name: score
desc: The relative weight of the category within a distribution.
meaning: How heavily this category weighs among the categories assigned.

name: forwardingUrl
desc: Urls that forward to this url. Used for url -> topical entity entries.
meaning: Addresses that redirect to this page.

name: language
desc: i18.languages.Language enum defined in i18n/languages/proto/languages.proto UNKNOWN_LANGUAGE
meaning: A language code used when building fingerprints.

name: index
desc: The segment index.
meaning: The position number of a text segment within the document.

name: address
desc: Stores parent/container information containing city, province & country.
meaning: The postal address plus containing city, province and country of a place entity.

name: addressSynonyms
desc: This field is only provided through the online qref interface (QrefMetadata). This is a fairly simple extraction from the /geo/type/feature/address_proto_blob triple.
meaning: Simplified address variants for a place, provided only by the online query-reference interface.

name: areaKm2
desc: Area in km^2 of the feature if the feature has polygon. Only set by qrefmetadata.
meaning: The size in square kilometers of a place that has a mapped boundary.

name: bound
desc: The tight bounds of this feature. Note that these are different from the FeatureProto.bound field.
meaning: The tight rectangular map bounds of a place entity.

name: countryCode
desc: Country code of the country of the entity. Only available in qref-metadata.
meaning: The country code of the entity, available only in query-reference metadata.

name: location
desc: The geographic location (center) and geometry of this entity. See geostore.FeatureProto for more details.
meaning: The center point and geometry of a place entity.

name: name
desc: The best name from Oyster for this entity. Is only included for some types of entities, and is a trimmed version of the proto (some fields are cleared).
meaning: The best display name for a place entity taken from Google's geo database.

name: oysterId
desc: The oyster id of the entity
meaning: The internal geo database identifier for the entity.

name: stableIntegerCountryCode
desc: Numerical country code, converted with i18n/identifiers/stableinternalregionconverter.h. It is the same as country_code, but it is available in the annotator model (and takes less space).
meaning: A numeric form of the entity's country code used inside the annotator model.

name: timezone
desc: Timezone if the feature is contained inside one.
meaning: The time zone the place falls inside.

name: wpLocation
desc: Information about the geographic location (center) extracted from the wikijoins.
meaning: Location coordinates for the entity pulled from Wikipedia joins.

name: type
desc: The type of the geocoded address. e.g. Road, Lake, Ocean, building. This comes from TypeCategory field in geostore/base/proto/feature.proto
meaning: A code saying what kind of place an address refers to, such as road, lake or building.

name: canonicalDocid
desc: The (canonical) image docid of the ImageData this image query is part of. Useful for identifying the ImageData even after doc_images are updated in between Webref annotation runs. Use docid only when canonical_docid == 0.
meaning: The canonical image document id that this image query belongs to.

name: imageIndex
desc: WARNING: The doc_images in docjoins are subject to updates including non-deterministic reordering of doc_images and their image_nb_data extensions. This means that without re-running WebrefAnnotator one cannot rely on the accuracy or even consistency of either image_index or query_index when parsing a cdoc from docjoins. In those situations one ought to rely on canonical_docid (or docid when canonical_docid is absent viz. 0). The index of the source image in CompositeDoc::doc_images.
meaning: The position of the source image in the document's image list.

name: queryIndex
desc: Queries index in ImageData::image_data_navboost.
meaning: A pointer to the matching query inside the image navboost data.

name: index
desc: Index within the proto. Several indices are necessary in case of nested repeated fields. The data can be accessed as follows: TOPICS: topic_annotations.kg_schema_topic(index(0)) .property_value(index(1)) .value(index(2)); TRIPLES: reconcile_request.triple(index(0));
meaning: Positions used to locate a piece of data inside a nested annotation structure.

name: equivalentAttributeId
desc: Equivalent kc attribute id for the given entity if applicable. E.g. for Daughter (/m/029wnx) this will be 'kc:/people/person:daughter'.
meaning: The equivalent knowledge card attribute id for this entity.

name: debugId
desc: A human friendly identifier (collection hrid). NOTE: The field name is a misnomer, this is the preferred field to use in production.
meaning: A readable identifier for a knowledge graph collection.

name: id
desc: Identifier of the collection, usually a MID (/m/xyz or /g/zyw). NOTE: In most cases, this is not the id that should be used, debug_id is the preferred identifier. The main reason is the this is not a stable id (mid for collection sometimes shift around).
meaning: The machine id of a knowledge graph collection, noted as not stable.

name: beginOffset
desc: Begin byte offset relative to the full original query.
meaning: The starting byte position of a range inside the query.

name: direction
desc: Direction defines the relation between the measurable aspect and the facet.
meaning: How a measurable aspect relates to the facet mentioned in the query.

name: endOffset
desc: End byte offset relative to the full original query.
meaning: The ending byte position of a range inside the query.

name: facetMid
desc: The mid of the facet associated with ASPECT category.
meaning: The knowledge graph id of the facet tied to an aspect in the query.

name: additionalBeginOffset
desc: The byte offset of the beging of the additional lightweight token match. e.g. the prefix pattern of the circumfix.
meaning: Start byte position of an extra matched token piece such as a prefix.

name: additionalEndOffset
desc: The byte offset of the end of the additional lightweight token match. e.g. the suffix pattern of the circumfix.
meaning: End byte position of an extra matched token piece such as a suffix.

name: beginOffset
desc: The byte offset of the begin of the lightweight token match within each range. The default value of -1 (std::string::npos) means that there's no affix or adposition detected.
meaning: Start byte position of a matched affix, or -1 when none was found.

name: endOffset
desc: The byte offset of the end of the lightweight token match within each range. The default value of 0 means that there's no affix or adposition detected.
meaning: End byte position of a matched affix, or 0 when none was found.

name: patternId
desc: Matched pattern Id which will be used to retrieve back pattern features. Pattern id is only populated for Enricher model.
meaning: The id of the matched text pattern, used to look its features back up.

name: sourceEntityIndex
desc: The index of the source entity in the resulting WebrefEntities or WebrefEntitiesWrapper, to which the lightweight token rule is applied. This field is only populated at the end of Qref scorer when we are sure which source entity should output.
meaning: Which candidate entity the token matching rule was applied to.

name: type
desc: The type of the lightweight token match, which provides the semantic information.
meaning: What kind of small token was matched, giving its grammatical role.

name: domain
desc: The domain name from which results come, e.g. "play.google.com".
meaning: The website domain the name data came from.

name: fprintModifier
desc: FprintModifier describing the formatting of the string. If fprint_modifier is set, then original_string, language and region should not be set.
meaning: A descriptor of how the string was formatted.

name: language
desc: The language in the III standard (
meaning: The language of the string.

name: region
desc: The region in the III standard (
meaning: The region of the string.

name: sourceType
desc: Which querybase pipeline the data comes from.
meaning: Which internal query data pipeline supplied this string.

name: dimension
desc: Undergoing migration into the PerVertical message. Avoid using it. Concept ids of MDVC dimensions of this concept.
meaning: Concept ids of the dimensions of this concept, marked as being migrated away.

name: expandedOutputConceptId
desc: Undergoing migration into the PerVertical message. Avoid using it. List of encoded mids to be expanded in WebRef/QRef output whenever this entity gets annotated. Will be populated in the annotators once static data is deprecated. b/78866814.
meaning: Extra concept ids to output when this entity is annotated, marked as being migrated away.

name: generalization
desc: Undergoing migration into the PerVertical message. Avoid using it. Concept ids of MDVC generalizations of this concept.
meaning: Concept ids of broader concepts for this one, marked as being migrated away.

name: isSynthetic
desc: True iff the topic is synthetically created during by MDVC extraction.
meaning: Marks a topic that was created automatically during concept extraction.

name: perVertical
desc: Data, specific to particular verticals.
meaning: Concept data split out per vertical such as shopping or local.

name: resolutionPriority
desc: Undergoing migration into the PerVertical message. Avoid using it. Resolution priority for this entity. In case a query has many possible resolutions, only the ones with the highest resolution priority are annotated.
meaning: Which entity resolutions win when a query has several, marked as being migrated away.

name: compatibleIds
desc: Concept ids compatible with this topic: specializations and/or ones having this concept as a dimension. Always includes the topic itself.
meaning: Concept ids compatible with this topic, always including the topic itself.

name: dimensionIds
desc: Concept ids of the dimension values of this topic.
meaning: Concept ids of the dimension values of this topic.

name: expandedOutputIds
desc: Concept ids to annotate whenever this entity is annotated.
meaning: Extra concept ids that get annotated whenever this entity is annotated.

name: generalizationIds
desc: Concept ids of the generalizations of this topic.
meaning: Concept ids of broader topics for this one.

name: isCore
desc: True if the topic is considered a "core topic" for the vertical.
meaning: Marks a topic as a main topic for its vertical.

name: isDimension
desc: If true, the entity is a dimension for some entities in the vertical.
meaning: Marks the entity as acting as a dimension for other entities.

name: isGeneralization
desc: If true, the entity is a generalization for some entities in the vertical.
meaning: Marks the entity as acting as a broader concept for other entities.

name: resolutionPriority
desc: Resolution priority for this entity. If there are many possible resolutions to a MDVC understanding, only the ones with the highest priority are annotated.
meaning: Priority deciding which entity resolutions get annotated when several are possible.

name: verticalName
desc: Name of the vertical this message is about.
meaning: The name of the vertical this block of concept data applies to.

name: addedByCloseAnswers
desc: Whether this mention was created by CloseAnswers on Postref. This bit is populated into corresponding intent_query through Aqua.
meaning: Marks a mention that was added later by the close answers system.

name: additionalExplainedRange
desc: If the mention's range is discontinuous, additional ranges that are a part of the mention but are not included in the begin/end range above.
meaning: Extra text ranges belonging to a mention that is split into pieces.

name: begin
desc: The [begin, end) byte offset, compatible with the Goldmine DocState representation. - For CONTENT, TITLE, META_CONTENT_TAG and IMG_ALT_TAG segments, the offsets are relative to the beginning of the document content. - For ANCHOR, QUERY, URL, IMAGE_QUERY, CONTEXT_ENTITY, CONTEXT_QUERY, SPORE_GRAPH, INSTANT_QUERY and VIDEO_TRANSCRIPT segments, the offsets are relative to the beginning of the corresponding (sub-)segment or text from doc attachment. The (indexing.annotations.goldmine) options are ma
meaning: The byte position where an entity mention starts in the document or query text.

name: beginTokenIndex
desc: The [begin end) token offsets in the Goldmine DocState. They follow similar rules as "begin" and "end" above, but for tokens rather than byte offsets. These fields are currently only populated by the query annotator.
meaning: The token position where an entity mention starts, filled only for queries.

name: compoundMention
desc: For a compound mention, the references to the entity and mention of the components. Each compound_mention claims one or more 'mrf' fields from the WebrefEntity owning this mention. Use QueryJoinToMeaningStructConverter to expand compound mentions into complete MRF.
meaning: References to the parts that make up a multi-part entity mention.

name: confidenceScore
desc: A probabilistic score describing how certain the annotator is that this exact range in the document or query refers to the entity. Probability that a mention is correct corresponds to confidence score roughly as follows: 0.3 -> 75% 0.5 -> 87% 0.7 -> 89% 0.9 -> 94% 1.0 -> 98% However if you consider all mentions with a score above 0.3, then most of these will have scores close to 1, so the overall precision of these mentions is around 95%.
meaning: How sure the annotator is that this exact stretch of text refers to that entity.

name: debugInfo
desc: Debug information.
meaning: Debugging details about a mention.

name: detailedMentionScores
desc: Additional detailed scores about this mention.
meaning: A breakdown of additional scores for an entity mention.

name: evalInfo
desc: Information used by the evaluation tools to mark mentions annotations as correct/incorrect. This will never be annotated in production (would be nice if was, though :-)).
meaning: Human evaluation marks on a mention, never produced in production.

name: interpretationNumber
desc: DEPRECATED and not populated anymore.
meaning: A deprecated field that is no longer filled in.

name: isImplicit
desc: True if the entity is mentioned implicitly. Note that a mention can be implicit
meaning: Marks an entity that is referred to indirectly rather than named outright.

name: lexicalAnnotation
desc: Provides a Wordgraph lexical signals for the mentioned range so it can be use in LooseParsing. Please don't use this field before consulting wordgraph-team.
meaning: Word level linguistic signals for the mention range, used by query parsing.

name: lowConfidence
desc: Qref & Postref only: Set to true for candidates part of qref candidate output for which there was no mention in qref. Internal to qref and LooseParsing. Do not use outside of these systems.
meaning: Marks a weak candidate used only inside query annotation internals.

name: matchingText
desc: Refcon-only: Annotated span in Refcon-normalized textual format, corresponding to the [begin end) offset interval in the CDoc. It will only be populated for CDocs originated from Docjoin extraction.
meaning: The annotated span in normalized text form, only for documents from doc joins.

name: nameMetadata
desc: Metadata attached to the name.
meaning: Extra details about the name used in the mention.

name: perMentionLightweightToken
desc: Provides concised access to all matched MatchedLightweightToken.
meaning: A compact view of all small token matches for the mention.

name: personalizationContextOutputs
desc: Additional personalization output scores about this mention.
meaning: Personalization boost or penalty scores applied to this mention.

name: priorProbability
desc: The prior probability of the entity for this mention.
meaning: How likely the mention's wording refers to that entity before context is considered.

name: referenceScore
desc: Whether the mention is a reference (e.g. it could be resolved to an entity coming from personal data) or not, currently only used for personal resolutions. Scores from 0 (not a reference) to 1 (reference). Use at your own risk as they are subject to change, advised to talk to refx-personal first.
meaning: How likely the mention points at something from personal data.

name: resolutionScore
desc: Whether the mention is a resolution or not, currently only used for personal resolutions. Scores from 0 (not a resolution) to 1 (resolution). Use at your own risk as they are subject to change, advised to talk to refx-personal first.
meaning: How likely the mention resolves to a specific personal item.

name: stuff
desc: Assorted things that can be added to a Mention.
meaning: A catch-all container for assorted extra data on a mention.

name: subsegmentIndex
desc: Identifies the sub-segment where the annotation occurs. See SubSegmentIndex for details. Not present in QRef, also deprecated for URL segment types.
meaning: Which sub part of the document segment the mention sits in.

name: trustedNameConfidence
desc: Confidence that this name is a trusted name of the entity. This is set only in case the confidence is higher than an internal threshold (see ConceptProbability).
meaning: How confident the system is that this wording is a trusted name for the entity.

name: begin
desc: Like begin/end, begin_token_index/end_token_index above.
meaning: The starting position of an extra range belonging to a split mention.

name: entityIndex
desc: The indices to identify the entity within the WebrefEntities.entities, the segment within its EntityAnnotations.segment_mentions, and the mention within that segment. entity_index is always guaranteed to be set, but segment_mentions_index and mention_index are omitted if the component reference is implicit.
meaning: The position of the referenced entity in the annotation list.

name: isHeadComponent
desc: The source of the compound has designated this component as the head. Only one of the components can be a head, but it's possible none are.
meaning: Marks one part of a compound mention as the main one.

name: component
desc: References to the component mentions which the MRF needs to be fully expanded. It is guaranteed that for a given set of components there exists only a single CompoundMention, i.e. the CompoundMentions are deduped to be unique so each set of components is present only once. The ArgumentValue of the WebrefEntity.mrf refer to these components via ComponentReference; it is guaranteed there are as many components as the MRF expression refers to.
meaning: The parts that a compound entity mention is built from.

name: mrfIndex
desc: The WebrefEntity.mrf indices which this compound applies to. There can be at most one CompoundMention which claims an MRF index, but it is possible there are MRF expressions which are not claimed by any CompoundMention.
meaning: Which meaning expressions this compound mention covers.

name: cleanText
desc: A clean version of text. This is mostly used for compatibility with other Goldmine annotators.
meaning: A cleaned copy of the mention text for debugging.

name: infoString
desc: Optional debug information.
meaning: Free form debugging notes.

name: snippet
desc: A snippet of the parsed text (html tags removed) in the page around this mention. Useful for human evaluation of the quality of the annotations. Outputted by WebrefAnnotator if --webref_output_mention_snippet_size is set to a value greater than 0.
meaning: A snippet of page text around the mention, produced only for human review.

name: text
desc: Original UTF-8 document text occurring in the range [begin, end).
meaning: The original document text inside the mention range, kept for debugging.

name: atmWeight
desc: Weight of the mention used in the ATM score.
meaning: The weight this mention carries in an internal evaluation score.

name: rating
desc: The aggregate numerical rating of this mention. 0.0 means completely incorrect, and 1.0 completely correct.
meaning: A human rater's score for whether the mention is correct.

name: isCorrectRange
desc: Set for mentions got from the new topicality template. True if the raters checked this range as being a good range for the entity. If the range is not correct we demote the mention score. This field is only used in template version V1. From template version V2 and forward it is now set via phrase_refer.
meaning: Whether raters judged the text range as a good range for the entity.

name: raterCanUnderstandTopic
desc: Whether rater can understand the topic.
meaning: Whether the human rater said they understood the topic.

name: ratingSource
desc: The source of the rating, possibly a golden set external to EWOK.
meaning: Where the human rating came from.

name: candidates
desc: List of per-candidate signals derived from annotation of this query.
meaning: Per candidate debugging signals from annotating a query.

name: query
desc: Query with region (language is set in parent NameInfo).
meaning: The query text used in this debugging record.

name: weight
desc: Query weight used in learning.
meaning: The weight a query carried during model training.

name: isMatchlessResultContext
desc: Whether the entity is purely from strong result entities, and is matchless in query annotation.
meaning: Marks a candidate that came only from result context with no query match.

name: mid
desc: Mid of the candidate entity or empty string for the full world.
meaning: The knowledge graph id of a candidate entity in debug output.

name: name
desc: Debug name of the entity (not usually populated).
meaning: A debug label for the entity, usually left empty.

name: mention
desc: The entities that were annotated on the context
meaning: The entities annotated in this piece of context text.

name: text
desc: The context (original) text.
meaning: The original context text.

name: weight
desc: The weight of the context on the document; depends on how many times we saw the string in the document.
meaning: How much weight the context carries on the document, based on repeat occurrences.

name: mid
desc: The entity the mention was referring to.
meaning: The entity that an n-gram mention referred to.

name: score
desc: The average score the mention was given across all occurrences of the n-gram.
meaning: The average score of the mention across all places the n-gram appeared.

name: featureType
desc: The Oyster feature type, which provides a rough categorization. This is a value of the enum geostore.FeatureProto.TypeCategory.
meaning: A rough category code for the type of place.

name: docFp
desc: In topicality ratings this is Fingerprint2011() of the normalized cdoc. - In query-mention ratings this is a hash of the QueryJoin. - In doc-content-mention ratings this is a hash of a QueryJoin in which the mention rating task has been embedded. -
meaning: A hash identifying the rated document or query.

name: url
desc: In topicality ratings this is the url of the document. - In query-mention ratings this is the query in format "en:US:query text". - In doc-content-mention ratings this is %x:%s where %x is the hex doc_fp of the cdoc (TODO(b/139799592) or sometimes the doc_fp below), and %s is the text of the eval range. - In entity-name ratings this is the MID of the entity.
meaning: The document url or query text that a rating applies to.

name: score
desc: Score corresponding to some kind of biasing strength which was applied. The exact semantics of this score is subject to further changes. Don't make assumptions about specific values or ranges. Values > 0 represents that a boost was applied. Values < 0 represents that a penalty was appled.
meaning: How strongly a personalization boost or penalty was applied.

name: outputs
desc: Detailed output scores per personalization type.
meaning: Personalization scores broken out by type.

name: isBypassedName
desc: There is a limit of entities per name for which we can keep name signals and score. This flag is set to true for names that by-passed per-name-scoring, as there were too many entities for the name.
meaning: Marks a name that skipped per name scoring because too many entities shared it.

name: isCompoundName
desc: This name is a generated compound name to pass primary pruning.
meaning: Marks a name that was built by combining other names.

name: isCompoundRetrievalKey
desc: Indicates special compound retrieval keys, like "Compound $mid1 $mid2"
meaning: Marks a special lookup key built from two entity ids.

name: isDictionaryTerm
desc: This is set to true if the entity corresponds to a dictionary term.
meaning: Marks a name that matches a dictionary word.

name: isEventRetrievalKey
desc: If true, this name is an event retrieval key.
meaning: Marks a name used as a lookup key for events.

name: isGeneratedName
desc: This name is generated from other names.
meaning: Marks a name that was generated from other names.

name: isGeneratedStreetname
desc: This name is a generated street name.
meaning: Marks a name that was generated as a street name.

name: isHierarchyPropagated
desc: This name is added by name propagation in hierarchy.
meaning: Marks a name that was inherited through a hierarchy.

name: isIsbn
desc: This name is an ISBN.
meaning: Marks a name that is an ISBN book number.

name: isLyricsContent
desc: This name comes from recording lyrics content.
meaning: Marks a name taken from song lyrics.

name: isPhoneNumber
desc: This name is a phone number.
meaning: Marks a name that is a phone number.

name: isRefconName
desc: This name is used for refcon.
meaning: Marks a name used by the reference resolution system.

name: isReferenceName
desc: This name is a reference name, only for internal usage, this name should not go into matching table without support of other signals.
meaning: Marks an internal only name that should not be matched without other support.

name: isRefpageUrl
desc: This name is the URL of a reference page.
meaning: Marks a name that is the web address of a reference page.

name: isReverseUniquePropertyName
desc: This name is generated from a reverse unique property of the entity.
meaning: Marks a name built from a reverse unique property of the entity.

name: isStrongIdentifier
desc: This name is a strong identifier for this entity.
meaning: Marks a name that uniquely identifies the entity.

name: isSynonymOrFuzzyMatch
desc: Set if the name is coming from synonyms.
meaning: Marks a name that came from synonyms or fuzzy matching.

name: isTrustedAllcapsName
desc: If true, this name is a trusted name if it is in ALLCAPS.
meaning: Marks a name that is trusted when written in all capitals.

name: isUnnormalizedName
desc: If true, do not do tokenization when compute fprint hash for this name.
meaning: Marks a name that should be hashed without being split into tokens.

name: notGeneratedName
desc: This name is clearly not generated(aka. at least one source of this name is not generated). This field is added for simplifying generated name tag while merging. Do not use this metadata directly.
meaning: Marks a name with at least one non-generated source; not meant for direct use.

name: originalNames
desc: Original versions of the name (before normalization). Used as query for the entity by Explicit Entity Search.
meaning: The original spellings of a name before normalization.

name: suppressTokenization
desc: Whether or not to suppress tokenization on this name.
meaning: Whether to skip splitting this name into tokens.

name: priorScore
desc: An unnormalized measure of how much evidence we have that this name variant refers to the key entity. Should be comparable to all scores from the same source for: - other entities having the same name variant - the open world score computed for this name variant
meaning: How much evidence there is that this spelling refers to that entity.

name: volumeBasedScore
desc: Prior score come from source that is quantifiable. artificial_score = prior_score - volume_based_score.
meaning: The part of a name's prior score that comes from countable sources.

name: scores
desc: Common prior_score/trust proto This field is shared by all sources providing this kind of data, the information has to be considered in context with the source.
meaning: The shared score block for a name variant from one source.

name: source
desc: The source of this NameVariantSignals proto
meaning: Which source supplied this name variant data.

name: count
desc: The total number of original names that a normalized name has (all versions from all different sources).
meaning: How many original spellings a normalized name has in total.

name: count
desc: The total number of different sources from where this version of the original name comes from.
meaning: How many sources supplied this exact original spelling.

name: score
desc: Score estimating how good this original name is: - some sources are considered more authoritative than others (e.g. KG) - a name found in more sources is better.
meaning: How good this original spelling is, based on source authority and frequency.

name: source
desc: The sources this name comes from.
meaning: The sources this spelling came from.

name: text
desc: One original name version.
meaning: One original spelling of the name.

name: source
desc: The sources the url was suggested by.
meaning: The sources that suggested this web address for the entity.

name: cpuInstructions
desc: Cpu instructions spent.
meaning: How many CPU instructions a processing step used.

name: name
desc: A string identifying the processor timing context.
meaning: The name of the processing step being timed.

name: processorCounters
desc: Document counters defined by processors. A processor can add and increment counters with NestedPerfCounter::IncrementCounterBy. See go/webref-annotator-metrics.
meaning: Counters that processing steps increment while running.

name: processorTimings
desc: Nested measurements, see NestedPerfCounter::ScopedPerfCounter.
meaning: Timings for nested processing steps.

name: wallTimeNs
desc: Wall time (in nanoseconds).
meaning: How long a processing step took, in nanoseconds.

name: productLineId
desc: Shopping product line ids (typically moka product line tag) of this entity. Represents shopping product lines, such as iPhone or Canon EOS. Typically, we expect only one id. But keeping repeated, in case we want to merge or aggregate product lines. Using int64, as tag_id in commerce/datastore/processors/moka/proto/moka_annotations.proto.
meaning: Shopping product line ids for the entity.

name: shoppingIds
desc: All ShoppingIds for this MID that need to be copied to IntentQuery (FunctionCall) if this MID is used in intent generation. See go/iql-shopping-ids for details.
meaning: Shopping identifiers copied along when this entity drives an intent.

name: variantClusterId
desc: All unique variant cluster ids (shopping's GPCs) of this entity.
meaning: Shopping variant cluster ids for the entity.

name: featuresIndex
desc: The set of indices in the NavBoostQuery::features() array that belong to the collapsed features.
meaning: Pointers to feature entries inside a navboost query record.

name: queriesIndex
desc: The index of the query in NavBoostDocument::queries() array.
meaning: The position of a query inside the document's navboost query list.

name: segmentMentions
desc: The actual mentions. Note SegmentMentions contains some fields specific to entity annotation, and those are typically not populated here.
meaning: The list of annotated mentions for these ranges.

name: type
desc: The type of ranges contained in this message.
meaning: What kind of ranges this record holds.

name: beginOffset
desc: Start index of range (within the segment) being annotated.
meaning: The starting position of the annotated range within the segment.

name: tokenCount
desc: Number of tokens in the range being annotated.
meaning: How many tokens the annotated range covers.

name: mentionSpan
desc: Per token mention spans.
meaning: Mention spans stored per token.

name: segment
desc: Segment types in which the mention appears. Now deprecated, because we only care about CONTENT segments.
meaning: The deprecated list of document segment types where the mention appeared.

name: shortToken
desc: Fingerprinted tokens which form the mention span. We are using 32-bit instead of usual 64bit fingerprints - this greatly reduces the memory footprint while still keeping the chance of collision reasonably low for our specific use case (1 in 4 billion).
meaning: Shortened hashes of the words making up a mention span.

name: token
desc: Fingerprinted tokens which form the mention span.
meaning: Hashes of the words making up a mention span.

name: aggregatedQueryCount
desc: Total query count for the document from all the query terms. Can be used to estimate the popularity of the document.
meaning: Total query count leading to the document, usable to estimate its popularity.

name: language
desc: Languages of the name, unknown language is not kept. TODO(b/145976266) Don't use the deprecated language enum.
meaning: The languages a name is known in.

name: namePrior
desc: Name prior to use. We read this from the prior for the "unknown" language.
meaning: The baseline likelihood that this name is used for the entity.

name: normalizedName
desc: The normalized name.
meaning: The cleaned up standard form of the name.

name: originalName
desc: Filled only if different than normalized_name.
meaning: The original spelling, stored only when it differs from the normalized form.

name: mention
desc: A list of all the places the entity in question was annotated within this segment. The (indexing.annotations.goldmine) option is for Goldmine AnnotationsFinder to include Mention only when segment_type="CONTENT"
meaning: List of every spot in this text segment where the entity was mentioned.

name: confidence
desc: Indicates how confident we are this extracted range is relevant to a document (document to be infered from context).
meaning: How sure the system is that an extracted date range actually applies to the document.

name: end
desc: End date extracted from the entity along end_source_property.
meaning: The end date pulled from the entity's knowledge graph data.

name: endSourceProperty
desc: KG-property that links the entity to the end date.
meaning: Name of the knowledge graph property that supplied the end date.

name: sourceEntityMid
desc: Entity from which this range was extracted.
meaning: Identifier of the entity the date range was taken from.

name: start
desc: Start date extracted from the entity along start_source_property.
meaning: The start date pulled from the entity's knowledge graph data.

name: startSourceProperty
desc: KG-property that links the entity to the start date.
meaning: Name of the knowledge graph property that supplied the start date.

name: anchorIndex
desc: Pointer to the exact set of anchors in the cdoc.
meaning: Pointer to a specific set of anchors in the document record.

name: genericIndex
desc: Pointer to the Webref-internal Segment indices. Can't be mapped back to the CDoc.
meaning: Pointer to internal segment positions that cannot be mapped back to the document.

name: imageQueryIndex
desc: Pointer to the exact set of image navboost queries in the cdoc.
meaning: Pointer to the image query entries stored in the document record.

name: jgnIndex
desc: Pointer to the proto in the cdoc and index within the proto for Spore.
meaning: Pointer to a specific internal record and position inside the document.

name: metaTagIndex
desc: Informs about the 'name' attribute of the referenced tag.
meaning: Tells which meta tag name the referenced tag position belongs to.

name: queryIndex
desc: Pointer to the exact set of queries in the cdoc.
meaning: Pointer to a specific set of queries in the document record.

name: allowWildcardIntents
desc: If set to true, allow STBR targets to trigger intents like ShowEntity that do not have explicit lists of allowed collections, accepting entities with any collections instead. This setting together with target_collection define what intents are allowed to be triggered by the STBR target. Be careful with setting this option to 'true', as in the case of our example the query [france] would result in the knowledge panel for the monarch. Louis XIV might've wanted such a behaviour, but you are probabl
meaning: Switch letting an entity transfer rule trigger panel style results for any entity type.

name: domain
desc: Name of Aqua grammar domain this STBR rule is restricted to. If the domain is set to anything other than "default", the STBR rule is only going to result in an annotation for the STBR target inside of the Aqua domain of the corresponding name. If there is no such Aqua domain, the rule is going to be ignored. The default value of string "default" for domain makes it possible for the STBR rule to be used inside Loose Parser.
meaning: Name of the grammar domain this entity transfer rule is limited to.

name: isReverseLink
desc: Whether this rule points from an STBR target to its STBR source. This field is an internal implementation detail that is not configurable by customers. Inside QRewrite we have to keep track of relations between entities. Among other things it is useful to remember which STBR target a given STBR source came from. For that purpose we attach an STBR proto to the STBR target, reversing the rule, i.e, putting STBR source's mid as the target etc. For this reversed rule we set is_reverse_link to true.
meaning: Internal flag marking a rule as the reversed copy of another rule.

name: mentionsOnly
desc: STBR doesn't just create annotations for STBR targets. It also can modify search result support (useful in PostRef) in order for web pages supporting the STBR source to also support the STBR target. Otherwise in PostRef annotations for STBR targets are going to be demoted, resulting in the STBR rule potentially not affecting anything. Regarding treatment of this result support, STBR has 3 possible modes that for historical reasons are represented as 2 booleans - mentions_only and support_share.
meaning: Setting that lets pages backing one entity also count as backing a related entity.

name: target
desc: Mid of the STBR target, e.g. "/m/04pwg" for Louis XIV.
meaning: The knowledge graph ID of the entity a rule points to.

name: targetCollection
desc: Collection that is going to be assigned to the target when the annotation for the target is created. This setting together with allow_wildcard_intents define what intents are allowed to be triggered by the STBR target. At the moment those annotations get created, we can not afford to fetch information about the STBR target from Topic Server, but the target mid by itself doesn't mean much for the Search stack. Setting up the collection for that annotated mid allows us to provide at least some inf
meaning: Entity type given to the transferred annotation, limiting what results it can trigger.

name: userCountry
desc: The user country this rule is for. Rules only take effect if the country is not set, set to an empty string or matches the country that is detected for the user - like the country user issued the query from. E.g. "US" for the United States.
meaning: Country the entity transfer rule applies to.

name: userLanguage
desc: User language this rule is for. Rules only take effect if the language is not set, set to an empty string or matches the language that is detected for the user's query. E.g. set it to "en" if you want the STBR rule to only work for users working from computers with English being set as the main language. Keep it unset if you want the rule not to depend on local language settings of user's computer.
meaning: User language the entity transfer rule applies to.

name: isReadable
desc: Signals about quality of data that was shown to raters. If document/query and concept description are readable.
meaning: Flag from human raters saying whether the text they were shown was readable.

name: experimentId
desc: The id of the experiment in case we are dealing with a refx data experiment. Should only be set in case of data experiments to gather topicality ratings, in order to allow separating these ratings from regular ratings.
meaning: ID separating experimental rating tasks from regular ones.

name: confidenceScore
desc: Triple annotation confidence_score (value between 0 and 1). Higher values correspond to higher confidence.
meaning: How confident the system is in a fact extracted from the page.

name: isImplied
desc: The information in this triple is implied by other triple(s) in the document.
meaning: Flag saying this extracted fact is implied by other facts on the page.

name: kgVerified
desc: Set to true if this triple is present in the webref model as either a link or property value. This implies that the information is in the Knowledge Graph. Note that it can happen that a triple is in KG but not present in the webref model.
meaning: Flag saying the extracted fact already exists in the knowledge graph.

name: mentions
desc: Occurrences of the triple on the document
meaning: Where on the page the extracted fact appears.

name: predMid
desc: The mid of the predicate kg-property(-ies). In order, in the case of multihop links.
meaning: Knowledge graph IDs of the relationship used in an extracted fact.

name: stuff
desc: Generic container to hold additional data such as signals, debug data etc. Data that can be stored in this field and their TypeIds: repository_webref::evaluation::ECMDebug (TypeId 192627933), defined in repository/webref/evaluation/triple_annotations/triple-diff.proto Debugging data to be used in WebIt's ECM report.
meaning: Generic container for extra or debugging data.

name: predMention
desc: Document mention of the predicate
meaning: Where the relationship part of an extracted fact appears on the page.

name: scopeBegin
desc: The [begin, end) byte offset of the document scope where this triple was annotated. This corresponds to a table row or a text sentence where the triple was identified. The sub_mention can be outside the scope when the subject is inferred from the table title.
meaning: Byte position marking the start of the text block a fact was read from.

name: scopeFprint
desc: Fingerprint2011 of space-joined SAFT tokens in the scope.
meaning: Hash of the text block a fact was read from.

name: stuff
desc: Generic container to hold additional data such as triple scoped signals. Data that can be stored in this field and their TypeIds: repository_webref::universal::webit::ScopeSignals (TypeId 192754198), defined in repository/webref/universal/processors/understanding/webit.proto
meaning: Generic container for extra data attached to a fact mention.

name: subMention
desc: Document mention of the subject
meaning: Where the subject of an extracted fact appears on the page.

name: valueMention
desc: Document mention of the value
meaning: Where the value of an extracted fact appears on the page.

name: idf
desc: IDF of the n-gram.
meaning: How rare a word or phrase is across documents.

name: pluralProb
desc: Probability that the n-gram is a plural form of a word. This information is extracted from SAFT annotations of queries. See HasPluralProperty().
meaning: Chance that a phrase is the plural form of a word.

name: docWeight
desc: The relative weight of the document, used when aggregating information from multiple documents.
meaning: How much weight this document gets when its annotation data is pooled with others.

name: ngramContext
desc: Extracted n-grams context scores (in cdoc language, weighted by doc_weight) output if webref_populate_annotation_ngrams is enabled.
meaning: Scores for phrases found around an entity mention, weighted by document weight.

name: numCandidates
desc: The total number of candidates.
meaning: Count of candidate entity matches considered.

name: numConceptsWithCandidates
desc: The total number of concepts with at least 1 candidate.
meaning: Count of concepts that had at least one candidate match.

name: numConceptsWithMentions
desc: The total number of concepts with at least 1 mention.
meaning: Count of concepts that had at least one mention.

name: numRangesWithCandidates
desc: The total number of RangeData objects with at least one candidate.
meaning: Count of text ranges that had at least one candidate.

name: statsPerType
desc: Statistics for each token type.
meaning: Breakdown of annotation counts by token type.

name: featureType
desc: Oyster Feature Type.
meaning: Internal map feature type code for a place.

name: index
desc: Indicates which entity this message belongs to: encoded_mid[index].
meaning: Position telling which entity in the list this metadata belongs to.

name: latE7
desc: Latitude and longitude of the location. Same format as geostore.PointProto.
meaning: Latitude and longitude of a place linked to the entity.

name: oysterId
desc: Oyster Feature ID of the location.
meaning: Internal map database ID for the place.

name: documentMetadata
desc: Information about the document copied from the docjoin. This will never be populated when WebrefEntities appears inside a CompositeDoc, but may we used when it stands alone.
meaning: Copy of document metadata carried alongside standalone annotations.

name: extensions
desc: Optional extensions (e.g. taxonomic classifications).
meaning: Open ended container for extra document annotation data.

name: webrefParsedContentSentence
desc: The content (CONTENT section 0) as parsed by WebrefParser. Only used by //r/w/postprocessing/idf/idf-pipeline for document ngram idf computation. Populated when the annotator is run with webref_populate_parsed_content Each webref_parsed_content_sentence represents one sentence of the context where saft annotations were used to determine the sentence boundaries. See r/w/universal/processors/saft/saft-sentence-helper.h for details.
meaning: Parsed page sentences kept only for an offline phrase statistics pipeline.

name: entityIndex
desc: The index of the entry in WebrefEntities.entity that the entity carrying this field is linked to. This field must be set.
meaning: Position of the other entity this one is linked to in the list.

name: linkMetadata
desc: Information about the link.
meaning: Details about the link between two entities.

name: linkWeight
desc: The weight of the link.
meaning: Strength of the link between two entities found on the page.

name: categoryConfidenceE2
desc: The confidence of the category. In the range [0, 100].
meaning: How confident the system is in a category assigned to the page, from 0 to 100.

name: categoryEncodedMid
desc: See go/category-annotations-api about the story behind various types of category annotations that are provided using the catmid token and category_encoded_mid fields below. Some of these annotation types are experimental, so please contact related-entities@ if you consider using this data. For production uses, please: 1. Add your use-case to go/hits-clients. 2. Subscribe to hits-users@ to receive general updates and info about deprecations. To convert it to the string form use metaweb::MidToStri
meaning: Category entity IDs attached to the page.

name: confidenceE2
desc: The confidence scores of all entities in the encoded_mid array. For space reasons this is also represented as a fixed-point integer with two decimal precision. Convert it to confidence_score using the following formula: float confidence_score = confidence_e2 / 100.0f Should have the same number of elements as the encoded_mid field.
meaning: Confidence scores for each entity found on the page.

name: encodedMid
desc: The int64-encoded MIDs of the entities in the document sorted by topicality score. To convert it to the string form use metaweb::MidToString(encoded_mid) defined in metaweb/util/mid/mid.h Should have the same number of elements as the topicality_e2 field.
meaning: The entities found on the page, listed in order of how central they are.

name: entityMetadata
desc: Per-entity metadata. Not packed (not every entity has metadata). If you'd like to add per-document metadata, see document_metadata instead.
meaning: Extra per-entity details attached to some entities on the page.

name: iqlAttachment
desc: A sub-proto to encode IQL expressions. To be used by Pianno page-level intents and Webref Compounds.
meaning: Encoded intent expressions attached to the page.

name: isAuthorIndex
desc: The indices of all the reference entities in encoded_mid that are authors of the page. Not packed as in most cases when populated, it contains 1 element.
meaning: Which of the page's entities are its authors.

name: isPublisherIndex
desc: The indices of all the reference entities in encoded_mid that are publishers of the page (e.g. /m/cnn on "
meaning: Which of the page's entities are its publishers.

name: referencePageIndex
desc: Only populated when the document is a reference page for an entity. Contains the indices of all reference entities in the encoded_mid and topicality_e2 arrays. Not packed as in most cases when populated, it contains 1 element.
meaning: Marks the page as the main reference page for one or more entities.

name: topicalityE2
desc: The topicality scores of all entities in the encoded_mid array. For space reasons this is represented as a fixed-point integer with two decimal points precision. Convert it to topicality_score using the following formula: float topicality_score = topicality_e2 / 100.f Should have the same number of elements as the encoded_mid field.
meaning: How central each entity is to the page, scored 0 to 100.

name: unboundIntentMid
desc: The uint64-encoded MID of the unbound intents generated by Pianno. An unbound intent is the annotation of an intent without slots arguments (e.g. Age) declared in Intent Catalog. See go/pianno-asteroid-belt-migration for details. We only keep the top unbound intents with the highest orbit scores. Should have the same number of elements as unbound_intent_score_e2.
meaning: IDs of general intents detected on the page without specific arguments.

name: unboundIntentScoreE2
desc: The confidence of the unbound intent. represented as a fixed-point integer with two decimal precision. In the range [0, 100]. Should have the same number of elements as unbound_intent_mid.
meaning: Confidence score for each detected page level intent.

name: dataEpoch
desc: The epoch of the Webref static data (the name-filter.data file). As of Dec 2020 in prod Goldmine (in webref_daily_full_model_static_data) this value is over from the alpha model static data, since this is where most of the parts come from. I.e. the value does not correspond to the actual model being used.
meaning: Timestamp of the static data files the annotator used.

name: utilStatus
desc: Error that occurred during the annotation. This field is only populated by QRef (i.e. under QueryJoin.status) and never by WebRef (i.e. under WebrefEntities.status) anymore, which instead reports errors (and soon also taints) through standard Goldmine mechanisms.
meaning: Error returned when annotation failed.

name: version
desc: The version number of the annotator (the cl the binary was built from). Must be enabled via a command line flag. See also the Goldmine's indexing::annotations::AnnotationMeta proto.
meaning: Build version of the annotator.

name: location
desc: The location as extracted from the wikijoins.
meaning: Coordinates for a place taken from Wikipedia data.

name: sourceUrl
desc: The source contains the url field from the wikijoins.
meaning: The Wikipedia source address the coordinates came from.

name: disjunctionId
desc: disjunction_id / is_positive
meaning: IDs of the OR clauses combined in this filter condition.

name: key
desc: key - a uint64 key that uniquely identifies this disjunction.
meaning: Unique numeric key identifying an OR clause in a filter.

name: tokenGroups
desc: groups - the group:token tuples that make up this disjunction. The disjunction will be active if
meaning: The tagged tokens that make up an OR clause in a filter.

name: disjunctions
desc: disjunctions is the set of OR clauses that
meaning: The set of OR clauses combined into one AND block of a filter.

name: isPositive
desc: If is_positive is set to false, then the entire disjunction is negated, and will be true only if none of its members is true.
meaning: Flag that flips an OR clause into a none-of-these condition.

name: tokenGroups
desc: token_groups - the group:token tuples that make up this disjunction. The disjunction will be active if
meaning: The tagged tokens that make up this OR clause.

name: conjunctions
desc: conjunctions is the set of AND-of-ORs blocks.
meaning: The AND blocks of OR clauses that define a filter.

name: conjunctions
desc: conjunctions - each conjunction is an AND-of-ORs; if any of these conjunctions match, then the entire restrict matches.
meaning: The AND blocks of a filter; matching any one matches the whole filter.

name: disjunctions
desc: disjunctions - each disjunction is an OR clause.
meaning: The OR clauses used by a filter definition.

name: subsKey
desc: subs_key - ignore. Only used for testing.
meaning: Test-only field that is otherwise ignored.

name: tokenGroups
desc: token_groups - group:token tuples, collated by group.
meaning: Filter tokens grouped by their group name.

name: debugTokenStrings
desc: debug_token_strings - (optional) strings that should be used for human-friendly printing. NOT used by the matching engine!
meaning: Human readable token strings kept only for printing, unused in matching.

name: name
desc: name - the name of the token group.
meaning: Name of a token group used in filters.

name: tokens
desc: tokens - a list of tokens, stored by their Fingerprint2011 hash.
meaning: The tokens in a group, stored as hashes.

name: namespace
desc: The name of this namespacey
meaning: Name of a custom filter namespace.

name: classLabel
desc: The class label of this datapoint. This should be populated if ScaM is being used for nearest-neighbor-based classification.
meaning: Label attached to a vector when it is used for classification.

name: dataIdStr
desc: Optional point id that can contain an arbitrary (unrestricted in content) value except when the data is provided via SSTable (sharded or not). In the case of SSTable the data
meaning: Optional free-form identifier for a data point.

name: expirationTimestamp
desc: A timestamp after which this datapoint is considered no longer valid and is eligible for deletion. The exact meaning varies with application/configuration.
meaning: Time after which the stored vector is treated as expired.

name: featureDim
desc: Optionally explicitly specifies the dimensionality of this vector. For dense vectors, this is ignored and, dimensionality is inferred from the number of values specified, and must be identical to this, or unspecified. For sparse vectors, the default value is correct for most users, and allows use of 64-bit hash values for feature indices. If you're using sparse vectors with a limited range of dimension indices and want to do K-Means clustering with them, you may want to specify this explicitly.
meaning: Optional explicit count of dimensions in the vector.

name: featureIndex
desc: for SPARSE vectors, specifies indices of the nonzero dimensions whose values are specified by the , , or field. This field is not used when specifying dense vectors.
meaning: Positions of the non-zero dimensions in a sparse vector.

name: featureType
desc: Describes the type of feature values.
meaning: Which data type the vector's values use.

name: featureValueFloat
desc: Actual feature vector. Only one of the following should be populated. This list has to be kept in sync with FeatureType enum. NOTES: Binary features are stored as ones or zeroes in feature_value_int64. Floating point values (feature_value_float, feature_value_double) may not be NaN.
meaning: The numeric values that make up the vector.

name: internalOnlyIsSecondaryPartition
desc: copybara:strip_begin INTERNAL USE ONLY! The ScaM Team reserves the right to remove this field and reuse its proto tag without notice. DO NOT USE outside of build_shards_pipeline! This field is used inside build_shards_pipeline to indicate whether this GFV is residing in its secondary (vs. primary) partition. copybara:strip_end
meaning: Internal-only flag about which partition a vector sits in.

name: normType
desc: Describes if data has been normalized and the type.
meaning: Whether and how the vector's values were normalized.

name: queryMetadata
desc: copybara:strip_begin A field that contains metadata information when the datapoint is acting as a query. copybara:strip_end
meaning: Extra information carried when a vector is used as a query.

name: restrictTokens
desc: copybara:strip_end_and_replace reserved 15;
meaning: Filter tokens attached to a vector.

name: userinfo
desc: This field allows application-specific metadata to be stored in a GFV. This information may be used by custom binaries or in pre- or postprocessing outside of ScaM. Use cases include but are not limited to:
meaning: Free-form application data stored alongside a vector.

name: weight
desc: DEPRECATED fields. Ignored by ScaM binaries. Do not use.
meaning: Deprecated field that the system ignores.

name: crowdingAttribute
desc: The value of the crowding attribute for this document. The maximum number of neighbors to return per crowding attribute value (per_crowding_attribute_num_neighbors) is configured per-query. This field is ignored if per_crowding_attribute_num_neighbors is larger than the total number of neighbors to return for a given query.
meaning: Grouping value that caps how many similar results come back per group.

name: squaredL2Norm
desc: The squared L2 norm of the original (pre-fixed-point transformation) GFV. Used for computing squared L2 distance.
meaning: Stored vector length used when computing distances.

name: definition
desc: DEPRECATED
meaning: Deprecated filter definition.

name: easyDefinition
desc: DEPRECATED
meaning: Deprecated simplified filter definition.

name: tokenMembership
desc: B) Token Definitions (V1 Restricts) In "forward" mode: defined on database points In "reverse" mode: defined on queries
meaning: Older style filter tokens attached to points or queries.

name: tokens
desc: DEPRECATED
meaning: Deprecated token filter set.

name: v3
desc: Only ONE of the following sections should be used: A) V3 restricts. Defined in //research/scam/proto/restricts.proto
meaning: The newer style filter attached to a vector.

name: v3CompatibleNamespace
desc: If this field is not empty, when query is in V1 restricts while database is in V3 restricts, SCaM will update V1 query to V3 automatically instead of sending error messages. When updating query from V1 to V3, SCaM server will use this field to fillin the 'namespace' field.
meaning: Namespace used when auto-upgrading an old style filter to the new one.

name: whitelistToken
desc: C) Whitelist / Blacklist Definitions (V1 Restricts) In "forward" mode: defined on queries In "reverse" mode: defined on database points
meaning: Allow-list tokens used by older style filters.

name: docid
desc: Data point for which we computed nearest neighbors. This field is set based on the data_id_str field in the QueryRequest GFV (or SSTable key if data_id_str is not present), and thus can be arbitrary data, e.g. docid, URL, query string.
meaning: Identifier of the data point whose nearest neighbours were computed.

name: metadata
desc: Metadata about the query. This field is populated if and only if: 1) ScaM is running in offline query-database or online mode and; 2) The metadata is directly fetched from the userinfo field inside GFV and; 3) MetadataConfig.userinfo.set_user_info_for_query is set to true. The field name is kept as "metadata" for consistency with neighbors.
meaning: Extra query information copied through from the stored vector.

name: neighbor
desc: All its neighbors.
meaning: The nearest neighbours that were found.

name: neighborSelectionOverride
desc: Propagate neighbor selection override information during offline search.
meaning: Overrides for how neighbours were selected, carried through offline search.

name: query
desc: The query vector for which we computed nearest neighbors.
meaning: The query vector used for the neighbour search.

name: retrievedVersion
desc: The version ID of the server that responded to this query, if one was specified. This field is not populated for offline (i.e. Flume rather than RPC) search.
meaning: Version ID of the server that answered the query.

name: crowdingAttribute
desc: If crowding is enabled, the crowding attribute of this neighbor will be stored here.
meaning: The grouping value of a returned neighbour.

name: distance
desc: This could be exact or approximate distance.
meaning: How far a neighbour sits from the query vector.

name: docid
desc: Neighbor data point. This field is set based on the data_id_str field in the GFV of the data point in the database (or SSTable key if data_id_str is not present), and thus can be arbitrary data, e.g. docid, URL, query string.
meaning: Identifier of a returned neighbour.

name: gfv
