desc: The field isn't populated by default, but when enabled (eg, in the ground-truth pipeline), this field provides the original database GFV corresponding to this result.
meaning: The original stored vector for a returned neighbour, when enabled.

name: metadata
desc: Metadata about the neighbor. This is returned under some configurations as a serialized proto. The specific proto depends on which metadata is configured to be returned.
meaning: Extra stored information about a returned neighbour.

name: approxEpsilonDistance
desc: The distance threshold to use for approximate search before exact reordering is performed, if exact reordering is performed. If this is not set and exact reordering is enabled, a reasonable default value will be chosen using a heuristic specified in ScamConfig.ExactReordering.NeighborSelectionOverrideHeuristics. This field is ignored if exact reordering is not enabled. This value must be non-NaN if set.
meaning: Distance cutoff for the fast pass before exact reranking.

name: approxNumNeighbors
desc: The number of neighbors to find via approximate search before exact reordering is performed. If this is not set and exact reordering is enabled, a reasonable default value will be chosen using the heuristic specified in ScamConfig.ExactReordering.NeighborSelectionOverrideHeuristics. This field is ignored if exact reordering is not enabled. This value must be > 0 if set.
meaning: How many neighbours the fast pass keeps before exact reranking.

name: epsilonDistance
desc: The maximum distance at which to return a neighbor. If this proto is used, at least one of this and num_neighbors must be set. The default is infinity, effectively returning num_neighbors neighbors regardless of distance. This value must be non-NaN if set.
meaning: Maximum distance at which a neighbour may be returned.

name: numNeighbors
desc: The maximum number of neighbors to return. If this proto is used, at least one of this and epsilon_distance must be set. The default is the largest value representable as an int32, effectively returning all neighbors within epsilon_distance. This value must be > 0 if set.
meaning: Maximum number of neighbours to return.

name: numSingleShardNeighbors
desc: If populated, this is the maximum number of neighbors that may be returned from a single shard. If not populated, up to num_neighbors neighbors are returned from each shard. Setting this to a smaller value than num_neighbors will increase speed at the expense of accuray by requiring cross-shard merging of fewer neighbors. If this value is set, num_neighbors must also be set and this value must be <= num_neighbors and >= num_neighbors / number of shards. If set, this value must always be > 0.
meaning: Cap on how many neighbours may come back from any single shard.

name: perCrowdingAttributeNumNeighbors
desc: The maximum number of neighbors to return for a single value of the crowding attribute. The crowding attribute is specified per-datapoint in the GenericFeatureVector proto, or the Document proto for sparse logistic models. Crowding is described more thoroughly in research/scam/utils/crowding_top_n.h. NOTES: Crowding is effectivley enabled if this value is less than num_neighbors.
meaning: Cap on neighbours returned per grouping value.

name: perCrowdingAttributePreReorderingNumNeighbors
desc: The maximum number of neighbors to return from the approximate portion of the nearest-neighbor search algorithm, within each shard, for a single value of the crowding attribute, before performing exact reordering. Ignored if exact reordering is disabled for this dataset.
meaning: Cap on neighbours per grouping value before exact reranking.

name: scoringExtensionMetadata
desc: The scoring extension metadata overrides for single machine classical scam database.
meaning: Overrides for the scoring add-on in a single machine setup.

name: treeXHybridCentersToSearch
desc: Note: currently not implemented for all database shard subclasses! Contact ScaM before using. Provides prematched centers_to_search for tree-X hybrid searchers. Ignores any overwrites related to centroid matching since they are already matched.
meaning: Pre-selected cluster centres for a hybrid search index.

name: treeXHybridLeavesSearchedOverride
desc: Note: currently not implemented for all database shard subclasses! Contact ScaM before using. Overrides max_spill_centers for tree-X hybrid searchers configured with FIXED_NUMBER_OF_CENTERS spilling. The max_spill_centers in the ScaM config is used if this field isn't set. Only valid if:
meaning: Override for how many index leaves a hybrid search reads.

name: namespace
desc: The name of this namespace.
meaning: Name of a numeric filter namespace.

name: op
desc: This MUST be specified for queries and must NOT be specified for database points.
meaning: Comparison operator used by a numeric filter on queries.

name: valueInt
desc: NOTE: Integers are represented in 64 bits here, but if all integer values for a given namespace fit in a narrower integer type (e.g. int8), we use the narrower integer type internally, increasing performance.
meaning: Integer value used by a numeric filter.

name: cpuTime
desc: An estimate of the CPU time used for this query on the machine associated with task_id, from when the query was received to when the response was ready to send, in seconds. Caveats: 1. Does not account for CPU time spent serializing, deserializing, compressing or decompressing protos within Stubby. 2. Does not account for cleanup time after response has been sent.
meaning: Estimated CPU seconds a machine spent on a query.

name: taskId
desc: Task number associated with response time measurements.
meaning: Machine number the timing numbers belong to.

name: wallTime
desc: Wall time taken on the machine associated with task_id from when the query was received to when the response was ready to send, in seconds. This time excludes the time spent sending the response and the time to perform cleanup operations after the response is sent.
meaning: Elapsed seconds a machine spent on a query.

name: latency
desc: Debugging fields: The wall and CPU time used by each query on each machine. For successful queries, there will be one entry here for each machine that the query used if QueryRequest.enable_latency_stats was enabled. For unsuccessful queries, the contents of this field will be undefined. NOTE: The following accounting rules apply in batched mode, assuming there are
meaning: Per-machine timing numbers kept for debugging a query.

name: numDeadlineExceededMachines
desc: The number of non-root machines for which a DEADLINE_EXCEEDED error occurred when they were contacted. This value does NOT include machines for which no reply was received because their parent machine timed out. Therefore, num_total_machines may be larger than num_ok_machines + num_unreachable_machines + num_deadline_exceeded_machines.
meaning: How many machines timed out while serving a query.

name: numOkMachines
desc: Number of machines that contributed to the results; this might be less than the total number of machines if a machine has failed. The impact of a single machine failure could be larger than just one machine, if it happens to be one of the machines involved in distributing the query and collecting results.
meaning: How many machines successfully contributed results.

name: numTotalMachines
desc: The number of machines used in this service for the dataset that was queried. If everything went right, this should be equal to num_ok_machines. If num_ok_machines < num_total_machines, some neighbors may be missing from results.
meaning: How many machines the queried dataset runs on.

name: numUnreachableMachines
desc: The number of non-root machines for which an UNREACHABLE error occurred when they were contacted. This value does NOT include machines that were implicitly unreachable because their parent machine was not reachable. Therefore, num_total_machines may be larger than num_ok_machines + num_unreachable_machines + num_deadline_exceeded_machines.
meaning: How many machines could not be reached for a query.

name: restrictStats
desc: The number of "active" datapoints for each dataset, i.e. points that are whitelisted by restricts and could be returned if they were close enough to the query. For successful queries, there will be one entry here for each dataset queried, if QueryRequest.enable_restrict_stats was true. For partially-successful successful queries, this field will contain results
meaning: Counts of how many data points passed the query's filters.

name: results
desc: The results for each dataset searched. If per_dataset_parameters was empty in QueryRequest then this will have one entry, the results for dataset 0. If per_dataset_parameters was not empty in QueryRequest, this will contain the results for each dataset queried, in order corresponding to the order of QueryRequest.per_dataset_parameters.
meaning: The neighbour results for each dataset that was searched.

name: status
desc: USEFUL ONLY IN CUSTOM BINARIES. In the stock ScaM server binary, all errors are relayed via the RPC's status. Thus, if RPC's status is ok, this field is guaranteed to be ok and if RPC's status is an error, no QueryResponse will be returned. The status of this query. This is useful when using a batched postprocessing lambda, which may ignore erroneous subqueries, continue postprocessing the valid ones and return OkStatus. In this case, this field will inform the client of any invalid subqueries.
meaning: Status of the query, useful only in custom builds.

name: customRestrictStats
desc: The evaluation results for all custom restricts. It's up to the individual custom restrict implementation and configuration to populate this field accordingly.
meaning: Evaluation results reported by custom filter plugins.

name: directLookupDocidsCount
desc: The number of docids in the direct lookup request.
meaning: How many IDs a direct lookup asked for.

name: directLookupMatches
desc: The number of datapoints found for direct lookup request.
meaning: How many data points a direct lookup found.

name: evaluationInfo
desc: Information about the evaluation of the restricts for this query. Could be used for production (e.g., custom restrict pass certain information to the downstream). copybara:strip_end
meaning: Details about how the query's filters were evaluated.

name: numActiveDatapoints
desc: The number of datapoints that are whitelisted by restricts specified for this query, across all shards for which the query executed successfully. In other words, this represents the number of datapoints that could potentially be returned if they were close enough to the query according to the selected distance measure. If restricts are disabled, this will be equal to num_total_datapoints.
meaning: How many data points passed the filters and could be returned.

name: numTotalDatapoints
desc: The number of total datapoints in all shards of this dataset for which the query executed successfully. This is returned for convenience so that a ratio can be easily computed, and so that num_active_datapoints can be put in perspective for partially successful queries, i.e. queries where only some shards were successful.
meaning: How many data points exist in the searched dataset.

name: postScoringExtensionNumNeighbors
desc: The number of neighbors to return post scoring extension.
meaning: How many neighbours to return after the scoring add-on runs.

name: bytesBlocklistTokens
desc: If present, override |string_blacklist_tokens|.
meaning: Byte form block-list tokens that override the string version.

name: bytesTokens
desc: If present, override |string_tokens|
meaning: Byte form filter tokens that override the string version.

name: namespace
desc: //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// NAMESPACE - the string name of the namespace that this proto is specifying, such as "color", "shape", "geo", or "tags". Recall that your overall query is an AND across namespaces.
meaning: Name of the filter namespace this block describes.

name: stringBlacklistTokens
desc: New use cases should prefer |bytes_tokens|, go/fast/11#bytes-vs-string When migrate, need to be consistent in both dataset and query.
meaning: String form block-list tokens for a filter namespace.

name: stringTokens
desc: New use cases should prefer |bytes_tokens|, go/fast/11#bytes-vs-string When migrate, need to be consistent in both dataset and query.
meaning: String form filter tokens for a filter namespace.

name: uint64BlacklistTokens
desc: TODO(qhliao) rename to |uint64_blocklist_tokens| eventually.
meaning: Numeric block-list tokens for a filter namespace.

name: customNamespaces
desc: This field allows custom restrict extension. - It is up to the extension to decide whether OK to specify the same custom namespace more than once per instance of the V3Restrict proto. - Unrecorgniazed (in |V3RestrictsConfig.custom_restrict_namespace_configs|) and unregistered (in factory function registry) custom namespace name will fail dataset loading (instead of being ignored silently). See go/scam-restrict-plugin for more details.
meaning: Custom filter namespaces plugged into the newer filter format.

name: namespaces
desc: A repeating field, where each entry specifies the set of tokens, within a single namespace, that apply to the query, or database point, on which this V3Restrict proto is defined.
meaning: Sets of restriction tokens attached to a query or data point for filtering nearest-neighbor lookups.

name: numericNamespaces
desc: This field allows restricts to be based on numeric comparisons rather than categorical tokens. HINT: To allow a range of values in a namespace (e.g. 42 <= x < 128), specify the same namespace twice in the query, e.g.: {namespace: "x" op: LESS value_int: 128 } {namespace: "x" op: GREATER_EQUAL value_int: 42 }
meaning: Numeric range restrictions used to filter candidates in nearest-neighbor search.

name: description
desc: catalog description
meaning: Text describing the data catalog that a dataset belongs to.

name: mid
desc: catalog mid
meaning: Knowledge Graph identifier for the data catalog.

name: name
desc: catalog name
meaning: Name of the data catalog a dataset came from.

name: url
desc: catalog url
meaning: Web address of the data catalog.

name: safeHtmlCitation
desc: The citation after HTML sanitation. Used only by the front-end.
meaning: A cleaned-up citation string prepared only for showing in the interface.

name: contentSize
desc: Size of the download, as a string from the provider. May include units.
meaning: Size of the downloadable file as the provider stated it.

name: downloadUrl
desc: URL for downloading the data
meaning: Link where the dataset file can be downloaded.

name: fileFormat
desc: File format at the link (ASCII, CSV, etc.)
meaning: The file format of the downloadable dataset, such as CSV.

name: fileFormatClass
desc: Pragmatic classification of file formats - for filtering purposes
meaning: A simplified file-format grouping used to filter dataset listings.

name: parsedContentSize
desc: Parsed content size
meaning: The download size parsed into a number and unit.

name: size
desc: Data size value, in the provided size unit
meaning: The numeric part of a data size.

name: unit
desc: The data size unit
meaning: The unit that goes with a data size number.

name: classificationSource
desc: The classification source that determines the field of study label.
meaning: Which classifier or source assigned the field-of-study label.

name: isAboveThreshold
desc: If set to true, it means that the probability is at least the threshold value specified from the corresponding saved model config. Thresholds for different fields may be different.
meaning: Whether the field-of-study confidence passed the required threshold.

name: label
desc: A label that represents the field of study.
meaning: A broad subject area label for a dataset.

name: probability
desc: A score between [0, 1] outputted from the classifier indicating the probability for being a YES instance.
meaning: Classifier confidence that the field-of-study label applies.

name: id
desc: A fingerprint id generated based on the license_class, URL or text. Since the knowledge graph requires a unique string id for the license but any filed of license can be empty, a fingerprint id can serve as a compact identifier representing the non-empty sub-fields.
meaning: A generated identifier standing in for a license record.

name: licenseClass
desc: A value from a controlled vocabulary that uniquely identifies a license. Unless this is set to LICENSE_CLASS_UNDEFINED_NO_MATCH or LICENSE_CLASS_UNDEFINED_CONTRADICTING_MATCHES other fields in this message should be empty.
meaning: A standardized code naming the dataset's license.

name: licenseMid
desc: mid for the license.
meaning: Knowledge Graph identifier for the license.

name: text
desc: The text (usually, the name) of the distribution license.
meaning: The written name or text of the license.

name: url
desc: The url for the distribution license.
meaning: Link to the license terms.

name: boxCoordinates
desc: Coordinates of the corners of the polygon in the form "lat1 long1 lat2 long2"
meaning: Corner coordinates of a rectangle covering the dataset's area.

name: circleCoordinates
desc: Coordinates for the circle area defined by its center and radius: "lat long, radius"
meaning: Center point and radius describing a circular area for the data.

name: containedInMid
desc: mids for locations that contain loctions in .
meaning: Identifiers of larger places that contain the dataset's locations.

name: locationMid
desc: mids for locations covering the dataset, contained in the . A region may contain multiple locations that are identified by mids.
meaning: Identifiers of the places a dataset covers.

name: locationMidLabel
desc: Labels (in the preferred language of the dataset) for the mids in .
meaning: Readable place names matching the location identifiers.

name: locationName
desc: The original name for the area covered by the dataset.
meaning: The original text name of the area the dataset covers.

name: pointCoordinates
desc: Latitude and longitude for a single point in the form of "lat,long".
meaning: A single latitude and longitude point for the data.

name: unformattedCoordinates
desc: Unformatted coordinates describing the region.
meaning: Raw, unparsed coordinate text describing the region.

name: impCount
desc: imp_count stores an estimate of the number of impressions for this tuple.
meaning: Estimated number of times this page was shown for this query.

name: lccCount
desc: lcc_count stores an estimate of the number of long clicks for this tuple. NOTE: It is similar to query_doc_count, but calculated in different manner.
meaning: Estimated number of long clicks recorded for this query and page.

name: query
desc: The query string.
meaning: The query text that these click counts belong to.

name: queryCount
desc: The query_count stores the counts on this query.
meaning: How many times this query was seen overall.

name: queryDocCount
desc: The query_doc_count stores the number of long-clicks on this pair.
meaning: Number of long clicks on this particular query and page pair.

name: organizationMid
desc: KG mid for the organization or person.
meaning: Knowledge Graph identifier for the organization or person behind a dataset.

name: organizationMidLabel
desc: Label (in the preferred language of the dataset) for the mid.
meaning: Readable name matching the organization identifier.

name: organizationName
desc: Unreconciled organization name. We store it here only if there are no organization_mid values present.
meaning: Plain organization name kept only when no entity match was found.

name: organizationUrl
desc: Original organization url
meaning: The organization's web address as given by the source.

name: originalOrganizationName
desc: Original name before reconciliation; empty if not reconciled.
meaning: The organization name as originally written before matching.

name: identifierFromSource
desc: An identifier as provided by the dataset itself.
meaning: An identifier the dataset gives for itself.

name: name
desc: The names of the dataset.
meaning: The names of the dataset.

name: doi
desc: The DOI for the dataset. We assume that there is only one.
meaning: The digital object identifier assigned to the dataset.

name: dateUpdated
desc: Most recent of the three dates (published, created, modified)
meaning: The most recent of the dataset's created, modified and published dates.

name: datePublished
desc: The date when the dataset was published.
meaning: The date the dataset was published.

name: alternateName
desc: Alternate names and acronyms for the dataset.
meaning: Other names or acronyms the dataset goes by.

name: locationReconciledForName
desc: Indicates if the location has been reconciled for the dataset name. This is used by LocationExtender to avoid re-annotating the dataset name.
meaning: Bookkeeping flag noting the dataset name was already checked for place names.

name: fieldOfStudy
desc: Field of study: a general, high-level classification of the dataset. This is only populated during indexing time and it is only populated if the classification_source is KNOWLEDGE_GRAPH or it's above inference threshold.
meaning: High-level subject classifications attached to the dataset.

name: sameAs
desc: Ids for other instances (not different versions) of this dataset.
meaning: Identifiers for other copies of the same dataset.

name: license
desc: License for the dataset.
meaning: License information for the dataset.

name: versionsSimhash
desc: A simhash value of the fields used for identifying versions of a dataset. This will be used by the VersionClusterInfoWriter.
meaning: A similarity hash used to spot different versions of the same dataset.

name: description
desc: Description of the dataset.
meaning: Descriptive text about the dataset.

name: isAccessibleForFree
desc: Indicates if the dataset is available for free or behind a paywal
meaning: Whether the dataset is free or sits behind a paywall.

name: coverageStartDate
desc: The start and end date that the dataset covers. If the dataset covers a single timepoint, then start and end dates are the same. Use the ISO 8601 format for dates (e.g., 2006-05-23).
meaning: The first date in the time range the dataset's contents cover.

name: versionEmbeddingVector
desc: An embedding for the dataset to be used by the VersionAggregator.
meaning: A numeric vector representing the dataset for version grouping.

name: authorList
desc: A string representation of the authors of the dataset, collected from author and creator in raw metadata. The exact format (e.g., comma-separated, etc.) is up to the extender that populates this field. The assumption is that this string may appear in the UI "as is".
meaning: A ready-to-display string listing the dataset's authors.

name: dateCreated
desc: The date when the dataset was created.
meaning: The date the dataset was created.

name: topSalientTermLabel
desc: Top salient term labels that describe the dataset document body.
meaning: The most prominent terms describing what the page body is about.

name: keyword
desc: Keywords describing the dataset.
meaning: Keywords describing the dataset.

name: hasCroissantFormat
desc: Indicates if the dataset has croissant format (
meaning: Whether the dataset is published in the Croissant format.

name: datasetClassificationScore
desc: Probability that the entity is in fact a dataset (in contrast to spam or website labelled as dataset that does not describe a dataset).
meaning: Probability that the page really describes a dataset rather than spam.

name: languageCode
desc: The 2-letter language code for the source page for the dataset. Same as the language code in source_url_docjoin_info. Populated only when generating output for indexing.
meaning: Language code of the page the dataset came from.

name: sourceUrlDocjoinInfo
desc: All the information extracted from docjoin, for the source_url of this dataset, aka DatasetMetadata.source_url.
meaning: Container holding web index data copied in for the dataset's source page.

name: compactIdentifierFromCitation
desc: Compact Identifier(s) extracted from the citation field. Like in the case of DOI(s) those identify the articles related to the dataset rather than the dataset itself.
meaning: Short identifiers pulled out of the citation text, pointing at related articles.

name: mentionedUrls
desc: Mentioned URLs in the description.
meaning: Web addresses mentioned inside the dataset description.

name: dateModified
desc: The date when the dataset was modified.
meaning: The date the dataset was last changed.

name: funder
desc: Funder of the dataset.
meaning: The organization that funded the dataset.

name: variable
desc: Variables that the data in the dataset captures (e.g., pressure, salinity, temperature). For now, these are just strings.
meaning: The measured variables the dataset contains.

name: numberOfDatasetsAtSourceUrl
desc: The number of datasets at the same source url as this dataset.
meaning: How many datasets sit at the same source address.

name: spatialCoverage
desc: Locations that describe spatial coverage of the data. If the data covers multiple locations then each value corresponds to one such location, describing its coordinates, mid, etc.
meaning: The geographic areas the dataset's data covers.

name: sourceOrganization
desc: Source of the dataset: unifies provider, creator, author, publisher etc.
meaning: The organization that produced or published the dataset.

name: doiFromCitation
desc: DOI(s) extracted from the citation field. In contrast to the "doi" field these DOIs identify the articles related to the dataset rather than the dataset itself.
meaning: Article identifiers pulled out of the citation text.

name: indexInCluster
desc: Index of this dataset in its cluster of replicas.
meaning: Position of this dataset within its group of duplicate copies.

name: dataDownload
desc: The dataset in downloadable form. There can be multiple data download entries for different file types.
meaning: The downloadable versions of the dataset in different file types.

name: scholarQuery
desc: Query string to send to Scholar to obtain the best approximation of citations to the dataset.
meaning: A prepared query string for looking up citations in Scholar.

name: catalog
desc: Catalog that this dataset is a part of.
meaning: The catalog record this dataset belongs to.

name: isBasedOn
desc: A resource (most likely another dataset) from which this dataset is derived or from which it is a modification or adaption.
meaning: Another resource this dataset was derived from.

name: versionClusterInfo
desc: Information on the version cluster that the dataset is a part of. This field is populated during the indexing time; the field is populated only if the dataset is part of a version cluster.
meaning: Details about the group of versions this dataset belongs to.

name: url
desc: urls for the dataset, including doi.
meaning: Web addresses for the dataset, including its DOI link.

name: replica
desc: The info of replicas of this dataset.
meaning: Details about duplicate copies of this dataset elsewhere.

name: isInferred
desc: Indicates whether the metadata was inferred using an ML model rather than from the schema.org fields. Use optional so that explicitly setting to false will ensure the value is passed along to the KG instead of being indistinguisable from being unset and thus not set in the KG. This field was originally non-optional; changing to optional is backwards compatible, but protos created prior to being optional won't have has_is_inferred() (go/proto-proposals/proto3-presence#wire-format-semantic-changes
meaning: Whether the metadata came from a machine learning guess rather than page markup.

name: scholarlyArticle
desc: For tables and figures, contains all of the metadata for a scholarly article that was the source of this table or figure. This field is populated only if metadata_type is 'TABLE' or 'FIGURE'.
meaning: Scholarly article metadata for a table or figure taken from a paper.

name: relatedArticleUrl
desc: The url for the article that (likely) describes this dataset.
meaning: Link to the article that likely describes this dataset.

name: basicFieldsHash
desc: A hash of the fields copied by BasicMetadataExtender and the importers. See cs/research/science_search/backend/extender/basic_metadata_extender.h for the list of fields.
meaning: A hash of basic copied metadata fields used to detect changes.

name: compactIdentifier
desc: Compact Identifiers (for example "RRID:SCR_002088") that can be resolved by Identifiers.org or N2T.net meta-resolvers.
meaning: Short resolvable identifiers for the dataset.

name: imageUrl
desc: The image urls provided by the dataset (e.g., for thumbnail images).
meaning: Image links the dataset provides, such as thumbnails.

name: licenseDeprecated
desc: License for the dataset. DEPRECATED
meaning: An older license field kept for compatibility; marked deprecated.

name: versionEmbeddingFieldsHash
desc: A hash of the raw metadata fields used by the VersionEmbeddingExtender.
meaning: A hash of the fields used to build the version embedding.

name: hasTableSummaries
desc: Indicates if the dataset has table summaries. This field is only populated during indexing time.
meaning: Whether the dataset has table summaries attached.

name: numberOfScholarCitations
desc: The number of articles that reference this dataset.
meaning: How many scholarly articles reference this dataset.

name: id
desc: A unique id for the dataset. For the data from Spore, this is the spore id, such as, for example "
meaning: The internal unique identifier for the dataset record.

name: measurementTechnique
desc: A technique or technology used in a Dataset corresponding to the method used for measuring the corresponding variable(s) (described using variableMeasured).
meaning: The method or technology used to measure the dataset's values.

name: sourceUrl
desc: Source url from which we gathered the metadata
meaning: The address of the page the dataset metadata was gathered from.

name: fingerprint
desc: The fingerprint of basic fields from DatasetMetadata, including: - name - description DEPRECATED
meaning: An old hash of the dataset name and description; marked deprecated.

name: descriptionInHtml
desc: Description of the dataset converted to HTML.
meaning: The dataset description converted into HTML.

name: datasetClassificationFieldsHash
desc: A hash of the raw metadata fields used by the QualityExtender.
meaning: A hash of the fields the dataset quality classifier looked at.

name: catalogName
desc: The name of the catalog that the replica comes from.
meaning: Name of the catalog a duplicate copy came from.

name: catalogUrl
desc: The url of the catalog that the replica comes from.
meaning: Web address of the catalog a duplicate copy came from.

name: indexInCluster
desc: The index of this replica in a cluster of replicas.
meaning: Position of this copy within its group of duplicates.

name: url
desc: Url for the replica.
meaning: Web address of the duplicate copy.

name: citation
desc: Proto containing all of the Scholar Metadata for this article.
meaning: Full scholarly metadata for the article.

name: figureOrTableImage
desc: contains the image of the figure or table cropped out of the pdf page encoded as a PNG.
meaning: A picture of a table or figure cut out of a PDF page.

name: figureOrTableOcrText
desc: Contains the text (as detected by OCR) contained inside the image of the figure or table.
meaning: Text read by OCR from inside a figure or table image.

name: landingPageUrl
desc: The url of the landing page for the scholarly article.
meaning: Web address of the article's landing page.

name: pageNumber
desc: The page number where the table and figure is located in the original pdf document.
meaning: Which page of the PDF holds the table or figure.

name: pdfDownloadUrl
desc: The url where the pdf file is located for the scholarly article.
meaning: Link to the article's PDF file.

name: displayUrl
desc: The url used to display in the google search results.
meaning: The web address shown to users in the search result.

name: docid
desc: The docid of the document.
meaning: The internal document identifier for the page.

name: indexTier
desc: Index tiers (BASE, UNIFIED_ZEPPELIN, etc) that the document belongs to. NOTE: Each document may belong to multiple tiers. NOTE: The original data type is an enum CompositeDoc::SubIndexType. However we don't want to depend on segindexer/compositedoc.proto because the proto is too large. Instead, we use CompositeDoc::SubIndexType_Name( subindexid) to convert into a string representation. To convert string back to CompositeDoc::SubIndexType, use CompositeDoc::SubIndexType_Parse.
meaning: Which index tiers the document is stored in.

name: languageCode
desc: The language of the document in the string representation of LanguageCode. Converts from Language Enum to LanguageCode through i18n/identifiers/langenclanguagecodeconverter.h Please use i18n/identifiers/languagecodeconverter.h for converting between LanguageCode and string representation.
meaning: The detected language of the document.

name: latestPageUpdateDate
desc: The syntactic date of a dataset document that reflects the publication date of the content.
meaning: The date on the page that reflects when its content was published.

name: navboostQuery
desc: A sequence of Navboost queries for the dataset source_url.
meaning: The list of queries and click counts recorded for the page.

name: pagerank
desc: The page rank of the document. DEPRECATED in favour of Pagerank_NS. Do not use as it is no longer maintained in docjoins and can break at any moment.
meaning: An old PageRank field that is no longer maintained.

name: pagerankNs
desc: The production pagerank value of the document.
meaning: The document's live PageRank value.

name: petacatInfo
desc: Petacat classifications for the web document. Normally the results from calling Petacat come in a PetacatResponse, which is very flexible and extensible. This proto takes most of the flexibility away - only rephil clusters, taxonomic classifications, and binary classifications, with discretized weights.
meaning: Topic classifications assigned to the web page by the Petacat classifier.

name: salientTerms
desc: A set of salient terms extracted fromthe document. DEPRECATEAD. Moved to DatasetMetadata for performance reasons.
meaning: An old copy of the page's prominent terms; marked deprecated.

name: scholarInfo
desc: Science per-doc data for inclusion in websearch.
meaning: Scholar-derived per-page data passed into web search.

name: sporeGraphMid
desc: A set of entities from WebRef annotations that are in SPORE_GRAPH.
meaning: Entities recognized on the page that exist in the science knowledge graph.

name: title
desc: The title of the document.
meaning: The title of the document.

name: topEntity
desc: A set of top entities from WebrefAnnotation, top is defined by topicality score, see go/topicality-score for detail. DEPRECATED. See label_to_mids_map instead.
meaning: An old list of the page's top entities; marked deprecated.

name: url
desc: The url of the document.
meaning: The web address of the document.

name: webrefEntity
desc: A set of entities copied from WebRefEntities on cDoc.
meaning: Entities recognized on the page, copied from the main document record.

name: deprecatedEntityType
desc: DEPRECATED. See entity_type instead.
meaning: An old entity type field replaced by a newer one.

name: description
desc: The English description of the mid from the KG.
meaning: The English description of the entity from the knowledge graph.

name: kgCollection
desc: HRID of the KG collections
meaning: Which knowledge graph collections the entity belongs to.

name: mid
desc: The KG identifier of the WebrefEntity.
meaning: The knowledge graph identifier of an entity found on the page.

name: indexInVersionCluster
desc: Index of this dataset in its cluster of versions.
meaning: Position of this dataset inside its version group.

name: numVersions
desc: The number of versions in a Version Cluster. This is equivalent to cluster size.
meaning: How many versions are in the dataset's version group.

name: versionClusterId
desc: A fingerprint id of the cluster of versions this dataset belongs to. This is a hash of a dataset_id in the cluster.
meaning: Identifier of the version group the dataset belongs to.

name: idata
desc: idata holds integer data under the attribute name, and could be interpreted differently according to the attribute name. Example: stores the ImadeData.docid used to generate thumbnails. idata will not be automatically converted into xml (the default behavior), but the behavior can be overwritten if necessary.
meaning: Whole-number data stored under a structured-data attribute, such as a thumbnail reference.

name: subobject
desc: A data object can have other data objects nested inside it. This is needed to represent Microformats and RDFa which have nestings e.g., a review with a business with an address, or a review with a rating object. See the Webmaster Central 2009/05 blog on "Introducing Rich Snippets".
meaning: A structured-data object nested inside another one.

name: tokenize
desc: Whether we should tokenize the value and cdata when generating restricts from this attribute.
meaning: Processing flag for whether the attribute's text is split into tokens.

name: value
desc: Either of cdata or value should be present.
meaning: The value held by a structured-data attribute.

name: language
desc: Audio language of video classified by Automatic Language Identification. It corresponds to the langid_result in S3LangIdSignals.
meaning: The spoken language detected in a video's audio.

name: languageConfidence
desc: Confidence interval of the recognized language.
meaning: How confident the language detection was.

name: speechClass
desc: Type of detected speech.
meaning: The kind of speech detected in the audio.

name: isAbuseWithHighConfidence
desc: This is used by Amarna to determine whether it should notify Raffia for immediate reprocessing. This field will be generated in Amarna's image_metadata corpus and exported to references_video_search corpus and written to ExportState.module_state.critical_metadata_checksum for determining whether Amarna should immediately notify Raffia whenever is_abuse_with_high_confidence's value changes.
meaning: Internal flag that triggers immediate reprocessing of a video.

name: videoClassifierOutput
desc: Output of all SafeSearch video classifiers in Amarna.
meaning: The combined output of the SafeSearch classifiers run on a video.

name: Number
desc: can be 1-3
meaning: A small numeric field on the citation record with unclear meaning.

name: Anchors
desc: All the anchor text (before, after, formal, etc) for this citation in the referring page.
meaning: The anchor text around a citation link on the referring page.

name: PMID
desc: Pubmed ID
meaning: The PubMed identifier of the article.

name: PatentCountry
desc: 2-letter country code where patent was issued, see ocean/metadata/patent_record.proto::Patent_Record::country_code for EPO one patent pertains to a list of countries.
meaning: Country codes where the patent was issued.

name: LegalCitation
desc: The ScienceCitation is how metadata passes through the scholar system. For legal, we use the normal ScienceCitation for the metadata/citation of legal journals. For court/government documents (like opinions or statues), we wrap it in the following embedded message
meaning: A wrapper holding court or government document details for legal records.

name: PublicationDay
desc: for patents, publicationD/M/Y is the date of issue, not application
meaning: The day of the publication or patent issue date.

name: FileCreationYear
desc: date of creation of the pdf/doc
meaning: The year the PDF or document file was created.

name: NumBackwardLinks
desc: for display in gws
meaning: How many works this article cites, kept for showing to users.

name: FileCreationMonth
desc: zero-indexed field
meaning: The month the PDF or document file was created.

name: PublisherAddress
desc: address from bibtex
meaning: The publisher's postal address.

name: VersionID
desc: Document version identifier - fingerprint of an id computed from the url, or of bibliographic data from a publisher. Different urls for the same article from the same source have the same version id (e.g., abstract, pdf version, and html version).
meaning: A fingerprint that identifies one article version across its different URLs.

name: ConferenceNumber
desc: 27 in the "27th conference on magical realism"
meaning: The sequence number of a conference, such as the 27th.

name: WorldViewable
desc: Is this version of the article world viewable?
meaning: Whether this version of the article can be read by anyone.

name: NumGoodEmbeddedRefs
desc: good embedded refs
meaning: How many usable references were found inside the document.

name: NumSectionRefs
desc: refs in marked section
meaning: How many references appear in a marked section of the document.

name: NumKeyQuotes
desc: for display in gws
meaning: How many key quotes are available, kept for showing to users.

name: AbstractCitationSource
desc: The source of abstract text that is chosen by science docid assigner.
meaning: Which source the chosen abstract text came from.

name: CitationSourceUrl
desc: url where record came from
meaning: The address the citation record was taken from.

name: PublicationVenue
desc: where published - subsumes booktitle, howpublished and journal from bibtex
meaning: Where the work was published, such as a journal or conference.

name: NumBackwardLinksFromLegal
desc: hack for legal rollout
meaning: A one-off count of citations from legal documents added for a rollout.

name: CrawledDocid
desc: If a citation is merged from a crawled version and a metadata version, keep the normal docid fp of the crawled version for clustering FP of normal docid of crawl version
meaning: The document identifier of the crawled version kept for grouping.

name: AbstractHtmlLeftOver
desc: Leftovers from AbstractHtml. These are usually unrecognized xml/html entities or xml/html tags
meaning: Leftover tags and entities that could not be parsed from the abstract.

name: NumForwardLinks
desc: for display in gws
meaning: How many works cite this article, kept for showing to users.

name: BorrowedFields
desc: OR of FieldType
meaning: Bit flags marking which fields were taken from another record.

name: PatentApplicationNumber
desc: Note that an issued patent has a PatentNumber and can also have a PatentApplicationNumber, whereas a patent application has a PatentApplicationNumber and can also have a PatentPublicationNumber.
meaning: The application number of a patent record.

name: TitleHtml
desc: Version of title for display. Contains unsanitized HTML/XML.
meaning: The article title kept with its original HTML markup so it can be displayed.

name: ClusterDiscoveryDate
desc: Used for logging, recommendations, and sort-by-date. Contains the earliest discovery date of the cluster, adjusted for earlier publication dates. Stored in Universal time scale (100 ns ticks since 0001 AD) because Unix timestamp would lead to negative dates for pre-1970 docs.
meaning: The earliest date the article group was discovered, used for logging and date sorting.

name: PublicationMonth
desc: month from bibtex PublicationMonth is a zero-indexed field (0 is January).
meaning: The month of publication.

name: CitationSrc
desc: DEPRECATED: use CitationSource
meaning: An old citation source field replaced by a newer one.

name: TranslatedAuthorListHasEtAl
desc: etal marker for the translated author list - just in case
meaning: Whether the translated author list ended with an 'et al' marker.

name: OtherID
desc: eg ERIC doc number or TR number
meaning: Some other identifier for the document, such as a report number.

name: CitationSource
desc: citation src: dblp/crossref/paper etc
meaning: Which source the citation record came from.

name: WOSID
desc: Web of Science ID
meaning: The article's identifier in the external Web of Science database.

name: NumBackwardLinksInWoS
desc: numcited in WoS
meaning: The cited-works count taken from Web of Science.

name: NumRelated
desc: for display in gws
meaning: How many related articles exist, kept for showing to users.

name: BaseLocalID
desc: Set when building an incremental index. Whereas BaseGlobalID is the ID of the corresponding base cluster, the local ID is the ID of an individual citation within that base cluster that corresponds to this reparse.
meaning: Identifier of the individual citation inside the base cluster.

name: CitationSourceCrawlTimestamp
desc: Seconds since the epoch, should be consistent with CitationSourceUrl.
meaning: When the citation source page was fetched.

name: ArxivSection
desc: e.g. hep-ph
meaning: The arXiv subject section of the paper.

name: OnlineMonth
desc: OnlineMonth is a zero-indexed field (0 is January).
meaning: The month the article appeared online.

name: PublisherOrg
desc: subsumes organization, school and institution from bibtex
meaning: Name of the publisher, school, or institution behind a scholarly article.

name: AbstractHtml
desc: Version of abstract field for display. Contains unsanitized XML/HTML.
meaning: The abstract kept in HTML form for showing to users.

name: PatentClassification
desc: patent classification e.g., "B24B 3100"
meaning: The classification codes assigned to a patent.

name: Type
desc: ArticleType
meaning: A code for what kind of scholarly article this is.

name: DEPRECATEDPublisherDisplayName
desc: these fields moved to DownloadURL where they belong
meaning: An old publisher name field that moved elsewhere.

name: PatentNumber
desc: number according to USPTO/EPO/JPO scheme.
meaning: The official patent number.

name: PubvenueID
desc: local journal number
meaning: An internal number identifying the journal or venue a paper appeared in.

name: NumHostedPages
desc: If set, then we host this many pages of this citation's content. Note that this field may be set to 0, in which case we should be hosting this content but have failed. DEPRECATED, moved to DownloadURL
meaning: An old count of hosted content pages that moved elsewhere.

name: NumRelated2
desc: for experiments
meaning: An alternative related-article count used for experiments.

name: DocumentID
desc: Local document identifier - url fingerprint if we know the url, or fingerprint of all fields if we don't. Different urls have different local docids.
meaning: A local identifier for the document, usually derived from its address.

name: AlternateVersionID
desc: Fingerprint of the URL after applying crawl and aggregate rewrites. Different citations with the same AlternateVersionID must have the same VersionID, but not necessarily vice versa. Omitted when identical to the VersionID.
meaning: A fingerprint of the rewritten address used to group citation records.

name: PatentOffice
desc: one of the above
meaning: Which patent office issued the record.

name: ReviewTypeReason
desc: bitmap of ReviewArticleTypeReasons
meaning: Flags recording why an article was labelled a review article.

name: DspaceID
desc: Dspace uses handle.net handles
meaning: The DSpace repository handle for the document.

name: AbstractTypeFromSource
desc: The original (unnormalized) type of an abstract. AbstractDisplay holds a normalized type deduced from things like tagnames, tag-attributes, keywords in documents or the placement of the abstract in the document. This field is meant for the type of the abstract identified explicitly by the source document. E.g., the value of the 'abstract-type' attribute from a tag in XML ('primary abstract', 'summary', 'highlights' etc.).
meaning: The abstract type exactly as the source document labelled it.

name: UnmatchedInstitution
desc: Author affiliations found in the document that we weren't able to match up to specific authors.
meaning: Author affiliations found in the paper that could not be tied to a specific author.

name: NumVersions
desc: for display in gws
meaning: How many versions of the article exist, kept for showing to users.

name: PublicationYear
desc: year from bibtext full year
meaning: The year of publication.

name: DOI
desc: Digital Object Identifier
meaning: The digital object identifier of the article.

name: TitleHtmlLeftOver
desc: Leftovers from TitleHtml. These are usually unrecognized xml/html entities or xml/html tags
meaning: Bits of markup left over that the title parser did not recognize.

name: BorrowedAuthors
desc: one bit per author
meaning: Bit flags marking which authors were taken from another record.

name: IncrementalExpected
desc: Is this article expected to have been indexed in the incremental?
meaning: Whether the article was expected in the incremental index build.

name: BaseGlobalID
desc: Global document identifier - only available when building increments over a known base index. This id is from the base index.
meaning: Identifier of the matching record in the base index.

name: ConferenceId
desc: Identifier for conference series - issn-lite
meaning: Identifier for a conference series.

name: LCCN
desc: library of congress call number
meaning: The Library of Congress call number.

name: LevelOfDiscussion
desc: If this is a target reference, the level of discussion of this reference.
meaning: How much a referenced work is discussed in the citing text.

name: AuthorListHasEtAl
desc: whether this citation had an "et al" in the author list
meaning: Whether the author list was cut short with 'et al'.

name: NumRelated3
desc: for experiments
meaning: Another alternative related-article count used for experiments.

name: Note
desc: random string data - unparsed
meaning: Free-form leftover text that was not parsed into fields.

name: UnmatchedEmailAddr
desc: Email addresses found in the document that we weren't able to match
meaning: Email addresses found in the paper that could not be matched to anyone.

name: Pages
desc: Using string to handle all kinds of page specifications. Internal structure is not really needed.
meaning: The page range of the article, stored as text.

name: AccessMonth
desc: AccessMonth is a zero-indexed field (0 is January).
meaning: The month the article was accessed, numbered from zero for January.

name: AbstractHtml
desc: Version of abstract field for display. This may contain XML/HTML tags.
meaning: The abstract kept with its original HTML tags so it can be displayed.

name: AbstractHtmlLeftOver
desc: Leftovers from AbstractHtml. These are usually unrecognized xml/html entities or xml/html tags
meaning: Bits of markup left over that the abstract parser did not recognize.

name: AbstractTypeFromSource
desc: The original (unnormalized) type of an abstract. AbstractDisplay holds a normalized type deduced from things like tagnames, tag-attributes, keywords in documents or the placement of the abstract in the document. This field is meant for the type of the abstract identified explicitly by the source document. E.g., the value of the 'abstract-type' attribute from a tag in XML ('primary abstract', 'summary', 'highlights' etc.).
meaning: The abstract's type exactly as the source document labelled it.

name: TitleHtml
desc: Version of title for display. Contains unsanitized HTML/XML.
meaning: An alternate article title kept with its original HTML markup for display.

name: TitleHtmlLeftOver
desc: Leftovers from TitleHtml. These are usually unrecognized xml/html entities or xml/html tags
meaning: Bits of markup left over from parsing the alternate title.

name: DEPRECATEDSrcFP
desc: Fingerprint of the referral document. The fingerprint should resist to small variance in the document content. DO NOT USE IT!
meaning: An old fingerprint of the referring document that is marked not to be used.

name: count
desc: Number of times this anchor text appears, only consider the text itself
meaning: How many times this anchor text appears.

name: face
desc: font face bitmask: kBold, kItalic, etc.
meaning: Bit flags for the font styling, such as bold or italic, of the anchor text.

name: size
desc: font size, in px
meaning: The font size of the anchor text in pixels.

name: text
desc: Space-delimited anchor words. Text that needs segmentation (like CJK or Thai) is unsegmented. Generated by ScienceParseUtils::AppendTokenSeqToString()
meaning: The words used in the anchor text pointing at the document.

name: type
desc: one of the "Type" value defined below.
meaning: A code saying which kind of anchor this record is.

name: weight
desc: weight of the anchor by looking where we get this anchor text. It can be PR, court level, year, or the combination of differerent aspects. weights are 1 - 128 defined as "Weights"
meaning: A weight from 1 to 128 for the anchor based on where it came from.

name: Department
desc: not in bibtex - from paper
meaning: The author's department as listed in the paper.

name: GuessOrderType
desc: Tracks the GuessNameOrder case used to parse this author name, defaults to 0 simply means that GuessNameOrder wasn't used.
meaning: Records which name-order guessing rule was used to parse the author name.

name: ID
desc: Author ID. Formatted as idtype:id
meaning: An identifier for the author, written as a type followed by an id.

name: Institution
desc: not in bibtex - from paper
meaning: The author's institution as listed in the paper.

name: Type
desc: Type is one of the contributors types. Writers are the default.
meaning: Which kind of contributor this person is, with writer as the default.

name: Type
desc: ontology/set of categories for the category
meaning: Which category system this classification comes from.

name: LegalMustInclude
desc: e.g., in law_articles.pat
meaning: Marks the URL as one to keep because it matches a law-articles pattern.

name: DisplayPriority
desc: display preference score
meaning: A score for how much this URL is preferred when showing the article.

name: PageCount
desc: Number of pages in the pdf2html conversion output. Only set for PDFs. For a partitioned PDF, this is the page count of the entire volume.
meaning: How many pages the converted PDF has.

name: LikelyWorldViewable
desc: Likely to be free-to-read for everyone, after accounting for library links etc.
meaning: Whether the article is likely free to read for everyone.

name: MetadataUrl
desc: url of publisher metadata file
meaning: The address of the publisher's metadata file.

name: NoIndex
desc: metatag: don't display this url
meaning: A page request not to display this URL.

name: ReferencesInPrevIndex
desc: were references parsed in a previous index
meaning: Whether the references on this page were parsed in a previous index.

name: NoSnippet
desc: metatag: don't show snippet
meaning: A page request not to show a snippet.

name: BrokenLandingPage
desc: set if we know the landing page is broken
meaning: A flag set when the landing page for this article is known to be broken.

name: DownloadYear
desc: no abbrv
meaning: The full year tied to this download URL.

name: WorldViewable
desc: metatag: is viewable by world
meaning: A page tag saying the content is viewable by everyone.

name: ContentChecksum
desc: checksum of the page
meaning: A checksum of the page contents.

name: ExcerptDebugLabel
desc: label for excerpt (abstract, summary, ..)
meaning: A debug label saying what kind of text the excerpt was taken from.

name: ContentType
desc: makes gws display nicer :)
meaning: The content type of the URL, used to make the result display better.

name: LongChunkCount
desc: number of long paragraphs
meaning: How many long paragraphs the page contains.

name: MustInclude
desc: e.g., in science_articles.pat
meaning: Marks the URL as one to keep because it matches a science-articles pattern.

name: FirstDiscovered
desc: seconds since the epoch
meaning: The time this URL was first discovered, in seconds since the epoch.

name: IndexPriority
desc: indexing preference score
meaning: A score for how strongly this URL is preferred for indexing.

name: HtmlTitle
desc: html title of the page
meaning: The HTML title of the page.

name: NoArchive
desc: metatag: don't show cached version
meaning: A page request not to show a cached copy.

name: DownloadMonth
desc: DownloadMonth is a zero-indexed field (0 is January).
meaning: The month tied to this download URL, numbered from zero for January.

name: CrawlTimestamp
desc: seconds since the epoch
meaning: The time the page was crawled, in seconds since the epoch.

name: LikelyDifferentMetricsVenue
desc: In the context of a given venue in Scholar Metrics, whether this URL likely does not link to the current venue.
meaning: Whether the URL likely does not belong to the venue being measured.

name: OutLinkCount
desc: number of external URLs (in PDF).
meaning: How many external links the PDF contains.

name: LikelyNoCache
desc: badurls_nocache at indexing time
meaning: Whether the URL was on the do-not-cache bad-URL list when indexed.

name: LikelyLegalJournal
desc: e.g., in legal_journals.pat
meaning: Whether the URL likely belongs to a legal journal.

name: Type
desc: ArticleType for this particular url
meaning: The kind of article this particular URL points to.

name: MaybeNoIndexReparse
desc: Incremental only: mark as NoIndexed if this is a reparse and the base version is NoIndexed.
meaning: Marks a reparsed page as not indexed when the original version was not indexed.

name: LikelyAheadPrint
desc: Whether this is likely the URL for an ahead print, at indexing time.
meaning: Whether the URL likely points to an ahead-of-print version of the article.

name: InPrevIndex
desc: is url included in a previous index
meaning: Whether this URL was part of a previous index.

name: DisplayOrg
desc: publisher display name
meaning: The publisher name to show for this URL.

name: WordCount
desc: number of words in content/body
meaning: How many words the page body contains.

name: OceanView
desc: describes whether url is viewable in ocean
meaning: Describes whether the URL can be viewed in the Books viewer.

name: DMCANotice
desc: metatag: URL; result was taken down
meaning: A notice URL recording that this result was taken down on copyright grounds.

name: LikelyNoIndex
desc: badurls_noreturngws at indexing time
meaning: Whether the URL was on the do-not-return bad-URL list when indexed.

name: ExcerptContent
desc: first few lines of abstract'ish excerpt
meaning: The first few lines of an abstract-like excerpt from the page.

name: HostedNumPages
desc: explicit zero means hosting failed
meaning: How many pages were hosted, where an explicit zero means hosting failed.

name: Agency
desc: values are from FundingAgency enum
meaning: A code for which funding agency paid for the work.

name: AgencyName
desc: Text name of the agency. For analysis. Plus for agencies that don't have an enum.
meaning: The written-out name of the funding agency.

name: DebugExtractionInfo
desc: Funding entries for the same agency and grant number can be merged during our extraction process so we maintain a record of all the deduped ExtractionInfo messages within the remaining entry.
meaning: A debug record of the duplicate funding entries that were merged together.

name: DebugFundingTextBlock
desc: Text block from which the funding entry was extracted. Intended to be used for offline analysis. DEPRECATED
meaning: A deprecated copy of the text a funding entry came from.

name: Recipient
desc: funding recipient
meaning: Who received the funding.

name: SourceText
desc: Original text for the funding acknowledgement
meaning: The original wording of the funding acknowledgement.

name: UrlBasedFundingSource
desc: Whether this funding info was added because this article was at the exclusive repository for this agency.
meaning: Whether funding was inferred because the article sits in that agency's repository.

name: ClearedFunding
desc: Set when we clear all extracted funding from this citation in the parser.
meaning: A marker set when the parser wiped all extracted funding from the record.

name: DebugFundingTextBlock
desc: Text block context from which the funding entry was extracted. Optionally filled and intended to be used for offline analysis.
meaning: The surrounding text a funding entry came from, kept for offline analysis.

name: Name
desc: e.g., "eng"
meaning: The name of a subject or language label given to the citation.

name: Probability
meaning: How likely, from zero to one, that this subject label applies.

name: MetadataUrl
desc: url of catalog metadata file
meaning: The address of the library catalog's metadata file.

name: NumLibraries
desc: Information about the number of libraries the citation appears. It should be useful for ranking.
meaning: How many libraries hold this work, noted as useful for ranking.

name: Subject
desc: Categories classification of the citation
meaning: Subject categories assigned to the citation by the library catalog.

name: Url
desc: UnionCatalog url to display to users
meaning: The catalog link shown to users.

name: HtmlTitleFp
desc: Fingerprint of the html title of the page. This is useful for checking if we have the same version of the page as websearch.
meaning: A fingerprint of the page title used to check it matches web search's copy.

name: IndexSelectionScore
desc: Index selection score for websearch, bigger is better: (0.5,1.0] - prefer selection into the base index, (0.0,0.5] - prefer selection into the supplemental index.
meaning: A score for whether the page belongs in the main index or the supplemental one.

name: NumBackwardLinks
desc: Summary statistics.
meaning: How many links point to the document.

name: PublicationYear
desc: Publication date.
meaning: The year the article was published.

name: RemoveLink
desc: Remove this URL from the index - error page, broken landing page, etc. DEPRECATED, was never used or even filled correctly.
meaning: An unused flag meant to drop broken URLs from the index.

name: ScholarId
desc: For links from websearch to scholar.
meaning: The Scholar identifier used to link a web search result to Scholar.

name: Title
desc: Title of the article. Its only filled in when the html title of the page isn't good.
meaning: The article title, stored only when the page's own HTML title is poor.

name: VisiblePrefixTerms
desc: Length of document prefix that most users are likely to see. Only filled in when we index subscription fulltext but most users see abstracts. This is a conservative guesstimate - e.g., ACM shows fulltext to university/company subscribers (including Google employees) based on user's IP address, but we don't know subscriber IPs, so ACM's PDF pages would have ~500 in this field (estimated length of abstract).
meaning: An estimate of how much of the document most readers actually get to see.

name: CountryCode
desc: No CountryCode means default viewability. two letter code
meaning: The two-letter country code a viewability rule applies to.

name: ViewType
desc: enum in ocean::LocaleViewability::ViewType
meaning: A code for what level of viewing is allowed in that country.

name: prefix
desc: Prefix to help with disambiguating between multiple text matches on page. Optional.
meaning: Text just before the target passage, used to pick the right match on the page.

name: suffix
desc: Suffix to help with disambiguating between multiple text matches on page. Optional.
meaning: Text just after the target passage, used to pick the right match on the page.

name: textEnd
desc: End of the text span to be highlighted. Optional.
meaning: Where the highlighted passage ends.

name: textStart
desc: Start of the text span to be highlighted.
meaning: Where the highlighted passage starts.

name: accountProvenance
desc: Propagated from knowledge.answers.sensitivity.Sensitivity account_provenance. Any ambiguity between the data here and dasher_user should be resolved by the conversion to pToken in
meaning: Records which account the sensitivity information came from.

name: dasherUser
desc: True iff the query is from a Dasher user.
meaning: Whether the query came from a managed Workspace account user.

name: sensitivityMode
desc: Key of a sensitivity.
meaning: A key naming which sensitivity category applies to the query.

name: blockNonV2SearchBackends
desc: Should e2e search candidates running in parallel with QU (eg. GBot) be blocked.
meaning: Whether parallel search backends should be blocked for this query.

name: ignoreQueryUnderstanding
desc: Iff true this follow-on sensitivity will rank above the ones determined by query understanding (QU).
meaning: Whether this sensitivity takes precedence over ones found by query understanding.

name: intentOnlyNoPii
desc: QU dectects a sensitive intent with no sensitive content (eg., [Send email]). This flag is only used to trigger a sensitive feature because as a precaution all sensitive features should check current sensitivity mode before triggering; but will NOT block any backends, which means all other features can compete fairly.
meaning: Marks a query with a sensitive intent but no sensitive personal content.

name: rewrittenQuery
desc: The rewritten query this sensitivity is for. Note different query rewrites could produce different sensitivities.
meaning: The rewritten version of the query this sensitivity was computed for.

name: tokenHmacSha1Prefix
desc: The hash of the corresponding capability token. The value is defined to be identical to the one in acl.proto's CapTokenMetadata: 10-byte prefix of HMAC-SHA1 of the token. The HMAC key is the following fixed (non-secret) 512-bit value: 79b1c8f4 82baf523 b8a9ab4a e960f438 c45be041 11f1f222 e8a3f64d aeb05e3d c3576acc ec649194 aede422c 4e48e0d1 ff21234a a6ed6b49 a7fa592e efd7bba3
meaning: A hashed prefix of an access token used to identify it.

name: chatId
desc: Chat IDs consist of alphanumeric characters and colons. Currently required.
meaning: The identifier of a chat used for access checks.

name: memberType
desc: The type of Chat members to consider, e.g. "all members" vs. "invitee" These are defined by legacy_relation_id values in social.graph.storage.EdgeTypeEnum.EdgeType enum options in social/graph/storage/proto/id.proto. See chat.pb (defined in production/config/cdd/socialgraph/mixer_config/prod/node_type_config) for all valid edge types associated with chat. Currently required.
meaning: Which group of chat members an access check should consider.

name: circleId
desc: Circle ID is unique only relative to the owner's Gaia ID. Currently required.
meaning: The identifier of a circle, unique within its owner's account.

name: ownerGaiaId
desc: The owner of the circle. Currently required.
meaning: The account that owns the circle.

name: requiredConsistencyTimestampUsec
desc: If present, then tests for membership in this circle must use data known to be at least as fresh as the given (FBS-assigned) timestamp. See
meaning: A timestamp saying how fresh circle membership data must be.

name: id
desc: Format: "{identity-pool}:{subject}#" Details: go/cloud-principal-identifiers
meaning: A cloud identity written as an identity pool plus a subject.

name: groupId
desc: Group ID is unique only relative to the owner's Gaia ID.
meaning: The identifier of a contact group, unique within its owner's account.

name: requiredConsistencyTimestampUsec
desc: If present, then tests for membership in this ContactGroup must use data known to be at least as fresh as the given (FBS-assigned) timestamp. See
meaning: A timestamp saying how fresh contact group membership data must be.

name: eventId
desc: Event IDs consist of alphanumeric characters and colons. Currently required.
meaning: The identifier of a calendar event used for access checks.

name: memberType
desc: The type of Event members to consider, e.g. "all members" vs. "owners" vs. "admins". These are defined by legacy_relation_id values in social.graph.storage.EdgeTypeEnum.EdgeType enum options in social/graph/storage/proto/id.proto. See event.pb (defined in production/config/cdd/socialgraph/mixer_config/prod/node_type_config) for all valid edge types associated with event. Currently required.
meaning: Which group of event members an access check should consider.

name: hostName
desc: Lower-case, fully qualified hostname.
meaning: The full lower-case machine name.

name: hostOwner
desc: If present, then any checks that compare this Principal to LOAS peer info must confirm the peer's machine owner is equal to 'host_owner'. If absent, then any peer machine owner is acceptable.
meaning: The machine owner a peer must match for the check to pass.

name: gaiaId
desc: Do not set this field. Contact credentials-eng@ if you believe you absolutely need to use it. This is the @prod.google.com Gaia ID that corresponds to the MDB user, see go/authn-merge for details. This field may always be safely ignored when performing an authorization check.
meaning: An internal account id matching an employee login that callers should not set.

name: allAuthenticatedUsers
desc: scope = ALL_AUTHENTICATED_USERS
meaning: Holds the principal when access is granted to all signed-in users.

name: capTokenHolder
desc: scope = CAP_TOKEN_HOLDER
meaning: Holds the principal when access is granted to holders of a capability token.

name: chat
desc: scope = CHAT
meaning: Holds the principal when access is granted to members of a chat.

name: circle
desc: scope = CIRCLE
meaning: Holds the principal when access is granted to members of a circle.

name: cloudPrincipal
desc: scope = CLOUD_PRINCIPAL
meaning: Holds the principal when access is granted to a cloud identity.

name: contactGroup
desc: scope = CONTACT_GROUP
meaning: Holds the principal when access is granted to a contact group.

name: emailOwner
desc: scope = EMAIL_OWNER
meaning: Holds the principal when access is granted to the owner of an email address.

name: event
desc: scope = EVENT
meaning: Holds the principal when access is granted to members of an event.

name: gaiaGroup
desc: scope = GAIA_GROUP
meaning: Holds the principal when access is granted to an account group.

name: gaiaUser
desc: scope = GAIA_USER
meaning: Holds the principal when access is granted to a single account.

name: host
desc: scope = HOST
meaning: Holds the principal when access is granted to a machine.

name: ldapGroup
desc: scope = LDAP_GROUP
meaning: Holds the principal when access is granted to a directory group.

name: ldapUser
desc: scope = LDAP_USER
meaning: Holds the principal when access is granted to a directory user.

name: mdbGroup
desc: scope = MDB_GROUP
meaning: Holds the principal when access is granted to an internal employee group.

name: mdbUser
desc: scope = MDB_USER
meaning: Holds the principal when access is granted to an internal employee account.

name: oauthConsumer
desc: scope = OAUTH_CONSUMER;
meaning: Holds the principal when access is granted to an OAuth client application.

name: postiniUser
desc: scope = POSTINI_USER
meaning: Holds the principal when access is granted to a Postini user.

name: rbacRole
desc: scope = RBAC_ROLE
meaning: Holds the principal when access is granted to a named role.

name: rbacSubject
desc: scope = RBAC_SUBJECT
meaning: Holds the principal when access is granted to a role subject.

name: resourceRole
desc: scope = RESOURCE_ROLE
meaning: Holds the principal when access is granted through a role on a resource.

name: scope
desc: This is only optional because required enums cannot be extended. Currently required.
meaning: Says which kind of principal this record describes.

name: signingKeyPossessor
desc: scope = SIGNING_KEY_POSSESSOR
meaning: Holds the principal when access is granted to whoever holds a signing key.

name: simpleSecretHolder
desc: scope = SIMPLE_SECRET_HOLDER
meaning: Holds the principal when access is granted to whoever knows a shared secret.

name: socialGraphNode
desc: scope = SOCIAL_GRAPH_NODE
meaning: Holds the principal when access is granted to a social graph node.

name: square
desc: scope = SQUARE
meaning: Holds the principal when access is granted to members of a square.

name: youtubeUser
desc: scope = YOUTUBE_USER
meaning: Holds the principal when access is granted to a YouTube user.

name: zwiebackSession
desc: scope = ZWIEBACK_SESSION
meaning: Holds the principal when access is granted to a browser cookie session.

name: rbacNamespace
desc: DEPRECATED as of 01.11.2019
meaning: A retired namespace field for role-based access records.

name: rbacRoleName
desc: Format: "role/z?" - "role" is the Sphinx globally unique name of the Sphinx role that provisions the RBAC role. - "/z?" suffix indicates which Zanzibar environment stores the role membership data ("/zd": dev, "/zs": staging, "/zp": prod, "/zt": local test instance). Example: "mysystem_myrole/zp"
meaning: The role name plus a suffix saying which environment stores its membership.

name: username
desc: Format "username" without "@domain", e.g., "bogdand".
meaning: A bare username with no domain part.

name: keymasterKeyType
desc: This value must be from the KeyMetadata.Type enum in keymaster.proto.
meaning: Which kind of signing key this is.

name: serializedVerificationKey
desc: The actual verification key bytes corresponding to the above type.
meaning: The raw bytes of the verification key.

name: serializedVerificationKeyset
desc: The binary serialized Keymaster SerializedReader of a public keyset. The keyset must contain exactly one key. N.B.: If this field is populated, serialized_verification_key should be set to the empty string and keymaster_key_type should be set to zero.
meaning: A serialized public key set containing exactly one key.

name: label
desc: A descriptive label to help identify a relevant ACL entry or otherwise disambiguate this instance.
meaning: A descriptive label that helps tell one shared secret from another.

name: genericLabel
desc: Used when type = GENERIC_SECRET
meaning: A free-form label used for generic shared secrets.

name: inviteId
desc: Used when type == INVITE.
meaning: The invitation identifier used when the secret is an invite.

name: type
desc: This is optional because required enums cannot be extended.
meaning: Says which kind of shared secret label this is.

name: sgnDomain
desc: The fields from ccc/socialgraph/socialgraphnode.proto:SgnNode that uniquely identify a social graph node. The 'ident' field is not included here because its value can be changed.
meaning: The domain part that identifies a social graph node.

name: memberType
desc: The type of Square members to consider, e.g. "all members" vs. "owners" vs. "admins". These are defined by legacy_relation_id values in social.graph.storage.EdgeTypeEnum.EdgeType enum options in social/graph/storage/proto/id.proto. See square.pb (defined in production/config/cdd/socialgraph/mixer_config/prod/node_type_config) for all valid edge types associated with square. Currently required.
meaning: Which group of square members an access check should consider.

name: squareId
desc: Currently required.
meaning: The identifier of a square.

name: info
desc: Used for application-specific information about the whole set of SentenceBoundaryAnnotations. Example: SAFT Team uses this to store an nlp_saft.Document proto giving any processing errors encountered.
meaning: A slot for extra application data about a whole set of sentence annotations.

name: cleanText
desc: A clean version of .text() generated by using CleanText() and stripping unnecessary whitespace.
meaning: A tidied-up copy of the annotated text with extra whitespace removed.

name: context
desc: Plain text context from the page within which the annotation occurred.
meaning: The surrounding page text where the annotation was found.

name: contextBegin
desc: Byte offsets for the clean text context above.
meaning: The byte offset where the stored surrounding text begins.

name: info
desc: Used for application-specific information about this annotation.
meaning: A slot for extra application data about a single annotation.

name: text
desc: Original UTF-8 document text occurring in the range [begin, end).
meaning: The original document text covered by this annotation.

name: toIndex
desc: Used to mark the annotations selected to be indexed.
meaning: Marks which annotations were picked to be indexed.

name: polarity
desc: Polarity represents the sentiment towards the subject.
meaning: Whether the feeling expressed toward the subject is positive or negative.

name: userEmotions
desc: The emotions that the user is feeling.
meaning: The emotions the user appears to be feeling.

name: politeness
desc: The degree to which the user is showing politeness.
meaning: How polite the user is being.

name: id
desc: Hash-value of the URL.
meaning: A hash of the source URL.

name: numShingles
desc: Number of shingles originating from this source.
meaning: How many of the document's text fingerprints came from this source.

name: timestamp
desc: First-seen timestamp of the source.
meaning: When this source was first seen.

name: neardupInfo
desc: This field will only be populated if the inferred image is a neardup of an inferred image. It stores the type and source of the images it is a neardup of.
meaning: Records which near-identical images this inferred product image matches.

name: DEPRECATEDSourceTitle
desc: DEPRECATED DEPRECATED DEPRECATED In case you didn't realize, these fields are (and have been for some time) deprecated. We'll stop pushing their data to production soon (probably Feb/09) and after a few weeks we'll probably remove them.
meaning: A retired field that once held the source title for a sitelink block.

name: TargetGroups
desc: One Sitemap can contain multiple TargetGroups, but only one of them will be displayed to the user - this decision will be made at displaying time and can take into account various factors, such as the users' language and country, currently running experiments, etc.
meaning: Groups of sitelink targets, of which only one is picked to show the user.

name: pageAnchorsDocInfo
desc: This field is populated in the Sitemap MDU subpopulator from cdoc data. This is used to store page anchors information for TopicTagsScrolltoFlow.
meaning: Stored page anchor details used to build jump links for a result.

name: searchInSite
desc: Enable site search.
meaning: Turns on the search-this-site box for the result.

name: sourceOrgfp
desc: prevents cross-domain forwarding
meaning: A fingerprint of the source site that stops sitelinks pointing at other domains.

name: subresultList
desc: This field is populated in the Sitemap MDU subpopulator from cdoc data. It's not set in the cdoc Sitemap.
meaning: The list of sub-results shown underneath the main result.

name: score
desc: optional, exclude to save space
meaning: An optional score on a retired sitelink target record.

name: isExternal
desc: An image is considered external iff both: 1. The image appears in a link that is not in the same org as the document, or the target URL is in a different org. 2. The image src is not in the same org as the document.
meaning: Flags whether an image on a page is hosted or linked from a different site than the page itself.

name: url
desc: The absolute url of the image as present in the page.
meaning: The full web address of an image exactly as it appears in the page.

name: metaNoSnippet
desc: These are set from tags in the web page:
meaning: Records that the page asked, via a tag, not to have a snippet shown for it.

name: teradoc
desc: If this is present it supercedes all the above data.
meaning: A pointer to another stored document record that replaces the rest of this one.

name: countDistinctResources
