desc: The number of distinct resources fetched to render the content. This may aid the calculation of total page load time for user experience. For example, if total_content_length is only a few dozen kilobytes, but that is from fetching 100 distinct resources, total page load time might be much higher than the total_content_length would otherwise infer.
meaning: How many separate files had to be fetched to render the page.

name: crawlTimestamp
desc: The time at which the main resource of the Snapshot was fetched, in seconds since epoch. Note that the various page dependencies may have been fetched at much earlier points in time (hours, maybe days) and that this could be off from the actual rendering time.
meaning: The time the page's main file was fetched, in seconds since epoch.

name: snapshotQualityScore
desc: The score here corresponds to the score in Snapshot, a number between 0.0 and 1.0 (higher the better).
meaning: A zero-to-one rating of how good the stored page snapshot is.

name: totalContentSize
desc: Number of bytes fetched to render the content. For example, to render a web page, this value would include the HTML, stylesheets, images, and all other dependencies. This can be used to calculate a coarse estimate of the total page load time a user might experience.
meaning: Total bytes downloaded to render the page, including images and stylesheets.

name: inLink
desc: One if the current text node is within a link; otherwise zero/not present.
meaning: Marks whether this chunk of page text sits inside a link.

name: maxSplit
desc: A value in the range [0,7] (zero if not present) indicating the most "powerful" splitting tag since the last text node. See "enum Category" in mustang/snippets/taginfo.h.
meaning: A 0-7 rating of the strongest text-breaking tag seen before this chunk of text.

name: brainScore
desc: The below fields are populated by SnippetFlow in superroot. Score generated from snippet brain model. go/snippets-brain
meaning: The score a machine learning model gave this candidate snippet.

name: features
desc: Snippets ranklab features generated by scorer V2.
meaning: The set of measured features used by the snippet scorer.

name: finalScore
desc: Final snippet score by chooser.
meaning: The final score used to choose among candidate snippets.

name: rankBySnippetFlow
desc: Final rank given by SnippetFlow.
meaning: The final ordering position this snippet candidate was given.

name: snippetsbrainModelName
desc: The below fields are populated by SnippetFlow in superroot.
meaning: The name of the model version used when choosing a snippet.

name: begin
desc: A piece of leading text is text within [begin, end). For example, a document is "ABCDEF". If we want to set leading text as 'CD', the value of begin is byte offset of 'C', the value of end is byte offset of 'E'. end == -1 means to the end of document.
meaning: The starting byte position of a piece of the page's leading text.

name: beginText
desc: UTF8 text, for alignment when using reusableinfo. Those text are not available in docjoins.
meaning: A copy of the starting text, kept so positions can be re-aligned later.

name: matchedPattern
desc: Matched dom path string for debugging.
meaning: The page structure pattern that matched, stored only for debugging.

name: embedItem
desc: An embed represents an external entity. See go/es-embeds.
meaning: An embedded reference to an outside item attached to a social message.

name: id
desc: An id to uniquely identify an attachment when several attachments are in a collection.
meaning: An identifier telling attachments apart within a collection.

name: highlight
desc: This indicates that the segment should be rendered as highlighted or visually emphasized.
meaning: Says a piece of message text should be visually highlighted.

name: style
desc: If set, this indicates that the segment should be rendered with the specified style. The absence of an explicit style represents "no style", i.e. the segment can be rendered with the default style chosen by the application.
meaning: The display style to apply to a piece of message text.

name: attachment
desc: An Attachment represents the structured entity to which we are linking. It contains an Embed (apps/tacotown/proto/embeds/embed_client.proto) with fields specific to the appropriate type of linked entity. For example, if we are linking to a photo album, the Embed may include the album ID and gaia ID of the creator. Clients that understand the Embed type within the Attachment may construct and/or decorate their link appropriately e.g. to make use of type-specific functionality or first-party integ
meaning: The structured item a social link points to.

name: attachmentRenderHint
desc: The hint to use when rendering the associated attachment. Ignored if there is no associated attachment.
meaning: A hint for how to display the attached item.

name: displayUrl
desc: If we wish to show the user a different (e.g. shortened) version of the URL for display purposes, then that version should be set here. If this field isn't set, link_target will be used for both purposes.
meaning: A shortened or prettier version of a link to show the user.

name: linkTarget
desc: link_target is the URL to navigate to when clicked. This could be the original URL, or a URL signed by the GWS URL signing service.
meaning: The address a link opens when clicked.

name: linkType
desc: LinkType is an optional field that provides additional information regarding link target. For example, link type can be identified as the SELF_LINK when the request was executed from the same link as the link target.
meaning: Extra labelling about what kind of link this is.

name: title
desc: Title is an optional field that provides a short string that describes the link or its destination. User interfaces often use title as a tooltip or for accessibility purposes. However, they are of course free to present this data in any form. This field is plain text.
meaning: A short description of a link, often used as a tooltip.

name: kgEntityConfidence
desc: For lightweight scoring in serving time.
meaning: How confident the system is about the entity behind a linked search term.

name: mid
desc: MID of the KG entity being linked.
meaning: The knowledge graph identifier of the entity a link refers to.

name: formatting
desc: Formatting to be applied when rendering the Segment. For all segment types, this is the standard way of representing that the Segment should be rendered in bold, italics, etc.
meaning: Styling to apply when displaying a piece of message text.

name: hashtagData
desc: For HASHTAG type:
meaning: Details attached to a hashtag inside a message.

name: linkData
desc: Type-specific metadata. At most one of these should be populated, and the one that is populated should correspond to the type of the Segment. For LINK type:
meaning: Details attached to a link inside a message.

name: searchLinkData
desc: For SEARCH_LINK type:
meaning: Details attached to a search link inside a message.

name: text
desc: Text content of the Segment. As a general rule, this field should contain the actual text that should be rendered in the UI. Thus, for a hashtag, it should be "#Foo", and for a link, it should be the display text. Clients that do not understand a particular segment type may use this text, along with the Formatting info below, as a fallback for display. The field is not required -- if all relevant information is carried in other metadata fields and there is no need for a fallback, or it
meaning: The visible text of a piece of a social message.

name: type
desc: Type of Segment.
meaning: What kind of message piece this is, such as text, link, or hashtag.

name: userMentionData
desc: For USER_MENTION type:
meaning: Details attached to a mention of a person inside a message.

name: user
desc: If the principal is backed by a gaia id, DO NOT use this field. Use user_gaia_id/user_id fields instead.
meaning: The account record for a mentioned person when no account id is available.

name: userGaiaId
desc: An unobfuscated gaia ID:
meaning: The plain account identifier of a mentioned person.

name: userId
desc: An obfuscated gaia ID:
meaning: The scrambled account identifier of a mentioned person.

name: profileId
desc: Obfuscated GAIA id.
meaning: A scrambled account identifier for a person's profile.

name: data
desc: Set of column-name and value for the given mimetype. The semantic meaning of the column values is mime-type specific. For example they may contain app_specific_endpoint_ids for WhatsApp. This is uploaded from CP2
meaning: Named columns of contact data uploaded from a phone's contacts store.

name: mimetype
desc: The mimetype of the action defined by the third-party app.
meaning: The data type label a third party app gave a contact action.

name: columnName
desc: The name of the column in CP2 for raw_contact_data.
meaning: The name of a column in the phone contacts database.

name: value
desc: The value of the data inside column.
meaning: The value stored in a contacts database column.

name: id
desc: This string will represent either the device make and model in the case of FSA2, or the device model in the case of FSA1.
meaning: The make or model of the Android device involved.

name: mutationContext
desc: The general mutation context data
meaning: Details about who changed a contact and when.

name: androidDeviceInfo
desc: Android device info should always be set when using either ANDROID_FSA1 or ANDROID_FSA2 as the source of the delete.
meaning: The Android device that made a contact change.

name: hostAppInfo
desc: Host app info should always be set when using CONTACTS_COMPANION as the source.
meaning: The app that hosted the sidebar where a contact change happened.

name: source
desc: The source of a mutate should provide all needed information a user should know, and should be enough information for the front end to generate a proper human readable string to describe the mutate to the user.
meaning: Where a change to a contact came from.

name: thirdPartyInfo
desc: Third party info should always be set when using THIRD_PARTY as the source.
meaning: Details about the outside app that changed a contact.

name: timestamp
desc: Timestamp representing when the contact was mutated. This should not be set on write, as it is the job of focus backend to determine this timestamp. This field will be populated on read with the data written by FBS.
meaning: When a contact record was changed.

name: contactActiveState
desc: Indicates if any reminders are active for entire contact. This will affect both connection reminders and date reminders such as birthday reminders. This is required.
meaning: Whether reminders are switched on for a given contact.

name: deletionContext
desc: A trashed contact may have deletion context set, which indicates where and when the contact was trashed. Deletion context is cleared when the contact is untrashed.
meaning: Where and when a contact was moved to the trash.

name: overlay
desc: Settings that describe how the decoration should be overlaid on the photo.
meaning: Settings for how a decoration sits on top of a profile photo.

name: sibsId
desc: SIBS ID of the decoration that is overlaid on the photo.
meaning: The identifier of the decoration placed on a photo.

name: id
desc: Required. The id for a delegated group.
meaning: The identifier of a delegated contact group.

name: hostAppName
desc: This string will represent the info for the host app to the Companion sidebar
meaning: The name of the app hosting the companion sidebar.

name: contentVersion
desc: Identifies the most recent version of this photo. Use this as a FIFE param (ie -iv12) to prevent reads of a stale version.
meaning: A version marker that keeps a stale copy of a photo from being served.

name: mediaId
desc: Unique identifier for the photo. For now, this will always be a Photos Backend media key.
meaning: The unique identifier of a stored photo.

name: partialNameOptions
desc: Required. Describes which shortening option the user implicitly chose for their limited profile. E.g., if 'John Doe' chose 'John D.', they implicitly chose: partial_name_options { given_name_spec { show_all: true } family_name_spec: { show_initial: true truncation_indicator: PERIOD } } While we'll in all cases serve the actual name chosen by the user for limited profiles (stored below), we'll use this information to recompute the default limited profile to be rendered to users when they change t
meaning: The rule a person chose for shortening their displayed name.

name: verbatimFullName
desc: The actual textual name that was chosen by the user in the UI. E.g., if 'John Doe' chose 'John D.', this holds 'John D.'. While
meaning: The exact shortened name a person picked for their limited profile.

name: androidMessages
desc: Created with user input in Android Messages.
meaning: Marks that a limited profile was set up inside Android Messages.

name: disableReason
desc: Indicates why the limited profile has been disabled. Will be set iff the limited profile is disabled. Note: When mutating limited profiles, in order to disable them, MutateDataRequest.DisableLimitedProfile must be true. Currently, disables are only performed server-side, so this is read-only for clients.
meaning: Why a person's limited profile was switched off.

name: gpayOobe
desc: Created with user input in GPay OOBE. This is not currently used because GPay does not setup mini profile, this might change in the future.
meaning: Marks that a limited profile was set up during GPay signup; currently unused.

name: lastUpdateTime
desc: Timestamp indicating when the settings were last stored. Read-only field.
meaning: When these profile settings were last saved.

name: legacyDiscoverability
desc: A user who had legacy discoverability had a Limited Profile autogenerated for them, either through a healer or in the live path in FBS.
meaning: Marks a person whose limited profile was generated automatically under old rules.

name: myAccount
desc: Created with user input in MyAccount UI.
meaning: Marks that a limited profile was set up in the My Account screens.

name: nameSettings
desc: Required. Defines how the name should be formatted in the limited profile.
meaning: How a person's name should be formatted on their limited profile.

name: profilePictureSettings
desc: DEPRECATED. Profile picture choices are controlled through the ACL of the Photo field.
meaning: An old, no longer used setting for limited profile pictures.

name: monthDay
desc: Absolute day of the month (if positive) or relative day from the end of the month (if negative). Example: 2nd and 20th of the month [2, 20]. Example: Last day of the month [-1]. Positive values should correspond to actual calendar day number (indexing starts at 1).
meaning: Which days of the month a reminder repeats on.

name: useLastDayIfMonthDayPastEnd
desc: If true, month_day beyond the end of month (i.e. month_day=31 in February) will default to the last day of the month.
meaning: Whether a date past a month's end falls back to the last day.

name: weekDay
desc: The nth occurrence of week_day to match. I.e. For 3rd Wednesday of the month, week_day = WEDNESDAY and week_day_number = 3. Values beyond the end of the month are skipped.
meaning: Which weekday a monthly repeating reminder lands on.

name: audioSource
desc: Stored. Updated on pronunciation creates and updates.
meaning: Where a recorded name pronunciation came from.

name: audioState
desc: Stored.
meaning: The stored status of a name pronunciation recording.

name: daysBeforeActiveDate
desc: Positive number of days before active date. The value 0 will denote a notification on the same day.
meaning: How many days ahead of a date a reminder is sent.

name: notificationTimeOfDay
desc: Time of day that notification is sent to user. This is local to the user's device.
meaning: The local time of day a reminder is sent.

name: language
desc: IETF BCP-47 language code that should be used for localizing the name computation (go/bcp-47). If not provided, we'll use the name origin detector to infer it. If unable to detect, "en" will be assumed.
meaning: The language used when shortening a person's name.

name: hideAll
desc: Completely omit that part of the name.
meaning: Leave that part of a person's name out entirely.

name: showAll
desc: Show the complete name. Note that this does not express the same semantics as show_first_n_chars=length_of_name, because when regenerating a shortened name the new name could have more characters, thus yielding a different result.
meaning: Show that part of a person's name in full.

name: showFirstNChars
desc: Show first
meaning: Show only the first few letters of that part of a name.

name: showInitial
desc: Show only the initial, i.e., a single character. Note that "character" refers to "user-perceived" characters, aka a "grapheme cluster". See go/morphology for more details.
meaning: Show only the first letter of that part of a name.

name: truncationIndicator
desc: Which truncation indicator to use after the shortened piece of the name. Will be ignored for the
meaning: Which mark, such as a period, follows a shortened name part.

name: allInitialsFromParsedName
desc: Extract an initial from each parsed name. For example, "Niels Henrik David Bohr" yields "N. H. D. B.". Other special cases are treated as follows:
meaning: Reduce every part of a person's name to initials.

name: firstInitialAndFirstLastName
desc: Show the initial of the very first name and the first last name, e.g. "Hugo Daniel Hernandez Garcia" yields "H. Hernandez".
meaning: Show a first initial plus the first surname.

name: firstInitialAndVeryLastName
desc: Show the initial of the very first name and the very last name, e.g. "Ana Maria Silva" yields "A. Silva".
meaning: Show a first initial plus the final surname.

name: knowledgeGraphNameShortening
desc: Shorten the display name using the Knowledge Graph name shortener (go/short-names).
meaning: Shorten a display name using the knowledge graph name shortener.

name: truncationIndicator
desc: Which truncation indicator to use after each shortened part of the name. Will be ignored for the
meaning: Which mark follows each shortened part of a name.

name: veryFirstNameAndAllInitials
desc: Show the full very first name and all the other initials, e.g. "Ana Maria Silva" yields "Ana M. S.".
meaning: Show the full first name and initials for the rest.

name: veryFirstNameOnly
desc: Show the very first name only, e.g. "Ana Maria Silva" yields "Ana".
meaning: Show only a person's first name.

name: relativePosition
desc: Top left position of the overlay relative to the user's avatar.
meaning: Where a decoration sits relative to a profile picture.

name: relativeScale
desc: Scale of the overlay relative to the user's avatar.
meaning: How big a decoration is relative to a profile picture.

name: activeState
desc: Indicates if this prompt is active regardless of its reccurrence date, dismiss date or notification triggers. This is required.
meaning: Whether a contact reminder is switched on at all.

name: lastDismissDate
desc: The most recent day the user dismissed this prompt. Empty means the user has never dismissed the prompt.
meaning: The most recent day a person dismissed a reminder.

name: notificationTriggers
desc: If this is empty, only the "Prompt Spark" will be displayed (in the time-range read from per type config), no push notifications will be shown. If push notification are configured with this field, the "Prompt Spark" time-range will be determined by earliest notification value here.
meaning: The schedule of push notifications for a reminder.

name: purpose
desc: Read-only. This is derived from the containing field value.
meaning: What a reminder is for, derived automatically from where it is stored.

name: recurrence
desc: How frequently will this prompt occur and how many times.
meaning: How often and how many times a reminder repeats.

name: uniquePromptId
desc: Prompt ID is generated by server on initial mutate.
meaning: The server generated identifier of a reminder.

name: title
desc: Title of prompt/spark being sent.
meaning: The headline text of a reminder shown to a person.

name: languageCode
desc: Locale option in which the pronouns were set, in the BCP-47 format. Set by the client at write time.
meaning: The language a person chose their pronouns in.

name: pronounType
desc: The pronoun entry type that the user has selected. This indicates which locale-independent classification of pronoun was selected (or optionally, if it is a custom field).
meaning: Which category of pronoun a person selected.

name: value
desc: The user's preferred pronouns. Eg. "they / them". This is a human-readable string to be displayed as the user's pronoun. Set at write-time, regardless of pronoun-type. Value is returned as it was set (no localization).
meaning: The pronouns a person wants displayed, as they typed them.

name: learningSessionId
desc: All pronunciations with the same learning_session_id were learnt in the same learning flow, e.g. multiple name segments learnt simultaneously from a recording in the Your People UI.
meaning: Groups name pronunciations recorded in the same sitting.

name: locale
desc: The locale used when learning the pronunciation. BCP-47 language code, e.g. "en-US".
meaning: The language setting used when a name pronunciation was recorded.

name: phonemes
desc: Phoneme sequence representing how the user pronounces |token|. Format is specified by the phonology_type type field, e.g. go/psampa is the preferred phonology type used by the TTS team.
meaning: The sound-by-sound spelling of how someone says a name.

name: spellingHint
desc: An optional user-specified spelling of this token, to improve pronunciation learning success rate. E.g. the token may be "Jana" and the spelling hint "jah-nah".
meaning: A person's own phonetic spelling of a name to aid pronunciation.

name: token
desc: Corresponds to a word segment of the contact name. E.g. for a contact with given name "John Doe", last name "Smith" and nickname "Best Dad", |token| can be any of {John, Doe, Smith, Best, Dad}.
meaning: One word of a contact's name that a pronunciation applies to.

name: every
desc: Multiplier on the frequency of the recurrence. Use this to specify patterns that recur every X days, months, years, etc. Must be a positive int. Example: [remind me to call mom every 2nd week]. If this field isn't set, it will default to 1 (every day,every week, etc). This field is ignored when recurrence_data is a SingleRecurrence. Optional.
meaning: How many days, months or years apart a repeating reminder falls.

name: recurrenceEndDate
desc: Ends at abstract DateTime. (inclusive)
meaning: The last date a repeating reminder runs.

name: recurrenceStart
desc: The start of the recurrence can be represented as a DateTime. This field is ignored when recurrence_data is a SingleRecurrence.
meaning: The date a repeating reminder starts.

name: repeatCount
desc: Will repeat only a finite number of times. This is the original number of times the recurrence will repeat and not how many times are left for it to repeat. This end type is not currently supported.
meaning: How many times a reminder repeats; this option is not supported yet.

name: repeatForever
desc: Will continue to repeat until prompt is deleted.
meaning: Marks a reminder that repeats until it is deleted.

name: description
desc: A free-text summary that the user inputs. E.g. "Coder by day, jazz guitarist by night."
meaning: A free-text blurb a person writes about themselves for their profile card.

name: language
desc: Indicates the language of this search profile. Use ISO-639 2-letter language code to specifying the language that this profile is created in.
meaning: The language a person's profile card was written in.

name: publicEmail
desc: This is the email that the user has chosen to display on their "SearchCard" publicly.
meaning: The email address a person chose to show publicly on their profile card.

name: publicPhoneNumber
desc: This is the phone number that the user has chosen to display on their "SearchCard" publicly.
meaning: The phone number a person chose to show publicly on their profile card.

name: countryCode
desc: Corresponding country code. Refer to go/people-search-dashboard for code list.
meaning: The country tied to a person's profile card entry.

name: entity
desc: Corresponding mid in KG.
meaning: The knowledge graph identifier for a topic on a person's profile card.

name: name
desc: Custom name of entity if there is no corresponding place/entity in KG (mid)
meaning: A custom label used when no knowledge graph entry matches.

name: lat
desc: Degrees [-90 .. 90]
meaning: The latitude of a place on a person's profile card.

name: lon
meaning: The longitude of a place on a person's profile card.

name: radius
desc: Meters
meaning: How far around a point, in metres, a profile's service area reaches.

name: accountId
desc: Unique contributor account id allocated by presence/janata infrastructure. This will be used in the frontend for various actions like reporting errors, photo uploads etc., go/boba-janata, go/cleanup-contributor-creation
meaning: The internal account identifier for a profile card contributor.

name: accountMid
desc: Account KG entity mid assigned to this user required by old janata serving stack. This is not required anymore for serving. But might need it for historical purposes. See
meaning: An old knowledge graph identifier for an account, kept for history only.

name: aresId
desc: Ares id used for tracking the auto moderation.
meaning: An identifier used to track automatic moderation of a profile.

name: state
desc: Current state of the Search Profile.
meaning: The current status of a person's public profile card.

name: changeTimestamp
desc: Timestamp of when the state was changed.
meaning: When a profile's status last changed.

name: displayTimestamp
desc: This will be used to display status to the user at a set time. If set to a value after
meaning: When a status message should be shown to the person.

name: type
desc: State that the UserProfile was changed to.
meaning: The status a profile was moved into.

name: sourceId
desc: CP2 sourceid column.
meaning: A bookkeeping column copied from the phone contacts database.

name: sync1
desc: CP2 sync1 column.
meaning: A generic sync column copied from the phone contacts database.

name: sync2
desc: CP2 sync2 column.
meaning: A generic sync column copied from the phone contacts database.

name: sync3
desc: CP2 sync3 column.
meaning: A generic sync column copied from the phone contacts database.

name: sync4
desc: CP2 sync4 column.
meaning: A generic sync column copied from the phone contacts database.

name: clientName
desc: Not to be used. We have since moved to a lookup string at read time approach as opposed to storing data at write time. b/146072927
meaning: An old field for an app's name that is no longer meant to be used.

name: projectNumber
desc: Project number of the third party application performing the delete to be looked up via ClientAuthConfig during display time for users to know the current name of an application which has deleted contact data.
meaning: The project number of the outside app that deleted contact data.

name: lastTimeContacted
desc: Last time a contact was contacted.
meaning: When a person last got in touch with a contact.

name: timesContacted
desc: Number of times a contact was contacted.
meaning: How many times a person has contacted someone.

name: weekDay
desc: Set of weekdays the recurrence applies to.
meaning: Which weekdays a repeating reminder applies to.

name: monthlyPattern
desc: The monthly pattern to recur.
meaning: The within-month pattern a yearly reminder follows.

name: months
desc: The months of the year to apply the pattern.
meaning: Which months of the year a repeating reminder applies to.

name: clientInteractionInfo
desc: Information regarding client interactions.
meaning: Details of how a person interacted with a suggested contact in an app.

name: cloudDeviceDataInfo
desc: Device information about the candidate available in the cloud.
meaning: Device information about a suggested contact held on the server.

name: cloudScore
desc: Affinity score for the cloud contact.
meaning: A closeness score for a contact computed on the server.

name: suggestionConfidence
desc: Indicator of the confidence in suggestion relevance.
meaning: How confident the system is that a suggested contact is relevant.

name: isDirectClientInteraction
desc: Whether this suggestion is an edge directly from the client. E.g., a suggestion with which the user shared a photo on photos app.
meaning: Marks a contact suggestion that comes from a direct interaction in the app.

name: deviceScore
desc: The partial affinity score only counting device features.
meaning: The part of a contact closeness score that comes from device data.

name: isDeviceDataKnown
desc: Whether device data about this candidate were available in the cloud.
meaning: Whether any device data about a contact was available on the server.

name: avatarUrl
desc: Avatar image URL for a Google Group, based on the member count.
meaning: The picture shown for a Google Group in chat.

name: description
desc: Short description of this bot. Only set if EntityType == BOT.
meaning: A short blurb about a chat bot.

name: developerName
desc: Display name of bot developer. Only set if EntityType == BOT.
meaning: The name of the developer behind a chat bot.

name: isMembershipVisibleToCaller
desc: Whether caller has visibility into the direct members of the roster. NEXT TAG: 11
meaning: Whether the requester is allowed to see a group's members.

name: memberCount
desc: DEPRECATED: use segmented_membership_counts instead. Number of members (direct or indirect) in a Google Group. Only an estimate for large groups (currently > 1K direct / indirect members).
meaning: An old count of a Google Group's members, replaced by a newer field.

name: segmentedMembershipCounts
desc: Represents the direct membership counts of a Google Group. May contain counts based on member type and membership state.
meaning: Counts of a Google Group's direct members broken out by type and status.

name: actorId
desc: Actor ID of the person, if available (if the person has used the Paisa app).
meaning: A person's identifier in the Paisa payments app.

name: subtitle
desc: Display subtitle, which may be used in suggestion/autocompletion results. Generally, this will be the Actor's registered Paisa phone number, in unmasked or masked form (e.g. +1
meaning: A secondary line, usually a phone number, shown under a suggested contact.

name: familyStatus
desc: Whether the person is in the same family as the requesting user. Family here refers to
meaning: Whether a person is in the same family group as the requester.

name: hiddenKeys
desc: The full list of hidden keys associated with this person. These are the external equivalent to the keys stored by the ConnectionLabelService, and they can be passed to the MutateConnectionLabel endpoint to unhide this person. This field will only be set if hide_type is HIDDEN.
meaning: The identifiers needed to unhide a person a user has hidden.

name: hideType

meaning: Whether a person is in the same family group as the requester.

name: hideType
desc: If this field is not set, the person is visible (implicit).
meaning: How a person has been hidden from suggestions, if at all.

meaning: A human readable label for a topic, filled in only for debugging.

If a content is annotated with webref /m/07bs0, then the content has to explicitly mention "Tennis" in some way, whereas if a content is annotated with k'nex /m/07bs0, t
meaning: The everyday knowledge graph identifier that comes closest to this topic.

name: generality

name: mid
desc: This is an MID in the /t/ namespace. We will migrate them to /g/ in Q3'15.
meaning: The identifier of the topic a piece of content or a user profile is tagged with.

name: moderationReason

meaning: The reason a piece of social content was moderated.

name: moderatorType
desc: Type of moderation. Semantically REQUIRED,
meaning: Whether a human or an automated system did the moderating.

name: abuseTypes
desc: The abuses.
meaning: The kinds of abuse found in a piece of social content.

name: appealState
desc: The appeal state.
meaning: Where an appeal against a moderation decision stands.

name: contentRestriction
desc: Field to explain various restrictions of the Stanza. Some examples of restrictions are: - Not permitted because of legal restrictions of geography/country of viewer or creator. - Content not suitable for current viewer i.e. porn, abusive, racy. - Creator restricted the content to an age group. - etc...
meaning: Why viewing of a piece of social content is limited, such as legal or age reasons.

name: deleteReason

name: deliveryRestriction

meaning: Limits on who a piece of social content can be delivered to.

name: moderationInfo

meaning: Details of the moderation applied to a piece of social content.

name: moderationState
desc: The moderation state.
meaning: The current moderation status of a piece of social content.

name: endTimeUsec

meaning: End time of the audio the language-identification result covers.

name: rankedTopSupportedLanguages

meaning: Ranked list of the most likely spoken languages detected in audio.

name: startTimeUsec

meaning: Start time of the utterance this language result belongs to.

name: topLanguageConfidence

meaning: Confidence range for the top recognized spoken language.

name: voicedUtterance
desc: Identifies when the provided audio sample does or doesn't contain voiced samples. E.g. an unvoice utterance happens when the EOS signal is received before any frame because all frames were filtered by the endpointer. For events where voiced_utterance is false, ranked_top_supported_languages is defined but scores are not to be trusted. All LanguageIdentificationResults contains a valid value of voiced_utterance.
meaning: Whether the audio sample actually contained any speech.

name: format
desc: The format of the string in "locale". Should be one of LocaleFormat.
meaning: Which format the locale string is written in.

name: atomicSize
desc: Size of atomic type, in bytes.
meaning: Size in bytes of one atomic audio data element.

name: atomicType
desc: Numeric type of data elements (if generic)
meaning: Numeric data type of the audio elements.

name: bitRate
desc: For compressed signals with fixed bitrate, this is the number of bits per second.
meaning: Bits per second for compressed audio with a fixed bitrate.

name: byteOrder
desc: Byte-order of the atomic_type When atomic_type == "char", byte_order should be always "1". When atomic_type == "int16", byte_order can be either "01" (Intel) or "10" (Motorola). Byte order should default to Intel when in question.

name: details

name: dimension

meaning: Array dimensions of a single audio sample.

meaning: How many atomic elements are stored per audio sample.

name: rank

meaning: Whether each sample is a scalar, vector, or matrix.

name: sampleCoding

meaning: Encoding used for the audio samples.

name: sampleRate
desc: For periodic signals, this is the number samples per second, else 0.0
meaning: Samples per second for periodic audio signals.

name: sampleSize
desc: Size of a single sample, in bytes.
meaning: Size in bytes of one audio sample.

name: sampleType
desc: Structure of each sample. "generic" means that the samples are multi-dimensional arrays of atomic_type with the specified rank.
meaning: Structure of each audio sample.

meaning: Time origin of the audio signal, in seconds.

meaning: Total number of samples in the audio file.

meaning: ID of the internal Livegraph writer that asserted this fact.

meaning: Whether this entry only adds provenance to a fact that already exists.

meaning: Keys used to check a fact came from enough independent sources.

Specifically, weak data is less preferred by conflict resolution inside of Livegraph compositi

name: dataAccessRestrictions

meaning: Bit flags for restrictions on using this data with language models.

meaning: Regions where this data is legally allowed to be used.

meaning: The national prefix needed to dial this number domestically.

name: number
desc: The actual number, broken down into sections as per local convention. Note that the actual formatting of these sections (hyphen vs space, usage of parentheses) will vary according to local custom.
meaning: The phone number digits split into local convention sections.

name: averageTermWeight
desc: The average weight of terms in the document. If not available, there will be no term weight averaging: font sizes will be taken literally from the document HTML.
meaning: Average weight of the terms in the document, used to scale term weighting.

name: doc
desc: The document itself. If present, the docservers parse the contents to create a mustang repository.
meaning: The document content that doc servers parse into an index repository.

name: extendedDocid
desc: The serialized ExtendedDocId, needed to construct a proper docinfo response if the docinfo request is missing it and it's present.
meaning: Serialized extended document ID used to build a docinfo response.

name: globalDocid
desc: the global docid, we need it in the docservers (Continuum mode) to construct proper docinfo response when the docinfo request does not contain a valid global docid
meaning: The global document ID used by doc servers.

name: originalEncoding
desc: If the original encoding isn't UTF8
meaning: The document's original character encoding when it is not UTF-8.

name: sectionType
desc: Indicates format of 'tokens' field in all Section entries.
meaning: Format of the token data stored in each document section.

name: fieldName
desc: List of field repository (subsection) names within the section.
meaning: Names of the sub-sections stored inside a document section.

name: muppetTitleLengthInDeciems
desc: Total max length of title in deciems
meaning: Maximum length allowed for the title shown in results.

name: muppetTitleNumLines
desc: Number of lines for title
meaning: How many lines the displayed result title may use.

name: alliance
desc: STAR_ALLIANCE
meaning: Which airline alliance the carrier belongs to.

name: baggageCarryonLimitationsUrls
desc: Default url for baggage fee information.
meaning: Default link to the airline's carry-on baggage rules.

name: baggageFeeUrls
desc: Default url for baggage fee information.
meaning: Default link to the airline's baggage fee information.

name: countryCode
desc: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code in which this airline is domestic.
meaning: Country in which this airline is domestic.

name: countryContactInfo
desc: LocalizedContactInfo allows localization by country and language. Once the data is ready, we will start filling both fields. After that the old field will be deprecated and deleted at some point.
meaning: Airline contact details broken out by country and language.

name: dupFlag
desc: true, if this carrier's IATA code is a "controlled duplicate" (goto/controlled-duplicate).
meaning: Whether the airline's IATA code is a known duplicate.

name: fqtvPartnerCode
desc: IATA codes of airlines who this airline's travel can be credited to for mileage accrual.
meaning: Airlines whose mileage programmes credit this airline's flights.

name: iataCode
desc: Note that some iata_codes are reused (
meaning: The airline's IATA code.

name: icaoCode
desc: EZY - some have no ICAO code
meaning: The airline's ICAO code.

name: innovataCode
desc: U2! - with optional dedup sign ('!')
meaning: The airline's code in the Innovata data source.

name: mid
desc: Note: fields #16 and #17 are ununused. The identifier of the airline, e.g. /m/07y2s for United Populated using airlines_mids.csv.
meaning: Knowledge graph entity ID for the airline.

name: names
desc: EasyJet/イージージェット
meaning: Localized names of the airline.

name: passengerAssistanceUrls
desc: Default url for passenger assistance information.
meaning: Default link to the airline's passenger assistance information.

name: popularity
desc: Number of flights with this airline over the next 180 days.
meaning: Number of flights this airline has scheduled over the next 180 days.

name: shortNames
desc: KLM - instead of 'KLM Royal Dutch Airlines'
meaning: Short display names for the airline.

name: sustainabilityProgramUrls
desc: URLs for airlines' sustainability programs.
meaning: Links to the airline's sustainability programme pages.

name: waiverSummaryUrls
desc: Default url for waiver information.
meaning: Default link to the airline's fee waiver information.

name: data
desc: Typically, formatted phone number.
meaning: Contact data, usually a formatted phone number.

name: countryCode
desc: Two char country code, e.g. "US"
meaning: Two letter country code for this airline contact entry.

name: language
desc: IETF BCP-47, e.g. "en" or "zh-HK-Hant"
meaning: Language tag for this localized airline contact entry.

name: DelegatedProjectName
desc: Project delegation name to support bandwidth enforcement. Harpoon will call SetDelegatedUser() with the specified DelegatedProjectName and a domain associated with the RequestorID provided in the client capatibility file.
meaning: Project name used to attribute crawl bandwidth to a client.

name: labelsDeprecated
meaning: Old client label map that is no longer used.

name: StartPos
desc: In ContentRange, the first byte is 0 (rather than 1), and the positions are inclusive. Thus, length is EndPos+1-StartPos
meaning: Byte offset where a partial content range begins.

name: NotChangedTimeMs
desc: fetched from the web. Time when the page was last
meaning: Time the page was last checked and found unchanged.

name: OriginalCrawlTimeMs
desc: Time when the page was
meaning: Time the page was first crawled.

name: ReuseTimeMs
desc: checked but found to be the same as before. If set, timestamp to indicate
meaning: Timestamp marking when a previously fetched copy was reused.

name: OldestTimeStampInUS
desc: Limited to 3.
meaning: The oldest event timestamps kept, capped at three.

name: uncompressedSize
desc: Size hint. Set if compression != NO_COMPRESSION
meaning: Uncompressed size hint for a compressed fetch body.

name: NotChangedDate
desc: fetched from the web. Timestamp indicates when
meaning: Timestamp for when the page was last actually fetched from the web.

name: OriginalCrawlDate
desc: Timestamp when the page was
meaning: Timestamp for when the page was originally crawled.

name: ReuseDate
desc: the page was last checked but found to be the same as before. If set, timestamp to indicate
meaning: Timestamp for when the page was last checked and found unchanged.

name: events
desc: The events store the detail of messages (usually error).
meaning: Detailed messages, usually errors, from the file transfer.

name: filePath
desc: The complete path (include the file name) of the file downloaded. For requests that require delivery, this path will be the user specified location. For requests that use Multiverse default storage, this path will be the managed by Multiverse.
meaning: Where the downloaded file was written on storage.

name: status
desc: Status of the transfer action.
meaning: The result status of the file transfer action.

name: StartTrackingTimeUsec
desc: Start and end timestamp tracking the delays for this request.
meaning: Timestamp marking when delay tracking for this request began.

name: WaitRobotsCacheTimeUsec
desc: obsolete. Not set.
meaning: An obsolete waiting-time counter that is no longer populated.

name: WaitRobotsFetchTimeUsec
desc: obsolete. Not set.
meaning: An obsolete waiting-time counter that is no longer populated.

name: BodyLocation
desc: If set, indicates where the fetched body is, e.g. a CNS file path. FetchReply.Body should be empty in this case. In the case where client does not support streaming but the content is too large to be accumulated in memory, we keep writing the streaming chunks to some storage unit and notify client when it is done.
meaning: Where the fetched page body was stored when it was too large to hold in memory.

name: ChunkNumber
desc: Fetch number in this series of fetches
meaning: The sequence number of this chunk within a series of partial fetches.

name: ContentRange
desc: If there is a Content-Range header, the ranges in it
meaning: The byte range reported in the response's Content-Range header.

name: ETag
desc: Any ETag seen in the headers
meaning: The ETag value seen in the response headers.

name: FetchID
desc: ID which links all partial fetches for this url
meaning: An id linking together all partial fetches of the same URL.

name: IsFinalResponse
desc: Is this the final response for this fetch?
meaning: Flag marking the last response in a chunked fetch.

name: ContentType
desc: Content type as inferred by the fetcher (webutil/http/content-type.proto)
meaning: The content type the fetcher inferred for the response.

name: CutoffSize
desc: Where did we cut off? Includes headers plus truncated but uncompressed content. Present if and only if we truncated the document.
meaning: The size at which the document was cut off, present only when it was truncated.

name: HttpVersion
desc: DEPRECATED, see field 113. Stores the HTTP version we used in the final hop.
meaning: A deprecated record of the HTTP version used on the final hop.

name: ProtocolVersionFallback
desc: DEPRECATED, see field 114. Whether we fallback from HTTP/2 to HTTP/1.1 during fetch. The fallback could happen in any hops and there can be at most one fallback because once fallback happens, we will not try HTTP/2 anymore.
meaning: A deprecated flag for falling back from HTTP/2 to HTTP/1.1 during a fetch.

name: UnTruncatedSize
desc: The amount of data we got from the webserver before any truncation, but after undoing any HTTP gzip/deflate encoding. For HTTP, this includes headers and uncompressed content. Content size is excluded if content was not successfully fetched. See description above TotalFetchedSize for comparison.
meaning: How much data arrived before truncation, measured after decompression.

name: ClientCanCrawl
desc: Is this client/requestorid allowed to crawl now? (based on resource use)
meaning: Whether this crawl client is allowed to crawl right now given resource use.

name: IsDefaultNode
desc: Is this the 'default' user's list
meaning: Whether this queue is the default user's list.

name: IsListForUrl
desc: Was this the list that a given request landed in?
meaning: Whether this is the queue a given request landed in.

name: NumCurrentFetches
desc: # of current active fetches
meaning: Number of fetches currently running from this queue.

name: NumUrls
desc: # of urls currently in the queue
meaning: Number of URLs waiting in this crawl queue.

name: PartnerTotalCapacityQps
desc: Total qps for this partner dedicated hostload, for non partner it will be -1.0.
meaning: Total crawl capacity reserved for a partner's dedicated host load.

name: PartnerTotalUsedQps
desc: Currently used qps for this partner dedicated hostlaod, for non partner it will be -1.0.
meaning: Crawl capacity currently used by a partner's dedicated host load.

name: RequestType
desc: The type of the request (low latency vs. high throughput)
meaning: Whether the crawl request is low latency or high throughput.

name: RequestorFp
desc: The fp64 of the requestor string
meaning: A numeric fingerprint of the requesting client's name.

name: hyperdriveAppName
desc: Hyperdrive Analytics.
meaning: The name of the internal application making the request, kept for analytics.

name: topicId
desc: Propagate the id instead of the string name to save storage resource. TODO (b/317133951) consider deprecate the two fields in string above.
meaning: A numeric id stored instead of a name to save storage space.

name: clientRpcType
desc: through which RPC request
meaning: Which kind of remote call the original request came through.

name: PostDataSize
desc: What's the post data size (in bytes) if it's a post request.
meaning: Size in bytes of the POST body, when the request used POST.

name: numDroppedReplies
desc: Number of times we drop the content of a stream reply or the final reply, which can only be caused by REJECTED_NO_RPC_BUFFERS now.
meaning: How many replies were dropped because no send buffers were available.

name: HintIPAddress
desc: If we do not have Endpoints in FetchReplyData (e.g., url rejected due to hostload limit), do we have a guess of the server IPAddress (e.g., from robots fetch)? This helps us classify URLs based on country code, etc. The field is filled with IPAddress::ToPackedString().
meaning: A best guess at the server's IP address when the real one was not recorded.

name: RpcStartDeadlineLeftMs
desc: RPC deadline left at the start of url control flow. Can be useful for debugging rpc deadline exceeded error received by clients, this field is only recorded if RpcEndDeadlineLeftMs is small enough.
meaning: How much request deadline remained at the start of processing, for debugging.

name: largeStoreHitLocation
desc: Set to the hit location (CNS filename) if cache comes from large store.
meaning: The storage file where the large cached copy was found.

name: dependentFetchType
desc: Dependent fetch type
meaning: What type of dependent fetch this request was.

name: isVpcTraffic
desc: Set if the fetch goes through the virtual private cloud path so we can track the VPC traffic.
meaning: Whether the fetch traveled the private cloud network path.

name: httpVersion
desc: Stores the HTTP version we used in the last hop.
meaning: The HTTP version used on the last hop of the fetch.

name: BotGroupName
desc: If we fetched using BotFetchAgent, what is the BotGroupName?
meaning: Which internal bot group performed the fetch.

name: isBidiStreamingFetch
desc: Whether this is a bidirectional streaming fetch.
meaning: Whether the fetch used two-way streaming.

name: authenticationInfo
desc: Stores the OAuth authentication method.
meaning: Which OAuth authentication method was used for the fetch.

name: RequestUserName
desc: Log the loas username in trawler private to help with debugging. Store the username in trawler private so clients won't see it from FetchReply. To reduce disk usage, we only log the loas username if the requestorid being used does not have ClientUsernameRestrictions.
meaning: The internal username of the requester, logged to help with debugging.

name: cacheHitType
desc: Only set if the fetch uses cache content (is_cache_fetch is true).
meaning: What kind of cache hit served this fetch.

name: originalClientParams
desc: Store the original client information.
meaning: A stored copy of the original requesting client's settings.

name: IsRobotsFetch
desc: Was this an internally-initiated robots.txt fetch?
meaning: Whether this fetch was an internally started robots.txt request.

name: resourceBucket
desc: If the requestor shares resource bucket with other requestorids, we will store the resource bucket name in these fields.
meaning: Name of the shared resource pool the requester draws from.

name: cacheAcceptableAge
desc: Corresponds to AcceptableAge field in FetchParams.
meaning: How old cached content was allowed to be for this request.

name: Producer
desc: Note TrawlerPrivateFetchReplyData is never sent back to clients. The following field is just for Trawler and Multiverse internal tracking, and clients should not look at this field at all.
meaning: Internal tracking field that clients are explicitly told to ignore.

name: ProxyInstance
desc: If set, this fetch was done through a proxy (e.g., fetchproxy).
meaning: Which proxy, if any, the fetch was routed through.

name: concurrentStreamNum
desc: How many concurrent streams are on the connection when the request finishes (including this request). Export this value to monitor the stream multiplexing for HTTP/2.
meaning: How many streams shared the connection when this request finished.

name: cacheAcceptableAfterDate
desc: Corresponds to AcceptableAfterDate field in FetchParams.
meaning: The earliest date cached content was allowed to have for this request.

name: credentialId
desc: Log the credential id
meaning: The credential identifier logged for this fetch.

name: ResponseBytes
desc: The number of bytes we sent back to the client.
meaning: How many bytes were sent back to the crawl client.

name: downloadFileName
desc: If the response header contains Content-Disposition header "attachment; filename="google.zip": the download_file_name would be "google.zip"
meaning: The filename given in the response's Content-Disposition header.

name: isFloonetFetch
desc: Whether or not this is a Floonet fetch request. Floonet requests have inherent lower availability (due to HOPE rejections when HOPE is in degraded mode, and other Floonet specific reasons). Therefore, it is important for debugging and for our availability SLO to know whether of not it is a floonet fetch. IMPORTANT NOTE: This field is only currently set for traffic that explicitly requires Floonet and can not failover to use Googlebot (i.e. "transparent" or "implicit" Floonet
meaning: Whether the request went through the Floonet fetch path.

name: multiverseClientIdentifier
desc: Multiverse client information
meaning: Information identifying the internal client that made the request.

name: TrawlerInstance
desc: Which Trawler cell was this response fetched in? (e.g. "HR" or "YQ")
meaning: Which crawler data center handled this response.

name: HSTSHeaderValue
desc: HTTP Strict-Transport-Security (RFC6797) header value. We log this so we can generate a list of hosts that prefer HTTPS over HTTP.
meaning: The site's Strict-Transport-Security header, logged to list hosts preferring HTTPS.

name: tier
desc: Service tier info will be used in traffic grapher for ploting per tier graph.
meaning: The service tier of the request, used for traffic charts.

name: Is5xxHostId
desc: Represents if the HostId belongs to HostId set in 5xx url patterns, it can work as a tag when emitting requestor minute summary, this helps us to aggregate traffic affected by 5xx patterns, and test if there are any fetching changes.
meaning: Marks hosts in a set known for server error patterns, used for traffic reporting.

name: UserAgentSent
desc: The useragent string sent to the remote webserver. It corresponds to UserAgentToSend field in FetchParams.
meaning: The user agent string the crawler sent to the web server.

name: googleExtendedObeyWildcardRobotsStatus
desc: We check if Google-Extended is allowed to crawl this URL, wildcard rules are obeyed, this is for internal analysis. Check RobotsTxtClient::RobotsStatus for the meaning of number.
meaning: Whether Google-Extended may crawl the URL when wildcard robots rules are obeyed.

name: RobotsBody
desc: If this was a robots.txt fetch (IsRobotsFetch above), this may contain the robots.txt body. (It may not, for instance, 404s are omitted; current policy is URL_CRAWLED + partially crawled) This includes http headers + body.
meaning: The contents of a fetched robots.txt file, headers included.

name: UserAgentSentFp
desc: The fp2011 of useragent sent to the remote webserver, note it corresponds to UserAgentToSend field in FetchParams
meaning: A numeric fingerprint of the user agent string that was sent.

name: prodRegion
desc: Log the prod region (only for regional harpoon requestor ids)
meaning: The production region logged for certain regional requesters.

name: RpcEndDeadlineLeftMs
desc: RPC deadline left at the end of url control flow. Can be useful for debugging rpc deadline exceeded error received by clients, this field is only recorded if it's small enough.
meaning: How much request deadline remained at the end of processing, for debugging.

name: isFromGrpcProxy
desc: Whether or not this response is sent from gRPC proxy service.
meaning: Whether the response came back through the gRPC proxy service.

name: ServerSignature
desc: An arbitrary string signature identifying the remote server type/version. In the case of HTTP, this would be the contents of the "Server:" header.
meaning: The Server header string identifying the remote web server software.

name: googleExtendedRobotsStatus
desc: We check if Google-Extended is allowed to crawl this URL and store the result here, wildcard rules are not obeyed, this is for internal analysis. Check RobotsTxtClient::RobotsStatus for the meaning of number.
meaning: Whether Google-Extended may crawl the URL, ignoring wildcard rules.

name: BotHostname
desc: This is the HOPE server that we sent the url to. We log the HOPE backend cell and hope server shard number (e.g., 'qf:6'). This allows us to understand how we are balancing our load to the HOPE servers.
meaning: Which internal fetch server handled the URL, logged to check load balancing.

name: vpcDestination
desc: The following are vpc information that's only set if is_vpc_traffic is true.
meaning: Private cloud destination details, filled in only for that kind of traffic.

name: bypassedHostOverfull
desc: Cache hit for this url, bypassed host_overfull error.
meaning: Marks a cached hit that skipped the host overload error.

name: CacheRequestorID
desc: Present if the reply is from the trawler cache. This is the requestorid of the trawler client that populated the cache with the data we are reusing.
meaning: Which client originally filled the cache entry being reused.

name: FetcherTaskNumber
desc: Which Trawler fetcher task fetched this URL.
meaning: Which fetcher task did the crawling.

name: debug
desc: A debug message that summarizes how the score was computed. Populated if result was matched and in debug mode.
meaning: A debug string explaining how the score was computed, only in debug mode.

name: docid
desc: The docid of the result, if available.
meaning: The internal document identifier of the result, when available.

name: estimatedNaviness
desc: The naviness for this result. Each matcher can determine the naviness to use for the result. This can be copied directly from the result, or estimated based on clicks or some other heuristic. The value should be between 0 and 1 and should indicate the probability that the user will click on that result. The estimated_naviness is used to break ties when between results with the same rank.
meaning: An estimate of how likely a user is to click this result, used to break ties.

name: provenance
desc: All provenances of this result support.
meaning: A record of where this result support came from.

name: rank
desc: The 0 based rank for this result. When the source is MAIN_GSR this corresponds to the index of the result in the generic search response specific in AddKnowledgePackerPreprocessors. Otherwise, the rank should be estimated so the result is closest in importance to the web result at the same rank.
meaning: The zero based position of this result, used to place it against web results.

name: score
desc: A score from 0 to 1 inclusive that represents the strength of the result support. A score of one indicates this result is entirely about this interpretation.
meaning: How strongly this result supports a given query interpretation, from 0 to 1.

name: source
desc: The source of the result support.
meaning: Which system this result support came from.

name: url
desc: The result url when available.
meaning: The address of the result, when available.

name: entityGroupType
desc: Entity group type of the supported entity. This field should only be set for support on entities.
meaning: The entity group type of the entity that this result supports.

name: fromAnswer
desc: ===== Deprecated Fields ===== The bool flag indicating whether the ResultSupport comes from answer entities.
meaning: A deprecated flag saying the support came from answer entities.

name: name
desc: The provenance provider name.
meaning: The name of the provider that supplied this provenance record.

name: NotChangedTimeMs
desc: fetched from the web. Time when the page was last
meaning: Timestamp for when the page was last fetched from the web.

name: OriginalCrawlTimeMs
desc: Time when the page was
meaning: Timestamp for when the page was originally crawled.

name: ReuseTimeMs
desc: checked but found to be the same as before. If set, timestamp to indicate
meaning: Timestamp for when the page was last checked and found unchanged.

name: url
desc: when it is fetched from the repository. URL of the document for debugging
meaning: The document address kept only for debugging when the record is read back.

name: canonicalCode
desc: The canonical error code (see codes.proto) that most closely corresponds to this status. This may be missing, and in the common case of the generic space, it definitely will be.
meaning: The standard error code closest to this status.

name: code
desc: Numeric code drawn from the space specified below. Often, this is the canonical error space, and code is drawn from google3/util/task/codes.proto
meaning: The numeric status or error code.

name: message
desc: Detail message
meaning: A readable detail message describing the status.

name: messageSet
desc: message_set associates an arbitrary proto message with the status.
meaning: An attached message carrying extra detail about the status.

name: space
desc: The following are usually only present when code != 0 Space to which this status belongs
meaning: Which family of error codes this status belongs to.

name: policy
desc: The list of trusted genome policy.
meaning: The list of store policies attached to this Play app annotation.

name: testCode
desc: The list of test code, used to log when serving. The test code is set in both control and experiment annotations when they are different.
meaning: Test codes logged at serving time to compare control and experiment annotations.

name: trustedGenomeHierarchy
desc: The list of trusted genome hierarchy. One trusted_genome_hierarchy may contain one or multiple entities. This is required for TG 2.0 tags.
meaning: The list of genre hierarchies attached to a Play app.

name: categoryId
desc: The category id matching this trusted genome entity. e.g. Action tag with id /m/025zzc matches category of id GAME_ACTION
meaning: The Play store category that matches this app tag.

name: id
desc: The identifier of a play trusted genome entity. Required.
meaning: The identifier of a Play app genre entity.

name: isLocalized
desc: Indicate whether the trusted genome entity has localized title.
meaning: Whether this app genre entity has a translated title.

name: level
desc: The level of the entity. E.g. in hierarchy like Action -> Platformer > Endless Runner. Action is level 1, Platformer is level 2 and Endless Runner is level 3. Currently, only APP_TAXONOMY and GAME_TAXONOMY type may have the levels. For entity that does not have hierarchy, its level is 1. Required.
meaning: How deep this entity sits in its genre hierarchy.

name: predicateName
desc: The name of the relation between the app and the entity. Required.
meaning: The name of the relationship between the app and this entity.

name: queryText
desc: The localized query string for this trusted genome entity. This query will be used when we want to bring users to SERP on click.
meaning: The translated search phrase used when a user clicks this Play tag.

name: recsTopicId
desc: The corresponding recs topics created from the trusted genome entity if available.
meaning: Recommendation topic ids created from this app genre entity.

name: score
desc: The confidence score of the entity to the app.
meaning: How confidently this genre entity applies to the app.

name: title
desc: The localized title. Required.
meaning: The translated display name of the entity.

name: userVisible
desc: This boolean is used to decide whether this entity will be shown on user-facing features in the Store or not.
meaning: Whether this entity is shown in user facing Play Store features.

name: entity
desc: List of entities (one or multiple) that belong in the same hierarchy. The entries will be ordered such that the first entry will be of level 1, and the second entry will be of level 2, and so on. Required
meaning: The ordered list of entities that make up one genre hierarchy.

name: hierarchyType
desc: The (hierarchy-level) type of this Trusted Genome hierarchy. Will only be populated when meeting certain criteria, e.g. 'GD2_Game_Main' means this hierarchy of entities can serve as the main game genre for Game Discovery 2.0.
meaning: The type of this genre hierarchy, filled in only in certain cases.

name: source
desc: The source of this Trusted Genome hierarchy.
meaning: Where this genre hierarchy came from.

name: trustedGenomeType
desc: The (entity-level) type of trusted genome entities in this hierarchy. Required.
meaning: The type of the genre entities contained in this hierarchy.

name: localizedRegionOverride
desc: Override text for region for special treatment. Override will be used in special cases for example regions are too long to show in UI, the override will be "CA/NV/..." to cut it short. By keeping a region override string we'll have more flexibility to adjust what we show on UI. Optional.
meaning: Shortened region text shown when the full region list is too long to display.

name: policyType
desc: Policy type. e.g. Government Endorsed, Apollo Required.
meaning: The kind of policy, such as government endorsed.

name: targetRegion
desc: Contains target region for the current policy. Optional
meaning: The regions this policy applies to.

name: localizedRegion
desc: Localized name for targeted regions. e.g. San Francisco Bay Area Required.
meaning: The translated name of a targeted region.

name: mid
desc: Associated KG entity mid for region. e.g. /m/06pvr
meaning: The knowledge graph entity id for the region.

name: channelMap
desc: Maps channel indexes of an audio stream to indexes corresponding to the specified ambisonics channel ordering scheme. For example: A 1st order pheriphonic ambisonics format is configured with 4 audio channels corresponding to ambisonic components W, X, Y, Z respectively. The channel_ordering scheme is specified as CHANNEL_ORDERING_ACN (which implies a W, Y, Z, X ordering). Therefore the channel_map is [0, 3, 1, 2].
meaning: How audio channels line up with the ambisonic component ordering.

name: owner
desc: REQUIRED: the current owner of this video. Please note that owner does not get implicit reader/writer access. You must set them explicitly.
meaning: Who currently owns this stored video asset.

name: reader
desc: Allowed readers of this video.
meaning: Who is allowed to read this stored video asset.

name: writer
desc: Allowed writers of this video.
meaning: Who is allowed to modify this stored video asset.

name: objective
desc: The objective this transition is about. REQUIRED.
meaning: The goal that this video processing transition relates to.

name: outcome
desc: Whether the objective is reached or not. REQUIRED.
meaning: Whether a video asset processing step succeeded.

name: reason
desc: An optional debug string indicating the reason for this transition. This is typically omitted for OUTCOME_SUCCESS. e.g. "The video's content is invalid due to failed blobstore cloning."
meaning: A debug message explaining why a video asset step ended the way it did.

name: id
desc: REQUIRED. IDs have some constraints: - 32 bytes max: this is enforced by the server - for the time being, must be parseable as a youtube ID (basically a base64-encoded string which maps to a 64-bit integer). This restriction will eventually be lifted.
meaning: The internal video identifier, capped at 32 bytes.

name: ns
desc: LINT.ThenChange( //depot/google3/googledata/production/playbooks/video-assets/clients.md, //depot/google3/video/assets/venom/proto/namespace.proto ) REQUIRED.
meaning: The namespace that a video identifier belongs to.

name: bitrate
desc: Audio bitrate in bits/s.
meaning: The audio bitrate of a video file in bits per second.

name: channels
desc: Number of audio channels.
meaning: How many audio channels the video's sound track has.

name: codecId
desc: Audio codec ID. Uses the numeric value corresponding to the CodecId enum object, in order to avoid the dependency on vsi/videostreaminfo.proto.
meaning: A numeric code saying which audio codec was used.

name: contentType
desc: Content type of the stream. Only populated with valid "acont" xtag values at the moment. Supported acont xtag values can be found in google3/video/storage/common/xtag_validation.cc. Examples: "original", "dubbed", "descriptive", "commentary", etc.
meaning: What kind of audio track this is, such as original, dubbed or commentary.

name: language
desc: Language, examples: "eng", "en", "enG", etc.
meaning: The language of the audio track.

name: lengthSec
desc: Audio length, in seconds. This value is derived from metadata in the source video, and often differs from the actual duration of any given transcode. In videos without valid timestamps, this value is not calculable, and is reported as zero.
meaning: The audio length in seconds as reported by the source video file.

name: sampleRate
desc: Audio sample rate.
meaning: The audio sample rate.

name: streamIndex
desc: Index of the stream in the file, 0-based.
meaning: The position of this stream inside the video file.

name: anchorQbstDistance
desc: QBST distance between the anchor and the top navboost query of the video if exists, or the video title otherwise.
meaning: How far the key moment text is from the video's top query or its title.

name: asrAverageBabelSimilarityScore
desc: Average of babel similarity between the anchor and all asr sentences.
meaning: Average text similarity between the key moment label and all spoken sentences.

name: asrMaximumBabelSimilarityScore
desc: Maximum babel similarity between the anchor and the asr sentences.
meaning: Best text similarity between the key moment label and any spoken sentence.

name: bleurtFeatures
desc: Features needed for Bleurt inference.
meaning: The inputs collected for running the Bleurt text model on a key moment.

name: bleurtScore
desc: The Bleurt inference score generated using the bleurt_features.
meaning: The Bleurt model score for a video key moment label.

name: descartesScoreWithTitle
desc: Descartes similarity score between video title and anchor label.
meaning: Similarity score between the video title and the key moment label.

name: descriptionAverageBabelSimilarityScore
desc: Average of babel similarity between the anchor and all description sentences.
meaning: Average similarity between the key moment label and the description sentences.

name: descriptionMaximumBabelSimilarityScore
desc: Maximum babel similarity between the anchor and the description sentences.
meaning: Best similarity between the key moment label and any description sentence.

name: dolphinDescriptivenessScore
desc: The predicted descriptiveness and usefulness rating scores generated by the Unified Dolphin model. Rating template: experimental/video/video_anchors_oneside_without_thumbnail/template.jhtml
meaning: Predicted rating of how descriptive and useful a video key moment is.

name: dolphinEnsembleScore
desc: If the dolphin model is an ensemble model, this contains the scores associated to each individual ensemble model.
meaning: Individual model scores when the key moment scorer is an ensemble.

name: dolphinFeatures
desc: The features used to generate the Dolphin score.
meaning: The inputs used to produce the key moment's Dolphin score.

name: dolphinScore
desc: The score generated by the Dolphin callout model.
meaning: The Dolphin model score for a video key moment.

name: labelPhraseEmbedding
desc: A phrase embedding for the anchor label. The model used to generate the embedding can be found in VideoAnchorSets: video_score_info.common_features.label_phrase_embedding_model
meaning: A numeric embedding of the key moment label text.

name: mumDescriptivenessScore
desc: The predicted descriptiveness of the anchor using the MUM unified scoring model.
meaning: Predicted descriptiveness of a key moment from the MUM model.

name: mumUsefulnessScore
desc: The predicted usefulness of the anchor using the MUM unified scoring model.
meaning: Predicted usefulness of a key moment from the MUM model.

name: retentionScore
desc: A score that is correlated with retention probability of the interval associated with this anchor (start time to end time). Retention probability of an interval is 1 - (probability the user does not watch the interval all the way through, given they started watching it). This score may be predicted by a model, or calculated from actual retention data.
meaning: How likely viewers are to watch this part of the video all the way through.

name: saftDocument
desc: A saft document generated from the anchor label.
meaning: A linguistic annotation built from the key moment label text.

name: timedLabelFeatures
desc: For annotating labels and their timing and context info. For example, this is used for anchor labels within a passage.
meaning: Labels found in a passage with their timing and surrounding context.

name: titleAnchorBabelMatchScore
desc: Babel similarity between the anchor and the video title.
meaning: Text similarity between the key moment label and the video title.

name: asrConfidence
desc: The ASR confidence for the label span, if available.
meaning: How confident speech recognition was about this piece of text.

name: isSentenceStart
desc: Whether or not this token is the first token in a sentence.
meaning: Whether this word is the first word of a sentence.

name: labelBeginCharIndex
desc: The character index range for the span. The end index is exclusive.
meaning: Where the label text starts within the surrounding text.

name: timeMs
desc: The time of the span.
meaning: The point in the video where this piece of text occurs.

name: imagesearchDocid
desc: Serving docid for the thumbnail in the images-tbn tables.
meaning: The internal serving key for a key moment thumbnail image.

name: isThumbnailMissing
desc: Set to true when no thumbnail could be generated for this anchor.
meaning: Whether no thumbnail could be made for this key moment.

name: servingMetadata
desc: Metadata about the anchor thumbnail computed by Amarna, including dimensions and the size in bytes.
meaning: Size and dimension details for the key moment thumbnail.

name: thumbnailInfo
desc: Information about the thumbnail anchor.
meaning: Details about the thumbnail chosen for a key moment.

name: timestampMs
desc: Millisecond timestamp of the frame used for the thumbnail.
meaning: The moment in the video that the thumbnail frame was taken from.

name: colorEntropy
desc: Entropy of the clustered color distribution.
meaning: How varied the colours are in the thumbnail image.

name: imageData
desc: Thumbnail image data for SafeSearch classification.
meaning: The thumbnail image itself, kept for safety classification.

name: isUnsafe
desc: Convenience field that consolidates signals for whether this thumbnail is safe.
meaning: A single flag saying whether the thumbnail is considered unsafe.

name: starburstV4Embedding
desc: 64d float vector of starburst v4 embedings.
meaning: A 64 number visual embedding of the thumbnail.

name: thumbnailBytes
desc: The raw data for a thumbnail.
meaning: The raw stored bytes of the thumbnail image.

name: dolphinDescriptivenessStats
desc: A summary of the Dolphin descriptiveness scores of the anchors in the set.
meaning: Summary of descriptiveness scores across a video's key moments.

name: dolphinUsefulnessStats
desc: A summary of the Dolphin usefulness scores of the anchors in the set.
meaning: Summary of usefulness scores across a video's key moments.

name: mumDescriptivenessStats
desc: A summary of the MUM descriptiveness scores of the anchors in the set.
meaning: Summary of MUM descriptiveness scores across a video's key moments.

name: mumUsefulnessStats
desc: A summary of the MUM usefulness scores of the anchors in the set.
meaning: Summary of MUM usefulness scores across a video's key moments.

name: hasMissingStarburst
desc: Whether or not any of the anchor thumbnails have missing Starburst embeddings.
meaning: Whether any key moment thumbnail is missing its visual embedding.

name: hasMissingThumbnails
desc: Whether or not any of the anchors have missing thumbnails.
meaning: Whether any key moment is missing a thumbnail.

name: thumbnailDiversity
desc: A score representing how diverse a set of thumbnails is. This is currently defined as one minus the median pairwise cosine similarity between thumbnail Starburst embeddings.
meaning: How visually different a video's key moment thumbnails are from each other.

name: fallbackAspect
desc: Product aspect to be used if non of the other aspects exist.
meaning: A backup product aspect used when no other aspect is available.

name: saftAspect
desc: Product aspect produced by running SAFT annotation.
meaning: A product aspect found by text annotation.

name: confidence
desc: The confidence score of the token: between 0 and 1.
meaning: How confident speech recognition is about a transcribed word.

name: durationMs
desc: The duration that the token is spoken for.
meaning: How long the spoken word lasts.

name: startTimeMs
desc: The time in the video at which the token starts being spoken.
meaning: When in the video the word starts being spoken.

name: text
desc: The speech token.
meaning: The transcribed spoken word itself.

name: asrMentionText
desc: If the description anchor has been recognized as an entity and that entity has also been mention in the ASR, this is the mention text from the ASR.
meaning: The wording used in the spoken transcript when the topic is mentioned.

name: asrMentionTranscriptOffset
desc: The start index of the ASR entity mention from the beginning of the ASR transcript. The index is included so that individual mentions that share the same mid and time can be distinguished which happens when an entity is mentioned multiple times in an ASR sentence. Each mid/asr_mention_transcript_offset will be unique.
meaning: A character position used to tell repeated mentions of a topic apart.

name: asrSentence
desc: The nearest ASR sentence.
meaning: The closest sentence from the spoken transcript.

name: asrStartTime
desc: The begin time in ms of the ASR sentence.
meaning: When the matched transcript sentence begins.

name: bertScores
desc: The result of the BERT inference using the title, ASR sentence and entity mention text.
meaning: BERT outputs computed from the title, transcript sentence and mention text.

name: broadness
desc: A score to help determine how specific this entity is.
meaning: How broad or general the topic is.

name: durationCoverage
desc: The percentage of the video covered by the span of the first mention to the last mention.
meaning: What share of the video lies between the first and last mention of the topic.

name: entityConnectedness
desc: The webref connectedness score of the entity.
meaning: How well connected the topic is in Google's entity graph.

name: entityDescription
desc: A short text describing the entity.
meaning: A short description of the topic.

name: entityInfo
desc: Information about how many documents the entity occurred in and how many total mentions the entity has across the entire video corpus.
meaning: Counts of how often and in how many videos the topic appears.

name: entityMentionInDescription
desc: Whether or not the entity mention text appears in the description of the video.
meaning: Whether the topic's wording also appears in the video description.

name: estimatedMentionTime
desc: The estimated begin time in ms of the entity mention using the text offset divided by the ASR duration.
