meaning: The estimated time in the video when the topic is mentioned.

name: groupCohesion
desc: Average similarity between this anchor and other anchors in the set.
meaning: How similar this key moment is to the others in its group.

name: hypernymConfidence
desc: The confidence of the hypernym used as the set label.
meaning: Confidence in the broader category chosen as the group label.

name: hypernymCount
desc: Number of hypernyms used for calculating similarity.
meaning: How many broader categories were used when measuring similarity.

name: hyperpediaSalientTermsSimilarity
desc: The cosine similarity between the document salient terms and the hyperpedia hypernyms for a given entity.
meaning: How close the topic's broader categories are to the video's main terms.

name: inWebrefEntities
desc: Whether or not this entity is in the webref entities.
meaning: Whether this topic is among the video's recognised entities.

name: isOracleEntity
desc: True if the given entity appears as an Oracle followup query.
meaning: Whether the topic also shows up as a follow up query.

name: isProduct
desc: Whether this entity counts as a 'product' for the purpose of dividing entities between the 'related topics' and 'products in this video' features.
meaning: Whether the topic counts as a product rather than a related topic.

name: maxMentionConfidence
desc: The maximum confidence of all of the entity mentions in the transcript.
meaning: The highest confidence among all mentions of the topic in the transcript.

name: mentionConfidence
desc: The confidence that the ASR mention matches the given mid.
meaning: Confidence that the spoken mention refers to this particular topic.

name: mentions
desc: Number of times an entity is mentioned in the ASR transcript.
meaning: How many times the topic is mentioned in the spoken transcript.

name: msFromLastAnchor
desc: The duration in ms between this anchor and the previous anchor or the beginning of the video if this is the first anchor.
meaning: Time since the previous key moment, or since the video started.

name: nextAsrSentence
desc: The ASR sentence after asr_sentence or "" if it is the last sentence.
meaning: The transcript sentence that comes after the matched one.

name: otherAsrMentionText
desc: The ASR text of each mention of the entity.
meaning: The transcript wording of every mention of the topic.

name: otherEstimatedMentionTimes
desc: Each time the entity was mentioned.
meaning: Every estimated time at which the topic was mentioned.

name: previousAsrSentence
desc: The ASR sentence before asr_sentence or "" if it is the first sentence.
meaning: The transcript sentence that comes before the matched one.

name: trustedNameConfidence
desc: The confidence that the ASR mention is a trusted name.
meaning: Confidence that the spoken mention is a reliable name for the topic.

name: webrefEntityTopicality
desc: The webref entity topicality score if the entity is a webref entity and 0 if not.
meaning: How on topic the recognised entity is, or zero if it is not one.

name: aggregateScore
desc: The total score used for filtering and selecting entity sets.
meaning: The combined score used to filter and pick topic groups.

name: clusterSize
desc: The prefiltered size of the entity set.
meaning: How many topics were in the group before filtering.

name: entitiesInWebrefEntities
desc: The number of entities in the anchor set that are in the webref entities.
meaning: How many topics in the group are recognised entities.

name: entityMentionInDescriptionCount
desc: The number of anchors where the entity mention text appears in the description of the video.
meaning: How many key moments use wording that also appears in the description.

name: groupCohesion
desc: The average cosine similarity between hypernyms of members of the set.
meaning: Average similarity between the broader categories of group members.

name: hypernym
desc: The most prominent hypernym across the entities in the set.
meaning: The most common broader category across topics in the group.

name: hypernymSalience
desc: The salience of the best hypernym for the set.
meaning: How prominent the group's chosen broader category is.

name: medianMentions
desc: Median number of times any member of the set was mentioned in the ASR transcript.
meaning: The median number of transcript mentions among topics in the group.

name: mentionSalience
desc: Mentions divided by the total number of entity mentions in the video.
meaning: The share of all topic mentions in the video that belong to this one.

name: salience
desc: Salience of the set computed by aggregating the hypernyms from each member and calculating the cosine similarity with the salient terms.
meaning: How prominent the topic group is relative to the video's main terms.

name: topHypernym
desc: The top N hypernyms for the entities in the set.
meaning: The leading broader categories for the topics in the group.

name: totalMentions
desc: Number of times any member of the group was mentioned in the ASR transcript.
meaning: Total transcript mentions for all topics in the group.

name: entityDocCount
desc: The number of documents where this entity was mentioned at least once.
meaning: How many videos mention this topic at least once.

name: entityMentionCount
desc: The number of times the entity was mentioned across the entire corpus.
meaning: How many times this topic is mentioned across the whole collection.

name: mid
desc: The entity id.
meaning: The identifier of the topic these counts belong to.

name: totalDocCount
desc: The number of documents in the corpus.
meaning: How many documents are in the collection, used for comparison.

name: totalMentionCount
desc: The number of mentions of any entity across the entire corpus.
meaning: Total mentions of any topic across the whole collection.

name: alignedOcrTexts
desc: OCR anchors with overlapping time-window with this anchor
meaning: On screen text detected during the same stretch of video as this key moment.

name: alignedTime
desc: The time stamp in milliseconds for the reference text (e.g. description anchor time).
meaning: The video timestamp that the reference text points at.

name: contextText
desc: Text around the aligned_time of a long duration, say [-15 minutes, +15 minutes]
meaning: Transcript text from a wide window around the aligned time.

name: labelText
desc: The main label text for the feature.
meaning: The main label text for the key moment.

name: textSimilarityFeatures
desc: Identified matching text by similarity.
meaning: Matching text found by similarity comparison.

name: textSpanAtAlignedTime
desc: The text span in the passage starting from the aligned time.
meaning: The stretch of transcript text starting at the aligned time.

name: dolphinFeatures
desc: The features used to construct the inference example.
meaning: The inputs assembled for the Dolphin span model.

name: dolphinScores
desc: The inference result from the Dolphin span model.
meaning: Scores returned by the Dolphin span model.

name: embeddingDistance
desc: Embedding distances (e.g. cosine distance) to the other anchors of the same video.
meaning: How far this key moment's embedding sits from the video's other key moments.

name: postGapInMs
desc: Time gap in ms to the next anchor. Always positive number.
meaning: Time until the next key moment.

name: preGapInMs
desc: Time gap in ms to the previous anchor. Always a positive number.
meaning: Time since the previous key moment.

name: saftBeginTokenIndex
desc: The range of tokens in video_info.saft_doc for the anchor label.
meaning: A pointer to where the label's words sit in the stored annotation document.

name: saftTranscriptStartCharOffset
desc: The range of characters in video_info.saft_transcript for the anchor label.
meaning: A pointer to where the label starts in the stored transcript text.

name: spanAsrConfidenceStats
desc: A summary of the ASR confidence for the selected candidate.
meaning: Summary of speech recognition confidence for the chosen text span.

name: spanDolphinScore
desc: A summary of the Dolphin span token scores for the selected candidate.
meaning: Summary of Dolphin word scores for the chosen text span.

name: wordCount
desc: Word count of the span text, tokenized with SAFT.
meaning: How many words the text span contains.

name: anchorSetDolphinScoreStats
desc: A summary of the dolphin scores over the anchor set.
meaning: Summary of Dolphin scores across a video's set of key moments.

name: commentId
desc: The ID that YouTube uses to uniquely identify the comment.
meaning: The YouTube identifier of a comment.

name: likeCount
desc: The total number of likes (positive ratings) the comment has received.
meaning: How many likes a YouTube comment received.

name: miniStanza
desc: The MiniStanza object that represents the comment. If populated, all other fields in this message may be empty.
meaning: An internal object that stands in for the comment.

name: publishedAt
desc: The date and time when the comment was orignally published, specified in ISO 8601 format.
meaning: When the comment was first posted.

name: textDisplay
desc: The comment's text, in HTML.
meaning: The comment text as HTML.

name: textOriginal
desc: The original, raw text of the comment.
meaning: The raw text of the comment.

name: updatedAt
desc: The date and time when the comment was last updated, specified in ISO 8601 format.
meaning: When the comment was last edited.

name: entityTextCoverage
desc: When the description anchor text has been recognized as an entity, how much of the description anchor text is covered by the entity mention.
meaning: How much of the description key moment text a recognised topic covers.

name: inAsr
desc: Whether or not a mention of the description anchor exists in the ASR.
meaning: Whether the description key moment is also mentioned in the spoken transcript.

name: isDescriptionAnchor
desc: Whether or not the anchor was created from the description for use in training data. This will be set to true for positive examples and false for negative examples.
meaning: A training data flag marking positive and negative example key moments.

name: spanToAsrTime
desc: The distance from the ASR sentence to the description anchor time in ms.
meaning: How far the transcript sentence sits in time from the description key moment.

name: asrAnchorCount
desc: The number of description anchors that were matched to captions in the ASR.
meaning: How many description key moments were matched to the transcript.

name: asrAnchorFraction
desc: The fraction of anchors that were matched to captions in the ASR.
meaning: The share of key moments that were matched to the transcript.

name: uniqueAsrMidCount
desc: The number of unique mids which where matched to description anchors.
meaning: How many distinct topics were matched to description key moments.

name: contextTokenCount
desc: The number of tokens in the context (sentence) where the description span is extracted from.
meaning: How many words are in the sentence the description span came from.

name: dolphinScores
desc: The inference result from the Dolphin span model if the anchor's source is description span.
meaning: Dolphin span results when the key moment comes from a description span.

name: spanDolphinScoreStats
desc: A summary of the Dolphin span token scores for the selected candidate. Currently, dolphin_scores in DescriptionSpanInfo would only contain a single span candidate so this field is essentially the copy of the score_stats for that span candidate.
meaning: Summary of Dolphin word scores for the description span.

name: spanTokenCount
desc: The number of tokens in the description span. The description span is formed from non-contiguous segment spans of a sentence (context), where each segment span's score satifsies the min span thresholds.
meaning: How many words the description span contains.

name: spanTokenCountRatio
desc: The ratio of span_token_count / context_token_count.
meaning: The span's word count as a fraction of its sentence's word count.

name: dolphinScore
desc: The score generated by the Dolphin callout model.
meaning: A score from one model inside the Dolphin ensemble.

name: altQuery
desc: The alt query used for building the Dolphin example.
meaning: The alternative query text used to build the model input.

name: answer
desc: The answer used for building the Dolphin example.
meaning: The answer text used to build the model input.

name: query
desc: The query used for building the Dolphin example.
meaning: The query text used to build the model input.

name: timeMs
desc: The time stamp of the video anchor in milliseconds.
meaning: The video timestamp of the key moment used in the model input.

name: title
desc: The title used for building the Dolphin example.
meaning: The video title used to build the model input.

name: url
desc: The url of the video.
meaning: The address of the video used to build the model input.

name: descriptivenessOutputKey
desc: The output put keys for Dolphin PredictResponse
meaning: Which response field holds the descriptiveness output.

name: ensembleModelNames
desc: If the dolphin model is an ensemble model (e.g. Video QnA model which consists of 4 teacher models), stores each individual model name.
meaning: The names of the individual models inside an ensemble.

name: inferenceBatchSize
desc: The inference batch size to use for inference methods that handle batching.
meaning: How many items to score in one batch.

name: inferenceMethod
desc: The method to use for inference. This must be set or inference will fail.
meaning: Which scoring method to call.

name: maxRpcRetries
desc: Holds value of flag --max_rpc_retries.
meaning: How many times to retry a failed remote call.

name: modelName
desc: Model name used for ModelSpec in PredictRequest used in the PredictionService API.
meaning: The name of the model to call.

name: modelPath
desc: Only used when using the bulk_inference API. See go/dolphin-models to learn about the different dolphin models.
meaning: Where the model files live for bulk scoring.

name: outputKey
desc: TODO(alexiaxu) To deprecate this field in the future Output key for Dolphin PredictResponse.
meaning: An output field name that is marked for future removal.

name: rpcDeadlineSeconds
desc: Holds value of flag --rpc_deadline (converted to seconds).
meaning: How long to wait before a remote call times out.

name: serviceBns
desc: Tensorflow inference BNS address when using PredictionService API.
meaning: The network address of the model serving job.

name: category
desc: The Webref category that this entity belongs to e.g. "/moka/software".
meaning: Which category the recognised topic belongs to.

name: confidence
desc: The overall confidence that this entity is annotated somewhere in the label.
meaning: Confidence that the topic appears somewhere in the label.

name: isRestricted
desc: Whether or not this entity belongs to a set of blocklisted categories.
meaning: Whether the topic falls into a blocked category.

name: mid
desc: The Webref entity mid.
meaning: The identifier of the recognised topic.

name: collectionId
desc: Collection id.
meaning: An internal collection identifier.

name: label
desc: Label for this anchor group.
meaning: The label shown for a group of key moments.

name: frameSimilarity
desc: The similarity between this topic and starburst features for frames in [frames[frame_level_starburst_start_index], frames[frame_level_starburst_start_index + len(frame_similarity)].
meaning: How closely each video frame matches the topic.

name: framesEndTimestampMs
desc: Timestamp in milliseconds for the last frame in this frame interval.
meaning: When the last frame in this stretch of video occurs.

name: framesStarburstStartIndex
desc: The index of the first frame within this interval of similar frames. VideoMultimodalTopicFeatures.frame_starburst_data.
meaning: A pointer to where this stretch of frames starts in the stored frame data.

name: framesStartTimestampMs
desc: Timestamp in milliseconds for the first frame in this frame interval.
meaning: When the first frame in this stretch of video occurs.

name: denseVector
desc: Raw float feature vector of the starburst representation.
meaning: The numeric visual embedding of a video frame.

name: sbVersion
desc: Starburst version. Possible values are: STARBURST_TEXT_V4 STARBURST_TEXT_V4_5 STARBURST_TEXT_V4_PLC STARBURST_TEXT_V5
meaning: Which version of the visual embedding model was used.

name: timestampMs
desc: Timestamp in milliseconds for this frame.
meaning: When this frame occurs in the video.

name: passage
desc: Features for inferences from generative models.
meaning: The passage of text fed to a generative model.

name: predictions
desc: Inference results.
meaning: The text that a generative model produced.

name: groundTruthTopic
desc: This field is present if we already have a ground truth topic from the training data.
meaning: The known correct topic taken from training data.

name: modelName
desc: The name of the model where the predictions come from.
meaning: The name of the model that produced the predictions.

name: predictions
desc: Inference results from the prediction service. Since we generally use beam search with beam_size > 1, this field is repeated to capture all the generated topic beams.
meaning: The candidate topics a generative model produced for the video.

name: bestAsrAndDescriptionAnchorsMatchInfo
desc: The match info about the description anchor matches with the ASR n-grams in the instruction passage. Each element represents the best match between a given description anchor and all qualified n-grams within the passage.
meaning: Training data record of the best match between description and transcript text.

name: bestDescriptionAndInstructionAnchorsMatchInfo
desc: The match info about the description anchor matches with the instruction anchors in a instruction passage. Each element represents the best match between a given description anchor and all the instruction anchors in the passage.
meaning: Training data record of the best match between description and instruction steps.

name: instructionAnchorsMatchInfo
desc: The match info about the instruction steps matches with the ASR. Each instruction step corresponds to a step extracted from a web doc. Each instruction passage can contain multiple instruction step matches thus the repeated field.
meaning: Training data record of how instruction steps matched the spoken transcript.

name: babelMatch
desc: The babel match info of the list anchor with its matched ASR text.
meaning: How well a list item from the description matched the transcript text.

name: descriptionSpanInfo
desc: The description span metadata about list anchor when the anchor source is DESCRIPTION_SPANS.
meaning: Details about the description span a list key moment came from.

name: listItemIndex
desc: The list item index of this anchor in the video description.
meaning: The position of this item in the description's list.

name: matchScores
desc: The metadata about this list item's matches with different ASR snippets. This is currently used in the base model (DTW) to generate candidate anchors.
meaning: How well this list item matched various pieces of the transcript.

name: pretriggerScore
desc: The score from the pretrigger model.
meaning: The score from the early filtering model.

name: titleAnchorBabelMatchScore
desc: Babel similarity between the anchor and the video title.
meaning: Text similarity between the key moment and the video title.

name: aggregatedSpanText
desc: The following fields are used for description span anchors, The aggregated span token texts over all the span candidates of the anchor set.
meaning: The combined span text across all candidates in the key moment set.

name: anchorSetSpanScoreStats
desc: A summary of the span scores over the anchor set. This summary is calculated over the aggregation of the individual token spans belonging to the span candidates of anchors.
meaning: Summary of span scores across the key moment set.

name: babelMatchScoreStats
desc: Median, average and standard deviation of babel_match_score among anchors in the same VideoAnchors cluster.
meaning: Median, average and spread of text match scores across the key moment set.

name: contextTokenCountStats
desc: A summary of the context token counts over the anchor set.
meaning: Summary of sentence word counts across the key moment set.

name: durationSpanRatio
desc: The ratio of anchors timespan duration over the total duration of the video. Anchors timespan duration is defined as the time span from the first anchor to the last anchor in VideoAnchors.
meaning: The share of the video's length from the first key moment to the last.

name: durationToPredictedTimeMsStats
desc: Median, average and standard deviation of duration_to_predicted_time_ms among anchors in the same VideoAnchors cluster.
meaning: Median, average and spread of the gap to predicted times across key moments.

name: listAnchorSource
desc: The source of anchors extracted from the video descriptions.
meaning: Where the list key moments were taken from in the video description.

name: listDescriptionItemsSize
desc: The total number of list items mentioned in the video description. Not all these list items are necessarily found as list anchors.
meaning: How many list items the video description contains.

name: matchedListDescriptionAnchorsRatio
desc: The number of matched anchors in the list anchors over the total number of post-filtering list items in the video description, i.e. matched_list_description_anchors_ratio = matched_list_description_anchors_size / post_filtering_list_description_items_size.
meaning: The share of eligible description list items that matched the transcript.

name: matchedListDescriptionAnchorsSize
desc: The number of matched list anchors found in the ASR. The matched list anchors are a subset of the post-filtering list items in the video description, and as such matched_list_description_anchors_size <= post_filtering_list_description_items_size.
meaning: How many description list items were matched in the transcript.

name: postFilteringListDescriptionItemsSize
desc: The total number of list items in the video description that are actually considered for matching. This is a subset of list items in the video description that passed filterings such as language filtering, i.e. post_filtering_list_description_items_size <= list_description_items_size
meaning: How many description list items survived filtering and were considered.

name: pretriggerScoreStats
desc: Median, average and standard deviation of pretrigger_score among anchors in the same cluster.
meaning: Median, average and spread of early filter scores across key moments.

name: spanTokenCountRatioStats
desc: A summary of the span token count ratios over the anchor set.
meaning: Summary of span to sentence word ratios across the key moment set.

name: spanTokenCountStats
desc: A summary of the span token counts over the anchor set.
meaning: Summary of span word counts across the key moment set.

name: descriptionAnchorTimeMs
desc: The timestamp of when the description anchor is annotated to appear in the video in ms.
meaning: Training data timestamp of when a description key moment should appear.

name: descriptionAnchorTimeToMatchedTimeMs
desc: The time gap of when the description anchor is annotated to appear in the video (description_anchor_time_ms) from when it's matched in the ASR as the list anchor.
meaning: Training data gap between the labelled time and the matched transcript time.

name: editDistance
desc: Closest edit distance between the anchor generated by description span and the description anchor where the span anchor must be within small threshold time difference of the description anchor timestamp.
meaning: How many character edits separate a generated video anchor's text from the matching description anchor.

name: editDistanceRatio
desc: edit_distance over the description anchor's label length.
meaning: That edit distance divided by the length of the description anchor's label.

name: matchedDescriptionText
desc: The description anchor text used for matching to Span anchor text.
meaning: The description anchor text that was matched against a span of video text.

name: matchedSpanText
desc: The description span anchor text that was the best match for the nearby description anchor.
meaning: The span of description text that best matched a nearby description anchor.

name: editDistanceRatioStats
desc: Summary of the edit_distance_ratios of the description spans from their best matched description anchor texts.
meaning: Summary statistics of edit distance ratios between description spans and their matched anchors.

name: editDistanceStats
desc: Summary of the edit_distances of the description spans from their best matched description anchor texts.
meaning: Summary statistics of edit distances between description spans and their matched anchors.

name: matchedDescriptionAnchorsTimegapStats
desc: Median, average and standard deviation of time gaps of when the description anchors is annotated to appear in the video (description_anchor_time_ms) from when they are matched in the ASR as the list description anchors.
meaning: Statistics on time gaps between where description anchors appear and where they match the transcript.

name: numDescriptionAnchors
desc: Number of description anchors in the description of this video.
meaning: How many timestamped anchors appear in the video's description.

name: method
desc: The method used for matching, e.g. 'babel', 'nlp', 'neon', ßß'phonetic'.
meaning: The name of the matching method used, such as phonetic or NLP.

name: frameSimilarityInterval
desc: The list of frame sequence similarities to this topic. The list of frames are picked to be around the topic timestamp. The set of frames selected are thresholded at a value to ensure the selected frame intervals are similar to the query.
meaning: A list of how similar video frames near a topic's timestamp are to that topic.

name: generativeTopicPredictionFeatures
desc: The inference results from the prediction services that generate the topics.
meaning: Results returned by the services that generate video topics.

name: navboostAnchorFeatures
desc: Features related to queries generated using document navboost data with timed anchors. Only populated if the query was generated using this approach.
meaning: A holder for query features built from the video's popular-query data and timed anchors.

name: topic
desc: The text of the generated topic.
meaning: The text of a topic generated for a section of the video.

name: topicEndMs
desc: End time of the topic.
meaning: The end time of the video topic.

name: topicStartMs
desc: Start time of the topic.
meaning: The start time of the video topic.

name: videoQuerySource
desc: How the query was generated.
meaning: A label recording how the query was generated.

name: maxFrameSimilarityInterval
desc: The similarity info for the frame with maximum similarity to the topic in its visual interval. The repeated similarity field in this proto has a single value corresponding to the maximum similarity. This similarity score is used to filter and pick the training data examples.
meaning: Details of the frame most similar to the topic, used to pick training examples.

name: normalizedTopic
desc: The topic/query normalized for Navboost and QBST lookups as well as fetching of the Rankembed nearest neighbors.
meaning: The topic text normalized so it can be looked up in query and embedding systems.

name: qbstTermsOverlapFeatures
desc: QBST terms overlap features for a candidate query.
meaning: A holder for how much a candidate query's key terms overlap the video's text.

name: rankembedNearestNeighborsFeatures
desc: Rankembed similarity features for a candidate nearest neighbor rankembed query.
meaning: Similarity features for a nearby query found through embedding lookup.

name: saftEntityInfo
desc: The information about the saft entity annotation for this topic.
meaning: Entity annotation details for the generated video topic.

name: topicDenseVector
desc: Raw float feature vector of the topic's co-text embedding representation in the Starburst space.
meaning: The numeric embedding vector representing the topic.

name: entityType
desc: Type name: e.g. /saft/person for a person's name.
meaning: The type of the named entity, such as a person.

name: text
desc: Text referring to an entity of type entity_type;
meaning: The text that mentions the named entity.

name: anchorText
desc: The anchor text used in the generated query.
meaning: The video anchor text used to build a generated query.

name: navboostText
desc: The navboost query used in the generated query.
meaning: The popular search query used to build a generated query for the video.

name: source
desc: How the navboost-anchor query was constructed.
meaning: A label recording how the anchor-plus-query text was built.

name: ocrFeature
desc: Additional details about position/font/color etc. for the OCR text
meaning: Extra details about position, font and color of the on-screen text.

name: ocrText
desc: The OCR recognized text label
meaning: The text read off a video frame by optical character recognition.

name: timeMs
desc: The time in ms at which the OCR text appears on the frame
meaning: The time in the video when the on-screen text appears.

name: minCharEditDistance
desc: The minimum char edit distance between the normalized OCR text and candidate word strings taken from a time window around the OCR appearance.
meaning: The smallest character edit distance between on-screen text and nearby spoken words.

name: minCharEditDistanceAsrText
desc: The matched ASR candidate for minimum char edit distance.
meaning: The spoken-text candidate that best matched the on-screen text.

name: minCharEditDistancePercent
desc: The min_char_edit_distance divided by the length of the OCR string.
meaning: That minimum edit distance divided by the length of the on-screen text.

name: ocrTextNormalizedForCharMatch
desc: The normalized OCR text which was used to match the candidate.
meaning: The cleaned-up on-screen text used for matching.

name: ocrTextNormalizedForCharMatchLength
desc: The length of the normalized OCR text.
meaning: The length of the cleaned-up on-screen text.

name: pretriggerScore
desc: The score from the pretrigger model.
meaning: The score produced by the pretrigger model.

name: wordOverlapAsrText
desc: The ASR text that was used for the word overlap calculation.
meaning: The spoken text used when counting overlapping words.

name: wordOverlapCount
desc: The number of words found both in the OCR text and the ASR in a time window around OCR appearance.
meaning: How many words appear in both the on-screen text and the nearby speech.

name: wordOverlapPercent
desc: The word_overlap_count divided by the number of words in the OCR text.
meaning: Overlapping word count divided by the number of words in the on-screen text.

name: normalizedWordOverlapScore
desc: The word_overlap_score divided by the greatest word_overlap_score for any cluster in the VideoAnchorSets.
meaning: The cluster's word overlap score divided by the highest such score in the video.

name: wordOverlapScore
desc: A score based on the number of overlapped words between the OCR and ASR for anchors in the cluster.
meaning: A score based on how many words overlap between on-screen text and speech for a group of anchors.

name: editDistance
desc: The string edit distance from the anchor label to the nearest OCR text.
meaning: How many character edits separate an anchor label from the closest on-screen text.

name: editDistanceRatio
desc: edit_distance over the description anchor's label length.
meaning: That edit distance divided by the length of the description anchor's label.

name: matchedDescriptionText
desc: The description anchor text used for matching to OCR text.
meaning: The description anchor text used for matching against on-screen text.

name: matchedFrameTimeMs
desc: The time of the selected OCR frame in ms. The best frame in a window around the target description anchor will be selected.
meaning: The time of the video frame whose on-screen text was chosen as the match.

name: matchedOcrText
desc: The OCR text that was the best match for the nearby description anchor.
meaning: The on-screen text that best matched a nearby description anchor.

name: maxEditDistance
desc: The max edit distance of any description anchor to its closest OCR text.
meaning: The largest edit distance between any description anchor and its closest on-screen text.

name: maxEditDistanceRatio
desc: The maximum of (edit distance of any description anchor to its closest OCR text over description anchor label length).
meaning: The largest edit-distance-to-label-length ratio across description anchors.

name: medianEditDistance
desc: The median edit distance of any description anchor to its closest OCR text.
meaning: The median edit distance between description anchors and their closest on-screen text.

name: averageTextAreaRatio
desc: Average text area ratio throughout video frames. Text area ratio for a frame is defined by sum(text area) / image area.
meaning: The average share of each video frame's area covered by text.

name: clusterIdToFrameSize
desc: Cluster id to the num of frames in each cluster.
meaning: A map from each cluster to how many frames it contains.

name: durationInMs
desc: Total time of this video in milliseconds.
meaning: The total length of the video in milliseconds.

name: langIdDetectedLanguage
desc: Video level detected language by lang id, aggregated from each frame.
meaning: The language detected for the whole video by the language identifier.

name: numClusters
desc: The number of ShotInfo clusters.
meaning: How many shot clusters the video has.

name: numFrames
desc: The number of video frames contained in ShotInfo cluster.
meaning: How many video frames are in the shot cluster.

name: ocrDetectedLanguage
desc: Video level detected language, aggregated from each frame.
meaning: The language detected across the video's on-screen text.

name: averageConfidence
desc: Average confidence.
meaning: The average confidence of the text recognition in this cluster.

name: averageOcrTextLength
desc: Deprecated. Please use ocr_text_length_stats.median instead. The average length of anchor labels. average_ocr_text_length is deprecated, because now ocr_text_length_stats has a field for holding the same value.
meaning: Average length of anchor labels in the cluster; replaced by a newer statistics field.

name: averageOfAverageTextHeightRatio
desc: Deprecated. Please use text_height_ratio_stats.mean instead. Average value of text height ratio (over image height), which is taken average over the same text. average_of_average_text_height_ratio is deprecated, because now text_height_ratio_stats has a field for keeping the same value.
meaning: Average height of on-screen text relative to the frame; replaced by a newer statistics field.

name: averageVerticalPosition
desc: Average of label center position.
meaning: The average vertical position of the text labels.

name: clusterRatio
desc: The number of anchors in the cluster over the number of anchors in the video.
meaning: The share of the video's anchors that fall in this cluster.

name: clusterSize
desc: The number of anchors in the cluster.
meaning: How many anchors are in the cluster.

name: countingNumberRatio
desc: The number of anchors that had a counting number over the number of anchors in total.
meaning: The share of anchors whose label contains a counting number.

name: durationMsStats
desc: Median, average and standard deviation of duration_ms among anchors in the same cluster.
meaning: Median, average and spread of how long anchors in the cluster stay on screen.

name: frameSizeRatio
desc: Frame size ratio over total frames in video.
meaning: The share of the video's frames covered by this cluster.

name: logOcrTextLengthStats
desc: Average and standard deviation of logarithm of the length of labels among anchors in the same cluster.
meaning: Average and spread of the log of label length within the cluster.

name: logTextHeightRatioStats
desc: Average and standard deviation of log(average_text_height_ratio) among anchors in the same cluster.
meaning: Average and spread of the log of relative text height within the cluster.

name: logp1000DurationMsStats
desc: Average and standard deviation of log(1000 + duration_ms) among anchors in the same cluster. Since duration_ms can be zero, 1000 is added before applying logarithm.
meaning: Average and spread of the log of anchor on-screen duration within the cluster.

name: maxVideoDurationRatioBetweenAnchors
desc: The maximum ratio of duration between two consecutive anchors to video duration. This is calculated after all anchor filtering has been completed.
meaning: The largest gap between two consecutive anchors as a share of video length.

name: maximumDurationRatio
desc: Stats for ratio of frame time intervals, over total video time.
meaning: The largest frame time interval as a share of total video time.

name: medianClusteringDistance
desc: The median cluster distance for the anchors in the cluster. The way the distance is calculated will vary depending on the clustering method.
meaning: The median distance between anchors grouped into this cluster.

name: medianOfAverageTextHeightRatio
desc: Deprecated. Please use text_height_ratio_stats.median instead. Median value of text height ratio (over image height), which is taken average over the same text. median_of_average_text_height_ratio is deprecated, because now text_height_ratio_stats has a field for keeping the same value.
meaning: Median height of on-screen text relative to the frame; replaced by a newer statistics field.

name: ocrAsrFeature
desc: Features for the overlap between OCR and ASR.
meaning: A holder for features comparing on-screen text with the spoken words.

name: ocrTextLengthStats
desc: Median, average and standard deviation of the length of labels among anchors in the same cluster.
meaning: Median, average and spread of anchor label lengths in the cluster.

name: textHeightRatioStats
desc: Median, average and standard deviation of average_text_height_ratio among anchors in the same cluster.
meaning: Median, average and spread of relative text height in the cluster.

name: countingNumber
desc: Counting number in this anchor's original label.
meaning: The counting number found in the anchor's original label.

name: topOcrLanguage
desc: OCR language that has the highest weight.
meaning: The on-screen text language with the highest weight.

name: averageAngle
desc: The average of rotation angles (degree) of texts.
meaning: The average rotation angle of the on-screen text.

name: durationMs
desc: Duration time in millisec.
meaning: How long the on-screen text stays visible, in milliseconds.

name: centerVerticalPositionRatio
desc: Vertical position of the center of this text, by ratio [0.0, 1.0].
meaning: How far down the frame the center of the text sits.

name: countingNumberOooRatio
desc: # of numbered anchors that are not out-of-order / # of all the numbered anchors. If no counting number is detected, this will be empty.
meaning: The share of numbered anchors that appear in order.

name: medianClusteringDistance
desc: The median distance between this anchor and other anchors in the cluster. The way the distance is calculated will vary depending on the clustering method.
meaning: The median distance from this anchor to the others in its cluster.

name: handwrittenTextRatio
desc: # of LINE entities that are recognized as handwritten texts over # of merged LINE entities.
meaning: The share of recognized text lines that look handwritten.

name: averageFontsize
desc: Font size or weight information. This is extracted from internal message, so may not be available in future.
meaning: The font size or weight of the on-screen text.

name: occurrenceRatio
desc: occurrence_count over the number of anchors merged to this anchor.
meaning: Occurrence count divided by the number of anchors merged into this one.

name: nTextsInSameFrame
desc: # of OCR texts that appear in the same frame. If duration of this OCR text is not zero, the maximum number among multiple frames where this OCR text appears is set to this field.
meaning: How many separate on-screen texts appear in the same frame.

name: relativeShotTimeMsPriorToStartTime
desc: Shot boundary time nearest to OnScreenText's start and end time. The time is relative to each OnScreenText's start / end time (ex. -1 means shot time exists prior to the start / end time). If shot time and start/end time is the same, 0 is set in 'prior' field. If no shot info is available, the below fields are not set.
meaning: How close the nearest shot change is to the text's start or end time.

name: originalLabel
desc: The label this VideoAnchor originally had before label clearning steps.
meaning: The anchor's label as it read before cleanup.

name: countingNumberPrefix
desc: Prefix for counting number in this anchor's label. If no counting number is detected, this will be empty.
meaning: The text that comes before the counting number in the label.

name: centerHorizontalPositionRatio
desc: Horizontal position of the center of this text, by ratio [0.0, 1.0].
meaning: How far across the frame the center of the text sits, horizontally.

name: averageConfidence
desc: Average value of confidence.
meaning: The average confidence of the text recognition.

name: occurrenceCount
desc: The number of OCR texts that have the same text among temporally-merged OCR texts.
meaning: How many merged on-screen texts share the same wording.

name: mergedLineCount
desc: The number of LINE entities used for this text.
meaning: How many recognized text lines were combined into this text.

name: ocrAsrFeature
desc: Features for the overlap between OCR and ASR.
meaning: A holder for features comparing this on-screen text with the spoken words.

name: hadUrlInLabel
desc: Whether or not this anchor had URL in its label before the label fixing step.
meaning: Whether the anchor label contained a web address before cleanup.

name: leftPositionRatio
desc: Left position of this text, by ratio [0, 1].
meaning: The left edge position of the text as a share of frame width.

name: isCountingNumberOoo
desc: Whether or not the counting number in this anchor's label is out-of-order. If no counting number is detected, this will be empty.
meaning: Whether the counting number in the label is out of order.

name: topPositionRatio
desc: Note that top-left position is (0, 0) for position values. Top position of this text, by ratio [0, 1].
meaning: The top edge position of the text as a share of frame height.

name: foregroundGray
desc: Color information, normalized to [0-1]. This color information is extracted from the largest word in the line entities of PageLayout message. See goodoc::PageLayoutEntity::Colors for details.
meaning: The grey level of the text color, normalized between zero and one.

name: languages
desc: Languages predicted by OCR. "repeated" is employed for this field because LINE entities of PageLayout message are sometimes annotated with multiple languages, and also two VideoAnchor that are annotated with different languages can be merged into one VideoAnchor. When two VideoAnchor are merged into one, the weight field values of the new VideoAnchor will be the average of weight field values weighted by merged_line_count.
meaning: The languages the text recognizer predicted for this on-screen text.

name: countingNumberSuffix
desc: Suffix for counting number in this anchor's label. If no counting number is detected, this will be empty.
meaning: The text that comes after the counting number in the label.

name: boxWidthRatio
desc: Box width and height ratio, against to the frame size, so the value range is [0, 1]. If this text feature consists of multiple text boxes, the box width / height is a union of each text box.
meaning: The width of the text box relative to the frame width.

name: qbstAnchorOverlap
desc: Fraction of salient terms of original query covered by anchor text.
meaning: The share of the query's key terms that also appear in the video anchor text.

name: qbstNavboostOverlap
desc: Fraction of salient terms of original query covered by top navboost query of the video.
meaning: The share of the query's key terms that appear in the video's top popular query.

name: answer
desc: Segment of text from the ASR.
meaning: A passage of the video's spoken text used as the answer.

name: dolphinScore
desc: Dolphin score calculated using the question as the query, the ASR passage as the answer. See go/dolphin-models to learn more.
meaning: A model score for how well the transcript passage answers the question.

name: editDistance
desc: Edit distance of the question and the title from 0 to 1 where 1 is most similar.
meaning: How similar the question is to the video title, from zero to one.

name: endMs
desc: End time in milliseconds relative to the beginning of the video.
meaning: The end time of the answer segment in the video.

name: isDuplicateOfTitle
desc: True if question_title_similarity is less than 0.2.
meaning: Whether the question is essentially a repeat of the video title.

name: neonScore
desc: Neon similarity of question and title.
meaning: A similarity score between the question and the video title.

name: pointwiseNormalizedGapScore
desc: Pointwise GAP normalized score. Score ranges from 0 to 1 and corresponds to GAP precision. See go/wa-cgap-to-pgap-migration to learn more.
meaning: A normalized precision score from the scoring model.

name: qbstScore
desc: QBST similarity of question and title.
meaning: A term-based similarity score between the question and the video title.

name: queryCount
desc: NavBoostFeature f_query_count for questions that are NavBoost queries.
meaning: How often the question was seen as a search query in the click data.

name: queryDocCount
desc: NavBoostFeature f_query_doc_count for questions that are NavBoost queries.
meaning: How often the question and this video appeared together in the click data.

name: question
desc: Question from Related Questions SSTable or NavBoost.
meaning: The question text attached to this point in the video.

name: startMs
desc: Start time in milliseconds relative to the beginning of the video.
meaning: The start time of the answer segment in the video.

name: videoDurationMs
desc: Duration of the video.
meaning: How long the video runs.

name: videoTitle
desc: Video title.
meaning: The title of the video, stored with the question-answer anchor features.

name: webrefMid
desc: Mid corresponding to the WebRef entity from the CDoc that was used to source the question.
meaning: The identifier of the entity that the question was sourced from.

name: webrefTopicalityScore
desc: The WebRef entity topicality score. Learn more about this score at:
meaning: How strongly the entity relates to the document it was taken from.

name: backgroundEncodingPath
desc: Path to Descartes background encoding in the form of a serialized drishti.DenseFeatureData proto. This is generated by the flume_generate_background_encoding binary.
meaning: A file path to a stored background encoding used by the model.

name: descartesModelVersion
desc: This field is used for debugging which model the decartes_model_score is generated from. You can learn more about the Descartes model at go/descartes-qa.
meaning: Which model version produced the score, kept for debugging.

name: descartesScoreThreshold
desc: Descartes score threshold for determining whether to output a QA pair as an anchor. This currently effects only the Descartes ranking score.
meaning: The minimum score a question-answer pair needs before it is output as an anchor.

name: dolphinConfig
desc: The configuration used for fetching Dolphin scores.
meaning: The settings used when fetching scores from the scoring service.

name: ensembleModelPath
desc: Path to Ranklab ensemble model used in post-trigger step.
meaning: A file path to the ensemble model used after the trigger step.

name: ensembleModelScoreThreshold
desc: Minimum score for video anchor to pass the post-trigger step. Calculated by training a logisitic regression model with 95% precision. Training colab can be found at go/video-qa-ensemble.
meaning: The minimum score a video anchor needs to pass the post-trigger check.

name: minEntityTopicalityScore
desc: Threshold for determining whether to consider an entity from a CDoc for sourcing questions on that topic. Learn more about this score at:
meaning: The minimum entity relevance needed before using an entity to source questions.

name: minQuestionDistance
desc: Threshold for determining whether questions belong in the same cluster.
meaning: The distance limit for grouping questions into one cluster.

name: relatedQuestionsSstablePath
desc: Path to the Related Questions SSTable that maps entities to questions.
meaning: A file path to the table mapping entities to related questions.

name: spanDurationSecs
desc: The duration threshold for merging captions.
meaning: The duration limit used when merging captions together.

name: anchorReSimilarity
desc: Rankembed similarity between the rankembed neighbor and the video anchor.
meaning: Embedding similarity between a neighboring query and the video anchor.

name: navQueryReSimilarity
desc: Rankembed similarity between the rankembed neighbor and the top navboost query of the video.
meaning: Embedding similarity between a neighboring query and the video's top popular query.

name: reSimilarity
desc: Rankembed similarity between the rankembed neighbor and the original query candidate.
meaning: Embedding similarity between a neighboring query and the original candidate query.

name: canonicalEntityName
desc: Representative canonical name for the entity.
meaning: The standard name for the entity.

name: entitySalience
desc: Score indicating the saliency (centrality) of this entity to the original_text.
meaning: How central this entity is to the text it was found in.

name: entityTypeName
desc: The type name, like "/saft/person", "/saft/art". See README.entity-types for the inventory of SAFT type tags.
meaning: The entity's type name, such as person or artwork.

name: mentionText
desc: Representative entity name mention extracted from original_text.
meaning: The wording used in the text to refer to the entity.

name: mentionType
desc: SAFT Mention type.
meaning: The kind of mention, as labeled by the entity annotator.

name: mid
desc: Freebase MID for entity if this the saft entity corresponds to a Webref KG mid. This field is not always populated and is taken from FREEBASE_MID mid in EntityProfile in the saft entity annotation.
meaning: The knowledge graph identifier for the entity, when one exists.

name: originalText
desc: The original input text (e.g. the anchor text) where the saft entity annotation was run on.
meaning: The original text the entity annotation was run on.

name: asrForProConExtraction
desc: The asr with sentence break that was used for pro/con extraction.
meaning: The spoken transcript, split into sentences, used to pull out pros and cons.

name: snippetWordCount
desc: The number of words in the ASR for the selected segment window.
meaning: How many words are in the selected segment's transcript.

name: snippetQaScore
desc: The QA model score for the selected segment window against the question.
meaning: A model score for how well the segment answers the question.

name: anchorLabelSentiment
desc: The sentiment score of the anchor label, with range: [-1, 1]. If using Lumin Pro/Con tags as the anchor labels, the "Pro" Lumin tag will have a score of 1 and Con Lumin tag will have a score of -1.
meaning: How positive or negative the anchor label is, from minus one to one.

name: productNameFromTitle
desc: The product name from title extracted by the grampus model.
meaning: The product name pulled out of the video title by a model.

name: snippetSubSegmentQaScore
desc: The QA model score for the best sub segment against the question.
meaning: A model score for how well that smaller part answers the question.

name: anchorLabelFirstMentionPos
desc: The first anchor_label mention position (word index, 0-based). It is computed from the snippet_sub_segment if exists. Otherwise it is computed from the snippet. It is not populated if there is no such mention.
meaning: The word position where the anchor label is first mentioned in the passage.

name: babelSimilarityScore
desc: The Babel similarity score between the snippet and the anchor label.
meaning: A similarity score between the passage and the anchor label.

name: conScore
desc: The classification score of the anchor being a con opinion.
meaning: How strongly the anchor is classified as a negative opinion.

name: isPro
desc: Whether the anchor is classified as a pro opinion.
meaning: Whether the anchor is treated as a positive opinion.

name: luminAspectWordsMentions
desc: The number of times words in Lumin aspect (that is not a stopword) being mentioned in the snippet.
meaning: How many meaningful words from the product aspect appear in the passage.

name: mumScore
desc: The score from the MUM model if the pro/con anchor is extracted by MUM.
meaning: The model score when the pro or con anchor was extracted by MUM.

name: grampusScore
desc: The score from the Grampus model if the pro/con is extracted by Grampus.
meaning: The model score when the pro or con was extracted by that model.

name: snippetSubSegment
desc: The ASR for the best matched sub segment inside the selected segment.
meaning: The spoken transcript for the best matching part inside the segment.

name: snippetSentimentScore
desc: The go/scarlett sentiment score of the selected segment window. Positive score represents positive sentiment. Negative score represents negative sentiment.
meaning: How positive or negative the selected segment sounds.

name: luminAspect
desc: The lumin aspect of the Pro/Con Lumin tag. e.g. "weight".
meaning: The product feature named by the pro or con tag, such as weight.

name: question
desc: The question used to score this video segment.
meaning: The question used when scoring this video segment.

name: snippetSubSegmentSentimentScore

meaning: Name of the input used when building a link that jumps to a point in a video.

meaning: Pattern used to build a link that skips to a specific time in a video.
