meaning: The ad tag used to serve ads with this video.

name: videoId
desc: Identifier video is known by in the video infrastructure. The format given here is the YoutubeId format (base-64) used in Venom; for Viper/Bandaid/ StreamingURLService, convert to ContentIdHex.
meaning: The internal identifier for this video in video infrastructure.

name: videoUrlOnExternalCdn
desc: Set if the video is hosted on an external CDN, in which case it is not to be transcoded and hosted at Google for the Interest Feed.
meaning: Address of the video when it is hosted on an outside content network.

name: blPresentFlag
desc: If a track contains the base layer substream.
meaning: Whether the video track carries the base picture layer.

name: dvBlSignalCompatibilityId
desc: Whether the stream is compatible with other sets of standard.
meaning: Whether the video stream also works with other display standards.

name: dvVersionMajor
desc: Specifies the major version number of the Dolby Vision specification that the stream complies with.
meaning: The major version of the high dynamic range spec the video follows.

name: dvVersionMinor
desc: Specifies the minor version number of the Dolby Vision specification that the stream complies with.
meaning: The minor version of the high dynamic range spec the video follows.

name: elPresentFlag
desc: If a track contains the enhancement layer substream.
meaning: Whether the video track carries the extra enhancement layer.

name: fourccTag
desc: dvhe, dvh1, dvav, dva1:
meaning: The four letter code naming the video's encoding format.

name: rpuPresentFlag
desc: If a track contains the reference picture unit substream.
meaning: Whether the track carries the reference picture layer.

name: maxContentLightLevel
desc: Defines the maximum content light level (in cd/m^2) over the entire video.
meaning: The brightest light level anywhere in the video.

name: maxFrameAverageLightLevel
desc: The maximum (over entire video) of the frame average light level.
meaning: The highest per frame average brightness in the video.

name: gridOffset0Horizontal
desc: Grid positions
meaning: Position of a packed frame within the video grid.

name: interpretation
desc: Content interpretation
meaning: How the packed frame content should be interpreted.

name: quincunxSampling
desc: Quincunx sampling flag indicating if quincunx sampling is used
meaning: Whether a checkerboard sampling pattern was used.

name: type
desc: Arrangement type
meaning: How two views are packed into a single video frame.

name: applicationVersion
desc: Application version is set to max version over all frames.
meaning: The highest version of the brightness metadata format used in any frame.

name: averageTargetedSystemDisplayMaximumLuminance
desc: The average of the nominal maximum display luminance of the targeted system display over all frames.
meaning: Average peak brightness of the display the video was graded for.

name: masteringDisplayActualPeakLuminanceFlag
desc: This flag is set if any frame has it.
meaning: Whether any frame reports the mastering display's real peak brightness.

name: targetedSystemDisplayActualPeakLuminanceFlag
desc: This flag is set if any frame has it.
meaning: Whether any frame reports the target display's real peak brightness.

name: blue
desc: Coordinates of the blue primary of the mastering display.
meaning: Colour coordinates of the blue primary on the mastering display.

name: green
desc: Coordinates of the green primary of the mastering display.
meaning: Colour coordinates of the green primary on the mastering display.

name: maxLuminance
desc: Maximum luminance of the display (in cd/m^2).
meaning: The brightest level the mastering display can show.

name: minLuminance
desc: Minimum luminance of the display (in cd/m^2).
meaning: The dimmest level the mastering display can show.

name: red
desc: Coordinates of the red primary of the mastering display.
meaning: Colour coordinates of the red primary on the mastering display.

name: whitePoint
desc: Coordinates of the white point of the mastering display.
meaning: Colour coordinates of the white point on the mastering display.

name: clampedOptimalFovBounds
desc: Like above, but with high-pass motion filtering applied and yaw rotation limited to +/- 15-degrees
meaning: Limited view bounds for a 360 degree video after motion smoothing.

name: deprecatedInitialView
desc: InitialView is from v1 spec, and is more or less equivalent to Pose from v2 spec. Therefore, InitialView found in xml metadata would populate the pose field in this proto.
meaning: An old field for the starting view direction of a 360 degree video.

name: fullPanoWidthPixels
desc: Dimensions of the full video frame.
meaning: The pixel width of the full panoramic video frame.

name: metadataSource
desc: Metadata source v2(svhd)
meaning: Where the 360 degree video metadata came from.

name: optimalFovBounds
desc: If video contains Wally-sanitized mesh and camera motion metadata (see go/wally-format ), this contains the optimal FOV (smallest FOV that encompass all combinations of input mesh FOV and rotations). This field will only be present if full FfmpegAnalyze is performed.
meaning: The best view bounds that cover all camera angles in a 360 degree video.

name: projectionType
desc: Mapping type used to map the sphere to the rectangular video E.g., "equirectangular",
meaning: How the sphere is flattened onto a rectangular video frame.

name: sourceCount
desc: The number of camera sources used to generate this video.
meaning: How many cameras were used to make the video.

name: spherical
desc: Whether the video is spherical or not.
meaning: Whether the video is a 360 degree video.

name: stereoMode
desc: The stereo mode.
meaning: How the left and right eye views are arranged for 3D.

name: stitched
desc: Whether the video has already been stitched.
meaning: Whether the camera views have already been joined together.

name: stitchingSoftware
desc: The stitching software.
meaning: The software used to join the camera views together.

name: timestamp
desc: Epoch Timestamp of when the first frame in the video was recorded
meaning: When the video's first frame was recorded.

name: layout
desc: Values 0 to 255 are reserved for current and future layouts. Value of 0 corresponds to a grid with 3 columns and 2 rows as follows: | right face | left face | up face | | down face | front face | back face |
meaning: How the six cube faces are arranged in the video frame.

name: padding
desc: Number of pixels to pad from the edge of each cube face
meaning: How many pixels of padding surround each cube face.

name: bounds
desc: Once mesh is analyzed, this field contains the bounds of the mesh(es) In case of stereo mesh, this will be the aggregate of both eye meshes
meaning: The viewing bounds of the video's projection mesh once analysed.

name: type
desc: The mesh type field will only be populated when we have done analysis on the mesh. If this field is missing, mesh analysis has not been done.
meaning: The kind of projection mesh, set only after the mesh is analysed.

name: aloudLoggingId
desc: Used to track videos produced via Aloud dubbing.
meaning: An identifier used to track videos made with the dubbing tool.

name: appVersion
desc: YT app version (ie. YT Create app version).
meaning: The version of the creator app used to make the clip.

name: assetLoggingId
desc: List of YT media asset logging ids.
meaning: Identifiers for the media assets used in the clip.

name: dubbingLoggingId
desc: Used to track videos produced via Universal Dubbing.
meaning: An identifier used to track videos made with universal dubbing.

name: productType
desc: Product used to create this video clip.
meaning: Which product was used to create the video clip.

name: audioStream
desc: Each entry corresponds to one audio stream in the original media file.
meaning: Details of each audio track in the original media file.

name: containerId
desc: Container type of the file, e.g. FLV, H264, MP3. Uses the numeric value corresponding to the ContainerId enum objects, in order to avoid the dependency on vsi/videostreaminfo.proto.
meaning: Which container format the media file uses.

name: fileSize
desc: Media file size in bytes.
meaning: Size of the media file in bytes.

name: overview
desc: This is a high-level description of the media. It does not contain PII.
meaning: A high level summary description of the media file.

name: videoStream
desc: Each entry corresponds to one video stream (usually just one) in the original media file.
meaning: List of the video streams found inside the original media file.

name: creationTimeStampUsec
desc: Creation timestamp of this media_info, in Unix timestamp since epoch.
meaning: Unix timestamp for when this media info record was created.

name: hasChapters
desc: Currently used by originals replacement pipeline to exclude all videos containing chapter info.
meaning: Whether the video contains chapter information.

name: orientation
desc: The orientation is annotated based on the final displayed resolution of the video file. A video will be labelled PORTRAIT whenever the height is greater than the width. The orientation is only labelled UNKNOWN in the case that the video stream had some transformation that was not a rotation in the video stream.
meaning: Whether the video displays as portrait, landscape, or unknown.

name: resolution
desc: The resolution for a video takes into account the displayed video size, and takes into account the orientation. For example: - A 1920x1080 video will have ORIENTATION_LANDSCAPE and RESOLUTION_1080P - A 1080x1920 video will have ORIENTATION_PORTRAIT and RESOLUTION_1080P - A 1080x1080 video will have ORIENTATION_LANDSCAPE and RESOLUTION_1080P
meaning: The display resolution bucket of the video, such as 1080p.

name: wallyMeshType
desc: This only applies when: projection = PROJECTION_PARTIALLY_SPHERICAL
meaning: Mesh type used for partially spherical video projections.

name: channels
desc: Number of audio channels.
meaning: How many audio channels the track has.

name: contentType
desc: Content type of the audio track extracted from VSI. This is only populated with valid "acont" xtag values at the moment, i.e., if VSI reports an invalid string, we ignore it. Supported acont xtag values can be found in google3/video/storage/common/xtag_validation.cc. Examples: "original", "dubbed", "descriptive", "commentary", etc.
meaning: What kind of audio track it is, such as original, dubbed, or commentary.

name: language
desc: Language of the audio track extracted from VSI. Populated if it's deemed a valid code by ISO639-2b, ISO639-2t or III library.
meaning: The language code of the audio track.

name: roundedUpOriginalDurationSec
desc: Approximate audio length, has the same caveats as its video equivalent.
meaning: Approximate length of the audio in seconds, rounded up.

name: hasCameraMotionMetadata
desc: Whether the data stream has camera motion metadata (dynamic) or not (static). Some Wally/VR180 videos do.
meaning: Whether the data stream carries camera motion metadata.

name: hasOzoAudio
desc: If true, source contains metadata for OZO spatial audio support. See b/62393568 for more information about the OZO spatial audio format. Note that SpatialAudioMode is independent of this format.
meaning: Whether the source carries OZO spatial audio metadata.

name: hasGeolocation
desc: Corresponds to vsi.video_clip_info().has_geolocation()
meaning: Whether the video clip carries geographic location data.

name: averageFps
desc: Prefer average_fps to match the logic used in transcoder for format profile frame rate checks. First added for Photos, see b/165839654.
meaning: Average frames per second of the video.

name: roundedUpOriginalDurationSec
desc: Approximate video length. Data is rounded up to the next second, to avoid being PII. (Long ago, YTFE set a precedent of rounding up durations, rather than rounding to the closest second.) This value is derived from metadata in the source video, and often differs from the actual duration of any given transcode. In videos without valid timestamps, this value is not calculable, and is reported as zero. Prefer the value from MediaInfo::VideoStream over this value, which was added to resolve b/202864
meaning: Approximate video length in seconds, rounded up to avoid personal data.

name: frameBlobRefs
desc: The blobRef where the representative frame is stored. This is repeated in order to support multiple thumbnails in the future.
meaning: Storage references to where representative video frames are saved.

name: frameFileList
desc: Video frame files (based on file_dir_to_save_frames parameter)
meaning: The list of saved video frame files.

name: frameTypeGenerated
desc: Frame type generated (VR/360/3D/default).
meaning: What kind of frame was generated, such as VR, 360, 3D, or default.

name: generatedFromDrishtiThumbnailer
desc: True if the thumbnails are generated from drishti_thumbnailer.
meaning: Whether the thumbnails came from the drishti thumbnailer.

name: hq720Generated
desc: hq720.jpg is a 1280x720 pixel image generated only when the input video resolution is 1280x720 or higher.
meaning: Whether a 1280x720 thumbnail image was created.

name: hqdefaultGenerated
desc: The flags below indicate whether certain optional thumbnail images were generated. hqdefault.jpg is a 480x360 pixel high quality image which should normally be always generated.
meaning: Whether the standard 480x360 high quality thumbnail was created.

name: hvcBackupGenerated
desc: True if a set of backup HVC thumbnails is generated.
meaning: Whether a backup set of HVC thumbnails was created.

name: improvedVerticalGenerated
desc: True if the thumbnails are generated with background crop and scrim.
meaning: Whether thumbnails were made with background crop and scrim.

name: maxresdefaultGenerated
desc: maxresdefault.jpg is an image of the same resolution as the input video. It is generated only when the input video is significantly higher-resolution than 640x480.
meaning: Whether a full resolution thumbnail image was created.

name: maxresdefaultHeight
desc: Height of the generated maxresdefault thumbnail.
meaning: Height in pixels of the generated max resolution thumbnail.

name: maxresdefaultWidth
desc: Width of the generated maxresdefault thumbnail.
meaning: Width in pixels of the generated max resolution thumbnail.

name: movingThumbnailGenerated
desc: True if moving thumbnails are generated.
meaning: Whether animated moving thumbnails were created.

name: privateThumbnailsGenerated
desc: True if private thumbnails were generated and stored in the thumbnail database.
meaning: Whether private thumbnails were created and stored.

name: publicThumbnailsGenerated
desc: True if public thumbnails were generated and stored in the thumbnail database.
meaning: Whether public thumbnails were created and stored.

name: rerunStatus
desc: Analysis result of running the rerun thumbnailer
meaning: Result of re-running the thumbnail generator.

name: sddefaultGenerated
desc: sddefault.jpg is a 640x480 pixel image generated only when the input video resolution is 640x480 or higher.
meaning: Whether a 640x480 thumbnail image was created.

name: storyboardGenerated
desc: This flag indicates if storyboard mosaic images were generated and stored in the thumbnail database.
meaning: Whether storyboard mosaic images were created and stored.

name: storyboardNumLevels
desc: Number of levels of storyboard generated (0 if policy default).
meaning: How many storyboard levels were generated.

name: storyboardPolicy
desc: Policy number that governed the storyboard generation. If zero, no policy was used and the storyboard format is not fully specified by the parameters contained in this message.
meaning: Which policy number governed how the storyboard was generated.

name: storyboardVersion
desc: Version of the storyboard.
meaning: Version number of the storyboard format.

name: storyboardVideoDurationMs
desc: Video duration of the video.
meaning: Duration in milliseconds of the video that was storyboarded.

name: storyboardVideoHeight
desc: Height of the video that was storyboarded.
meaning: Height of the video that was storyboarded.

name: storyboardVideoWidth
desc: Width of the video that was storyboarded.
meaning: Width of the video that was storyboarded.

name: webpGenerated
desc: This flag indicates if images in WebP format were created and stored in the thumbnail database.
meaning: Whether WebP format thumbnail images were created and stored.

name: inputReadTime
desc: Total time taken in seconds to read the input
meaning: Seconds spent reading the input file.

name: partialFile
desc: Was the VSI computed on a partial file ?
meaning: Whether the stream info was computed from only part of the file.

name: totalVsiTime
desc: Total time (of all attempts) taken in seconds to compute VSI
meaning: Total seconds spent computing the video stream info.

name: partialVsi
desc: True if the output vsi is a partial vsi.
meaning: Whether the produced video stream info is only partial.

name: vsiTime
desc: The time (in secondes) from vsi_engine init to vsi written to output buffer.
meaning: Seconds taken from engine start to writing the stream info output.

name: count
desc: message count of each payloadtype
meaning: How many SEI messages of a given payload type were found.

name: cumulativeSize
desc: If the video stream has multiple SEI messages with the same payload type, this is the sum of all these payloads' sizes.
meaning: Combined size of all SEI payloads sharing the same type.

name: payloadtype
desc: use int type in case there are payload types that are not included in the SEIPayloadType enum below. The enum can be used for lookup
meaning: The numeric SEI payload type identifier.

name: itu1770LoudnessDb
desc: Loudness measured using ITU-R BS. 1770
meaning: Loudness of the audio measured by the ITU-R BS.1770 standard.

name: perceptualLoudnessDb
desc: Perceived loudness of audio measured using replaygain.
meaning: Perceived loudness of the audio measured with replaygain.

name: checksum
desc: Checksum of the thumbnail bytes used to identify which image the score belongs to. Only filled when thumbnail version is 0.
meaning: Checksum of the thumbnail bytes used to identify which image a score belongs to.

name: colorSampling
desc: Color sampling score encoded as uint32. Encode/Decode using youtube::color::RgbToUint / UIntToRgb. Field is only relevant for TYPE_COLOR_SAMPLING.
meaning: Encoded color sampling score for a thumbnail image.

name: denseFeatures
desc: Thumbnail dense features.
meaning: Dense machine learning feature values computed for a thumbnail.

name: denseGeneralExtraFeatures
desc: FeatureExtra extension for dense features.
meaning: Extra data attached to the thumbnail dense features.

name: externalImageId
desc: A unique identifier for the image that is independent of the resolution. The Image ID accompanies the image bytes through its lifecycle, from creation till vanishing. Image ID is not based on image content; it is different than checksum (e.g. two different images with the same bytes may not have the same image ID). This ID is used as a unique identifier for clients such as T&S and classifiers. For more info refer to go/thumbnail-id-ts-ab-testing Note: Image ID's are still in development and are
meaning: A resolution independent unique identifier for a thumbnail image.

name: isAssigned
desc: If true, score is manually assigned.
meaning: Whether the thumbnail score was set by hand rather than computed.

name: isInstant
desc: If true, score will be instantly indexed by YouTube search indexer.
meaning: Whether the thumbnail gets indexed immediately by the YouTube search indexer.

name: quantizedFeatures
desc: Thumbnail quantized dense features, available in TYPE_STARBURST_COMPRESSED
meaning: Compressed form of the thumbnail dense feature values.

name: sparseFeatures
desc: Thumbnail sparse features, available in TYPE_STARBURST
meaning: Sparse machine learning feature values computed for a thumbnail.

name: thumbnailVersion
desc: Version number of the thumbnail. Should be consistent with the version number in the ytimg_content column family.
meaning: Version number of the thumbnail.

name: langResults
desc: The complete list of language scores, sorted from high score to low.
meaning: Ranked list of likely spoken languages detected in the video.

name: speechClass
desc: What kind of speech (if any) was detected.
meaning: What kind of speech, if any, was detected in the video.

name: confidence
desc: A score between 0.0 and 1.0; the relative probability that this is the language of the video. This should not be interpreted as an absolute probability. For instance, scores may be calculated for all languages even for videos for which no speech was detected.
meaning: Relative probability that the video is in this spoken language.

name: langCode
desc: The language code for one of the languages supported by automatic language identification.
meaning: Language code for a language the speech identifier supports.

name: count
desc: Counts itu-t t.35 message with the same country code and provider code
meaning: Count of registered ITU-T T.35 messages sharing the same country and provider codes.

name: count
desc: Counts user data with the same uuid and payload If payload size is larger than limit, the payload will be 'Payload size is larger than limit: ' + limit size Count will be for user data with same uuid and payload exceeds limit in this case
meaning: Count of unregistered user data blocks sharing the same identifier and payload.

name: payload
desc: Payload may not be filled in Payload may contain user data
meaning: Raw unregistered user data payload from the video bitstream.

name: artist
desc: Lists the artist of the original subject of the file.
meaning: Artist named in the video file's container metadata.

name: audioVendorId
desc: Audio vendor ID
meaning: Identifier of the audio vendor from the container metadata.

name: author
desc: Different containers use different video clip info. The following fields include info from popular formats: AVI, MOV, and WMV.
meaning: Author named in the video file's container metadata.

name: commissioned
desc: Lists the name of the person or organization that commissioned the subject of the file.
meaning: Person or organization that commissioned the video's subject.

name: copyright
desc: Records the copyright information for the file.
meaning: Copyright information recorded in the video file.

name: engineer
desc: The engineer who worked on the file.
meaning: Engineer credited in the video file's metadata.

name: geolocation
desc: Optional geo-location information in WGS 84.
meaning: Optional latitude and longitude recorded with the video clip.

name: keywords
desc: Provides a list of keywords that refer to the file or subject of the file.
meaning: Keyword list stored in the video file's container metadata.

name: make
desc: The camera make such as Apple, Samsung etc.
meaning: Camera manufacturer recorded in the video metadata.

name: medium
desc: Describes the original subject of the file.
meaning: Description of the original subject or medium of the file.

name: metadata
desc: Container level metadata
meaning: Container level metadata entries for the video file.

name: model
desc: The camera model such as iPhone7 or Pixel, etc.
meaning: Camera model recorded in the video metadata.

name: software
desc: Identifies the name of the software packages used to create the file.
meaning: Name of the software used to create the video file.

name: sourceProvider
desc: Identifies the name of the person or organization who supplied the original subject of the file.
meaning: Person or organization who supplied the original subject of the file.

name: subject
desc: Describes the contents of the file.
meaning: Description of the file contents stored in the container metadata.

name: technician
desc: Identifies the technician who digitized the subject file.
meaning: Technician credited with digitizing the subject file.

name: videoVendorId
desc: Video vendor ID
meaning: Identifier of the video vendor from the container metadata.

name: altitudeE2
desc: Altitude is in meters and multiplied by 100 (i.e., in centimeters). Up till 10 km this fits in 3 bytes.
meaning: Altitude of the video recording in centimeters.

name: latitudeE7
desc: Latitude and longitude are in degrees and multiplied by 10^7. This gives the worst precision of about 1 cm at the equator.
meaning: Latitude of the video recording stored as degrees times ten million.

name: bitrate
desc: Video bitrate in bits/s.
meaning: Video bitrate in bits per second.

name: codecId
desc: Video codec ID. Uses the numeric value corresponding to the CodecId enum object, in order to avoid the dependency on vsi/videostreaminfo.proto.
meaning: Numeric identifier of the video codec used.

name: fps
desc: Video frame per second, obtained by parsing video header information. The value can be inaccurate for some types of codecs. See comments at
meaning: Frames per second read from the video header.

name: lengthSec
desc: Video length, in seconds. This value is derived from metadata in the source video, and often differs from the actual duration of any given transcode. In videos without valid timestamps, this value is not calculable, and is reported as zero.
meaning: Length of the video in seconds as read from source metadata.

name: streamIndex
desc: Index of the stream in the file, 0-based.
meaning: Zero based position of this stream within the file.

name: width
desc: The video stream's width and height. Important notes: 1) These are the coded dimensions of the video stream and DO NOT take into account any rotation metadata that may be present in the video container. Prefer to use the MediaOverview::resolution and MediaOverview::orientation when possible. 2) In the case you want detailed displayed width/height information, you can use the MediaOverview::orientation to determine the displayed dimensions. E.g., in the case of PORTRAIT orientation: displayed_wid
meaning: Coded pixel width of the video stream before rotation is applied.

name: profile
desc: video profile
meaning: Encoding profile of the video stream.

name: fileHeaderFingerprint
desc: Input file header fingerprint
meaning: Fingerprint computed from the input file header.

name: videoNumberOfFrames
desc: Number of Video frames Warning: running video::FfmpegVideoFileInformation() won't set this info Ffmpeg tool does not report the number of frames accurately. We can't rely on fps and video length. So we will set this after we processed every frame using the filter framework
meaning: How many video frames the file contains.

name: pixFmt
desc: Pixel format for the video stream.
meaning: Pixel format of the video stream.

name: fileMagic
desc: The file type string returned by libmagic, a third party library. It might accidentally include some user content. Some normal file_magic examples: -- RIFF (little-endian) data, AVI, 1016 x 696, 30.00 fps, video: XviD, audio: (stereo, 48000 Hz) -- MPEG sequence, v2, program multiplex -- ISO Media, MPEG v4 system, iTunes AVC-LC -- Microsoft Windows Movie Maker project file
meaning: File type description string returned by the libmagic library.

name: isImageFile
desc: True if the video is actually an image file (JPEG, PNG, GIF, etc) and not a video file.
meaning: Whether the file is actually a still image rather than a video.

name: videoHasNonMonotonicPts
desc: video has non-monotonic PTS.
meaning: Whether presentation timestamps in the video go backwards.

name: numTimedtextStreams
desc: Total number of timedtext streams in the file
meaning: How many timed text streams the file contains.

name: videoFps
desc: video frame per second, obtained by parsing video header information. It could be inaccurate for some types of codecs, notably, WMV, ASF, and FLV. It will be inaccurate for videos that does not have constant frame rate since it is the smallest framerate that can accurately represent all timestamps (see ffmpeg doc for AVStream.r_frame_rate). Also frame rate can be parsed from headers and can be wrong if it is not available there since ffmpeg uses a heuristic for determining it.
meaning: Frames per second parsed from the video header.

name: videoNumberOfInvisibleFrames
desc: Invisible frame count Keep a count of frames that are not displayed should the full frame count be needed for the video stream. The only codec currently reporting this value is VP8 with alternate reference frames enabled
meaning: Count of frames that are decoded but never displayed.

name: videoHasNonMonotonicDts
desc: video has non-monotonic DTS (potential problem)
meaning: Whether decode timestamps in the video go backwards.

name: audioChannels
desc: audio channels
meaning: Number of audio channels in the file.

name: videoPixelAspectRatio
desc: video pixel aspect ratio
meaning: Pixel aspect ratio of the video.

name: videoClipInfo
desc: Video clip information, such as copyright, title, and author.
meaning: Container metadata for the clip such as copyright, title, and author.

name: videostreaminfoVersion
desc: Version number of the videostreaminfo application that generated this protobuf.
meaning: Version number of the tool that produced this stream info record.

name: audioFrameSize
desc: audio frame size
meaning: Size of an audio frame.

name: videoHasNonZeroStartEditList
desc: video (MOV) has a possibly av desync issue due to edit lists not starting at 0
meaning: Whether edit lists start at a nonzero point, risking audio video desync.

name: numDataStreams
desc: Total number of data streams in the file
meaning: How many data streams the file contains.

name: avDistance
desc: Audio-Video interleaving distance between packets (in bytes)
meaning: Byte distance between interleaved audio and video packets.

name: audioLength
desc: audio length in seconds Note that when the VSI is from users videos, it is not guaranteed to be the same as transcode lengths and it could be 0 when the full VSI cannot compute the length from the source header and timestamps (for example when header and timestamps are too broken).
meaning: Length of the audio in seconds.

name: parsedByInHouseParsers
desc: True if the file was successfully parsed by in-house parsers. Unset if parsing wasn't attepmted.
meaning: Whether in-house parsers successfully parsed the file.

name: videoHasPossibleOpenGop
desc: video has possible open GOP
meaning: Whether the video may use open groups of pictures.

name: fileName
desc: Input file name. DEPRECATED; don't expect the file name to be correct.
meaning: Input file name, marked deprecated and not to be trusted.

name: numVideoStreams
desc: Total number of video streams in the file
meaning: How many video streams the file contains.

name: audioSampleSize
desc: Number of meaningful bits per decoded audio sample. This is an implicit conceptual meaning. This is
meaning: Number of meaningful bits per decoded audio sample.

name: containsChapters
desc: If the video contains chapters info.
meaning: Whether the video contains chapter information.

name: containerType
desc: Name of the container format guessed by ffmpeg.
meaning: Name of the container format guessed by the parser.

name: audioBitrate
desc: audio bitrate in bits/s
meaning: Audio bitrate in bits per second.

name: containerId
desc: Container Id.
meaning: Identifier of the media container format.

name: videoInterlace
desc: Information on interlaced video.
meaning: Information about whether the video is interlaced.

name: partialFile
desc: By default we assume that the entire file was given computing the VSI - if that is not true this flag should be set to true.
meaning: Whether the stream info was computed from only part of the file.

name: avLength
desc: Audio and video length in seconds. It's the max of the audio and video length. Note that when the VSI is from users videos, it is not guaranteed to be the same as transcode lengths and it could be 0 when the full VSI cannot compute the length from the source header and timestamps (for example when header and timestamps are too broken).
meaning: The longer of the audio and video lengths in seconds.

desc: Byline date for time sensitive snippets. Most of the time it originates from quality_timebased::SyntacticDate and it is floored to PT midnight.
meaning: The date shown alongside time-sensitive snippets.

name: listSummary
desc: List summary phrase for list pages.
meaning: A summary phrase used for pages that are lists.

name: snippetRenderedToken
desc: How tokens are rendered in generating snippet.
meaning: How each token was rendered when building the snippet.

name: sectionHeadingAnchorName
desc: If requested, the snippet generator may take note of query items present in an entry in an on-page table-of-contents (i.e. a series of on-page links to named anchors.) If so, these two fields contain the formatted and highlighted entry and the name of the on-page anchor it links to, respectively. This may be used by GWS to show a direct link to that named anchor on the page.
meaning: The matched table-of-contents entry and the on-page anchor it links to.

name: obsoleteManybox
desc: ManyboxData
meaning: An obsolete placeholder for Manybox data.

name: orionEntities
desc: DEPRECATED If requested, the orion entities
meaning: A deprecated set of entities found in the document.

name: sentimentSnippets
desc: DEPRECATED Sentiment snippets
meaning: Deprecated sentiment-based snippets.

name: findyTidbits
desc: A bitvector of the tidbits in the snippet that are appropriate for the Quick Scroll (Findy) Chrome extension. Typically these contain "extra body matches", i.e., important query items not in the title.
meaning: Marks which snippet pieces suit the Quick Scroll browser extension.

name: answerDocMatches
desc: A list of answers that had at least one hit in the document. Answers are identified by their index into the QRewriteQueryParams_AnswerSnippetInfo array (see //query/proto/query-params.proto).
meaning: Which prepared answers had a match inside the document.

name: scienceInfo
desc: Abbreviated bibliographic data from Google Scholar.
meaning: Short bibliographic details for the document from Google Scholar.

name: titleLengthAdjustedForBrowserWidth
desc: True if the title length is already adjusted for the browser width. If it is true, GWS needs not truncate the title.
meaning: Whether the title was already shortened to fit the browser width.

name: snippetsRanklabFeatures
desc: Records features to analyze titles/snippets in ranklab.
meaning: Recorded features about titles and snippets for offline analysis.

name: isLoginPage
desc: True if the document represents a login page.
meaning: Whether the document looks like a login page.

name: docPreviewRestrictionsForAmp
desc: DocPreviewRestrictions for amp result.
meaning: Rules limiting how much of the AMP version of the page can be previewed.

name: siteDisplayName
desc: The domain-level display name of the website, such as "Google" for google.com. See go/site-display-name for more details. As of Aug 2023, this field is being deprecated in favor of
meaning: The friendly site name shown for the result, now being replaced.

name: docPreviewRestrictions
desc: DocPreviewRestrictions for canonical url.
meaning: Rules limiting how much of the page can be previewed.

name: truncatedTitle
desc: Only for desktop web search. Please refer to Title.keep_original_title_and_populate_truncated_one for more details.
meaning: A shortened version of the title.

name: snippetPageNumber
desc: If requested the page number on which the snippet begins. (Only for documents such as PDFs where page numbers are well-defined.)
meaning: The page number where the snippet starts, for paged documents like PDFs.

name: seenNotTerm
desc: Did a negative query term match the meta description?
meaning: Whether a negative query term matched the meta description.

name: numTokensSkippedByInDocRestrictionsInScoring
desc: Number of tokens that is skipped because of in doc restrictions during scoring. This is an estimate, as the list of tokens is cached in TokenInfoManager. We should only monitor the cases where this number is too big or non-zero.
meaning: A count of tokens skipped while scoring, kept for monitoring.

name: snippetHighlightMatchesBitmap
desc: List of bitmaps representing matches to leaf query terms within each of the highlighted snippet text fragments. Consecutive bitmaps correspond to consecutive text fragments. It gets populated iff return_query_snippet_highlight_matches = true. Example: document body section: "This cafe has pet friendly patio." squery: (a (o dog :o pet :syn:general) friendly :o (o restaurant :o cafe :syn:general)) Let's assume the returned snippet text contains the whole document body section where two f
meaning: Bitmaps marking query term matches inside each highlighted snippet fragment.

name: obsoleteLocalinfo
desc: LocalWWWInfo
meaning: An obsolete placeholder for local information.

name: longStructuredSnippet
desc: Returned if want_long_structured_snippets. If present, caller should ignore the normal snippet.
meaning: A longer structured snippet that replaces the normal snippet when present.

name: listSnippet
desc: List snippet data.
meaning: Snippet data formatted as a list.

name: squeryFingerprint
desc: This field is never set.
meaning: A query fingerprint field that is never set.

name: isValidResult
desc: Assume this is true unless we discover that the result doesn't match the the query, in which case this result is invalid despite having returned docinfo.
meaning: Whether the result actually matches the query and should be kept.

name: info
desc: Additional data. Currently, this is used for sitelinks, localinfo, manybox, discussion metadata, richsnippets, similarpages and breadcrumbs.
meaning: A bundle of extra result data such as sitelinks, rich snippets, and breadcrumbs.

name: languageScore
desc: A list of watchpage languages predicted arranged according to their scores.
meaning: Predicted languages for a video watch page, ordered by score.

name: usesSpeechSignals
desc: Does the prediction uses speech signals like audio language.
meaning: Whether the language prediction used audio or speech input.

name: version
desc: An identifier to recognize the model version used for this prediction.
meaning: Which version of the language model produced the prediction.

name: score
desc: Score for the predicted language by the WatchPage Language model.
meaning: The model's confidence for a predicted watch page language.

name: watchpageLanguage
desc: The language predicted by the WatchPage Language model.
meaning: A language the model predicts for the video watch page.

name: predictions
desc: Versioned WatchPageLanguageResults. This is to experiment and launch new models. The first prediction is the latest production version.
meaning: Predictions from each model version, with the production one first.

name: watchpageLanguage
desc: The language predicted by the V1 WatchPage Language model. For new and experimental versions use versioned_language_result.
meaning: The language predicted for the watch page by the first model version.

name: tag
desc: Tag that specifies the use-case within provider's data. It appears as a string in Alexandria signal and in the DocJoins. During the indexing stage this field will be converted to a 64-bit fingerprint to save space. See the "tag_fp" field, below.
meaning: A label naming which use case within a data provider's feed this came from.

name: tagFp
desc: A fingerprint of the "tag" field, automatically calculated during the indexing stage. Will be used as a key for fetching the data.
meaning: A fingerprint of the provider tag used as a lookup key.

name: startUnixTime
desc: Start and end times should always appear. Marked as optional to avoid breaking code.
meaning: The start time of a live result's relevant time window.

name: privateDoNotAccessOrElseSafeHtmlWrappedValue
desc: IMPORTANT: Never set or read this field, even from tests, it is private. See documentation at the top of .proto file for programming language packages with which to create or read this message.
meaning: A private internal wrapper for HTML text that callers must never touch.

name: detail
desc: Provides fetcher-specific detail about how source satisfied the request.
meaning: Notes on how the fetcher satisfied a content fetch request.

name: source
desc: The fetcher that ultimately satisfied this fetch request.
meaning: Which fetcher ultimately served this fetch request.

name: currencyCode
desc: Currency code the user uses to purchase this Super Thanks item.
meaning: The currency used for a paid comment purchase.

name: entitlementId
desc: The ID of the Super Thanks entitlement. It uniquely identifies a Super Thanks purchase. This field is deprecated in favor of transaction_id, see go/st-deprecate-ent-id.
meaning: A deprecated purchase identifier for a paid comment.

name: priceInMicros
desc: Price of Super Thanks item the user purchases in micros.
meaning: The price paid for a paid comment item.

name: superVodItemId
desc: The Super Thanks item the user purchases, it represents price tier.
meaning: Which price tier of paid comment item was bought.

name: transactionId
desc: The ID of the Super Thanks transaction. It uniquely identifies a Super Thanks purchase.
meaning: The transaction identifier for a paid comment purchase.

name: version
desc: Which version of experiment this Super Thanks comment is posted in.
meaning: Which experiment version the paid comment was posted under.

name: demotedRestrictionSeverity
desc: Output only. The severity of the active demotion. At most one CommentDemotedRestriction can be active at any time. Only supported for Comments with an associated ChatEvent.
meaning: How severe the active demotion on a video comment is.

name: exemptFromHold
desc: Output only. True if the comment is auto-approved by creator-defined roles and is not subject to automod hold.
meaning: Whether the comment skips moderation hold because its author is trusted.

name: held
desc: Output only. True if the comment is held and going to be reviewed by channel owner or moderators. The issuers that can hold entity comments are: 1) TNS 2) AUTOMOD, 3) CHANNEL_SETTINGS, 4) CHANNEL_MODERATOR, 5)GLOBAL, 6) ISSUER_UNSPECIFIED. The issuers that can hold live chat are // 1) AUTOMOD, 2) GLOBAL, 3) ISSUER_UNSPECIFIED. Issuer definitions:
meaning: Whether the comment is held for review by the channel owner or moderators.

name: heldForCreatorReviewStatus
desc: Output only. The moderation state of comments that have been held. Currently only effective for live chat because we can not tell the rejected creator review status for entity comments from current data model.
meaning: The review state of a comment that was held.

name: moderated
desc: Output only. True if the comment is moderated and not overridden by creator reviews.
meaning: Whether the comment is moderated and not overridden by a creator review.

name: moderatedByBlockedWords
desc: Output only. True if the comment is moderated due to any of the creator-defined blocked words.
meaning: Whether the comment was moderated for containing a creator-blocked word.

name: moderatedByChatRemoval
desc: Output only. Live Chat only. True only if the live chat message is directly moderated by a privileged user from Live Chat chat room. go/ytfexit-live-chat-moderation#remove-chat-messages
meaning: Whether a live chat message was removed directly by a privileged user.

name: moderatedByTns
desc: Output only. True if the comment is moderated by TnS. Maps to SBE Spam
meaning: Whether the comment was moderated by the trust and safety system.

name: rejected
desc: Output only. True if the comment is rejected or taken down by TNS.
meaning: Whether the comment was rejected or taken down.

name: userModerationDecision
desc: Output only. The moderation decision on comments from privileged users. This field can be used to take place of
meaning: The moderation decision made by a privileged user on the comment.

name: moderationStatus
desc: The moderation status of comments due to privileged user decision. Privileged user can manually reject comments in multiple ways or approve held comments.
meaning: The moderation status resulting from a privileged user's decision.

name: rejectType
desc: For comments with REJECTED status, it can result from privileged users directly rejecting comments or reviewing comments that have been held, for both entity comment and live chat, but reject type is only captured for live chat because we are not able to distinguish the 2 types from data model for entity comment.
meaning: How a rejected comment came to be rejected, recorded only for live chat.

name: autoModEnforcements
desc: Live chat auto moderation only. The HOLD decisions and whether they are enforced correspondingly.
meaning: The automatic hold decisions on a live chat message and whether they applied.

name: createTime
desc: Required. The creation time of this restriction.
meaning: When the comment restriction was created.

name: externalCommentId
desc: Required. The external ID of the comment that this restriction described.
meaning: The identifier of the comment this restriction applies to.

name: issuer
desc: Required. The system who moderated the comment. For CommentModeratedRestriction all issuer enums apply."Issuer" is different from the grouping for permission check, which will be enforced via Boq Scaffolding RpcSecurityPolicy.
meaning: Which system moderated the comment.

name: reason
desc: Required. The specific restriction reason why the comment is moderated. When Automod issues multiple HOLD decisions for a chat message, they always share the same reason.
meaning: The specific reason the comment was moderated.

name: reviewable
desc: True if moderation comes from T&S, Automod, and some of channel owner settings and comments will be put into "Held For Review" queue for channel owner review. After any creator review, this restriction will remain in this status to capture the original restriction. True maps to ModerationState=HOLD in Stanza. False if moderation results from channel owner manual opertation or author in hidden user list, and maps to ModerationState=REJECTED in Stanza.
meaning: Whether the restriction puts the comment in the creator's review queue.

name: status
desc: Required. For moderated restriction on comment and live chat but not issued by Automod, the field should be always set to ACTIVE. For Automod moderation on live chat, the restriction is active as long as one of the HOLD decisions is enforced. Can only be changed by upcoming QPS threshold configuration changes and backfills.
meaning: Whether the comment restriction is currently active.

name: updateTime
desc: The timestamp when this restriction is updated.
meaning: When the comment restriction was last updated.

name: enforced
desc: Whether or not the decision is enforced.
meaning: Whether an automatic moderation decision was actually applied.

name: name
desc: Current the enforcement rule depends on live chat write QPS at chat message creation time. Enforce MEDIAN when QPS<=4. Enforce HIGH_RECALL when QPS>4 AND QPS<=10. Enforce ULTRA_HIGH_RECALL when QPS>10.
meaning: Which automatic moderation rule was used, chosen by current chat traffic rate.

name: channelModeratorDetails
desc: Only set when the issuer type is CHANNEL_MODERATOR.
meaning: Details about the channel moderator who issued the restriction.

name: channelOwnerDetails
desc: Only set when the issuer type is CHANNEL_OWNER.
meaning: Details about the channel owner who issued the restriction.

name: isDeleted
desc: Whether a comment is from deleted shares. See stanza_restrictions for more specific information and is_publicly_visible for comments which are allowed to be seen by everyone.
meaning: Flag saying the comment came from a deleted share.

name: numRepliers
desc: Number of different repliers the comment has.
meaning: How many different people replied to the comment.

name: ytReplyToItemId
desc: For replies to replies, this contains the parent reply's id. The parent_id field is actually the root stanza_id (not guaranteed AFAIK).
meaning: Identifier of the specific reply this comment answers.

name: detailedLanguageCode
desc: The language code with extra script details. This is derived from detailed_language_code if it's populated, otherwise the same as language_code. E.g. mr-Latn
meaning: The comment's language code including script details.

name: textEmbedding
desc: Comment text embedding.
meaning: Numeric vector representation of the comment text.

name: contentUpdateTimestamp
desc: The stanza content last update timestamp, as observed by the server. Note that for many comments older than Nov. 2014 this is unset in the original stanza. MiniStanza tries to be consistent with the original so for such comments it remains unset in MiniStanza. If you use this field you should check has_content_update_timestamp().
meaning: When the comment record was last updated on the server.

name: channelId
desc: The channel of the video or post this comment belongs to. In certain circumstances a video can belong to multiple channels, this channel_id does not handle that situation well. go/yt-identity-overview for further reading.
meaning: Which channel the commented video or post belongs to.

name: textQualityScores2
desc: Predicted probability of the comment being flagged based on the text. For testing the new annotation process only.
meaning: Test-only copy of the predicted chance the comment gets flagged.

name: isPinned
desc: Whether the comment is pinned. This is derived from YTMS and may be out of sync with other fields (a day early or behind).
meaning: Flag saying the comment has been pinned to the top by the creator.

name: creationTimeInSeconds
desc: The time when the comment is created.
meaning: When the comment was posted.

name: ytCommentQualityScore
desc: Existing quality corpus scores.
meaning: An existing quality rating for the comment.

name: textQualityScores
desc: Predicted probability of the comment being flagged based on the text.
meaning: Predicted chance the comment gets flagged, based on its text.

name: superThanksInfo
desc: Super Thanks related info if a comment is posted through a Super Thanks purchase.
meaning: Details about a paid Super Thanks purchase attached to the comment.

name: wordEntropy
desc: Word entropy of the comment.
meaning: A measure of how varied the words in the comment are.

name: endUserDeleted
desc: Whether a comment is deleted by the end user.
meaning: Whether the author deleted the comment.

name: commentClassificationBuckets
desc: List of pre-defined classification score buckets to which the comment belongs. E.g. satisfaction_v1_percentile_80.
meaning: Which preset score buckets the comment falls into.

name: parentId
desc: The parent stanza's stanza_id, empty for top-level posts (non-replies). Prefer is_reply field for checking if a comment is a reply since that is unaffected by surrogatization. For replies to replies, this is the root stanza_id (not guaranteed AFAIK).
meaning: Identifier of the comment this one hangs off of.

name: mustDeleteComments
desc: Whether a comment's author channel is deleted. Populated from
meaning: Flag saying the comment author's channel has been deleted.

name: offlineEngagementScores
desc: Offline engagement scores map. Keyed by various model names.
meaning: Precomputed model scores for how much engagement a comment gets.

name: empiricalCtrs
desc: Comments empirical CTRs.
meaning: Measured click-through rates for the comment.

name: postId
desc: The post this comment belongs to.
meaning: Identifier of the post the comment belongs to.

name: sensitivityScores
desc: Sensitivity scores map for smart reply sensitivity scores. Keyed by model names. See (g3doc/company/teams/expander/research/conversation/sensitive.md) for more information on sensitivity scores.
meaning: Model scores rating how sensitive a comment is for smart reply purposes.

name: misinfoScores
desc: Misinfo scores map. Keyed by various model names.
meaning: Model scores estimating whether a comment contains misinformation.

name: languageCode
desc: Unicode CLDR language code of the segments, as implemented by //depot/google3/java/com/google/i18n/identifiers/LanguageCode.java This is derived from user_content and should be considered the canonical language code of the comment.
meaning: The language the comment text is written in.

name: subjectIsVideoOwner
desc: Whether the comment is authored by the creator.
meaning: Flag saying the comment was written by the video's creator.

name: automodScores
desc: Automod scores map. Keyed by various model names. Deprecated. Consider using low_quality_scores instead.
meaning: Deprecated automatic moderation scores for a comment, keyed by model name.

name: lowQualityDecisions
desc: Low quality decisions. Keyed by decision types corresponding to secondary keys.
meaning: Decisions marking a comment as low quality, grouped by decision type.

name: distillerEngagements
desc: All distiller engagements like reports and downvotes.
meaning: Reader reactions to the comment such as reports and downvotes.

name: commentType
desc: Whether the comment is on a video, post, or other product.
meaning: Whether the comment is on a video, a post, or something else.

name: shortReplyVideoId
desc: Associated Short Reply video ID if the comment represents a Short Reply. See go/yt-comment-sticker-m2.
meaning: Identifier of the Short video attached when the comment is a Short Reply.

name: ansibleScores
desc: TnS Ansible scores map. Keyed by various model names.
meaning: Abuse model scores for a video comment, keyed by model name.

name: commentClassificationRanking
desc: Comment classification for ranking mapping all secondary keys to values. E.g. {"joke_v1":0.8, "joke_v2":0.7, "question_v1":0.3}.
meaning: Comment classification scores used for ordering comments.

name: videoId
desc: The video this comment belongs to.
meaning: Identifier of the video the comment belongs to.

name: mentionedTimestampCommentSecond
desc: Timed comments for the "mentioned" secondary key.
meaning: The point in the video, in seconds, that the comment mentions.

name: commentModeratedRestrictions
desc: Contains various comment moderated restrictions. Only available in the Atlas version. Extracted from
meaning: The history of moderation restrictions placed on the comment.

name: channelProfileQualityScores
desc: Channel profile quality scores map. Keyed by various model names.
meaning: Quality scores for the commenter's channel profile, keyed by model name.

name: subscriptionTimestamp
desc: The timestamp (in seconds) when the author subscribed to the channel.
meaning: When the comment author subscribed to the channel.

name: numDislikes
desc: Number of dislikes the comment has. num_likes and num_dislikes are retrieved from a different source than other fields and may be out of sync (a day early or behind).
meaning: How many dislikes the comment received.

name: isSubscriber
desc: If the comment author is publicly subscribed to the channel.
meaning: Flag saying the comment author publicly subscribes to the channel.

name: stanzaId
desc: Refers to the stanza this data is derived from.
meaning: Internal identifier of the record this data came from.

name: impersonationScores
desc: Impersonation scores map. Keyed by secondary key (score type).
meaning: Scores estimating whether a YouTube comment author is pretending to be someone else.

name: subject
desc: The author of the comment Prefer using yt_author_channel_id instead of subject when possible.
meaning: The account that wrote the comment.

name: segments
desc: A textual content for the context.
meaning: The actual text content of the comment.

name: eligibleQualifiedTeaserFilters
desc: The qualified comment teaser filters that this comment is eligible for. Refer to go/comment-teaser-design for more information.
meaning: Which comment teaser filters this comment qualifies for.

name: isAuthorSponsor
desc: If the author is a channel member (sponsor).
meaning: Flag saying the comment author is a paying channel member.

name: coverageSamplingEligible
desc: Whether or not this comment is eligible for comment classifier coverage sampling (in Kapla). Refer to go/coverage-monitoring-for-kapla-comment-classifiers for more information.
meaning: Whether this comment can be used in classifier coverage sampling.

name: smartReplies
desc: Smart replies for this comment. Keyed by model names.
meaning: Suggested canned replies generated for this comment.

name: hasCreatorReply
desc: If the comment has a creator reply.
meaning: Whether the video creator replied to the comment.

name: stanzaRestrictions
desc: Contains various restriction information about a stanza.
meaning: Restrictions limiting where or to whom the comment can be shown.

name: commentEnforcementStatus
desc: Contains the current status of comment enforcement. This provides a summary/aggregation of all restrictions (one per comment), while CommentModeratedRestriction provides the history of restrictions (multiple per comment). Extracted from
meaning: A summary of the current moderation status of the comment.

name: lastReplyTimestampUsec
desc: The time when last reply is created.
meaning: Time the most recent reply to this comment was posted.

name: numReplies
desc: Number of non-abusive replies the comment has.
meaning: How many non-abusive replies the comment received.

name: numSubscribersBucket
desc: Bucketed number of subscribers held by comment author.
meaning: Rough size bucket for the comment author's subscriber count.

name: numLikes
desc: Number of likes the comment has. num_likes and num_dislikes are retrieved from a different source than other fields and may be out of sync (a day early or behind).
meaning: How many likes the comment received.

name: charEntropy
desc: Char entropy of the comment.
meaning: How varied the characters in the comment text are.

name: hasCreatorHeart
desc: Indicator for whether there is creator heart on this comment.
meaning: Whether the video creator gave the comment a heart.

name: isPubliclyVisible
desc: If the post is publicly visible.
meaning: Flag saying the post can be seen by everyone.

name: creationDevice
desc: The creation device. Derived from shares:yt_creation_device
meaning: The kind of device the comment was written on.

name: commentClassification
desc: Comment classification mapping all secondary keys to values. E.g. {"joke_v1":0.8, "joke_v2":0.7, "question_v1":0.3}.
meaning: Scores saying what kind of comment this is, such as a joke or a question.

name: content
desc: The text content of the comment.
meaning: The text of the comment.

name: isReply
desc: Whether the comment is a reply.
meaning: Flag saying this comment is a reply to another comment.

name: ytAuthorChannelId
desc: The youtube channel id of the comment author. One person can have multiple channels and one channel can have multiple users. go/yt-identity-overview for further reading.
meaning: Identifier of the YouTube channel that wrote the comment.

name: channelDiscussionId
desc: The channel this channel discussion comment belongs to. Note that this will match channel_id for such comments.
meaning: Which channel discussion the comment belongs to.

name: lowQualityScores
desc: Comment low quality scores. Keyed by various model names. Rename from the old automod_scores.
meaning: Model scores rating how low quality a YouTube comment is.

name: sentiment
desc: Sentiment. This omits entity_sentiment and keeps only the polarity, magnitude, and score. Sentiment as currently implemented is not debiased and has limited language coverage. Please read go/comments-sentiment-access before using.
meaning: How positive or negative the comment text reads.

name: textLength
desc: Text length of the comment in UTF-16 code points. The encoding could change in the future.
meaning: How many characters long the comment is.

name: textEmbedding
desc: Comment text embedding.
meaning: Numeric vector representation of a YouTube comment's text.

name: flagPredictionScore
desc: Score produced by the user flag prediction model.
meaning: Model score predicting whether users will flag the comment.

name: flagPredictionVersion
desc: Version identifier of the flag prediction model.
meaning: Which version of the flag prediction model produced the score.

name: magnitude
desc: Total magnitude of the sentiment. A positive number representing the total intensity of sentiment regardless of positive vs negative polarity.
meaning: How strong the overall sentiment is, ignoring positive or negative direction.

name: polarity
desc: Polarity of the sentiment. Value is between -1.0 and 1.0 inclusive, with larger numbers representing more positive sentiment and negative numbers representing negative sentiment.
meaning: How positive or negative the text is, from -1 to 1.

name: score
desc: The average score over sentences. This combines the polarity and magnitude signals into one value. Bounded between -1.0 and 1.0.
meaning: Average sentiment across sentences, combining direction and strength.

name: entityName
desc: The representative entity name. This can be blank for cases when there is no explicit name like "I" or "it". The mentions' tokens can be used to get more details about each entity.
meaning: The name of the thing the sentiment is about.

name: magnitude
desc: Total magnitude of the sentiment.
meaning: How strong the sentiment toward this thing is.

name: mid
desc: MID for this entity, if available.
meaning: Knowledge Graph identifier for the thing the sentiment is about.

name: polarity
desc: Polarity of the sentiment. See above for detail.
meaning: How positive or negative the feeling toward this thing is.

name: score
desc: The per entity score between -1.0 and 1.0. Combines the signal from polarity and magnitude values.
meaning: Combined sentiment score toward this thing, from -1 to 1.

name: endToken
desc: Token end index in corresponding SAFT document (inclusive).
meaning: Where in the text this mention ends.

name: magnitude
desc: Total magnitude of the sentiment.
meaning: How strong the sentiment is at this particular mention.

name: polarity
desc: Polarity of the sentiment. See above for detail.
meaning: How positive or negative this particular mention is.

name: score
desc: The per mention score between -1.0 and 1.0. Combines the signal from polarity and magnitude values.
meaning: Combined sentiment score for this particular mention.

name: startToken
desc: Token start index in corresponding SAFT document.
meaning: Where in the text this mention starts.

name: entity
desc: The entity annotating the document.
meaning: The thing or topic being attached to a YouTube document.

name: format
desc: The annotation is a format annotation, i.e. it tells the format of the video.
meaning: Annotation describing what format the video is.

name: present
desc: The annotation is present in the video. Semantic Legos and Presence Legos naturally overlap and can contain the same entities. However, we do not enforce a strict subset relation.
meaning: Annotation saying the thing actually appears in the video.

name: semantic
desc: The annotation is a semantic annotation, i.e. it tells what the document is about and what the reasons to watch the video are. The annotation should be valid for the complete annotated document, not simply a part of the document such as a video segment.
meaning: Annotation describing what the video is about overall.

name: taxonomic
desc: The annotation is a taxonomic annotation, i.e. it tells to which class of the Legos taxonomy the document belongs to.
meaning: Annotation placing the video in a category of YouTube's topic taxonomy.

name: annotations
desc: The annotations for this document. For a given (entity, relationship type) pair, there will be at most one annotation. The list has no particular order.
meaning: The full list of topic annotations attached to a YouTube document.

name: debugName
desc: DO NOT USE THIS FIELD. The entity name here can be random garbage and when it's actually a name it will be in a random language (most of the time English but not always). This field is going away soon. For a replacement you should probably use the following RPC: cs/symbol:Ytpedia.GetNames please read go/ytks-calling details on how to call it and don't hesitate to write to us for help with this (or in any case before starting to send real traffic to us) at: g/yt-knowledge-service
meaning: An unreliable debug label for an entity that the docs say not to use.

name: kgId
desc: The ID of the Knowledge Graph entity. Note: this is the primary ID at generation time. See
meaning: Knowledge Graph identifier of the annotated entity.

name: confidence
desc: Format classification confidence score, in the 0-1 range. A score of XX% means that we expect at least XX% of the documents annotated with this format to be correctly annotated; i.e. thresholding at XX% yields a precision of at least XX%.
meaning: How sure the system is about the video's format label.

name: confidence
desc: Confidence score. Thresholding at the confidence score at 0.XX yields annotations of precision of at least XX%.
meaning: How sure the system is that the entity appears in the video.

name: contexts
desc: Extra context about how the entity relates to the document. Typically vertical-specific. Please refrain from populating this field as we're working on migrating most of the use cases to the LegosEntity proto so clients don't have to scan all relationships to know which annotations they may be interested in.
meaning: Extra detail about how the entity relates to the video.

name: confidence
desc: Confidence score. Thresholding at the confidence score at 0.XX yields annotations of precision of at least XX%. Only filled in the intent definition Legos. Please use IsSemanticAnnotationAtConfidenceThreshold() from video/youtube/discovery/legos/annotations/public/legos_annotations_util.h to obtain only intent definition Legos. For more information on the migration please look at go/legos-intent-migration.
meaning: How sure the system is that the video is about this entity.

name: topicalityScore
desc: DEPRECATED. Please use confidence instead. Will be set to the same value as confidence in early January 2019. See go/legos-intent-migration for more information.
meaning: Old topical relevance number, replaced by the confidence field.

name: subject
desc: The subject of the semantic relationship. This is set when the relationship is derived from some other entity. The exact meaning of this field depends on the ContextType.
meaning: The other entity a relationship was derived from.

name: type
desc: The type of semantic relationship between the document and the entity. This allows one to retrieve vertical-specific fine-grained information about the document.
meaning: What kind of relationship the video has to the entity.

name: isRedundant
desc: Set to true if the taxonomy annotation is redundant amongst the set of other taxonomy annotations for the same document, i.e. if there is at least one other taxonomy annotation that is a child node of this one.
meaning: Flag saying this category label is already covered by a more specific one.

name: score
desc: A score, in the 0-1 range, used to rank taxonomy annotations.
meaning: A number used to order a video's category labels.
